bsgyur bas/ san+d+raḥ/—sbyinapade/ sad+maḥsogs so/ /shi tu ka /sha la tu ka'o/ /sha yig pha rol la na mtha' can la tu ka ā ga ma yang na 'gyur te/ san shrad+dhā zhes pa la/ tu ga ā ga ma yang na bar byas/ sa tu'i sha tsu la sha tsu 'os/ta tsa/ na nya/ aṭa la sha'i tsha 'os yang na sha'ang tshar bsgyur bas/ sa.ā+oṃ hūṃd+dhā / dad pa'i sbyin pa 'am gshid zan gyi sbyin pa//— sa.ā+oṃ d+dhā/ nga mo hra swā da tsi nga mu ṇa ni bye༄ sna/nga ma las thung ngu la atsa la nga muṭa rtag tu'o/ /tshig mtha' ngam so sor bsdu ba'i mtha' can u pa d+mā thung ngu can las chopha rol gyi atsa la nga muṭa ā ga ma rtag tu 'gyur te/ ṭa gnas don u brjod don ma so sor bsdu ba'i don te/ ka lā par/ nga ṇa na u pa d+mā thung ngu can rnams dbyangs la gnyis so zhes pa dang gcig go/ /pra t+yang sto༅ zhes pa la/ pra t+yabyād+mā/ bdag nyid rab tu mchod/ de bzhin du / su gaṇa yī shaḥzhes pa la/ legs par bkra ba'i dbang phyug /— su gaṇ+ḍi shaḥ/ tshogs bzang dbang phyug /bha ga ban i ti/ zhes pa la/ bha ga bam+bi ti/— bcom ldan 'das zhes/ sogs so/ /pu maḥkha bo ma pa re/ pum gyi kha ya la am pha rol la'o/ /pum gyi ma yig khaya so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge am so sor bsdu ba pha rol can la sar 'gyur zhing sngon mar sna ldan mtshon byed 'dri ba'am yang na nga ro ā ga ma ster te/ pum ko ki laḥzhes pa la/ sum̐sko ki laḥ/ khubyug pho/— sum̐ sko ki laḥ/ sa maḥsu ṭi/ sam 5kyi suṭa la'o/ /sam gyi ma yig suṭa pha rol la sar 'gyur zhing sngon mar sna ldan mtshon byed 'dri ba 'am yang na nga ro ā ga ma sbyin par bya ste/ sam skarta zhes pa la/ saṃ skarta/ —kun tu byed po'am yang dag par byed po—/ —saṃskarta/ na: tsha bya pra shān/ pra shān ma yin pa'i na'i 'ang tsha ba la'o /pra shān ma yin pa'i na mtha' am so sor bsdu ba pha rol na yod pa'i tshab so sor 117—103

bsdu ba pha rol la rur 'gyur zhing sngon mar sna ldan mtshon byed 'dri ba'am yang na rjes su nga ro ā ga ma 'ang 'gyur te/ bha bān tshoni①ཿzhes pa la/ mdo 'dis na ru u khyad don/ kha ra ba sā na yorngi sardza byā yaḥ/ khar dang gnas med pa'i rnam par bcad bya'o/ /khar so sor bsdu ba pha rol na yod pa dang gnas med pa ste tshig mtha'i ra yig rnam par bcad byar 'gyur te/ rā3/ rnam bcad/rnam par bcad bya'i sa 'os/ rnam bcad sa/ sa tu'i sha tsu sogs kyis sa shar bsgyur bas/ bha r+pā spyodaḥ1/——a chod cig—bha r+pā bye / de bzhin du tsa krin tra hi zhes pa la/ tsa kri s+thā nyi/snye'akhor lo can bsrung bar mdzod/ tsa kri n+t+ra nyi/ pra shān ④gyi na rur mi 'gyur te/ pra shān ta no nyi/ zhes pa la/ pra shān+ta no ti/——rab tu zhi ba rgyas par mdzod/ ṭ+wā spe/ dz+nyān gyi pa la'o /dz+nyān rmi na yig pa yig dang pho ⑤can pha rol la ru ru yang na 'gyur te/ rur bsgyur na snga mar sna ldan mtshon byed dam yang na rjes su nga ro ā ga ma yang 'gyur te/ rur bsgyur ba'i phyogs la ra rnam bcad/ ku pu dag la ṅka pe dag yang na 'os/ rnam bcad yang na pe ru bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ dz+nyār+pā hi/——mi skyongabar mdzod/— dz+nyāḥpā nyi/ dz+nyā r+pā hi/—mi skyongabar mdzod/—dz+nyāḥpā nyi/ rur ma bsgyur ba'i phyogs la/ dz+nyād+mā ⑥ hi/snyemi skyong bar mdzod/— kā ṭ+wā mre ḍi te/ kān gyi bskyar ba la'o/ /kān gyi na yig bskyar ba pha rol la ru ru 'gyur zhing sngon mar sna ldan mtshon byed dam yang na nga ro ā ga ma'ang 'gyur te/ kān kān zhes pa la/ rmā ⑦skun/skyicil ci la/snyermās+thān/kaḥka sogs rnams la yang ngos rkor mi 'gyur ro/ /kas+thā di 6 tsa/ kaḥka la sogs pa rnams la'ang ngo / /kaḥka la sogs pa rnams kyi rnam bcad ni ku pu pha rol la rko sridang be+e dag tu 'gyur ba ma yin te/ kaḥkaḥzhes pa la/ kaskaḥ/117—104

snga ma'i mtha'i rnam bcad rgo shar so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge pha rol na yod pa'i khar dang po can la rnam bcad nyid du gnas te/ kaḥt+pa ru ciyubasogs so/ /bā sha ri—/ shar la yang na'o/ /snga ma'i mtha'i rnam bcad ni shar so sor bsdu ba pha rol la yang na pha rol gyi gzugs su bsgyur te yang na sa'o/ /ha riḥ/ she te/zhes pa la/ ha ri sgo te/snye'aphrog byed nyal/ kaḥṣan+de zhes pa la/ kaṣ+ṭhan+de/snyeci dum bur byed / kaḥsā dhuḥ zhes pa la/ kas+thā dhuḥcilegs sogs so/ /'grel par lung drangs pa/ kharba re sha ri bā bi sarga lo pa/ khar pha rol la sha ra la rnam par bcad bya yang na dbyi'o/ /khar pha rol na yod pa'i shar dang po can pha rol la rnam bcad yang na dbyi ste/ ha riḥ/ sgra ra ti zhes pa la/ ha ri sgra ra ti—/ —'phrog byed 'khor bar byed/—ha ri thru ra ti/ ha riḥsgu ra ti/—'phrog byed 'khor bar byed/'grel par lung drangs pa/ ta dṛ ha toḥka ra pa trostso stir de ba yoḥsuṭa ta lo pabyu/tata bṛ hata dag gi/ ka ra dang pa ti dag la chom rkun dang lha dag la suṭa ste ta dbyi ba 'ang ngo / /tata dang bṛ hata dag gi kar dang pa ti dag pha rol la rim pa bzhin chom rkun dang lha dag brjod pa la suṭa ā ga ma 'gyur zhing mtha'i ta 'ang dbyi khuste/ tata ka raḥ/ zhes pa la/ ta ska raḥ/—chomarkun/ thra had pa ti②ཿzhes pa la/ thra ha spa tiḥ/snyephur bu/ ku dwoḥṅka kau tsa/ ku pu dag la ṅka yu dag kyang ngo / /snga ma'i mtha'i rnam bcad ni ku ste ka sde'i dang po gnyis/ pu ste pa sde'i dang po gnyis pha rol la rim pa bzhin ka kha gnyis la rko dang pa pha gnyis la yu zhes par yang na 'gyur te/ ka dang pa brjod pa'i don no/ /kaḥka ro ti/ zhes pa la/ kaṅka ro ti/—cibyed/ —kaḥka ro ti/ na maḥ kha gaṅgā ya/zhes pa la/ na marja gar+sā ya/snyenam mkha'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /—namaḥkha gad+dhā ya/ kaḥ117—106

pu nā ra ma te/snyeslarayang rtse bar byed/ ha ris ra myaḥ/ zhes pa la/ sa sa dzuṣa sogs kyis ru ra'i ra la 'os ra phyis mdo 'dis ring por bsgyur bas/ ha rī ra myaḥ / ——'phrog byed mdzes pa/ sogs so/ /bi pra ti ṣe dhe pa ram̐ kā.oṃ/ dgag pa dang bral ba la pha rol gyi bya ba'o/ /dgag pa dang bral ba ste mdo gnyis kyi cho ga 'jug pa la pha rol te mdo phyi ma de'i bya ba 'jug pa shas che ste/ dper na ig gi atsa la yaṇa'o zhes atsa gang byung yang ya ṇar bsgyur ba thob kyang mdo phyi ma aka 'dra ba la ring po'o zhes pa'i phyi ma'i bya ba 'jug pa lta bu'o/ /e tat+ta doḥsu lo pophoko ra nanya sa mā se ha li/ e tata dang tata dag gi nanya'i tshig sdud dang ka ma yin pa'i hal la su dbyi'o/ /e tata dang tata dag gi nanya'i tshig sdud dang ka yig ma yin pa'i hal dang bo can pha rol la rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig su'i rjes dbyi ste/ a lhaṣaḥ/ bisnguḥzhes pa la/ e ṣa bijuḥ/ 'di khyab 'jug /saḥ ha riḥzhes pa la/ de'aphrog byed/— sa ha riḥsogs so/ /sophotsi lo pe tsa tat+yā da pū ra ṇi/ saḥ.atsa la dbyi la de rkang pa rdzogs pa la'o/ /tad la su byin pa'i saḥzhes pa'i rnam bcad ni atsa pha rol la dbyi zhing spyir btang phyis pa la mtshams mi sbyor yang de tshigs bcad kyi rkang pa rdzogs par byed pa la mtshams spyor te/ saḥ e ṣa zhes pa la/ mdo 'dis rnam bcad phyis be+er mtshams sbyor du bas/ me+e ṣa zhes pa byung ste/ 'grel par dper brjod tshigs bcad byung ba ni/ be+e ṣa dā sha ra bye rā maḥ/ be+e ṣa rā dzā yu byekhyu raḥ/ be+e ṣa karto ma hā t+yā gī/ me+e ② ṣa dī mo ma hā ba laḥ/ de bod skad du/ de 'di shing rta bcu pa'i bu dga' byed/ /de 'di rgyal po g.yul ngor brtan ④pa'o/ /de 'di gtong ba chen po rna ba can/ /de 'di 'jig pa stobs ni chen po'o/ /zhes pa 117—109

ste rkang pa'i dang po rnams su/ se ①ṣa zhes byung ba lta bu'o/ /i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa su sadheḥsru tāta pañca sarnya yaḥs mābhāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mtshams sbyor gyi mdo las mtshams sbyor lnga pa rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel kyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las mtshams sbyor lnga pa'i cho ga spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //bla ma dang 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar mtshams sbyor gyi cho ga rnams bshad zin nas/ da ni ming las tshig tu bsgrub pa su la sogs pa'i rab tu bya ba rnams 'chad par bya ste/ arba pa da dh+wa tu ra pra t+ya yaḥpā ti pa di shaṃ/ byings min pa rkyen med pa don dang ldan pa ming ngo / /byings ma yin pa ste byings la kṛta sogs kyi rkyen sbyin pas 'gyur grub pa/ su sogs dang ti sogs kyi rnam dbye'i rkyen med pa'i don dang ldan pa ni/ rtags sam—/ ming ngam/ sgra 'am/ pā ti pa di ka zhes bya ste/ su la sogs pa rnams 'jug pa'i yul lo/ /pra t+ya yaḥpa rabya/ rkyen pha rol la'ang ngo / /supa la sogs pa'i rkyen rnams ming gi pha rol tu sbyin par bya'o/ /su la sogs pa ni 'di rnams te/ su au dzas/ am loṭa shas/ ṭā rgyu bhis/ nge dz+nyā bh+yas/nga se sgyum bh+yas/ ngas os ām/ ji os supa/ rnam dbye 'di rnams kyi dang po'i gcig tshig gi u dang / mang tshig dzas kyi dza/ gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig gi ṭa / mang tshig gi sha /gsum pa'i gcig tshig gi ṭa/ bzhi pa/ lnga pa/117—110

drug pa/ bdun pa rnams kyi nga rnams dang / lnga pa'i nga se'i i/ bdun pa'i mang tshig gi pa rnams don dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba'i ming can no/ /bi bhat+tabya / rnam dbye'o/ /gong du bshad pa'i su la sogs pa rnams dang / 'og nas 'byung ba'i ti la sogs pa rnams la rnam dbye zhes bya'o/ /su la sogs pa nyer gcig po 'di rnams kyi'ang / su au dzas dang po don tsam brjod pa/ am skyob ①shas gnyis pa las kyi don/ ṭā sgyum bhes zhu gsum pa byed pa po/ nge sgyum bh+yas bzhi pa ched du bya ba/ nga si sgyum ⑦ bh+yas lnga pa byung khyang / ngas os chag drug pa 'byel pa/ ji os supa bdun pa gnas gzhi rnams la 'jug go/ /de rnams las dper na dang po'i gcig tshig su dang / gnyis tshig ā+oṃ mang tshig dzas lta bu thams cad la gcig tshig gnyis tshig mang tshig ste gsum gsum du gnas so/ /su paḥ/ supa'o/ /supa zhes smos pas so sor bsdu ba'i brda ste dang po'i gcig tshig su la bdun pa'i mang tshig gi pa sbyar bas su nas pa'i bar gyi rnam dbye bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig po thams cad go bar byed do/ /bh+yo ka yordi ba tsa ṣ+pe ka ba tsa ṣ+pe/ e ka dī dag gi gcig tshig gnyis tshig dag go/ /gcig gi skad dod e ka la rnam dbye rnams kyi gcig tshig kho na dang / gnyis kyi skad dod dī la gnyis tshig kho na 'jug go/ /ba hu 6 ba hu ba tsa rna/ ba hu la mang tshig go/ /mang po'i sgra ba hu zhes pa lta bu la mang tshig kho na 'jug go/ /da — rtags dang rnam dbye sbyor ba'i cho ga rnams ston par bya ste/ rtags de yang pho rtags mo rtags ma ning gi rtags dang gsum du yod la/ rtags gsum po de la'ang atsa'i mtha' can dang hal gyi mtha' can gnyis su gnas pa las—/ dang po atsa'i mtha' can pho rtags a thung mtha' can las/ rā ma 177—111

zhes pa'i rtags sam ming la dper brjod du bya ste/ rā ma la su/ de dbyi 'os u phyis/ sa sa dzuṣa sogs kyi mdos sa ra/ khar sogs kyi mdos ra rnam bcad byas pas/ rā maḥ/snyedaga'abyed/ rā ma la gnyis tshig /au pra tha ma yoḥpūrba sa bar+ṇaḥ/ dang po dag la snga ma 'dra ba'o/ /ming aka so sor bsdu ba'i mtha' can gyi pha rol tu rnam dbye dang po dang gnyis pa dag gi atsa dang po can rnams byung na/ de'i snga ma rtags mtha'i atsa de dang 'dra ba'i ring por 'gyur bas skabs 'dir yang a ring por bsgyur ba thob kyang / de'i dmigs bsal/nā di tsi/ ata itsa la ma yin no/ /aka gi nang tshan yin kyang rtags mtha' a yig la pha rol itsa snga ma 'dra ba'i ring por mi 'gyur bas a ring por mi bsgyur / etsa la 'phel ba 'os gnyis dag gis gcig 'phel bar bsgyur bas/rā mo/snyedaga'abyed dag /rā ma la mang tshig dzas/ tsu ṭu①/ tsu ṭu dag go/ /rkyen gyi thog ma'i tsu ste tsa sde dang ṭu ste ṭa sde rnams 'gro ba'i ming can te dz+ra phyis/ na bi bhakhyo tusmraḥ/ rnam dbye'i tu sra mra rnams ma yin no/ /rnam dbye'i ta sde dang /shas lta bu'i sa dang / am lta bu'i ma rnams ni 'gro ba'i ming can ma yin no / /dang po dag la sa ②ma 'dra ba 'os ring po/ sa sa dzuṣa sogs kyis sa ra/khar sogs kyis rnam bcad byas pas/ rā māḥ/snyedaga'abyed rnams/ e ka ba tsa ṣ+pe saṃ budhiḥ / gcig tshig la sa ①budhi'o/ /bod pa'i don du sbyin pa'i rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig la saṃ burnyi zhes ming 'dogs byed do/ /rā ma la bod pa'i don kyi su/ eng hra swāhūṃ budhi④ཿ/ thung ngu dang eng las saṃ budhi'o/ /atsa thung ngu rnams dang / eng so sor bsdu ba'i mtha' can las pha rol gye saṃ budhi dbyi bar bya ste/ saṃ budhi phyis/ bod tshig rnam dbye byin pa'i rtags su he sngon 117—112

du bzhag pas/ he rā ma/snyekyedaga' byed/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig gong gi rnam dbye dang po'i skabs ltar bsgrubs pas/ te rā mo/——kye dga' byed dag /terā māḥ/skyikye dga' byed rnams/ rā ma la rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gcig tshig am/ a mi pūrbaḥ/am la snga ma'o/ /rtags mtha' aka so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge yin na rnam dbye gnyis pa'i am rmi a yig snga ma'i gzugs su 'gyur te/ rā oṃ/ dga' byed la/gnyis tshig dang po'i gnyis tshig ltar bsgrubs pas/ rā mo/—dga' byed dag la/ rā ma la mang tshig shas/ la sha kwa tadhi te/ de phan ma yin pa la la sha ku rnams so//de phan gye rkyen ma yin pa'i rnam dbye dang / byings sgrub dang / kṛta sogs gang la'ang rkyen gyi thog mar gnas pa'i la yig dang / sha yig dang / ku ste ka sde rnams 'gro ba'i ming can te/ shra khyaphyis/ dang po dag la snga ma 'dra 'os ring por bsgyur/ tasmrats+tsha so naḥsum̐ si/ de las shas kyi na skyes pa la'o /skyes pa'i rtags 'dra ba'i cho ga byas zin pa'i pha rol gyi shas kyi sa yig ni na yig tu 'gyur te/ sa nar bsgyur bas/ rā mān/—dga' byed rnams la/ ra ṣā dz+nyā no ṇa sa mā na pa de/ ra ṣa dag las na'i ṇa rkang pa mtshungs pa la'o/ /rkang pa mtshungs pa ste tshig rkang gcig tu gnas pa'i ra yig dang ṣa yig dag las pha rol gyi na yig ni ṇar 'gyur ro/ /aṭa ku pāng nusbya bā yepho pi/ aṭa ku pu āng num rnams bar na yod kyang ngo / /tshu rol ra yig dang ṣa yig dag las pha rol gyi na yig ni aṭa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge rnams dang / ka dusde dang / pa sde dang / nyer bsgyur āng dang num ā ga ma rnams bar na yod kyang ṇar 'gyur bas—/ spyir btang na ṇar 'gyur ba thob kyang de'i yang dmigs bsal ni/na pa dān+ta su/ tshig mtha'i ma yin no/ /rgyu mtshan gong du smos pa de rnams 117—113

tshang yang tshig mtha'i na srog med ni ṇar mi 'gyur bas na nyid du gnas so/ /rā ma la gsum pa'i gcig tshig ṭā sbyin/ yasmrata pra t+ya ya bi dhi sta dā di pra t+ya yāṅge①/gang rkyen kyi cho ga rkyen de'i snga ma la aṅga'o/ /gang rkyen gyi gzhi 'am snga ma ste rtags de la zupha rol rkyen gyi cho ga 'byung ba'i phyir aṅga'i ming can zhes brda chad byed do/ /ṭā/ nga se nga sā mi nāṣ+ṭhaḥ/ ṭā nga si ngas rnams kyi i na ata mya rnams so/ /rtags a yig mtha' can aṅga zhes brda chad byas pa de'i pha rol rnam dbye gsum pa'i gcig tshig ṭā ni i na dang / lnga pa'i gcig tshig nga se ni ata / drug pa'i gcig tshig ngas ni gya rnams su 'gyur te/ ṭā/ i na/a las yon tan nos e/ ra ṣa dag la zhes pa'i mdos/ na ṇa/ rā me ṇaske/ — dga' byed kyis/ rā ma la/ gsum pa'i dz+nyā/ su pi tsa/ supa la'ang ngo / /rtags a thung mtha' aṅga'i ming can las/ supa la sogs pa'i rnam dbye yanya so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge byung na rtags mtha' ring por 'gyur ro/ /rā mā rgyu—/ ——dga' byed dag gis/ rā ma la/ gsum pa'i/ byes/ a to bhi sa is/ ata las bhisa'i isa'o/ /rtags a thung mtha' aṅga'i ming can las/ rnam dbye gsum pa'i mang tshig bhis ni is ru bsgyur ro/ /e tsa las 'phel ba dang /sa sa dzuṣa sogs kyis/ rā moḥ/snyedaga'abyed rnams kyis/ rā ma la/ bzhi pa'i nge /ngeḥyaḥ / nge ya'o/ /rtags a thung mtha' can aṅga'i ming can las pha rol gyi nge ni ya ru 'gyur te/ nge ya ru bsgyur/ supa la'ang ngos ring po/ rā mā ya/ —dga' byed kyi ched du/ rā ma la bzhi pa'i dz+nyā/ supa la'ang ngos/ dga' byed dag gi ched du/ rā mā rgyu/ rā ma la bzhi pa'i mang tshig bh+yas/ ba hu ba tsa ṣ+pe dzha byeta/mang tshig la dzhal la eta'o/ /rtags mtha' a thung aṅga'i ming can las/117—114 /

rnam dbye mang tshig dzhal gye yi ge dang po can gang byung yang rtags mtha' e yig tu 'gyur te/ rā me bh+yaḥ dga' byed rnams kyi ched du/ eta/ zhes bshad pa ni ta yig de'i dus kyi'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /rā ma la/ lnga pa'i nga si/ ṭā nga se ngas rnams kyi i na ata gya rnams so zhes pas/ nga se ata/ aka 'dra ba sogs kyis/ rā māta/—dga'abyed las/ rā ma la/ lnga pa'i rgyu dang bh+yas/ gong gi bzhi pa'i skabs ltar bsgrubs pas/ rā mā rgyu/ dga' byed dag las/ rāme bh+yaḥ—/ —dga' byed rnams las/ rā ma la/ drug pa'i ngas/ ṭā nga si sogs kyi mdos/rā ma su/— dga' byed kyi/ rā ma la/ gnyis tshig os/ o se tsa/ os la'ang ngo / /rnam dbye os pha rol la rtags aṅga'i ming can de e ru 'gyur ro/ /e tsa'i aya sogs dang / sa sa dzuṣa sogs kyi mdos/ rā ma yoḥ/ dga' byed dag gi/ rā ma la/ drug pa'i ām/ hra swa na byā po nuṭa/ thung ngu na dī āpa rnams las nuṭa'o/ /rtags mtha' thung ngu rnams dang na dī ming can te bud med kyi rtags yī spru gnyis dang āpa ste mo rtags ā ring mtha' can rnams las pha rol rnam dbye drug pa'i mang tshig ām la nuṭa ā ga ma ster te/ ṭa yig k+kita sogs kyi don u brjod don/ rā ma/ nām/ nā mi/ nām la'o/ /nām pha rol la rtags mtha'i atsa gang yin kyang ring por 'gyur te/ rtags mtha' ring po aṭa ku pu sogs kyi mdos/ nā shā/ dga' byed rnams kyi/— rā mā hūṃ/rā ma la/ bdun pa'i ji / nga 'gro ba'i ming can yin pas phyis/ a la yon tan nos/ rā me/——dga' byed la / rā ma la bdun pa'i os/ gong drug pa'i skabs ltar bsgrubs pas/ rā ma yoḥ/——dga' byed dag la/ rā ma la bdun pa'i mang tshig supa pa so sor bsdu ba'i don yin pas phyis/ mang tshig la dzhal la eta 'os/117—115

rā me su/ ā de sha pra t+ya ya yoḥ/ kun nas bsgyur ba dang rkyen dag la'o/ /tshu rol iṇa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge dang ka sde yod la/ pha rol ṣa sar bsgyur zin pa lta bu kun nas bsgyur ba dang / rkyen gyis tshig mtha' min pa rnams ṣa ru 'gyur te/ rā ①me 6/snyedaga' byed rnams la/ tshig mtha' yin na mi 'gyur te/ha rista tra/— 'phrogabyed de la/ zhes pa lta bu la tshu rol iṇa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge i mthong yang pha rol sa ṣar mi 'gyur bar sa nyid du gnas pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar atsa mtha' can skyes pa'i rtags las spyir btang a thung mtha' can gyi cho ga rnams bshad zin nas a thung mtha' can las dmigs bsal sarba la sogs pa'i cho ga rnams bshad par bya ste/ sar+pā dī ni sarba nā mā —/ sarba la sogs pa rnams la sarba'i ming can no/ /sarba la sogs pa ni 'di rnams te/ sarba/snyethams cad—/ bi shwa/snyesnatshogs/ ubha/snyeganyis/— u bha ya/ ḍa ta ra/ ḍa ta ma/ i ta ra/snyerang ngam tha dad/ a n+ya/——gzhan/ a n+ya ta ra/snyegazhan dang gzhan/ twata/——khyod/ṭa/—/ —rang / bye chab/snyekhrims/ ba/chab/ —mnyam pa/ cisachab/— sa cha'am mnga' zhabs/ ༷/41/——shar ram mdun nam sngon/ pa ra/snyepharol/ a wa ra/snyegazhan/ dak+ṣi ṇa/ —lho/ ut+ta ra/ —byang /phyag pa ra/— gzhan zhig/ phyagadha zab/snyedama' ba dang mchu/ swa/— mtho ris/ phyagan+ta zab/— bar mtshams/t+yad—/ —de/ tad/ sa/nga// —gang/ 6) tang// —de/ 6) nga)ma// —'di/ phyagadas/ —'di/6) ka / —gcig /dī/snyeganyis/ sdo/ṣ+ṭhad/ —khyod/ yi/smad/snyebadag /byas/ 'a ta/— yod/ kim/ ci rnams so/ /ḍa ta ra dang / ḍa ta ma ④gnyis ni ming min yang rkyen de gnyis gang la sbyar ba'i ming de yang sarba'i ming can du shes par bya'o/ /'di rnams ni rtags gsum cho ga thams cad 'jug rung yin no/ /sarba la rnam dbye dang po'i su dang au gnyis gong spyir btang a thung mtha' can rā ma'i skabs ltar 117—116

pa'o / /sarba'i ming can gyi nang tshan/ u bha la ni/ su sogs gcig tshig bdun dang dzas sogs mang tshig bdun mi 'jug /gnyis tshig bdun po kho na 'jug pas/ rnam dbye dang po la/ u r+bha/ gnyis pa la/ u bye/gsum pa la/ u bhā rgyu① / bzhi pa la/ u bhā dz+nyā②/ lnga pa la/ u bhā dz+nyā/drug pa la/ u bha ②yoḥ/ bdun pa la/ u bha yoḥ/ de rnams rnam dbye rnams kyi gnyis tshig kho nas grub pa'o/ /sarba'i ming can gyi nang tshan/ sgorba sogs la/ rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig gong ltar/ pūrbaḥ/pūrbo / mang tshig dzas kyi skabs yang na ba ste/ pūrba la/ dzas/ pūrba pa rā wa ra dak+ṣi khot+ta rā pa rā dha rā ṇi bya was+thā yā ma saṃ dz+nyā yī/ sgorba/ pa ra/ a wa ra/ dak+ṣi ṇa④/ ut+ta ra/ a pa ra/ a dha ra rnams rnam par bzhag pa ste ming ma yin pa la'o/ /sarba'i nang tshan/ pūrba sogs te pūrba nas/ a dha ra'i bar rnams la rnam par bzhag pa ste ming ma yin na sarba nā ma'i cho ga dang /ming yin na spyir btang a thung mtha' can rā ma'i cho ga ltar bsgrub pa'o/ /sgorbe/pūr+pāḥ / de bzhin swa'i sgra la dzas/ swa ma dz+nyā ti dha nā khyu yī⑤ / swa la gnyen dang nor dag la ma yin no/ /sarba'i nang tshan swa la gnyen dang nor dag dang sbyor ba'i tshe sarba'i ming can ma yin te/ sarba sogs kyi cho ga ltar dzas shīr mi 'gyur bar spyir btang a thung mtha' can kho na'i cho gas bsgrub skyepa'o/ /swāḥdz+nyā ta yaḥ/——mthoris zhes pa/ an+ta ra la dzas/ an+ta ram̐ ④ba nyispyo go pa saṃ byā na yoḥ/an+ta ra la phyi dang spyor ba gon pa dag las so/ /sarba'i ming can an+ta ra'i sgra la/phyi dang spyor ba dang gos gyon pa'i sgra sbyor ba'i tshe/ sarba nā ma'i bya ba mi 'jug pararka/ rā ma'i cho ga khe ④nas bsgrubs pas/ an+ta rāḥdang / phyi dang gon 117—118

pa'i don ma yin na sarba'i ming can ltar bsgrubs pas/ an+ta re/ pūṭ+wā di bh+yo na wa bh+yo bā/ pūrba sogs dgu las yang na'o/ /pūrba la sogs pa dgu las/rnam dbye lnga pa'i gcig tshig nga si dang / bdun pa'i gcig tshig ngi gnyis ni yang na ba ste/ spyir btang a thung mtha' can rā ma'i cho ga dang sarba nā ma'i cho ga gang rung 'jug pas/ lnga pa la/ pūr+pāta/ pūrba smrata/ bdun pa la/pūrbe / pūrba smin lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du/ pa rāta/ pa ras+thāta/ lnga pa/pa 3snare/ pa ra smin/ bdun pa ste/ de ltar pūrba nas/ an+ta ra'i bar thams cad rigs 'gre'o/ /sarba'i ming can rnams la nyer bsgyur sbyor ba dang /ming dang / sa ma la mnyam pa'i don/ swa la nor dang gnyen gyi don/ an+ta ra la phyi'i don rnams sbyor ba la sarba'i ming can ma yin te/ sarba nā ma'i cho ga rnams mi 'jug par spyir btang a thung can kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /de yang dper na/ a ti sar+pāḥ/—shin tu thams cad rnams/ zhes nyer bsgyur a ti yod pa'i sarba la dzas shīr mi 'gyur bar rā ma ltar bsgrubs pa lta bu'o/ /na ba hu bye ho—/ 'bru mang po la ma yin no/ /sarba sogs la 'bru mang po'i tshig sdud gnas pa la yang sarba nā ma'i cho ga rnams mi 'jug ste/ dper na/ thra ya sarba la/ nge byin pa smi ru mi 'gyur bar/ nge yar bsgyur bas/ pri ya sar+pā ya/ — dga' ba thams cad kyi ched du/ tro tī yā sa mā se/ gsum pa'i tshig snyud la'o/ /gsum pa'i tshig sdud ces pa de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba'i khyad par rnam dbye gsum pa tshig sbud kyis phyis pa dang skabs 'gar ma phyis kyang 'dra ste/ rtags sarba'i ming can rnams la sarba'i bya ba mi 'jug par spyir btang a thung mtha' can gyi cho ga byed pas/ dper na/ ma sa pūr+pā ya/snyematshungasapa'i sngon/snyem se na pūr+pā ya/117—119

lta bu'o/ /dwan+de tsa/ zlas dbye la'ang ngo / /rtags mtha' a yig sarba'i ming can tshig sdud kyi khyad par zlas dbye gnas pa las kyang sarba nā ma'i bya ba rnams mi 'jug pas spyir btang gi cho gas bsgrub 1pa'o/ /pūrba pa rā wa rā hūṃ/— shar pha rol gzhan rnams kyi/ suṭa mi 'jug nuṭa 'jug pa lta bu'o/ /bi bhā ṣā dza se/ dzas la gdam nga'o/ /sarba nā ma las/ zlas dbye'i tshig sdud gnas pa la sarba'i ming can gyi bya ba dang spyir btang a thung mtha' zucan kyi cho ga rnam dbye dang po'i dzas la gdam nga bya ste/ shī ru 'gyur ba dang aka 'dra ba'i cho ga gnyis ka 'jug pa'o/ /bar+ṇa shra me ta re/ bar+ṇa shra me ta rāḥlta bu'o/ /pra tha ma tsa ra ma tī yāsprarja ka ti pa ya ṣ+pe zhumābya/ pra tha ma/— dang po'am thog ma/ tsar ma/—pagasapa/ tī ya/ alpa/ —chungangu / ar+bha/ phyed/ ka ti pa ya/——jitsam/ ṣ+pe ma khrims rnams la yang ngo / /pra tha ma sogs la yang rnam dbye dang po'i mang tshig dzas ni sarba sogs kyi skabs ltar shī ru 'gyur ba dang spyir btang a thung mtha' can ltar aka 'dra ba'i cho ga gnyis kar 'jug pas gdam nga'o/ /pra tha me/snyedangapo rnams/snyepra thamāḥ/tī ya'i rkyen sbyar ba ni/ dī tī ye/— gnyis pa rnams/snyedwo tī yāḥlta bu'o/ /pra tha ma sogs la dzas ma gtogs rnam dbye lhag ma gzhan thams cad rā ma'i skabs dang 'dra'o—/ /'grel par lung drangs pa/ tīya su pih+phu bā sarba nā ma tā bā tsā/tī ya'i nga 'gro ba rnams la sarba'i ming can du yang na bshad do/ /tī ya'i rkyen la yang nga 'gro ba'i ming can rnams sarba'i bya ba dang / rā ma'i bya ba gnyis gdam nga can yin pas gnyis ka 'jug ste/ rnam dbye bzhi pa'i nge la/ dī tī yasmi—/ dī tī yā ya/ lnga pa/ dri tī yasmrata/ dī tī yāta/ bdun pa/dri tī yasmin/ dwa thu tī ye/ lta bu'o/ /lhag ma rnams rā ma dang 'dra'o/ /117—120

cad gnas pa'i ming can ma yin pa zhes dgos pa'i dbang gis ming 'dogs byed de/ dgos pa ni/ shas sogs thams cad gnas pa'i ming can ma yin pa rnams kyi snga ma'i ming de la rnam 'gyur byung ba'i phyir pa da 1zhes ming 'dogs byed de 'og nas ci rigs pa 'byung ngo / /ya tsi sgo/ ya atsal bha'o/ /ya'i rkyen dang shas sogs thams cad gnas pa'i ming can ma yin pa rnams kyi rnam dbye atsa ste dbyangs thog ma can rnams kyi snga ma'i ming ngam rtags de la dha 2zhes dgos pa'i ched du ming 'dogs byed do/ /aslo po naḥ/ na'i ata dbyi'o/ /rtags bha'i ming can gyi pū ṣan zhes pa lta bu'i pha rol du shas sogs thams cad gnas pa'i ming can ma yin pa atsa thog ma can pha rol la rtags mtha' na srog med kyi snga ma'i a de dbyi'o/ /pū ṣan la/ shas a phyis/ ra ṣa sogs kyi mdos na ṇa drangs/ pūṣ+ṭa snaḥpū ṣan la rgyu/ na lo paḥ/ pā nyi pa di tī ta su ming mtha'i na dbyi'o/ /ming mtha'i na srog med ni rnam dbye hal thog ma can rnams la dbyi ste na phyis/ pū ṣa rgyu / pū ṣan la/ bdun pa'i ji byen/bi bhā ṣā ji byeḥ/ ji shi dag la gdam nga'o/ /rnam dbye bdun pa'i ji dang shī ste/ma ning gi rtags la au shīr bsgyur ba gnyis kyi snga ma'i rtags mtha' na srog med gnas pa'i a dbyi ba dang mi dbye ba gang rung 'dam ka can du bya ste/pūṣ+ṭi—/ pū ṣa ṇi/ saṃ khyu bi sā ya pūrba sgyu t+na byesgyu ha na n+ya ta ra sde5ngo /grangs bi sā ya snga ma'i at+na'i a han ngi la yang na'o/ /grangs rnams dang nyer bsgyur bi dang / dgongs dz+wame'i skad dod/ sā ya rnams snga ma'i a t+na'i sbra ni rnam dbye bdun pa'i gcig tshig ngi la a han zhes par yang na 'gyur te/grangs thog ma can la/ dz+wa 8at+na la ngi sbyin pas/ drusne/ nyim gnyis/——dru ha ni/117—123

drusgo / snyenyim gnyis/ bi thog mar bzhag pa la/ byasgo/skyinyithal/——bya ha ni/ bya sgo / sā ya thog mar bzhag pa la/ sā yāsde/ sā yā ha ṣ+pe/ sā yāsgo/zhes pa lta bu'i gzugs gsum gsum byung ba'i rjes ma rnams na'i ata dbyi'o zhes pas bsgrubs pa'o/ /zhes pa de rnams ni skyes pa'i rtags las a thung mtha' can rnams so// //myu/ skyes pa'i rtags ā ring mtha' can la/ bi shwa pā/—sna tshogs 'thung /zhes pa'i rtags la dper brjod na/ bi shwa pā zhes pa la/ rnam dbye dang po'i gabyug tshig /su/ de dbyi 'os u phyis/ sa sa dzuṣa sogs dang / khar sogs kyi mdos bsgrubs pas/ bi shwa pāḥ/ au dang dzas la/ dz+re spyodz+dza se tsi/ring po las dzas itsa la'o/ /a yig ring po'i mtha' las pha rol kyi rnam dbye itsa so sor bsdu ba dang po can rnams dang dzas la/ dang po dag la snga ma 'dra ba'o—/ /zhes pa'i mdo'i cho ga 'jug pa ma yin te/ etsa'i 'phel ba dang /aka 'dra ba la ring po byas pas/ bi shwa po/ bi shwa pāḥ/ gnyis pa'i gcig tshig la/ am la snga ma 'os/ bi shwa r+pā/ gnyis tshig la/ bi shwa po/ mang tshig shas la/ ā to dh+wa toḥ/ byings kyi āta kyi'o/ /rnam dbye gnyis pa'i shas nas brtsams te/ bdun pa'i supa kyi bar gyi rnam dbye atsa thog ma can gang byung yang / rtags byings kyi ā ring mtha' can yin pa'i ā de dbyi ste/ā phyis pas/ bi shwa paḥ/ rnam dbye lhag ma'ang bshad ma thag pa'i cho ga ltar gyis bsgrubs pas/ gsum pa la/ bi shwa pā/ bi shwa pā dz+nyā/ bi shwa pā bhiḥ/bzhi pa la/ bi shwa pe/ bi shwa pā rgyu/ bi shwa pā bh+yaḥ/ lnga pa la/ bi shwa paḥ/bi shwa pā rgyu/ bi shwa pā bh+yaḥ/ drug pa la/ bi shwa paḥ/ bi shwa poḥ/ bi shwa dzā/717—124

bdun pa la/ bi shwa pi/ bi shwa poḥ/ bi shwa pā su/ bod tshig la/ te bi shwa pāḥ/ te bi shwa po/ he bi shwa pāḥ/ de bzhin du/ so ma pā/——zhi ba 'thung /tī 'do la pā/—chu 'thung / shaṃkhazla/— dung bzo ba/ hā hā/——dri za/ ghā/ rtswa la sogs pa mang po dag kyang bi shwa pā dang bya ba 'dra ba'o/ /zhes pa skyes pa'i rtags kyi ā ring mtha' can gyi bya ba bshad zin to/ /myu/ da ni skyes pa'i rtags i thung mtha' can gyi bya ba rnams bshad par bya ste—/ ha ri la/snye'aphrogabyed/ rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig /su/ sa sa dzuṣa dang khar sogs kyi mdos/ ha riḥ/ ha ri la/ au/ dang po dag la/zhes pas/ ha rī/ ha ri la dzas/ dza se tsa/ dzas la 'ang ngo / /ika so sor bsdu ba thung ngu rnams kyi pha rol rnam dbye dang po'i mang tshig dzas mthong na rtags aṅga'i ming can de yon tan du 'gyur te/ ha re/ dzas/ dza phyis/etsa' aya awa sogs kyi mdos/ ha ra yaḥ/ ha ri la/ kun tu bod pa'i gcig tshig saṃ burnyi'i ming can/ su/ hra swa su gu ṇaḥ/ thung ngu'i yon tan no—/ /ika thung ngu rnams saṃ burnyi la yon tan du 'gyur te/ he ha re/ su/thung ngu dang eng la zhes pas/ su phyis/ he ha re/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig gong rnam dbye dang po dang 'dra bas/ he ha rī/ he ra yaḥ/ ha ri la/gnyis pa'i am dang / ā+oṃ am la snga ma'o zhes pa dang / dang po dag la zhes pas/ ha ro/ ha rī/ ha ri la/ shas sha phyis/ dang po dag la zhes pas—/ ha rīs/ de yang shas kyi na skyes pa la'o/ /zhes pas sa srog med na/ha rīn/ ha ri la gsum pa'i/ ṭā/ she sngo sbya sa khi/ sa khi ma yin pa la lhag ma sgo'o/ /na dī ming can dang rtags ika so sor bsdu ba thung ngu rnams kyi 117—125

nang nas sa khi ma yin pa ste/ sa khi'i sgra bor ①ba'i ika thung ngu'i mtha' rnams kyi pha rol du rnam dbye lhag ma ste/ dang po dang gnyis pa ma yin pa'i rnam dbye gsum pa'i ṭā nas brtsams te/ bdun pa'i supa kyi bar pha rol du byung na rtags mtha'i dbyangs de la ghi zhes ming rtags byed de dgos pa'i ched du'o/ /ā ngo khunā ste yi/ bud med ma yin pa la āng gi nā'o/ /rtags mtha' spyi'i ming can gyi pha rol āng ste/ ṭā ni bud med kyi rtags ma yin pa la nār 'gyur ro / /ha ri shā/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la bya ba lhag po med pas/ ha ri dz+nyā/ ha ri bhikyeḥ/ ha ri la/ bzhi pa'i nge / bherdi ti/ sgo'i nga 'gro ba las so/ /rtags mtha' ghi'i ming can de pha rol rnam dbye nga 'gro ba'i ming can rnams dang phrad na rtags mtha' ghi'i ming can de yon tan du 'gyur bas/ ha re—/ nge / nga phyis/ etsa'i aya sogs kyi mdos/ ha ra ye/ ha ri dz+nyā/ha ri bh+yaḥ/ ha ri la/ lnga pa'i nga si/ ha ri/ nga si/ bshad ma thag pa'i mdos—/ ha re/ as/ nga se nga soḥtsa/ nga ṅga ngas dag gi yang ngo / /rtags mtha' eng so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge yod na pha rol rnam dbye lnga pa'i nga si dang / drug pa'i ngas gnyis kyi nga 'gro ba'i ming can phyis pa'i a de ni snga ma eng gi yi ge gang mthong ba de'i gzugs su 'gyur te/ ha reḥ/ ha ri rgyu/ ha ri ste④ཿ/ ha ri la/ drug pa'i/ ngas/ lnga pa dang 'dra bas/ ha reḥ/ha ⑤ ri/ os/ ika gi zhes pas/ haspyoḥ/ ha ri/ ām/ thung ngu sogs kyis nuṭa/ ra ṣa dag la zhes pas/ na ṇa/ nām la 'os rtags mtha' ring por 'gyur/ ha rī rde/ ha ri la/ ji / astsosteḥ/ ghi'i arta yang ngo / /rtags mtha' ghi'i ming can gyi pha rol du rnam dbye bdun pa'i ngi 117—126

byung na/ rtags mtha' ghi'i ming can de ata du 'gyur la/ yang gi sgras ji yang au ru 'gyur te/ ha ra/ go etsa la 'os/ ha ro/ haspyoḥ/ ha ri 6/ de bzhin du/ shrī pa ti/——dpal gyi bdag po/ me/ asni/ ra bi/——nyim/ka byu snyan ngag /la sogs pa mang po dag kyang ha ri dang bya ba 'dra'o/ /sa khi'i grogs posgra la cung mi 'dra ste/ sa khi la rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig su byin/ sa khi/su—/ a nang sau/ su la a nang ngo / /sa khi'i sgra la kun du bod pa'i don du sbyin pa'i saṃ budhi ma yin pa'i su la rtags mtha' a nang du 'gyur te/ sa khan/su / a lodh+yān+d+ra rba u pa jo/ al mtha' las snga ma u pa dh+wa'o/ /rtags mtha' al te gsal byed dam skabs 'gar dbyangs kyang rung ste mtha'i snga ma'i yi ge de ni u pa d+mā'i ming can no/ /sarba nā mas+thā ṣ+pe tsā saṃ burnyo/ saṃ budhi ma yin pa'i thams cad gnas pa'i ming can la yang ngo / /rtags mtha' na yig srog med kyi u pa dh+wa'i atsa de ni bod pa'i don du sbyin pa'i su/ saṃ budhi'i ming can ma yin pa'i thams cad gnas pa'i ming can kyi rnam dbye rnams la ring por 'gyur ro/ /sa khān su/ a thrak+ta e kā la pra t+ya yaḥ/ rkyen al gcig pa a thrak+ta'o / /rkyen al gcig pa ste yi ge srog ldan dang gnyis gsum lta bu ma yin pa'i gsal byed srog med gcig po de la/ a thrak+ta'i ming can zhes dgos pa'i dbang gis ming 'dogs byed do/ /ha la t+yā bh+yo dīspyota su ti su thrak+ṇi hal/hal dīpa/ āpa/ ring po rnams las su ti si a thrak+ta'i hala'o/ /rtags mtha' la hal te gsal byed srog med dang / bud med du bsgrub pa'i rkyen dīpa dang āpa kyi mtha' dang ring po rnams las/ su dang / ti sogs kyi ti dang /si rnams kyi u dang i phyis pas/ hal atsa med pa'i yi ge gcig pa/ a 117—127

thrak+ta'i ming can de dbyi bar bya ste/ su phyis/ sa khān/ ming mtha'i na dbye'o zhes pas/ na phyis/ sa khā/ sa khyu ra saṃ burnyo/ sa khi las saṃ burnyi ma yin pa la'o/ /sa khi'i skabs 'dir kun du bod pa'i don gyi gcig tshig saṃ burnyi ma yin pa'i dang po'i su nas gnyis pa'i au ṭa'i bar gyi rnam dbye lnga po sngar thams cad gnas pa'i ming can zhes brda chad byas pa de rnams la skabs 'dir ṇita ste/ ṇa 'gro ba'i ming can zhes dgos pa'i ched du ming 'dogs byed do/ /sa khi la/ dang po'i au dang dzas/ gnyis pa'i am dang au rnams sbyin/ a tsaṇ+ḍi nyi/ 2 sro 'gro ba la atsa'i'o/ /pha rol du 2 ṇa 'gro ba'i ming can byung na rtags mtha'i atsa ste dbyangs de 'phel bar 'gyur bas skabs 'dir yang au sogs bzhi la ṇa yig 'gro ba'i ming can zhes ming 'dogs byas pa'i dgos pa ni 'di yin pas rtags mtha' 'phel ba/ etsa'i aya awa sogs kyi mdos/ sa khā yo/ sa khā yaḥ/ sa khā yi/ sa khā yo/ sa khi la/ kun du bod pa'i su sbyin saṃ burnyi ma yin pa zhes pas skabs 'dir bshad ma thag pa'i bya ba mi 'jug /gong ha ri'i skabs dang 'dra bas/ he sa khe/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig bshad ma thag pa'i rnam dbye dang po'i gnyis tshig dang mang tshig ltar bsgrubs pas/he sa khā yo/ te sa khā yaḥganyis pa'i mang tshig shas kyi skabs ha ri dang 'dra bas/sa khā+en/ gsum pa rnams la/ sa khyu/ sa khi rgyu/ sa khi rnyiḥ/ bzhi pa la/sa khye/ sa khi r+ghaṃ/ sa khi bh+yaḥ/ sa khi la/ lnga pa'i/ nga si sbyin/ khya t+yāt+par su/ khi nyi dag las pha rol gyi a'i'o/ /rtags mtha' khi ring po dang thung ngu ti ring po dang thung ngu rnams kyi pha rol rnam dbye lnga pa dang drug pa'i nga si dang ngas gnyis kyi nga phyis pa'i a de ni u ru 'gyur te/ sa khyuḥ/ sa khi hūṃ/717—128

sa khi bh+yaḥ/ sa ①khi la rnam dbye drug pa rnams/ sa khyuḥ/ sa khyo / sa khā+e rmā/sa khi la/ bdun pa'i ji byin/ auta/ cha'/ /rtags na dī'i ming can dang ghi'i khyeming can ma yin pa'i i thung dang u thung dag las pha rol gyi rnam dbye bdun pa'i ji ni au ru 'gyur te/ ji au/ ika gi atsa la/ yaṇa/ sa rja/gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ sa khro / sa khi 6/ pa tiḥs mā sa e wa/pa ti tshig sdud med pa 'di bzhin no/ /pa ti'i sgra tshig sdud med pa ste/ pa ti bdag po zhes pa lta bu la sa khi'i sgra kho na'i bya ba rnams 'jug la/ tshig sdud dang 'byel pa ni/ dper na/ pra dzā pa ti skyedagu'i bdag po lta bu la ni ghi'i ming can yin pas spyir btang i thung mtha' can ha ri'i skabs dang cho ga thams cad 'dra'o—/ /i thung mtha' can ka ti'i sgra la ni mang tshig kho na 'jug la gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig dag mi 'jug go/ /ba hu ga ṇa ba tu ḍa ti saṃ khyu/ mang du 'dren pa ba tu ḍa ti rnams saṃ khyu'o/ /mang du 'dren pa ste mang tshig kho na thob pa rnams dang / ba tu dang / ḍa ti'i rkyen rnams la saṃ khyu'i ming can zhes dgos pa'i dbang gis ming 'dogs byed do/ /ḍa titsa/ ḍa ti la yang ngo / /gong du bshad pa'i saṃ khyu'i ming can de rnams kyi nang nas kyang ka ti lta bu ḍa nyi'i rkyen mtha' can de la ṣa ṭa'i ming can zhes be+er yang ming 'dogs byed do/ /pra t+ya ya su luka blu lupaḥ/ rkyen gyi luka thru lupa rnams so/ /pha rol gyi rkyen dbyi ba de la luka 'am blu'am lupa zhes zer ro/ /dper na/ dzas/ luka zer ba'am—/ dzas blu zer ba'am/ dzas lupa zer ba lta bu gang byung yang /dzas de dbyi ba kho na'o/ /ka /kyeti la/— jitsam/ rnam dbye dang po'i mang tshig dzas dang / gnyis pa'i mang tshig shas gnyis byin/ ṣasbyo luka /ṣaṭa rnams las 117—129

dbye'o / /ṣaṭa'i ming can gyi rtags las pha rol rnam dbye dang po'i mang tshig dzas dang / gnyis pa'i mang tshig shas rnams dbyi ste/ ka ti'i sgra ṣaṭa'i ming can yin pas/ dzas shas dag phyis/ ka ti/ ka ti zhes pa grub/ pra t+ya ya lo pe pra t+ya ya la k+ṣa rde/ rkyen phyis pa la rkyen gyi mtshan nyid do/ /pha rol rkyen phyis kyang rkyen byen pa'i mtshan nyid kyi rkyen gyi bya ba thob bo zhes rtags mtha'i i er 'gyur ba'i spyir btang thob kyang / na lu ma tsā ga su/ phyis pa la aṅga'i mi ①yin no/ /zhes dmigs bsal luka 'am shā'am lupa ces pa'i sgras rkyen phyis zin pa de la/ aṅga te/ rtags de la bya ba med pas/ ka te zhes mi 'gyur bar ka ti nyid du gnas so/ /rnam dbye gsum pa'i mang tshig la/ ka ti bhiḥ/ bzhi pa la/ ka ti bh+yaḥ/ lnga pa la/ ka ti bh+yaḥ/ drug pa la/ ka tī rmā/bdun pa la②/ ka ti 6/ bod tshig la/ te ka ti/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /i thung mtha' can tri'i sgra la yang grangs bgrang ba'i skabs su mang tshig kho na sbyor bsaske/ tri la/—gsum/ rnam dbye dang po dang / gnyis pa/ gsum pa/bzhi pa/ lnga pa rnams kyi mang tshig rnams byen/ gong ha ri ltar bsgrubs pas/tra yaḥ/ ṭ+wān/ tri bhiḥ/ tro bh+ya①ཿ/ tri bh+yaḥ/ tro la/ drug pa'i mang tshig āmarka/ treḥtra yaḥ/ tri'i tra ya'o/ /rnam dbye drug pa'i ām pha rol la tri zhes pa'i sgra ni tra ya zhes par 'gyur te/ tri tra ya/ thung ngu zhes pas nuṭa/nām la 'os rtags mtha' ring po/ ra ṣa sogs kyi mdos/ na ṇa/ tra yā hūṃ/bdun pa la/ tri 6/ bod tshig /he tra yaḥ/ i thung mtha' can dri'i sgra la yang grangs bgrang ba'i skabs su gnyis tshig kho na sbyor ro/ /t+ya dā dri nā maḥ/t+yad sogs rnams kyi a'o/ /t+yad la sogs te t+yad nas dri'i bar brgyad po 117—130

rnams pha rol rnam dbye gang mthong yang rtags mtha' a ru 'gyur te/ dri gnyis/la—/ rnam dbye dang po dang gnyis pa gnyis kyi gnyis tshig /au/ dī'i i a mtshams sbyar bas/ dwo dwo/ rnam dbye gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang /lnga pa rnams la/ dā rgyu/ dā rgyu/ dā rgyu/ drug pa dang / bdun pa la/dwa ①yoḥ/ dwa ②yoḥ/ dwo'i sgra la ming dang nyer bsgyur thog ma can rnams la dī'i i ar mi 'gyur zhing / rnam dbye yang su nas pa'i bar thams cad 'jug la de'i tshe cho ga yang spyir btang i thung mtha' can ha ri'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /de yan gyis skyes pa'i rtags i thung mtha' can gyi sde tshan spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas rags pa rnams bshad zin to// //༈ da ni skyes pa'i rtags sī ring mtha' can ni/ bā ta pra m+bi la/—ri dwags kṛ su/ sa sa dzuṣa'i mdo dang / khar sogs kyi mdos/ bā ta pra m+biḥ/bā ta pra m+bi la/ au dang dzas ika gi atsa la yaṇa 'os/ bā ta pra spyo/ bā ta pra myaḥ/ rnam dbye gnyis pa la/ bā ta pra rmā/ bā ta pra smyo/ bā ta pra m+bin/gsum pa la/ bā ta pra myu/ bu ta pra m+bi rgyu/ bā ta pra rmā bhiḥ/ bzhi pa la/bā ta pra bye/ bā ta pra rmā r+ghaṃ/ bā ta pra m+bi khyuḥ/ lnga pa la/ bā ta pra myaḥ/bā ta pra sbo rgyu/ bā ta pra m+bi bh+yaḥ/ drug pa la/ bā ta pra myaḥ/ bā ta pra myoḥ/bā ta pra sdi/ bdun pa la/ bā ta pra sbo/ bā ta pra myoḥ/ bā ta pra rmā 6/bod tshig /he bā ta pra m+biḥ/ te bā ta pra spo/ he bā ta pra myaḥ/ rnams grub ste cho ga go bde'o/ /de bzhin du/ de wa ya jo/snyelha mchod pa/ ati laskyi shin tu phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa mang po dag cho ga 'di kho na dang 'dra'o/ /yī ring mtha' can byings gnas pa rnams bya ba cung mi 'dra ste/ suspyi la/—blo bzang ngam legs pa'i blo/117—131

'jug /rnam dbye bdun pa'i ji ma gtogs cho ga thams cad suspyi'i skabs dang 'dra ste/ nīḥ/ ni yo/ ni yaḥ/ lta bu rigs 'gre/ bdun pa'i ji la cung mi 'dra ste/ bhā la ji / nge dzā na byā ①: bh+yaḥ/ ji'i ām/ na dī āpa nī rnams las so/ /rnam dbye bdun pa'i ji ni bud med kyi rtags/ na dī ming can rnams dang / āpa kyi mtha' rnams dang / rtswa'i sgra rnams la ām du 'gyur te/ ni rmā/ gā ma bhā grong sde'i phra ma mkhan yang rnam dbye bdun pa'i gcig tshig ji ma gtogs pra dhī'i skabs dang 'dra/ ji la bshad ma thag pa nī dang 'dra ste / gā ma ṇ+ḍiḥ/ grwa ma stso/ gā ma rgyaḥsogs dang / bdun pa la/ gā ma ṇi lnga/ sa khā+e dang pa tī ring po'i mtha' can yang rnam dbye lnga pa'i nga se dang /drug pa'i ngas ma gtogs rnam dbye gzhan thams cad la cho ga pra dhī dang 'dra zhing /nga si/ ngas gnyis la sa khā+e dang / pa tī la/ nga si dang ngas byin/ khi ti dag las pha rol gyi a'i ⑧'o zhes pas nga se dang ngas kyi a u mtshams sbyar/sa khyuḥ/ pa kyuḥ/ drug pa yang gzugs dang bsgrub tshul gnyis ka 'dra'o/ /phru bhā'i zhingarnga bar byed/ sgra yang rnam dbye bdun pa'i ji la nī'i skabs dang 'dra zhing /ji ma yin pa'i rnam dbye gzhan thams cad la pra dhī'i skabs kyi cho ga dang 'dra'o/ /de ltar skyes pa'i rtags las yī ring mtha' can spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa rags pa bshad zin to/ /༈ da ni skyes pa'i rtags u thung gi bya ba rnams bshad par bya ste/ shaṃ bhu la/ su/ sa sa dzuṣa zhes dang / khar dang zhes pa'i mdos/ shaṃ bhuḥ/snyelha chen po/ shaṃ bhu la/ lo/ dang po dag gi zhes pas/ shaṃ bhū/ shaṃ bhu la/dzas—/ dzas la 'ang ngos/ u o mtshams sbyar/ shaṃ bha waḥ/ shaṃ bhu la/117—133

snu two/ snu hwaḥ/ gnyis pa la/ snu hūṃ/ snu rwa/ snu hwaḥ/ gsum pa la/snu hā/ snu snu dz+nyā/ tū snu bhiḥ/ lta bu ste atsa thog ma can rnams la/ u lngar 'gyur/ hal thog ma can rnams la bya ba lhag po med pas go bde'o/ /de bzhin du/ a ti tsa mū shinatugayo ba la sogs pa spyir btang spru ring skyes pa'i rtags thams cad cho ga 'di dang 'dra'o/ /u ring mtha' can kha la pū la su byin/kha la pūḥ/ kha la pū la/ skyod 66su pi/ u'i hukyesub la'o/ /byings kyi khru rnam dbye dang po'i su nas/ bdun pa'i mang tshig gi ⑤pa'i bar gyi atsa thog ma can gang byung yang spru de lnga kho nar 'gyur te/ de yang mtha' khru de'i sngon du yi ge gnyis sam gsum sogs yod pa yi ge brtsegs pa med pa zhig dgos so/ /kha la dwo/ kha la pāḥ/ gnyis pa rnams la/ kha la dz+wa/ kha la dwo/ kha la pāḥ/gsum pa rnams la/ kha la pā/ kha la pū rgyu/ kha la pū bhiḥ/ sogs te bsgrub tshul rigs 'gre'o/ / su phru ①legs gcod la sogs pa yang 'di dang 'dra'o//swa bhū ④bdag yod zhes pa/ suspyi'i skabs dang 'dra bas/ su la swa bhū thuḥ/rnam dbye atsa thog ma du can rnams la/ u war 'gyur bas/ swa bhu waṃ/ swa ⑦bhu waḥ/ gnyis pa la/ swa zu waṃ'u/ swa byu waṃ/ swa bhu waḥ/ gsum pa la/swa bhu 'do/ swa bhū rgyu khya / swa byu ⑪ rnyiḥ/ sogs so/ /ka ṭa sru/ swa yi byutshosna/sogs kyang 'di dang 'dra'o/ /byu su dhī dag la ma yin no 8 / /yaṇar 'gyur ba ma yin kyang dmigs bsal bar+ṣa bhū lo dus su 'byung ba zhes pa'i sgra ni bhū'i ⑫mtha' yin kyang yaṇar 'gyur te/ su la/ bar+ṣa ⑫byuḥ/ bar+ṣa bhū la au/ bar+ṣa bhā stsa/ bar+ṣa bhū'i 'ang ngo ⑫/ /bar+ṣa khyu zhes pa'i sgra 'di su sogs kyi rnam dbye zhes pas⑩/atsa thog ma can rnams la yaṇar 'gyur te/ u lngar bsgyur bas/ bar+ṣa d+ngha/117—137

dh+wa ṭ+wā rde/ bdun pa'i ji la ṛta kyi ji thams cad gnas pa zhes pas yon tan/d+mā ta ri/ ①dh+wa troḥ/ jo tro 6/ kun tu bod pa'i su la/ ṛta kyi ji thams cad gnas pa'i ming can zhes pas yon tan/ he dh+wa taḥ/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig dang po'i skabs dang 'dra/ he dh+wa tā ro/ he d+mā tā raḥ/ de bzhin duske/ na z-i/snyetshabo/ ho tro/— sbyin sreg /botre ⑤sbyin sreg sogs mang po zhig 'di dang 'dra'o—/ /pi tri la/snyepha/ su/ gong bzhin bsgrubs pas/ pi tā/ pi tro'i bluskabs 'dir gzhan cho ga thams cad snga ma dh+wa tre'i skabs dang 'dra la/dang po'i au nas gnyis pa'i au'i bar rnams la u pa dh+wa ring por mi 'gyur te/dh+wa tro zhes pa rkyen trotsa tre mtha' can yin la/ pi z-i zhes pa tretsa mtha' can ma yin pas so/ /pi ta ro/ pi ta raḥlta bu'o/ /gzhan rnams rigs 'gre'o/ /dzā mā tri/— mgapa/ bhā tro spun zlasogs kyang 'di dang 'dra'o/ /dṛ tsa/ dṛ'i yang na'o—/ /dṛ ④mizhes pa'i rtags la rnam dbye drug pa'i ām ma gtogs pi ⑤j-i'i skabs dang 'dra/ ām la rtags mtha' ring por 'gyur ba dang mi 'gyur ba 'dam ka can du bya ste/ 1 hūṃ 'am/ yang na dṛ rde lta bu'o/ /de rnams kyis skyes pa'i rtags la ṛ yig mtha' can gyi bya ba rnams bshad zin to/ /༈ skabs 'dir dzāta dang dzata dang eta rnams kyi mtha' can kyi rtags med par grags so/ /myu/ o yig mtha' las go'i sgra la dper brjod du bya ste/ go to ṇita/go las ṇita'o/ /o mtha' can go lta bu'i pha rol gyi rnam dbye dang po nas gnyis pa'i /ṭa'i bar sngar thams cad gnas pa'i ming can zhes brda chad byas pa de rnams la skabs 'dir ṇa 'gro ba'i ming can zhes ming 'dogs byed do/ /117—139

go la/ su au dzas rnams/ 2 snyu 'gro ba la atsa'i 'o zhes pa'i mdos rtags mtha' 'phel ba/ goḥ/ gā waṃ/ gā waḥ/ gnyis pa'i am dang shas la/o to phodze+e so/ /ota las am shas dag la'o/ /rtags o yig mtha' can las rnam dbye gnyis pa'i am shas pha rol la rtags mtha'i o dang pha rol gyi a 'dus pas ā ru 'gyur te/ am la/ tsā/ au la/ gā wo/ shas la/gāḥ / gsum pa rnams la/ ga wā/ go rgyu/ go rnyiḥ/ bzhi pa rnams la/ga we tsho7/ go dz+nyā/ go bh+yaḥ/ lnga pa rnams la/ goḥ/ go rgyu/ go bh+yaḥ/drug pa rnams la/ goḥ/ ga yo3ཿ/ ga rmā/ bdun pa rnams la/ ga wi/ga yoḥ/ go 1ṣā/ bod tshig /te ④goḥ/ he gā cha/ te gā waḥ/ de bzhin du/ su byo phyenyimasogs kyang 'di dang 'dra'o/ /de ltar o mtha' can rnams bshad zin to/ /myu/ da ni e kyeyig mtha' can las ri'i gseraram nor sgra la dper brjod na/ri la su/ rā yo ha li/ ri'i hal la'o/ /i yig mtha' can ri sgra lta bu'i pha rol du rnam dbye hal thog ma can gang byung yang rtags mtha'i i de ā ru 'gyur ro/ /rāḥ / rā yo/ rā yaḥ/ gnyis pa rnams la/ rā yi/ rā ④yo/ rā yal ཿ / gsum pa rnams la/ rā yā/ rā rgyu/ rā bhiḥ/ bzhi pa rnams la/rā ye/ rā hūṃ/ rā bh+yarteḥ/ lnga pa rnams la/ rā yaḥ/ rā rgyu(bye / rā bh+yaḥ/drug pa rnams la/ rā yaḥ/ rā yoḥ/ rā yī/ bdun pa rnams la/ rā yi/rā yoḥ/ rā su/ bod tshig la/ he rāḥ/ te rā yo/ he rā yaḥ/ au yig mtha' can glo lkuzhes pa'i sgra la dper brjod bya ste/ atsa thog ma can rnams la au ā war 'gyur/ hal thog ma can rnams la bya ba lhag po med pas/ rnam 117—140

dbye dang po rnams la/ gloḥ/ glu waṃ/ glu waḥ/ gnyis pa la/ glu waṃ/glu waṃ/ glu waḥ/ gsum pa la/ glu wā/ glodz+nyā/ 1 bhiḥ/ sogs so/ /no grul sogs pa rnams kyang 'di dang 'dra'o/ /①i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gya sru tā da dzan+ta purliṅgām mābhāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las atsa'i mtha' can skyes pa'i rtags rnams rdzogs so/ /de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta ②zhes bya ba las skyes pa'i rtags atsa mtha' can rnams kyi cho ga spyir btang dmigs bsal ①dang bcas pa rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so / /༈ dud ni bud med ⑤kyi rtags las atsa mtha' can gyi cho ga rnams bshad par bya ste/ ra mā la/—rtsabam/ su/ hal dīpa āpa ring po sogs dhikyis su phyis / ra mā/ ra mā la/ lo/ au ⑦nga ā paḥ/ lo'i āpa las so/ /bud med kyi rtags āpa kyi mtha' can las ⑧rnam dbye dang po'i gnyis tshig au dang /gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig lo gnyis ni shī ru 'gyur te/ sha 'gro ba'i ming can yin pas phyis mtshams sbyar bas/ ra me/ ra mā la ⑨dzas dang po dag la zhes pas/ra māḥ/ ra mā la/ kun tu bod pa'i su/ saṃ bustso ⑩tsa/ saṃ budhi la yang ngo //āpa ⑪mtha' can ni saṃ budhi pha rol la er 'gyur te/ rtags ⑫mtha' e/ thung ngu eng sogs kyis saṃ budhi phyis pas/ te ⑫ra me/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig gong dang 'dra ste/ he ra me/ he ra māḥ/ ra mā la/ e⑫/ am la snga ma 117—141

as+thā'i sgra dang na dī'i ming can rnams saṃ budhi pha rol la rtags mtha' thung ngur 'gyur te/ te asba/ akrā nor rgyun ma dang / a1 'bigs byed lha mo yang 'di dang 'dra'o / /'grel par/ as+thā'i ①don can yin kyang de phan kyi rkyen ḍa dang /la dang / ka gnas pa de la mo rtags su bsgrub pa'i rkyen ṭāpa byin pa lta bu la saṃ budhi la yang thung ngur mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes bshad pas/ dper na/ as+thā ḍā la / saṃ burnyi byin thung ngur mi 'gyur/ ra mā dang 'dra bas/ te as+thā ḍi/de bzhin du/ he as+thā le/ he asbyike/ lta bu'o/ /dza rā rganamozhes pa'i sgra la rnam dbye ha la thog ma can rnams la ra mā'i skabs dang 'dra/ atsa thog ma can rnams la dza rā nyid dza ras zhes par 'gyur ba dang ra mā'i rnguskabs gnyis 'dam ka can du bya ste/ rnam dbye dang po rnams la/ dza rā/ dza ra sau/dza ra saḥ/ bod tshig la/ he dza re/ he dza ra sau/ he dza ra saḥ/ gnyis pa la/ dza ra saṃ/ dza ra sau/ dza ra saḥ/ gsum pa la/ dza ra sā/ dza rā rgyu/ dza rā bheḥ/ bzhi pa la/ dza ra se/ dza rā dz+nyā/ dza rā bh+yaḥ/ lnga pa la/dza ra saḥ/ dza rā rgyu/ dza rā bh+yaḥ/1 drug pa la/ dza ra ④ saḥ dza ra soḥ/dza ra sī/ bdun pa la/ dza ra se/ dza ra soḥ/ dza rā ⑤su/ 'di rnams dza ras su 'gyur ba'i phyogs yin la/ ra mā dang 'dra ba'i skabs kyi dper brjod go bde bas ma bkod do/ /nā se kā zhes pa rnam dbye dang po rnams dang /kun tu bod pa'i don can rnams dang / rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig rnams ra mā'i skabs dang 'dra/ shas nas brtsams te/ shas la sogs pa rnams la pad data nas zhes pa'i/ mdos/ nā se kā nas zhes par 'gyur bas/ shas la⑥/ na saḥ/ gsum pa rnams la/ na sā/ no rgyu/117—144

no bhiḥ/ bzhi pa la/ na se/ no dz+nyā/ no bh+yaḥ/ lnga pa la/ na saḥ/ no dz+nyā/no bh+yaḥ/ drug pa la/ na saḥ/ na soḥ/ na sī/ bdun pa la/ na si/na soḥ/ na smra/ ni shā/ zhes pa'ang su nas shas kyi bar ra mā dang 'dra/shas nas bzung ste/ shas la sogs pa rnams la kyezhes pa'i/ mdos/ ni shā/ni shra ru 'gyur/ shas la/ ni shaḥ/ ṭā la/ ni shā/ ni shal/ rgyu/brabya bh+rastsa thra dza mṛ dza ya dza rā dza khyu dza tsha shī ṣa/ bra: bh+rasnga mṛ dza mṛ dza ya dza rā dza 7 bye dza tsha sha rnams kyi ṣa'o/ /brabya sogs bdun dang / tsha dang sha srog med ming mtha' yin pa de dzha rngul so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge gang mthong yang ṣa 4ru 'gyur ro—/ /dzhasha la dzhal rnams kyi dza sha rnams so ltazhes pas ṣa ḍa drangs/ nir+ghaṃ/nir+bheḥ / bzhi pa la/ ni she/ nihūṃ/ nibyeḥ/ lnga pa la/ ni shaḥ/nihūṃ / nibh+yoḥ/ drug pa la/ ni shaḥ/ ni shoḥ/ ni 6shaṃ/ bdun pa'i ngi dang os la/ ni shi/ ni shoḥ/ ni sha /su/ sha ṣa/ ṣa ḍa/ḍa las sa la dhuṭa'o/ /zhes pas/ dhuṭa ā ga ma/ khar la tsara'o zhes pas/dha ta/ ḍa ṭa/ nibyu/ rmā sa thra ta nā rnams kyang rnam dbye thams cad gnas pa'i ming can rnams la ra mā dang 'dra/ shas nas bzung 'dam ka can te/'grel par rmā sa thrata nā sā nu rnams kyi rmā sa thrata snu rnams su yang na'o zhes pa byung bas/ rnam dbye shas sogs pha rol la/ rmā sa/ ni/ rmā sa/thra ta nā/ ni/ thrata/ sā nu ni/ snu rnams su yang na 'gyur ro/ /shas la/rmā saḥ/ ṭā mul/ rmā sā/ rgyu byes 5gnyis la/ yang dag par sbyor ba'i mtha' dbyi'o zhes pas sa phyis/ rmā dz+nyā/ rmā bhiḥ/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/thra taḥ/ thra tā/ thra:/ thradhiḥ/ sogs so/ /sgru ni 'chad 'gyur dhe nu 117—145

dang 'dra'o/ /bi shwa pā snatshogs 'thung ma dang / go pā b.langaskyong ma sogs ra mā dang 'dra'o—/ /de rnams kyis bud med du brjod pa ā ring ①mtha' can gyi bya ba rnams bstan zin to/ /myu/ da ni mo rtags i thung mtha' can gyi bya ba rnams bshad par bya ste/ma ti/——blogros/ su/ ma tiḥ/ ma ti la/ au/ dang po dag gi zhes pas/ma tī/ ma ti dzas/ dzas la 'ang ngos/ ma ta ya②ཿ/ ma ti/ am/ saṃ la snga ma zhes pas/ ma ti/ au la/ ma ①tī/ ma ti/ shas dang po dag gi mdos/ ma tīḥ/ ma ti/ ṭā/ 'dir bud med kyi rtags yin pas ṭā nar mi 'gyur/ ma t+yā/ ma ti dz+nyā/ ma ti bhiḥ/ ma ti la/ nge / ji ti hra swa:/ nga 'gro ba la thung ngu'i yang na'o/ /bud med du brjod pa'i i u thung ngu rnams dang / iya uwa thob ④pa'i khyu ring u ring rnams kyang rnam dbye nga 'gro ba rnams pha rol la na dī'i ⑤ ming can gyi cho ga rnams yang na bar bya ste/ān+ta ⑥r+yaḥ/ na dī las āṭa'o/ /bud med kyi rtags na dri'i ming can las rnam dbye nga 'gro ba rnams la /ṭa ā ga ma ster ro/ /ma ti la yang na bar byas pas—/ ma h+ye/ ma ta ye/ ma ti dz+nyā/ ma ti bh+yaḥ/ lnga pa'i nga se la 'dam ka /ma t+yāḥ/ ma teḥ/ ma ti dz+nyā/ ma ti bh+yaḥ/ drug pa la'ang / ma t+yāḥ/ma teḥ/ ma troḥ/ ma tī rmā/ ji la/ ma dh+yā/ ma to/ ma troḥ/ ma ti 6/bod tshig /te ma te/ te ma tī/ he ma ta yaḥ/ khru te/——thosapa/ smṛ ti/ —dran pa/ budhi blornams kyang 'di dang 'dra'o/ /tri mel dzas/ tri 1 tsa tu roḥste yo ti thra tsa ta mṛ/ tro tsa tur dag gi bud med la ti thra tsa ta thra dag go/ /gsum gyi skad dod tri dang / bzhi'i skad dod tsa tur gnyis ni mo rtags kyi skabs rnam 717—146

dbye pha rol la tri ni/ ti ①mṛ dang / tsa tur ni/ tsa ta thra zhes par 'gyur ro—/ /ti mṛ/ dzas/ tsa ta mṛ/ dzas/ a tsi ra ṛ taḥ/ ṛta kyi atsa la ra'o/ /ti sre 1 tsa ta thra zhes ṛta mthar 'gyur ba'i ṛta de rnam dbye atsa thog ma can rnams ①la ra srog med du 'gyur ro/ /ti sra④ཿ/ tsa ta sraḥ/shas la/ ti sraḥ/ tsa ta sraḥ/ ti mṛ bhiḥ/ tsa ta sre bhiḥ/ bzhi pa lnga pa gnyis la/ nyi thra bh+ya⑤ཿ/ tsa ta mṛ bh+yaḥ/ drug pa'i ām la/ ra atsa zhes pa'i mdos⑥/ nuṭa/ na ti mṛ tsa ta sre/ ti sre tsa ta mṛ dag la ma yin no/ /spyir btang rmā la rtags mtha' ring po thob kyang dmigs bsal ⑦ti thra dang /tsa ta thra dag rmā pha rol la ring por 'gyur ba ma yin te/ ti mṛ rbohūṃ/ tsa ta thra rde—/ bdun pa la/ ti mṛ 6/ tsa ta mṛ 6/ bod tshig la/ te ti sraḥ/te tsa ta sraḥ/ pri ya tri dga'ab gsum zhes pa lta bu ming thog ma can la tri/ tri thra zhes par mi 'gyur la/ rnam dbye yang mang tshig tu ma zad thams cad 'jug ste/cho ga yang skyes pa'i rtags ha ri'i skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra la/ ṭā dang shas nar mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du/ pre ⑨ya tsa tur dga'ab bzhi zhes pa yang /tsa ta srer mi 'gyur te/ dper brjod rgyas pa 'og tu 'byung ngo / /yang skabs 'gar ming dang po can la yang / ti mṛ/ tsa ta mṛ/ zhes par 'gyur ba'ang srid do/ /zhes 'grel par bshad do/ /dī'i ④sgra la/ tad sogs kyi rnam dbye la a⑪/ a la bud med du brjod pa'i ṭāpa sbyar bas dā zhes grub/de la rnam dbye rnams kyi gnyis tshig rnams byin/ ra mā ltar bsgrubs pas—/ au gnyis la/ dwo/ rgyugasum la/ dā dz+nyā/ os gnyis la/ dwa yoḥ—/ de yan gyis bud med kyi rtags i thung mtha' can rnams kyi bya ba bshad 117—147

yang na'o/ /rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gcig tshig am dang mang tshig shas ①dag pha rol la byā'i i yar yang na 'gyur te/ ste yo/ yang na am la snga ma 'os/ spyo/au la/ ste yo/ shas/ bshad ma thag pa'i mdos/ ste yaḥ/ yang na dang po dag gi zhes pas/ byāḥ/ gsum pa la/ ste rngu yā/ byā rgyu/ byā bhiḥ/nge la/ la da dang / iya/ s+t+ri yi/ sdi sgyum/ sdi bh+yaḥ/ lnga pa la/ ste yāḥ—/ sdi sgyum1/ sdi khyuḥ/ drug pa la/ ste yāḥ/ ste yoḥ/ spyo rde/bdun pa la/ ste yī/ ste yoḥ/ byā 6/ shrī/——dpalamo/ la su shrīḥ/ shrī la/au dang dzas/ atsa la byu byings sgru ④rnams kyi zhes pa'i mdos i ya/ shri yo/shri yaḥ/ shrī la saṃ budhi byin/ shrī/ su/ ṣ+pe ya du wang s+thā nā waspyo/ byā shem yin pa'i iya uwa gnas pa dag ma yin no/ /sdi ma yin pa zhes byā'i sgra ni iya uwar 'gyur yang na dī'i ming can yin la/ byā ma yin pa iya uwa gnas pa ste/yī iyar 'gyur ba dang khru uwar 'gyur ba rnams bud med du brjod pa'i skabs 'dir yang na na dudī'i ming can ma yin te/ skabs 'dir shrī yang / na dī'i ming can ma yin pas saṃ budhi dbyi ba dang rtags thung ngur 'gyur ba sogs mi byed/he shrīḥ/ he shri yo/ he shri yaḥ/ gnyis pa rnams la/ shri yo/ shri yo/ shri yaḥ—/ gsum pa la/ shri yā/ shrī dz+nyā/ shrī bhiḥ/ shrī la/ nge / spyir btang iya uwa thob pa rnams bud med du brjod pa'i skabs na dī'i ming can ma yin no zhes bkag kyang dmigs bsal/ nga 'gro ba la thung ngu'i yang na'o zhes pa'i 'grel par/ yī khru dag kyang yang na par bshad pas/ rnam dbye nga 'gro ba'i ming can rnams la na dī'i ming can gyi bya ba ltar āṭa ster ba dang iya u war 'gyur ba gnyis ka thob pas/ shri ye/ shi yi/ sgyum bh+yaḥl/ shrī dz+nyā/117—149

'dra'o / /ta nu lusaphra ma la sogs pa yang 'di dang 'dra'o/ /u thung mtha' can krobyu ⑫la bshad ma thag pa dang bya ba mi 'dra ste/ ste dze+e tsa/ bud med la'ang ngo / /krobyu'i cespyang mo sgra ni bud med kyi rtags la dṛtsa bzhin ṛ mthar 'gyur bas/ krosgo 'gyur/ ṛn+de bh+yo dīpa/ ṛta na rnams las dīpa'o/ /rtags ṛta mtha' can rnams dang na mtha' can rnams la bud med du bsgrub pa'i rkyen dīpa 'gyur te/ dīpa byin/ krosgyi zhes par 'gyur ro/ /cho ga thams cad sngar mo rtags ā+o ring skabs su bshad pa'i go rī dang 'dra'o/ /de rnams kyis u thung mtha' can mo rtags kyi cho ga bstan zin to/ /༈ da ni mo rtags u ring mtha' can rnams kyi bya ba brjod par bya ste/ ba dhū / — mna'am/ su/ ba dhūḥ/ au dang / dzas/ ba dz+nyā/ ba dh+waḥ/ ba dhū la—/ saṃ burnyi/ su/ as+thā'i don na dī rnams kyi thung ngu 'os/ rtags mtha' thung ngur 'gyur/ eng thung ngu zhes pas su phyis/ te ba dhu/ te ba dhī/he badz+nyāḥ/ ba dhū la/ am/ am la sngon ma'i 'os/ ba bye/ chadal/ ba dz+nyā/ shas la/dang po dag gi mdos/ ba dhūḥ/ gsum pa rnams la/ ba spyo/ ba dhū sgyum/ba dhū bhiḥ/ nge la/ ba dhī/ ba dhū rgyu/ ba dhū bh+yaḥ/ ngas la/ ba dhūḥ/ dz+nyā bh+yas 'dra/ ngas la yang / ba dhūḥ/ os la/ ba twoḥ/ ām la/ thung ngu na dī khye zhes pas nuṭa/ ba dhū rmā/ ngi la/ ba dz+nyā/ os la/ ba dz+nyāḥ/supa la1/ badhū 6 rnams grub ste go rī'i ④ skabs dang 'dra'o/ /de bzhin du/tsa mū g.yomal sogs pa rnams kyang 'di dang 'dra'o/ /zla gsal bar brngod ma zhes pa'i sgra 'di bya ba thams cad shrī'i skabs dang 'dra/ saṃ budhi la thung ngur byed pa dang mi byed pa 'dam ka yin pas/ he ju/ he khyuḥ/ pu naspyo be+er yang 'byung ma zhes pa 117—151

pa zhes pas u pa dh+wa ring po/ hal dīpa zhes pas su phyis/ ming mtha'i na dbye 'os/ na phyis/ swa sā/ au ①dzas/ am skyodarnams la skyes pa'i rtags kyi skabs su/ jo tre la bshad pa'i cho ga dang 'dra bas/ swa sā ro/ swa sā raḥ/swa sā re/ swa sā ro/ shas dang ṭā ⑤nār mi 'gyur te/ bud med kyi rtags yin pas so/ /shas la dang po dag ①gi zhes pa'i mdos/ swa swoḥ/ ṭā la/swa sru/ swa thra ④rgyu/ swa thra nyiskyeḥ/ lhag ma rnams kyang jo tro'i skabs dang 'dra'o—/ /gzhan ṣaṭa'i ming can bdun po 0thams cad cho ga 'di kho nas rigs 'gre'o④/ /de rnams kyis ṛta mtha'i bya ba rnams bstan zin to/ /myu/ bud med kyi rtags o yig mtha' can skyes pa'i rtags kyi skabs su bshad pa'i go'i skabs dang 'dra/ i ④yig mtha' can rnams ri sgra dang 'dra/au yig mtha' can rnams glo zhes pa'i skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra ste/ mdor na o mtha' dang i spumatha' dang au mtha' can rnams skyes pa'i rtags kyi skabs su bshad pa'i cho ga kho na las spros pa med do/ /i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gya sru tā da dzan+ta byā liṅgām mābhāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las atsa' mtha' bud med kyi rtags rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las/ atsa'i mtha' can bud med kyi rtags rnams kyi cho ga spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //117—153

da ni atsa'i mtha' can ma ning gi rtags rnams bshad par bya ste/ byer btang a thung mtha' can dz+nyā na zhes pa'i sgra la dper brjod bya ste/ dz+nyā na/snyeye shes/su / a tophophra/ ata las ama'o/ /ma ning a thung gi mtha'i pha rol du rnam dbye dang po'i su dang gnyis pa'i am ni am du 'gyur ro/ /su/ am/am la snga ma'o zhes pas/ dz+nyā rna/ dz+nyā na/ go na sum̐ sa kāstso/ ma ning la'ang ngo / /ma ning gi rtags las rnam dbye dang po'i audang gnyis pa'i au ni shī zhes par 'gyur la de la bha'i ming can zhes brda chad do/ /au shī/ ya gye ti tsa / gang gi ita la'ang ngo / /yī yig bha'i ming can dang de phan gye rkyen rnams la rtags mtha'i a yig dang i yig dbyi'o zhes pas spyir btang a dbyi ba thob kyang dmigs bsal 'grel par gzhan nas lung drangs te/ au shrīr 'gyur ba la a dbyi ba ma yin no/ /zhes pa byung bas a mi dbyi mtshams sbyar/ dz+nyā ṣ+pe/dz+nyā na la/ dzas/ dzash+ka soḥshiḥ/ dzas shas dag gi shi'o/ /ma ning gi rtags las pha rol rnam dbye dang po'i dzas dang gnyis pa'i shas ni shi zhes par 'gyur ro//shi sarba nā ma s+thā rgo/ shi thams cad gnas pa'i ming can no/ /dzas dang shas shi zhes par 'gyur ba de la thams cad gnas pa'i ming can zhes ming 'dogs byed do/ /na sum̐ ① sa ka gya dzha la tsa/ ma ning gi dzhal atsa'a'o/ /ma ning gi rtags dzhal so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge rnams dang atsa'i mtha' las thams cad gnas pa'i ming can pha rol la nu ma ā ga ma ster ro/ /u brjod don/ ma ni ma 'gro ba atsa'i mtha' la pha rol zhes pa'i don/ saṃ burnyi ma yin pa'i thams cad gnas pa'i ming can la yang ngo zhes pas/ u pa dh+wa ring por bsgyur/ dz+nyā nā ni/ gnyis pa rnams la'ang sgrub tshul dang gzugs gnyis ka 'dra bas/ dz+nyā 117—154

rna—/ dz+nyā ṣ+pe/ dz+nyā nā ni/ saṃ burnyi la/ eng thung ngu zhes saṃ budhi ①phyis/ te tshwa na④/ te dz+nyā ṣ+pe/ te dz+nyā nā ni/ rnam dbye lhag ma thams cad skyes pa'i rtags kyi skabs su bshad pa'i rā ma'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /de bzhin du/ dha na—/ snyenor/ ba na/—nags/ phal/snye'abrasabu/ la sogs mang po zhig 'di dang 'dra'o//ka ta ra sogs la su dang am la bya ba mi 'dra ste/ aṇ+ḍa ta rā di bh+yaḥpañca bh+yaḥ/ḍa ta ra sogs lnga rnams las a daḍa'o/ /ma ning gi rtags kyi skabs su ḍa ta ra'i mtha' can/ ka ta ra dang / ka ta ma/ a n+ya ta ra/ a n+ya ta ma/i ta ra ste lnga po'i pha rol gyi rnam dbye dang po'i su dang gnyis pa'i am ni/ a daḍa zhes par 'gyur ro/ /ka ta ra/ a daḍa zhes pa byung / ṭiḥ/ ṭi'i'o//rkyen ḍa 'gro ba pha rol la rtags sogs kyi ṭi dbye bar bya ste/ ṭi phyis/ drangs/—ka ta rang / bā wa sā ṣ+pe/ gnas med pa la yang na'o/ /gnas med pa ste tshig mtha' hal atsa med pa de dzhal so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge yin na rang dang gnas mthun pa'i tsar so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge rnams su yang na 'gyur te/ ka ta rata—/ ka ta rad/ au dang dzas la/ ka ta re/ ka ta rā ṇi/ bod tshig kyang rnam dbye dang po dang 'dra bas/ he ka ta ra da/ he ka ta ra ta/ te ka ta re/ ④he ka ta rā ṇi/ gnyis pa rnams la'ang / ka ta rad/ ka ta rata/ka ta re/ ka ta rā ṇiX/ rnam dbye lhag ma rnams skyes pa'i skabs su bshad pa'i sarba'i rtags dang 'dra/ de bzhin du/ ka ta ma/ a n+ya ta ra/ a n+ya ta ma/ i ta ra sogs kyang 'di dang 'dra'o/ /a dza ra/ zhes pa'i rtags la atsa thog ma can rnams la sngar bshad pa'i mdos/ a dza ras/ zhes par 'gyur ba dang mi 'gyur ba 'dam rjoka ste/ su la/ a dza re/ a dza ra saṃ/117—155

au la/ a dza re/ a dza ra sī/ dzas la a dza ras su mi 'gyur ba'i phyogs la/a dza rā ṇi/ lugs gcig la/ a dza ra nu sra①/ i zhes gnas pa la/sī ta ma ha taḥsaṃ yo ga su/ sa mtha' ma hata dag gi yang dag par sbyor ba'i'o/ /sa mtha' na dang yang dag sbyor ba sta brtsegs pa dang ma hata la num byin pa'i na lta bu'i u pa jo ni/ saṃ burnyi ma yin pa'i rnam dbye thams cad gnas pa'i ming can rnams la ring por 'gyur ro/ /a dza rārmi/ saṃ burnyi la/ he a dza ra/te a dza re/ te a dza sī/ te a dza rā ṇi/ he a dza rārmi/ gnyis pa rnams dang po dang 'dra/ gsum pa rnams la/ a dza re ṇa/ a dza ra sā/ a dza rā rgyu/ a dza riḥ/ bzhi pa la/ a dza rā ②ya/ a dza ra se a dza rā rgyu①—/ a dza re bh+yaḥ/ lnga pa la/ a dza rāta/ a dza ra sa④ཿ/ rgyu bh+yaḥ'adra/drug pa la/ a dza ra su/ a dza ra saḥ a dza ra yoḥ a dza ra soḥ a dza rā shā/ a dza ra sī/ bdun pa la/ a dza re/ a dza ra se a dza ra yoḥ / a dza ra soḥ/ a dza ra ⑤6/ j-i rjod ya la/—snying/ rnam dbye dang po rnams dang bod tshig rnams dang / rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig rnams dz+nyā na'i skabs dang 'dra ste/ z-i da yo/ dz+dza da ye/ z-i da yā ni/te z-i da ya/ te ⑦z-i da ye⑧/ he z-i da yā nī/⑨ z-i da yo/ j-i da ye/ dz+dza da ya la/ shas/ shas sogs rnams la zhes pa'i mdos j-i da ya/ z-id du 'gyur⑫—/ dzas shas dag gi shi/ ma ning gi dzhal atsa'i 'os num/ hṝn+di/lugs gcig /z-i da yā ni/ ṭā la/ dz+dza dā/ z-i da ye na/ hūṃ la/z-ihūṃ—/ z-i da yā dz+nyā/ bhiḥl/ z-id+dhiḥ/ z-i da yiḥ/ nge la/ z-i de/z-i da yā ya/ rgyu 'dra/ bh+yaḥl/ j-ibh+yoḥ/ dz+dza da ye bh+yaḥ/ nga si la/ z-i daḥ/117—156

rtags ①ika so sor bsdu ba'i yi ①ge yod la rnam dbye atsa thog ma can byung na num ā ga ma ster ro/ /bā ri bhā/ dzas la/ dzas shas dag gi shi/ rnam dbye atsa la zhes pas num/ samyurnyi ma yin pa'i zhes pas u pa dh+wa ring po/ bā rī ṇi—/ saṃ burnyi la/ thung ngu'i yon tan no zhes dang / thung ngu dang eng zhes pas saṃ budhi phyis/ he bā re/ he bā ri tī/ te bā rī ṇi/ rnam dbye gnyis pa rnams dang po dang 'dra/ ṭā la/ bā ri ṇa/ dz+nyā la/ bā ri rgyu/ rnyiḥl/bā ri bhiḥ/ nge la/ bā ri ṇi/ dz+nyā 'dra/ bh+yas la/ bā re ①khyuḥ/ nga se la—/ bā ri ṇaḥ/ rgyu bh+yaḥ'adra/ ngas la/ bā ri ṇaḥ/ os la/ bā ri khoḥ/bā rī shā/ ji la/ bā ri ṇi/ os 'dra/ supa la/ bā ri 6/ a nā di zhes pa'ang rnam dbye ṭā yan chad bā ri dang 'dra ste/ dang po rnams la/ a nā di/ a nā di nī/ a nā dī ni/ bod tshig la/ he a nā de/ te a nā di rtswa/ he a nā dī ni/ gnyis pa rnams kyang dang po dang 'dra/ a nā di/ṭā—/ tro tī yā di 6 bhā ṣi ta sum̐ sko sum̐ baṅgā la wa mya/ gsum pa sogs rnams la skyes par bshad pa'i skyes pa bzhin ga la wa'i'o/ /rtags ika so sor bsdu ba'i mtha' can las pha rol rnam dbye gsum pa'i ṭā nas bdun pa'i supa kyi bar gyi atsa thog ma can rnams la/ sngar skyes pa'i rtags kyi skabs su bshad pa'i cho ga rnams dang / ma ning gi rang lugs ltar atsa thog ma can rnams la num ster ba sngon gyi drang srong ga la ba'i lugs so/ /a nā di nā ste lugs gnyis ka gzugs 'dra / skyes pa ltar na ṭā nā/ ma ning rang lugs ltar na num byin drangs pa'o—/ /hūṃ bhis la/ a nā di hūṃ/ a nā di bhiḥ/ nge la/ a nā da ye/a nā di ṣ+pe/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ nga si la/ a nā deḥ/ a nā di naḥ/ dz+nyā bh+yas 117—159

zhes pas i yar 'gyur/ su dhi yā/ su dhe rgyu/ su dhi bhiḥ/ nge la/ su dhi ṣ+pe—/ su dhi ye/ rgyu khyus 'dra/ nga si la/ su dhi naḥ/ su dhi yaḥ/ r+ghaṃ ①bh+yaḥ'adra—/ ngas la/ su dhi naḥ/ su dhi yaḥ/ os la/ su bye noḥ/ su dhi yoḥ/ ām la/ su bye rmā/ su bye yī④/ ji la/ su dhi ni/ su dhi yi/os 'dra/ supa la/ su dhi 6/ pra dhī la sogs pa yang 'di dang 'dra'o/ /de rnams kyis ma ning gi rtags i ring thung rnams kyi cho ga bstan zin to/ /༈ da ni ma ning gi rtags u mtha' can rnams bshad par bya ste/ ma dhu su / —sprangaji/ ma ning la su e 'jig /ma dhu/ au shī/ num/ ma byu smi/dzas shi num/ u pa dh+wa ring po/ ma dhū ni/ he ma dhu/ he ma sgo/ te ma dhu nī/ te ma dhū ni/ gnyis pa rnams dang po dang 'dra/ ṭā la num/ ma dhu nā/ ma dhu dz+nyā/ ma dhu bhiḥ/ nge la/ ma dhu ṣ+pesne/ rgyu bh+yas 'dra/ nga si la/ma dhu naḥ/ rgyu bh+yaḥ'adra/ ngas la/ ma dhu naḥ/ os la/ ma dhu noḥ/ām la/ ma dhū ④rmā/ ji la/ ma dhu ni/ os 'dra/ ma dhu 6/ amyu yang 'di dang 'dra'o/ /su ṣ+ṭa/snyelegasagacod/ zhes pa'ang rtags mtha' thung ngur 'gyur—/ rnam dbye dang po rnams la/ su lu/ su lu nī/ su phru ni/ he su lu/ he su lo/ he su lu nī⑤/ he su phru rjoni/ gnyis pa rnams dang po dang 'dra/ ṭā la/ ma ning rang lugs ltar na/ nu ma/ su lu nā/ skyes pa'i lugs ltar na rtags mtha' thung ⑦ngur mi 'gyur/ ig dze+egi a tsa la yaṇa/su lā/ su lu dz+nyā/ su lu bhiḥ/ nge la/ su lu ṣ+pe/ su swe/ rgyu bh+yas 'dra/nga se la/ su lu naḥ/ su lwaḥ/ dz+nyā bh+yas 'dra/ ngas la/ su lu naḥ/ su lwaḥ—/ os la/ su lu noḥ/ su ā+oḥ/ ām la/ su phru rmā/ su hūṃ/117—161

etsa'i ika thung ngur kun nas bsgyur ro/ /ma ning gi rtags las etsa so sor bsdu ba'i mtha' can rnams ni ika so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge thung ngu rnams su 'gyur bas| pra dhu zhes par 'gyur/ su phyis/ pra dhu/ pra dhu m+bi/ pra dhū ①ni/he pra dhu④/ he pra dhu m+bi/ he pra dhū ni/ gnyis pa rnams 'dra/ ṭā ④man chad la atsa dang po can rnams la ma ning rang lugs kyi cho ga ltar na num byin/skyes pa'i lugs ltar ④etsa'i aya awa sogs bya ste/ pra dhu nā/ pra dha wā/pra dhu rgyu/ pra byu bhiḥ/ pra dhu ṣ+pe/—grubazang po/ pra dha we/ spyo bh+yaḥ'adra/ nga si la/pra dhu naḥ/ pra dhoḥ/ dz+nyā bh+yaḥ'adra/ ngas yang nga si dang 'dra/ as ⑤la/pra byu noḥ/ pra dha yoḥ/ ām dhil/ pra dhū rmā/ pra dha rmā/ ji la/ pra dhu ni—/ pra dha wi/ os 'dra/ pra byu 6/ pra ri norarab zhes pa'ang pra ri zhes par 'gyur/ pra ri/ pra ri bhā/ pra rī ṇi/ he pra ri/ ho pra ri bhā/ he pra rī ṇi/ gnyis pa rnams 'dra/ ṭā sogs la ma ning rang lugs ltar na num steraske/ skyes pa'i lugs ltar na i ā yar 'gyur te/ ri ⑦zhes pa'i skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /su no zhes pa/ su nu zhes par 'gyur/ i ⑧āya dang au āwa'i khyad ma gtogs pra ri skabs dang 'dra'o/ /i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa su sru tā da dzarnya na sum̐ sa ka liṅgā ni sa māṭ+wāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las atsa'i mtha' can ma ning gi rtags rnams rdzogs so / /⑨de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po ⑩pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las atsa'i mtha' can ma ning gi rtags rnams kyi bya ba byer btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa rags pa rnams 117—163

ming can gyi su pha rol la num ā ga ma 'gyur te/ num byen/ ha la dīpa āpa zhes pas ①su phyis/ yang dag par sbyor ba'i mtha' dbyi 'os/ ha phyis/ a na ḍān/ lo dang dzas la/ a na ḍā ho/ a na ḍā haḥ/ a na cheha la/saṃ burnyi/ am saṃ burnyo/ saṃ budhi la ama'o/ /a na cheha dang tsa tur gnyis la saṃ burnyi pha rol la am ā ga ma ster ro/ /a na che ha'i su la 'os num/ he a na ḍan/ he a na ḍā ho/ he a na ḍā haḥ/ am la/ a na ḍā haṃ/aul—/ a na ḍā ho/ shas la/ a na che haḥ/ ṭā la/ a na che hā/ a na che ha la/ dz+nyā bh+yas/ ba su sre su dhī swa na che hūṃ daḥ/ ba su sre su dhī su a na che ha rnams kyi da'o/ /ba su dang sre su dang d+dhā su dang a na che ha rnams kyi sa mtha' rnams dang ha yig ni dzhal so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge gang rung pha rol na yod pa dang tshig mtha' la da ru 'gyur ro/ /a na che:/ a na chedhiḥ/ bzhi pa rnams la/ a na che te/ a na che:/ a na chebh+yoḥ/ lnga pa rnams la/ a na che haḥ/ a na che:/ a na che5ཿ/ drug pa rnams la/ a na che haḥ/a na che hoḥ/ a na che hūṃ/ bdun pa rnams la/ a na che hi/ a na che hoḥ/a na cherlu/ shwe ta wāha —dkarapo thob pa zhes pa cung mi 'dra ste/ 'grel par/shwe ta wāha/ ut+tha shās/ pu ro ḍās/ a wa yādza/ rnams la tshig mtha' ma yin pa la ḍa sa'i rkyen 'jug go zhes pa byung bas/ rtags de rnams la dbyangs ma yin pa'i hal thog ma can gyi rnam dbye rnams la ḍasa'i rkyen byin/ ḍa yig ṭi'i'o zhes pa'i don yin pas ṭi phyis/ shwe ta bas su/ a twa saṃ ta mya tsā jo toḥ/a tu as mtha'i 'ang byings ma yin pa'i'o/ /a tu'i mtha' dang as kyi mtha' ④byings ma yin pa dag saṃ budhi ma yin pa'i su pha rol la u pa jo ring por 'gyur ro//117—167

yi ge pha rol la u ru 'gyur ro/ /su byu r+ghaṃ/ su byu rnyiḥ/ nge la/ su di we/rgyu bh+yas la/ su byu ①rgyu/ su byu ④bh+yaḥ/ nga ṅga la/ su di waḥ/ rgyu bh+yas 'dra/drug pa rnams la/ su di waḥ/ su di yoḥ/ su di shā/ ji la/ su di byu/os la/ su di yoḥ/ supa la/ su byu 6/ bod tshig la/ she su rdzuḥ/he su di waṃ/ he su di waḥ/ ra mtha' can la tsa tur bzhizhes par ①mang tshig bdun po sbyor te/ tsa tur/ dzas/ tsa tur a na che ha da ga gi ām u dāt+ta'o zhes pa'i mdos ām ā ga ma/ tsa tāraḥ/ shas la/ tsa tu raḥ/ bhis la—/ tsa tusgoḥ/ bh+yas gnyis la/ tsa turgyaḥ/ ām la/ ṣaṭa tsa turgyabyu/ṣaṭa tsa tur rnams las kyang ngo / /ṣaṭa dang tsa tur zhes pa la/ rnam dbye drug pa'i ām la nuṭa ster ro/ /ra ṣa sogs kyis na ṇa/ atsa las ra ha la zhes pas ṇa gnyis/ tsa tuṭ+wā/ supa la/ rosru pi/ ra'i supa la'o/ /tsa tur gyi ra ni rnam dbye bdun pa'i mang tshig supa pha rol la rnam par bcad ④par mi 'gyur bar ra nyid 'dren pa'o/ /tsa tukhyo/ spyir btang ra ha la/ zhes pas ṣa gnyis su bya ba thob kyang / sha ro tsi/ atsa la shar gyi'o/ /shar so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge atsa dang ldan pa dag ra ha la gnyis su mi 'gyur ro zhes pas dmigs bsal gyi mdos gnyis su mi 'gyur/ te tsa tā raḥ/ thra ya tsa tur dga'ab bzhi zhes pa lta bu rnam dbye thams cad 'jug ste/ su la/ thra ya tsa ṭ+wāḥ/au dang dzas la/ m+bi ya tsa tā ro/ pri ya tsa tā raḥ/ am la/ thra ya tsa tā re/au la/ pre ya tsa twa ro/ shas la/ pri ya tsa tu raḥ/ gsum pa rnams la/pri ya tsa tu rā/ pri ya tsa tu:/ pri ya tsa tubhiḥ/ bzhi pa rnams la/ thra ya tsa tu re/ pre ya tsa tu:/ pri ya tsa turgyaḥ/ nga se la/ thra ya tsa tu raḥ/117—170

rgyu bh+yas 'dra/ ngas la/ pri yatsa turaḥ/ os la/ thra ya tsa tu roḥ/ ām la / grangs bgrong ba'i ①skabs ma gtogs nuṭa mi 'jug /pri ya tsa tu dzā/ji la/ thra ya tsa tu ri/ os la/ pre ya tsa tu roḥ/ /pre ya tsa tukhyo/ saṃ burnyi la i/ te tsa twa②ཿ/ te tsa tā ro/ he tsa tā raḥ/ ma mtha' can la/ pra shām la su/ mo no jo toḥ/ byengs kyi ma'i na'o/ /byings kyi ma ni dzhal so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge rnams pha rol dang tshig mtha' la na ru 'gyur te/ man/su phyis/ pra shān/ lo dang dzas la/ pra shā mo/ pra shā maḥ/ gnyis pa rnams la/ pra shā oṃ/ pra shā mo/ pra shā maḥ/ ṭā la/ pra shā mā/ dz+nyā la/pra shā:/ rnyis lasne/ pra shārnyiḥrjo/ bzhi pa rnams la/ pra shā me/ pra shāhūṃ/pra shābyuḥ/ nga se la/ pra shā maḥ/ rgyu bh+yas 'dra/ drug pa rnams la/ pra shā maḥ| pra shā moḥ/ pra shā rmā/ bdun pa rnams la/ pra shā mi/ pra shā moḥ/pra shārlu/ te pra shān/ he pra shā mo/ te pra shā maḥ/ kim la/rkoci/ su/kimaḥkaḥ| kim gyi ka'o/ /kim zhes pa'i sgra ni rnam dbye gang mthong yang ka zhes par 'gyur ro/ /kaḥ/ kau/ ke/ sogs te pho rtags sarba'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /sarba nā ma'i nang tshan i 'didam la/ su/ i da mo maḥ/i dam gyi ma'o/ /i dam zhes pa'i ma ni su pha rol la ma nyid du gnas te/t+yad sogs rnams kyi a'o zhes pa 'gog pa'i don no/ /i da mo lnga sum̐ si/ i dam gyi aphra skyes pa la'o/ /i dam zhes pa'i i dang da srog med ni skyes pa'i rtags kyi skabs su pha rol la yang aya zhes par 'gyur te/ a yi/ i dam la/lo—/ t+yad sogs rnams kyi a 'os ma a/ a to gu ṇi/ ad sdekyi yon tan la'o| /tshig mtha' ma yin pa'i ata mtha' las i dam gyi ma ar 'gyur ba 117—171

lta bu'i a yig yon tan gyi ming can de snga ①ma'i gzugs su 'gyur ro/ /i da/lo—/ dbyu/ da'i'ang ngo / /i dam zhes pa'i ma ar 'gyur ba snga ma'i gzugs su song ba'i da de'ang rnam dbye gang mthong yang ma ru 'gyur ro/ /i ma/au— etsa ②la 'phel ba 'os/ i mo/ dzas la/ i dam/ i ma/dzas shī a las yon tan/ i me/ gnyis pa rnams la/ i rma/ i mo①/i mān/ ṭā la/ a nā pyakaḥ/ āpa la a na ka ma yin pa la'o/ /i dam zhes t+yad sogs rnams kyi rjo.a 'os/ i da zhes par bsgyur ba ni ka'i rkyen mtha' can ma yin na āpa so sor bsdu ba ste rnam dbye gsum pa'i ṭā nas bdun pa'i supa kyi pa'i bar gyi rnam dbye gang mjong yang a na zhes par 'gyur ro/ /ṭā i na/ a ṣ+pe na/ rgyu la/ ha li lo paḥ/ hal la dbye'o/ /ṭā sogs kyi nang tshan yin kyang rnam dbye hal thog ma can rnams la i da zhes pa a nar mi 'gyur bar i dang da gnyis du byi'o/ /a rgyu/ sub la'ang ngos ring po ā rgyu—/ bhis la/ a rnyiḥ/ ṣ+pe nga ma da so ra koḥ/ ka ma yin pa dag gi i dam a ⑤das dag la ma yin no/ /ka'i rkyen mtha' can ma yin pa'i i dam dang a das dag las rnam dbye gsum pa'i mang tshig bhis ni es zhes par mi 'gyur ro/ /mang tshig la dzhal la eta 'os/ e bhiḥ/ nge rjol/ t+yad sogs rnams kyi a 'os/ i da/ nge / sarba'i ming can las smi 'os/ nge smi/hal la dbyi 'os/ i dang du phyis/ ame+e/ hūṃ dang bh+yas la/ ā dz+nyā/ e bh+yaḥ—/ i da/ nga se/ nga si ji dag gi dze+esmrata smin dag gos/ nga se/s+thāta—/ hal la dbyi 'os id phyis/ asmrad/ ā rgyu/ e bh+yaḥ/ ngas la/a su/ os la/ āpa la a na ka ⑧ma yin pa la 'os ⑨i da a na zhes par 117—172

'gyur—/ os la 'ang ngos/ rtags mtha' e/ a na yoḥ/ ām la/e ྾/ ji la/ asmin/ os la/ a na yoḥ/ supa la/ e 6/yang i dam gyi ①lus 'gyur lugs gcig la/ i ①da zhes pa rnam dbye gnyis pa rnams dang / gsum pa'i ṭā dang drug pa dang bdun pa'i os rnams la yang na ba ste/ dī tī yā ṭosge ①na/ gnyis pa ṭā/ os rnams la e rjona'o/ /rnam dbye gnyis pa rnams dang ṭā dang os gnyis rnams pha rol la i dam dang e tad ni e ⑤na zhes par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa rnams la/ e dz+wa/ e no/e nān/ ṭā la/ e ṣ+pe na/ os la/ e rjon yoḥ/ t+yad sogs la bod tshig mi 'jug go/ /༈ na mtha' can la/ rā ⑦dzan la/—rgyalapo'am gsal ba/ su/ saṃ budhi ma yin pa'i thams cad gnas pa'i ming can la 'ang ngos/ u pa ṅgā ring po/ hal dīpa āpa sogs kyis/ su phyis/ ming mtha'i na dbye'os/ na phyis/ rā dzā/au dang dzas la/ saṃ burnyi ma yin pa zhes pas/ u pa dh+wa ring po/ rā dzā no/rā dzā naḥ/ rā dzanu la/ saṃ budhi'i ming can su/ na ji saṃ busbyoḥ/ ji saṃ burnyi dag la ma yin no/ /rnam dbye bdun pa'i ji dang saṃ budhi pha rol la ming mtha'i na dbye ba ma yin no zhes pas na mi phyi/ te rā dzan/ te rā dzā no/ he rā dzā naḥ/ e dang au la/ rā dzā dz+wa/ rā dzā kau/ rā dzan la shas/ na'i ata dbyi 'os/ dza' a phyis/ sa tu'i sha tsu la ⑧sha tsu 'os/ na nya/ dza nya 'dus pa rnye/ rā rnyeḥ/ ṭā la/ rā dz+nyā/ rgyu la/ ming mtha'i na dbye 'os/na phyis/ na lo paḥ⑨sugrwar saṃ dz+nyā tusbi dhi 6 kṛ ti/ na dbyi ba supa dbyangs ming kṛta tuka gi cho ga rnams la'o/ /supa ste su sogs rnam dbye rnams dang 117—173

dbyangs pha rol dang ming dang kṛta kyi rkyen rnams dang / tuka ā ga ma sogs la na phyis pa'i rjes la cho ga gzhan mi 'jug ste/ dper na rgyu gyi skabs su na phyis pa'i rjes la supa la'o zhes pa'i ring po mi byed pa lta bu'o/ /rā dza rgyu/ bhis la/rā dza bhiḥ/ bzhi pa rnams la/ rā sna①/ rā dzadz+nyā/ rā dza bh+ya④ཿ/ nga si la/rā snyoḥ/ rgyu bh+yas 'dra/ ngas la/ rā snyoḥ/ os la/ rā snyoḥ/ ām la/rā ā+oṃ/ ji la/ ji saṃ burnyi dag la ma yin no zhes pas/ lugs gcig la/rā dza ni/ yang na/ rā rnyi/ os la/ rā rnyoḥ/ supa la/ rā dza su/༈ pra ti di wan la su/ pra ti di wā①/—sosor gsal ba/ au dang dzas/ pra ti di wā no/ pra ti di wā naḥ/ am la/ pra ti di wā dz+wa/ au la/ pra ti di wā no/ shas la/ 'grel par a phyis pa las u pa d+ma ring po 'o zhes pa byung bas—/ na'i a dbyi 'os/ a phyis/ u pa ṅgā ring po/ pra ti dīsnaḥ/gsum pa rnams la/ pra ti dībhā/ pra te di dhiwa rgyu/ pra ti di wa bhiḥ/sogs / rā dzan gyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /༈ ya dz+wan lha mchod mkhan la su/ yadzā/ au la/ yadzā no/ dzas la/ya dzā naḥ/ am dang au la/ ya dzā ṣ+pe/ ya dzā kau/ shas la/ na saṃ yo bā dwa me tā ta/ wa ma yang dag par sbyor ba'i mtha' las ma yin no/ /rtags kyi u pa jo wa yig dang ma yig brtsegs pa yod na spyir btang na'i a dbyi'o/ /zhes pa'i a mi dbyi ba na nyid atsa thog ma can rnams la 'dren pa kho na'o/ /ya dz+wa naḥ/ ṭā la/ ya dz+wa nā/ rgyu bhis/ ya dz+wa rgyu/ ya dz+wa bhiḥ/ nge la/ ya dz+wa ṣ+pe/ rgyu bh+yaḥ'adra/ nga si la/ ya dz+wa naḥ/ r+ghaṃ bh+yas 'dra/ drug pa rnams la/ya dz+wa naḥ/ ya dz+wa noḥ/ ya dz+wa rmā/ bdun pa rnams la/ ya dz+wa ni/ ya dz+wa 117—174

༈ ma gha wan brgyabyin la/ su/ ma gha wā ba hu lo/ ma gha wan gyi ①yang na'o/ /ma gha wan zhes pa'i sgra ni rnam dbye gang mthong yang ma gha wa dṛ zhes par yang na 'gyur ro/ /ṛ 'gro ba'i ming can yin pas mi gnas kyang dgos pa'i ched du'o//u sdi tsā sarba nā ma ④s+thā ṣ+pe dh+wa toḥ/ uka 'gro ba atsa rnams kyi thams cad gnas pa'i ming can rnams la byings ma yin pa la'o/ /rtags mthar uka ste u yig dang ṛ yig dang lo ①yig 'gro ba rnams dang atsa zhes pa'i rtags byengs ma yin pa dag la pha rol rnam dbye thams cad gnas pa'i ming can gang byung yang num ④ā ga ma ster ro/ /ma gha wan tra/ su/ a tu as mtha'i 'ang byings ma yin pa'i 'os/ u pa dh+wa ⑤ring po/ hal dīpa āpa dhisogs kyi mdos su phyis/yang dag par sbyor ba'i mtha' dbyi 'os/ ta phyis/ ma gha wānadze+e/ au dang dzas la/ ma sgegha wārnyo/ ma gha wān+taḥ/ am dang au la/ ma ⑨gha wārnya/ ma gha wārnyo/ shas la/ ma gha wa taḥ/ gsum pa rnams la/ ma gha wa ⑩tā/ma gha wa :⑪/ ma gha wadhiḥ/ nge la/ ma gha wa te/ rgyu bh+yas 'dra/ nga se la/ma gha wa taḥ/ dz+nyā bh+yas 'dra/ drug pa rnams la/ ma gha wa taḥ/ ma gha wa to⑫ཿ—/ ma gha wa hūṃ/ bdun pa rnams la/ ma gha wa ti/ ma gha wa toḥ/ ma gha warlu/ bod tshig rnams la/ te ma gha wan/ te ma gha wārnyo/ te ma gha wārnyaḥ—/ ma gha wan/ zhes pa/ ma gha wa tro ⑫zhes par ma 'gyur ba'i phyogs ni/rnam dbye dang po rnams la/ ma gha wā/ ma gha wā rna/ ma gha wā naḥ/ am dang au la/ ma gha wā dz+wa/ ma gha wā ④no/ shas la/ i gya ṇaḥsaṃ pra sā ra ṇi⑫/yaṇa'i ika ⑩tu slar yang dag par bsgyur ro/ /yaṇa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge rnams ika so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge grangs mnyam pa rnams su 'gyur te/ de la 117—176

slar yang dag par bsgyur ba'i ming can zhes zer ro/ /shwa yu wa ma gho nā ①ma tarnyi te/ shwan yu wan ma gha wan rnams kyi de phan ma yin pa la'o/ /shwan la sogs pa 'di rnams kyi de phan gyi rkyen ma yin pa rnam dbye/ shas nas/bdun pa'i sub kyi bar atsa thog ma can rnams la slar yang dag par bsgyur te/lnga| u/ ma gha u/ an/ shas/ saṃ pra sā ra ṇ+ḍartso/ saṃ pra sā ra ṇa las kyang ngo / /slar yang dag par bsgyur ba las pha rol gyi atsa de yang snga ma'i gzugs su ①'gyur bas a u dang bcas pa u/ a la yon tan nos o/ ma gho naḥ/ gsum pa rnams la/ ma gho nā/ ma gha wa rgyu/ ma gha wa bhiḥ/ nge la—/ ma gho ṣ+pe/ rgyu bh+yas 'dra/ nga se la/ ma sgo naḥ/ rgyu bh+yas 'dra/drug pa rnams la/ ma gho naḥ/ ma gha ①noḥ/ ma gho dzā/ bdun pa rnams la/ma gho ni/ ma gho noḥ/ ma gha wa su/ bod tshig la/ he ma gha ban/ te ma gha wā rjono/ he ma gha bānaḥ/༈ shwan la su/snyekhyi/ shā/ lo dang dzas la/ shā no/ shā naḥ/ am dang lo la/ shā rna/ shā no/ shwan la/ shas/ shwan yu wan ma gha wan rnams kyi zhes pas/ wa u/ shu naḥ/ ṭā la/ shu nā/ sgyum bhis la/shwargyu—/ shwa rnyi⑤ཿ/ rnam dbye lhag ma rnams la'ang atsa thog ma can rnams shas dang 'dra/ hal thog ma ducan rnams dz+nyā dang 'dra'o/ /༈ yu wan la su/—lang tsho'am dar bab/ yu wā/ au dang dzas la/ yu wā no/yu wā naḥ/ am dang lo la/ yu wā rna/ yu wā no/ shas la/ shwan yu wan sogs kyi mdos wa u/ yu u an/ shas/ na saṃ pra sā ra be+e saṃ pra sā ra ṇi/slar yang dag par bsgyur ba la sbar yang dag par bsgyur ba ma yin no/ /wa 117—177

rnams kyi i yig ni rnam dbye thams cad gnas pa'i ming can rnams la a yig tu 'gyur te/ pa tha ā/ su/ thon+d+raḥ/ tha'i n+d+ra'o/ /pa thi dang ma thi zhes pa'i tha yig ni rnam dbye thams cad gnas pa'i ming can rnams pha rol la n+d+ra zhes par 'gyur ro/ /pan+d+ra ā/ su/ aka gi 'dra ba la ring po/ sa sa dzuṣa sogs dang khar sogs kyi mdos/ pan+d+raḥ/ lo dang dzas la/ pan+d+ra no/pan+d+ra naḥ/ am la/ par+sā rna/ au la/ pan+d+ra no/ pa thin la/ shas/bha su ṭiḥlo paḥ/ bha'i ṭi dbyi'o/ /bha'i ming can pa thin la sogs pa rnams kyi ṭi rnam dbye thams cad gnas pa'i ming can ma yin pa atsa thog ma can rnams la dbyi ste/ pa thaḥ/ ṭā la/ ṭi phyis drangs/ pa thā/ sgyum rnyis la/ming mtha'i na phyis/ pa thi dz+nyā/ pa thi bhiḥ/ bzhi pa rnams la/ pa the/pa thi rgyu/ pa thi bh+yaḥ/ nga si la/ pa thaḥ/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ drug pa rnams la/ pa thaḥ/ pa thoḥ/ pa tsā/ bdun pa rnams la/ pa thi/ pa thoḥ—/ pa thi 6/ bod tshig la/ he pan+d+ra/ he pan+d+rano/ te pan+d+ra naḥ/ma thin srubs pa yang 'di dang 'dra'o/ /༈ ṛ bhuk+ṣan brgyabyin la/ su/ pa thin ma thin ṛ bhuk+ṣan rnams kyi āta 'os/na ā/ aka gi 'dra ba la ring po/ ṛ bhuglaḥ/ au dang dzas la/ ṛ bhu7 no/ṛ bhuk+ṣu naḥ/ am dang au/ ṛ bhulnga rna/ ṛ bhugla no/ shas la/ bha'i ṭi dbye 'os/ ṭi phyis drangs/ ṛ bhuk+ṣaḥ/ ṭā la/ ṛ byuk+ṣu/ hūṃ la/ ṛ bhuk+ṣa rgyu/ lta bu ste/ atsa thog ma can rnams la ṭi dbyi/ hal thog ma can rnams la ming mtha'i na dbyi ba kho na'o/ /༈ na mtha' can/ pañcan lngal/ dzas dang shas/ ṣ+ṭi tā ṣaṭa/ ṣa na 117—179
