kṛta rkyen byin pa'i byings las 'gyur zin pa de dang de phan gyi rkyen mtha' dang tshig sdud byas pa'i mtha' rnam dbye byin ma grub ①pa de la ming ngam rtags sam sgra zhes zer te su sogs 'jug pa'i yul yin pas/ yudza la/ su/ yu je ras mā se—/ yudza' tshig sdud ma yin pa la'o/ /tshig sdud med pa'i yudza zhes pa'i rtags la rnam dbye thams cad gnas pa'i ming can rnams pha rol du byung na num ā ga ma 'gyur te/ yunudz+ra/ hal dīb āpa sogs kyis su phyis/ yang dag par sbyor ba'i mtha' dbyi 'os/ dza phyis/ kin+d+ra t+ya ya su kuḥ/ kin rkyen gyi ku'o / /kin gyi rkyen byin pa'i mtha' na gnas pa'i yi ge rnams pha rol dzhal so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge dang tshig mtha' la grangs mnyam pa'i ku ste ka sder sne'agyur te/ta sde'i lnga pa na/ ka sde'i ①lnga pa ngar 'gyur/ yī/ au dang dzas la/ yuljo/yuñjaḥske/ am dang au la/ buyuljo/ yuljo/ shas la/ yu dzaḥ/ ṭā/yu dzā/ rgyu bh+yas la/ kin rkyen gyi ku 'os dza ga /yuhūṃ/ yusdi⑤ཿ/ nge la/yu jo/ rgyu bh+yas 'dra/ nga si la/ yu dzaḥ/ rgyu bh+yas 'dra/ drug pa rnams la/yu dzaḥ/ yu dzoḥ/ yu rdzu/ ji la/ yu dzi/ os la/ yu dzoḥ/ supa la/dza ga /khar la tsar 'os/ ga ka /inya sogs kyis sa ṣa drangs/ yuk+ṣu/bod tshig rnams la/ he yī/ he yuljo/ teyuñjaḥ/ ༈ yudza tshig sdud can ni/ su yudz+ra/—legs par lha mchod pa/ su/ tsolkuḥ/tsu'i ku'o/ /dzhal so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge gang rung pha rol du byung ba dang tshig mtha' la tsu ste tsa dusde srog med pa rnams ku ste ka sde'i grangs mthun pa rnams su 'gyur te/ dza ga /gnas med pa la yang na 'os kar 'gyur ba 'am ga nyid du gnas pa 'dam ka can du byas pas/ su yuka/ su yug /au dang dzas la/117—182

rol la sa yig tu 'gyur ro/ /suḥ/ au la/ khyo/ dzas/ shī/ bye sogs te/ sarba pho rtags kyi skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /༈ da yig mtha' can tad detad kyang bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra ste/ saḥ/to—/ te sogs so/ /yad gangaces pa la'ang / yaḥ/ yo/ ye/ sogs soske/ /e tad del/ e ṣaḥ/ e to①/ e te/ sogs rigs 'gre/ yang e tad kyi lus 'gyur gzhan ni rnam dbye gnyis pa rnams dang / ṭā dang os gnyis la/ gnyis pa ṭā os rnams la e na'o zhes pas/ e tad/ e na zhes par 'gyur/ gnyis pa rnams la/ e dz+wa/ e kau/ e nān/ ṭā la/e ṣ+pe na/ os gnyis sdel/ e na yoḥ/ zhes pa'ang lugs gcig go/ /༈ da yig ①mtha' can/ yuṣ+ṭhad/snyer+ṣa/ a smad nga'am bdag la/ surjo/ de pra tha ma yo ram/ de dang po dag gi ama'o/ /yuṣ+ṭhad dang aṣ+ṭhad ces pa'i rtags las rnam dbye dang po rnams dang gnyis pa rnams dang bzhi pa'i de rnams ni am zhes par 'gyur te/ su ⑤am du 'gyur/ yuṣ+ṭhad/ am/ asmad/amaske/ tā ho sau/ su la twa aha'o/ /rnam dbye dang po'i su pha rol la yuṣ+ṭhad kyi ad bzhag pa'i yugramra gsum ni/ twa zhes par 'gyur la/ asmad kyi ad bor ba'i asmra rnams a ha zhes par 'gyur te/ twa ad/ am/ a ha ad/amarka/ she ṣe lo paḥ/ lhag ma la dbyi'o/ /yuṣ+ṭhad dang asmad rjoces pa'i da yig ā dang ya ru 'gyur ba dag mi dbyi la/ ā ya ru 'gyur ba ma yin pa rnams dbyi bar bya ste/ da phyis/ twa a/ am/ a ha a/ am/ ad kyi yon tan la'o dang / am la snga ma 'os/ two/ mas haṃ/ yujud/ asmad ⑦la au/ nge dang po dag gi am 'os/ au/ am du 'gyur/ yuṣ+ṭhad/ am/117—186

asmad①| am/ yu wā waṃ dwo ba tsa ṣ+pe/ gnyis tshig la/ yu wa ā wa dag go / /rnam dbye gnyis tshig rnams la/ ad bor ba'i/ yudz+dza ni/ yu wa dang ad bor ba'i asmra ni/ ā wa zhes par 'gyur te/ yu wa ad/ am/ā wa ad/ am/ pra tha mā yāstsa dri ba tsa ṣ+pe bhā ṣā yi②/ dang po'i 'ang gnyis tshig brjod pa la'o/ /rnam dbye dang po'i gnyis tshig pha rol la yuṣ+ṭhad ces pa'i mtha' ār 'gyur te/ da yig ā ru 'gyur/ yu wa a ā/ am/ā dze+ewa a ā/ am/ ata kyi yon tan la 'os/ yu wa ā/ am/ ā wa ā / am④/ aka gi 'dra ba la ring po dang / am la snga ma 'os/ yu rmā/ā rmā/ yuṣ+ṭhad/ asmad la dzas/ nge dang po dag gi am 'os dzas am/yuṣ+ṭhad—/ am/ a ⑤smad/ am/ yu ya ba yo dza si/ dzas la yu ya ba ya'o| /rnam dbye dang po'i mang tshig dzas pha rol la ad bor ba'i yuṣ+pe ni yu ya dang ad bor ba'i asma ni ba ya zhes par 'gyur ro/ /yu ya ad/ am/ba ya ad/ am/ lhag ma la dbye 'os da phyis/ ad kyi yon tan la'o dang /am la snga ma 'os/ yu byayi/ ba yi/ yuṣ+ṭhad/ asmad la/ gnyis pa'i am/ nge dang po dag gi zhes pas am am du 'gyur/ yuṣ+ṭhad/ am/asmad / am/ twa mā we ka ba tsa ṣ+pe/ gcig tshig la twa ma dag go/ /rnam dbye gcig tshig rnams pha rol la/ ad bor ba'i yudz+dza ni twa dang ad bor ba'i asmra ni ma zhes par 'gyur te/ twa ad/ am/ ma ad/ am/ dī tī yā lnga tsa/ gnyis pa la'ang ngo / /rnam dbye gnyis pa rnams pha rol la'ang yuṣ+ṭhad asmad dag gi mtha' ste da ā ru 'gyur te/ twa a ā am/ ma a ā/a ma/ ata kyi yon tan la'o dang / aka gi 'dra ba la ring po/ am la snga 117—187

a ti yuṣ+ṭhad/ a ti asmad ces pa la/ rnam dbye gong du smos pa rnams ma gtogs gang byung yang yuṣ+ṭha twa dang asma ma zhes par 'gyur/ de nas gong du bstan pa'i rang rang gi cho gas bsgrub ste/ rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig la/a ti two/ a t+ya haṃ/ gnyis tshig la/ a ti hūṃ/ a ti rmā/ mang tshig la/a ti yu yo/ a ti ba yi/ gnyis pa'i gcig tshig la/ a ti hūṃ/ a ti rmā/gnyis tshig la/ a ti hūṃ/ a ti rmā/ mang tshig la/ a ti tān/ a ti mān / gsum pa'i gcig tshig la/ a ti twa yā/ a ti ma yā/ gnyis tshig la/ a ti tā rmyergyu/ a ti mā rgyu/ mang tshig la/ a ti tā bhiḥ/ a ti mā bhiḥ/ bzhi pa'i gcig tshig la/ a ti tu bye/ a ti ma hūṃ/ gnyis tshig la/ a ti tā dz+nyā/ a ti mā rgyu/ mang tshig la/ a ti twa bye/ a ti ma bye/ lnga pa'i gcig tshig la/ a ti twata/ a ti mata/ gnyis tshig la/a ti tā bye rgyu/ a ti mā dz+nyā/ mang tshig la/ a ti twata/ a ti mata/dag rngupa'i gcig tshig la/ a ti ta wa/ a ti ma ma/ gnyis tshig la/ a ti twa yoḥ/ a ti ma yoḥ/ mang tshig la/ a ti tā 4shaṃ/ a rngonyi mā shaṃ/bdun pa'i gcig tshig la/ a ti twa yi/ a ti ma yi/ gnyis tshig la/ a ti twa 'uyoḥ/ a ti ma yoḥ/ mang tshig la/ a ti tā su/ a ti mā su/ lta bu'o / /yang mi zad pa'i tshig sdud kyis murnam dbye rnams kyi gnyis tshig bsnyus rjes a ti snga ma can ni gong du smos pa'i rnam dbye rnams bor ba'i pha rol du rnam dbye gang byung yang ad bor ba'i yudz+re ni yu wa dang / ad por ba'i asmra ni ā 3wa zhes par 'gyur te/ dper na/ yu waṃ a ti/ ā waṃ a ti/ zhes pa la rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig au tshig sdud kyis bsdus/ a ti sngon/ a ti 117—191

yuṣ+ṭhad / a ti asmad ces pa la rnam dbye dmigs bsal bzhi po ma gtogs rnam dbye gang byung yang yuṣ+ṭha ni yu wa dang / asgra ni ā ①wa kho nar 'gyur/ de nas rang rang gi cho ga gong du bshad pa rnams kyis bsgrubs pas/ dper na/rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig la a ti two/ a t+ya haṃ/ gnyis tshig la/ a ti yu rmā②/ a ti ā shāsne/ mang tshig la/ a ti yu yo/ a ti ba yi/gnyis pa'i gcig tshig la/ a ti yu shā④/ a ti ā shā⑤/ gnyis tshig la/a ti yu shā/ a nyi ā shā/ mang tshig la/ a ti yu wān/ a ti ā wān/gsum pa'i gcig tshig la/ a ti yu wa yā/ a ti ā wa yā/ gnyis tshig la/a ti yu wā rgyu/ a ti ā wārgyu/ mang tshig la/ a ti yā wā bhiḥ/ a ti ā wā bhiḥ—/ bzhi pa'i gcig tshig la/ a ti tu :du/ a ti ma :/ gnyis tshig laske/ a ti yu wāspyo/ a ti ā wā r+ghaṃ/ mang tshig la/ a ti yu wa bye/ a nyi ā wa bye/ lnga pa'i gcig tshig la/ a ti yu wata/ a ti ā wata/gnyis tshig la/ a ti yu wā dz+nyā/ a ti ā wā rgyu/ mang tshig la/ a ti yu wata—/ a ti ā wata/⑦ drug pa'i gcig tshig la/ a ti ta ba/ a ti mamarka/ gnyis tshig la/ a ti yu ba yoḥ/ a ti ā ba yoḥ/ mang tshig la/a ti yu bā rka/ a ti ā bā kai/ bdun pa'i gcig tshig la/ a ti yu ba yi/a ti ā ba yi/ gnyis tshig la/ a ti yu ba yoḥ/ a ti ā ba yoḥ/ mang tshig la/ a ti yu bā su/ a ti ā bā su/ yang yud+mā ⑧na a ti/ asmran ⑨a ti—/ gong bzhin mi zad pa'i tshig sdud kyis rnam dbye rnams kyi mang tshig bsdus rjes a ti snga ma ni rnam dbye dmigs bsal bzhi po ma gtogs rnam dbye gang byung yang gzugs gzhan du mi 'gyur bar yuṣ+ṭhad asmad ces pa nyid du 117—192

par 'gyur te/ dper na/ yubyud rnam dbye drug pa'i gnyis tshig gis bsgrubs zin pa/ yu ba yoḥ/ zhes pa r+pā zhes par 'gyur/ asmad drug pa'i gnyis tshig gis bsgrubs zin pa/ a ba yo①ཿzhes pa kau zhes par 'gyur/ de bzhin du bzhi pa'i gnyis tshig gis bsgrubs zin pa/ yu bā rgyuni r+pā dang / ā bārgyu ni kau zhes par 'gyur/ de bzhin du/ gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig gis bsgrubs zin pa/ yu r+pā/ ni/ r+pā dang / ā r+pā ni kau zhes par 'gyur ro/ /ba hu ba tsa na su bsna sau/ mang tshig gi bas nas dag go/ /rnam dbye drug pa bzhi pa gnyis pa rnams kyi mang tshig gis bsgrubs zin pa/ yuṣ+ṭha shaṃ dang yuṣ+ṭha bye dang yuṣ+ṭhan rnams pas zhes par 'gyur/ asmra ka dang / asma bye dang /asmran rnams nas zhes par 'gyur ro/ /te ma yā be ka ba tsa na su/ gcig tshig gi te mi dag go/ /rnam dbye drug pa dang bzhi pa'i gcig tshig gis bsgrubs zin pa/ tu bh+yam dang ta ba dag te zhes par 'gyur/ ma oṃ dang / ma ma dag me zhes par 'gyur ro/ /tā mo dri tī yā yāḥ/ gnyis pa'i tā mā dag go/ /rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gcig tshig gis bsgrubs zin pa'i/ two zhes pa ni tā dang /rmā zhes pa ni mā zhes par 'gyur ro/ /༈ de dag tshigs bcad dang sbyar ba'i dper brjod ni/ shrī shasta wa tumā spru ha daṭ+wāste me pi sharma saḥ/ swā m+bi te me pi sa ha riḥpā tu bā ma pi no bi bhuḥ/de yang bod skad la/ dpal gyi dbang phyug khyod bsrung bdag la yang / /khyod la sbyin pa bdag la'ang bde ba stsol/ /khyod kyi rje de 'phrog byed bdag gi yang / /mnga' bdag khyod dag la bsrung bdag la yang / /zhes pa ste/ tshig rkang dang po'i yi ge gsum pa la tā dang drug pa la mā zhes pa ni khyod la dang ⑤bdag la zhes 117—194 //

gnyis pa'i gcig tshig dang / tshig rkang gnyis pa'i yi ge gnyis pa la te dang gsum pa la me ni khyod kyi ched don la bdag gi ched don la zhes pa'i don gyi khyod la dang bdag la ste bzhi ①pa'i gcig tshig /tshig rkang gsum pa'i yi ge gsum pa te dang bzhi pa me ni khyod kyi dang bdag gi zhes drug pa'i gcig tshig /tshig rkang bzhi pa'i yi ge gsum pa r+pā dang lnga pa kau ②ni khyod dag la dang nged dag la zhes gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig go/ /de bzhin du/ su khaṃ r+pā da dā tī shaḥ/dbang phyug khyod dag la bde ba sbyin/ su khaṃ no da dā tī shaḥ/ dbang phyug nged dag la bde ba sbyin/ zhes pa/ bām dang no ni khyod dag la dang nged dag la ⑦zhes bzhi pa'i gnyis tshig go/ /pa ti r+pā ha riḥ/ khyed dag ④gi bdag po 'phrog byed/ pa ti kau gu ruḥ/ nged dag gi bdag po bla ma/ zhes pa'i r+pā dang no no khyed dag gi dang nged dag gi zhes drug pa'i gnyis tshig go/ /ta snga byā 2h+pho—/ de'i spyod 0rnams la bsrung bar mdzod/ ta snga byāh+pho/ de'i nged rnams la yang bsrung bar mdzod/ ces pa'i bo dang no ni spyod rnams la nged rnams la zhes gnyis pa'i mang tshig go/ /su khaṃ bo da byār/ bde ba khyed ⑦rnams la sbyin/ su khaṃ no da byār/ bde ba nged ⑤rnams la sbyin/ zhes pa'i/bo dang no ni khyod rnams la nged rnams la zhes bzhi ⑨pa'i mang tshig go/ /pa ti baḥha riḥ/ khyod rnams kyi bdag po 'phrog byed/ ba ti naḥburnyaḥ/ nged rnams kyi bdag po sangs rgyas/ zhes pa'i/ baḥdang naḥni khyed rnams kyi dang nged rnams kyi zhes drug pa'i mang tshig go/ /slar yang kun nas bsgyur ba de rnams 'dod na yin gyi mi byed du mi rung ba ma yin pas 'dam ka can no/ /tshig gi thog ma ma yin pa la zhes pas/ tshig re re'i dang bo ste thog ma la/ hūṃ 117—195

rmā sogs rnam 'gyur thog ma kho na byed kyi/ tā mā la sogs pa rnams su mi 'gyur te/ dper na/ hūṃ pā tu/—khyed la bsrung / rmāpā tu/ —bdag la bsrung / zhes pa lta bu twa mā zhes par mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du/ gnyis pa'i mang tshig gi dper brjod/ yuṣ+ṭhan rak+ṣa tu go bin+daḥ/—a la bsrung bar mdzod khyab 'jug /asmran budhaḥsarba dā pā hūṃtu/ bdag la sangs rgyas kyis rtag tu skyong bar mdzod/ zhes pa bas nas su mi 'gyur ro / /de ltar drug pa'i gnyis tshig gi dper brjod/ yu wa yoḥpu tra/—a dag gi bu/ ā9wa yoḥpu tra/ —ngedadag gi bu/ zhes pa yu ba yoḥ/ r+pā dang / ā ba yoḥ/no zhes par mi 'gyur ro/ /gzhan rnams kyang de dag gis rigs 'gre'o/ /na tsa bā hā hai ba yuste/ tsa bā a ha ha e wa rnams sbyor (( ba la ma yin no/ /tsa la sogs pa lnga po rnams dang sbyor ba'i tshe yang te me ④sogs slar yang kun nas bsgyur ba de dag mi byed do/ /dper na/ ta wa tsa ma ma tsa me ṭī tsan+d+ra le khe ba bzlu te/ khyod dang nga yi byams 'dris ni/ /zla ba yar ngo bzhin du 'phel/ /zhes pa lta bu ste/ te tsa me tsa mi zer bar/ /ta wa tsa ma ma tsa zer ba lta bu'o/ /sdeb spyor bsgrig pa zhedang tshig rkang mi 'grig pa'i skyon yod na tsa sogs dang sbyor ba'i skabs yin kyang te me sogs su bsgyur ba mi 'gog go zhes pa 'grel par gsung ngo / /pa shādze+ertswa nā lo tsa pya ṣ+pe/ lta ba'i don rnams kyi yang mig gis mi mthong ba la'o/ /lta ba'i don dang sbyor ba'i cha ④yang mig gis mthong ba'i don yin na te me sogs su 'gyur la/ mig gis snyemathong ba'i don ma yin na te me sogs su mi 'gyur bar ta ba ma ma sogs kho nar gnas so/ /'grel par bod tshig bar ma chad pa gnyis sngon na yod na ⑨te me sogs su 'gyur la/ bod tshig byin pa'i tshig gcig sngon na yod na te me sogs su mi 'gyur zhes pa byung ste/ de 117—196

yang dper na/ de bā smrad+mā hi dṛ ha re/ bitsā ྅spru n+yak+ṣa sarba dā/ kye lha bdag rnams la skyong mi'i seng ge/ rtag par bdag rnams la srungs khyab 'jug kye| zhes pa lta bu ste/ de ba nas sogs mi 'byung bar/ de ba asmran/bitsā asmran zhes byung ba bzhin no/ /bod tshig byin pa gnyis sngon na yod na 'gyur te/ dper na/ ha re kṛ pā lo naḥpā nyi/ nged rnams la skyongs brtse ldan 'phrog byed kye/ zhes pa lta bu ste/ ha re kṛ pā lo zhes bod tshig byen pa gnyis kyi rjes su naḥ/ zhes byung ba lta bu'o/ /bod tshig byin pa gcig las med kyang de'i gong na tshig gzhan yod na naḥsogs su 'gyur te/ sarba dā rak+ṣa de ba naḥ/ kye lha bdag rnams la srungs rtag tu ni/ /zhes pa lta bu/ de ba zhes bod tshig byin pa gcig las med kyang de'i gong na sarba dā rak+ṣa zhes tshig gnyis yod pas naḥ/ zhes pa byung ba lta bu'o/ /de rnams kyis ①yuṣ+ṭhad asmad kyi cho ga rnams bshad zin to/ /yuṣ+ṭhad asmad gnyis ni yul pho mo ma ning gsum po gang la yang 'jug tu rung ba la/ dngos su pho mo ma ning gi rnam 'gyur logs ②na med do/ /༈ da yig mtha' can/ su pād la/—rkangamadzes/ su/ hal dripa āpa sogs kyis su phyis/ gnas med pa la yang na 'os/ su pāta/ su pād/ au dang dzas la/ su pā do/ su pā daḥ/ bod tshig kyang dang po dang 'dra/ am dang au la/ su pā rda/ su pā do/ shas la/ pā daḥ/ pata/ pād kyi pada'o / /pād ces pa'i rtags ni/ shas nas bzung rnam dbye atsa thog ma can rnams la pad ces u pa dh+wa thung ngur 'gyur ro/ /supa daḥ/ gsum pa rnams la/ su pa dā/ su pā:/ su pārnyiḥ/ bzhi pa rnams la/ su pa de/117—197

༈ sa yig mtha' can su pis la su/ su phyis/ sa sa dzuṣa dag gi ru 'os sa ru/ u brjod don/ dra bra dag gi u pa d+mā'i ring po ika gi 'os/i ring por bsgyur/ su r+pāḥ/ au ①dang dzas la/ su pi sau/ su pi saḥ/gnyis pa rnams la/ su pi saṃ/ su pi sau/ su pi saḥ/ ṭā la/ su pi sā②sgyum bhis ①la/ sa sa ④dzu ṣa'i ru/ dra bra sogs kyis ⑤mdos/ u pa d+mā ring po/ su r+pādz+nyā/ su r+pābhiḥ/ nge la/ su pi se/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ nga se la/ su pi saḥ/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ drug pa rnams la/ su pi saḥ/ su pi soḥ/ su pi tsā/ bdun pa rnams la/ su pi se/ su pi so duḥ/ su r+pā྾/ su pāḥ6④/ bod tshig rnam dbye dang po dang 'dra/ su rus zhes pa'ang cho ga rnams su pis dang 'dra'o/ /༈ sa yig mtha' can u rjes 'byel can/ bi dwa su la/snyemakhasapa/ su/ u num kyi don yin pas phyis/ uka 'gro ba atsa rnams kyi thams cad gnas pa'i ming can rnams la byings ma yin pa la 'os/ num/ saṃ budhi ma yin pa'i thams cad gnas pa'i ming can la yang ④ngos/ u pa dh+wa ring po/ hal dīpa sogs dang / yang dag par sbyor ba sogs kyis/ bi dān/ au dang dzas la/bi dād+mo/ bi dābe+eḥ/ am dang au la/ be+e dā:/ bi dād+mo/ shas la/ wa soḥsaṃ pra sā ra rte/ was kyi saṃ pra sā ra ṇa'o/ /rtags mtha' was zhes pa'i pha rol du shas la sogs pa'i rnam dbye atsa thog ma can gang byung yang be+er yang dag par bsgyur ba ste wa srog med ur 'gyur ro/ /bid/ u as/ shas/ saṃ pra sā ra ṇa las kyang ngos/ a snga ma'i gzugs su song / kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis/ sa ṣa/ bi du ṣaḥ/ ṭā la/ bi du ṣā/ sgyum bhis la/ ba 117—212

su sri su d+dhā su a na cheha rnams kyi da 'os sa da/ bi dwa:/ bi dwasgoḥ/ nge la/bi du ṣe/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ nga se la/ bi du ṣaḥ/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ drug pa rnams la/ bi du ṣaḥ/ bi du khoḥ/ bi du ྾/ bdun pa rnams la/bi du ṣi/ bi du ṣeḥ/ bi dwakhru/ bod tshig rnams la/ te bi dwan/ he bi dārlo / te bi dād+maḥ/༈ sa mtha' u rjes 'byel can/ pe tsi wa su la/ su/ uka 'gro ba sogs kyis num/ su phyis/ yang dag par spyor ba'i mtha' phyis/ saṃ budhi ma yin pa sogs kyis u pa dh+wa ring po/ pe tsi wān/ au dang dzas la/ pe tsi wārlo—/ pe tsi wābe+eḥ/ am dang au la/ pe tsi wād+me1/ pe tsi wād+mo/ shas la/was kyi saṃ pra sā ra ṇa 'os/ lnga u/ saṃ pra sā ra ṇa las kyang ngos/ a snga ma'i gzugs su song / was u ru 'gyur na iṭa 'jig go zhes pa 'grel par byung bas / tsa'i srog gi i phyis/ kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis/ sa ṣa/ pe tsu ṣa 3ཿ/ ṭā la/ pe tsu ṣā/ sgyum bhis la/ wa su sri su sogs kyis sa da/pe tsi wahūṃ/ pe tsi wad+dhiḥ/ nge la/ pe tsu ṣe/ bh+yam 1bh+yas 'dra/ nga se la/pe dātsu ṣaḥ/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ drug pa rnams la/ pe tsu ṣaḥ/ pe tsu sngoḥ/pe tsu ྾/ bdun pa rnams la/ pe tsu ṣi/ pe tsu khoḥ/ pe tsu wakhru/ bod tshig rnams la/ te pe tsi wan/ te pe tsi wārmyo/ te pe tsi wād+maḥ/myu/ sa mtha' ⑤can/ dza ga mu su/ la su/ sboḥtsa/ ma ba dag la 'ang ngo / /ma yig dang ba yig dag gi rkyen pha rol la byings kyi ma yig ni na ru 'gyur te/ ma na/ dza ga na su/ su/ uka 'u'agro ba sogs kyis num/u de'i don/ hal sogs kyis su phyis/ yang dag par sbyor ba'i mtha' phyis/117—213

bdun pa rnams la/ u sha na si/ u shan soḥ/ u sha nasru/ saṃ budhi la/gzugs gsum 'byung bas lugs gcig la/ hal sogs kyis su phyis/ sa sa dzuṣa sogs kyis/ he u sha naḥ/ yang na 'grel par/ saṃ budhi la rtags mtha' a nang du yang na 'gyur te/ na dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba 'dam ka can no zhes pa byung bas/ rtags mtha' a nang / na dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba yang na ba byas pas/ he u sha na/ te u sha nan/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig dang po dang 'dra'o/ /a no ①has/ pu ru rda blushas gnyis la'ang saṃ budhi la yang na ba mi byed gzhan cho ga thams cad u sha nas dang 'dra'o/ /༈ sa mtha' can/ be+e dha sa la su/ su phyis/ a tu as mtha'i 'ang byings ma yin pa'i ngos/ u pa dh+wa ring po/ be ṅgā①ཿ/ saṃ burnyi la/ te be dhaḥ/gzhan ma thams cad u sha nas dang 'dra/ su bas zhes pa'ang su la u pa dh+wa ring por mi 'gyur gzhan cho ga rnams bshad ma thag pa be dha sa dang 'dra'o/ /stsa/ sarba sogs kyi nang tshan sa yig mtha' can/ a das la/snye'adi/ su/a das au su lo pa:/ a das kyi au ste su dbyi ba'ang ngo du/ /a das zhes pa'i rtags mtha'i sa ni au ru 'gyur la/ su yang rjodabye ste/ sa au/ su phyis/ta da dag gi bye su la sa mtha' ma yin pa la 'os/ da sa/ etsa la 'phel ba 'os / a ⑦sau/ a das la/ a katha' rkyen byin pas/ a sa ka /zhes pa grub pa la/ sā du two tsa/ sa las u 'ang ngo / /a das la a katsa' rkyen byin pa'i skabs nga sa yig tu bsgyur zin pa'i srog a yig de ni u ru 'gyur te/a dāsu ka zhes pa grub/ de la rnam dbye'i cho ga thams cad spyir btang a thung mtha' can rā ma dang 'dra'o/ /au la/ t+yad sogs rnams kyi rnam dbye la a 117—216

'os—/ sa a/ ata kyi yon tan la 'os/ snga ma'i gzugs/ e tsa la 'phel ba 'os/ a do/ a da soṭ+wā du do maḥ/ a das kyi da la u ste da'i 'ang ma'o/ /a das zhes pa'i da ni rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig su ma gtogs rnam dbye gang mthong yang ma yig tu 'gyur zhing da'i srog atsa ring po gang yod kyang khru ring du 'gyur/ thung ngu gang yod kyang u thung ngu 'gyur te/ a spru/dzas la/ t+yad ①sogs kyis a da/ dzas/ a das kyis zhes pas/ da ma/dzas kyi shrī/ a las yon tan/ a me/ e ta ā+o dwa hu ba tsa ṣ+pe/ eta kyi yīta mang tshig la'o/ /a das ki da mar gyur pa'i rnam dbye mang tshig las byung ba'i e ni sī ru 'gyur te/ e ā+o/ a rmā/ am la/ a sum̐/ au la/a rū/ shas la/ a rūn/ ṭā la/ a mu nā/ sgyum la/ a mū rgyu/rnyis la/ ka ma yin pa dag gi i rda a das dag la ma yin nos/ nyis esar mi 'gyur/ mang tshig la dzhal la eta ④'os e/ eta kyi yīta mang tshig la 'os/a m+bi bhiḥ/ nge la a mu྾/ sgyum la/ a mū rgyu/ bh+yas ①la/ a m+bi bh+yaḥ/nga se la/ a mud+māta/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ ngas la/ a mu byu/ os la/ā mu yo④ཿ/ ām la/ a m+bi ྾/ ngi la/ a mu྾na/ os la/ a mu yoḥrka/ supa la/ a m+bi 6/ i ti pā ṇi ni byā khyaka ra ṇa su sru tā h+phurliṅga ha lar+sāḥs mābhāḥ/ zhes pa pā duṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i ⑦mdo las skyes pa'i rtags hal mtha' can rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las skyes pa'i rtags hal mtha' can 117—217

/de—bhis la/ ra ba sogs kyi mdos/ u pa dh+wa ring po/ gī:/ gīsgoḥ/ nge la/ gi re/sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ nga si la/ gi raḥ/ dz+nyā bh+yas 'dra/ drug pa rnams la/gi raḥ/ gi roḥ/ gi dzā/ bdun pa rnams la/ gi ri/ gī 7roḥ/ gīkhyo/bod tshig la/ te gī(naḥ/ te gi ro/ he gi raḥ/༈ ra yig mtha' can/ pur ①zhes pa dang / dur zhes pa'ang cho ga thams cad gir gyi skabs dang 'dra'o④/ /༈ ra yig mtha' can/ tsa tur la/ dzas/ tri tsa tur dag gi bud med la/ ti tha latsa ta thra dag gos/ tsa ta thrar 'gyur/ tsa ta sraḥ/shas la/ tsa ta sraḥ/ bhis la/ tsa ta thra gebheḥ/ bh+yas gnyis la/ tsa ta sre bh+yaḥ// ām la/ tsa ta sre popeshā/ supa la/ tsa ta thra 6/ bod tshig la—/ he tsa ta sraḥ/༈ ma yig mtha' can/ kim la/ kim gyi ka 'os/ kim ka /bud med du brjod pa'i rkyen ṭāpa/ kā la/ su/ ha la dīpa āpa ces pas su phyis/kā—/ lo la/ sna'i āpa las sos/ ke/ dzas la/ dang po dag la zhes pas / kāḥ/ sogs te cho ga thams cad mo rtags sarba'i skabs bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /ma yig mtha' can/ i rda la/ su/ i rda gyi ma 'os/ ṭi ar mi 'gyur/ yaḥsau/ su la ya'o/ /i dam zhes pa'i da ni bud med du brjod pa'i skabs su pha rol la ya ru 'gyur ro/ /da ya/ su phyis/ i yi/lo la/ t+yad sogs kyi a'os/ ma a/ ata kyi yon tan la 'os snga ma'i gzugs—/ da'i 'ang ngos da ma/ bud med du brjod pa'i rkyen ṭāpa/ i mā//17—220

ma'i āpa las so/ /lo shī/ i me/ dzas la/ i māḥ/ am la/ i rmā/au la i me/ shas la/ i māḥ/ ṭā la/ āpa la an sogs kyis/ i da/a na/ bud med du brjod pa'i rkyen/ ṭāpa/ a nā/ āpa kyi āng la'ang ngos—/ a na yā/ sgyum la/ hal la dbye 'os/ i dang da phyis/ a/ṭāpa—/ ā hūṃ/ bhis la/ ā bhiḥ/ nge la/ i rda/ a/ ṭāpa/ sarba tsa nā ma las sngaṭa ste thung ngu 'ang ngos/ sngaṭa/ a sri/ sgyum khyus la/ ā sgyum/ā bh+yaḥ/ nga si la/ a sngaḥ/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ ngas la/ a snga/ os la/a na yoḥ/ ām la/ ā tsā/ ji la/ a sde/ os la/ a na yoḥ/supa la/ ā su/ rnam dbye gnyis pa rnams dang ṭā dang os gnyis la yang na bar bshad pa ltar/ lugs gcig la/ gnyis pa rnams la/ e dzā/ e ṣ+pe/e nāḥ/ ṭā la/ e na yā/ os gnyis la/ e na yoḥ/༈ dza yig mtha' can/ sradza la/ su/ tsu'i ku 'os/ dza ga /su phyis—/ gnas med pa la yang na 'os/ sraka /sag ③/ au dang dzas la/sra rdo/ sra dzaḥ/ gnyis pa rnams la/ sra rdza/ sra rdo/ sra dzaḥ/ ṭā la/sra dzā/ rgyu bhis la tsu'i ku 'os/ srahūṃ/ srasgoḥ/ nge la/ sra dze/ r+ghaṃ bh+yas 'dra—/ nga se la/ sra dzaḥ/ rgyu ①bh+yas 'dra/ drug pa rnams la/ sra dzaḥ/sra dzoḥ/ sra rdzu/ ji la/ sra dzi/ os la/ sra dzoḥ/ supa la/ tsu'i ku 'os—/ dza ga /khar la tsar/ sra k+ṣu/ bod tshig rnams dang po dang 'dra/༈ da yig mtha' can/ t+yad la/ su/ t+yad sogs kyis a/ ata kyi yon tan la 'os snga ma'i gzugs/ mo rkyen ṭāpa/ ta da dag gi su la sa mtha' ma yin pa la 'os/ ta sa/ su phyis/ snga/ lo la/ bye/ dzas/117—221

thag pa dang 'dra'o/ /༈ sa yig mtha' can/ a das la/ su/ a das kyi lo ste su dbyi ba'ang ngos—/ sa au/ su phyis/ ta da dag gi ①zhes pas/ da sa/ a sau/ lo la/t+yad sogs kyis a/ ata (gekyi yon tan la 'os snga ma'i gzugs/ bud med du brjod pa'i rkyen/ ṭā pa/ a dā/ au/ au'i āpa las sos au yī/a la yon tan nos/ a e/ a das kyi da la u ste da'i 'ang ma ①'os a rū—/ dzas/ a rūḥ/ a ma la/ a k+shi/ au la/ a spru/ shas la/ a rūḥ—/ ṭā la/ a mu yā/ sgyum la/ a sprurgyu/ rnyis la/ a rū bhiḥ/nge la/ a mu bye/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ nga si la/ a mu byāḥ/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ngas la/ a mu byāḥ/ os ④la/ a mu yoḥ/ ā ma la/ a rū ྾/ ji la—/ a mu dh+yā/ os la/ a mu yoḥ⑤/ supa la/ a rū 6/ i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gya sru tāta sdi liṅga ha lahāḥs mābhāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las bud med kyi rtags hal mtha' can rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las bud med kyi rtags hal mtha' can rnams rnam dbye dang phrad pa'i cho ga spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //da ni hal gyi mtha' can ma ning gi rtags rnams brjod par bya ste/ ha yig mtha' can/ swa na che ha la/snyeglangakhyub bzang po/ su/ tsa tur a na che ha 117 224

/de—dag gi ām u dāt+ta /pe'os/ ām ā ga ma/ ma ning la su am 'jig /ba su sre su dhī su a na che ha rnams kyi da 'os/ ha da/ gnas med pa la yang na 'os/swa na ḍāta/ swa na ḍād/ au la/ ma ning la'ang ngos/ au (0shī/ swa na ḍā tī—/ dzas la/ dzas shas dag gi shi 'os/ dzas shi/ ma ning gi dzhal atsa'i 'os/ num saṃ budhi ma yin pa'i zhes pas u pa dh+wa ring pog/ swa na ṭī hi/gnyis pa rnams la/ swa na ḍāta/ swa na ṭād/ swan ṭā nyige/ swa naṭī nyi/bod tshig dang po dang 'dra/ ṭā nas bzung rnam dbye lhag ma thams cad skyes pa'i rtags a na che ha'i skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /༈ ra yig mtha' can/ bār la/ su/ ma ning la su am dag 'jig/bāḥ—/ au la/ bā rī/ dzas la/ bā ri/ gnyis pa rnams la'ang / bāḥ/bā rī/ bā ri⑤/ bod tshig rnams la/ te bāḥ/ he bā rīkhyeke/ he bā ri/ṭā la/ bā rā/ dz+nyā rnyis la/ bādz+nyā/ bābhiḥ/ bzhi pa rnams la/ bā re/bādz+nyā—/ bārgyaḥ/ lnga pa rnams la/ bā raḥ/ bā:/ bārgyaḥ/ drug pa rnams la/ bā raḥ/ bā roḥ/ bā dzā/ bdun pa rnams la/ bā ri/ bā roḥ—/ bā྾/༈ ra yig mtha' can/ tsa tur la/ dzas/ tsa tur a na cheha dag gi slo u dāt+ta 'os/ ām/ dzas shas dag gi shi/ tsa ṭ+wā ri/ shas la/ tsa tā ri/ bhis la/ tsa tubhiḥ/ bh+yas gnyis la/ tsa turgyaḥ/ ām la/ tsa tuhūṃ—/ supa la/ tsa tu྾/ bod tshig la/ he tsa twa ri/ thra ya tsa tur zhes pa lta bu grangs kyi don ma yin na rnam dbye thams cad 'jug ste/ dang po rnams la/ pri ya tsa tuḥ/ pri ya tsa tu rī/ pri ya tsa tu ri/ gnyis pa 1 17 225

rnams la'ang / pri ya tsa tuḥ/ thra ya tsa tu rī/ pri ya tsa tu ri/ gsum pa rnams la/ pri ya tsa tu rā/ thra ya tsa tudz+nyā/ pri ya tsa tubhiḥ/ bzhi pa rnams la / pri ya tsa tu re/ pri ya tsa tu:/ pri ya tsa tubh+yaḥ/ nga se la/ pri ya tsa tu raḥ/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ drug pa rnams la/ pri 2ya tsa tu raḥ/ pri ya tsa tu roḥ/ pri ya tsa tu dzā/ bdun pa rnams la/ thra ya tsa tu ri/ pri ya tsa tu roḥ/ thra ya tsa tu khye/ bod tshig rnams dang po dang 'dra/lnga/ ma yig mtha' can/ kim la/ su/ ma ning la su am dag 'jig pas / su phyis/ kim/ skyod la/ ki ka /skyod/ yid/ ke/ dzas la/kā ni/ gnyis pa rnams la'ang / kim/ ke/ kā ni/ ṭā sogs lhag ma rnams la/ kim kar 'gyur cho ga thams cad sarba dang 'dra'o/ /myu/ ma yig mtha' can/ i dam la su/ ma ning la su am 'jig /i rda/au la/ i me/ dzas la/ i mā ni/ gnyis pa rnams la/ i rda/ i me/i mā ni/ ṭā la sogs pa rnam dbye lhag ma rnams skyes pa'i skabs dang 'dra/lnga/ na yig mtha' can/ brah+ma na la/ tshangs pa/ su/ ming mtha'i na dbyi 'os / na phyis/ ma ning la/ su am 'jig /brah+ma/ au la/ brah+ma ṭ+wā/dzas la/ brah+ma ṇi3/ gnyis pa rnams la'ang / brah+ma/ brah+ma d+dhā/ brah+ma ṇi/ṭā la/ brah+ma shā/ rgyu bhis la/ ming mtha'i na phyis/ brah+ma dz+nyā/ brah+ma bhiḥ/nge la/ brah+ma ṇi/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ nga se la/ brah+ma ṇaḥ/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/drug pa rnams la/ brah+ma ṇaḥ/ drah+ma ṇiḥ/ brah+ma rde/ bdun pa rnams la/ brah+ma ṇi/brah+ma khoḥ/ brah+ma su4/ bod tshig la 'grel par na dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba 'dam ka can no zhes pa byung bas/ te brah+ma/ he brah+man/ te brah+ma be+e/ he brah+ma ṇi/117—226 /

༈ tsa yig mtha' can/ go atsa la su/ su phyis/ tsu'i ku/ gnas med pa la yang na 'os6/ go aka /go ag /au la/ atsa'i 'os a phyis—/ go ṭī/ dzas la/ go ā—/ gnyis pa rnams kyang 'dra/ ṭā sogs rnam dbye lhag ma rnams skyes pa'i rtags phratsa'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /༈ ta yig mtha' can/ ya kṛta la/ su/ su am 'jig /gnas med pa la yang na 'os/ ya kṛta/ ya kṛd/ au la/ ya kṛ tī/ dzas la/ya kṛrnyi/ gnyis pa rnams kyang 'dra/ ṭā la/ ya kṛ tā/ sgyum rnyis la/ ya kṛ:—/ ya kṛd+dhiḥ/ de la/ ya kṛ te/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ nga se la/ ya kṛ taḥ/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ drug pa rnams la/ ya kṛ taḥ/ ya kṛ toḥ/ ya kṛ tī/ bdun pa rnams la/ ya kṛ ti/ ya kṛ toḥ/ ya kṛkhru/ bod tshig rnams dang po dang 'dra'o/ /sha kṛta nges ②pa'ang cho ga thams cad ya kṛta ①dang 'dra'o/ /༈ ta yig mtha' can/ dad ta la/ su/ su am 'jig /gnas med pa la yang na 'os/ da dad/ da data④/ au la/ da da tī/ dzas la/dzas shas dushi/ bā na sum̐ sa ka su/ ma ning gi yang na'o/ /a bh+yasta'i ming sha tu'i rkyen mtha' can ma ning gi rtags kyi skabs dzas shas shir 'gyur ba thams cad gnas pa'i ming can la num ā ga ma yang na 'jug go/ /༷da dārnyi/ da da ti/ gnyis pa rnams kyang 'dra/ ṭā la/ da da tā/ sgyum bhis la/dzhasha la dzhal rnams kyi dzasha rnams sos/ da da:/ da dad+dhiḥ/ nge la/ da da te/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ nga si la/ da da taḥ/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ drug pa rnams la/ da da taḥ/ da da toḥ/ da da hūṃ/ bdun pa rnams la/ da 117—230

rnams la/ swa pi 2/ swa poḥ/ swap+lu/ bod tshig rnams dang po dang 'dra/lnga/ sa yig mtha' can/ dha nus la/ gzhu/ su/ su am phyis/ sa sa dzuṣa sogs kyis dha nuḥ/ au la/ kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis/ sa ṣa/dha nu ྾/ dzas la/ dha zu ṣithu/ gnyis pa rnams kyang 'dra/ ṭā la/ dha nu ṣā/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ sa sa dzuṣa 1sogs kyis sa ra/ dha nu:/ dha nusniḥ/nge la/ dha nu ṣe/ sgyum bh+yas 'dra/ nga se la/ dha nu ṣaḥ/ sgyum 4bh+yas 'dra/drug pa rnams la/ dha nu ṣaḥ/ dha nu khoḥ/ dha nu hūṃ/ bdun pa rnams la/dha nu ṣi/ dha nu sngoḥ/ dha nukhyo/ bod tshig rnams rnam dbye dang po dang 'dra/ha bis dang po 5yas sogs kyang dha nus dang 'dra'o/ /myu/ sa yig mtha' can/ a das la/ su/ ma ning la su am phyis/sa sa dzuṣa dag gis ru6/ a daḥ/ au la/ t+yad sogs kyis a3/ a la yon tan/ a de/ a ngas kyi nga la u ste da'i 'ang ma 'os/ a rū/ dzas la / a rū ni/ gnyis pa rnams kyang dang po dang 'dra/ ṭā nas bzung rnam dbye lhag ma rnams kyi cho ga thams cad a ngas skyes pa'i rtags kyi ༷ skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa su sru tāsgo sum̐ sa ka liṅga ha lan+d+raḥs mā 9dz+nyāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las ma ning gi rtags hal mtha' can rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis nyu brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen bo pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel kyi go don dper brjod cho ga sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las ma ning gi rtags hal mtha' can rnams rnam dbye dang phrad pa'i cho ga spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa 117—232

de phan gyi rkyen rnam dbye rnams mi 'jug pa rang bzhin du gnas pa rnams kyang mi zad pa'o/ /de yang dper na de phan gyi rkyen rnam dbye lnga pa'i don dang / bdun pa'i don la tas tra sbyar ba'i/ ta taḥ/—delas/ ya taḥ / gangalas/ tatra/——del/ ya tra gang la lta bu'o/ /kṛd+me rdza taḥ/ kṛta kyimra etsa mtha' 'ang ngo / /kṛta sogs kyi rkyen ma yig mtha' can rnams dang etsa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge'i mtha' can rnams kyang mi zad pa'o/ /dper na/ smra ram̐ / dran par byis/ zhes ma mtha' can dang / dz+re ba se/snyetshorab/ pibabye/snye'athung ba/zhes pa etsa'i mtha' can lta bu rnams kyang mi zad pa'o/ /ghā to suṅka su naḥ/ ghā to sun ka sun rnams kyang ngo / /ghā dang to sun dang ka sun zhes pa'i rkyen byin pa'i mtha' rnams kyang mi zad pa'o/ /de yang dper na ghā rkyen mtha' can/ kṛ tā / —byas nas/ to sun gyi mtha'/ u de toḥ/— steng/ ka sun gyi rkyen mtha' can/bi mṛ paḥ/——rnam par mgyogs pa/ lta bu'o/ /a bya yārlu paḥ/ mi zad pa las supa kyi'o / /mi zad pa'i sde rnams las sub ste su sogs rnam dbye thams cad 'jig go/ /'grel par ji skad du/ sa dṛ shaṃ tro 6 liṅge 6 sar+pā su tsa bi bhasti 6/ba tsa ṣ+pe 6 tsa sarbe 6 yan+da bye ti ta da bya yo/ zhes pa byung ste/ bod skad du/rtags gsum la ni mnyam par mtshungs/ /rnam dbye thams cad la yang ngo / /tshig rnams thams cad la yang ste/ /dbyer med gang de mi zad pa'o/ /zhes mi zad pa'i sde 'di rnams la pho mo ma ning gi dbye ba'i rtags kyi mtha' dang mi 'dra ba cung zad tsam yang med de/ kun la sbyor ba kho na yin pas/ gang las kyang mi 'gyur bas na mi zad pa'am/ yang tshig gcig gis don sna tshogs ston pas na don zad pa med pa'i phyir mi zad pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /nyer bsgyur 117—236

a ba dang a pi gnyis kyi a dbyi ba dang / ni sha dang btsa/ disha gsum la ṭāpa ster ba sngon gyi drang srong bha gu ri 'dod do zhes pa'ang 'grel par byung ngo / /i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa su sru tā da bya yāzheḥs mābhāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las mi zad pa rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod blupa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don dper brjod cho ga sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las mi zad pa'i sde rags rim du bstan pa'i sde tshan rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //da ni rtags gsum ngos bzung ba'i don du rtags so so'i dbye ba shes par 'dod pas/ mo rtags kyi rkyen nam bud med du bsgrub pa'i rkyen rnams kyi 'jug tshul bshad par bya ste/ a dzā r+ya taṣ+ṭhapa/ a dza sogs ata las ṭāpa'o//a dza sogs ata mtha' rnams las bud med du bsgrub pa'i rkyen ṭāpa ster ro/ /a dza la/ ṭāpa/ mtha'i hal 'os pa phyis/ tsu ṭu dag gos ṭa phyis/ aka gi 'dra ba la ring bo 'os/ a 1dzā/ ram/ de bzhin du bsgrubs 4pas/ e ḍa shad—/ — lug mo'am ma mo/ phyag /spyo/ rgodam/ 'do ṭa ma// bye'umo/ cad 5ste/ ma// byi ba mo/ nga ba'i/ bu mo lo bcu drug ma/ chedaṭā/ dbang can/ nga ma// —tshod ma/ nga ཿ// bi'umo/ cad/de/ dal bus 'gro ma/ lnga/'do tā/—khrel med ma/ chadajo/ blo ldan ma/ skadam/ 'do/—khu byug mo/ sa/nged thams cad sogs dang ata mtha' can ma yin kyang / bātsa/ ni sha /disha6/ gsum la ṭāpa 'jug pa bha gu ri 'dod do zhes pa ltar/ ṭāpa sbyar bas/ bā tsā/ ngag ma—/ ni shā/ — mtshanamo/ di shā/— phyogasam/ sogs dang / yang 'grel par gzhan 117—237

las kyang bud med du bsgrub pa'i rkyen dīpa 'jug ste/ bi du ྾/— mkhasam/ shrīm :de / dpal ldan ma/ bab nga :de/— skal can ma/ nga 75rjes/ g.yos ma/ :de byu1byed/ rtsed mo mkhan ma//de pa/:de/ nad can ma/ bya/:de/ mdzes ma/ ngas(ga lnga// nub phyogs kyi bud med/ pa/ bye ste// ti rasbyi/ — dud 'gro mo/ u dī ṭī/ byang phyogs kyi bud med/ ba no ra tsa/ wan las ra'i'ang ngo / /wa yig u pa dh+wa na yod pa'i na mtha' la dīpa 'jug par ma zad na yig kyang ra yig tu 'gyur te/ dhi banu la dīpa/ bye ba rī/—bloldanam/ de bzhin du/ha ri dṛ shwa rī/ yang 'grel par lung drangs pa/ ba no na ha sha ban gyi hasha las ma yin no/ /gong du ban mtha' can la dīpa 'gyur zhing na rar 'gyur ba bshad kyang de'i dmigs bsal wa de dang hasha so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge gang rung nyis brtsegs su yod na dīpa kyang mi 'jug cing na rar mi 'gyur te/ dper na/rā dza yu dh+wan/ sa ha yu dh+wan/ zhes pa lta bu la dīpa mi 'jug go/ /'grel par gzhan nas lung drangs pa/ ba hu bye ho bā/ 'bru mang po la yang na'o/ /tshig sdud kyi nang tshan 'bru mang po'i tshig sdud kyi mtha' la 1dīpa ster ba dang na rar 'gyur ba yang na ba ste 'dam ka can no/ /bloldanam mang po/— ba hu bye ba rī'am yang na dīpa ma byin par gong hal mtha'i skabs su bshad pa ltar bsgrubs pas/ba hu bye bā lta bu'o/ /pā do n+ya ta ra sde / pād las yang na'o/ /pād las dīpa yang na ba ste ster mi ster 'dam ka can no/ /dī pa dī/ rkangaganyis ma/ yang na/pād pata sogs so/ /ṭā bṛ tsi/ rig byed la ṭāpa'o/ /pad ces pa rig byed kyi don can yin na mo rkyen ṭāpa 'jug ste/ dī pa dā/ zang gnyis ma/ mnaḥman las so/ /ma u pa dh+wa na yod pa'i na yig mtha' can la mo rkyen dīpa 'jug pa ma yin te/ dper na/ si man zhes pa lta bu la dīpa mi 'jug /su/117—239

na yā ①sa yoḥ/ yas dag gi ma yin no/ /ka'i snga ma yin kyang ya ste yang dang sa ste tad gnyis kyi a ni i ru 'gyur ba ma yin te/ dper na/ ya kā/ sa kā zhes par gnas la/ yi kā/ se kā/ zhes par mi 'gyur ro/ /'grel par/t+ya kan ma yin no zhes pas de phan gyi rkyen t+ya kan gyi mtha' ni ir mi 'gyur bas/dper na/ a dhi t+ya kā/ u pa t+yakā/ zhes pa nyid du gnas so/ /yang 'grel par lung drangs pa/ shis brjod la bun gyi ma yin no/ /bun gyi rkyen shis brjod kyi don can yin na a ir mi 'gyur te/ jo ba kā/snye'atshobam/ bhab kā yod pa ma yin lta bu ste/ bun a kar 'gyur ba'i rjes so/ /tshig rjes ma la mi 'gyur te/ de ba dasti kā/—lhas sbyin ma/ ya rnyikā/snyemachod sbyin ma/ yang 'grel par/k+ṣi pa kā sogs las ma yin no zhes pa byung bas/ k+ṣ-i pa kā/snyezad ma/ tsaṭa kā| —byi'um/ sgru ba kā/—brtanapa ma/ tā ra kā sgrolabam rnams kyang a ir mi 'gyur ro/ /bar+ṇa kā mdog ma zhes skud pa'i mdog lta bu skud pa'i don yin na a ir 'gyur la/don gzhan yin na mi 'gyur ro/ /brta kā zhes pa'ang shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta rnams de kar gnas par 'dod la/ byang phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta rnams brti kā zhes a ir 'gyur ba 'dod ces 'grel par byung ngo / /aṣ+ṭa kā gtor ma zhes pa'ang lha dang pha'i don yin na a ir mi 'gyur la/ don gzhan la a ir 'gyur bas/aṣ+ṭi kā lobargyad ma zhes pa 'byung ngo / /yang 'grel par gzhan nas lung drangs te/sru sdeta kā sogs la 'dam ka'o zhes pa byung bas sru ta kā/snyebud med sbrum ma btsas nas zhag bcu las mang ba ma song ba'i ming/snyesru ①ti kā/ pu tra kā/snyebumo/—pu ti kā/ thran+d+ra ra kā/—bud med mang po tshogs pa'am/—thran+d+ra ri kā/—yul bcom brlag gi bud med la yang zer/ u dī tsā mā tasgyuṣ+pe ya ka pūr+pā yāḥ/ byang pa rnams āta kyi shul yaka snga ma'i'o/ /byang 117—241

kyi ya'ang dbye'o zhes pa byung bas/ pu ྾/—rgyal/ dzā na pa da kuṇ+ḍa go ṇa s+thā ba bhā dza nā ga kā la nī la ku sha kā muka ka ba rā bye bye ma tā ba pa nā kṛsbyi mā shā ṇa spo be+e bar+ṇa nā tsā da nā yo be+e kā ra mi thu ṣ+pe tsā ke sha be she 6/ dzā na pa da kuṇ+ḍa go ṇa s+thā la bhā dza nā ga kā la nī la ku sha kā mu ka ka ba ra rnams las rgyu snod glang khal/ ma bcos pa lo ma sbom pa mdog khebs min pa khyen/ ①'khrig 'dod/ skra chas rnams la'o/ /dzā na pa da la sogs pa bcu gcig po de rnams la go rims ②bzhin rgyu la sogs pa bcu gcig rnams kyi don brjod pa'i tshe dīṣa 'jug ste/dzā na pa dī/—skyes yul gyi rgyu ma/ kuṇ+ḍi/—sgod ma/ go bhā/—glang khal ma/ s+thā rta//—ma bcos ma/bhā jordo/snyelo ma'am 'dab ma/ rta/ ste//—sbom pa'am phyug mo/ na/rtag/—nag mo/ nī rtag/snyeram mam rdzon mo/ku shī/—lcags khyem/ kā mu tī/snye'akhrig 'dod ma/ ka ba rī/snyethoracog ma/ lta bu yin la/de dag las ①gzhan la ṭāpa 'jug pas/ dzā na pa dānas/ ka ba rā'i bar ro//'grel par gzhan nas lung drangs te/ smi la las srog chags dang sman dag la'ang ngo / /zhes pa 'byung bas/ nī lī ba ḍa bā/rkorgodamasngon mo/ bhā lī o ṣa be+eḥ—/ snyesmanasngonamo/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /yang 'grel par sho ṇa las shar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta rnams dīṣa 'jug par yang na 'dod do zhes 'byung bas/ sho tī/snyedamaramo/—sho ṇa—/ u rnga tāṅga ṇa ba tsa nāta/ uta mtha' las yon tan brjod pa las so/ /uta mtha' las yon tan brjod pa la dīṣa yang na 'gyur te/ mṛ dī④/—'jam mnyen ma/—mṛ duḥ/ pa ṭī/—mkhasam/—pa ṭuḥ/ uta mtha' ma yin na yon tan brjod pa yin kyang dīṣa mi 'gyur te/ shu 6sdi/snyebudamed gtsang ma/ uta mtha' yin kyang yon tan brjod pa ma yin na dīṣa mi 'jug ste/ ā khuḥ/snyephyim/ 'grel par lung drangs pa/ kha ru dang u pa jo na brtsegs pa yod na dīṣa 'gyur ba ma yin 117—248

las ti'o/ /yu ban gye sgra las bud med du brjod pa'i rkyen nyi 'gyur te ming mtha'i na dbyi 'os/ na phyis/ yu ba tiḥ/ langatshom/ i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa su sru tāta ste yo ba tsa na pra t+ya yām mābhāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las bud med du brjod pa'i rkyen rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan snabacos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin zis su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las/ bud med du brjod pa'i rkyen ngos bzung 'jug yul cho ga spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa rags pa rnams re zhig sdogs so// // da ni byed pa can gyi le'u bshad par bya ste/ le'u 'dis gong du bshad pa'i rnam dbye rnams kyi 'jug yul rgyas par ston par byed de/ s+thā ti 2pa di kārba liṅga snyepa ri mā ṇa ba tsa nā ma tre 4pra tha mā/ rtags kyi mtshan nyid ming gi don tsam brjod pa la dang po'o/ /rtags gsum po gang yang 'jug tu rung ba'i mtshan nyid can de la ming gi don tsam brjod pa la rnam dbye dang po rnams 'gyur te—/ yidakhyedaḥ/——mtho ba/ niste/ཿ/— dma'ab/ kṛṣ+ṭaḥ/ — nagapo/ shrīḥ/— dpal/ dz+nyārde/ ye shes—/ tad /de/snyekhal/ /de ṇa/ཿ/——byemoche/ phyag bhā ma//—bye bo che/ /de ma/ཿ/ gcig //de/ gnyis dag / baha snyewaḥ/——mngapornams/ yung /— sbyorab/ aupa ga waḥ/——nye ba'i ba lang / tsi tra guḥ / snyebalangakhra'o/ /zhes pa lta bu ste ming gi don tsam brjod pa kho na'o/ /saṃ bo dha ṣ+pe khutsa / kun du bod pa la'ang ngo / /kun du bod pa'i don la'ang rnam dbye dang po rnams 'gyur te/ te rā ma/—kye dga' byed/ terā mo/ kye dga' byed dag /he rā 117—255

māḥ / —kye dga' byed rnams/ de ltar rnam dbye sde tshan bdun las dang po rnams kyi 'jug tshul spyir btang bshad nas/myu/ gnyis pa'i 'jug tshul ni/ karturīdz+re ta ta oṃ karma/ byed po'i 'dod pa las so/ /gang byed pa po'i 'dod pa'i bya ba'i las ka de la ① las zhes brda chad byed do/ /karma ṇi dwo tī yā/ las la gnyis pa'o/ /las te gang bya ba'i las ka ston pa'i don la rnam dbye gnyis pa rnams 'jug ste/ ka ṭi ka ro ti/ rtswalhasabyed/ o da na ma pa tsa ti/—zas 'tshed/ grwa.oṃ gats+tsha na/ grong la 'grosne /yang 'grel par bha ba karma te/ dngos po dang las la rnam dbye dang po 'jug go zhes byung ste/ se bya te se bi taḥ/snyemachodapas mchod/ lasgyus dā ha riḥ/ dpal rtag tu 'phrog byed/ sha ten k+shi taḥsha t+yaḥ/ brgya'i rdzas brgya/ ta thā yuste tsā m+bidz+re tai/ de'i sbyor ba mi 'dod pa la'ang ngo / /byed pa po 'dod pa'i bya ba'i las ka de la las zer bar ma zad byed pa po'i 'dod pa ma yin zhing las mtshan nyid pa ma yin kyang gang bya ba'i las ka de la'ang gnyis pa 'gyur te/ dper na/ bi ṣe hūṃste /—dug bza'/dug bza' zhes pa byed pa po'i 'dod pa dang las mtshan nyid pa ma yin kyang /pi ṣe zhes rnam dbye gnyis pa byung ba lta bu'o/ /a ka zi tai tsa/ ma bshad pa'ang ngo / /nges par kun sbyin pa sogs dang yang na bar ma bshad pa rnams la'ang las zhes ming 'dogs byed do/ /byings duha 'jo ba/ yā tsi slong ba/ru bye sgrib pa/ pra tshi zi'agrib/ tsi gsog pa/ byu shegasal por brjod pa/shā su rjes su bstod pa/ dzi rgyal ba rnams dang / bhā thob pa/ dṛ 'phrog pa/kṛṣa rko kye ba/ man+d+ra srub pa/ baha thob pa/ daṇ+ḍa ⑦chad pa/ gra lduha nye bar len pa/ muṣa rku ba/ patsa 'tshod pa rnams dang spyor ba la du/ las kyi tshig 117—256

gnyis gnyis spyor dgos la de yang rnam dbye gnyis pa kho na 'jug ste/ dper brjod 'grel par tshigs bcad du byung ba ni/ /yo du do ha dha ra ma.oṃ ya yā tsa dzo ba su dz+nyā pa be+e / —gang dag sa la zas 'jo ma/ /stobs ldan la slong nor 'dzin sa/ /du ngo dha de t+yān pā tā tsho'i pa pra 'a ji 'a r+pā zico tai/ 1 / lha min rnams la sa 'og sgrib/ /dbang po la yang 'grib par 'dod/ /dharmān bā tsi no dī da ma bra rngubīṭ+wān swa se bi — naḥ/ chos rnams kun gsog rig byed la/ /de rnams rang g.yog rnams la smras/ /pābe+e bān nā shādzha kre tri lo tī ma dza ya dri pūn/ —sa bdag rnams la bstod nas mchod/ /'jig rten gsum las dgra rnam brgyal/ /rwa rab ma/ che/ na kyang dwaspyon ngesabye/ bhā ma/ ha rah+phu lnga// sgo ldan gnas la gnyen rnams thog /grong la gzhon nu ma phrogs te/ /'a kar+ṣa kai saṃ bi pi rna ma man+d+ra spyi ra dhi su sgo/——nags la lha min rko bar byed/ rgya mtsho sa srubs bdud rtsi la/ /wa ba ha d+man+da ram̐ sau dhu ma daṇ+ḍa ya da rī na srun/ rgya mtsho la thob man+da ra/ /dgra bo rnams la nor chad byung / /dza grwa ha byu ta dṛ sha kra ma mu: ji nyi dzān su bye/— dpag bsam shing la dbang pos bzung / /lha min rnams la bdud rtsi brkus/ /pa tsa ti pā ṇi ghā karma yaḥpha lo tai hi rda bha je / srog chags rnams kyi las tshod pa/ /gang 'bru de la 'phrog byed mchodasnye/ /zhes pa zirdog rkang re re la gong du smos pa'i byings ting mtha' can re dang / tshig grogs rnam dbye gnyis pa'i mtha' can gnyis gnyis byung ba lta bu'o/ /ga ti budhi pra t+ya pa sā nārja shasda karmā karmā shā ma ṇi kartas ṇi/ 'gro ba dang rtogs pa dang zas dang dzisgra'i don gyi las dang las med pa rnams kyi ṇi kyedang lhan cig pa ma yin pa'i ṇi med pa la byed pa po byesnala'o—/ /'gro ba la sogs pa de rnams kyi sgra sbyar bar bya ba'i rtags tshig grogs ṇitsa dang lhan cig pa ma yin pa ṇitsa med pa dang sbyor ba'i byed pa po la rnam dbye gnyis pa khye'agyur la/ ṇi tsa dang lhan cig pa yin na las kyi don la gnyis pa 'gyur te/ dper brjod 'grel par khutshigs bcad stsobyung ba ni/ sha tū na ga 117—257

ma yat+pargasbe dādze+e swā na be+e da yata/— mtho ris la song dgra bo rnams/ /rig byed don la nged rnams rig /ā sha yadz+nyā mṛ 3snatai de pān be da ma dh+yā 2pa ya dī dhi/bdud rtsi bzas snyenas lha rnams kyang / /tshangs pas sngon dus rig byed bklags/ /lnga sa yat+pa li le thrasgyi yo so me —— ha rirga tiḥ/ —sa gzhi la sdad chu bo rnams/ /'phrog byed gang de bdag gi dpal/ /zhes ④gong du smos pa'i don rnams dang sbyor ba'i tshig rkang re thurer rnam dbye gnyis pa'i rjes byung ba lta bu'o/ /'grel par bhā ba ha dag dang sbyor ba las byed pa po la gnyis pa 'gyur ba ma yin te gsum pa nyid do zhes pa byung bas/ nā ya ti bhā re j-i bye na/— bran gyis khur 'dren/ bā haya ti bhā re bye h+ye na/ bran gyis khur 'khur ba thob/ yang 'grel par ā di dang khā di dag sbyor ba'i rtags de la'ang / gnyis pa rnams 'gyur ba ma yin gyi gsum pa kho na 'gyur bar bshad pas/ de gnyis dang spyor ba'i rtags de ba dat+ta la ṭā sbyar bas / ā da ya ti de ba daste nā.oṃ/— lhas sbyin gyi bza' ru 'jug zan/— khā da ya ti de ba daste nā.oṃ/ yang 'grel par lung drangs pa/ bhak+ṣa'i 'tshe ba ma yin pa la ma yin no/ /bhak+ṣa'i sgra 'tshe ba'i don ma yin pa'i sbyor ba la byed pa po la gnyis pa 'gyur ba ma yin te/ bhak+ṣa ya t+ya.oṃ ba ṭu nā/— slob ma zan bza' ru 'jug /'tshe ba yin na gnyis pa 'gyur te/ bhak+ṣa ya nyi thupa lī warda ta sa sri/ bza' ru 'jug glang rnams lo tog la / yang 'grel par khru 3graha dṛsha rnams don spyor ba la byed pa po la 3snaganyis pa 'gyur ba sngon gye slob dpon kha cig 'dod do zhes pa byung bas/ shā ba ya ti gī tai de ba dar+ghaṃ/ lhas byin glu nyan du 'jug /gā ha ya ti pa sum̐ de rda/ —slob ma rig byed len du 'jug /dar+sha pa ti bha s+t+ri de baṃ/ —lha mchod gtong du 'jug /yang 'grel par/ a ya kran+da shabhā pa dh+wanya rnams kyi spyor ba la gnyis pa 'gyur ba ma yin gyi gsum pa nyid do zhes pa byung bas/ a ya ya ti me+e ni kai ra rīn/snyedamag 'gro ru 'jug dgra bo rnams la/ kran+da ya 117—258

ti be+e ni kai ra rī na/snyedamag rnams kyis dgra bo rnams du ru 'jug /shabhā ya ya ti be+e ni kai ra 3)na / snyedamag rnams kyis dgra bo rnams sgra sgrog tu 'jug /hā ya ya ti (1 rig ra rīn/ dpa' bo rnams kyis mgron du dgra bo rnams la/ z-i kro ra n+ya ta ra sde/ z-i kṛ dag gi yang na'o/ /z-inya dang kṛnya gnyis kyi sgra sbyor ba'i byed pa po la gnyis pa yang na 'gyur te/ hā ra ya ti bhā ram̐ r+bha h+ye/——bran phur 'phrog tu 'jug / hā ra ya ti bhā ram̐ j-i bye na/ kā ra ya 7 ti ka ṭī de ba dahaṃ/ lhas byin re lde byed du 'jug / kā ra ya ti ka ṭi de 3ba daste na/ yang 'grel par a bhe bā di dang dṛsha sbyor ba las byed pa po la tang ān spyor ba'i yul gnyis pa yang na 'gyur ro zhes pa byung bas/ a sgyi wā da ya te ku 5byu na ba sum̐ / bla ma slob ma la gsong por smra ru 'jug/ a bhi wā da ya te gu byu na ba ṭu nā 7/ dar+sha ya te rā dzā j-i bye/snyergyal po'i bran la lta ru 'jug/ dar+sha ya te rā dzā j-i h+ye na/ a bye shīng s+thā dzā tsa—/ a bye shīng s+thā āpa rnams kyi'ang ngo / /nyer bsgyur a bye snga ma'i shī dang s+thā ༄zhe dang āpa rnams sbyor ba'i bdun pa'i don la gnyis pa 'gyur te/ a bye she te bai kuṇ+ḍi 3snaha riḥ/— 'phrog byed mtho ris la nyal/ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha ti bai sbyikuṇ+ḍi ha riḥ/ —'phrog byed mtho ris la gnas/— a dh+yāste be+e kuṇ+ḍi ha riḥ/ a bhi ni bi sha:/ a bhi ni bi sha'i (1'ang ngo / /nyer bsgyur a bhi dang ni snga ma'i bi sha 5dang sbyor ba'i'ang bdun pa'i don la gnyis pa 'a sdomar te/ yi/ bhi bi sha te sad+mārge/ legs pa'i lam la mngon ske/par 'gro/ ni bi sha te sad+mārgo/— legs pa'i lam la nges par 'gro/ 'grel par ni dang a bhe snga ma yin kyang la lar gnyis pa mi 'gyur te bdun pa nyid do zhes pa byung bas/ pā pe a bhi ni bi shaḥ / —rig pa la nges par 'gro/ u pān spyoze saḥ/ u pa a nu a dhi/ āng rnams bsra la'o/ /nyer bsgyur u pa a nu a dhi āng rnams snga ma'i bas dang sbyor ba la bdun pa'i don la gnyis pa 'gyur te/ u pa ba sa ti bai kuṇ+ḍi ha riḥ/ 'phrog byed 717—259

mtho ris la nye bar gnas/ chenas pa nas/ sto bas ti bai kuṇ+ḍi ha riḥ/— 'phrog byed mtho ris la kun du gnas— zhes pa'i bar lta bu'o/ /'grel gyepar/ u pa sogs snga ma'i bsra dang sbyor ba yin kyang gnas pa'i yul de bza' btung med pa'i sa yin na bdun pa'i don la gnyis pa mi 'gyur zhing bdun pa nyid do zhes pa byung bas/ ba ṣ+pe u pa bas ti/— nags la nye bar gnas/ u pa sarba ta soḥkār+yā bye gu par+yā di 6 tri 6 dī tī yā mre ḍi tī te 6 ta to n+ya tā pi dṛ sh+ya te/ gnyis dang / thams cad de dag gi bya ba dang /'dzin pa dang / yang yang la sogs par gsum du dang / zlos pa'i mtha' rnams su —dang / de las gzhan du yang dag gnyis pa mthong ngo / /u pa ya dang sarba tas kyi mtha' can de dag gi bya ba ste/ de gnyis dang 'byel pa'i ming gzhan dang 'dzin pa ste sgo —ngan pa'i don byeka spyor ba dang / yang yang la sogs par gsum pa zlos pa'i mtha' zhes pa/ u pa ri/ a dhi thu/ a ho gsum yang yang zlos pa'i mtha' rnams dang / de las gzhan du yang zhes pa/ a bhi taḥ3/ pa ri taḥ/ sa ma yā/ ni ka ṣā/ hā/ ṛ hūṃte/ pra ti rnams spyor ba la'ang rnam dbye gnyis pa 'gyur te/ dper brjod rim pa bzhin/sngo pa ya taḥ/ go pā kṛṣ+ṭi/— 'drog 3 pa nag po gnyis/ sarba taḥkṛlja/— thams cad du nag po la/bye ka 8kṛṣ+ṭa bste/ ngan pa nag po mi mchod/ u parlu pa ri lo kai ha riḥ/—steng ma steng ma'i 'jig rten la 'phrog byed/ yinabyedh+ya bye lo kai/ —lhag pa lhag pa'i 'jig rten/ yi/ dhophosgo lo kai/— 'og ma 'og ma'i 'jig rten/ yinabhe taḥkṛṣ+ṭi/ —mngon par nag po/ pa ri taḥkṛṣ+ṭi/——yongs su nag po/ sa ma sa/ tre r+ghaṃ / snye'adus pa'i nag po la/ ni ka khu tsotre ṣ+ṭi/ nye ba'i nag po la/ hā tre/ṣ+ṭi/— kye ma nag po/ gro/ te kṛṣ+ṭi/ —nges par nag po/ pra ti kṛṣ+ṭi/ —sosor nag po/ an+ta ra an+ta re ṇa yuste/ an+ta ra an+ta re ṇa sbyor ba la'o/ /an+ta nyu)ra dang /— nang / an+ta re ṇa bar ram mtshams sam 117—260

dbrag sbyor ba la'ang rnam dbye gnyis pa 'gyur te/ an+ta rā gārta pa h+ye/ khyim bdag gi nang / yi/n+ta re ṇa darja su khan+da ṭ+wābha ba ti/ chos kyi bar du gcod pa la bde bar mi 'gyur/ /a nu rlak+ṣa ṇi/ a nu'i mtshan nyid la'o/ /mtshan nyid kyi don la a nu sbyor /5ba la yang gnyis pa 'gyur te/ dza pa ma nu pra bar+ṣa ta/ bzlas pas rjes su char rab tu 'bab/tro tī yāze/ gsum pa'i don la'o/ /a nu sbyor ba las rnam dbye gsum pa'i don la'ang gnyis pa 'gyur te/ na dī man ba se tā se nā/skyichu bo la rjes su nye ba'i dmag /tī ṣ+pe/ dman pa la'o/ /dman pa'i don la a nu yis spyor ba la yang rnam dbye gnyis pa 'gyur te/ a nu ha ri su rāḥ/ 'phrog byed rjes su lha/ u po bye ke tsa/u pa lhag pa la'ang ngo / /dman pa'i don dang lhag pa'i don la'ang u pa yis sbyor ba la gnyis pa 'gyur te/ u pa ha ri su rāḥ/ 'phrog byed la nye ba lha/ lak+ṣa ṇibye khyu tā khyu na bhā ga bīs+thā su pra ti par+yan baḥ/ mtshan nyid dang 'di ltar gyur pa dang bgo skal dang zlos pa rnams la pra ti pa ri a nu rnams las so/ /mtshan nyid la sogs pa de rnams kyi don la pra ti la sogs pa snyesbyor ba la gnyis pa 'gyur te/ mcha na nyid la/ ha ri pra ti/ 'phrogabyed la so sor/ ha ri pa ri/— 'phrog byed la rgyas pa/ ha ri ma byenu/ 'phrog byed la rjes su/ 'di ltar gyur pa la/ bhasto bur+ghaṃ pra pyeti / —so so sangs rgyas kyi 'bangs/ bhaX biṇ+ḍi pa ri/ khyab 'jug gi 'bangs rgyas/ bhasto dra dhe ma nu / ——rjes su sangs rgyas kyi 'bangs/ bgo skal la/ labye/ཿha rispra ti/ 'phrog byed dpal so sor byed/lal+līḥha ridza ri/——'phrog byed dpal rgyas/ lasmroḥha snyeri ma nu/ —'phrog byed dpal rjes su/ zlos pa la/ khyu kyetai khyu tai pra ti pra bhuḥ/snyesems can dang sems can la 5so sor bdag po/ byu tai byu khyatai pa ri pra (1ཿ/snyesems can dang sems can rgyas pa'i bdag po/ khyu lta byu ta ma nu pra bhuḥ/ —sems can dang sems can la rjes su bdag po/ a r+bha ra bhā ge/ a r+bha bgo skal ma yin pa la'o/ /117—261

bgo skal gyi don ma yin pa'i a bhi sbyor ba la gnyis pa 'gyur te/ ha ri ma bhi brta to bhalto/ —mngon par yod 'phrog byed la 'bangs/ a ti ra nyi kra ma be+e/ a ti shin tu ba'i bya ba la'o/ /a ti phul du byung ba'i bya ba sbyor ba la gnyis pa 'gyur te/a te tso de bān kṛṇ+ḍaḥ lha rnams las phul du byung ba nag po/ kā khā dh+wa no ra bye ta saṃ yo ge/dus dang lam bar mtshams med par sbyor ba la'o/ /dus la bltos nas lo re bzhin lan re klog ces pa lta bu dang lam bar ma chad pa'i don sbyor ba la gnyis pa 'gyur te/ mā saṃ ka s+thā bhā/ —zlabalabiji/ mā sa ma dī te/——zla bal klog go/ mā saṃ gu ḍa dh+wa nāḥ/— zla ba la ku ram dang yos bza'/ kro shaṃ ku ṭi ba/ na dī/ rgyang grags la 'gyog por chu/ kro sha ma dhī te/— rgyangagrags la glog go/ kro shaṃ gi riḥ/ rgyang grags la ri bo/ yang de lta bu las gzhan bar ma chad pa ma yin pa la gnyis pa mi 'gyur te/ mā rdo sa gya dī ra dhī 5te/— zla ba gnyis klog go/ kro sha sri ka de shaḥparbata/— rgyang grags kyi yul gcig ri bo/ de rnams kyis rnam dbye gnyis pa 'jug yul bshad nas da ni gsum pa'i yul bshad par bya'o/ /myu/ swa tan+d+raḥkarta/ rang dbang can de byed po'o/ /shing gcod mkhan lta bu rang dbang dang paldan pa de la byed po zhes brda chad byed do/ /sā dha ka ta oṃ shi ka ra khaṃ/ bsgrub nus pa de byed pa'o/ /bya ba gang yang bde blag tu bsgrub nus pa de la byed pa zhes brdar btags rngoso/ /katre ka ra ṇa yoskṛ tī yā/byed pa po dang byed pa dag la chogasum pa'o/ /bya ba gang yang byed pa po dang byed pa gnyis kyi don ston pa la rnam dbye gsum pa 'gyur te/ rā me ṇa bā ṇi dga' byed kyis mda' yis spre'u bsad na ha to bā lbo zhes pa rā me ṇa byed pa po pā ṇi na byed pa lta bu'o/ /pra kṛ t+yā di 9bh+yaste tī yā/ pra kṛ ti sogs rnams las gsum pa'o/ /pra kṛ ti la sogs pa rnams la yang rnam dbye gsum pa 'gyur te/ /prakṛ t+yā tsā ruḥ/— rang 117—262

bzhin gyis mdzes pa/ pā sku/ rdo nyu ṇa saḥ/— de rab tu mang ba'i/ go tre ṇa ba/rgyaḥ/ gra rgya'i rigs/sa me ṣ+pe rnguti/——songacha/ bi ṣa me ṣ+pe ti/ songazhes/ dī dro ṇi na jo bye shrī rja ti/ 'bru bye bo che gnyis tshong du 'jug /pañca ke na pa dzushun hwa ti/ phyugs lnga sprod du 'jug /su khe na duḥcekhe na yā ti / — sdug bsngal las bde ba thob/ di baḥkarma tsa/ di ba'i las la'ang ngo / /di ba'i sgra sbyor ba la las kyi don la'ang gsum pa muyang na 'gyur te/ a k+ṣeḥdī bya ti / ——shortser 'jug/— a/ k+ṣun dī bya ti/ a pa brgo tro tī yā/ 'bras bu thob pa la gsum pa'o/ /yang dag par shes sam bya ba gang gi 'bras bu thob pa'i don la dus dang lam bar mtshams med par thuspyor ba la gsum pa 'gyur te/ ad+dhā be+e dopho dhī taḥ/— nyin mo rig byad glog go/ /kro tsoshe na be+e do3 dhī taḥ/ —rgyang grags la rig byed klog go/ /'bras bu thob pa'i don ma yin na gsum pa mi 'gyur te/ mā sa ma dhī to nā yā taḥ—/ ——zla bar bklags kyang ma shes/ sa ha yuste pra dh+wa ṣ+pe/ lhan cig sbyor ba la'o/ /lhan cig pa'i sgra sbyor byeba'i don la gsum pa 'gyur te/ pu tre ṇas hā ga taḥ/ bu dang lhan du yod/ 'grel par sār+ghaṃ sā she rka sa me rnams sbyor ba la gsum pa 'gyur ro zhes pa byung bsanyu) / pu tre ṇa sarnya mā ga taḥ/ —budangalhan du yod/ pu tre ṇa sa kai 1 1 ga taḥ/——bu dang lhan du song / shi bye ṇa sa oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ti/ slob ma dang nye bar gnas/ ye rmā ga bi kā raḥ—/ gang gi lus kyi rnam 'gyur la'o/ /gang gi lus kyi rnam par 'gyur ba yod pa gsal bar gzhan mtshon nus pa de la rnam dbye dang po'i don la gsum pa 'asdomar te/ phyag1 kā ṇaḥ/——migazhar ba'o/ /pā de na khasgo ཿ/ rkang pa 'theng po'o/ /karte na ba bye raḥ/——rna ba 'on pa'o/ /shi ra sā kha lā ṭaḥ/ mgo bo spyi ther ba'o/ /ihūṃ bhū ta lak+ṣa ṇi/'di 'drar yod pa'i mtshan nyid la'o/ /'di dang 'di 'dra'o zhes pa'i mtshan nyid kyi don la gsum pa 'gyur te/ k+ṣa tre rto pā dz+nyā ya ma dāspyi ta/ —mkhan po dang 'dra 117—263

bar slob ma la blta'o/ /saṃ zlo n+ya ta ra sde karma rde/ yang dag par shes pa'i las la yang na'o / /yang dag par shes pa'i las kyi don la gsum pa yang na 'gyur te/pi tā sañju nī te/ phar yang dag par shes/ pa ti ram̐ sar+sā nī te/ he to/ rgyu la'o/ /bya ba spyor ba'i rgyu la gsum pa 'gyur te/ pu bye na dṛsgo gu ruḥ/snyebasod nams kyis mthong bla ma'o/ /'grel par de'i bya ba sbyor ba'i rgyu la zlos pa la'ang skabs 'gar gsum pa 'gyur ro zhes byung bas/ sha te na sha te na ban+d+ran pā ya ya ti pa yaḥ be'u brgya brgya 'o ma 'thung du 'jug /sha tai sha ta —rtebaṭ+wān pā ya ya ti pa yaḥ/ yang 'grel par / dal bo'i don bye sbyor ba la gsum pa 'gyur ro zhes pa byung bas/ a lam+bi laste na/ dalapos dal po/ yang 'grel par bden pa'i don sbyor ba la'ang byegasum pa 'gyur ro zhes pa byung bas/ sa tā masgo ha ri bhas+thā/ bden pa'i don 'phrog byed 'bangs—/ yang 'grel par pūrba dang a bar sbyor ba dang don med pa ste ngan pa'i don la gsum pa 'gyur ro zhes pa byung bas/ mā se na pūrbaḥ.a ba raḥ/——gzhan zla ba snga ma/ pu bye na tī naḥ/ —bsod nams dman pa/ shaste khaṃ ka la haḥ/snye mtshon chas 'khrugs/amṛṣ+ṭa su bya ba hā jere tsa turgya ze tre tī yā mi 'os pa'i rgyu la bzhi pa'i don la gsum pa'o/ /gang mi 'os pa'i bya ba'i rgyu sbyor ba la bzhi pa'i don la gsum pa 'gyur te/ dā snga saṃ yats+tsha ti kā mu kaḥ/ —bran mo la thig le sbyin/ mi 'os pa ma yin na gsum pa mi 'gyur te/ bhār+yā yi saṃ yats+tsha ti kā mu kaḥphye/ —chung ma la thig le sbyin/ de rnams kyis gsum pa'i 'jug yul bshad zin nas da ni bzhi pa'i 'jug ⑪ yul bshad par bya'o// //myu/ karma 7 rja ya ma bhi pri ti sa saṃ pra dā rna/ gang gi las mngon par rab tu 'ong ba de yang dag par rab tu sbyin pa'o/ /gang gi ched du sbyin par 'dod 117—264

pa dang len par 'dod pa ste sbyin pa'i las dang / gang gi ched du 'gro ba dang 'ong ba rnams la yang 1dag par rab tu sbyin pa zhes tha snyad btags so/ /tsa tus+thā saṃ pra dā ṣ+pe/ yang dag par rab tu sbyin pa la bzhi pa'o/ /gang gi ched du yang dag par rab tu sbyin pa zhes brda chad byas pa de la rnam dbye bzhi pa 'gyur te / zwah+ma ṇi bh+yaḥhūṃ da dā ti/ —bram ze rnams la ba lang sbyin/ de be+e bh+yaḥpu྾ da dā ti/ lha rnams la me tog sbyin/ u pā dh+yā yā ya su warte da dā ti/ mkhanapo la gser 'bul/ yang dag par rab tu sbyin pa ma yin na sbyin pa'i don yin kyang bzhi pa mi rngu 'gyur te/dā nī yo bi praḥ/—bram ze la sho gam sprod/ zhes pa rnams sbyin pa'i las kyi don 'ong ba'i don la/ pra bye she te spyo/snyebud med bdag po'i ched du nyal/ ru tsuṭ+wā r+ghaṃ pri ya mā ṇaḥ/sred pa'i don dang ldan pa'i dga' ba la'o/ /gang sred pa'i don dang ldan pa'am sred pa la dga' ba'i byed pa can la bzhi pa 'gyur te/ ha ra ye ro tsa te bhat+taḥ—/ —'phrog byed la bran sred pa byed/ shā gha h+phung s+thā sha r+pā dhībe+e mā naḥ/ shāgha h+phung s+thā shapa rnams kyi shes pa'i 'dod pa dang ldan pa la'o/ /byings shā gha dang h+phu dang s+thā dang shapa rnams kyi rngusbyor ba'i shes par 'dod pa'i byed pa can la bzhi pa 'gyur te/ go bīsma rāta kṛṣ+ṭha yashā gha te/ —'brog mo nag po bran bzhin 'dod/ kṛ: yasnu te / — nag po la ngan par smra/ kṛ: ya tiṣ+ṭha te/——nagapo la gnas/ kṛ: ya sha pa te/ —nag ngo la phra ma byed—/ bhā re rut+ta mar+ṇaḥ/ 'dzin pa'i bu lon lhag pa la'o/ /gang 'dzin pa'i sbyor ba bu lon lhag pa'i byed pa can la bzhi pa 'gyur te/ a haṃ mok+ṣu ya dh+wa ra pa te budhaḥ/ —bdag grol ba'i phyir 'dzin par byed sangs rgyas/ smṛ pyahe rīspru tai/ grogs 'dod pa la'o—/ / rgu gang gi grogs 'dod pa'i sbyor ba'i byed pa can la bzhi pa 'gyur te/ha ra yesmṛ ha ya ti/snye'aphrogabyed 'dod/ kru dha dru tedze+e sru yāzwa rmā yi pra ti ko paḥ/ kru 117—265

dha dru ha yīkhyu a sru rnams gang la so sor khro ba'i don la'o/ /kru dha sogs rnams khro ba'i don bya ba ma yin pa so sor brjod pa'i sbyor ba la bzhi pa 'gyur te/ ha ra ye kru rgya ti/snye'aphrogabyed la khro bar byed/ ha raye dru t+ya ti/snye'aphrog byed la 'khu bar byed/ ha ra ye khrakhyo ti/snye'aphrog byed la phrag dog byed/ ha raye a pū ①ya ti/—'phrog byed la phra ma byed/ kru dha dru ho ru pa thraṣ+ṭa yoḥ/ kru dha dru ha dag gi nye bar 'os pa dag la'o/ /kru dha dang druha dag gi sbyor ba mi 'os pa ma yin pa 'os pa'i don gyi sbyor ba ste khro ba'i don ma yin na bzhi ②pa 'gyur ba ma yin pas gnyis pa nyid 'gyur te/ thād+ma ṇa ma bhi kru rgya ti/—bram ze la khro bar mi byed/ thāh+ma ṇa ma bhi dru khya ti/—bram ze la 'khu bar mi byed/ rā dhī k+korlu su bi prashāḥ/ rā dha yīk+ṣa dag las gang gi 'dri ba la'o/ /rā dha dang yīk+ṣa dag 'dre ba'i don la sbyor ba la bzhi pa 'gyur te/ kṛ: ya rā rgya te/kṛ: ye k+ṣu te/—nag pol 'dri bar byed/ pra t+yāhūṃ shu ba pūrba su kaṭ+wā/ pra ti āng dag las shu'i snga ma'i byed pa po la'o/ /nyer bsgyur pra ti dang āng yod pa'i shu'i snga ma'i rtags de la byed pa po'i don la bzhi pa 'gyur te/ bi pā ya shrī pra ti shri r+ṇa ti—/ snyebram ze'i ba lang so sor thos/ be+e pā ya gā mā shri kho ti/—bram ze ba lang kun du thob/ a nu pra ti kṛ ṇabyu/ a nu pra ti dag gi kṛ ṇa la'ang ngo / /a nu dang pra ti snga ma'i kṛ ṇa dang sbyor ba'i rtags snga ma de la'ang byed pa po'i don la bzhi pa 'gyur te/ho tre a nu kṛ ṇ+ḍa ①nyi/snyesbyin sreg mkhan la rjoso sor rjod par byed/ ho tre pra ti kṛ ṇ+ḍa ti/snyesbyin sreg mkhan la rjes su rjod par byed/ pa ri kra ya ṇi saṃ pra dā na ma n+ya ta ra sde/ pa ri kri ya'i yang dag par rab tu sbyin pa yang na'o/ / pa ri kri ⑤ ya'i sbyor ba las byed pa po'i don yang dag par rab tu sbyin pa'i don can la bzhi pa yang na 'gyur la yang na gsum pa nyid de/ sha butā ya pa ri shrī topho nu byu hi/—brgya yis yongs su nyos pa 117—266

rjes su smros/ sha te na pa ri spri to nu byu hi/ ta dbye tsa snatudhī bā tsā/ de'i don la bzhi pa brjod do/ /de'i don zhes zhepa don shin tu bzang ba bsgrubs na myur du 'grub nges pa da lta mngon du ma gyur pa zhig la zer la don de la bzhi pa 'gyur te/dper brjod 'grel par tshigs bcad du byung ba ni/ saṃ ya mā ya khru tai dhadhe na ro dharmā ya saṃ ya me/snyesdom brtson ched du thos pa 'dzin/ /mi dag sdom brtson chos kyi ched/ /dharme mok+ṣu ya me jo 5bī dha rna dā nā ya byuk+ta ye/ —blo ldan thar pa'i ched du chos/ /sbyin pa'i phyir dang zas phyir nor/ /zhes pa/ mā ya gnyis dang k+ṣu ya dang nā ya zhes bzhi pa'i de sbyar ba lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du burnyo bha be+e 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par sgog yi dza ga te nyi tā ya ma māṭ+wā ya ma nu kas+thā ya me bi gho lta bu'o/ /yang 'grel par lung drangs pa/ he tu yo ge tsa/rgyu sbyor ba la'ang ngo / /gang gi rgyu'i don sbyor ba la bzhi pa 'gyur te/ drwah+ma zla ya he tai spyi re/—bram ze'i rgyu 'bras zan/ kri yātho pa pa da gya tsa karma ṇis+thā ni naḥ/ bya ba'i don gyi nye ba'i tshig la'ang ④las la'o/ /bya ba'i don gyi nye ba'i tshig la las te gnyis pa'i don la bzhi pa yang na 'gyur te/ pha le 5bh+yo yā ti/ 'bras bu rnams thob par byed/ tu maspyortso bhā ba ba tsa nāta/ tum gyi don las kyang dngos po brjod pa las so/ /rkyen tum dang / ghanya sogs dngos po brjod pa'i don du sbyin pa'i sbyor ba la'ang bzhi pa 'gyur te/ yā ce gā ya yā ti/ mchod sbyin thob/ na maḥswaste swā hā lo ba ṣakhro gārtso④/ na ma sa swa ste swā hā/ a lo ba ṣaṭa rnams sbyor ba las kyang ngo / /na mas la sogs pa — —de rnams kyi sbyor ba la bzhi pa 'a sdomazab te/ /na res dra d+dhā 'a /snyesangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na res dhache/ kyang/ chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na ma.oṃ ghā ya/— dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /swaste pra dzā bh+yaḥ/ bde legs su gyur cig skye dgu rnams/swā hā pi dṛ bh+yaḥ/ —pha mes rnams legs par tshim mo/ /alo khyu te bh+yaḥ/— tshim pa 'byung po rnams/ ba 117—267

ṣa ḍin+d+ra ya/— dbangabyed dbang po la/ yang 'grel par lung drangs pa/ u pa pa da bi bhasteḥkā ra ka bi bhat+tarba 1lī ya sī/ nye ba'i tshig gi rnam dbye las byed pa can byu rnam dbye stobs dang ldan pa la'o/ /gong du na mas sbyor ba la rnam dbye bzhi pa kho na 'jug par bshad kyang lung 'dis gcig tu ma nges te gong du rnam dbye bzhi pa 'jug par bshad pa ni nye ba'i tshig la ltos pa yin la/ skabs 'dir byed pa can ni gnyis pa yin pas na mas dang sbyor ba la yang skabs 'gar gnyis pa 'jug go zhes pa byung bas/ dper na/ oṃ na ma④ཿsernyi/snyegrub thob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na maska lha rnams la phyag 'tshal loro ti de ①bān lta bu'o/ /ma n+ya kan+d+ra rgya nā dā re bi bhā ṣā pā ṇi ④6/ ma n+ya'i las la srog chags ma yin pa rnams la smad pa la yang na'o/ /ma n+ya'i las la srog chags ma yin pa la smad pa la bzhi pa yang na 'jug cing yang na gnyis pa nyid de/ na hūṃ tro ⑤rja ya ma bye/——a rtswar yang mi sems/na hūṃ tre ⑥ṇi ma bye/ smad pa ma yin na bzhi pa mi 'gyur te/ hūṃ de baṃ ma bye—/ — alhar sems/ yang srog chags ma yin kyang no la bzhi pa mi 'gyur te/ na hūṃ nā baṃ ⑦ma bye/snyeglo grur yang mi sems/ srog chags yin na smad pa yin kyang bzhi pa mi 'gyur te/ na hūṃ shu kai ma bye/——spyod ṣ+pe tsor yang mi sems/ na hūṃ shi ga lo ma bye/snyekhyod ce spyang du'ang mi sems/ ga t+yarja kan+d+ra ṇi dī tī yā tsa tusgo tseṭ+wā yā na dh+wa ni/ 'gro ba'i chadon kyi las la gnyis pa dang bzhi pa dag g.yo ba la ste lam ma yin pa la'o/ /'gro ba'i don la 'jug pa'i byings kyi las su bya ba la rnam dbye bzhi pa dang gnyis pa gang rung 'gyur te/ de'ang g.yo ba ste 'gro bzhin pa de yang lam la 'gro ba ma yin pa la'o/ /pra dze+e bra dza ti kṛṭ+wā/snyebacom brlags 'gro bar byed do nag mo/ pra dzā ya bra dza ti kṛ:/ g.yo bzhin pa ma yin na ⑨bzhi pa mi 'gyur te/ ma na sā 717—268

ba rna yā ti/—sems kyis nags la sleb/ lam ma yin na'ang gnyis pa nyid de/ mārgo gats+tsha ti/snyelamala'agro bar byed/ yang 'grel par lam yin kyang ut+pa the na snga ma'i ba thi la 'gro ba'i don la bzhi pa 'gyur ro zhes bshad pa①/ ut+pa the na pa the gats+tsha ti| —'grul pa lam la 'gro bar byed/ yang 'grel par/ 'gro ba'i don yin na g.yo ba dang lam yin min la yang mi bltos par bzhi pa dang gnyis pa yang na bar skabs 'gar srid do zhes byung bas/ gā mā ya gi tā/snyegrong la 'gro bar byed/snyegā me gi tā/de rnams kyis bzhi pa'i yul bshad nas da ni lnga pa'i yul bshad par bya ste/༈ sgru ba ma pā ye pā dā rna/ brtan pa las bral ba de nges par kun sbyin pa'o / /gang brtan pa las 'bral ba'am sngar 'dus pa'am 'byar ba gyes shing zhig pa'am so sor phral ba de la nges par kun sbyin pa zhes tha snyad byed do/ /a pā dā ṣ+pe pañca m+bi/ nges par kun sbyin pa la lnga pa'o/ /gong du nges par kun sbyin pa zhes brda chad byas pa de la rnam dbye lnga pa 'gyur te/ grwa ②mā dā yā ti—/ —grongalas 'ongs so/ /dh+wa ba tolhashāt+pa ta ti/—bang brgyugs pa'i rta las lhung ngo / /yang 'grel par ④phra ma dang dga' ba dang bral ba dang 'os ma yin pa rnams dang sbyor ba las kyang lnga pa 'gyur ro zhes byung bas/ pā pātshu gube+e te/snyesdeg pa las phrag dog byed/ pāpā dwo ④ra ma ti/—sdeg pa las dga' ba dang bral bar 'gyur/—dharmāt+tha mā r+ya ti/—chos las mi 'os pa byed/bhā tāṭ+wā rmā bha ya he tuḥ/ 'jigs pa dang bsrung ba'i don rnams kyi 'jigs pa'i rgyu la'o/ /'jigs pa'i don dang bsrung ba'i don rnams kyi sbyor ba las 'jigs pa'i rgyu la yang lnga pa 'gyur te/ tso/ rā dī bhe ti/snyechom rkun las 'jigs so/ /tso rāṭ+wā ya te/—chom rkun las bsrung ngo / /pa rā dze ra so bye⑤ཿ/ rgyal ba ma yin pa'i 'pham pa la'o/ /gang rgyal ba ma yin pa'i 'pham pa'i don spyor ba la lnga pa 117—269

'gyur te/ pā pāt+pa rā dza ya te/— sdig pa las 'pham par 'gyur/ bā ra shāṭ+wā nā m+bidz+re taḥ/ spangs pa'i don rnams kyi 'dod pa la'o/ /gang kyespangs pa'i don rnams la de spang bar 'dod pa la lnga pa 'gyur te/ ya bi bh+yo gāḥbār ya ti / nas rnams las ba lang rnams zlog par byed/ an+tak+ṣiṃ ye nā dar+sha na mi 'a ti/ gang gis mi mthong bar byed pa'i sted pa la'o/ /gang gis mi mthong bar 'dod pa'i sbed pa'i don sbyor ba la lnga pa 'gyur te/ mā turni lī ya te kṛṣ+ṭaḥ/ nag po ma las yib par byed/ā khyu to pa yo ge/ klog pa dang nye bar spyor ba la'o/ /slob pa'i don nye bar spyor ba'i klog 5pa'i sgra sbyor ba la yang lnga pa 'gyur te/ u pā dh+yā yā da dhī te ba ṭuḥ / mkhan po las klog par byed slob ma/ slob pa'i don nye bar sbyor ba ma yin na lnga pa mi 'gyur te/ na ṭa su gī tsā shrī ḍo ti/ gar mkhan gyi glu thos par 'gyur/ dza ni kartuḥpra kṛ ti/skyed par byed pa'i rang bzhin la'o/ /rang bzhin te rgyu gang gi ——'bras bu'am dngos po bskyed par byas zin pa'i rgyu la lnga pa 'jug ste/ brah+ma ṇaḥpra dzāḥ pra dzā yadhe / tshangs pa/ las skye dgu rnams skyed par byed/ bhu baḥpra bha baḥ/ 'byung bar 'gyur ba las so/ /gang las 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i yul la lnga pa 'gyur te/ hi ma ba to shaṃ gā pra bha ba ti/ gangs can las gi gā 'byung bar byed/ 'grel par/ l+yapa phyis pa la gnyis pa dang bdun pa'i don la 3lnga pa'o zhes pa byung bas/ kṛta tresogs kyi rkyen l+yapa phyis pa'i rtags la rnam dbye gnyis pa dang bdun pa'i don la lnga pa 'gyur shite/ shā sā dāsprek+ṣa te/ khang bzangs sgrul lta bar byed/ ās nādrek+ṣa te/ gdan las lta'o//yang 'grel par lung drangs pa/ prashā khyu na yobya/ 'dri ba'i brjod pa la'o/ /gang shes lta bu 'dri ba'i brjod pa sbyor ba la lnga pa 'gyur te/ kasmra hūṃta twa mā ga taḥ / khyod ci nas 'ongs/ ya tartswa dh+wa kā la nirmā rde ta tra pañca rmā/ gang 117—270

las lam dus nges pa'i tshad de la lnga pa'ang ngo / /gang las lam dang dus nges pa'i tshad ston pa la lnga pa 'gyur te 'ang gi sgras dang po dang gnyis pa dang bdun pa rnams kyang 'gyur ro/ /ba nāṅgā mo yo dza rna/—— nas gnas gyogrong la rgyang grags bzhi/kārti kyāḥ.ā gra hā ya bhā mā se lta bu'o/ /a t+yā rā di ta rarte dika shabhāñjut+ta ra pa dā dzā hi yuste/ a n+ya ā khyerāta i ta ra ṛ te phyogs kyi sgra azhu rnams kyi phyi ma'i tshig dang ātsa ā hi dag gi sbyor ba la'o/ /a n+ya la sogs pa 'di rnams dang sbyor ba'i tshig phyi ma dang ātsa ā hi rkyen mtha' can la lnga pa 'gyur te/ a n+yaḥkṛ: ta—/ — nagapo gzhan/ bhisgo rā na/ta/— dga' byed las gzhan/ lnga/rāta rā na/ta/— dga' byed las nye ba/i ta ro rā māta/——dga' byed las cig shos/ ṛ te ⑪bud+dhā ta ku to mok+ṣu ta/— sangs rgyas kyi bor bas ci phyir grol/ pūrbo grwa na/ta/ sharagye grong las/ phyag ya masgo/ta pūrbaḥ/snye'adi nged las snga ma/pāka gā māta/snyegrongalasashar/ kak+ṣi ④rja gā māta/snyelho phyogs kyi grong / —dak+ṣi zla hi gā māta/yang 'grel par/ snga ma'i don sbyor ba las skabs 'gar lnga pa 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ bha bā dā ra bh+yaḥ/——'khor ba las snga ma/ yang 'grel par grong gi phyi lta bu khyaphyi'i don sbyor ba la lnga pa 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ grwa mā dwa hiḥ/——grong las phyi/a pa pa rī brdza ṣ+pe/ a pa pa ri dag gi bor ba la'o/ /a pa 'upa ri dag sbyor ba bor ba brjod pa la las rab tu sbyor ba zhes ming 'dogs byed do/ /āng maṭ+wā dā ba tsa ṣ+pe/ āng las mtshams brjod pa la'o/ /āng las mtshams lta bu bar mtshams bzung ba'i don brjod pa la yang las rab tu sbyor ba zhes dgos pa'i dbang gis ming 'dogs byed do/ /pañca mya āng skyeb ri bhiḥ a pa she.āng ba ri rnams kyi lnga pa'o/ /a pa la sogs pa 'di rnams gong du las rab tu sbyor ba zhes ming 'dogs byas pa'i don de dag dang sbyor ba la rnam dbye gnyis pa'i don 117—271

bshad pas/ bha dze shaṃ sgobya ra ṇa yoḥ/snyedabang phyug zhabs la mchod par byed/ ṣad+dhā te tu pra yo ge/ rgyu dang rab tu sbyor ba la drug pa'o/ /'di'i rgyu 'di zhes pa lta bu rgyu'i don sbyor ba la drug pa 'gyur ro/ /zasakyiphyir sdod do/snye.an+da mya te toḥb sa ti/ sarba nāsnaskṛ tī yā tsa/ sarba nā ma'i gsum pa la'ang ngo / /rgyu'i don brjod pa'i sarba nā ma'i rtags rnams dang sbyor ba la drug pa 'gyur zhing gsum pa'ang ngo / /ka sra te toḥ/ ci'irgyu'i/ ke na te tu nā/snyergyuciyis/ yang 'grel par lung drangs pa/sarba sogs dang sbyor ba'i rgyu'i don brjod pa la rnam dbye thams cad kyang ngo / /sarba nā ma'i rtags rnams dang spyor ba'i rgyu'i don brjod pa la gsum pa dang drug pa 'gyur bar ma zad rnam dbye thams cad yang na 'gyur te/ kāḥte tuḥ/—rgyuci/ki te rtu/ —rgyucil/ ke rgyu ci yis na te tu nā sogs so/ /ṣaṣ+ṭha ta sa za pra t+ya ye na/rkyen ata tas kyi don la drug pa'o/ /rkyen ata dang tas spyor ba'i don dang ①sbyor ba la drug pa 'gyur te/ dak+ṣi ṇa to grwa ma gya/——grongagi lho/ pu grong gi sdun rastata gā ma gya e na yā dī tī yā/ e na'i gnyis pa la'ang ngo / /e na'i sbyor ba la drug pa 'gyur te gnyis pa la'ang ngo / /dak+ṣi rde na blu gā oṃ/——grongagi lho/snyedak+ṣi rde na gā ma gya / dru rārnyi kādze+eḥṣasbya n+ya ta ra sri/ ring ba dang nye ba'i don rnams kyi drug pa yang na'o/ /thag ring ba dang nye ba'i sbyor ba la lnga pa 'gyur zhing drug pa'ang 'gyur te/ dru re gā māta/— grongalas ring ba/ dru ram̐ gā ma gya/——grong gi ring ba/ ni ka ṭi grwa māta / snyegrong la nye ba/ ni ka ṭi grwa ma gya/snyegrong gi nye ba/ rnyophobe+e darba gya ka ra ṇi/dzan shes pa'i don ma yin pa la byed pa po la'o/ /dzan shes pa'i don brjod pa ma yin pa'i mi shes pa'i don brjod pa sbyor ba la byed pa po ste gsum pa'i don la drug pa 'gyur te/ sarngi ③sngo dzā nī te/——mar gsar du shes/ mi shes pa ma yin na mi 717—274

'gyur te/skadakyis bur shes/ —swa re ṇa pu tram̐ dzā nāti/ a dhī garba da ye shaṃ karma ①ṇi/dran pa'i don dang da ya i sha rnams kyi las la'o/ /dran pa'i don brjod pa dang byings da wa i sha rnams kyi sbyor ba la las te gnyis pa'i don la drug pa 'gyur te/ mā tu rabye ti/——madranapar byed/ pituḥsma ra ti/snyepha dran par byed/ sabe+e kho da ya te/——mar za bar byed/ dzag tā mibye/— 'gro ba rnams kyi dbang phyug /kṛnyaḥpra ti yan+de/kṛnya'i 'bad pa la'o/ /che kṛnya byed pa la'o ⑤zhes pa'i byings las 'bad pa rtogs par byed pa dang sbyor ba la drug pa 'gyur te/ e dho da ka sro pa saṃ cha sku ru te—/ snyechu 'phel gyi bya ba yang dag par 'bad par byed/ ru dzāṭ+wā dzā bhā ④ ba tsa nā nā ma dz+wa reḥ/nad kyi don rnams kyi dngos po brjod pa rnams kyi dz+wa ⑤ra ma yin pa la'o/ /nad dang brdeg pa la sogs pa 'tshe ba'i don can gyi 'ubyings rnams las grub pa rnams kyi dz+wa ra ma yin pa ste ma rtogs pa'i tshig gi sbyor ba'i rtags la las kyi don la drug pa 'gyur te/ tso ra su ru dza ti/snyechom rkun nad kyi 'debs/ tso ra khya ni harnyi—/ —chom rkun nges par gsod④/ dz+wa ra sbyor ba la gnyis pa nyid de/ tso re dz+wa ra ya ti—/ snyechom rkun rims kyi 'debs/ ā shi ṣi ldunā thaḥ/ nā tha'i smon pa la'o/ /nā tha'i sgra smon pa dang shis pa brjod pa dang sbyor ba la drug pa 'gyur te/ sabe+e ṣe mgon pos mar sbyin par byed nā tha te da dā nyi/ dzā se ni pra ha ṇa nā ṭa krā tha pi ྾ hid+marja ram̐/dzā se ni ⑨pra ha ṇa nā ṭa/ krā tha pi ṣa rnams kyi 'tshe ba'i don rnams kyi'o/ /dzā ⑩ se la sogs pa 'di rnams 'tshe ba'i don brjod pa dang byer ba la gnyis pa'i don la drug pa 'gyur te/ tso ra srodz+dzas ya ti/snyechom rkun 'joms par byed/ tso ra gya ni pra harnyi—/ snyechom rkun nges par rab tu gsod par byed/ tso ra sron+da ṭa ya ti/—chom rkun 'ching bar byed/tso ra su krā tha ya ti/snyechom rkun la snun par byed/ tsor gya pi naṣ+ṭi/— chom rkun phye mar 'thag par byed/117—275

'tshe ba'i don ma yin na mi 'gyur te/ dh+wa nāḥpi yos 'thag par byed naṣ+ṭi/ bya ba j-i pa khoḥs marba yo/ bi a ba dz+dza pa ṇa dag gi rgyal ba la'o/ /bi dang a ba snga ma'i j-i ①dang pa ṇa rgyal ba'i don brjod pa dang sbyor ba la gnyis pa'i don la drug pa 'gyur te/ sha ta gya bya ba ha ra te②/—brgya thams pa'i rgyal bar byed/ sha ta gya bya ba ba ṇa te—/ rgyal ba brjod pa ma yin na drug pa ⑦mi 'gyur te/ zwah+ma khaṃ pa ṇa bram ze la bstod pa byed ya ④ti/ di bsta ⑤darba gya/ di ba'i de'i don gyi'o/ /di ba zhes pa'ang de'i don te bshad ma thag pa ltar rgyal ba'i don la sbyor ba la'ang gnyis pa'i don la drug pa 'gyur te/ sha ta gya brgya thams pa'i rgyal bar byed dī bya ti/ bi bhā kho pa sarge/ nyer bsgyur la yang na'o/ /nyer bsgyur snga ma'i dipa las rgyal ba'i don brjod pa la gnyis pa'i don la drug pa yang na 'gyur te/ sha rjolta pra dī bya ti / snyebargya thams pas rab tu rgyal bar byed/rkosha ta gya pra dri bya ti⑦/ kṛ tophorba pra yo ge kā lophodhi ka ra ṇi/ dus kyi don rab tu sbyor ba'i kṛta las lhag par byed pa la'o/ /kṛta sogs kyi rkyen dus kyi don brjod pa dang spyor ba las lhag par byed pa ste rnam dbye bdun pa'i don la drug pa 'gyur te/ pañca kṛ twa3t+naḥhūṃ ste/—nyi malnga zan za bar byed/ dī ra sgo bye ste/—nyi ma gnyis zan za bar byed/ kadṛ karma khoḥkṛ tiḥ/ byed pa po dang las dag la kṛta la'o/ /byed pa po dang las dag brjod pa yang yin la kṛta sogs kyi rkyen mtha' can kyang ⑧yin pa sbyor ba las drug pa 'gyur te byed pa po la/ ta ba gā saṃ kā/—khyodaza bar byed/ ta ba ga mi kā/—khyod 'gro bar byed/ lasal/sarba sa tā rmā ⑨sems can thams cad la rgyas par mdzod puṣ+ṭi ku ru/ na maḥs sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /man+ta bud+dhā rmā⑫/ u bha ya pā ⑪sto karma ṇi/ gnyis thob pa la las la'o/ /rnam dbye gnyis pa dang drug pa gnyis ka thob pa la las la drug pa 'gyur te/117—276

tsi tram̐ ga r+pā ba lang skyong ba khra ma ①rnams 'jo bar byed do ho go ba ke na/ k+ta su tsa brta mā ṣ+pe/k+ta'i 'ang da ltar ba la'o/ /k+ta'i rkyen da ltar ba'i don brjod pa sbyor ba la drug pa 'gyur te/ bden par shes bzhin pa/rkos tsā dz+nyā taḥ/ da ltar ba ma yin na mi ②'gyur te—/ grwa oṃ grongal song ga taḥ/ na sum̐ sa ke bhā be/ ma ning la dngos po la'o/ /k+ta'i rkyen dngos po'i don brjod pa ma ning gi rtags sbyor ba la drug pa yang na 'gyur te/ sa tsā ba taḥ/—bden pa rnams sang /snyes rnyirga taḥ/ a dhi ka ra ṇa bā tsi nabyurka/ lhag par byed pa po brjod pa la'ang ngo / /k+ta'i rkyen mtha' can dang sbyor ba las lhag par byed pa ste bdun pa'i don la drug pa ①'gyur te/ i da me ṣā mā ④si tai/—'di'adiru sdod/ na lo kā bya ya nijo ṣa larja dṛ rde/ 'jig rten mi zad pa bden pa ṣal troṇa rnams kyi don la ma yin no/ /'jig rten gyi sgra sbyor ba dang mi zad pa'i sde rnams dang sbyor ba dang bden pa'i don can gyi rkyen dang ṣal gyi rkyen dang / tre ⑤ṇa sogs rkyen lnga po'i mtha' can rnams dang sbyor ba la drug pa 'gyur ba ma yin te/ 'jig rten gyi sgra sbyor ba la/ tsa kṛ rjobān sreṣ+ṭi ha riḥ/—'jig rten byed po 'phrog byed/ mi zad pa la/ a lo ka risnguḥ/rkogang bar byas⑦/bden pa'i rkyen mtha' can/ ha ri de t+yā na ha ta bān/—lha min 'joms byed 'phrog byed/bistu nā ha tāḥ de t+yāḥ/—khyab 'jug gis lha min rnams bsad/ ṣal gyi rkyen mtha'/ yī ṣaṅkaraḥ.a hā nyungangu zas re/ z-iṇa sogs lnga ni 'di rnams te/ tro/ shā na⑧tsa/tsā na/ sha dṛ/ tre ⑨ṇa sogs lnga po yin la thog mar dṛ'i rkyen mtha' can la/lo kān kartu/—'jig rten byed po/ shā natsa la/ so me pa ba mā naḥ/snyezhi ba 'thung bar byed/tsā ⑫na la/ ān+d+ra rna maṇ+ḍa ya mā naḥ/—bdaganyid gsal ba/ sha tri ⑪la/ be da ma dhī rig byed klog yan/ tri ⑫ṇa la/ lo 'jig rten byed po tshangs pa kān karta brad+mā/ yang 117—277

'grel par/ dīṣa sha tu'i rkyen can dang sbyor ba la gnyis pa'i don la drug ①pa yang na 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ mu ra su dwo ṣan/—lhaminagyi sgra/ mu ram̐ dri ṣan/a ke nor bha bi byu ②dārta masbya yoḥ/ aka in dag gi 'byung 'gyur bu lon ngan pa la'o/ /aka dang in gyi rkyen dus 'byung 'gyur brjod pa bu lon ngan pa'i don can sbyor ba la gnyis pa'i don la drug pa 'gyur ba ma yin te/ sa ta①ཿpā la kophopa ta ra nyi/snyeskyes bu dam pas bu lon 'phrod par 'gyur/ su kha bde bas bu lon 'phrod par 'gyur mṛ khaṃ dā yīrjo/ kṛ t+yā rmā karta ri bā/ kṛta rnams kyi byed pa po la yang na'o/ /kṛta sogs kyi rkyen mtha' can dang sbyor ba na byed pa po'i don la drug pa yang na 'gyur te/ ma yā se byo swa ra swasnri/—bdag gi dbyangs can ma mchod/ ma ma se byo swa ra swasnri—/ —bdag gi dbyangs can ma mchod/ tu spyodze+er tu lo pa mā dz+nyā j-i tī yā n+ya ta ra sde/mnyam pa'i don dang mnyam par nye bar 'jal ba ma yin pa dag la gsum pa yang na'o—/ /mnyam pa'i don gyi sgra rnams kyi sbyor ba dang mnyam par nye bar 'jal ba ma yin pa ste mnyam pa med pa sbyor ba dag la drug pa dang gsum pa yang na ste/pi tā tu be+eduḥpu traḥ/—phadanga'adra ba bu/—pi tuḥtu phyaḥ pu traḥrjo/ pi tā sa dṛ shaḥpu traḥ—/ snyephadangamanyam pa bu/snyepi tuḥs dri shaḥpu traḥ/ pi tā sa maklu traḥ/—pha dang mtshungs pa bu/—pi tum ma klu traḥ/ burnya su tu phyaḥnāste/—sangs rgyas dang mnyam pa med/snyebudhe na tu be+eḥnāste—/ tsa tus+thā tsā shi byā yu 6 ma dra bha dra ku sha la su khārba hi taiḥ/ smon pa ā yu6 ma dra bha dra ku sha la bde ba'i don rnams dang hi ta rnams kyi bzhi pa'ang ngo / /smon pa rtogs par byed pa dang ā yu 6 sogs bzang po'i don dge ba'i don bde ba'i don sogs de rnams kyi spyor ba la drug pa dang bzhi pa dag 'gyur te/ ā yu py-i ta ba bhū yāta/snyekhyod tshe ring bar gyur cig /—ā yu lhi tu bye bhū yāta/ ma dre ta ba bhū 117—278
