yātaske/ —khyod dga' bar gyur cig /snyem dre tu bye byu yāta/ bha dre ta ba byu yāta/—khyo bzang por gyur cig/snyebha dro tu bye khyu yāta①/ ku sha lo ①ta ba bhū yāta/snyekhyod dge bar gyur cig /kusha lo tu bye bhū yāta/—khyod dgebar gyur cig /su khaṃ ta ba bhū sneyāta/snyekhyod bde bar gyur cig /—sukhaṃ tu bye bhū ④yāta/ tsi ram̐ dzī bi lta ma ma bhū ⑤yāta/—bdag ring du 'tsho bar shog /— tsi ram̐ jo rjobi lta ma bye bhū yāta/ ka spyo r+ṇa ta ba bhū yāta/—khyod dge bar gyur cig /—ka spyo ṇi tu bye bhū yāta/hi lta ta ⑦ba byu yāta/—a laphan par gyur cig /snyehi tai tu bye bhū yāta/ tresna ṭ+wā rmā ka ra ṇi ṣajo bā/ tshim pa'i don rnams kyi byed pa po la drug pa yang na'o/ /tshim pa'i don rnams dang sbyor ba la byed pa po'i don khrul drug pa yang na 'gyur te/pha ⑨le'idṛp+taḥ/—'bras bu rnams kyis tshim/—pha khā rmā trop+taḥ/ de rnams kyis drug pa 'jug tshul bshad zin nas/ da ni bdun pa'i 'jug yul bshad par bya ste/༈ ā jo rophodhi ka ra rde/ gnas gzhi ste lhag par byed pa'o/ /gang gnas pa'i gzhi 'am yul de la 'dir lhag par byed pa zhes brda chad byed do/ /sap+ta mya dhi ka ra ṇi ⑩tsa/ lhag par byed pa la'ang bdun pa'o/ /gong ⑪du lhag par byed pa zhes ming 'dogs byas pa de la bdun pa 'gyur te/ yang 'grel par lung drangs pa/ dru rārnyi kāze bh+yaḥ/ ring ba dang nye ba'i don rnams las so /gong du lhag par byed pa'ang zhes 'ang gi sgra dang lung 'dren 'dis lhag par byed pa ma yin kyang thag ring ba dang nye ba'i don la'ang bdun pa 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas—/ de yang dang po gnas ⑫la lhag par gnas pa'i don la dbye ba bzhi ste/au pa bye ṣi kaḥ/ sā m+bi pi kaḥ/ bi ṣa yaḥ/ a bhi byā sngaḥ/ de rnams bod skad du nye bar 'dus pa dang / nye ba can dang / mngon par khyab pa dang /yul can dang bzhi po yin la/ gnas gzhi'i don dbye ba bzhi po de rnams la 117—279

bdun pa 'jug ste dpe rim pa bzhin/ dang po nye bar 'dus pa ste brten pa de la dngos su reg pa yin la/ de la bdun pa 'jug pa'i dpe ni/ ka ṭi āste/—rtswa lhas la bsdad/ nye ba can/ na byā ①mā ste/—chu la gnas te chu dang nye bar gnas pa'i don/ mngon par khyab pa la/ ti le 6 ste lo/snyetil 'bru rnams la nyil mar/ yul can la/ z-i dze+edi brad+mā mṛ taspa re/snyesnying la tshangs pa mchog gi bdud rtsi'o/ /nye ba dang ring ba'i dpe ni/ ba na gya dru re—/ snyenags dang ring ba la/ ba na myurnyi ke/snyenags dang nye ba la/ 'grel par/ k+ta'i rkyen can dang sbyor ba la gnyis pa'i don la bdun pa yang na'o zhes bshad pas/ a dhī tī byā ka ra ṇi/—brda sprod klog par byed/ yang 'grel par lung drangs pa/ sā dh+wa sā dhu pra yo ge tsarka/ legs pa ①po dang legs pa po ma yin pa rab tu sbyor ba la yang ngo /legs pa po zhes pa sdig pa dang bral ba'i ming yin la/ de dang sbyor ba la bdun pa 'gyur zhing sdig bral ma yin pa dang sbyor ba la yang bdun pa yang na 'gyur te/sā dhuḥkṛk+ṣiṃ mā ta ri/snyelegs pa nag po'i ma/ a sā byuḥkṛsgo mi legs pa nag po'i zhang po/ mā tu le/yang 'grel par/ dgos pa las byung ba'i las la sbyor ba la bdun pa 'gyur bar bshad cing dper brjod tshigs bcad du byung ba ni/ tsarma ṇi dri pi rna harnyi dan+ta yortarnyi kuñja re/rkopags pa'i phyir du stag gsod do/ /mche ba dag la glang chen gsod/ /bā le 6 tsa mā rjorī hin+ta sesdi puṣ+ka la kā ha taḥ/—rnga ma rnams la g.yag rnams gsod/ /gla rtsi'i ched du dri ldan gsod/ /zhes pa lta bu ste/ tsarma ṇi/ dan+ta yoḥ/ bā le 6/ sisdi/ zhes/ ji ⑤os/ supa ji rnams sbyin pa'i rjes 'byung ba lta bu'o/ /ya su bhā be rjon bhā ba lak+ṣa r+ṇa/ dngos po gang gi dngos po'i mtshan nyid la'o/ /gang gi bya ba dang bya dze+eba'i dngos po'i mtshan nyid la bdun pa 'gyur te/ go 6 du khya mā ṣ+pe 6 ga taḥ/snyeb rnams 'jo ba la song /117—280

a rnyi rī shwa re/ a dhi dbang phyug la'o/ /a dhi sbyor ba dbang phyug gi don brjod pa can la las rab tu brjod pa zhes ming 'dogs byed do/ /yasmra da bye ke ya sru tse shwa ra ba tsa rna ta tra sap+ta m+bi/ gang las a dhi gang gi dbang phyug brjod pa de la bdun pa'o—/ /gang las a dhi sbyor ba gang gi'ang dbang phyug gi don brjod pa las rab tu brjod pa zhes ming 'dogs byas pa de la bdun pa 'gyur te/ a dhi bhu bi rā maḥske/ snyesa'i dbang phyug dga' byed/ ṣajotsā nā da re/ ma gus pa la drug pa yang na'o/ /gang gi bya ba'i bar gyi rtags de las ma gus pa brjod pa la drug pa dang bdun pa'ang ngo / /ru da ti pā shā jo ta/snyenguzhingasong/rkoru da taḥmā shā dzī ta/ swā rmā shwa rā dhi pa ti dā yā da ①sāk+ṣi pra ti byu pra sru taibyu/ swā m+bi yī shwa ra a bye pa ti dā yā da/ sāk+ṣi/ pra ti bhū pra snesru ta rnams kyi'ang ngo / /swā rmā la sogs pa 'di rnams dang sbyor ba'i rtags la drug pa dang bdun pa yang na ba ste/ dharma swā m+bi/snyechosakyi rje/ dharma mya swā m+bi—/ snyechosakyi rje/ dha na sī shwa raḥ/snyenoragyi dbang phyug/snyedha na su yī shwa raḥ/ de she a rnyi pa tiḥ/snyeyulagyibadag po/—de sha su a dhi pa ti/ sgo ge dā yā da/ sgo ga gya dā yā da/snyelongs spyod bgo skal/ dha ṣ+pe sāblu/snyenoragyi dbang po/snyed sken su sāk+shi/ dha ṣ+pe pra nyi bhū/snyenoragyi gnya' bo/—dha na su pra ti byu/ ga baṃ pra sru ta/—b.lang gi be'u/—go 6 pra sru ta/ ā yuk+ta ku sha lā hūṃ ④bā se bā lnga/ ā yuk+ta ku sha la dag gi mchod pa la yang na'o/ /ā duyuk+ta dang ku sha la dag gi mchod pa'i don brjod pa dang / sbyor ba la drug pa dang bdun pa yang na ste/ ā yuk+taḥha ri byu dza ṣ+pe/—'phrog byed la mchod pa kun du sbyor bar byed/snye.ā yuk+taḥha ri pū dza na su/ ku sha laḥha ri pū dza ṣ+pe/snye'aphrog byed la dge bar mchod par byed/ ku sha laḥha ri pū dza na su/ ya ta: nidz+nyā ra hūṃ/ gang las kyang nges par bkar ba rnams kyi'o/ /rigs dang yon tan dang bya ba la sogs pa'i sgo 117—281

nas gzhan las nges par bkar ba ste nges par bzung ba'i don la drug pa dang bdun pa rnams 'gyur te/ dṛ hūṃ dī dzaḥgreṣ+ṭha/—mi rnams kyi gnyis skyes mchog/snye1 6 dwo dzaḥgreṣ+ṭhaḥ| —mi rnams la gnyis skyes mchog/ ga r+pā kṛ: goḥb hu khye rā/snyeb lang rnams kyi ba nag mo 'o ma mang / go 6 (1: gau①ཿba hu k+ṣi rā/—ba lang rnams la ba nag mo 'o ma mang / 'a nga 'a gre' par dper brjod tshigs bcad du byung ba ni/ pu ru ṣā hūṃ k+ṣakhyuyaḥ/—skyes bu rnams kyi rgyal rigs dpa'/ shu raḥbyā mā nā rī hūṃ dar+ṣa tī yā/snyebud med rnams kyi sngo bsangs mjos/ gats+tsha tsā jo ban+ta shī gh+raḥ/snye'agro ba rnams kyi rgyug pa masgogs/ dharma shī tā rmā shrad+dhā gāḥ/snyechos dkar rnams kyi dad pa mchog /de rnams drug pa'i ām dang / yang na bdun pa'i sub sbyar bas/ pu ru ṣe 6 k+ṣadh+ri yaḥ/snyeskyes bu rnams la rgyal rigs dpal/ /shu rā②ཿshā mā nā rī ①6 dar+ṣa bhā yā/snyebud med rnams la sngo bsangs mdzes/ /ga::rlu dh+wa ban+ta // gh+raḥ/—'gro ba rnams la rgyug pa mgyogs/ /dharma lnga/ te 6 shrad+dhāgāḥ/— chos dkar rnams la dad pa mchog /④zhes pa tshig rkang dang po rigs las dkar ⑤ba/ gnyis pa yon tan/ gsum pa dang bzhi pas bya ba ston pa'o/ /pañca sbo bi bhaste/ rnam par gus pa la lnga pa'o/ /rnam par gus pa ste dad pa phul du byung ba gzhan las bkar ba'i don la rnam dbye lnga pa 'gyur te/ u dī tsā dāk+ṣi ṇa bye bh+yaḥsu gro tri yāḥ/—lho pa dang byang pa dag shin tu gus/ sā dhu ni pu ṇ+ḍaṭ+wā sgyu martse yī sap+ta mya pra teḥ/ pra ti med pa'i mchod pa'i don la sā dhu ni pu ṇa dag gi bdun pa'o—/ /nye dhibasgyur pra ti sngon na med pa'i sā dhu/ ni pu ṇa dag mchod pa'i don du sbyor ba'i rtags la bdun pa 'gyur te/ mā ta ri sā byuḥ/—ma mchod pa rig bral/mā ta ri ni pu ṇaḥ/—mamachod pa slar/ pra ti sbyar ba la/ sā dhuḥmā ⑦ta re pra ti/snyelegs po ma la so sor/ yang 'grel par pra ti med pa la'ang gnyis pa yang na 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ sā dhuḥ.a nu mā ta re/—legs pom la rjes su/ pra si tokhru kā rgyu khru tī yātsa/117—282

pra si ta dang 45 ka dag gi gsum pa yang na'o/ /pra si ta ①dang 〈tha ka dag gi sbyor ba la/ bdun pa 'gyur zhing gsum pa'ang 'gyur te/ pra si to ha ri ṇa/pra si to ha ro/ ut+pa ko ha ri shā/ ut+pa ko ha ro/ nak+ṣa tre tsa lu pi/ skar ma la'ang mi mthong ba la'o/ /skar ma las mi mthong ba'i don sbyor ba la gsum pa dang bdun pa yang na ste/ pu bye ṇa ②gats+tshata/snyergyalasong/ pubyegats+tsha ta/snyergyal song / mi mthong ba'i don ①ma yin na gsum pa mi 'gyur te/ pu bye sha ṣ+peḥ/—rgyal dang spen pa/ yang 'grel par lung drangs pa/ a karma jo tu bhi⑦ཿyo ge de sha kā lā dh+wa bhā be bh+yaḥdwo tī yā ⑤bā/ byings las med pa rnams kyi sbyor ba la yul du sa lam dngos po rnams las gnyis pa yang na'o/ /byengs las med pa rnams kyi sbyor ba la'ang yul sogs kyi sgra la bdun pa 'gyur zhing gnyis pa'ang ngo / /de yang yul la—/ na bye ba sa ti/snyechulaganas/snyesmi rda pa dus ti/ dus la/ rā tro she te/—namal nyal/—rā tre she ta/ lam la/ kro shaṃ pa sa ti/snyergyangagrags la gnas/snyekro she ba sa ti/dngos po la/ yā gi nyiṣ+ṭha ti⑦/snyemachodasbyin la gnas/snyeyā ge tiṣ+ṭha ti/ i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa su sru tād+ku ra kā ni sa māṭ+wāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las byed pa can rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin zis su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las/ byed pa can te rnam dbye rnams kyi 'jug tshul zhib mor ston pa las spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //117—283

da ni tshig sdud kyi rnam gzhag 'chad par bya ste/ sa marbaḥpa da bi ①dhiḥ/don sdud pa tshig ②gi cho ga'o/ /tshig ①gnyis sam mang po don gcig tu sdud pa'i cho ga ston par byed pa ni tshig sdud kyi cho ga'o/ /sa mā sabya tusgro/ tshig sdud bzhi'o/ /ka ⑦lā pa/ tsan+d+ra pa/ dbyangs can ma sogs su bsdu ba'i grangs drug tu bzhed kyang gzhung 'dir phyogs gnyis pa dang las 'dzin pa'i bsdu ba gnyis de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba'i ⑤nang du bsdus te spyir btang bsdu ba'i grangs bzhi yod par bzhed la/ bzhi po ci zhe na/ mi zad pa'i bsdu ba/ de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba/ 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba/ zlas dbye'i dubasdu ba dang bzhi'o/ /de yang bsdu ba byas pa'i tshig gnyis las/ tshig snga ma brjod bya'i gtso bor gyur pa mi zad pa'i bsdu ba/ tshig phyi ma gtso bor gyur pa de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba/dngos su brjod pa gnyis po de dang 'grel pa'i don gzhan gtso bor brjod pa 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba/ tshig gnyis ka gtso bor gyur pa zlas dbye'i bsdu ba rnams so/ /a bya yi ⑦bi bhat+ta sa m+bi pa sa mṛdhi thrasgyeṭ+wā bhā bā t+ya yā saṃ pra ti/shaja pā dubhā ba partswa r+ya thā nu pūrgya yo ga pa r+ya sā dṛ sh+ya saṃ pabhi sā ka khye ta ba tsa ṣ+pe skegu—/ mi zad pa rnam dbye dang nye ba dang / 'grub pa dang / 'phel ba dang /dngos med kyi don dang / 'das pa dang / dus ma yin pa dang / sgra rab tu gsal ba dang / rjes su ji lta ba dang / snga ma'i phyi ma dang / cig car dang / mnyam pa dang / phun sum tshogs pa dang / mtha' dag dang /mtha'i tshig rnams la'o/ /mi zad pa sogs don de rnams supa dang supa don gcig pa'i tshig sdud can du 'gyur te de rnams kyang mi zad pa'i bsdu ba'i ming can du 'gyur ro/ /'grel par/ tshig mang po tshig gcig tu sbyor ba dang /117—284

atsa du ma atsa gcig tu sbyor ba dang / rnam dbye'i mtha' can mang po rnam dbye gcig tu sbyar bas/ sngar tshig mang ba dang brjod pa ma bde ba rnams tshig nyung zhing brjod pa bde bar 'gyur ba ni tshig sdud kyi dgos pa'o zhes bshad do/ /de rnams las dang po mi zad pa'i bsdu ba bshad par bya ste/ ha ro a bye kṛ t+ya/snye'aphrog byed bya ba lhag por/ zhes pa tshig sbyor ram ngag ces bya ste tshig sdud byed pa'i gzhi yin no/ /pra tha mā nidriṣ+ṭi sa mā sa u pa sardza dz+wa/ dang po nges par sbyor ba'i tshig sdud nyer bsgyur ro/ /rnam dbye dang po dang sbyor ba'i bsdu ba byed pa'i yul rnam dbye dang po thob pa de la nyer bsgyur zhes ming 'dogs byed do/ /u pa sardza rna pūbaṃ/ nyer bsgyur sngon du'o/ /tshig sdud ①kyi skabs 'dir gong du nyer bsgyur zhes ming 'dogs byas pa de tshig sbyor gyi skabs mtha' dbus gang na yod kyang sngon du sbyor bar byed pas/ a dhi ha ro kṛ t+ya/ zhes gnas pa 'di la mā ti pa di ka zhes ming 'dogs byed do/ /su po dh+wa tu mā ti pa di ka yoḥ/byings mā ti pa di ka dag las supa kyi'o/ /byings dang sbyor ba dang tshig sdud kyi skabs mā ti pa di ka zhes ming 'dogs byas pa bsdu bya der gnas pa'i rnam dbye rnams dbyi zhing der ma zad gzhi dang / phrad dang / khyad par dang 'dra ba'i skad dod sogs tshig gi rjes 'brang rnams kyang dbyi bas ha ri la sbyin pa'i ji dang kṛ t+ya phyis/ a dhi ha ri/ de ltar rnam dbye rjes 'brang dang bcas pa phyis pas tshig sdud kyi ming thogs pa de la be+er tshig tu sgrub byed kyi rnam dbye rnams 'jug pa las mtshon byed su byen/ a rnyi ha ri su/ a bya yī bhā babyu/ mi zad par gyur pa la'ang ngo / /mi zad par gyur pa ste mi zad pa sngon na yod pa mi zad pa'i bsdu ba byas pa de la rnam dbye thams cad 'jig cing bya ba yang med 117—285

pas su phyis/ de'i rjes su don ston pa'i tshig gzhan sbyor dgos te/ a dhi ha ri pra thraṭ+wā ka thā/snyelhag par rab tu 'phel ba'i brjod pa 'phrog byed/ de bzhin du/ rā ya ma ti krān+ta—/ rkochos 'byor pa dang ldan pa/ rnam dbye rjes 'brang dang bcas pa phyis/ a ti ri/zhes pa la/ mi zad pa'i bsdu ba'i mtha' ma ning du 'gyur zhing / ma ning la thung ngur 'gyur bas/ a ti ri/snye'abyoraldan/ de bzhin du/ nā ba ma ti krān+ta la/—gru shin tu non pa/ ati nu/snyegrunubal khad/ de ①rnams mi zad pa'o/ /'grel par/ don tshang zhing brjod bde na gong du bshad pa ltar tshig sdud kyi bya ba 'jug la don mi ston cing brjod pa mi bde na tshig sdud kyi cho ga rnams mi 'jug ste/ dper na/sarnyi gu shāḥha ro/snye'aphrog byed la yon tan rnams yod/ zhes pa lta bu la tshig sdud kyi bya ba mi 'jug go/ /nye ba la/ kṛṇ+ḍa gya u pa/—nagapo'inye ba/ zhes pa la/ u pa kṛṇ+ḍa su/nā bya yī bhā bā da to masto pañca myuḥ/ mi zad par gyur pa las ata la ma yin zhing lnga pa ma yin pa'i ama'o/ /spyir btang mi zad pa'i bsdu ba'i mtha' las rnam dbye thams cad 'jig par bshad kyang dmigs bsal mi zad par gyur pa las kyang a yig mtha' can la rnam dbye rnams mi 'jig cing rnam dbye lnga pa rnams ma gtogs rnam dbye thams cad am du 'gyur te/ su am/ u pa kṛṣ+ṭi/—nag ponye ba/ lnga pa la/ u pa kṛ: ta snyenagaponye ba las/ sogs so/ /dṛ tī yā sap+ta myorba hu lo—/ gsum pa bdun pa dag yang na'o/ /gong du mi zad par gyur pa'i a yig mtha' la rnam dbye lnga pa ma gtogs rnam dbye lhag thams cad am du 'gyur bar bshad kyang / mdo 'dis rnam dbye gsum pa dang bdun pa dag am du 'gyur ba dang spyir btang a thung mtha' can gyi bya ba gnyis ka 'jug pas 'dam ka can du bya ste/ gsum pa la/ u pa kṛṣ+ṭi na/—nye bar nag po yis/snye.u pakṛṣ+ṭi/117—286

lo yis spyor ba bcas pa/ zhes pa la rnam dbye gsum pa'i rjes bsdus/ yu ga pa bye nyi'i don sa ha sngon/ sa ha tsakra su/ zhes gnas pa la/ a pya yī bhā be tsā kā le/ mi zad par gyur pa la'ang dus ma yin pa la'o/ /mi zad par gyur pa'i bsdu ba las kyang dus kyi sgra sbyor ba ma yin pa la sa ha ni sa zhes par 'gyur te/sa tsakre/snye'akhoralo dang bcas pa/ mnyam pa la/ ha reḥsā dṛ sh+yi/snye'aphrog byed 'dra ba/ zhes pa la gong bzhin rnam dbye bsdus/ sā dṛ sh+ya'i don sa sngon su 'jig /sa ha ri—/ snye'aphrogabyed 'dra ba/ phun sum tshogs pa la/ k+ṣa tā ṇ+ḍi saṃ pa ti/—gdugs kyi bdag po/zhes pa la rnam dbye bsdus sam pa ti zhes pa'i don la sa sngon/ sak+ṣa tram̐/—gdugs bcas/ mtha' dag la/ tro ṇi nas ka lo ati/—rtswa mtha' dag za bar byed/ zhes pa la gong bzhin rnam dbye rnams bsdus/ saka la'i don āng sngon/ ā tri ṇi ati/—rtswa kun za bar byed/ mtha'i tshig la/ asdi gran+d+ra parja tai a dhī te/—me'i pu nyi'i mtha' klog par byed/ zhes pa la rnam dbye bsdus gran+d+ra pa.oṃ ta'i don sa sngon/ sāldi a dhi te/—me'i pu ti mtha' klog par byed/ zhes pa lta bu rnams so/ /ya thā sā dṛ bye/ ya thā'i mnyam pa ma yin pa la'o/ /ya thā'i sgra mnyam pa'i don brjod pa ma yin na supa dang supa don gcig par 'gyur te/ shat+ta ma na ti kra mya ka ro ti/—nus pa dang ci 'tsham par rim pas gyis shig /zhes pa la rnam dbye rjes 'brang dang bcas pa phyis/ a na ti zhes pa'i don mi bad ①pa ya thā sngon/ ya thā shat+ta/—nus pa ji lta ba/ mnyam pa'i don brjod pa yin na tshig sdud kyi bya ba mi 'jug ste/ ya thā ha ri②ཿ/—ji ltar 'phrog byed/ ta thā ha raḥ/—deltar gsod byed/ yā ba da ba jo ra ṇi/ yā bta kyi logs su bkol ba la'o/ /mang po'i nang nas gcig logs su bskol ①ba'i don yod pa'i yā bta kyi sgra sbyor dhib yang mi zad pa'i bsdu bar 'gyur te/ yā ban+t+ra man+d+ra 117—288

pas / gaṅgā yā pā re/snyegaṅgā'ipharol/ zhes pa la/ gaṅgā pā ram̐/snyegaṅgā'ipharol/ de bzhin du/ gaṅgā yā ma bye/snyegaṅgā'idabus/ zhes pa la/ gaṅgā ma bye/—gaṅgā'i dbus/zhes pa lta bu'o/ /saṃ khyu baṃ bye na/ rigs kyi grangs la'o/ /rigs kyi dngos po brjod pa'i grangs kyi sgra mi zad pa'i bsdu bar yang na 'gyur te/ dwo mu bhā baṃ sh+lau/—thubapa'irigs gnyis/ yang na/ dī mu ni/snyethubapaganyis/ de bzhin du/tri mu ni byā ka ra ṇa su bi byā/—lung ston pa shes pa'i thub pa gsum/ zhes pa'am/ yang na/tri mu ni byā ka ra rde bi byā/rkolung ston pa shes pa'i thub pa gsum/ na ①dī rnyi:/ chu klung rnams kyi'ang ngo / /chu klung gi ②sgra brjod pa'i grangs kyi sgra'ang mi zad pa'i bsdu bar 'gyur te/ sabhā rmā gaṅgā rmā sa ma ha raḥ/—gaṅgā bdun pa nyal du/ zhes pa la/rnam dbye dang rjes 'brang bsdus/ sap+ta gaṅgā/—gaṅgābadun/ de bzhin du/ dwa yoḥya mu na yoḥs ma ha re①/—chu bo ya mu na gnyis lhan du/ zhesapa la/ dwo ya mu rna/—chu bo yamu na gnyis/ a n+ya pa dābe+e tsa saṃ dz+nyā yo/ tshig don gzhan la ming la'o/ /chu klung rnams kyi tshig don gzhan la supa kyi mtha' ming la mi zad pa'i bsdu bar 'gyur te/ad+mat+ta gaṅgā yasmin de she/—yul gang la gaṅgā spyon pa dang / zhes pa la/ rnam dbye tshig rjes 'brang dang bcas pa phyis/ ud+mat+ta gaṅge de she/snyeyulagaṅgā'ismyon pa/ ming min na/shrī r+ghaṃ gaṅgā dza lo be go ya gya/snyegang gi myur ba gaṅgā'i chu/ zhes pa la/ mi zad pa'i bsdu ba mi 'jug go/ /des na 'bru mang gi bsdu ba byas pas/ shī gh+ra gaṅgā de shaḥ/—myur bar gaṅgā'i yul/ a bya yī bhā be sha rata pra thra ti bh+yaḥ/ mi zad par gyur pa la sha rata sogs rnams las so/ /mi zad par gyur pa'i bsdu ba byas pa'i mtha' las sha rata sogs rnams la ṭa tsa'i durkyen sbyin par bya ste/ sha ra rda u pa/—ston la nyeb/zhes pa la/ rnam dbye gnyis pa'i rjes phyis/ u pa sngon/ u pa sha rad ces 117—291

ro zhes bshad pas/ suṭa/ ṭa gnas kyi don u brjod don sa sa dzuṣa sogs kyis sa ru/ u brjod don ata las ru'i p+lu ta ma yin pa las p+lu ta ma yin pa la 'os—/ ra u/ a las yon tan nos/ o/ eng las tshig mtha' las ata la 'os/ a phyis/ pa rophok+ṣi/——lkog gyur/ zhes pa la/ ṭatsa sogs snga ma ltar bsgrubs pas/ pa rophok+ṣ-i/ lkogagyur/ de bzhin du/ sa mak+ṣ-i/—mig legs pa/a na k+ṣe/snyerjesasumig /gnyis kyang tshig sbyor ṭatsa'i rkyen sogs snga ma rnams dang 'dra'o—/ /a na:/ an las kyang ngo / /mi zad par gyur pas basbu ba'i mtha' an mtha' la'ang ṭatsa'i rkyen sbyin par bya'o/ /nastadhi te/ de phan las na'i'o/ /de phan gyi rkyen pha rol la na mtha'i ti dbyi bar bya ste/ rā snyoḥs m+bi paṃ/ rgyal po las nye ba/ zhes pa la rnam dbye bsdus/ sa m+bi pa'i don nyer bsgyur u pa sngon/ u pa rā dzan/ an las kyang ngos/ ṭatsa bshad ma thag pa'i mdos ṭi phyis/ u pa rā dze+e/— rgyalanye/ de bzhin du/ ād+manophobye/— lhag pa'i bdag nyid/ zhes pa la'ang gong bzhin bsdu ba ṭatsa'i rkyen sbyor ba sogs byas pas/a dh+yād+me/ lhag pa'i bdag nyid/ na sum̐ sa kā da n+ya ta ra sde/ ma ning las yang na'o/ /mi zad pa'i bsdu ba byas nas ma ning gi rtags su 'gyur ba lta bu ma yin pa'i bsdu ba byed gong nas ma ning gi rtags yin pa an mtha' las mi zad pa'i bsdu ba'i mtha' las kyang ṭatsa yang na gyur te/ tsarma naḥ/ u pa zhes pa la rnam dbye bsdus/u pa sngon/ yang na ṭatsa byin nas ṭi phyis/ su am/ yang na su 'jig /ming mtha'i na phyis/ u 2pa tsarja/—pagasapa las nye ba/ u pa tsarma/ na dī por+ṇa mā snga gra hā ya d+dhā bh+yaḥ/ na dī/ por+ṇa mā se/ a gra hā ya ṇi rnams las so/ /na dī sogs 'di rnams la'ang mi zad par gyur pa'i mtha' las ṭatsa yang na 'gyur 117—293

te / na byāḥs m+bi paṃ/— chuklungalas nye ba/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye bsdus sa m+bi pa'i don u pa sngon/ yang na ṭatsa sbyar bas/ u pa na rda/ —chu klung las nye ba/ —u pa na di / de bzhin du/ por+ṇa mā sru sa m+bi paṃ/— zla ba nya gang ba'i nye ba/ zhes pa la/ /u dūpa por+ṇa mā saṃ/—zla ba nya gang ba ste bco lnga dang nye ba/ yang na/ u pa por+ṇa mā si/snyezla ba nya gang ba ste bco lnga dang nye ba/ a gra hā ya rgyuḥs m+bi paṃ/ zhes pa la/ u pā gra hā ya ṇi/——gza' 'dzin med pa'i nye ba/ yang na/ u pā gra hā ya ṇi/——gza' 'dzin med pa'i nye ba/ dzha yaḥdzha ya'i'o / /mi zad par gyur pa'i mtha' la dzhaya so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge gang yod kyang ṭatsa yang na 'gyur te/ ngas/——sa mi dhaḥs m+bi paṃ/ nyeba'iyog pa/ zhes pa la/rnam dbye phyis/ sa m+bi pa'i don u pa sngon/ ṭatsa/ yang na/ ma ning la/su am 'jig /gnas med pa la yang na 'os/ ṭatsa/— u pa sa mi sgo/——nye ba'i yog pa—/ gro pa sa mi ta/ — nye ba'i yog pa/ sngo pa sa mid/ gi rergyu se na ka su/gi ri las mchod pa'i'o/ /gi ri'i sgra mchod pa'i don dang 'brel ba'i don mi zad par gyur pa'i mtha' las ṭatsa yang na 'gyur te/ gi reḥs m+bi paṃ/— ri yi nye ba la/zhes pa la rnam dbye phyis/ u pa sngon/ ṭatsa yang na ba byas pas/ ṭatsa/snye u pa gi ram̐/ riyinyeb la/ —u pa gi ri/ de rnams kyis mi zad pa'i bsdu ba rnams bshad zin to/ /lnga/ da ni de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba bshad par bya ste/ dī ñchatī yā shri krutā tī ta pa ti ta ga tā t+yasta pābhā brjeḥ/ gnyis pa la brten pa dang / 'das pa dang /lhung ba dang / song ba dang / bden pa dang / thob pa dang / gyur pa rnams kyi'o sgo / /bsten pa sogs don de dag dang sbyor ba la rnam dbye gnyis pa'i mtha' supa dang supa don gcig pa'i de'i skyes bu'i bsdu bar 'gyur te/117—294

zhes pa la/ gsum pa'i rjes bsdus/ shaṃ ku lā khaṇ+ḍaḥ/— stares gcod/ de bzhin du/ṭā—/ d+mā t+yāzaḥ/— 'bras so ba'i don/ yon tan brjod pa ma yin na de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba mi 'jug rmyeste/ ak+ṣa ṇ+ḍa kā ṇaḥ/ migazhar ba/ zhes pa lta bu la gsum pa'i rjes mi dbyi'o / /pūrba sa dṛ byesha sa mo nāza ka la ha ni pu ṇa mi shra shrabyāḥ/ pūrba sa dṛ sha sa ma don ngan pa kal ha ni pu ṇa mi shra shra kyā rnams kyi'o/ /pūrba sogs dang spyor ba gsum pa'i mtha' don gcig par 'gyur te/ mā se na pūrbaḥ/ zhes pa la rnam dbye bsdus/ mā sa pūrbaḥ/ —zlabs sngon ma/ de bzhin du/ ṭā/——kṛdzhas dṛ sa/ཿ / nag pos mtshungs pa/ ṭā/— 6) ma/ sa che/ཿ/snyedaga' byed kyis 'dra ba/ ṭā/ —sdo/ zurgya nyi zugaḥ / —bsod nams kyis dman pa/ ṭā/ can—— ma/ 'a/ thamaḥ/ mtshon gyis 'khrugs/ ṭā/— ste/chag :she sdo/ ṇaḥ / —bstan bcos mkhas pa/ ṭā/— sdog1/ :she 11ཿ/ 'omasabasres/ ṭā/— zug kyang cad tsho/11ཿ/ mig legs pa/ 'grel par/ a ba ra dang sbyor ba'ang gsum pa'i mtha' don gcig par 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ ṭā/ mā sā ④ba raḥ/——zlabasagazhan/ kadṛ ka ra ṇi kṛ tā ba hu lo/ byed pa byed po dag la kṛta kyi mang po'o/ /byed pa dang byed po'i don gyi gsum pa'i mtha' kṛta sogs kyi rkyen can dang sbyor ba la ba hu lo zhes pa don gsum la 'jug pas don gcig pa de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba 'gyur ba dang mi 'gyur ba yang na ba sogs mang po 'byung ste/ dper na tshig sdud kyi bya ba 'jug pa / ha ri zla tā taḥ/ —'phrog byed kyis bsrung / zhes pa la gsum pa'i rjes phyis/ha ri tā taḥ/ —'phrog byed kyis bsrung bye/ de bzhin du/ na khiḥbin+da'uḥ/ sen mos bsral/zhes pa la/ na kha bhen+daḥ/ —sen mos bsral/ tshig sdud kyi cho ga mi 'jug pa/ bhik+ṣa bhiḥ.u hi taḥ/ bslangasapas ltogs/ zhes pa lta bu rnam dbye mi dbyi'o/ /de bzhin du/dā tre ṇa khru na bān/ zorabs rnga/ khame+eḥtshe na bān/ —griyisabacad/ sogs so/ /kṛta ④117—296

s+t+ya ra dhi kārba pa tsa ṣ+pe/ kṛta rnams kyis lhag pa'i don brjod pa la'o/ /kṛta sogs rnams kyi rkyen yod pa gsum pa'i mtha' don lhag po brjod pa can ni supa dang supa don gcig pa de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba 'jug ste/ kā kaiḥpe rkyayā na dī—/ snyebya rog rnams kyis chu 'thung / zhes pa la/ rnam dbye bsdus/ kā ka pe yā na dī(rngu—/ snyebyarog chu 'thung / de bzhin du/ bā྾ na tshe byā ni/ khayis brdas/ zhes pa'ang rnam dbye bsdus don gsal bar byed pa'i tshig grogs tro snoṇa sbyar bas/ bāt+pa tshe bye dṛ ṇa ni/snyertswa rnams kha yis brngas/ arje na byañja rnapya/ zas kyis bya na la'o/ /zas kyis bya na brjod pa la gsum pa'i mtha' don gcig par 'gyur te/ k+ṣi re ṇa sik+ta o chod naḥ/ 'o mdang zan sbyor/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye dang rjes 'brang phyis/ k+ṣi ro da naḥ / 'omadang zan/ bhak+ṣe ṇa mi byeshrī ka ra ṇi/ zas kyis sre ba'i byed pa la'o/ /zas sre ba'i byed pa sbyor ba la gsum pa'i mtha' don gcig par 'gyur te/ gu tso ḍi na mi shāḥd+mā nāḥ/——bu ram dang yos bsres/ zhes pa la/ gu choḍa ṅgā nāḥ/ bu ram dang yos/tsa tudhī tā daṭ+wārba ba li hi ta su kha rak+ṣi taiḥ/ de'i don dang ba li hi ta su kha rak+ṣi ta rnams kyi bzhi pa'o/ /de'i don zhes don bzang po brjod pa dang / ba li sogs sbyor ba la'ang bzhi pa'i mtha' supa dang supa don gcig pa de'i skyes bu'i bsdu bar 'gyur te/ yu pā ya dā rubye/ kaba'iched kyi shing / rnam dbye bsdus/ yu pa dā ru/— kaba'iched kyi shing / 'grel par/ skabs 'gar de'i don yin kyang rnam dbye mi sdud pa yang yod do zhes bshad pas/ ram̐ dha nā yasbyil/——tshong pa'i phyir gyi sgod/zhes pa lta bu rnam dbye mi dbyi'o/ /ba la ⑪ dang sbyor ba la/ khyu tā ya ba liḥ/——'byung po'i tshed kyi gtor ma/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye bsdus/ khyu ta ba liḥ/ —'byung po'i gtor ma / de bzhin du/ ngesnyen ra su khaḥ/——milabade ba/ nge —go rak+ṣi taḥ/—ba lang la bsrung 117—297

ba—/ nge go nyi tai/ ba lang la phan yipa/ pañca m+bi bha ye na/ 'jigs pas lnga pa'o/ /'jigs pa'i rgyu'i don brjod pa'i sbyor ba la lnga pa'i mtha' ⑤don gcig par 'gyur te/ tso rāta bha yi/snyechom rkun las 'jigs/ zhes pa la rnam dbye lnga pa'i rjes bsdus / tso ra bha yi/ —chomarkun las 'jigs/ de bzhin du/ nga si —bṛ ka bhi taḥ/snyespyang ki las skrag/ nga si —thra ka bhi tizhuḥ —spyangaṅka las skrag/— dṛ ka bhiḥ/ —ngasi/ a pe tā po bhā muk+ta pa ti tā krupa tra ste ralpa shaḥ/ a pe ta a po bye muk+ta pa ti ta a patrasta rnams kyi chung ngu la'o/ /a pe tre ta sogs tshegs chung ngu brjod pa can dang sbyor ba la lnga pa'i khumatha' don gcig par 'gyur te/ su khā da pe taḥ/ —bde ba las sbyor / zhes pa la/ lnga pa'i rjes bsdus/ su khā spru pe taḥ/ bdebaspyor/ de bzhin sdo / nga si ma/lnga/ nges zwaḥ/— stobs dang mnyam/ nga si tha lnga/ dza/shā ཿ/ —'khor lo las grol/ nga si sa/ ga pa ti haḥ/ bde 'gro las lhung / ta ram̐ gā pa trastaḥ/ rba rlabs la skrag/ sto kārnyi ka spudru rārba kṛ zwa ṇi ste na/ sto ka arnyi ka ring ba'i don kṛ tshu rnams k+ta'i'o/ /k+ta'i rkyen can sto ka dang / arnyi ka dang ring ba'i don rnams dang / kṛ dz+ra rnams k+ta'i rkyen can dang spyor ba la lnga pa'i mtha' mi dbyi zhing rang sar gnas kyang de dag la mi dbye ba'i tshig sdud ces zer ro/ /sto kārluk+taḥ/— cung zad grol/ a sprarluk+taḥ/ cung zad las grol/ yi dhi na/rluk+taḥ/ nye ba las grol/ dru rārluk+taḥ/— ring ba las grol/ tre/ rta rje/k+taḥ/— sdug bsngal las grol/ zhes pa rnams lnga pa'i rjes ma phyis pa'o/ /ṣaṭ+wā/ drug pa'o/ /rnam dbye drug pa'i mtha' yang supa mtha' dang supa mtha' don gcig par 'gyur te / rā p+taḥpu ru ṣaḥ/ rgyal po'i skyes bu ste rgyal po'i mi sna/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye phyis/rā dzan du log /ming mtha'i na dbyi 'os/ na phyis/ rā dza pu ru ṣaḥ/—rgyal po'i skyes bu/ 'grel par/ kṛta sogs kyi rkyen mtha' can dang sbyor ba las mtshan 117—298

nyid brjod pa la drug pa'i mtha' don gcig par 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/byā sa gya kṛ tiḥ/ —rgyasapar byas/ zhes pa la drug pa'i rjes basbus byā 1 sa kṛ tiḥ/ de bzhin du/ bhā ra ta shra ba rte /— bhā ra ta la sa thos pa/ byed/ yā dza kā di bhibya/ yā dza ka sogs rnams kyi'o/ /yā dza ka sogs dang sbyor ba la'ang drug pa'i mtha' supa dang supa don gcig par 'gyur te/ dī dza gya yā dza kaḥ/ gnyis skyes kyi ma chod sbyin/zhes pa la rnam dbye phyis/ dī dza yā dza kaḥ/ gnyis skyes kyi ma chod sbyin/ de bzhin du/ngas —dī jo ༷/ ja kaḥ/ gnyis skyes kyi ma/chod nga// ngas dī ja stu ta kaḥ/ gnyis skyes khrus byed/ dī dzā rgya pa kaḥ/ ngas gnyis skyes rngog pa/ra byed/ngas dī ja dwat+ta kaḥ/ gnyis skyes byus pa byed/ ngas dī dza ho tre — kaḥ/— gnyis skyes sbyin sreg byed/ 'grel par lung drangs pa/ gra ha/ ra tha/patrī / rnams ga ṇa ka dang sbyor ba yang don gcig par 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/gra ha ga ṇa kaḥ/ gza'i grangs/ ra tha ga ṇa kaḥ/ thingarta'i grangs/ patrī ga ṇa kaḥ/ 1nga ba'i grangs —/ na nid+dhā ra ṇi/ nges par bkar ba la ma yin no/ /gang la nges par bkar ba'i don gyi drug pa'i mtha' don gcig par 'gyur ba ma yin te/ dṛ rde dz+wa dzaḥgreṣ+ṭhaḥ/ mi rnams kyi gnyis skyes ma/chog /zhes pa lta bu rnam dbye mi dbyi'o/ /pū ra ṇa gu ṇa su hi tārja sa da bya ya ta bya sa mā nā bye ka ra be+e na/ gang ba dang yon tan dang shin tu phan pa'i don dang bde ba dang mi zad pa ta bya rnams mnyam pa'i lhag par byed pa'i'o/ /sdogs pa la sogs pa'i don de rnams dang mi zad pa dang sbyor ba dang / ta bya kyi rkyen can dang spyor ba dang / mnyam pa'i lhag par byed pa'i don sbyor ba yang drug pa'i mtha' don gcig par mi 'gyur te/rdzogs pa la/ sa tī ṣaṣ+ṭhaḥ/ bdenapa drug /yon tan la/ gu ṇa gya pa tram̐/ yon tan gyi snod de mkhas pa/ yang 'grel par/ yon tan rgyun du rtags pa'i don la drug pa'i 117—299

mtha' don gcig par 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ ngas tsan+da na gan+dhaḥ/ tsan dan gyi dri / zhes pa lta bu don gcig par 'gyur ro/ /shin tu phan pa'i don la/ shin tu phan nga rnams kyi tshim/ su hi tā rmā tredzhaiḥ/ pha 'a/ rmā z-ibheḥ/ 'bras bu rnam/sa kyis —1tshim / bden pa 'ab/ dī ja su/ kurba ṇaḥ/ gnyis skyes kyis byas/ sa tsā ṭa/rba ṇaḥ/ bden pa rnams kyis byas/mi zad pa la/ sa tsā kṛ tā/ bden pa/ rnams kyis byas nas/ ta byam la/ sa hūṃ karta ju/— / bden nga/ rnam/sa kyi byed/ yang 'grel par/ ta bya gyi rkyen can dang sbyor ba las kyang skabs 'gar don gcig par yang 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ ngas dī dza karta bye/ —gnyis skyes kyi byed/ mnyam pa'i lhag par byed pa'i don la/ rā rnyophon la sum̐ / rgyal ngo/'i le 'o med / ste na tsa pū dzā dze+e/ k+ta'i yang mchod pa la'o/ /k+ta'i rkyen can yang mchod pa'i don sbyor ba la drug pa'i mtha' don gcig par mi 'gyur te/ rā dz+nyā ma to budhaḥpū 4zirdo taḥ/ rgyal ngo/ rnam sa kyi 'u gas sa ngas rgyas mchod/ karma ṇi tsa/ las la'ang ngo /las kyi don gnyis yod pa dang spyor ba la drug pa'i mtha' don gcig par 'gyur ba ma yin te/ tsā ra ya ti ga r+pā do ho go pe na/ phyugs rdzis ba lang rnams 'jo zhing 'tsho bar byed/tro dza kā rgyu karta ri/ trotsa a ka dag las byed pa la'o/ /byed pa'i don gyi rkyen tre tsa a ka dag sbyar ba'i rtags las drug pa'i mtha' don gcig par mi 'gyur te/bha ba taḥshrī mān/ spyodakyi dang/la ldan/ pa tsa ka su tsa tu raḥ/ 'tshod pa/'i grung po/ yang 'grel par bdag gi sgra sbyor ba la tro tsa mtha' can yin kyang tshig sdud kyi bya ba 'jug go zhes bshad pas/ ju baḥbhartaḥl/ tritsa/ bhū bhartaḥ/ —sa'ibadag ngo// ni bye shrī ḍā dz+re mu bi ka yoḥ/ rtag tu rtsed mo 'tsho ba dag las so/ /rtsed mo dang 'tsho ba'i don brjod pa can dang spyor ba la drug pa'i mtha' rtag tu don gcig par 'gyur te/rtsed mo la/ ubyā/ me tog ji do shal bcang / la/ ka put+pa sgo dzi kaḥ ngas/ 'tsho ba'i don 717—300

'gyur te/ kām+bi bye sidhaḥ/ zhes pa la/ kām+bi l+ya sedha ཿ/ yu la kām+bi lnga la grub thob/ de babyu/na du/ sto/ ta pa shusko ཿ/ tshabs bskam/sa/ skṛ ta pa kwaḥ/ maral btsos/ ni ga /ri brnyaḥ / lcags sgrog gis bcings/ ku ga ti pā sna da yabya/ ku ga ti pra la sogs pa rnams kyang ngo / /ku'i sgra rtags gzhan dang sbyor ba dang / ga ti'i ming can rnams dang pra la sogs pa rnams bya ba'i don can dang spyor ba rnams supa dang supa don gcig pa 3 de'i skyes bu'i bsdu bar 'gyur zhing yang gi sgras dman pa dang nyung ngu'i don la ku'i sgra kata dang ka ba dang kā rnams su yang 'gyur te/ ku྾ taḥpu ru ṣaḥ/ skyesabungan pa/ zhes pa la rnam dbye bsnyus kuh+phi ta'i don ku sngon/ ku pu ru ṣaḥ/ skyesabungan nga// de babyu/na du/ ku bi praḥ/ bram ze ngan pa / ku la ba rde/ tshwa ngan pa 'am nyung ngu'am/ lhad can/ na/ 'a/ ba rde/ tshwa ngan nga 'am/ nyung ngu'am/ lha da can/ karja ba rde/ tshwa ngan pa/'am/ nyung ngu 'am lhad can/ ka ba 'a ba ṇi/ tshwa ngan pa 'am nyung ngu 'am/ lhad can/ ka duṣ+ṭi/ drod chung ngu /bo/ ṣ+ṭi/ drod chung ngu / ka boṣ+ṭi/ drod chung ngu / kwa.oṃ/ zas ngan/ ka da.oṃ/ zas nyung ngu'am/ ngan nga /kā.oṃ / zas nyung ngu'am/ ngan nga / ka bā.oṃ/ zas nyung ngu'am ngan pa / usmye di rtswa ḍā tsa:/ khru rī sogs dang rtswa ḍā tsa rnams kyang ngo / /u rī sogs dang rkyen rtswa dang ḍātsa gnyis kyi mtha' can rnams la ga ti'i ming can zhes brda chad byed de gong du ku ga ti pra la sogs pa rnams kyang ngo zhes pa'i don du ming 'dogs byas te/ dper brjod ni/ am lnga/ rī kṛ t+ya su/ semasapa/ra bya ba/ am/ sngo/ ra rī kṛ t+ya su/ sems par byu/ ba/ phyagachab phyag sku'i spro/ /pho ṭa// brgyan pa ra bya/ am phyagan+taḥspro/ tai sdo// bar mtshams byas /ngas — ma naskṛ tai/ —sems kyi byas/ ji pu raskṛ 5 tai/ sngo na du byas/ ma / ti raskṛ tai/ mi snang bar byas/de rnams ga ti'i ming can dang rtswa'i mtha' la/ ngas shul+lī kṛ t+ya/ da7ra ngo ra byas/ ḍā tsa la snyesu kha la ḍā tsa/ bde bar byas su khā kṛ tai/— tsu ṭu sogs kyis tsa phyis/ ḍā 'gro ba la ṭi phyis/ de'i 117—303

nyung ngu'i don dang sngon par khyab zu7pa'i don dag brjod pa na supa dang supa don gcig par 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ i ṣata ba sgo/—cungazad 'ching / zhesapa'i don la/ ā ba sgo/——cungazad 'ching / de bzhin du/ a bhi byasteḥn ga raḥ/ mngon par khyab pa'i grong / zhes pa'i don la/ ā na ga raḥ/ yang 'grel par lung drangs pa / a kyā da yaḥkrād+dhā r+yaze dri tī yā ya/ a ti sogs rnams khyab pa sogs kyi don la gnyis pa'i'o/ /a ti la sogs pa rnams khyab pa sogs kyi don brjod pa la gnyis pa'i mtha' don gcig par 'gyur te/ a ti krāsgo mā dze+e/ shin tu khyab pa'i phreng ba/zhes pa la rnam dbye rjes 'brang dang bcas pa phyis/ a ti mā khā su/ e ka bi bhalti tsā rngu/ pūrba ni pā tekhya / rnam dbye gcig la'ang snga ma ma yin pa'i nges tshig la'o//nges pa'i tshig rnam dbye gcig tu sdud pa'i cho ga tshig sbyor gyi skabs kyi tshig gnyis bzhag pa'i snga ma ma yin pa'i tshig phyi ma de la u pa sardza zhes ming 'dogs byed do//goste yo ru pa sardza su/ go bud med dag gi u pa sardza'i'o/ /rnam dbye bsdus pa'i mtha'i go'i sgra dang bud med kyi rkyen mtha' can u pa sardza'i ming mtha' can de thung ngur 'gyur te/ gong du u pa sardza'i ming can zhes brda chad byas pa'ang dgos pa 'di'i don yin/ des na mā khā'i khā thung ngur 'gyur/ a nyi mā laḥ/—khyab pa'i phreng ba/ de bzhin du/ a ti krān+ta garja/—gi gā'i shin tu khyab pa/ zhes pa la/ a ti shaṃ gaḥ/— gaṅgā'ikhyabapa/ de bzhin du/ uṅga taḥpe dze+e/— khyab par 'gro ba'i dus/ zhes pa'ang rnam dbye dang rjes 'brang phyis/ rtags mtha' thung ngu / u dī laḥ/ khyab pa'i dus/de bzhin du/ a bhi mu khaṃ pra san+daḥ/ zhes pa la/ a bhi mu khaḥ/ mngon par phyogs pa/ pra ti ak+shi/ zhes pa la gnyis pa'i rjes phyis/ pra t+yak+ṣaḥ/——cho lo so sor/bud med kyi rkyen mtha' ma yin na thung ngur mi 'gyur te/ a ti tadri/— gru shin tu 1 17—305

non pa/ a ti laskyi/— shin tu dpal dang ldan pa'am shin tu phun sum tshogs pa/—a ti 11ཿ/ 'grel par / a ba sogs rnams kuṣ+ṭa sogs dang sbyor ba la gsum pa'i mtha' don gcig par 'gyur zhes bshad pas/ a ba kuṣ+ṭaḥ/— khu byugs ①skad snyan po 'donapya/ ko ki la yā zhes pa la/ rnam dbye rjes 'brang dang bcas pa phyis/ a ba ko ki laḥ/yang 'grel par/ pa ri sogs glu na sogs kyi don brjod pa la bzhi pa'i mtha' don gcig par 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ pa ri glu naḥ/——yongs su klog par mi 'dod/a r+ya ya nā ya/ zhes pa'i ngag sbyor la rnam dbye rjes 'brang dang bcas pa phyis/par+ya r+ya ya naḥ/——klogami 'dod/ de bzhin du/ a lo su ba raḥku mādri/snyegazhon nu ma'i byed kyi byis pa rgyan bzang po/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye rjes 'brang dang bcas pa phyis/ a lo ku mā riḥ/— gzhon nu ma rgyan bzang / yang 'grel par/ nir sogs rnams khyab pa sogs kyi don du spyor ba la lnga pa'i mtha' don gcig par 'gyur ro zhes pa byung bas / nit+pan+taḥ/ kau shāḥspya/ zhes pa la/ au —ni skoshā m+biḥ/snyenges par mdzod ldan/yang 'grel par/ i ba dang sbyor ba la rnam dbye rnams mi dbyi zhing de la mi dbyi ba'i tshig sdud zer ro zhes bshad pas/ to i baḥ/——de dag 'dra ba/ bā sa sī i ba/ gosadag 'dra ba/ zhes pa lta bu la rnam dbye mi dbyi mtshams sbyar/ tā bi ba bā sa sī ba/ pūrba kā be+eka sarba dza rakhru rā ṇa na tsa ke ba khāḥ/ sa mā nā dhi ka ra be+e snyen/ snga ma'i dus e ka sarba dza rata pu rā ṇa rnams gcig ma yin pa la'ang mnyam pa'i lhag par byed pa la'o/ /snga ma'i dus te 'das pa'i dus dang sbyor ba dang e thuka sogs dang sbyor ba la'ang spyotshig gcig min pa don mnyam pa'i lhag par byed pa la supa dang supa don gcig par 'gyur te/ sna te na a nu lep+taḥ / —khrus kyi rjes su byug pa/ zhes pa la/ gsum pa'i rjes bsdus/ sna tā nu 117—306

lnga p+taḥ / — khrus kyi rjes su byug pa/ de bzhin du/ ces ke na sna taḥ/— gcig ci khrus/ zhes pa la/ces ka sna taḥ/— gcig khrus/ de dang 'dra bar/ sarbe ṇa sna taḥ/ thams cad kyi khrus/ zhes pa la/ sarba sna taḥ/ de dag dang 'dra bar/ dza ra tā ba yaḥ/ rgan po yin tshod/zhes pa la/ dza ra dwa yaḥ/ rganapoyin tshod/ de bzhin du/ pu hu rā ṇi na uk+taḥ/ pu rā ṇa khrog—/ zhes pa la/ pu rā khok+taḥ/ purā ṇa khrog/ tshig gcig yin na bsdu ba'i tha snyad med de/ pūrbaḥ/ zhes pa lta bu la basbu ba'i cho ga rnged do/ /mnyam pa'i don lhag par byed pa ma yin pa ste/ don 'gal ba la tshig gnyis dang gsum la sogs pa yod kyang don gcig par mi 'gyur te/ ba sgo se tsa rna dza la/ me la chu snyim/ pa/sa blugs2/ zhes pa lta bu la bsdu ba'i bya ba mi 'jug go/ /tah+phu ru ṣaḥs mā nā bye ka ra ṇaḥkarma dh+wa ra yaḥ/ de'i skyes bu mnyam pa'i lhag par byed pa las 'dzin pa'o / /de'i skyes bu'i tshig snyud kyi nang tshan mnyam pa'i lhag par byed pa ste snga phyi'i tshig gnyis kyi don/ dngos po gcig la mnyam par 'jug pa'i don can de la las 'dzin pa'i bsdu ba zhes bya ste/ e 4kā tsā sau sā ṭī tsa/ gcig kyang 'di yin gos kyang 'di/ zhes pa la rnam dbye rjes 'brang dang bcas pa phyis/ e kā sā ṭī/ sā ṭī zhes pa/ rgya gar gyi bud med kyi kha yos gcig gi ming / zhes gnas pa la/ pu 5sa bat+parma dh+wa ra ya dzā tī yaḥde shī ye 6/ skyes pa dang 'dra bar las 'dzin rigs yul rnams la'o—/ /las 'dzin pa'i bsdu ba'i skabs don mnyam pa dang sbyor ba dang rigs kyi sgra dang yul gyi pha rol can rnams la tshig gnyis bsgrigs pa'i snga ma'i mtha' na bud med kyi rkyen mtha' spru ma yin paṃ gang yod kyang skyes pa'i rtags dang 'dra bar thung ngur 'gyur bas kā thung ngur song / e ka sā ṭī/ de bzhin du/ pā tsa kā tsā sau byā ⑥tsa/——chod mkhan ma yang 'di bud med kyang 'di/ zhes pa la/ pā tsa kabyā/ bud med 1 77—307

tshod ma/ de dang 'dra bar/ pañca mā tsā sau bhār+yā tsa/ chung ma yang 'di lnga yang 'di/ zhes pa la/ pāñca ma bhār+yā/— chungam lnga/ de rnams dang 'dra bar/ daṭ+wā tsā sau bhār+yā tsa/ sbyin pa mo yang 'di chung ma yang 'di/ zhes pa la/ dat+ta bhārlu/ chungam sbyin pa mo/ de bzhin du/ su ke ste/ sa sau bhār+yā 'a / skra mdzes ma yang 'di chung ma yang 'di/ chenas pa 'a// sdo/ ke sha bhār+yā/ chung ma skra mdzes ma/ de bzhin du/ zwah+ma zla tsā so bhār+yā tsa/ bram ze mo yang 'di chung ma yang 'di/zhes pa la/ shāh+ma ṇa bhār+yā/ chungam bram ze mo/ de bzhin du/ pā tsa kasbyo sau dzā tī yas / 'tshod nga yang 'di rigs kyang 'di/ zhes pa la/ pā 1tsa ka ja tī yaḥ/ —'tshod pa'i rigs/de bzhin du/ pā tsa kabya de shī yabya/ 'tshod pa yang 'di yul yang 'di/ zhes pa la/ pā tsa ka de shī yaḥ/ 'tshodapa'i yu la/ de bzhin du/ sarbe tsa de babya/ tham/sa cad la yang lha dang /zhes pa la/ sarba de baḥ/ lhathams cad/ de bzhin du/ ja ra—1 sau pa tichen/ rgasapo/ yang 'di bdag po yang 'di/ zhes pa la/ dza rat+pa ti/ —rgasapo bdag ngo// u pa mā nā ni sā mā n+ya ba tsa naiḥ/ nye bar sbyor ba rnams mnyam par brjod pas so/ /'di dang 'di 'dra zhes pa lta bu nye bar sbyor ba rnams don mnyam par brjod pa yang don gcig par 'gyur te/ gha na : i ba shā maḥ/ sprin dang sngo skya 'dra/ zhes pa la/rnam dbye dang 'dra ba'i skad dod bsdus/ gha na shā maḥ/ sprinasngoskya/ u pa mi tai 3 byā ghā di bhiḥ/ nye bar sbyor ba byā gh+ra la sogs pa rnams kyis so/ /byā gh+ra la sogs pa rnams nye bar spyor ba'i don brjod pa yang don gcig par 'gyur te/pu ru sngo byā gh+ra i ba byuraḥ/ skyes bu stag dang 'dra ba la dpa' bo/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye rjes 'brang dang bcas pa phyis/ pu ru ṣa byā gh+ra shā raḥ/— skyesapastag lta bu/ bi she ṣa r+ṇa bi she bye ṇa ba hu waṃ/ khyad par khyad par kyis mang po la'o/ /don gcig gis khyad par du byed pa'i supa mtha' dang / khyad par gyis bsdu ba'i gzhi don 117—308

gcig par 'gyur te/ rak+ta tsā sau la tā tsa/——dmar ba yang 'di 'khri shing yang 'di/ zhes pa la rnam dbye rjes 'brang dang bcas pa phyis/ rak+ta la tā/— 'khril shing dmar po/ de bzhin du/ kṛṇ+ḍaste sau sarbache / nag ngo/ yang 'di sgrul yang 'di/ zhes pa la/ kṛṣ+ṭa sarbaḥ—/ sgrul nag po/ de bzhin du/ lo nyi tā tsā hūṃ sau a hi:/ lu hang yang 'di sbrul yang 'di—/ zhes pa la/ lo hi tā hiḥ/ sbrulalu hang / de bzhin du/ byā lo tsa ta dut+pa lo tsa—/ sngon po yang 'di ut+pa la yang ngo / /zhes pa la/ bhā 'o/t+pa lo/ ut+pa la sngon po/ yang 'grel par lung drangs pa/ shā ka 5pābe+e bā dī nā mut+ta ra pa da lo 3pabya/ shā ka pābe+e ba sogs rnams kyi tshig phyi ma dbyi ba'ang ngo / /las 'dzin gyi bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir shā ka pābe+e ba sogs kyi tshig snga ma'i phyi ma ste tshig gsum bsgrigs pa'i dbus ma dbyi ste/ ste/ kaḥthra yaḥpābe+e baḥ/ 'dab ma la dga' ba sa bdag/ sa bdag sde rgyal po'i ming /zhes pa la/ tshig snga ma'i phyi ma dang rnam dbye rnams phyis/ shā ka pābe+e baḥ/de dang 'dra bar/ de baḥpū dza ④ko zwah+ma ṇaḥ/ lhamachod pa'i bram ze/ zhes pa la'ang /tshig snga ma'i phyi ma pū pyedza ka dang rnam dbye phyis/ de ba zwah+ma ṇaḥ/ lha'i bram ze/ nanya/nanya'i'o / /dgag pa'i nanya sngon du 'jog pa yang de'i skyes thu'i bsdu ba'o/ /na lo po nanyaḥ/ nanya'i na dbyi'o/ /tshig sbud kyi skabs nanya zhes pa'i na ni tshig phyi ma pha rol tu byung na dbyi ste/ dharme bi rudheḥ/— chosa'ajoms/ zhes pa la/rnam dbye phyis/ bi rudha'i don nanya sngon/ mdo 'dis na phyis/ a dharmaḥ/ chos 'joms / de bzhin du/ pā pā bha baḥ/ sdigamed/ zhes pa la/ cha pā paḥ/ sdig med—/ de dang 'dra bar/ na drwah+ma ṇaḥ/ zhes pa la/ a zwah+ma ṇaḥ/ bram ze ma yin—/ tasmran+d+ra ḍa tsi/ de las atsa la nuṭa'o/ /dgag pa'i nanya'i na phyis pa de las tshig grogs atsa thog ma can byung na nu ṭa ā ga ma 'gyur te/ ka lā par 177—309

dbyangs la yi ge bzlog par bya ba zhes pa dang dgos don 'dra'o/ /a shā lkuta.a n+yaḥ / rtalas gzhan pa// zhes pa la/ rnam dbye bsdus/ a n+ya gyi don nanya sngon/nanya'i na dbyi'os/ na phyis mdo 'dis nuṭa ṭa gnas kyi don u brjod don/a na shwaḥ/ rtalasagazhan pa/ 'grel par lung drangs pa/ na bro na lo paḥ/ ti ngi k+ṣe ye/ nying la med pa la nanya'i na dbyi'o/ /ting mtha' can gyi sngon du 'jog pa'i nanya'i na'ang med pa'i don brjod pa yin na dbyi ste/ na pa tsi se/ 'tshod pa/ra mi byed/ zhes pa la na phyis/ a pa tsa se/— 'tshodapar mi byed/ na bhān+da pān+da be da gyenā sa t+ya na mu tsi na ku la na kha na hūṃ sa ka na k+ṣa tra nasna na kra nā ke 6 pra kṛ t+yaḥ/ na —1ṭa / ma bsal ba/ zug ///// mi bsrung ba/ cad nges2)/ mirig pa/ ste/ ba/ snye/pho/ mi bden pa/na dza/ byu1/ mi lhong ba/ na ṭa/ 'a// rigs med de sre mang / na tab/ —sen mo/ zug dre/ sa ka / ma ning /nab tra/ skaram/ nasna/ sgos med/ na lnga// mi 'gro ba/ mtho ris/— ste/ ka bya/ma sa 'a/ zabang bzhin gyis so/ /na bhāṭa sogs de rnams kyi na yig ni tshig gzhan gyi thog ma yin kyang mi dbyi bar rang bzhin du gnas so/ /sad+ma hat+pa ra mot+ta mo྾ṣ+ṭaḥpū bye ma naiḥ/ sata ma hata pa ra ma ut+ta ma ut+paṣ+ṭa rnams mchod pa sems pa rnams kyi'o/ /sata sogs de rnams mchod pa dang legs par sems pa'i don brjod pa'i phyir du sbyor ba yang don gcig pa'i de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba'i nang tshan las 'dzin gyi bsnyu bar 'gyur te/ saṭ+wā sau dharma bya/——dam pa yang 'di chos kyang 'di/zhes pa la rnam dbye rjes 'brang dang bcas pa phyis/ sadhermaḥ/ dam pa/'i chos de bzhin du/ ma hūṃ rtswa sau de babya/ lha yang 'di chen po yang ngo / /zhes pa la/ rnam dbye rjes 'byel dang bcas pa phyis/ ma had de baḥ/— lhachen po/ ād+ma ha taḥ/ sa mā nā bye ka ra ṇa dzā tī ya yoḥzi/ ma hata kyi mnyam shepa'i lhag par byed pa dang 117—310

ri rigs dag la āta'o/ /ma hata kyi mtha' mnyam pa'i lhag par byed pa ste gzhi mthun pa'i tshig dang rigs dag la āta du 'gyur te/ ka khā par/ gzhi mthun tshig la ma hata kyi/ ā'i yi ger byed pa'o zhes pa dang gcig go/ /'di'i ṭi āta/ ma hā de baḥ/ lhachenango// de bzhin du/ pa ramasbyo sau de babya—/ ——mchog kyang 'di lha yang ngo / /zhes pa la/ pa ra ma de baḥ/snye lhamachog /ut+ta masbyo sau gu rustsa/snyemachog kyang 'di bla ma yang ngo / /zhes pa la/ ut+ta ma gu ruḥ/— bla mamachog /4zlaṣ+ṭa rtswa① sau de babya/——gzi brjid can kyang 'di lha yang ngo / /zhes pa la/ 4zlaṣ+ṭa de baḥ/ lha gzi brjid can/ 'grel par lung drangs pa/ ghā sa ka ra bi shiṣ+ṭi khya pi bā 37phyu/ ghā sa/ka ra bi shiṣ+ṭa rnams pha rol la ā be yig tu brjod par bya zhing ghā sa sogs pha rol la ma ha tī ④zhes pa'ang ma ha ru 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ ma ha tī la ṭā/ghā sa la su ma ha (khya t+yāghā saḥ/snyemangapos rtswa/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye bsdus ma ha tī ma hā ru 'gyur 'u/ ma hā ghā saḥ/ — rtsamangapo/ de bzhin du/ ṭā— ma ha t+yā ka raḥ/ —chen po yis bya ba/ chenas pa la/ ma hā ka raḥ/ byab chen po/ de bzhin du/ ṭā——ma ha t+yā bi shiṣ+ṭaḥ/snyechen poyis mchog /zhes pa la/ ma hā bi shiṣ+ṭaḥ/——chemachog /tadhi tāsgot+ta ra pa da sa mā hā re tsa/ de phan gyi don tshig phyi ma mnyam du 'dus pa la'ang ngo / /de phan gyi don can gyi tshig phyi ma pha rol la mnyam du 'dus pa na don gcig pa de'i skyes bu'i bsdu bar 'gyur te/ pūrba sde 7shā lā yī bha ba/ —'gron khang shar ma la/rnam dbye rnams bsdus/ pūrba shā la bha ba/ zhes pa la/ dika pūrba pa dā da saṃ dz+nyā lnga nyaḥ/ phyogs kyi tshig snga ma las ming ma yin pa la nya'o/ /phyogs kyi tshig snga ma can la ming ma yin pa la dngos po'i don la de phan gyi rkyen nya 'gyur ro//zhes pas/ de phan gyi don can gyi tshig phyi ma bha ba phyis/ de'i don gyi rkyen nya/117—311

nya 'gro ba la 'phel ba/ porba shā laḥ/—'gronakhang shar/ dika saṃ khye saṃ dz+nyā lnga/phyogs grangs dag la ming la'o/ /phyogs kyi sgra dang grangs dag ming brjod pa na don gcig par 'gyur te/ dak+ṣi ṇ+ḍa tsā sau aldi:/snyelho yang 'di me yang ngo / /zhes pa la/dak+shi ṇ+ḍaghi naḥ/——lho'ime/ de bzhin du/ sap+ta tsa te gā mā:/snyegrong yang de bdun yang ngo //zhes pa la/ sap+ta gā māḥ/—grongabadun rnams/ de bzhin du/ sap+ta tsa ṛ ṣa ya:/snyedrang srong yang de bdun yang / zhesapa la/ sap+tar+ṣa yaḥ/snyedrang srong bdun rnams/ saṃ khyu pūrbo dī guḥ—/ grangs thog ma can ni phyogs gnyis pa'o/ /dngos po gang zhig grangs kyi sgra dang 'grel gyob na grangs kyi sgra sngon du 'jog cing de la de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba'i nang tshan phyogs gnyis pa'i bsdu ba zhes brda chad byed do/ /pañca su ka pā le 6 saṃ skṛ taḥ/snyekapāli lnga 'dus/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye rnams dang rjes 'brang bsdus—/ pañca ka pā la/snyekapālilnga/ saṃskṛ tai ba tsak+ṣuḥ/ 'dus pa la zas la'o/ /zas kyi don gyi 'dus pa'i don la de phan gyi rkyen aṇa'o rduzhes pas aṇa 'jug kyang / dī goḥlu ga na pa tre/ phyogs gnyis pa'i bu brgyud ma yin pa la dbyi'o//phyogs gnyis pa'i tshig sdud kyi skabs 'dir bu brgyud kyi rkyen ma yin pa'i de phan gyi rkyen rnams dbyi ste/ pañca ka pā la la yang aṇam sbyin kyang chog /sbyin kyang mdo 'dis dbyi bas gzugs 'dra'o/ /bu brgyud kyi rkyen yin na mi dbyi ste/dwa yoḥ/ mi tra yoḥ/ pu traḥ/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye rnams bsdus bu brgyud kyi rkyen nyi nya 'gro ba la 'phel ba/ dwo mi tri4ཿ/snyegrogs gnyis kyi bu/ zhes pa lta bu mi dbye'o / /yang / pañca bhiḥgo bhiḥspri ta/—ba lang lnga yis tshong / zhes pa la/ rnam dbye rnams bsdus/ pañca guḥ/snyebalang lnga/ te na 4 taḥ/ de yis rdzas brje ba la'o—/ /de yis rdzas brje ba ste tshong gi don la de phan gyi rkyen ka 'gyur ro zhes 717 312

pa thob kyang / a rgyarba pūr+pājo gorlu ga saṃ dz+nyā yī/ lhag pa'i don snga ma las phyogs gnyis pa la ming ma yin pa la dbyi'o/ /lhag pa'i don snga ma can las/phyogs gnyis pa'i tshig sdud kyi skabs 'dir ming ma yin pa la de phan gyi rkyen rnams dbyi bas/ ka byin ma byin la gzugs khyad par med do/ /yang /pañca ga bo dha rgo ya su/——gang gi nor ba lang lnga/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye rjes 'brang dang bcas pa phyis/ pañca go dha rna/snyenorab lang lnga/ go ra tadhi ta lu ki/ go yis de phan dbyi ba ma yin no/ /go yis sgra'i mtha' dang de'i skyes bu'i tūbasdu ba'i mtha' la de phan gye rkyen atsa 'gyur zhing dbyi ba'ang ma yin no zhes pas atsa'i rkyen—/ pañca ga paḥ/——b.lang lnga/ zhes pa la/ dī gu re ka pa tsa rna/ phyogs gnyis pa la gcig tshig go/ /phyogs gnyis pa'i bsdu ba byas pa'i mtha' las rnam dbye rnams kyi gcig tshig kho na 'jug pa shas che'o/ /sa na sum̐ sa rka/ de ma ning ngo / /phyogs gnyis pa'i bsdu ba byas pa'i mtha' gcig thutshig 'jug pa de rnams ma ning gi rtags su 'gyur ro/ /ma ning la su am du 'gyur/ pañca ga baṃ dha dz+wa/snyegang gi nor ba lang lnga/ a kā rādhot+ta 4ra pa do dī guḥ/ phyogs gnyis pa a yig mtha' tshig phyi ma la'o/ /phyogs gnyis pa'i bsdu ba'i skabs tshig phyi ma a yig mtha' can las bud med du brjod pa'i rkyen dīpa 'gyur te/ tra yā rde lo kā r+ghaṃ—/ snye'ajig rten rnams kyi gsum rnams kyi/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye bsnyus/ bud med du brjod pa'i rkyen dīpa/ tri lo tī/——'jig rten gsum/ ā tshibaṃ to bā/ āpa mtha' la yang na'o/ /phyogs gnyis pa'i tshig sdud kyi skabs tshig phyi ma'i mtha' de āpa mtha' can yin na yang na dīpa 'gyur zhing yang na ma ning gi rtags su 'gyur te/tra yā dzā kha ṭ+wā dzā/—khri rnams kyi gsum rnams kyi/ zhes pa la/ tri kha ṭī/——khri gsum ma/ tri kha 117—313

ṭī / khrigasum/ 'grel par lung drangs pa/ a norlo pabya snri yī nyubā/ an gyi dbyi zhing bud med du yang na'o/ /phyogs gnyis pa'i an gyi mtha' dbyi zhing bud med kyi rtags su yang na 'gyur te/ palnga rmā karmā rde— / lnga rnams kyi las rnams kyi/zhes pa la rnam dbye phyis/ pañca karma na/ go yis de phan dbyi ba ma yin no zhes pa'i mdos atsa an phyis/ dīpa yang na ba byas pas/ pañca kad+mā/ las lnga ma/pañca karme/ las lnga/ yang lung drangs pa/ pa tā do na dīpa/ pā tra sogs la dīpa mi 'gyur ro/ /phyogs gnyis pa'i bsnyu ba byas pa'i mtha' pā tra sogs la bud gred du brjod pa'i rkyen dīpa 'gyur ba ma yin te/ palnga dzā pā tā rde/— sgod rnam/sa kyi lnga rnams kyi/ /zhes pa la/ rnam dbye phyis dīpa mi 'gyur/ pañca pā tram̐/ sgodalnga/de bzhin du/ tsa turlu gi/ gzugs ba'i/ tri bhu ba rna/ sagasum/ tah+phu ru ṣa sde gu leḥsaṃ khyu bye yā deḥ/ e gu li las de'i skyes bu'i grangs mi zad pa sogs kyi'o/ /de'i skyes bu'i bsnyu ba'i skabs drangs dang mi zad pa snga ma'i e gu li zhes pa'i rtags la rkyen atsa 'gyur te/ dwo i gu lī pra mā ṇa ma su/ srog chags kyi ma dzub mo/ gnyis / zhes pa la/ rnam dbye rjes 'byel dang bcas pa phyis/ rkyen atsa byin / bye 4gu lo/ mdzub mo gnyis/ de bzhin du/ ni re gu lo/ ma/dzub mo/ med pa/ a hasmadze+e ka de sha saṃ khyu ta pu rgyustso rā treḥ/ a han sarba saṃ khyu ta puju rnams las rā tri las 5kyang ngo / / a han 6sogs de rnams snga ma'i rā tri'i sgra la rkyen atsa 'gyur zhing yang gi sgras mi zad pa dang grangs sngon 7ma la'ang 'gyur te/ a habya rā trirtse/ nyin mo dang mtshan mo/ zhes pa la rnam dbye bsdus/ atsa'i rkyen/a ho rā tram̐/ nyinam—/ rā tāṭ+wā hāḥsum̐ se/ rā tri a ha na a ha rnams skyes pa'o/ /rā tri la sogs pa de rnams yang na skyes pa'i rtags su 'gyur te/ sarbartswa sau rā 177—314

tri:/ mtshan mo yang 'di thams cad kyang ngo / zhes pa la rnam dbye bsdus/ yang na a han sogs kyi mdos atsa'i rkyen byin ma ning gi rtags su 'gyur/ yang mdo 'dis skyes pa'i rtags su 'gyur te/ sarba rā tram̐/ mtshan mo/ tham/sa cad/ sarba rā triḥ / mtshan rngo/ thams cad/ de bzhin du/ pūrba rā treḥ/ mtshanamo'i sngo na la / chenas pa 'ab/ ༷/rba rā tram̐/ —mtshanamo'i sngo na ma/ ༷/lnga/ che/ thogaḥ ma/tshanamo'i sngon ma / de ba'i/na du/ am/ sdu/ 1 lnga/ ta shes tram̐/ thogaḥ/ ma/tshanamo bshad/ am/ ṭa/ ju rā tram̐/ triḥ/— ma tshan mo'i bsod nams/ dī rā tram̐/ :/ triḥ/ mtshan mo gnyis/ yin ti rā tram̐/ triḥ/ r+shan tu ma/tshan rngo// rā dzā haḥ/sa khi bh+yaṣ+ṭa tsa/ rā dzan a han sa khi rnams las ṭatsa'o/ /de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir rā dzan sogs rtags gsum po de'i mtha' la ṭatsa'i rkyen 'jug ste / ma hūṃ rtswa sau rā dzā tsa/ chen ngo/ yang 'di rgyal ngo yang ngo / zhes pa la/ rnam dbye rjes 'brang dang bcas pa phyis/ ma ha ta rā dzan du log /'dis ṭatsa/ tsu ṭu sogs kyis tsa phyis/— ṭa/ ṭita rte so gas kyi don yin nga sa phyis / an gyi dbyi zhing zhes pas an phyis/ rgyal ngo/ chen ngo// ma hā rā ja ཿ/ ma/nyam/ pa/'i lhag nga ra byed pa sogs kyis ma hata ma/ hā ru 'gyur/de bzhin du/ a ti sha ye na rā dz+wa/ phul du byung ba'i rgyal ngo / zhes pa la/ a ti rā dzaḥ rgyal ngo phul byung / a ti rā dz+re/ phul du byung ba'i rgyal ngo / de bzhin du/ rā ma gya sa khā / dga' byed kyi grogs ngo// zhes pa la/ rā ma sa khaḥ/ dga' byed grogs ngo / ma hūṃ ston sau sa ta/ tsa/ chen ngo/ yang 'di grogs ngo yang ngo / /zhes pa la/ ma hā sa khaḥ/ grogs ngo chen ngo//a t+naṣ+ṭa kho re ba/ a han gyi ṭa kha de 4dag las nges pa'o/ /a han gyi mtha' las ṭa dang kha'i rkyen 'gyur zhing rkyen de dag pha rol la a han gyi ṭi nges par dbyi ste/ ut+ta masbyo sau a habye/ —mchog kyang 'di nyi ma'ang ngo / /zhes pa la/ rnam dbye phyis / ṭa'i rkyen byin/ ṭi phyis/ ut+ta mā haḥ/ nyi ma ma/chog /de bzhin du/117—315

dwo a ha m+bi/ nyi ma dag gnyis dag /zhes pa la/ rnam dbye bsdus rkyen kha byin kha ā+o nar 'gyur ṭi phyis/ dru tī naḥ/— nyim gnyis/ yang 'grel par/ rā dzan gyi mtha' yin kyang / ma dru rde rā rnyi/ bzang po rnam sa kyi rgyal mo/ zhes pa lta bu la rnam dbye dbyi ba ma gtogs ṭatsa'i rkyen mi 'jug go zhes bshad pas/ ma dra rā rnyi / rgyal mo dbe+e ba/ yang 'grel par lung drangs pa/ a han gyi mtha' la mchod sbyin brjod pa'i phung po'i don la rkyen kha 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ a tī naḥkra tuḥ / ma/chod sbyin byed pa/'i phung ngo / asgophot+na e te bh+yaḥ/ mchod sbyin byed pa'i phung po// a han gye at+na 'di rnams las so/ /'di rnams zhes pa sarba la sogs pa sngon na yod pa'i a han gyi mtha' las rkyen ṭatsa 'gyur zhing a han gye at+na zhes par yang 'gyur te/sarba.ā+oṃ sau a habya/ tham sa cad kyang 'di nyi ma/'ang / zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs phyis/ṭatsa'i rkyen mdo 'dis at+na ru 'gyur/ sar+pāt+na/ nyi ma tham sa cad/ zhes pa la/asgo3dad+dhā ta/ a han gyi ata mtha' las so/ /a han zhes pa ata mthar 'gyur ba las de'i tshig snga ma de la na ṇar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan gyi yi ge re pha yod na at+na'i na yang ṇar 'gyur te/ saṭ+wāṇ+ḍaḥ/ de bzhin du/ pūrba a haḥ/ zhes pa la/ pūr+pāhāḥ/ nyim snga dro/ pa ram̐ phya haḥ/ nyimaphyidro/ chenas pa la/ pa rāṇ+ḍa/ nyim phyi dro/ na saṃ khyu deḥs mā ha re/ grangs la sogs pa'i kun srud pa la ma yin no/ /grangs dang po la sogs pa'i kun sdud pa la a han gyi mtha' at+na 1 zhes par 'gyur ba ma yin te/ dwo a nyi nā / nyi ma dag gnyis dag /zhes pa la rnam dbye bsdus/ṭatsa'i rkyen byin mtha' at+na ru mi 'gyur bas/ dru haḥ/ nyimaganyis/ de bzhin du/rgya haḥ/ nyim gsum/ ut+ta mo kā dz+nyā tsa/ ut+ta ma e ka dag las kyang ngo / /ut+ta ma dang e ka dag las pha rol kyi a han gyi mtha' yang at+na zhes par 'gyur ba ma 717—316

yin te/ ut+ta ma dang pu rgya don gcig pas/ pu rgya sbyo kyisau a habya/ bsod nams kyang 'di nyi ma yang ngo / /zhes pa la rnam dbye bsnyus ṭatsa'i rkyen byin/ pu rgyu ha su/'grel par lung drangs pa/ pu rgya su di nā rgyu na sum̐ sa shaṃ/ purgya su di na dag las ma ning ngo / /purgya dang su di na dag las pha rol gyi a han zhes pa ni ma ning gi rtags su 'gyur te/ pu dh+yā haṃ/ bsodanams nyi ma/ de bzhin du/ e kartswa sa/ phyag hachen/ gcig kyang 'di nyi ma yang ngo / /cenas pa 'a// ces na/ haḥ/ nyimagacig /phyag ba/ lnga/ yā mu ra saḥ/ u ras las tsub las so/ / u ras las de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba'i mtha' las tsub kyi don la rkyen atsa 'gyur te/ a shwa su u ra saḥ.a gre ā spyo / rta yi brang ṅga rtse'i tsu ba/ zhes pa la rnam dbye phyis/ a gra ā khyu kyi don atsa sbyar te/a shwa ra saṃ/ rtayibrang tsub/ a nopho shā yas sa ra sī dzā ti saṃ dzha yoḥ/ a nas athra a yas sa ras rnams kyi rigs ming dag las so/ /a nas la sogs pa 'di rnams la de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba'i mtha' las rigs dang ming gi don la rkyen atsa 'gyur te/ u pa a na saṃ/ su g.yos khang la nye ba/ zhes pa la/ gnyis pa'i rjes phyis atsa byin/ su am u pā na saṃ/ g.yos khang nye ba/ de bzhin du/ a mṛ tai athraḥ / zhes pa la/ ṭatsasu a mṛ tā thraḥ/ 'chi med ril bu'am bdud rtsi ril bu/ de bstunon du/ na/ tshong yi sa/ sdu// cenas pa 'a// lca gas nag na/ 'a/ pa/ sdu a tsa su am/ nge/ bzhin du/ māzla kā ram̐ sa ra sī/ zhes pa la/ māzle ka sa ra saṃ/ ma tsho yi sbal pa//grwa ma kau ṭā dz+nyā rtsetsa takyāḥ/ grwa ma kau ṭa dag las kyang ta k+ṣi las so/ /gā ma dang kau ṭa dag snga ma'i ta k+ṣi las kyang de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba'i mtha' la ṭa tsa'i rkyen 'gyur te5/ gā me ṭak+ṣi/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye phyis ṭa'i rkyen byin/ grwa ma tak+ṣaḥ/— grongal shing bzo ba/ de bzhin du/ kau ṭa rtswa sau ta k+ṣi tsa/ —shing bzo ba g.yo sgyu can/117—317

byung yang don gcig pa de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba nges par 'jug ste/ kur+ghaṃ kā raḥ/zhes pa la rnam dbye bsdus/ kum+bha kā raḥ/ bum pa byed pa ste rdza mkhan/ tu mun rtsu lo kṛ yā yā mi ti sap+ta myu ni rde shā ti dan+ta spyo pa pa da two/ tu mun rtsul dag dang bya ba spyor ba bdun pa'i yul ting mtha' ma yin pa'i nye ba'i tshig gi'o/ /tu mun dang sgol dag gi rkyen mtha' can dang kṛta sogs kyi bya ba'i rkyen dang sbyor ba'i ting mtha' ma yin pa'i nye ba'i 3tshig rnam dbye bdun pa'i yul can kyang don gcig pa de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba 'jug ste/ swa du kā ra bhuste/ zhes pa la/ a mai bā bya ye 2na/ mi zad pa'i nges par ama'o/ /gong du smos pa'i bsdu ba de dang 'byel ba'i mi zad pa sngon na yod na am ā ga ma 'gyur te/ 'dis am/am la sngon ma'i gzugs/ ma nga ro/ swa rdu kā ra bhuste/ ro dang ldan nga/ za bar byed/tu mun la/ kā le bhuhūṃ/ zhes pa la/ kā la bhuhūṃ/ dusazos nas/ tro tī yā pra j-i tī n+ya n+ya ta ra sde/ gsum pa sogs rnams yang na'o/ /u pa rda sha pha rol na yod pa'i mū la ka gsum pa sogs kyi mtha' don gcig par yang na 'gyur te/spru la ke na u pa rda shaḥbhuste/ rtsa ba can nye bar so yis bza'/ zhes pa rang gnas sam yang na rnam dbye bsdus pas/ spru la ko pa rda shaṃ bhuste/ ghā tsa/ ghā yang ngo / /ghā'i rkyen mtha' can dang spyor ba la yang gsum pa'i mtha' don gcig par 'gyur te/ ṭaphyisapa'o/ u:ཿkṛ twa/ ma/ tho bar byas nas/ u pa zlo 4pa kra oṃ ta dā t+yā 5bi khyu sa spyodze+e/ u pa dz+nyā u pa kra ma de sogs 'dod pa la'o/ /u pa dz+nyā/ u pa kra ma sogs dang sbyor ba yang 'dod pa'i don can yin na don gcig pa de'i skyes bu'i basbu bar 'gyur zhing de dag ma ning gi rtags su'ang 'gyur te/ ngas pā ṇi ṣ+peḥ / u pa dz+nyā/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye bsdus/ pā ṇi rgyu pa dho/ pā ṇi ni nye 777—320

bar shes/ de bzhin du/ nan+da spyo pa kra maḥ/ dga' ba'i nye ba'i rim pa / zhes pa la/nasdo pa kra maḥ/ —dga' ba'i nye ba'i rim pa/ tsā yā bā hu bye/ tsā yā mang po la'o/ /de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir mang po brjod pa dang 'brel ba'i tsā yā zhes pa'i sgra yang ma ning gi rtags su 'gyur te/ sha la bhā dzā tsā yā/ phye ma leb rnams kyi grib ma//zhes pa la/ sha la bha tsā yo/ bye ma leb rnams kyi grib ma / sa bhā rā dzā ma nu 6 pūṭ+wā rā dzan dang mi ma yin pa snga ma'i sa bhā la'o/ /rā dzan dang mi ma yin pa'i sgra snga ma'i sa bhā zhes pa ma ning gi rtags su 'gyur te/ i na su sa bhā/ tshogasapa/ 'di'i/ zhes pa la / i na sa sgo/ tshogs nga/ 'di'i/ de bzhin du/ phro/ shwa ra su sa bhā/ dbang phyug bi tshogs— cenas pa 'ab/ phrog sa/ zab sa r+ghaṃ/ dbang phyug sga tshogs pa// rā dha/ཿsa bhā/ rgyal ngo/'i tshogs pa / zhes pa la/ rā dza sa dzha1 / rgyalango 'i tshogs/ de bzhin du/ pi shā tsa su sa bhā / shaza'i tshogs pa// cenas pa 'a / pi ste/ tha sa sgo/ shaza'itshogs / yi/ ste/ 'a/ 'bye/ la gron khang ma yin pa la'ang ngo / /bong du mi ma yin pa zhes byung yang mdo 'dis 'gron khang du 'tshogs pa lta bu ma yin pa'i 'tshogs pa'i don la ma ning gi rtags su 'gyur te/ snri rde sa bhā/ budamed kyi tshogs / zhes pa la/ sdi 5 sa r+ghaṃ/ bud med kyi tshogs/ bi bhā ṣā se nā su rā tsā yā shā lā ni shā dz+nyā/ se nā su rā tsā yā shā lā ni shā rnams kyi 'dam ka'o/ /se nā la sogs pa de rnams bsdu ba'i mtha' ma ning gi rtags su yang na 'gyur te/ dī dzā ā+oṃ sa 6 nā/ gnyis skyes te bram ze'i sde/ zhes pa la/dī dza se rna/ dwo dza se nā/ de bzhin du/ ya bā ram̐ su rā/ nas rnams kyi chang /zhes pa la/ ya ba su ram̐/ rā/ bṛk+ṣa su tsā yā/ thing gi grib ma / zhes pa la/thrak+ṣa tsā yi/ yā/ ga r+pā shā khā/ ba lang gi 'gron khang / zhes pa la/ go shā lo/ khā/ngas ṭa/ ni ste//——legs pa'i mtshan mo/ ngas — su ni shaṃ/ —legasapa/'i mtshan rngo// se nā la sogs pa 117—321

de rnams de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba'i nang tshan las 'dzin dang na nya snga ma can la ma ning gi rtags su mi 'gyur te/ dṛ 1zwa.ā+oṃ sau se nā tsa/—bstan pa yang 'di sde yang 'di/zhes pa lta bu la rnam dbye phyis ma ning gi rtags su mi 'gyur te / go bud med sogs kyis thung ngu / dṛ zwa se naḥ/ sdebastan pa / de bzhin du/ na se nā/ sde med/zhes pa la/ a se naḥ/ pa ra ba l+liṅge dwan+d+ra tah+phu ru ṣa yoḥ/ rtags pha rol 'dra bar zlas dbye de'i skyes bu —dag gi'o/ /de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba dang zlas dbye'i basbu 5ba'i skabs 'gar rtags gnyis bsgrigs pa'i snga ma pha rol tu song zhing phyi ma sngon mar song la de'i skabs rtags dang rnam dbye phrad pa'i bya ba rnams pha rol tu song ba'i rtags de nyid rtags gsum po gang yin kyang de dang 'dra bar bsgrub ste/ kuklu ṭabya ma yu 6rī tsa/ khyim/bya dang rma bya/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye bsdus rtags snga phyi yang na ba rjes rnam dbye dang phrad pa'i cho ga pha rol tu gang byung ba de'i 7lugs byas pas/ ma yu rī kuklu ṭo/ yang na/ kuklu ṭa ma yurlo/de bzhin du/ arja su pibe+e lbo/ pipiling phyed kyi/ zhes pa la/ pibe+e l+yadhi/ yang na / arja pibe+e lī/ pūrba ba da shwa ba ḍa bo/ snga ma 'dra bar a shwa ba ḍa ba dag go/ /a shwa dang ba ḍa ba dag snga ma dang 'dra bar rnam dbye rnams 'jug ste/a shwa bya pa ḍa bā tsa/ rtadangargod ma / zhes pa la/ a shwa ba ḍa bo/ rta dang rgod ma/bārjartsaḥ / arja ri tsa'i yang na'o/ /ar+bha dang sbyor ba'i ri tsa yang na ma ning gi rtags su 'gyur zhing yang na pho rtags nyid do / /ṛ tsaḥ.ar+ghaṃ/——nges tshig phyed/zhes pa la/ rnam dbye phyis/ snga phyi bsgyur/ ṭa tsa byin/ azlurtse/adzhartsaḥ / druṣ+ṭa naḥsaṃ khyu yā ma ba hu bye khya shī troḥ/ dī aṣ+ṭan dag gi grangs la 'bru mang po dang brgyad cu ma yin pa dag la'o/ /dī dang aṣ+ṭa na dag gi mtha' 117—322

zhing da'ang ḍa ru 'gyur te/ ṣa ḍa dhi kā da sha /zhes pa la/ rnam dbye phyis/ṣa ṣa da shan/ mdo 'dis ṣa phyi ma u/ a la yon tan nos khro/ da ḍa/sngo ḍa sha /——bcudrug /de rnams kyis de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba bshad zin nas da ni 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba bshad par bya ste/myu/ a ṣ+pe ka ma n+ya pa dāze/ du ma gzhan gyi tshig gi don la'o/ /supa mtha' du ma gzhan gyi supa mtha'i tshig gi don la 'jug pa ste tshig gnyis sam mang po'ang rung ste dngos su brjod pa de ma yin pa la/ tshig de dag gi don dang 'byel pa'i don gzhan dngos su ma brjod pa zhig brjod bya'i gtso bor byed pa'i supa mtha' mang po don gcig tu bsdu ba de ni 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba zer ro/ /sabe+e m+bi bi she ṣa be+e ba hu dī ho/ bdun pa khyad par du 'bru mang po la'o/ /'bru mang po'i bsnyu ba'i skabs 'dir rnam dbye bdun pa khyad par du bya ba ste tshig gnyis sam mang po bsgrigs pa'i tshig snga ma de bdun pa'i don can yin na snga ma kho nar gnas la tshig sbyor gyi skabs tshig phyi ma bdun pa'i don can yin na de sngon du 'jog pa 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'i khyad chos yin no/ /pābye u da shaṃ ya snga sau / —gong ji chu bo thob pa/ 'di/ zhes pa la rnam dbye rjes 'brel dang bcas pa phyis/s+thāsto da ko grwa ma/—chubothob pa'i grong / de bzhin du/ u rto ra tho ya myu sau/ gang gi shing rta 'dren pa/ de/ zhes pa la/ spru bhā ra tho3n ḍān/ shing rta 'dren glang khyu ba/ u j-i ta mo da rde ya su saḥ/——gang zan 'jogs de/ zhes pa la/ u dh+ri 4to da nā/ zan 'jogs/ r+pā ta ma ba ram̐ ya snga sau/ gang sga yos ser ngo 'di/ zhes pa la/ r+pā tā ba ro ha riḥ/—yos ser po 'phrog byed/ bī rāḥpu ru ṣa kāḥya smin/ dang 'a bo rnams skyes bu rnams gang la/ zhes pa la/bī ra pu ru ṣa ko grwa maḥ/— skyes bu dpa' ngo 'i grong / m+bi la mu dz+wa lo ba puḥya su/ gang gi lus sngo 117—325

skya / zhes pa la/ byā lo dz+wa la ba puḥ/snyelus sngo skya/ u:ཿ——gangagi sgo mtho ba/ mu khaṃ ya gya / zhes pa la/ uñciḥmu khaḥ/snyesgomathob/ kha ra gya mu kha mi ba mu kho ① ya snga sau / gang gi gdong bong bu'i gdong 'dra ba 'di/ zhes pa la/ kha ra ⑤mu khaḥ/— bong bu'i gdong /'grel par lung drangs pa/ sap+ta myu pa mā na pūrba spyot+ta ra pa da lo pabya/bdun pa nye ba snga ma'i tshig phyi ma dbyi ba'ang ngo / /tshig sbyor gyi skabs rnam dbye bdun pa nye ba sngon na yod pa'i tshig phyi ma yang dbyi ⑦ bar bya ste/ ka re sbi tai dha rna ya s+thā sau/ —gang gi lag na gnas pa'i nor 'di/ zhes pa la/ bdun pa'i rjes ka re zhes pa'i nye ba'i tshig phyi ma dz+re tai phyis/ rnam dbye rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'ang phyis pas / ka ra dha naḥ/— laganor/ yang 'grel par/ 'dus pa dang byed pa'i tshig rnam dbye drug pa la dbyi ba'ang ngo zhes bshad pas/ ke shā dzā saṃ gha taḥtsū ④ḍā ya su/——gang gi skra rnams 'dus pa'i thor gtsug⑤/ zhes pa la/ ke sha tsū ḍaḥ/snyeskra'i thor gtsug⑥ /su bar+ṇa gya bi kā ropho lo kā ro ya myu sau/snyegang gi gser las byas pa'i rgyan 'di/ zhes pa la/su bar+ṇa lo kā rahūṃḥ/snyegaser gyi rgyan/ ste yāḥsum̐ bad+dhā ṣi ta sum̐sku da nu paḥs mā nā dhi ka ra ṇi ste yā ma pū ra bhā thra yā di 6/ bud med kyi skyes pa can bshad pa sprung ma yin pa'i bud med la mnyam pa'i lhag par byed pa la rdzogs pa dang pri ya sogs ma yin pa'i 5skyes pa bzhin no/ /bud med kyi rtags sngar skyes pa'i rtags can du phyabashad pa da lta khrung gi rkyen ma yin pa'i bud med kyi rtags su bsgrub pa'i rkyen mtha' can ni mnyam pa'i lhag par byed pa ste gzhi mthun pa'i tshig la rdzogs pa'i rkyen mtha' can dang pri ya sogs pha rol na yod pa ma yin pa ni skyes pa'i rtags bzhin hūṃ.atsa rnams ⑪thung ngur 'gyur te/ tsi tā gā baḥya su/snyegang gi ba khra mo/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye phrad dang bcas pa phyis/ mdo 'dis ā pa mtha' can tsi tā 717—326

thung ngur 'gyur/ tsi tra guḥ/ bakhramo/ byu pa ba tī bhār+yā ya su/ gang gi chung ma gzugs ldan ma/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye phrad dī pa dang bcas pa phyis/ rū pa bad+dhāzla / chung ma gzugs ldan ma/ sngar skyes pa'i rtags can du bshad pa ma yin na thung ngur mi 'gyur te/ gaṅgā bhār+yā ya gya/ gang gi chung ma ṅga ṭ+wā/ zhes pa thung ngur mi 'gyur/ gi gā bhār+yaḥ/— chungam gi gā/ ung 7—gi rkyen can la/ drwah+ma ba dhū bhār+yā ya su/ gang gi chung ma bram ze'i bu mo/ zhes pa la thung ngur mi 'gyur te/ zwah+ma ba dhū bhāzla / chung ma bram ze'i bu mo/a pū ra ṭ+wā pra mā byoḥ/ ma yin zhing rdzogs pa tshad dag las so/ /gong du bshad pa ltar rdzogs pa'i rkyen can dang tshad las thung ngur 'gyur ba ma yin zhing rdzogs pa'i rkyen can dang tshad kyi sgra dag la zlas dbye'i bsdu ba'i mtha' las rkyen apa 'gyur te/ ka spyo d+dhā pañca m+bi yā sī rā ṭī rde/ gang rnams kyi mtshan mo rnams kyi dbe ba ma lnga pa//cenas pa 'a / rnam/ dbye/ sogs bas/sa/ ka lnga/ bhā palha ༷// mtshan rngo/ dge ba ma lnga pa rnams/zhes pa gnas pa la rkyen apa byin/ ka spyo bhā pañca ma rā tra yaḥ/ tshad la/byā 1pra mā bhā ya myu sau/— gang gi bud med tshad ma 'di/ zhes pa la/ sdi pra mā ṇaḥ/ bud med tshad ma/ na dī ṛ tabya/ na dī ṛ ta las kyang ngo / /na dī'i ming can dang ṛta mtha' can pha rol la 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'i mtha' las rkyen kapa kyang 'gyur zhing de'i tshe sngon ma skyes pa bzhin thung ngur 'gyur te/ ka spyo bhā pañca m+bi ya snga sau—/ —gang sga dge ba ma lnga pa 'di/ chenas pa la/ rnam dbye/ sogs bsdus ka s+thā d+dhā patso m+bi/zhes gnas pa na dī'i ming can yī yig mtha' la rkyen kapa byin/ de'i nus pas snga ma thung ngur song / ka spyo ṇi pañca m+bi kaḥ/ dgeb ma lnga pa/ de bzhin du/ ṛta mtha' las/ ba ha baḥkarta ro ya su/ gang ji byed pa/ ngo/ mang ngo rnams/ zhes pa la/ pa hu kad+ngha kaḥ/ byedapa po mang po pa/ thra yā sogs la/ ka spyo bhā pri pa/ ya su/ gang sga dbe ba ma 117—327

dga' ma/ zhes pa la thung ngur mi 'gyur/ ka stso ṭ+wā thra yaḥ/ —dge ba ma'i dga' ma/ tshig sbyor bsdu tshul sogs de dang 'dra bar byas pas/ bhār+yā ma no dz+nyā/snyechung ma yid 'ong ma/bhār+yā ka spyo bhā/— chung ma dge ba ma/ bhārlu su bha ba// chung ma skal bzang ma/ bhārlu dur+bha ba//— chung ma skal ngan ma/ (1na/ tso sa na//——chung mamanyam pa mo/ bhān/ tha pa ba// chung ma rtsab rtsob ma/ bhān/ sa/ / —chungam nor can ma/ kaspyo bhā sa ce 3—'a//snye btsun mo dge ba mo/ bhārlu kān+ta/——chung ma mdzes ma/bhārlubha khye/——chungamamatshar mo/ ka s+thā bhā du hi tā/snyebumodage ba mo/ ta se khā di ṭī 3kṛ twa sutsaḥ—/ ta si la sogs nas kṛ twa su tsa'i bar rnams so/ /de phan gyi rkyen ta si la sogs nas bzung kṛ twa sutsa'i bar rnams kyi mtha' can dang sbyor ba yang skyes pa bzhin du 'gyur te/ dripa —rū pa ba tī tasmrata/——gzugs ldan ma de las/ zhes pa la / rnam dbye lnga pa'i rjes phyis/ de'i don de phan gyi rkyen ta si la byen/la dang i 'gro ba'i ming can mdo 'dis skyes pa bzhin du 'gyur/ rū pa bat+ta taḥ / ——gzugs ldan ma de las/ de bzhin du/ kṛ twa su tsa'i rkyen can la/ rū pa ba tī pañca kṛ twaḥ/ zhes pa la/ rū pa bat+pañca kṛ twaḥ/——gzugs ldan ma lnga po/ de bzhin du / tsa ra ṭa'i rkyen la'ang skyes pa bzhin du 'gyur te/ ā sgyu tsa raḥ/— phyug por spyod ma/ zhes pa la/ ā sgyu /chetsa raḥ/ phyugapor spyod ma/ yang 'grel par lung drangs pa/dzā tī ya kalpa de sh+ya de shī ya rū pya pā shā do/ dzā tī ya kalpa de sha ⑤ de shi ya rū pya pā sha sogs la'o/ /de phan gye rkyen dzā ti ya la sogs pa 'di rnams pha rol la yang skyes pa bzhin du 'gyur te/ pa ṭī dzā tī ya/ zhes pa la/ pa ṭu dzā tī ya/ snyemakhasama'i rigs/ de babyu/na du/ pa ṭī kalpa/snyemakhas ma'i dus/ zhes pa la/ pa ṭu kalpa / mkhas ma'i dus/ paṭī de sh+ya/ zhes pa la/ pa ṭu de byu/ pa ṭī de shī ya/zhes pa la/ pa ṭu de shrī ya thu/ pa ṭī rū pya/ zhes pa la/ pa ṭu rū pya/ pa 117—328

ṭī pā sha/ zhes pa la/ pa ṭu pā sha/ yang 'grel par/ twa dang tal dag gi rkyen dag las kyang skyes pa bzhin du 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ ta ṭī twa—/ snyemakhas ma nyid/ zhes pa la/ pa ṭu two/ —mkhas ma nyid/ de bzhin du/ pa ṭī ta / snyemakhasam nyid/ zhes pa la/ pa ṭu tā/ —mkhasam nyid/ yang 'grel par/ sha'i rkyen pha rol las kyang skyes pa bzhin du 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ ba tī sha/ zhes pa la—/ ba hu shā① ཿ/ yang 'grel par lung drangs pa/ kuklu ṭ+wā dī nā maṇ+ḍa di 6/kuklu ṭī sogs kyi aṇ+ḍa sogs la'o/ /aṇ+ḍa sogs pha rol la kuklu ṭī sogs kyis ri rngo skyes pa bzhin du 'gyur te/ kuklu t+yā aṇ+ḍi ya su/ gang gi bya mo'i sgo nga / zhes pa la/kuklu ṭā ṇ+ḍi/snyekhyimabya ma'i sgo nga / de bzhin du/ mṛ gyu pa rda ya gya/ —gang gi ri dwags mo'i rkang pa/zhes pa la/ mṛ ga pa rda/— ri dwags mo'i rkang pa/ mṛ gyu hūṃ ram̐ ya su/— gang gi ri dwags mo'i 'o ma/zhes pa la/ ridwags mo'i 'o ma/ —mṛ ga spyi re/ kā kā yāḥshā pa ya su/snyegang gi bya rog mo'i phrug gu/ zhes pa la/ kā ka shā baḥ/ kyad+mā ni nobya/ byarogamo'i phrug gu/ kyang mā ni ni dag las kyang ngo / /ming byings su bsgrubs pa'i rkyen gyi nang tshan kyang pha rol dang / mā ni ni'i sgra pha rol las kyang skyes pa bzhin 'gyur te/ e ṭī cho.i bā tsa ra ti/——ri dwags mo 'dra bar rloms/ zhes pa la/ e shā ya te yā dzā/snyeri dwags mo 'dra bar rlom ster ma/ dar+sha nī yī mā ni bhā ya su/ —gang gi mthong bar sems/ zhes pa la/ dar+sha nī ya mā ni nī/snyemathongabar sems/ na ko pa d+mā yāḥ/ ka u pa d+ma'i ma yin no/ /de phan gyi ka u pa dh+wa na yod pa la skyes pa bzhin 'gyur ba ma yin te/ pā tsi kā bhārlu ya su—/ snyegang gi chung ma 'tshed pa mo/ zhes pa la/ pā tsi kā bhāzla /snyechungama'atshed pa mo/ de bzhin du/ra se kā bhār+yā ya su/snyegang gi chung ma grung mo/ zhes pa la/ ra si kā rngubhābyu /——chung ma grung mo/ma dri kā bhār+yā ya su/——gang gi chung ma bzang mo/ zhes pa la/ ma dri kā bhār+yāḥ/snyechung ma bzang mo/117—329

de phan gyi ka'i rkyen yin kyang a ka yin na skyes pa bzhin du 'gyur te/ pā kā bhār+yā ya gya/ —gang gi chung ma 'tshed pa mo/ zhes pa la/ pā ka bhār+yā saṃ dz+nyā pū ra byo bya/—chung ma 'tshed mo/ ming rdzogs pa —1dag las kyang ngo / /bud med kyi ming dang rdzogs pa'i don gyi rkyen can dag kyang skyes pa bzhin du 'gyur ba ma yin te/ dat+tha bhār+yā ya gya / gang gi chung ma byin ma/ zhes pa la/ daṭ+wā bhābyu / chung ma byin ma/ de ba'i/na du/ patso m+bi bhār+yā ya gya/ gangagichung ma lnga pa/ zhes pa la/ pañca m+bi bhābyu / chungamalnga pa/ bṛdhi ni mit+ta su tsa tasgota snga rak+ta bi kā re/ 'phel ba'i rgyu mtshan can gyi de phan gyi'ang dmar por byed pa ma yin pa la'o/ /de phan gyi rkyen nya ṇa rjes su 'byel pa lta bu rtags snga ma de la 'phel ba yong ba'i rgyu mtshan can mdog dmar por byed pa'i don can gye rkyen ma yin pa pha rol la yang skyes pa bzhin du 'gyur ba ma yin te/de phan aṇa/ sro spyo bhār+yā ya su/ gang gi yu la sro sdi'i chung ma/ zhes pa lta bu la thung ngur mi 'gyur/sro spyo bhār+yaḥ/ yu lasro lci'i chung ma/ de bzhin du/ mā thu rī bhār+yā ya su/ gang gi yul bcom brlag bi chung ma/ zhes pa la/ de phan aṇa/ mā thu rī bhār+yaḥ/ —yul bcom/ brlag gi chung ma/swāṅgābye to mā ni bhā/ rang lus las kyang yīta kyi mā ni byā ma yin pa la'o/ / rang gi lus kyi sgra brjod pa'i bud med kyi rtags yīta mtha' can rnams kyang pha rol tu mā ni byā ma yin pa na skyes pa bzhin du 'gyur ba ma yin te/ su ke shī bhār+yā ya gya/ gang gi chung ma skra mdzes ma/ zhes pa la/ su ke shī bhār+yaḥ/— chung ma skra mdzes ma/mā ni nī yin na rang lus yin yang skyes pa bzhin 'gyur te/ su ke shī mu ni dī ya sru/ / — gang gi skra mdzes ma sems/ cenas pa 'a / sdo/ te/ sa/ na/ :de bye// skra mdzes ma sems/ dzā/ tebya / rigs kyi'ang ngo / /rigs brjod pa can bud med kyi rtags dīṣa mtha' can yang skyes pa bzhin du 'gyur ba ma yin te/ driṣa— drwah+ma bhā bhār+yā ya 117—330

gya—/ snyegang gi chung ma bram ze mo/ zhes pa la/ thung ngur mi 'gyur/ rīṣa— drwah+ma bhā bhāzla /snyechung ma bram ze mo/ saṃ khya yā bya yā san+d+ra dru rā dhi ka saṃ spyoḥsaṃ khye ye/ grangs kyi mi zad pa ā san+da.a dru ra a dhi ka rnams dang grangs rnams grangs la'o/ /grangs dang mi zad pa—/ ā san+da/ a dru ra/ a bye ka rnams sbyor ba dang grangs rnams dang grangs sbyor ba yang don gcig pa 'bru mang po'i bsdu bar 'gyur ro/ /ba hu bye ho saṃ khye ye ḍa tsa ba hu ga ṇata/ 'bru mang po la grangs la ḍatsa ste ba hu ga ṇa ma yin pa las so/ /'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'i mtha' las grangs kyi sgra la ba hu dang ga ṇa ma yin pa la ḍatsa'i rkyen 'jug ste/ u pa ga taḥd sha ye ྾ te/—gang rnams kyi de rnams nye bar 'go ba bcu/ zhes pa la/ bshad ma thag pa'i mdo snga mas rnam dbye phrad dang bcas pa phyis/ u pa da shan/ zhes pa la/ mdo 'dis ḍatsa/ tsu ṭu sogs kyis tsa phyis/ ṭi dbyi 'os an phyis/ ḍa de'i don yin pas phyis/dzas—/ u pa da shāḥ/——ste bar bcu rnams/ ti bo sha teḍiti/ dzi sha ti'i ḍa 'gro ba la ti'o/ /ḍa 'gro ba'i rkyen pha rol la bo sha ti zhes pa'i ṭi dbye bar ma zad ti yang dbyi ste/ ā san+daḥbo sha ti ya gya/ gangagistan nyi shu/ zhes pa la/ grangs kyi mi zad pa ā san+da sogs kyi mdos rnam dbye phrad dang bcas pa phyis/ 'bru mang po zhes pas/ ḍatsa mdo 'dis ti phyis/ ḍa 'gro ba la ṭi phyis/ ā saṃn+da bo shāḥ—/ ——stananyi shu/ de bzhin du/ a dru raḥbo sha ti ya gya/snyegang gi ring ba ma yin pa nyi shu/ zhes pa la/ a dru ra bo shāḥ/snyenyebanyishu/ a dhi kaḥdzi shā hūṃti ya gya/—gang gi lhag po nyi shu/zhes pa la/ a bye ka bo shāḥ/——lhagapo nyi shu/ grangs dang grangs sbyor ba la/ dwo tra yaḥbā mā ā+oṃ ye ྾ te/snyegang rnams kyi tshad de rnams gnyis dag gsum rnams kyang / zhes pa la/rnam dbye phrad sogs phyis/ ḍatsa dwo tāḥ/ gnyisagasum/ ba hu dang ga ṇa las ḍatsa 117—331

mi 'jug ste/ u pa ba hu ya gya/ gangasganye ba mang ngo / zhes pa la/ u pa ba ha baḥ / nyebamang po rnams/ de bzhin du/ sngo/ pa ga kho ya su/ —gang sga nye ba tshogs/ zhes pa la/u pa ga zlaḥ/ tshogs pa/ nye ba/ 'grel par lung drangs pa/ saṃ khyu yāstah+phu ru ṣa gya ḍatsa / grangs 1la de'i skyes bu'i ḍatsa'o/ /'bru mang por ma zad grangs la de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba'i mtha' las kyang ḍatsa'i rkyen 'gyur te/ nitro sha taḥ.i 2gu li khyuḥ/ ngan pa mdzub mo sum cu/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye phrad pa dang bcas pa phyis/nitro shata la/ ḍatsa/ ṭi phyis/ ni— shaḥ/ ngan pa sum cu/ didh+wa mā bye ta rā le/phyogs mtshams kyi ming la'o/ /shar lho zhes pa lta bu phyogs mtshams kyi ming rjod par byed pa na yang 'bru mang po'i bsdu bar 'gyur te/ dak+ṣi ṇa pūr+pā yāḥ.i ta rā lo / lho shar gyi ma/tshams/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye phrad dang bcas pa phyis/ dak+ṣi ṇa pūrbaḥ / shar lho/ ta tra te ṣ+pe da mi ti sa rū pe/ de la des 'di zhes rang bzhin mthun pa na'o/ /g.yul du de la bzung ba dang / des phrogs 5pa 'di zhes brjod pa'i supa mtha' rnams rang bzhin mthun pa na don gcig par 'bru mang po'i bsdu bar 'gyur ro/ /a bye ṣā ma pi dṛ sh+ya te/ gzhan yang mthong ngo / /bshad ma thag pa'i don de rnams tshang ba don gcig par 'gyur bar ma zad gzhan yang bsdu ba byas pa'i rtags snga ma'i mtha' de atsa gang yin kyang pha rol atsa thog ma can ma yin pa la ā ring mtha' can du'ang 'gyur ro/ /itsa karma bya ti hā re/ g.yul gyi las la itsa'o/ /g.yul byi don 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba byas pa'i mtha' la itsa'i rkyen 'jug ste/ ke she 6 ke she 6 kṛ tī tā i rda yur+ghaṃ pra bṛtrī / skra rnams la skra rnams la bzung nas 'di rab tu 'khrug pa'i tshul/ zhes pa la/ de la des 'di sogs kyi mdos rnam dbye phrad dang bcas pa phyis/ ke sha ke sha /zhes pa la/717—332

gzhan yang mthong ngo zhes pa'i mdos rtags snga ma'i a thung āta/ mdo 'dis itsa / ke shā ke shi/ skra'athab/ de bzhin du/ daṇ+ḍi bya daṇ+ḍibya i rda yudhe pra z-itrī / dbyug pa dang dbyug pa bzung nas 'di rab tu 'khrug pa/'i spyod pa/ ni1 / zhes pa la/ daṇ+ḍa daṇ+ḍi / dbyug 'thab/ muṣ+ṭi bhiḥmuji bheḥ.i rda yudhi pra bṛr+ghaṃ/ khu tshur rnams kyis khu tshur rnams kyis 'di rab tu 'khrug pa 'i tshul ni/ zhes pa la/ muṣ+ṭa myuṣ+ṭi/ 'dzog 'thab/ orgu ṇaḥ/ u'i yon tan no/ /rtags gang zhig u yig mtha' can yin pa de'i pha rol tu de phan gyi rkyen byung na u yig de nyid yon tan du 'gyur te/ bā tū byaḥbā tū bhiḥ.i rda yurnyi pra dṛtrī/ lag pa/ rnams kyis lag pa rnams kyis 'di rab tu 'khrug pa/'i tshul / stunas pa 'ab/ bo/nga chab rnams dang 'dra bar rnam dbye phrad sogs phyis/ rtags gong ma āta — itsa/mdo 'dis yon tan/ bā hā bā ha bi/ laga'athab/ a se bheḥ.a se bheḥ.i rda yur+ghaṃ pra bṛtrī / gre rnams kyis gri rnams kyis 'dir rab tu 'khrug nga 'i tshul / zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs bsdus / 'di'i rtags snga ma'i mtha' pha rol atsa yin pas ār mi 'gyur/itsa / a su se/ gre'athab/ rang bzhin mthun pa ma yin na bsdu ba mi 'jug ste/dper na/ ha le na mu sha le na i rda yur+ghaṃ pra bṛr+ghaṃ/ thong pa/ yis gtun r+shang sgas 'di rab tu 'khrug pa'i tshul / zhes pa lta bu la bsdu ba mi 'jug go/ /te na sa he ti tu l+ya yo ge/de yis sa ha zhes pa'i mnyam pa'i sbyor ba la'o/ /de yis zhes pa gsum pa'i mtha' sa ha mnyam pa'i spyor ba la don gcig pa 'bru mang po'i bsdu bar 'gyur ro/ /po pa sardza na su/ yang na nyer bsgyur ro/ /'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir sa ha zhes pa yang na sa zhes par 'gyur zhing sa ru 'gyur ba de la nyer bsgyur zhes ming 'dogs byed de dgos pa ni sa de rtags gang yin pa de'i sngon du 'jog pa'i ched yin te/ pu tre 4 ṇa sa haḥ/ budang bcas pa / zhes pa la/ de 717—333

tri mūr+bhaḥ/ mgobo gsum/ an+tarba hidz+nyā tsa lasna ཿ/ an+tar/ ba hir dag las kyang lo man las so/ /an+tar ba hir dag las pha rol gyi lo man las 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'i mtha' las apa rkyen du 'gyur te/ an+tarlo mā naḥya snga sau/ gang gi nang sga ba spu 'di/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye phrad sogs bsdus apa byen/ pa 'gro ba'i ming can ṭi phyis/ arnyarlo maḥ/ nangaspu/ de bzhin du/ ba hirlo mā naḥya snga sau/ gang bi phyi'i ba spu 'di/ zhes pa la/ ba hirlo maḥ/ phyispu/ atsa nā si kā yāḥsaṃ dz+nyā yī na saṃ bārdzu 'do ted+ngha / sna la ma yin pa las nā se kā'i ming la atsa ste nas kyang ngo / /sna la zhes pa'i sgra sngon na yod pa ma yin pa'i nā se kā las ming brjod pa la 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'i mtha' la a tsa rkyen du 'gyur zhing de'i tshe/ nā se kā nyid kyang nas zhes par 'gyur ro/ /pūrba pa dāhūṃ zlo yā ma gaḥ/ snga ma'i tshig las ming la ga ma lin —pa las so/ /'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir/ snga ma'i tshig de la na ṇar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can gyi yi ge yod na tshig gcig ma yin kyang ga yig ma gtogs pa'i yi ge gzhan bar na yod kyang na ṇar 'gyur te/ du ri ba nā se kā ya khru/ gang na sna bug ngan nga/ 'dra ba/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs phyis/mdo sngon mas atsa dang / nā si kā nas su 'gyur/ mdo 'dis na ṇar/dur+ṇa saḥ/ sna ngan nam sna mi mdzes pa// de bzhin du/ kha re ba nā si kā ya su5/ gang bi sna bong bu 'dra ba/ zhes pa la/ kha ra ṇa saḥ/ bongasna/ yang na/ kha ra zlaḥ/ sna la sngon na yod na nas su mi 'gyur te/ bh+yo lo nā se kā ya su/ gang bi sna sbo ma ngo / zhes pa la/ nas su mi 'gyur/ atsa byin/ bh+yo la nā se kaḥ/ snasbomapo/ 'grel par lung drangs pa/ khur kha rā hūṃ bā/ khu ra kha ra dag las yang na'o/ /khu ra dang kha ra dag snga ma la/ nā si kā nas su 'gyur zhing / atsa yang na 'gyur 117—335
