te / khu re ba nā si kā ya mya/ gang ji sna mig pa/ 'dra ba/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs bsdus/ nā si kā/ nas su 'gyur/ atsa yang na bar byas pas/khya ra zlaḥ/ rmigapa/ 'dra ba'i sna/ khu ra ṇa saḥ/— rmig nga/ 'dra ba'i sna/ u pa sanātsu/ nyer bsgyur las kyang ngo / /nyer bsgyur snga ma'i nā se kā yang nas su 'gyur zhing atsa yang na 'gyur ro/ /u pa sanāta ba hu 1 lo/ nyer bsgyur las mang po'o/ /'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir/ nye bsgyur la na ṇar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can gyi yi ge yod na/ na de skabs la lar ṇar 'gyur ba dang la lar mi 'gyur ba sogs mang po 'byung ngo / /pra kak+ṣe ṇa nā se kā ya su/ gang gi sna rab tu ma dzes nga zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs basbus/ mdo snga mas nā si kā nas/ atsa/mdo 'dis na ṇa/ pra ṇa saḥ/ snarab/ de bzhin du/ uñciḥnā se kā ya su/ sang sna ma thon po// zhes pa la/ uta na saḥ/ sna ma/thon ngo// 'grel par lung drangs pa/beḥgraḥ / bi las gra'o/ /nyer bsgyur 4bi sngon du byung na nā si kā zhes pa ni gra zhes par 'gyur te/ bi ga tā nā se kā ya myu sau/ gang si sna rnam/ pa ra song ba 'di/ zhes pa la / be+e graḥ/ snamed/ nanya duḥsu bh+yo ha li sasbyo ra n+ya ta ra sde/ nanya dur su rnams/ las ha li sasbri las yang na'o/ /nanya dang dur dang su rnams snga ma'i ha li dang salbi dag la 'bru mang po'i bsnyu ba'i mtha' la atsa yang na 'gyur te/ na ha li ya gya/ gang bi thod nga med pa / zhes pa la/ phrad sogs phyis/ atsa yang na bar byas pas/ a ha laḥ/ thodamed/ a ha liḥ/ thodamed/ de bzhin du/ na salbi ya su/ bang bi mdung med/ zhes pa la/ a sagh+raḥ/ mdung med/ a salbiḥ/ su ha laḥ thod pa bzang ngo 'am legs ngo / su ha liḥ/ su sagh+raḥ/ ma/dung bzang po/'am mdzes ngo 'am legs ngo —/ su salbiḥ/ duḥ ha laḥ/ thod pa/ ngan nga// duḥha liḥ/ duḥsagh+raḥ/ ma/dung ngan 177—336

pa / snyeduḥsalbiḥ/ ni t+ya ma sitsa pra dzā me dha yoḥ/ pra dzā me dha dag la rtag tu a sitsa'o//nanya dang dur dang su rnams sngon na yod pa'i pra dzā dang me dha dag la 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'i mtha' las rkyen a setsa rtag tu 'gyur te/ na pra dzāḥya gya/ —gang gi skye dgu med pa/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye rjes 'brang sogs phyis/ a setsa tsa rjes 'byel/ i brjod don/ skyedagumed pa/ a pra dzāḥ/ —asitsa su/ de bzhin du/dzas ——duḥpra dzā ཿya su/ gang gi skye bo ngan pa/ chenas pa la/ asitsa su/ duḥpra jo ཿ/ skye bo ngan pa/dzasasnyesu pra ja ཿya gya/ gang gi skye bo bzang po/ zhes pa la/ a sitsa su/ su pra ja ཿ/ skye bo bzang po—/ dzas —na ces d+maḥpa/ sru//—gang gi blo gros med pa / chenas pa 'a / asitsa su phyag ces dh+wa1 ཿ/ blo gros med pa/ dzas duḥme dh+waḥpa su// gang gi blo gros ngan pa / chenas pa la/ asetsasu dum+bi dh+waḥ / snyeblo gros ngan pa/ dzas ——su me ṅgāḥya su/ gang bi blo gros bzang po/ zhes pa la/ su me dh+waḥ / snyeblogros bzang po/ dharmā da ni tsa ke ba lāta/ gcig las dharma las a ni tsa'o//'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir sngon du rtags gnyis gsum sogs med pa/rtags gang yang rung ba gcig sngon na yod pa'i dharma las rkyen a ni tsa 'gyur te/ka spyo ṇa dham+bi ya gya/ gang gi dge bas chos/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye phrad sogs bsdus/a ni tsa byin/ tsa rjes 'byel i brjod don/ chos dashe ba — ka spyo ṇa dharmā/ snyarman la su su phyis na'i u nga/ dh+wa ring po ming mtha'i na dbyis pa'o/ /jugag gnyis sogs yod na a ni tsa mi 'gyur ba'i dpe ni/ su pra dharmo ya su/ chos gang gi rab tu bzang ngo// zhes pa la/rnam dbye phrad sogs phyis/ su pra dharmaḥ/ rab tu bzang ba'i chos/ dak+ṣi ṇirmā lubha yo ge/dak+ṣi ṇirmā bsnun pa'i sbyor ba la'o/ /dak+ṣi ṇirmā/ ri dwags gzhogs g.yas phub pa / zhes pa mda' bsnun pa lta bu'i ri dwags gzhogs rman pa can brjod pa la 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba tshig phrad do/ /pra sa: gidzā nu no dz+nyāḥ/ pra sam dag la dzā nu na gyi 117—337

dz+nyā'o / /'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir nyer bsgyur pra dang sam sngon du byung na/ dza nu na zhes pa'i sgra tshu zhes par 'gyur te/ pra ga te dz+wa nu m+bi ya su / mgyogs pa'i pus mo/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye phrad sogs bsdus/khye dzā nu tshuru 'gyur / pra tshuḥ/ pusamo rab/ de bzhin du/ saṃ dzā nu byā ya gya/ gang ji pus mo legs ngo// zhes pa la/ saṃdz+nyāḥ/— pusamo legs po/ 'grel par lung drangs pa/ uspyo dī bhā ṣā/ urja las yang na'o/ /urja sngon ma'i dzā nun yang dz+nyā zhes par 'gyur ba dang mi 'gyur ba 'dam ka can te/ ur+ghaṃ dzā nu nī ya su/ gang gi pus rngo/ sbam po/zhes pa la/ lnga/rja ja nuḥ/ pusamo/ sbo ma ngo// yang na/ ཿ/rja tshuḥ/ pus mo sbom ngo// dha nu ṣabya/ dha nu ṣa'i 'ang ngo / /'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir dha nu ṣa zhes pa'i mtha' a nang du 'gyur te/ shāṅga dha nu ra su/ gzhu sra ba 'di/ zhes pa la / rnam dbye phrad sogs bsdus mtha' a nang du 'gyur/ nga rjes 'brel na'i srog a brjod don/ shāṅga dha nā/ ṣa a nang du bsgyur dha nu an la su na'i u nga/ dh+wa ring ngo/ hal sogs kyis su phyis ming ma/tha'i na phyis i7 ji atsa la yaṇa byas nga 'o gzhu sra ba/ ṇ+ḍa/ pa/ pa/ cigangar / jo/ pa/lnga/ ninga'o / /'bru mang po'i bsdu ba byas pa'i dzā yā zhes pa'i mtha' ning zhes par 'gyur te/ yu ba ti dzā yā ya su/ bang sga chung ma/ dar ma// zhes pa la/ rnam dbye phrad sogs phyis/ yā las ā phyung ā de ning du 'gyur nga rjes 'brel/ yu ba dzā phra ni / su/ lo po borlu yi/ bra yu dag gi wal la jedabyi'o/ /byings dang byings ma yin pa'i 'ang lnga srog med 3dang bra srog med dag wal so sor 9bsdu ba'i yi ge gang rung pha rol la dbyi ste/ yu ba dzā niḥ/ chung ma dar bab/ de bzhin du/dīdzhaiḥdzhai shaṃḥya/ rdo rdoXtsha/na rdobye di rdo rdo rdo/rngo ba/ zang rte byepabye mobye bye' bye phubye ༵ kau rdo py-i// zhedhibye dh+ri / 117—338

med du brjod pa na/ pā da/ pad du ①'gyur ba dang dīpa sbyin pas kum+bha pa dī sogs tshig phrad du bya ste/ kum+bha su ①pā do i ba pā do yasu/— gang gi rkang pa bum pa'i rkang pa/ 'dra ba dag /zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs bsdus/ kum+bha ⑦pā da④ཿ/snyebum rkang /de bud med du brjod pa na mdo 'dis/ kum+bha pa dī/snyebumarkang ma/ de bzhin du/sha ta pā dāḥya gya/ —gang gi rkang pa brgya rnams/ chenas pa la/ sha ta pā daḥ/snyerkang pa brgya pa/sha ta pa dī/ rkangapabargya ma/ saṃ byu su pūrba su/ grangs dang su snga ma'i'o/ /grangs kyi sgra rnams dang nyer bsgyur su sngon na yod pa'i pā da'i mtha' yang 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir dbyi ste/ dwo pā do ya su/snyegang gi rkang pa gnyis/ zhes pa la/dī pāta/snyerkangapa gnyis/—dī pādu/ de bzhin du/ sa ha sra pā dāḥya mya⑤/——gang gi rkang pa stong / chenas pa la/ sa ha sras pād/ rkangapastong / saha sras nga/ta/ —rkang pa stong / sdo pā do ya su/— gang gi rkang pa mdzes pa/ zhes pa la/ su pāta/——rkangamadzes/——su pād/ ba ya se dan+ta su da dṛ/ na tshod la dan+ta'i da tro'o/ /'bru mang po'i bsdu ⑥ba'i skabs 'dir na tshod brjod pa'i don dang 'byel pa'i dan+ta ni su dang grangs sngon du byung na da dṛ zhes par 'gyur te/ dwo darnyo ya gya/snyegang gi so dag gnyis/ zhes pa la/rnam dbye sogs phyis/ darnya da dṛ ru 'gyur/ ṛ uka ⑦'gro ba la rnu gyi don/dī ngan/snyed tro la su uka 'gro ba rnams la nu ma ṛ de'i don yin pas phyis ha la sogs kyis su phyis brtsegs pa'i mtha' dbyi 'os ra phyis/ so gnyis/ de bzhin du/ tsa twa raḥdan+taḥya su/—gang gi so bzhi pa rnams/zhes pa la/ tsa turdan/snyesobazhi pa/ de bzhin du/ ṣaṭā dad+dhāḥya su/—gang gi so drug pa/zhes pa la/ ṣe sha na/ so drug pa ste rta bong / su dar+sāḥ' su / —gang gi so mdzes/ chenas pa la/su dan/ —so mdzes te dar bab/ na tshod kyi / zu don can min na da trer mi 'gyur te/dwo darnyo ya su/ zhes pa la/ dī dan+ta ka rī/snyemache gnyis pa ste glang po che/ a 4 ta shudha 117—340

shu bh+ra dṛ ṣa bā rā he bh+ya:/ a gra an+ta shudhe shu bh+ra bṛ ṣa bā rā ha rnams las kyang ngo //a gra la sogs pa 'di rnams sngon du byung na 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir dan+ta ni da tro ru yang na 'gyur te/ kuphe la s+thā gra darnyo ya su/ gang sga so gug pa/'i rtse mo/zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs phyis/ dan+ta da dṛ ru yang na 'gyur bas/ kuzlu lā gra darnyaḥ/ sogugapa'i rtse mo/ kurja la gra dan/ de bzhin du/ shudheḥdarnyo ya sum / — gang gi so gtsang ma/ cenas pa 'a / sdo/dhe dan+taḥ/ so gtsang ma/ sdo/dha 2)na/ so gtsang ma/shu khyuḥdarnyo ya su/ gangasga so da7ra po/ zhes pa la/ shu bh+ra dan+taḥ/ so da7ra po/ shu bh+ra dan / sod7ra ngo// dṛ ṣa su dadho ya su/ gangabi glang gi so/ zhes pa la/ dṛ ṣa dan+taḥ/ glang so / —dṛ 2 ṣa dan/ bā rā ha su dasto ya gya/ gangan phag pa 'i so/ zhes pa la/ bā rā ha dan+taḥ / — phag so/ bā rā ha dan/ phagaso/ 'grel par kyang gi sgras mū ṣa ka dang a hi gnyis las kyang / yang na bar bshad pas/ mū ṣa ka su darnyo ya su/ gang sga byi ba'i so/ cenas pa la/ 4/ ṣa ka dan+taḥ/ byiso/ dza/ ṣa ka dan/ byiso/ de babyu/na du/a heḥdadho ya su/ gang gi snyul gyi so/ zhes pa la/ a hi dan+taḥ/ sgrul so / a hi dan / sbrul so/ ka ku da snga bas+thā yī lo paḥ/ ka ku da yi na tshod la dbyi'o/ /'bru mang po'i bsdu — ba'i skabs 'dir na tshod kyi don dang 'brel ba'i ka ku da zhes pa'i mtha' dbyi ste/ a dzā tai ka ku rda ya gya/ gang sga tshogs/ ma ma gang ba/ zhes pa la/rnam dbye sogs phyis/ ka ku da'i mtha' yang phyis/ a dzā ta ka kud/ tshogs ma ma gang ba ste byis pa/ chung ngu / yi/ dzā ta ka kuta/ tshogs ma ma/ gang ba ste byes pa/ chung ngu / de bzhin du/pūrte ka ku do ya su/ —gang sga tshogs ma gang ba/ zhes pa la/ pūr+ṇa ka kud/ tshogs ma gang ba ste dar la bab pa/ pūr+ṇa ka kuta/ tshogs ma gang ba ste dar la bab pa// u dī rgyu 4 ka ku da su/uta bi dag las ka ku da yi'o/ /'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir nyer 5117—341

la aṇa gyi thung ngu'o zhes pas rkyen ka yig pha rol la aṇa so sor bsdu ba'i atsa ring po rnams thung ngur 'gyur yang dmigs snabasal rkyen kapa la thung ngur 'gyur ba ma yin te/ ba hu labyu/ཿ'a smin de she/ gang la phun sum tshogs pa/ mang ngo/'i yul/ zhes pa la/rnam dbye sogs bsdus/ na dī ṛta mtha' dag la'ang ngos kapa/ mdo 'dis thung ngur mi 'gyur/ ba hu lasmre kā/ dpal mo mang ngo// she ṣā dī bhā ṣā/ lhag ma las 'dam ka'obye / /sngar bshad zin pa bud med du brjod par ma zad lhag ma ste mdo 'di nas bzung bud med du brjod pa dang bud med du brjod pa ma yin pa la'ang kapa ster ba dang mi ster ba 'dam ka can du bya ste/ ba hu daṇ+ḍi naḥyasmin de she/ — gang la dbyug pa/ can mang ngo 'i yu la/ zhes pa la rnam dbye sogs bsdus/kapa 'dam ka can du byas pas/ ba hu daṇ+ḍi kaḥ/ dbyug pa/ can mang ngo / yang na/dbyug pa can mang ngo / ba sdom 1(ṇ+ḍi//— daṇ+ḍi la su in ha na sogs kyis na ring ngo / ming mtha'i na hal sogs kyis su phyis pa/'o/ /ā po3n+ya ta ra sde/ āpa kyi yang na'o/ /spyir btang rkyen kapa pha rol la aṇa thung ngur mi 'gyur bar bshad kyang / de'i dmigs bsal 4rkyen kapa pha rol la āpa gematha' can thung ngur yang na 'gyur te/ ba hu mā lā ya gya / gang gi phreng ba mang po ma/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs phyis/ lhag ma las 'dam 6 ka 'os/ kapa yang na bar byas byin pa'i phyogs la mdo 'dis thung ngur 'gyur ram mi 'gyur ba yang na bar byas pas/ ba hu mā la dzakaḥ/ —phreng ba mang ngo// ba hu mā khā kaḥ/ ba hu mā laḥ/— phrengab mang ngo / yang 'grel par/ ā pa rmematha' can ma yin kyang ā yig mtha' can kapa pha rol la yang na thung ngur 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas—/ su so ma pā ya snga byesau/snyegang gi legs par zhi ba 'thung ba 'di/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye dbyi ba sogs gong ltar bsgrubs pas/ su so ma pa kaḥ/ —legs par zhi ba 'thung ba/117—343

su so ma pā kaḥ/ legs par zhi ba 'thung ba/ su so ma pā/ legs nga/ra zhi ba 'thung / na saṃ dz+nyā lnga/ming la ma yin no/ /dngos po gang gi 'ang ming brjod pa la 'bru mang po'i ri1 bsdu ba'i mtha' la kapa 'gyur ba ma yin te/ bi shwa gya de bāḥ.a su/ sna tshogs kyi lha 'di/zhes pa la/ rjes 'byel sogs phyis kapa mi 'jug /bi shwa de baḥ/ sna tshogs lha/yī ya sabya/ yī yas kyi'ang ngo / /rkyen yī yas spyor ba'i rtags la yang 'bru mang po'i basbu ba'i mtha' las kapa 'gyur ba ma yin te/ ba ha baḥ gre yī saḥ.a sra / dbe ba ma nga ngo 'di/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs phyis/ kapa mi 'jug /ba hu gre yān/ rngo ya su 'a su u la 'gro ba so bas kyis num u de'i don u pa/ ṅgā ring ngo brtsegs pa 'i ma tha' dbyi 'os /sa phyis / hal so sas kyis su phyis / dang la ma nga ngo / bajo te bhā tuḥ/ bstod pa la bhā dṛ yi'o/ /bstod pa'i sgra don brjod pa'i bhā tre las 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'i mtha' la kapa mi 'jug ste/ su sgyu tā ya su/ sang bi spu na zla bzang ngo / rnam dbye sogs phyis/ kapa mi 'jug /su khyu tā/ spu na zla bzang / bstod pa'i don ma yin na kapa 'gyur te/mūkho bhā tā ya su/ sang si spu na zla glen nga / zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs phyis/ kapa byin / mūkho bhā tre kaḥ/ spunazla glen nga / sarba nā ma saṃ khya yoḥsarba nā ma grangs dag gi'o / /'bru mang po'i bsdu ba la sarba sogs dang grangs kyi sgra rnams ni rtags gnyis sam gsum sogs gang yod kyang rtags de dag gi sngon du 'jog — ste/saza shwe to 4bir+ya te ya snga sau/ gang bi tham sa cad dakhrer ngo ra yod pa 'di/ zhes pa la/ sarba shwe taḥ/ thams cad da7ra ngo / de bzhin du/ dwo shuklo bir+ya te ya gya/ gang sga gnyis dag da7ra ngo/ zhes pa la/ dī shuklaḥ/ dalar ngo/ gnyis / ṣ+pen+d+ra di bh+yaḥ/ in+d+ra sogs rnams las ma yin no/ /spyir btang 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir tshig sbyor gyi skabs rnam dbye bdun pa thob pa tshig gral bsgrigs kyi phyi ma la yod na bsdu ba 117—344

tshar nas sngon du 'jog dgos kyang / dmigs bsal she.in+d+ra sogs ni phyi mar spo ba ma yin te/ in+d+ra rū mas ya su/ gang gi rtsa ba la zla ba/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs phyis/ rū lo zhes pa la bdun pa byin pa yin kyang de'i pha rol tu in+d+ra mi spo / in+d+ra rū liḥ/ — rtsabal zla ba/ de bzhin du/ gang sga dpral ba la zla ba in+d+ra she kha re ya su/ zhes pa la/ in+d+ra she kha raḥ/ dpral ba zla ba/ shaṃ khaṃ pā ṇi ya su/ gang bi phyas na dung / zhes pa la/ phyagan dung / shaṃ kha pā ṇiḥ tsakraḥpā rto ya su/ gang si phyag na 'khor lo— zhes pa la/ tsakra pā ṇiḥ/ phyagan 'khor 'o / badz+raḥpā ṇi bir+ya te ya su saḥ/ gangagi phyag na rdo rje yod pa de/ zhes pa la/ badz+ra pā ṇiḥ/ phyag na rdo rje/ pad+maḥpā ṇi bir+ya te ya su saḥ / gang gi phyag na pa/d+ma yod pa de/ zhes pa la/ pad+ma pā ṇiḥ/ phyagan nga d+ma/ pad+maḥnā r+bha bir+ya te ya gya/ gang sga lte ba la pa d+ma yod nga/ de/ zhes pa la/ pad+ma nā bheḥ/ lte bar pa/d+ma/ nibye/niṣ+ṭha'o—/ /byings las 'das pa'i don brjod pa can 5gyi rkyen nijo'i ming can k+ta dang k+ta ba tu'i rkyen can yang 'bru mang po'i bsru ba'i skabs 'dir phyi mar 'jog pa ma yin te/ kṛ taḥka ṭo ya khru/ gang sga rtswa lhas byas/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye rjes 'grel sogs phyis/ kṛ ta ka ṭaḥ/ rtswalhas byas / bā hi tāspyu di 6/ ā hi ta asni sogs rnams la yang na'o/ /spyir btang niṣ+ṭha'i ming can gyi rkyen can tshig sngon mar 'jog par bshad kyang dmigs bsal 7la ā hi ta asni sogs dang sbyor ba'i nijo'i rkyen — mtha' can ni yang na phyi mar 'jog ste/ ahā ā hi to ya su / gang gi me la sbyin sreg byas/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs bsdus nas k+ta'i rkyen mtha' can sngon du sgo ba'am mi spo ba yang na bar byas pas/ asgyu hi taḥ/ me la sbyin sreg byas/ ā hi tīsna9snaḥ/ melasbyin sreb byas/ de bzhin du/ pu 1 traḥdza to ya su—/ — gang gi bu skyes/ zhes pa la/ pu tra dza taḥ/ buskyes/ dza ta pu traḥ/ 'grel par/117—345

'bru mang po'i bsdu ba la dbye ba gnyis te/ de ma yin pa'i yon tan can dang /de'i yon tan can no zhes byung bas de ma yin pa'i yon tan can byu dper brjod ni / ba hu dha rgo yasmin/ gangalanor mang po/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs bsdus/ba hu dha naḥ/ noramang ngo// aste dha rna ya su/ nor yod nga/ gang gi/ zhes pa la/ nor yod pa / aste dha naḥ/ de'i yon tan can gyi dper brjod ni/ lam+bi karto ya su/ gang sga rna ba gnyis po ring ngo dag/ zhes pa la/ lalba kar+ṇaḥ/ rnab ring ngo / de bzhin du/ ma hā pra dzha ya su/ shes rab chen po gang sga/ cenas pa la/ ma hā pra dzhaḥ/ shes rab chen po/ ཿ/ ti ba hu bye rta—hi sa mā sa sa mābhāḥ/ de rnams kyis 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba bshad zin to/ /lnga/ da ni zlas dbye'i bsdu ba bshad par bya ste/ tsārje dwo dwaḥ/ dang gi don la zlas dbye'o/ /supa mtha' mang po dang gi don gyi tshig bsdu ba ni zlas dbye'i bsdu ba zhes bya'o/ /de la dbye ba bzhi ste/ 'du ba dang bral ba de'i don dang / 'byor pa dang bral ba de'i don dang / gcig gcig spyor ba de'i don dang / kun sdud pa de'i don dang 4 bzhi'o/ /de ltar bzhi las/gcig la 5gcig sbyor ba dang / kun du sdud pa ni/ bya byed gang yang nus pa'i phyir zlas dbye'i bsdu ba 'jug la/ 'du ba dang bral ba de'i don dang /'byor pa dang bral ba de'i don gnyis dang 'byel ba'i don la ni bya byed stongs pa'i phyir zlas dbye'i bsdu ba mi 'jug go/ /dwo dz+wa ghi/ zlas dbye la ghi'o/ /zlas dbye'i bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir gong du sa khi ma yin pa la lhag ma ghi'o zhes rtags gang la ghi'i ming can zhes ming 'dogs byas pa de 3rnams ni thog mar 'jog ste/ ha ribya ha ra:/ 'aprog byed dang 'phrog po yang / zhes pa lta bu ghi'i ming sngon 117—346

du 'jog la/ de nas rnam dbye phrad sogs bsdus/ log ha ri ha ro/ 'phrog byed 'phrog po dag /de bzhin du/ pa ṭu: gup+tabya/ —mkhas pa dang sbas pa yang / zhes pa la/pa ṭu gubye/ mkhas pa sbas pa dag /'grel par/ rtags ghi'i ming can gcig dang ghi'i ming can ma yin pa gcig gi bar gyi rnam dbye bsdu ba yin na ghi'i ming can de sngon mar 'jog la rtags mang po bsgrigs pa la ni gcig tu ma nges so zhes bshad pas/ dper na/ ha ri: ha rabye gu rubya/ 'phrog byed dang 'phrog ngo dang bla ma dang /zhes pa la/ dzas——ha ri ha ra gu ra baḥ/— 'phrog byed 'phrog ngo/ bla ma rnam sa/ zhes pa lta bu ru gu 1ghi'i ming can yin kyang ha ra zhes pa'i rjes su byung ba lta bu'o/ / a dzā ༄ — r+ya darnye/ atsa dang po ata mtha' 'o/ /zlas dbye'i bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir rtags gang la'ang atsa ste dbyangs yig gang rung dang po na yod pa/ata mtha' na yod pa de ni thog mar 'jog ste/ yī shabya kṛṇ+ḍabya/ dbang phyug dang nag po dang / zhes pa la/ phro/ sha kṛk+ṣiṃ/ dbang phyug nag ngo dag /de yang gong du bhi'i ming can gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar ming mang po bsgrigs pa la ni gcig tu ma nges te/dper na/ a shwatso ra thabya in+d+rabyu/ rta dang shing rta dang dbang po dang / zhes pa la/ a shwa ra than+d+raḥ/— rta shing rta dbang po rnams/ zhes pa —in+d+ra ra tha'i rjes su byung ba lta bu'o/ /'grel par lung drangs pa/ atsa dang po ata mtha' can las ghi'i ming can pha rol lo/ /atsa dang po ata mtha' can dang sgo'i ming can gnyis tshogs pa la ni ghi'i ming can nyid pha rol tu gzhag 4par bya ste/ /in+d+ra: aghibya/ dbang ngo/ dang me dang / cenas pa la/ au —yigan+d+ra spru/ dbang po me dag /chenas aghi sgo'i ming can de pha rol tu byung ba lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du/ in+d+rabya bā yu:/ dbang ngo dang rlung dag /zhes pa la/ cha in+d+ra pā yu/— dbang ngo/ rlung dag /atsa dang po can yin kyang ata 117—347

mtha' can ma yin na sngon du 'jog pa'i nges pa med do/ /3 bṛk+ṣa: ashā tsa/ —thing dang rgod ma dang / zhes pa la/ dṛ k+ṣu shwe/ shing dang rgod ma dag /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /aspra tsa ta ram̐/ atsa nyung ngu'o/ /zlas dbye'i bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir rtags gang la'ang atsa nyung ba dang mang ba gnyis las/ nyung ba nyid sngon du dgod — —par bya ste/ shi bco ke sha bachen/ byu ba dang lha min 'joms dang / chenas pa la/ shi ba ke sha bo/ ji ba dang lha min 'joms dag /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /tshig mang po bsgrigs pa la ni der ma nges te/ shaṃ kha: dun+d+ra bhe byu bī shā tsa/ dung dang 'dam ma dang sgra snyan dang / zhes pa la/ shaṃ kha dun+d+ra bhi dī rjaḥ/——dung 'dam ma sgra snyan rnams/ 'grel par lung drangs pa/la ghā k+ṣa re pū/ yi ge thung ba sngon ma la'o/ /zlas dbye'i bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir dbyangs ring po dang thung ngu gnyis las thung ngu sngon du 'jog par bya ste/ku shabya kā shachen/ rtswa ku sha dang kā sha dang / zhes pa la rnam dbye sogs phyis/ ku sha kā shaṃ/ ku sha ka sha /yang 'grel par lung drangs pa/ a bh+yad+ngha tai tsa/ mchod pa la'ang ngo / /mchod pa ste gus pa'i yul kyi rtags de sngon du 'jog go zhes bshad pas/ta pa sargyu parbata4/ da7'a thub pa/ dang ri bo dag /chenas pa la/ ta pa sa barba to/— dka' thub pa dang ri bo dag /gus pa'i yul dka' thub pa sngon du byung ba lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du/ byā h+ma ṇa: k+ṣa tri ya: biṭa tsa shu dra:/ bram ze dang rgyal rigs dang rje'u rigs dang dmangs rigs/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs bsdus/ shā h+ma ṇa k+ṣa tri ya bibyu druḥ3 / — bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs dmangs rigs rnams/ yang 'grel par lung drangs pa/ sgyu tudh+yā ya sa/ spun gyi rgan pa'o/ /zlas dbye'i bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir spun rgan pa dang gzhon pa lta bu las rgan pa'i sgra sngon du 'jog ste/ yu byekhyu rabyu ardzu na: / g.yu la ngor brtan pa dang srid sgrub/ zhes pa la/ yu byekhye rārdzu no/ g.yul ngor brtan pa/ srid 117—348

sgru ba dag /yang lung drangs pa/ grangs las nyung ba sngon du'o/ /grangs dang grangs spyor ba las nyung ba de sngon du dgod de/ dwo tsa da sha tsa/— gnyis dang bcu dang / zhes pa la/ dā da sha/ bcuganyis/ dwo dwabya pā ṇi tūr+ya se nāṅgā ram̐/ zlas dbye la 1srog chags dang / rol mo dang / dpung rnams kyi yan lag la'ang ngo / /zlas dbye'i tshig sdud la srog chags kyi yan lag dang / rol mo'i yan lag dang /dpung gi yan lag rnams la bsnyu ba'i mtha' la rnam dbye rnams kyi gcig tshig kho na 'jug pa shas che ste/ dan+tabya oṣ+ṭhabya/ so dang mchu dang / zhes pa la rnam dbye phrad sogs phyis/ mdo 'dis gcig tshig su/ darnyobye/ de bzhin du/ mārja gi ka: / rnga rlum dang 'khar rnga dang / pā ṇa bi —na ka:/ zhes pa la/ mārja gi ka pā ṇa bi shaṃ / rnga rlum dang 'khar rnga / ra thi kache a shwache hastebya/ thing rta dang rta dang glang ngo che dang / zhes pa la/ ra thi kā shwa ha sto / thingartarta glang po che/ dzā ti ra pru ṇi dzā/ srog chags ma yin pa'i rigs rnams kyi'o/ /srog chags ma yin pa'i rigs rnams kyi thun mong gi sgra rnams kun sdud pa don gcig par 'gyur te/ jo nā tsa shad+ku lī tha / yos dang 'khur ba dang / chenas pa la/ rnam dbye sogs phyis/ dh+wa nā shad+kulnga / yos 'khur ba/ bi shiṣ+ṭha 5lisgo na dī de sho3grwa māḥ/ grong khyer ma yin pa'i yul dang chu bo rnams kyi rtags tha dad pa'i'o/ /grong khyer gyi sgra brjod pa ma yin pa'i yul gyi sgra dang / chu bo'i sgra rnams kun sdud pa la don gcig par 'gyur te/ gaṅgā tsa sho ṇabya/ gaṅgā dang chu bo dmar ngo / zhes pa la/ gaṅgā sho khaṃ/ de bzhin du/ ku rubya k+ṣe tram̐ tsa/ sgranganadang zhing / zhes pa la/ ku ru k+ṣe tram̐/— sgra nganazhing / rtags tha dad ma yin na kun sdud par mi 'gyur zhing / gcig gcig sbyor ba zlas dbye'i bsdu ba 'gyur te/ gaṅgā tsa ya mu 6 nā tsa/snye chu bo gaṅgā dang chu bo ya mu na dang / zhes pa la/177—349

rnam dbye sogs phyis/ 'dir kun sdud pa ma yin pas gcig tshig mi 'jug/gaṅgā ya mu ṣ+pe/ chu bo gaṅgā chu bo ya yu na dag /grong gi sgra brjod pa yin na kun sdud par mi 'gyur te gcig gcig spyor ba nyid do/ /dzāsba babya shā phru ki byā tsa/ dzāmyu'i grong dang sā lca'i grong / zhes pa la/ dzāsba ba me shā phru ki rdzu/ dzāmyu'i grong dang sā lu'i grong dag /gru dra dzan+ta baḥ / srog chags phra mo rnams so/ /srog chags phra mo rnams kun sdud pa don gcig par 'gyur te/ yu kā thutsa lik+ṣ-i tsa/ shig dang sro ma dang / zhes pa la/ yu kā lik+ṣ-i / sroshig /ye ྾ tsa bi ro dhaḥsha shwa ti kaḥ/ gang rnams kyi gtan kyi dgra rnams kyi'o/ /srog chags gang dang gang gi gtan gyi snyedagra rtag tu 'khon pa rnams kun sdud pa don gcig par 'gyur te/ a hibya na ku la:/— sbrul dang sre mang /chenas pa la/ yi/ hi na ku tsho'i/ sgrulasre ma nga —/ de baḥ/na du/ phya shwache ma hi ṣachen/ rta dang ma nye dang / ce/sa pa 'a// yin shwa ma/ nyi ṣi/ rtamate/ na/ kargyu lnga/ ༷/ kas / bya rog dang 'ug pa dang / zhes pa la/ kā ko ༷/ shaṃ/ byarog 'ug pa/ 'grel par gtan byi dgra yin kyang lha dang lha min ni kun sdud par mi 'gyur te/ gcig gcig spyor ba nyid do zhes bshad pas/ de babya de mut+yabya/ —lha dngalha min dang / zhes pa la/ de ba de khyo / lhadang lha min dag /shu dā ṇa ma ni ra ba se tā rmā/ dmangs rigs rnams kyi mi gnas pa ma yin pa rnams kyi'o/ /dmangs rigs kyi rigs yin pa'i las bya ba de mi gnas pa ma yin pa gnas pa'i las bcas de ni kun snyud trepa don gcig par 'gyur te/ ra dza kabye tan+tu bā yabya/ ras 'khrud mkhan dang tha ga pa dang / zhes pa la/ra dza ka tan+tu bā yo/ ras 'khrud mkhan dang tha ga pa// mi gnas pa meyin na/ kun sdud par mi 'gyur te/ tsāṇ+ḍa la: mṛ ta yabya/snyegatum po dang ro dang / zhes pa la/ tsāṇ+ḍa la mṛ ta yo/ gtumapo dang ro/ ga bā: pra j-i ti ni tsa/ ba lang la sogs pa rnams 177—350

dzas—/ tsū tā sho kāḥ/ shing tsu ta dang shug pa rnams/ de bzhin du/ sgrasgogs/ —ru ru: thra ṣa taspru/ ri dwags ru ru dang sha ba/ zhes pa la/ su — ru ru thra ṣa tai/ ri dwags ru ru sha ba/rnams / tāḥ/ dzas/ ku sha snelkubya kā shabya/ —rtswa ngan sel dang kā sha /zhes pa la/ su— ku sha kā shaṃ/ ngan sel kā sha /rnams/ shāḥ dzas/ya brgyun ste/ ṣachen/— nas dang sran ma dang / cenas pa la/su / ya ba mā ṣe/ —nasasran/ rnams/— ṣāḥ— dzas/ nga bye tsa 1 tai tsa/ —zhodanga'om/ zhes pa la/su / da 2 bye sgo tai/ zho'om/ aushī/ — te/ rnams/ ba lang dang ma te/ gochen ma nyi ṣachen/ zhes pa 'ab/ su/ go che/ hi ṣe/ ba langam he/ e— sngo/ dag /sdo/ kachen had+machen/ de tso dang ngang pa/ dang / zhes pa la/ su/ ku sha haṃ saṃ/ ṣ+pe tsongang pa// rnams/ sā1ཿ/ dzas/ a shwabya ba ḍa bstso// rta dang rgod ma/ dang / zhes pa la/ su/ a shwa ba sha baṃ/— rta rgod ma/ dzas/— sgo/ཿ/ rnams/pūrbabya a pa rabya/ sharadang gzhan/ zhes pa la/ pūr+pā pa ram̐/ sharagazhan/ dzas/ rāḥ/ rnam/sa/a dha rabya ut+ta rabya/ mchu dang byang ngam dma' dang byang / zhes pa la/ su/ a dha rot+ta ram̐ / mchu byang / dzas/ rāḥ/ rnams/ bi pra ti ṣidhi tsā na bye ka ra ṇa bā tsi/'gal ba rdzas —med pa rnams kyi brjod pa la'ang ngo / /'gal ba rdzas med 5pa rnams kyi brjod pa la'ang kun sdud pa don gcig par yang na 'gyur te/ shi tabya ushaṃ tsa/ grang ba dang dro ba dang / zhes pa la/ su/ shi to shrī/ grang dro/ rke— bhe/ —dag/de bzhin du/ kā ma: kro dhabya/ —la sadang khro ba dang / zhes pa la/ kā ma kro r+ghaṃ/ las khro ba/ au sgo/ dag /su khaṃ tsa duḥkhaṃ tsa/ bde ba dang sdug bsnga la dang / zhes pa la/su — su kha duḥkhaṃ/ bdesdug/ ka khe/ dag /ni da bye pa yā dī ni/ da dhi pa yas la sogs pa rnams ma yin no/ /da bye pa yas la sogs pa rnams kun sdud pa don gcig par 'gyur ba ma yin te/ da dhi tsa pa yaspru/ zho dang 'o ma/ zhes pa la/rnam dbye sogs phyis/ da dhi pa ya sī/ zho'omadag /de bzhin du/ izlabya 717—352

brtibya / snyegasal ba dang sgo mdongs dang / zhes pa la/ gsal ba sgo mdongs dag/ —id+dhā brti ྾—rmye/bāka tsa ma nabya/ ngag dang yid dang / zhes pa la/ ngag yid dag/ — wād+ma na sau/ sbra nga rtsi dang mar gsar dang /— ma dhu tsa sarngi:/ zhes pa la/ ma dhu sarbi ṭī/ sprang mar gsar dag /dad can ma dang blo ldan ma dang / shād+dhā tsa me dh+wa tsa/ zhes pa la/ shād+dhā me bye/ dad can ma blo ldan ma dag /dkar phyogs dang nag phyogs dang / shu lnga/chen kṛṣ+ṭachen/ cenas pa la/ sdo/77 kṛste/ da7ra phyogs nag phyogs dag /ā r+yabya a ba sā rde tsa/ thog ma dang tha ma dang / zhes pa la/ ā byā ba sā ṣ+pe/ thog mtha' dag /ya rdzatsa a nu bā kyi tsa/ mchod nga/ dang rjes su brjod pa dang / zhes pa la/ya dzā nu pā kye/ mchod pa/ rjes su brjod pa dag /u khru kha lam̐ tsa mu sha lo tsa/ gtun dang gtun this dang / zhes pa la/ ngas u 3 ༷/ kha la mu sha le/ gtun gtun shing dag /'phrog byed dang brgya byin dang / ha riche ba sa 'grechen/ chenas pa la/ yo ha ri bā sa cha/ 'phrog byed brgya byen dag /brah+ma tsa pra dzā pa tibya/ tshangs pa dang skye dgu'i bdag ngo dang / zhes pa la/ brah+ma pra dzā pa tī/ tshangs pa dang skye dgu'i bdag po dang / shi babya bai shra ba ṇabya/ —'i ba dang rnam thos sras dang /zhes pa la/ shi ba bai shra ba ṇi/——zhi ba rnam thos sras dag /so mabyu ru drabya/ zla ba dang drag ngo//zhes pa la/ zlab drag ngo/ dag /so ma ru dro/ na rā dbya parba ta:/ drang srong mi sbyin dang ri bo dang / zhes pa la/ na ra da parba to/ misbyinari bo dag /srur+yabyatsan+d+ra ma:/— nyi ma dang zla ba dang / zhes pa la/ srur+ya tsan+d+ra ma sau/ nyizladag /rā mabya lagla ṇabya/ dga' byed dang mtshan nyid ldan dang / zhes pa la/ rā ma lagh+ra ṇi/— dga' byed mtshan nyid ldan dag /dhī —mabyu ardzu na:/ —'jigs pa/ dang srid sgrub dang / zhes pa la/ dī mārdzu no/ 'jigs pa srid sgru ba dag /kaspa la: a shwa ta rabya/ snam budang rta dang / zhes pa la/ kasbra lā shwa ta ro/ snam bu rta dag/de dag da dhi'i sogs khong yin no/ /ā nang ṛ thutī dwo dz+wa/ zlas dbye la ṛta rnams kyi ā nang ngo / /zlas dbye'i bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir tshig sngon ma'i mtha' 117—353

yang phyis/ bhā ta ro/ mingasring dag /de bzhin du/ budang bu mo dang / pu trabya du nyi tā tsa/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs dang du te tro yang phyis pas/ pu tre/ bu bu mo dag /na sum̐ sa ka ma na sum̐ sa ke ṣ+pe ka badz+nyā snga n+ya ta ra sde/ ma ning la ma ning ma yin pa'i gcig 'dra ba'ang 'di'i yang na'o/ /zlas dbye'i bsdu ba la ma ning gi rtags dang / ma ning ma yin pa'i rtags dag sbyor ba na 'di ste ma ning gi rtags ma yin pa de yang na dbyi zhing 'ang gi sgras kun sdud pa'ang yang na 'gyur te/shukle tsa kasba labya/ dakhrer ngo dang snam/ bu/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs dang skyes pa'i rtags kalba 1 la rnams phyis/ shukle/ snam da7ra/ yang 3na/ shuklo/ snam dalar dag/yang ma phyis pas/ shukla kasba lo/ snam/da7ra dag /pi tā mā tā/ pha la ma yi'o/ /zlas dbye'i basbu ba la pha dang ma gnyis la ma nyid yang na dbyi ste/ mā tā tsa pi tā tsa / mdang pha dang / zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs phyis/ mā tro dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba yang na bar byas pas/ pi ta ro/ phamadag /mā tā pi ta ro/ shwa shu raḥshwarja/gyos po la sgyug mo'i'o/ /zlas dbye las gyos po dang sgyug mo gnyis las sgyug zhemo nyid yang na dbyi ste/ shwa shubya shwa shu rabya/ gyos ngo dang sgyug rngo/ dang / zhes pa la/rnam dbye sogs phyis/ shā 6 shā dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba yang na bar byas pas/shwa shu ro/ gyosasgyug dag/ —shwa shu shwa shu ro/ t+ya dze+edā dī ni sadze+eni bye/ t+yata sogs rnams la thams cad rnams kyi rtag tu'o/ /zlas dbye'i skabs 'dir t+yad sogs rnams la rtags gzhan thams cad rtag tu dbyi ste/ sa tsa de ba dat+ta rkyebya/snyede dang lhas byin yang / zhes pa la/ rnam dbye tshig grogs dang bcas pa phyis/ to/ —lhas byin de dag /'grel par/ t+yad 9 sogs gnyis tshogs pa la ni sngon ma dbyi'o skye ༷zhes bshad pas/ sa tsā nyu ya:/ de dngagang dang / zhes pa la/ rnam dbye phrad 117—356

sogs dang ming gong ma phyis/ yo/ degang dag /gā mya pa shu saṃ bhe ṣ+ṭa ta hu ṇi 6 sdi1/grong gi phyugs 'dus pa rnams la gzhon nu ma yin pa la bud med 'o/ /zlas dbye'i bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir grong du gnas pa'i phyugs 'dus pa brjod pa la/gzhon nu ma'am chung ngu ma yin pa ste bor ba'i gzhan ma rtags mo rtags rnams gnas shing rīrtags gzhan ma rnams yang na dbyi ste/ ba lang rnams dang 'di rnams dang /— ba/ bache yin ste/shā / i mā ni i rda bud med du bsgru bas pa 'o/ /zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs phyis/ go dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba yang na bar byas pas/ i māḥ/ ba lang 'di rnams/ yang na/ ga bi māḥ/ bal nga'adi rnams/ de bzhin du/ a dzā bya i māche / —ra rnams 'di rnams/ cenas pa 'a / 83 ste/ཿ/ ra rnam sa 'di rnam sa / pa/nga na/ phyag ja — 83 māḥ—/ ra 'di rnams/ grong du gnas pa ma yin na mi dbyi ste/ ru ra babya i mā:/ ri dwags ru ru rnams dang 'di rnam sa dang / zhes pa la/ ru ru i māḥ/ ri dwags ru ru 'di rnams/phyugs ma yin na/ 'dus pa'i don yin kyang mi dbyi ste/ drwah+ma rja: i mābya/— bram ze rnams dang 'di rnams dang / zhes pa la/ drwah+ma ṇa i māḥ/ bram/ ze 'di rnams/ ga'o/na nu yin na mi dbyi ste/ ban+d+rabya i mābya/ be'u rnams dang 'di rnams dang / zhes pa la/ bat+pa i māḥ/ be'u'adi rnams/ de rnams kyis 4zlas dbye'am gnyis gnyis pa'i bsdu ba rnams bshad zin to/ /myu/ da ni tshig sdud bzhi po'i cho ga ci rigs thun mong du bshad pa las/ṛka pū ra rtsuḥpa thā ma nak+ṣe/ ṛtsa pur dhur pa thin rnams kyi ak+ṣa ma yin pa las apa'o / /dhur dang ak+ṣa sbyor ba ma yin pa'i rtags de rnams las bsdu ba'i mtha' la apa kyi rkyen 'gyur te/ arja gya ṛka /ces pa rnam dbye bsdus/apa byin pa rjes 'byel/ adhartsaḥ/ rig byed kyi tshig byed/ de bzhin du/ bisgoḥpūḥ/ —khyab 117—357

la rnam dbye rjes 'brang sogs phyis/ atsa byin/ tsa rjes 'byel/ pra ti sā oṃ—/ —sosor snyan tshig /de bzhin du/ a nu a dhī te sā /mo be+e rda/ rjes su klog par byed snyan tshig rig byed/ zhes pa la/ a nu sā oṃ/— rjesasu snyan tshig /a ba rak+ṣudze+e ma tram̐ sā ma be+e de/— bsrung ba'i don la sngags snyan tshig rig byed/ zhes pa la/ a ba sā me/ —bsrung ba snyan tshig/lo ma ā+oṃ pra ti yuk+ṇi/ —ba spu so sor sbyor ba/ zhes pa la/ pra ti lo rma/ ba spu so sor/ a nu lo ma no ya su/ —gang girjes su ba spu/ zhes pa la/ a nu lo oṃ/ rjesasub spu/ a ba u ra se lo mā ni ya su/——gang gi brang kun la ba spu/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs phyis/atsa byin/ a ba lo maḥ/ kunal ba spu/ de rnams 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba'o/ /'grel par/ kṛṣ+ṭa/ pāṇ+ḍa/ u da ka /grangs rnams sngon ma'i bhū mi las atsa 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ kṛṇ+ḍartswa sau khyu mibya/ nag ngo yang 'dis yang ngo / /zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs phyis/ atsa byin pas/ kṛṣ+ṭa bhū maḥ/ sanag po/ de bzhin du/ pāṇ+ḍasbyo sau khyu mibya/ skya bo yang 'di sa 'ang ngo / /zhes pa la/ pāṇ+ḍakhyu maḥ—/ saskya/ u jed kartswa sau bhū mibye/ sa yang 'di dar ba 'ang ngo / /zhes pa la/ u da ka bhū maḥ—/ —sa dar ba/ dwo bhū miḥ/ sa gnyis dag /zhes pa la/ saganyis/ dī bhū me/ tra yo bhū miḥ/ sa rnams gsum rnams/ zhes pa la/ tri bhū me/ sagasum/ de rnams kyis kṛṣ+ṭa sogs gsum po de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba'i nang tshan las 'dzin dang / dī sogs gnyis po phyogs gnyis pa'i bsdu ba'o/ /asto3 dar+sha nāta/ ak+ṣi'i zhemi mthong ba las so/ /ak+ṣi mi mthong ba'i don can las bsdu ba'i mtha' la atsa 'gyur te/ga r+pā ak+ṣi i ba/ —ba lang gi mig dang 'dra ba ste skar khung / zhes pa la/ atsa rnam dbye sogs phyis/ ga sgo ཿ/— ba lang mig ste skar khung / mthong ba'i don yin na mi 'gyur te/bi pra su ak+ṣi/ —bramaze'i mig /zhes pa lta bu la atsa mi 'gyur rnam dbye sogs phyis/117—359

brtsa saṃ — glang po che gzi brjid/ de de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba'i nang tshan las 'dzin gye bsdu ba'i mtha' la atsa byin pa'o/ /'grel par lung drangs pa/ alpa rā dza dz+nyā tsa/ alpa rā dza dag las kyang ngo / /alpa dang tsho rā dzan sngon ma'i brtsas la'ang bsdu ba'i mtha' la atsa 'gyur te/ adze+e brtso ya su/— gang gi gzi brjid chung ngu /zhes pa la/ alpa brtsa saṃ/— gzi brjid chung ngu / de 'bru mang po'o/ /rā dzā tsa brtsartswa sau / rgyal po yang 'di gzi brjid kyang ngo / /chenas pa 'a// rā ja brtsa saṃ/ rgyal po gzi brjid/zhes pa las 'dzin no/ /a ba sa madhe bh+yaḥta ma saḥ/ a ba saṃ an+dha rnams las ta mas la'o/ /a ba saṃ arnya rnams sngon ma'i ta mas las bsdu ba'i mtha' la bye atsa 'gyur te/ a ba ta mo ya mya/ gang gi kun du khro ba/ zhes pa la/ a ba ta ma saṃ / kun du khro ba/ de bzhin du/ saṃ ta mo ya gya/ gang gi rgyun du khro ba/ zhes pa la/ saṃ ta ma saṃ/ rgyun du khro ba/ arnya dz+nyā ā+oṃ ta mo ya su/ —gang gi rmongs pa shes med khro ba/ zhes pa la/an+dha ta ma saṃ/ rgongasapa khros pa/ de rnams 'bru mang ngo / /'grel par lung drangs pa/swa so ba shī yaḥgre ya saḥ/ swas las ba shi yas gre yas dag las so/ /swasra snga ma'i ba shī yas dang gre yas dag la'ang atsa 'gyur te/ swaḥb shī yaḥ/ mtho ris kyi gnas / zhes pa la/ swa ba shī ya saṃ/ mthoris gnas/ de bzhin du/ swaḥgre yaḥ/ mtho ris dge ba/ zhes pa la/ swo gre ya saṃ/ mthoris dbe ba/ a na ba tabhā dra ha saḥ / a nu a pa tap+ta las ra has las so/ /a nu a ba tabe+e rnams sngon ma'i ra has las atsa 'gyur te/ a nu tiṣ+ṭha ra ha si/— dben par rjes su gnas/ zhes pa la/a nu ra ha saṃ /— dben par rjes su/ a ba tiṣ+ṭha ra ha si/snyedaben par kun du gnas/ zhes pa la / a ba ra ha saṃ/— kun du dbe+en par/ de gnyis mi zad par gyur pa'i bsdu ba'o/ /tap+ta ta pa ra ha se tiṣ+ṭha ya gya saḥ/——gang gi dka' thub pa dka' thub la dben pa/ zhes pa la/117—362

tabe+e ra ha saṃ1 / dbenapa/ra da7'a thub/ zhes pa 'bru mang ngo / /pra te ru ra saḥ/ pra ti las u ras las so/ /pra ti sngon ma'i u ras las atsa 'gyur te/ u ra se pra ti tsisdo brta te/ brang la so so ra ma/tshan nyid yo da/ zhes pa la/ pra tru ra saṃ/ brang so so ra/de mi zad pa'i bsdu ba'o/ /a nu ga ba mā yā me/ a nu las go la rgyas pa la'o/ /a nu sngon ma'i go las rgyas pa'i don brjod pa la/ atsa 'gyur te/ a nā yā saṃ yā na yulti ga r+pā/ rjes su rgyas nga ra byed thing rta 'dren nga 'i ba la nga rnam sa / zhes/ nga/ la/ a nu ga baṃ / rjes su ba la nga / zhes pa mi zad par 'gyur ro/ /'grel par lung drangs/ pa/u pa sanā da dh+wa 2 naḥnyer bsgyur las a dh+wan 'a/'o/ /nyer bsgyur sngon ma/'i a/ dh+wan la atsa 'gyur zhing an yang dbyi ste/ pra ga taḥ.ad+dhā ā+oṃ/ rab tu 'gro ba'i la ma /zhes pa la/ pā dh+waḥ/ lamarab/ na pū dza nāta/ bstod nga/ las/ ma yin no/ /bstod pa'i don can las basbu ba'i mtha' nga/ rkyen gang yang 'gyur ba ma yin te/sustsu rā dzā/ zhes pa la/ su rā dzā/ rgya' ngo lesas ngo 'am bzang / de bzhin du/ a ti sha ye nā rā dzā/ phul du byung ba'i rgyal ngo / zhes pa la/ a/ ti rā dzā/ rgyal ngo phul byung/ de rnams mi zad par gyur pa'i basbu ba'o/ /ki maḥk+ṣe pe/ kyim gyi phrag dog la'o/ /kim gyi sgra phrag dog gi don brjod pa can la bsdu ba'i mtha' la rkyen gang yang mi 'gyur te/ kim rā dzā/ ci'irgyal ngo / nanyastah+phu ru ṣāta/ nanya'i de'i skyes/ bu la sa so / /nanya de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba'i mtha' las rkyen gang yang mi 'gyur te/na 6) dzā / cesas pa 'a / phyag shes dzā / rgyalango min/ de baḥ/na du/ na sa ta// grobs min/zhes pa la/ a sa khā/ grogasamin/ ba tho bi bhā ṣā/ ba thin gyi 'dam ka'o/ /pa thin gyi sgra la nanya de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba'i mtha' la atsa ster ba dang mi 4ster ba 'dam ka can te/ na pas+thāḥ/ lamamin/ zhes pa la/ atsa yang na bar byas 117—363

pas / phyag pajoḥ1 / lam min/ yi/ pa dze+e/ lamamin/ 'a gre'/ par zicog sdud kyi skabs 'dir a ba sh+ya ma la sogs pa'i ma dbyi bar 'dod do zhes bshad pas/de yang ji skad du/ lum+bi da ba sh+ya maḥkṛ bye rtu kā ma ma na so ra pi/ sa mo bā hi ta ta ta 4 yoṅgā sa su pa tsi yusgo nyoḥ/ zhes pa byung ste/ de bod skad du/kṛta la a ba sh+yam kyi ma dbyi ste/ kā ma ma nas dag las tum gyi yang / hi ta ta ta la sa/ma gyi yang na ste/ rmā sa'i a ni yu/ṭa ghanya la/ zhes gsungs te/a ba sh+yam/ zhes/ pa'i pha rol tu byings kṛta sogs/ kyi mtha' can byung na/ a ba sh+yam/ gyi ma dbyi ba ste/ a ba bye bhā byaḥ/ 'o sakyang bangen/ zhes pa la// pha rol tu kṛta so/gas/ kyi rkyen can byung bas/ ma phyis/ a ba sh+ya bhā bye/ de bzhin du/byings/ tum kyi rkyen can gyi 5 pha rol tu kā ma dang ma nas gang rung zhig byung na tum/ gyi ma/ dbyi ste/ gabye kā maḥ/ 'grobar 'dod/ zhes pa la ma phyis// gabye kā maḥ/de bzhin du/ gabye ma/ nāḥ/ zhes pa la/ gan+tu ma nāḥ/ yid 'astso bar byed/ de bzhin du/ nyer 6bsgyur sa/ma gyi pha rol/ tu hi ཿ ta dang tata gang rung byung na sam gye ma/ yang na dbyi ste/ saṃ hi taḥ/ zhes nga/ rang gnas sam yang na ma phyis/ nga/sa / sa hi taḥ/ grobasabazang ngo / saṃ hi taḥ/ de bzhin du/ saṃ ta taḥ/ nge la bzang ngo / yang na/ ngelabazang ngo// sa ta taḥ/ rmā sa'i pha rol tu byings/ nga/tsa ghanya'am / yu/ṭa'i rkyen can byung na rmā sa/'i sa yi a dbyi ba 'am yang na mi dbyi ste / rmā sa su pa tsa rna/ zhes pa la/ rmā spa tsa rgo/ thabatsos nga / yang na/ tha btsos nga / // sa nga/ 'a rna/ de bzhin du/ // sa su pā kaḥ/ ༅btsos pa / chenas pa 'a//rmā spra kaḥ/ yang na/ rmā sa pā kaḥ/ shabatsos nga// zhes pa lta bu'o/ /yang 'grel par / kā ba dang ma nas pha rol la yang sam gye ma yang na dbyi'o zhes byung bas/117—364

che/ na/ ches kyang sru// gang sga yang dag 'dod/ cenas pa 'a// yangadag 'dod/ sa na/ che/ཿ/ ma/nga cad/saṃ kā maḥ/ gang ji yang dag 'dod/ de bzhin du/ saṃ ma no ya su/ bang ji yid yang dag nga//stunas pa 'a / sa ma/ naḥ/ dngaba'i yid/ 'a/nga na/ saṃ ma/ naḥ/ dngaba'iyid/ ya/ da ka sro dadze+e dz+nyā dze+e/ ming la u da ka'i u da'o/ /ming gi don dang 'brel pa'i u da ka ni u da zhes par 'gyur te/ u da kabyu sau me ghabya/ chu yang 'di sprin ya nga ngo / /zhes pa la/ u da me ghaḥ/ chusprin/ de bzhin du/ 'o hi tartswa sau u da ka:/ dmarapo yang 'di chu yang ngo / /zhes pa la/ lo hi to daḥ/ chudam ra ngo / k+ṣi rartswa sau u da ka:/ 'o ma/ ya nga 'di chu'ang ngo / /zhes pa la/ ṭī ro daḥ/ 'o chu/ pe ṣa bā sa bā ha na bye ṣā tsa/pe ṣa bā sa bā ha na bye rnams/ la/ yang ngo / /pe ṣa la so/gas/ nga/ 'di rnam/sa/ dang spyor ba'i u da ka'ang yang na u da zhes nga/ra 'gyur te/ u da ke na pe ṣi/ chu yis phye ma ra byas / zhes pa la / u da pe ṣi/ yang na/ u da ka nge ṣe/ de bzhin du/u da ke bā sa/ཿ/ chulasanas nga / zhes/ nga/ la / u da bā sa/ཿ/ chubanas / yang na/ u/ da ka bā saḥ/ chubanas / u da ka khru bā ha naḥ/ jes/ nga/ 'a// u da bā ha naḥ/ chu thob nga / yang na/ u da ka bā ha naḥ/ u da kai bye ya smin/ sang la chu sarter zhes/ pa la/ u da byeḥ/ chusater/ yang na/ u da ka byeḥ/ chusader/ e ka ha khā ngo dru/ ra yi ta bye3n+ya ta ra sde1 / dang ngo/ra hal gcig nga/ 'a/ gang bar byed pa la/ yang na'o / /gang ba'i don dang 'brel nga/'i u da ka dang sbyo ra ba'i tshig grogs de la tshig de'i yi ge dang po de hal gcig pa ste/ yi ge gnyis gsu/ma brtsegs/ pa min na u da ka nyid u da ru yang na 'gyur te/ u da ka gya pū ra khaṃ kur+ghaṃ// chus gang ba'i bum pa / zhes pa la/ u da kur+ghaṃ/ chubum / yang na/ u da ka kur+ghaṃ/ chubum/ de bzhin du/ u da ka gya pū ra rde pā tram̐/ chusagang ba'i sgod/ zhes pa la/ u da bā 717—365

traḥ / — grong sga phra ma mkhan gyi bu/ yang na/ gā ma bhā pu traḥ/ grong sga phra ma mkhan gyi bu/ e kā tarnyi te tsa/ e kā'i de phan la'ang ngo / /e kā zhes pa'i mtha' ni de phan gyi rkyen pha rol la thung ngur 'gyur te/ e kā su bha ba/ gcig sga dngos ngo / bya 1 ba'i don de phan gyi rkyen ta byin/ rnam dbye phyis/ ā thung ngur gyur/ ṭā pa e ka tā / dngos ngo gcig ma// d+mā poḥsaṃ dz+nyā tshan+da sorba hu lo/ dīpa ā pa dag gi ming sdeb sbyor dag las mang po'o/ /dīpa kyi mtha' dang ā pa kyi mtha' dag ming dang sdeb sbyor sogs la thung ngur mang po 'gyur te/ re ba t+yaḥmi traḥ/ ska ra ma/'i sanyen/ zhes pa la rnam dbye phyis/ re ba tī thung ngur song re ba ti mi traḥ/ de bzhin du/sha 2lā yāḥbahaḥ/ zhes pa la/ she 'a/ ba haṃ/ rdothobang/ iṣ+ṭa ke ྾ kā mā lā dzā tsi ta tū la bhā ri 6/ iṣ+ṭa kā khra bhā kā mā lā rnams/ kyi tsi ta tū la bhā ra rnams la'o//iṣ+ṭa kā la sogs pa de rnams kyi pha ro' tu rim bzhin/ tsi ta la sogs nga/ de rnams byung na/ iṣ+ṭa kā la sogs nga/ de rnams kyi mtha' thung ngur 'gyur te/yinaṣ+ṭa kā pa/ཿtsi taḥ/ so phas si rtsis nga / zhes nga/ la// yi/ṣ+ṭa ka tsi tai/ so phas rtsis nga / de bzhin du/ yī ṭī kā yāḥtū waṃ/ so phas ma nyam nga 'am ma/tshungs nga 'am 'dra ba/ zhes/ nga/ la/yī ྾ ka tū lo/ so phas ma/nyam pa 'am ma tshungs nga 'am 'dra ba/ mā 'di/ tsā saubha rī tsa/ phreng ba ya nga 'di lci ba ya nga ngo / /zhes pa la/ mā la bhā rī/ phrengabalci mo / byi tirdza na pa da rā tri nā bhi nā ma go tra rū pas+thā na bar+ṇa ba yo ba tsa na/ ban+tu 6 bye ti ṣa dza na pa da rā tri nā bye nā ma go tra rū pa swān bar+ṇa ba yas ba tsa na ban+tu rnams la'o/ /bye ti ṣa la sogs pa 'di rnams pha rol las ma nā zhes pa'i sgra ni sa zhes par 'gyur te/ sa mā ā+oṃ bye tirlu s+thā sau/ gang gi mtshungs nga/'i 'od 'di/ zhes pa la rnam dbye phrad sogs phyis/ sa mā na / sa zhes par 'gyur/ sa dre/ tiḥ/ ma tshungs nga 'i 'od/ de bzhin du/ sa mā 117—367

rgo dza na pa do ya snga sau/ gang sga skye ba'i yu la mtshungs pa/ 'di/ zhes pa la/ sa dza na pa daḥ / skye yulam tshungs pa/ sa na/ rna rā tri byu t+ta/ sau/ gang bi mnyam pa/'i mtshan mo/ 'di/ stunas pa 'ab/sa rā triḥ/ mtshan ma nyam nga / sa na/ dz+wa na 1 bi r+ya t+yā sau/ bang be lte ba ma/tshungs nga 'di/ zhes pa la/sa nā r+bhaḥ/ lte ba mtshungs / sa mā ā+oṃ nā ma s+thā sau/ sang bi ming ma tshus nga 'di/ zhes pa la/sa 2 nā ma/ mingamatshungs pa / sa mā rna go tro ya sgyu sau/ gang bi risas ma tshungs nga 'di/ zhes nga/ la / sa go traḥ/ risas ma tshungs / sa ma ā+oṃ ru ngo/ ya snga sau/ gang si sazusas ma tshungs nga 'di/zhes pa la/ sa ru paḥ/ gzubs ma tshungs / sa mā rna s+thā rna ya snga sau// gang ṅge gnas ma tshungs pa 'di stunas pa la/ salnga/ rna/ sanas ma tshungs / sa/ ste/ rna brto 05 sgo sau/ gang na ma/dos ma tshunga' nga 'di/ zhes pa la/ sa bar+ṇaḥ/ ma dos ma nyam nga / sa ste/ rna ba yo ya snga sau/ sang si na tshod ma tshungs nga 'di/ zhes nga/ 'a/5 sa ba yaḥ na tshod ma/tshungs nga / sa mā rna 6 ba tsa no ya snga sau// sang si brjod nga ma tshungs nga 'di/ zhes nga/ 'a// sa ba tsa naḥ/ brjod nga ma tshungs nga / sa mā/ ṣ+pe ban+d+raḥya snga sau / sang si sanyen bathes ma tshungs nga 'di/ zhes pa la/ sa/ ban+dhuḥ/ sanyen ma tshungs 'gre'/ nga/ra lung drangs/ nga// piṇ+ḍa gan+dha lo hi ta kuk+ṣi be bhā nga/snri nga/k+ṣe 6/piṇ+ḍa gan+dha 'o/ hi ta ku k+ṣi nge tī pasnri nga/k+ṣa rnam/sa la'o/ /piṇ+ḍa 'a/ sogs/ nga/ 'di rnam/sa/ pha rol 'a/'ang sa/ mā na sa/ ru 'gyur te/ sa mā rna piṇ+ḍi ya snga sau// sang si bda' kha ma tshungs nga 'di/ zhes nga/ la// sa/ piṇ+ḍaḥ/ bda' kha ma tshungs nga / de bzhin du/ sa nā/ rgo garjo ya snga sau/ gang si dri ma tshungs nga 'di/ zhes nga/ la/ sa gan+dhaḥ/ dri ma tshungs pa / sa/ mā rna lo hi to ya snga sau/ sang ci dam ra ngo ma/tshungs nga 'di/ zhes pa la/ sa lo hi taḥ/ dmar ngo ma/tshungs nga / sa mā rgo ku k+ṣiḥya sru sau/ sang si ma khal ma ma/tshungs nga 'di/ zhes pa la/ sa kuk+ṣaḥ / ma/khal ma ma/tshungs nga / ba mā rna be+e bhā ya snga sau/— gang bi ci nga lo ma/tshungs nga 'di/ zhes pa la / sa be+e ṭī/ cingalom/tshungs/ pa / sa mā dz+wa pasbyi 9 ya snga sau/ sang sga bdag mo ma/tshungs nga 'di/1 77—368

cesas nga 'ab/ sa nga ——/ bdag mo ma tshungs nga / sa ste/ byed nga 11 kyang lnga/ sdus/ gang sga phyogs mtshungs pa 'di / zhes pa la/ sa pak+ṣaḥ/ phyogs mtshungs pa/ tsa ra ṇi brah+ma tsā ri ṇi/ spyod pa la brah+ma tsā ri la'o/ /spyod pa'i don dang 'byel pa'i brah+ma tsā ri zhes pa pha rol la'ang sa mā na sa ru 'gyur te/ sa mā rgo brah+ma tsā rī ya snga sau/ sang na tshangs pa ra spyo da nga ma tshungs pa 'di/ zhes pa la/ sa brah+ma tsā rī/ tīze ye/ tīrja la ya la'o/ /tīrja ya'i rkyen can pha rol la'ang sa mā na sa ru 'gyur te/ sa mā rgo tībye ya snga sau / gang si bste gnas ma/tshungs pa/ 'di/ chenas pa la/ sa tīn+d+raḥ/ bste sanas/ ma tshungs nga / be+e byā kho da re/ u da ra la 'dam ka'o/ /ya rkyen can gyi u da ra pha rol la sa mā na sa ru 'gyur ba dang mi 'gyur ba 'dam ka can te/ sa nā/ na nu/ darlo ya snga sau/ sang si lho ba ma tshungs nga 'ji/ zhes nga/ 'a// rnam dbye phrad so/gas phyis// sa/ mā na sa ru 'gyur ba dang mi 'gyur ba yang na bar byas nga/sa// so dad+ma / lho ba ma tshungs nga / yang na / sa mā no dar+yaḥ/ khyob mtshungs nga / dṛka dṛ sha ba tu ṣā/ dṛka dri sha ba tu rnams la'o/ /dṛka rta dang dṛ sha pha rol dang ba tu'i rkyen can rnams/ pha rol la'ang sa mā na sa ru 'gyur te/ sa/ nā/ rgo dṛ gla snga sau// sang si ma thong ba ma tshungs nga 'di/zhes pa la/ sa dṛka/ ma tshungs pa ra ma thong / de bzhin du/ sa/ nā/ rna dṛ sho ya myu sau gang bi ma thong ba ma/tshungs nga 'di/ zhes pa la/ sa/ dṛ shaḥ/ ma tshungs nga ra ma thong / ba tu'i rkyen can la/ sa mā dz+wa gha ṭa ba tu da ram̐ ya snga sau/ sang si lto ba bum nga can ma tshungs nga 'a'i/ zhes pa la/ sa gha ṭa bān / kum nga can ma tshungs / i rda ki mo rī sha tī/ i rda ki dag gi spyi sha tī dag go/ /dṛka dṛ sha dang ba tu'i rkyen pha rol la i rda ni yī sha dang ki ni ki zhes nga/ra 'gyur te/ i yo dṛ gya gya/ gang si ma thong ba 'di/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs phyis/ i rda/ yī shar 'gyur/ sha 'gro ba al gcig ma yin pa 117/de369

dper brjod gong du'ang bshad pa ltar/ de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba'i skabs rtags atsa dang po can pha rol tu byung na ku zhes pa'i rtags ni kata ces par 'gyur te/ku ar+ghaṃ/ zhes pa la/ ka da.oṃ/ zanangan nga / 'grel par lung drangs pa/ tre tsa/tri la'ang ngo / /tri zhes pa'i rtags pha rol la'ang ku kata du 'gyur te/ ku tra yoḥ / zhes pa la/ kan+d+ra yaḥ/ ngan nga sasu ma// ra tha ba da yobye/ ra tha ba da dag las kyang ngo / /ra tha dang ba da dag pha rol la'ang ku kata 1 'gyur te/ ku ra thaḥ/ zhes pa la/ ka dra thaḥ/ trangarta ngan nga// de bzhin du/ ku ba daḥ/ brjod nga ngan nga / zhes pa la/ ka dwa daḥ/ brjodang ngan nga / tre ṇi tsa dzā sto/ tre ṇa la'ang rigs la'o/ /z-i ṇa la rigs brjod pa can pha rol la'ang ku kata du 'gyur te/ku tre ṇa su dzā ti/ rtswa ngan nga 'i risas / karje khaṃ/ rtswangan pa / kā pa byak+ṣa yoḥ/ pa thi na a/k+ṣa dag las kā'o/ /pa thin dang ak+ṣa dag pha rol la ku ni kā zhes nga/ra 'gyur te / ṭa/ nga/dze+eḥ/ la ma ngan pa / chenas/ pa 'a// a tsa na/ nga/ thaḥ/ lam ngan nga / nge bstunon du / ku a/k+ṣaḥ/ thing rta'i 'khor 'o ngan pa / zhes pa la/ kā k+ṣa2ཿ/ r+shang rta'i 'khor lo ngan pa /i ṣa darje tsa/ chung ngu'i don la'ang ngo / /ku'i sgra chung ngu'i don brjod pa na'ang kā zhes/ nga/ra 'gyur te/ i ṣata dza lo/ chu chung ngu 'am/ nyung ngu / zhes pa'i don 'a / kā dza lo/ chuchung ngu / be+e bhā ṣā pu ru ṣe/ pu ru ṣa la gdam nga'o/ /pu ru ṣa zhes nga/'i sgra pha rol la ku kā zhes par 'gyur ba dang mi 'gyur ba 'dam ka can te/ ku྾ ta ngu/ ru ṣaḥ/ skyesadu ngan nga / zhes pa la/ ku pu ru ṣaḥ/ skyes bu ngan pa /yang na/ kā pu ru ṣaḥ/ skyesabungan nga / ka ba 4ste/ uṇ+ḍa la ka ba'ang ngo / /uṇ+ḍa pha rol la ku'i sgra ni ka ba zhes par 'gyur zhing 'ang gi sgras/ kata/ kā rnams su'ang 'gyur te/ ku uṣ+ṭaḥ/ zhes pa la/ ka poṣ+ṭi/ drod zhan pa / ka dur+ghaṃ/ drod 717—372

zhan pa// kolja/ 'gril 1 par/ aghi pha rol la yang ka ba sogs su 'gyur ro cenas bshad pas/ ṭa/ phya sniḥ/ mengan pa / chenas pa 'a// ka ste/ghiḥ/ me ngan pa / yi/ dasniḥ / mengan pa// kābyāḥthra kho da rā dī ni ya tho ba diṣ+ṭi/ thra kho da ra la sogs pa rnams gang legs pa rnams su'o/ /thra kho da ra la sogs pa'i gzugs rnams ā ga ma ster ba dang / yi ge 'gyur ba dang / yi ge nyams pa dbyi ba dang /yi ge bsnol ba la/ sogs pa de dang de'i mdos ma zin kyang brjod pa bde ba dang /gzugs gang legs pa rnams su 'gyur te/ thra ṣa dwa do da re ya su saḥ/ ri dwasas kyi lto ba 'dra ba de sang si/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye phrad sogs phyis/ thra ṣata u da ra / zhes gnas pa la/ mdo 'dis/ ta phyis/ ata la yon tan/ bṛ kho da ram̐ / ri dwasas lho ba/ ga r+pā in+d+raḥ/ ba la nga rnam sa kyi dbang po / zhes pa la / rnam dbye phyis/go in+d+ra/ mdo 'dis/ a ā ga ma byin te/ ga be+en+d+raḥ/ ba lang dbang ngo / ho sa tī ti / 'tshe ba 'di/ zhes pa la// i ti phyis// ho sa// zhes pa mdo 'dis yi ge snga phyi 'gyur te/ atsa gnyis rang gnas/ ha dang sa/ gnyis/ snga phyi bsgyur bas/sedhaḥ / 'tshe ba phul du byung ba ste seng se'o/ /grusnyeḥ.āt+na ya su/ sang si sas nga ba'i bdas nyid/ zhes nga/ la rnam dbye sogs/ phyis/ mdo 'dis/ ā ur song / gru rnyod+mā/ sas nga ba'i bdas nyid dam sba sa nga 'i bdas nyid/ ma dh+yā ro tī ti/ sa ngasgra sgros nga 'di/ zhes/ pa la/ rnam dbye sogs phyis/ ro tī'i don/ ra/ ma tī raḥ/ zhes gnas pa la/ mdo 'dis / tī yu/ra du bsgyur / ma yu raḥ/ sa la sgra sgros ste rma bya'o/ /sogs te mdos ma zin pa thams cad mdo 'dis bsgrub bo/ /na hi thran+ti thra ṣi bya 4 bye ru tsi sa hi ta ni 6 kau/ nā 5hi j-iti thra ṣi bya dhi ru tsi se ha ta ni rnams la kipa la'o/ /na nyi la sogs pa de rnams ki pa kyi rkyen byin pa pha rol la ming sngon ma'i mtha' ring 177—373

por 'gyur te/ u pa pa de na hra te/ long pa la nye bar 'ching ba/ zhes pa la/ de'i don du/ u pa sngon ma'i na ha la/ ki pa/ kipa yongs rdzogs 'jig /mdo 'dis pa ring po/ u pā na ta/ lham/ nibya ye na brta te/ yul ngan pa 'byung /zhes pa'i don la/ — bṛta/ yul ngan nga / pra kak+ṣe ṇa bar+ṣati/ char rab tu 'bab pa//zhes pa'i don la/ pā bṛṭa/ chararab tu 'bab pa// bi she ṣe na bya dha ti/ rnam/ nga/ra ci na pa/ra byed zhes pa'i don la/ bī bya na/ rnam pa ra snu na pa// bra kak+ṣe na ro tsa ti/ rab tu sasal bar byed/ zhes pa'i don la/ drwa ru ka/ rabatu gsal ba/ tu ram̐ sa ha te/ zhes pa'i don la/ tu rā ṣa ṭa/ ma/gyogs pa ra bzod nga// pa ri 1 ta no ti/ yongs su rgyas pa/ra byed/zhes pa'i don la/ pa rī ta ta/ yongasasu rgyas nga / ba na gi rlo ཿsaṃ dz+nyā mā ko ṭa ra ki shu lu kā dī dzā/ ba na gi ri dag las ming la ko ṭa ra ki shu lu ka sogs rnams kyi'o / /ming la ba na'i sngon du ko ṭa ra sogs dang gi ri'i sngo na du ki shu lu ka sogs byung na ko ṭa ra sogs ring por 'gyur te/ ki shu lu ka su gi riḥ/ rgya skyesas kyi ri/ zhes pa la/ rnam dbye bsdus/ mdo 'dis ka ring po/ ki shu yi/kā gi riḥ/ rgyaskyebs kyi ri/ ko ṭa rā rde ba khaṃ/ rdzong si nabs te bya tshang ma nga ngo yod nga 'i nabs so / /zhes pa la/ ko ṭa rā ba ṇi/ rdzongabinags / ba rna pu ra gā mi shra kā se za kā sā ri kā ko ṭa rā gre bh+yaḥ/ ba na'i bu ra gā/ mi shra kā si dh+ra kā sa ri kā ko ṭa ra a gra rnams las so/ /ba na'i sngon du pu ra kā —la sogs pa 'di rnams byung na ba na'i na yig ni ṇa yig tu 'gyur te/ pu ra gā rmā ba rna/ gu gul shing sga nags / zhes pa la / pu ra gā ba r+ṇa3/ gu gul shing ji nags/ de bzhin du/ mi shra kā rmā ba ā+oṃ/ 'dres pa/'i nags/ zhes pa la/ mi shra kā ba r+ṇa/ 'dresapa'i nags/ se za kā rmā ba rna/ thang shing sga nags—/ zhes pa la/ sedh+ra kā 5pa khaṃ/ thangashing gi nags/ sa ri kā dzā 7ba dz+wa/— tsher ma 117—374

la ba na'i na ṇar mi 'gyur te/ i ri kā dzā ba rna/ 7 ko la 'i nags/ zhes pa la/i ri 1 kā ba rna2 / pā rna de she/ pā na'i yul la'o/ /tshig sngon ma la na ṇar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can gyi yi ge yod pa la de yang yul brjod pa'i don yin na pā na'i na ṇar 'gyur te/ k+ṣi ra pā rna ye ྾ te/ gang rnam sa kyi 'o ma 'thung ba de/ zhes pa la / k+ṣi ra pā khaṃ/ 'om 'thung ba/ de bzhin du/ gang rnam/sa kyi chang 'thung ba de/ su rā pā rgo ye ྾ te/ zhes pa la/ su rā pā r+ṇa/ changa'athung ba/ bā bha ba ka ra ṇa yoḥ/ chang 'thung ba/ dngos po dang byed pa dag las yang na'o/ /tshig sngon ma na ṇar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can kyi yi ge yod pa la dngos/ po dang byed pa'i don can yin na pā na'i na ṇar yang na 'gyur te/ k+ṣi re ṇa bā rde/ 'oma'athung ba/ zhes nga/ la/ k+ṣi ra bā rde/ k+ṣi ra pā rna/ de bzhin du/ k+ṣi ra pā dze+e ka ro ti pā tram̐/ 'o ma 'thung bar byed nga 'i sno da/ zhes pa la/ k+ṣi ra pā ṇi pā tram̐/ 'oma'athung stso da/ k+ṣi ra pā/ ā+oṃ pā tram̐/ 'o ma 'thung sgo da/ gi ri na t+yā dī dzā bā/ gi ri na dī so/gas/ rnams/ kyi yang na'o/ /gi ri sogs la na dī'i na ṇar yang na 'gyur te/ gi ro na dī/ rilachu/ zhes/ nga/ la//gi ri ṇa dī/ rilachu/ gi ri na dī/ rilachu/ de bzhin du/ tsakra kā ram̐ na dī 5ya su/ / gang si 'khor bar byed nga 'i chu/ stunas pa 'a// tha kra ṇa dī/ chu'akhor/ 'a kra na dī/ chu 'khor/pra ti pa di rmā ta nu m+bi bhat+ta 6 tsa/ ming nu ma rnam dbye rnams la 'ang ngo / /tshig sngon ma la na ṇar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can kyi yi ge yod na pha rol gyi ming gi na dang num byin pa'i na dang ṭā i 6nar 'gyur ba lta bu rnam dbye'i na rnams ṇar yang na 'gyur te/ ming la/ ma ṣartswa sau bā r+pā tsa/ sran ma ya nga 'di sa bon ya nga / zhes pa la/ ma ṣa bā pi ṇi/ sranasabon/ num la/ bye hi 7bā r+pā ya su/ gang bi 'bru'i sa bon—/ chenas pa 'ab/ dzasashi num/ —bye/ hi ste/ pā ṇi/ 'bru'i sa bon rnams/ rnacha/ dbye/ la/ chab 7 17/de377

ṣa pa // 1 kyang sum/ gang ji sran ma'i sa bon/ cenas pa 'ab/ ṭā.in/ ma/ ṣa da/ pe ṇa/——sran son/yu ba de r+ṇa/ yu ban sogs kyi ma yin no/ /mdo snga ma'i mtshan nyid rnams tshang yang yu ban sogs kyi na ṇar mi 'gyur te/ ra myabyu sau yu bā tsa/ —yid 'phrog pa/ ya nga 'di dar bab kyang ngo / /zhes pa la/ ṭā ramya yu nā/ yid 'phrog dar bab kyi/ de bzhin du/zab byu/ snga haḥ/ rtseba'i nyi ma / stunas pa 'a// ṭā zab ste/ ṭ+wā/ rtsebs nyi ma// ṭa/ ma/ ti than/ku ldan pa la'ang ngo / /tshig sngon ma de la na ṇar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can gyi yi ge yod la/ tshig phyi ma de'i yi ge dang po la ku ldan pa ste/ ka sde'i yi ge yod na 'ang na ṇar yang na 'gyur te/ ha reḥkā mi m+bi/ 'phrog byed kyi 'dod nga la / zhes pa la / ha ri kā mi be+e/ de bzhin du/ shuṣ+ka tsā sau go ma yo tsa/ 〉 ma po 'ang 'di ba la nga si lci ba'ang ngo / /zhes pa la/ shuṣ+ka go 4ma ye ṇa/ —lcib skam/ ngo / pa da bya bā ye3pi/tshig bar na yod pa la'ang ngo / /mdo snga ma de rnams kyi rgyu mtshan rnams tshang yang de'i bar na tshig yod na na ṇar mi 'gyur te/ ma ṣabya kum+bhabya bā btso/ sran ma/ dang bum nga dang sa bon dang / zhes pa lta bu la/ ma ṣa kum+bha bā pe na/ sran ma bum nga sa bon kyis /de bzhin du/ tsa turtswaṅgabya yo gabya/ ba'i dang ya na la ga dang sbyo ra ba dang / zhes pa la/ tsa tu raṅga yo ge na/ yanal ga ba'i sbyo ra gyis / pā ra ska ra pra j-i tī ni tsa saṃ dz+nyā yī/ pā ra ska ra la sogs pa rnams kyang ming la'o/ /pā raska ra la sogs pa rnams kyang ming brjod pa la gzugs legs pa rnams su 'gyur te tshig phrad do/ /pā raḥka ro ti / pha rol byed pa / zhes pa la/ pā ra ska raḥ/ pharolabyed pa / de bzhin du/ kiḥki d+mā ya ༄/3/— gang sga ci ci'i tshad/ zhes pa la/ kisti d+dhā/ —cici'itshad/ ba naḥpa tiḥ/ nags kyi bdag po/ zhes pa la/ ba naspa tiḥ/ —nags bdag /a dhaḥshi ra shi pa de/ a dhashi ra shī'i 6pa da la'o/ /a dha dang shi ra shī'i rnam bcad ni pa da pha rol la sa ru 117—378

'gyur te/ a dhaḥ pa rda/ 'ogarkangapa/ zhes pa la/ a dhaspa rda/ 'ogarkang pa/ de bzhin du/ shi ra shīḥpa rda/ mgoborkang pa// zhes pa la/ shi ra shī spa rda/ mgo bo rkang pa—/ pañca myuḥsto kā di bh+yaḥ/ sto ka la sogs pa rnams lnga pa'i 'o/ /sto ka la sogs pa rnams las pha rol gyi rnam dbye lnga pa tshig phyi ma la mi dbyi ste/ sto kārluk+taḥ—/ — chung ngu la sa grol/ dru rārluk+taḥ/ ring ngo las grol / aspra rluk+taḥ nyung ngu las grol/kṛsgorluk+taḥ / ——dka'ab las grol/ ka ti pa yārluk+taḥ/ cung zad las grol/ o dzam ho3m+bhasta mas skṛ tso tī yā yāḥ/ o dzas/ sa has/ am+bhas/ ta mas las gsum pa'i'o / /o dzas la sogs pa 'di rnams las pha rol gyi gsum pa tshig phyi ma la mi dbyi ste/ yos ja sā kṛ tai/ gzi brjid kyis byas/ sa ha sā kṛ tai/ lhan cig sgas byas/yinam+bha ste/ kṛ tai/ chuyis byas/ ta ma na/ kṛ tai/ khyobar byas / ma nasaḥsaṃ dz+nyā yī/ ma nas las ming la'o/ /ma nas la 3 pha rol gyi rnam dbye gsum pa'i tshig phyi ma la ming brjod pa la mi dbyi ste/ ma na sā gup+taḥ/ yidakyis sba sa pa// ma na sā de bī/ yid kyis lha mo/ā dz+nyā yi ni tsa/ ā dz+nyā yin la'ang ngo / /ma nas las pha rol gsum pa ni ā dz+nyā yin tshig phyi mar gyur pa'ang mi dbyi ste/ ma na sā dz+nyā yī/ yid kyisab7'a/ āt+pa nabya pū ra ṇi/ ād+man las kyang rdzogs pa la'o/ /āt+pa na las kyang pha rol gyi gsum pa ni grangs sdogs pa'i rkyen can gyi tshig phyi ma la mi dbyi ste/ ṭā ād+ma nā pañca maḥ/ —bdag nyid kyis lnga pa / ṭā ād+ma nā ṣaṣ+ṭhaḥ/ bdag nyid kyis drug pa// pra kṛ t+yā di bh+yabyu/pra kṛ ti sogs rnams las kyang ngo / /pra kṛ ti la sogs pa rnams las kyang pha rol gyi gsum pa ni tshig phyi ma la mi dbyi ste/ pra kṛ t+yā dru paḥ/ pra kṛ t+yā tsa rūḥ—/ snyerang bzhin kyis mdzes pa/ bai yā ka ra zla khyu yī tsa tud+dhāḥ/ brda sprod pa'i ming la bzhi pa ya'i'o/ /brda sprod pa'i ming gi don can āt+pan las pha rol gyi bzhi pa 117—379

ni tshig phyi ma la mi dbyi ste/ ād+ma ṣ+pe ba rda/— bdag nyid kyi ched kyi tshig /ād+ma ṣ+pe bhā ṣā/ — bdag nyid kyi ched kyi bshad pa/ pa ra gya tsa/ ba ra'i —rmye'ang ngo / /don sngon ma ltar la lnga na du ma zad par las kyang pha rol gyi bzhi pa ni tshig phyi ma la mi dbyi ste/pa rasmi pa rda/ gzhan gyi ched kyi tshig /pa rasmi bhā ṣā/— gzhan gyi ched du bshad pa/ ha la dan+d+rat+pa p+ta myuḥsaṃ dz+nyā yī/ ha la ata mtha' las bdun pa'i ming la'o/ /hal mtha' can dang ata mtha' las pha rol gyi bdun pa ni ming la tshig phyi ma la mi dbyi ste/ga bi yu bye rgyu sbi raḥg bi yu bye dag las spri ra'i 'o/ /ga bi dang yu dhi 5dag las pha rol gyi sbi ra zhes pa'i sa ni ṣa ru 'gyur ro/ /ga bi spru raḥ/ ba lang la gnas/zhes pa la/ mdo sngon mas bdun pa mi dbyi/ mdo 'dis sa ṣa/ sa ṣar song bas tha'ang ṭha/ ga bikhye raḥ/ —ba lang la gnas/ de bzhin du/ yu byesbi raḥ/zhes pa la/ yu dhiṣ+ṭi raḥ/ —g.yu langor brtan pa/ yang mi dbyi ba kho nar ma nges te/ā ra bye spru raḥ/— dgon pa/ la gnas/ zhes pa la/ ā ra sgo spri raḥ/ dgon pa na gnas/bak+ṣe dzaḥ/ dbyar skyes/ bste dzaḥ/ dz+dzad d+ku rgyu 4tsa/ z-id dib dag las kyang ngo / /z-i da dang dib dag las kyang pha rol gyi bdun pa tshig phyi ma la mi dbyi ste/ z-i di smṛka5 / snying la reg /di bi smṛka6/ —mtho ris la reg /ma dh+yāṅga ro/ ma dh+ya las gu ru la'o/ /ma rgya las pha rol gyi bdun pa ni gu ru tshig phyi mar gyur pa la mi dbyi ste / ma bye gu ruḥ/ dbus na bla ma/ an+d+rastso/ an+ta las kyang ngo / /an+ta las pha rol gyi bdun pa ni gu ru tshig phyi mar gyur pa la mi dbyi ste/ adhe gu ruḥ/ —mtha'an bla ma/ a mūdhe masta kāt+yāṅgā da kā me/ mūsgo masta ka kā ma la ma 3yin zhing rang lus las so/ /rang gi lus kyi yan lag las pha rol gyi bdun pa tshig phyi ma la mi dbyi zhing mūsgo masta ka kā ma rnams la dbyi'o/ /mgrinanag/ kabye kā laḥ/ u ra se lo mā/717—380

brang la spu/ u da re ma ṇiḥ/ pho ba la nor bu/ mūsgo sogs la/ mūsgo ni shi kha / ——spyo bo la gtsug phud/ cesas pa la/ (1d+dhā tso/ ta// spyi bo gtsug phud/ cha/rtag te/ // ta// thodapa la gtsug phud/ cenas pa la/ masta ka shi ta// thod nga la gtsug phud/ mu khe kā sna/ nga su// gang sga gdong la dngas ma/ zhes pa la/ mu kha kā maḥ/ gdong la dngas ma/ badhe tsa bi bhā 1 ṣā/brnya la'ang gdam nga'o/ /tshig sngon ma'i mtha'i bdun pa ni brnya pha rol la dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba 'dam ka can te/ hasta ban+dhaḥ/ la ga nga la bcings/ zhes pa la / hasta brnyaḥ/ la gapa la bcings / yang na rang gnas/ de bzhin du/ tsakre ban+dhaḥ / 'khor lo la bsdam sa/ tsakre ban+dhaḥ/ tah+phu —ru ṣe kṛ ti ba hu lo/ de'i skyes bu la kṛta la mang po'o/ /de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba la bdun pa'i mtha' can mang po kṛta sogs kyi rkyen can pha rol la mi dbye ste/ sdong ngo la dga'/ stasbe ra maḥ/karte dza paḥ/— rna bar sgos nga / pā dṛṭa sha raṭ+wā la di r+pā dze/ pā dṛṣa sha rata kā la dib rnams kyi dza la'o/ /pā bṛṣa sogs 'di rnams kyi pha rol gyi bdun po 5ni dza tshig phyi mar gyur pa la mi dbyi ste/ nge pru bṛṣi dzaḥ/ dbyar skyes / ji sha ra di dzaḥ/ sto na skyes/ ji kā le 6 dzaḥ/ dus la skyes / ji di bi dzaḥ/ mthoris skyes / bi bhā ṣā bar+ṣa k+ṣa ra sha ra ba rāta/ bste k+ṣa ra sha ra ba ra las gdam nga'o/ /bar+ṣa la sogs pa 'di rnams kyi pha rol gyi bdun pa'ang dza tshig phyi mar gyur pa la dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba 'dam ka can te/ bak+ṣe dzaḥ/ lolaskyes/ bar+ṣa dzaḥ/ k+ṣa re dzaḥ/ 'gyur skyes—/ —k+ṣa ra dzaḥ/ sha re dzaḥ/ ma/da'askyes/ sha ra dzaḥ/— mda' skyes/ ba re dzaḥ ma/chog skyes— —ba ra dzaḥ/ sha ya bā sa bā se ṣ+ṭa kā lāta/ sha ya bā sa bā sen rnams la dus ma yin pa la'o/ /tshig sngon ma'i bdun pa ni dus kyi don can ma yin pa'i sha ya sogs pha rol la dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba 'dam ka can te/ swe 3sha yaḥ/ bdag nyal/717—381

gyi tshig phyi mar gyur pa la mi dbyi ste/ ngasasnyehotuḥpu tra/—sbyin sreg mkhan gyi bu/ ngas snyeho tu radhe bā sī/snyesbyin sreg mkhan gyi nye gnas/ bi bhā ①ṣā swa thra pa troḥ/ swa thra pa te dag la gdam nga'o/ /swa thra dang pa ti dag tshig phyi mar gyur pa las tshig snga ma'i ṛta mtha'i pha rol gyi drug pa ni dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba 'dam ka can te/ na rmā duḥpa tiḥ/snye.a chi'am rmo mo'i bdag po ste me me'am po po/snyen rmā dṛ pa tiḥ/ du hi tuḥpa nyiḥ/snyebu mo'i bdag po ste mag pa/snyedu hi dṛ pa ti/ mā tuḥswa sā/—mayispun te sru mo/snyemā tre ṣ+ṭa sā/ mā j-i pi j-i rgyuswa sā/ mā z-i pi tre dag las swa thra'o/ /mā tro dang pi dṛ dag gi pha rol du swa thra byung na swa'i sa ṣar 'gyur te/ mā tuḥswa sā/snyem yispun te sru mo/snyemā dṛ khya sā/bi tuḥswa sā/snyepha yispun te a khu'o/ pi dṛ swa sā/ mā tro pi tro bh+ya ma n+ya twa ⑤ra sde/ mā tram̐ snepi tro dag la yang na'o/ /swa thra mā tre dang pi tre dag gi tshig phyi mar gyur pa yang na ṣar mi 'gyur te/ mā tre ṣa sā/snyema'ispun/ mā tro swa sā/ pi tre ṣ+ṭa sā/snyepha'i spun/ pi tre swa sā/snyepha'ispun/ rnam dbye ma phyis pa la ṣar mi 'gyur te dper brjod gong du bstan zin to/ /i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa su sru tā t+pa mā sām mābhāḥ/zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las tshig sdud rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don dper brjod cho ga sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las/ tshig sdud kyi cho ga spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //༈ da ni ming las rang dang 'byel pa yis/ /ming gzhan bsgrub pa de phan te/ /zhes pa'i de phan gyi rkyen rnams kyi 'jug yul bshad par bya ste/ byā 117—383

bya to3ṇa/ rtses pa las gong du aṇa'o/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i mdo de yis rtses so/ /thul lo/ /rgyal lo/ /brkos zhes 'byung ba las gong du de phan gyi 'jug yul bshad pa de rnams la aṇa yang na 'gyur te spyir btang ngo / /ta sgyu pa tram̐/ de'i bu brgyud la'o/ /rtags gang dang gang la'ang drug pa'i mtha' las de'i bu brgyud kyi don la aṇa la sogs pa 'gyur ro/ /sa maṭ+wā rmā pra mā dā/yang dag pa'i don rnams kyi thog ma las yang na'o/ /yang dag pa'i don zhes pa bu brgyud kyi rkyen ster rgyu'i ming de don 'gal ba ma yin pa don mthun pa'i tshig bu brgyud sogs kyi rkyen ster yul de'i sngon na yod ①na'ang aṇa la sogs pa rnams yang na 'gyur te/ u pa go ra pa bye/snyenye ba'ib lang gi bu/ zhes pa ngag sbyor la rnam dbye phyis/ a pa t+ya'i don aṇa byen/ tadhi te (kyeṣ+ṭa tsā mā deḥ/ de phan rnams la atsa rnams kyi dang po'i 'o/ /de phan gyi rkyen rnams la nya na rjes su 'byel pa las rkyen ster yul gyi ming rnams kyi atsa rnams las dang po de 'phel bar 'gyur te/ au pa gu/ aṇa/ ṇa de'i don yin pas phyis/ u'i yon tan nos/ u o/ etsa'i a ya sogs kyi mdos/ au ba ga baḥ/snyenye ba'i ba lang gi bu/ bud med du brjod pa na/ ṭi ta zwa sogs kyis dīpa/ au pa ga bī/—nye ba'i ba lang gi bu mo/ a ba bye po tra pra z-i ti go tram̐/ bu brgyud la bu'i bu la sogs pa rnams la rigs la'o/ /bu brgyud brjod pa can bu'i bu la sogs pa la rigs rtogs par byed pa la'ang aṇa la sogs pa 'gyur ro/ /e ko go tre/ rigs la gcig pa'o/ /bu brgyud kyi rkyen rnams rigs rtogs par byed pa la'ang 'jug ste rkyen gcig pa zhes so/ /au pa ga paḥ/snyenye ba'i ba lang gi rigs/ dza ④taḥ.inya/ata las i nya'o/ /ata mtha' las bu brgyud kyi don la inya 'gyur te/ dak+ṣa 117—384

mtha' a kang du 'gyur bar 'dod pas/ byā sa myu pa bye/— rgyasapa'i bu/ rnam dbye sogs phyis/ inya mtha' a gang / byus ka /inya/ na yā rgyu pa dān+targyu pū rdzu tu tā sgyu mi tsa/ lnga lnga tshig dang po dag gi ma yin zhing de dag gi e tsa'o/ /de phan gyi rkyen 'phel ba'i rgyu mtshan can pha rol la rkyen ster yul gyi tshig de la ya yig dang ba yig tshig gi dang po dang nye ba can yod na 'phel bar mi byed cing de dag la itsa ā ga ma ster te/ de'ang etsa ni so sor bsdu ba yin pas ya yig yod na e dang ba yod na au ster te/ ka khā par/ ya ba zirdog dang po dag gi ma yin zhing 'phel ba ā ga ma'o zhes byung ba dang gcig go/ /skabs 'dir ya yin pas i byin/ rgyasapa'i bu/ be+e yā sa kiḥ/ tshig sbyor sngon ma ltar byas pas/bā rū bhā kiḥ/— zhi dul can gyi bu/ ṣ+pe ṣā da kiḥ/— nags kyi mi'i bu/ tsāṇ+ḍa la kiḥ/——gtum po'i bu/baisba kiḥ/snyebim+bi'i mdog 'dra ba'i bu ste shin tu dmar ba'i bu/ go tre kuṭ+wā di bh+ya:sto/ kuñja sogs rnams las rigs la'ang phonya'o/ /kuñja la sogs pa rnams la bu brgyud kyi don dang rigs brjod pa la'ang sgonya 'gyur te/ glangapo'i bu/snyekuñja snga pa h+ye/zhes pa'am/ kuñja su go traḥ/——glang po'i rigs/ zhes pa'i don la/ sgonya/ nya 'phel ba'i don tsa dbyangs don/ pha/ skabs 'gar a ya ṇar 'gyur/skabs 'gar ā ya nar 'gyur zhes 'grel par byung ⑫bas/ ā ya nar 'gyur/kaulnga ya naḥ/——glang po'i bu'i rigs/ shā tasgonyo raste yī/ shā ta las sgonya la bud med min pa la'o/ /zwa ta sogs la bud med ma yin pa la sgo nya'i mtha' la rang don la khya 'gyur te/ /zwa ta la sgo nya byin nas gong ltar bsgrubs pas/ drwa tā ya na su swādze+e/snyesru ta'i bu'i rang don/ zhes pa'i don la/ krā tā ya n+yaḥ/snyethā ta'i bu'i rang don/ de bzhin du/ kaur+sā ya n+yaḥ/snyeglang po'i bu'i rang don/ byā da yasta drwa dzāḥ/ khya sogs 117—387

ngo/'i tshogs/ dmar ru mako nag gi tshogs/ —bo/:sngo kaḥ/ —gulnga la ṭhaka /su kha shā ya la ṭhal /— sa tab ste/ 'ab kaḥ / —bde bar nyal ba'i tshogs sam dmar ser byi tshogs/——che/ṅga bla kaḥ/ siṅgali la ṭhaka /ste/ ste/ di bh+yo yaḥ—/ bā sha la sogs pa rnams las ya'o/ /pā sha la sogs pa rnams la tshogs pa brjod pa la drug pa'i mtha' las ya 'gyur te/ ya pā shā/— zhagasapa 'i tshogs / ya — bā /pho / rlung sga tshogs/ ya ṭab sbyar ba ste rang bzhin kyi mo rtags so/ / 11 :// rtsa'i tshogs/ (2 lophopi / u la 'ang ngo / /ba ta las tshogs pa brjod pa la spru la'ang 'gyur te/rlung bi tshogs/ bā tū laḥ/ cil/ 'grel par lung drangs pa/ kha la go ra thā r+ya/kha la go ra tha las ya'o/ /kha la sogs pa 'di rnams las tshogs pa brjod pa la kyang sha sdomazab ste// ya tab /sto/ ṭāb tha chad dam ngan nga 'i tshogs/ ya ba/ ste// ṭāb ba la nga ji tshogs /ya ra byā/ ṭāb thing rta'i tshogs / i ni tra ka r+ya tsa:/ i ni traka r+ya tsa rnams kyang ngo //kha la gor tha rnams las tshogs pa brjod nga/ la rim pa bzhin i ni tra ka r+yatsa rnams 'gyur te/ tha chad dam ngan pa 'i tshogs/ kha li be+e/ kha la i ni na'i i brjod don ṛta na ma/tha' 'es pa sa dīb/ ba la nga si tshasas sa ma ribs kyi tshobs/ —bo/ tā/ so tra la ṭāb/ ra tha la 7 r+ya tsa tsa dbyangs don ra tha ka r+ya/ —tringarta'i tshobs / ta da sde pra ha ra ṇa mi ti 1 ḍā yāṇ+ḍaḥ/ mtshon cha las de 'di la rtse bar byed pa zhes pa la ṇa'o/ /mtshon cha las de 'di la rtse bar byed pa zhes pa'i don la dang po'i mtha' bdun pa'i don can la ṇa 'gyur te/daṇ+ḍaḥpra ha ra ṇa ma sri 1 ḍā yī/ 'di la mtshon cha dbyug pas rtse bar byed/ zhes pa'i don la/daṇ+ḍa la ṇa/ dbyug nga sa rtse/ dāṇ+ḍa/ ḍāb/ de bzhin du/ muji la ṇa 'phel ba ṭāpa / —mobye/ —khu tshur gyis rtse/ bhanyaḥsā sde1 ye ti nyaḥ/ de 'di bya ba zhes pa'i ghanya la nya'o/ /bya ba'i tshig sngon na yod pa gha nya'i mtha' las bdun pa'i don la nya 'gyur te/ bye na pā ta la nya/ bye na ti la su pā te nye1 / bye na ti la'i pān nya la'o/ /pā ta 1 17—402

nya'i rkyen can pha rol la bye na dang til dag la mum ā ga ma 'gyur te/ ma ni ma 'gro ba atsa'i mtha' las pha rol gyi don dang u brjod don no/ /nyaṭāpa shri rna // shā// khra lta bu ba/ :de nga/stunozug du// til sngon ma'i bā ta la nya 'phel ba byen ti la'i 'es pa/ mum ṭāpa/ — sten lo pā tā/ snumathob/ ta da dhī te ta dre da/ de brjod pa dang de rig pa'o/ /de brjod pa dang de rig pa'i don la gnyis pa'i mtha' la aṇal sogs pa 'gyur sten / in+d+ra sogs 'es pa 'i brda sprod brgyad ni in+d+ra byā sa ra ṇa tsan+d+ra byā la ra ṇa bi shā li byu khre ra ṇa shā 7 ṭā ya ṇa byu khre ra ṇa pā ṇi ni byu 7 ra ṇa su masto bha dra byā 7 ra ṇa nga tai dza li byu khre ra ṇa ma nu dzen+d+ra byu khre ra ṇa rnams so / / 6)byed 55ཿaṣ+ṭa byā ka ra khaṃ a dhi te pā ṇi ni ṛ ṣiḥ/ dbang ngo so gas brda sprod brgyad klog pa drang srong pā be+e pa /chenas palnga/ mdon 'a / byā 7 ra ṇa la an i ā sa ma su a ma / be+e 1 pa/ ka zab khaṃ pā ṇi ni lnga/ ṣiḥ / brda sprod klog pa drang srong pā ṇi pa / de bzhin du/ in+d+ra da yaḥ.aṣ+ṭa byā ka ra khaṃ be ti pā ṇi ni ṛ ṣiḥ/ dbang ngo sosas brda sprod brgyad ris pa drang sro nga pā ṇi nga / zhes pa'i don la/ aṇa be+e yā ka ra khaṃ pā ṇi ni ṛ ṣiḥ/ brda sprod ris nga drang sro nga pā ṇi pa / kra mā di bh+yo bun/ kra ma la sogs pa rnams la sa buna'o/ /kra ma la/ sogs pa rnams la sa de brjod pa dang de rig pa'i don la bun 'gyur te/ na dbyangs don bu a ka /bun kra ma kaḥ / rim/ pa shes pa / bun pa da kaḥ tshisaris nga / ta da smi na s+t+ri ti she tan+d+ram+bi/ de 'di na yod pa zhes pa yul la de'i ming la'o/ /de 'di na yod pa zhes yul gyi ming yang go bar byed pa'i don la bdun pa'i mtha' la aṇa 'gyur te/ u dusba rā ṇi saṃ ti asmin de she/ 'di na u durja ra rnams yo da pa 'i yu la / zhes pa'i don la/ u duji ra yo da pa / —au dulba raḥ/ te na ni dṛr+ghaṃ/ de yis rdzogs pa la'o/ /de yis rdzogs pa'i don la gsum pa'i mtha' la aṇa la sogs pa 'gyur te/ ku shāsbe na nidṛt+ta/ ngan sel gyis gang ba/ stunas palnga/ 1debya/ 'ang/ grong khyer ma dzod lda na/ ma/ sa/ste/ bya/ ba/ ti/ ku shasba la a ṇa 1 77/de— 03

'phel ba ṭita rte sogs kyis dīb/ ta su ni bāsaḥ/ de'i gnas la'o/ /gnas su sdod pa la de'i ming la drug pa'i mtha' la aṇa la sogs pa 'gyur te/ shi bā rmā ni bā saḥ / 'i ba rnams kyi sanas / ce/sa palnga/ mdon 'a / zhibapa / shi baḥ/ aṇa'aphel ba/ phyag zla/ rab bste ba bya/ mi ring ba nyid las kyang ngo / /mi ring ba nyid brjod pa la drug pa'i mtha' la aṇa 1la sogs pa 'gyur te/ yu la rnams kyi mi ring ba nyid/ bi di shā nā ma du ra bha baṃ/ zhes pa'i don la/ yu la mi ring ba/ bai di shaṃ/ aṇa'aphel ba/ dza na pa de lu ba / ljongs la dbyi'o/ /gnas kyi don can gyi rkyen rnams ljongs brjod pa'i don yin na rnam dbye mang tshig la 'jig ste/ spyongs lnga len nga rnams/ baṃ tsalāḥ/ aṇa phyis nga 'o/ /ba ra ṇa di bh+yabya/ ba ra ṇa la sogs pa rnams las kyang ngo / /ba ra ṇa la/ sogs/ nga/ rnams kyi mi ring ba'i don gyi rkyen rnams kyang rnam dbye mang tshig pha rol la/ 'jig ste/ dzas la aṇa phyis pa 'o/ / ba ra rjaḥ/ risas nye ba rnam sa / she ṣe/lhag ma la'o/ /gong du bshad pa de rnams las nye bar sbyar ba la lhag ma don gzhan la aṇa la sogs pa 'gyur te/ tsakyu ṣā kṛ hra te/ bltabyamis /zhes pa'i ma/zug 'a// blta bya/ ste/:/ /nga/ aṇasu a ma/ aṇa cha/ nga/ ḍa ཿ/ —mnyan bya/ aṇa bas sa naḥ / myangabya/ a ṇa sprar+sha naḥ/ reg bya/ ta tra dzā taḥ/ der skyes pa las so/ /der skyes pa'i don la bdun pa'i mtha' la aṇa la sogs pa rnams 'gyur te/bcom/ brlas tu skyes pa / ma thu rā yī dzā taḥ/ zhes pa'i don la/ bcom/ brlag tu skyes / mā thu raḥ / aṇa 'phel ba/ pā bṛ ṣaṣ+ṭha ka /pā dṛ ṣa las ṭhaka'o/ /s+thā bṛṣa'i sgra las der skyes pa'i don la bdun pa'i mtha' la ṭhaka 'gyur te/ ṭha7 7 'phel don ṭha7 il/ pā thra ṣi kaḥ/ dbyar skyes/ ta tra bha baḥ/ de la dngos po la'o/ /de'i dngo sa po brjod pa la bdun pa'i mtha' la aṇa la sogs pa 'gyur te/ ma thu rā yī bha 717/de4 07/

yataskyiyi/ bā byu/ཿ/——nub tu skyes pa'am nub nas 'ongs pa'am nub pa// yata sa/ dī tsuḥ/— byang du skyes pa'am byang nas 'ongs pa'am byang ba/ yata dra/ tī 4/ཿ/ nub tu skyes pa'am nub nas 'ongs pa'am nub pa// yi byu/ yāṣ+ṭha pa/ mi zad pa las t+ya pa'o/ /mi zad pa'i nang tshan a ma i ha/ kwa rnams dang ta se la dang tral gyi rkyen mtha' rnams las lhag ma la t+yapa 'gyur te/blon ngo/'am blon ngo las skyes pa / yin na/ /phoḥ/ t+yapa/ nga/ dbyangs don/ t+yapa yinaha /maḥ/ 'di 'am/ 'di las skyes pa 'am 'di nas 'ongs/ t+yapa/ ma/ /snaḥ/ ci la sa skyes sam ci nas 'ongs pa/'am ci/ t+yapa/ ta ta::ཿ / de la sa skyes sam de nas 'ongs pa 'am de la / t+yapa// ta ya/ /maḥ/ de la sa skyes sam/ de nas 'ongs sa ma/ de la t+yapa ṣ+peḥsgru pe/ ni las brtan pa la t+yapa 'o/ /ni las brtan pa'i don la t+yapa 'gyur te/ ni ya tai sgru baṃ/ —nges nga 'am/ brtan nga / zhes pa'i don la/ t+yapa/ ni h+ye / nges pa 'am/ brtan nga 'am mi g.yo ba/ skyes ṣa mo khyaḥshwa sophon+ya ta ra sde/ skyes ṣa mas khyas shwas las yang na'o/ /e ṣa mas sogs rnams las lhag ma la t+yapa yang na 'gyur te/t+yang/ skyes ga ma bye// 'di la sa skyes sam 'di nas 'ongs sa ma 'di/ t+yang sdomabye// kha sa nga skyes sa ma kha sa nga 'ongs sam kha sang / t+yapa shwaspyo/ rlung la sa skyes sa ma rlung nas 'ongs sa ma rlung / 'a nga na/ skyes ṣa masta dze+e/ sogs te 'og tu 'chad do/ /thra dhiḥya snga tsā mā distaj-idhi/ gang gi atsa rnams kyi dang po 'phel ba de 'phel ba'o/ /rtags gang gi'ang atsa rnams kyi dang po 'phel ba'i yi ge yod pa de la 'phel pa'i ming can zhes ming 'dogs byed de dgos pa ni 'phel ba las tsha' zhes sogs kyi ched de/ thradhertseḥ/ 'phel ba las tsha'/ /gong du 'phel ba'i ming can zhes brda chad byas pa de las lhag ma la tsha 'gyur te/ gārgye dza taḥ/ garga'i bu la sa skyes nga / gābye bha ba/ garga'i bu nyid/ zhes palnga/ 1den 'a / gargya la tsha tsha smi ya bu brgyud kyi de phan la ā ma yin pa 'es ya phyis/ sgo/༷/ kyangaḥ/ garga'i bu'am garga'i bu las skyes pa/ ri bya'i bu'am ri bya'i bu las skyes pa/ sto/ gas+t+ri yaḥ/ — tshayīya/ shā che/yaḥ/ ra 117—407

ba ru skyes pa'am ra ba nas 'ongs pa'am ra ba/ t+ya dā dī ni tsa/ t+yad la sogs pa rnams kyang ngo / /t+yad la sogs pa rnams las kyang lhag ma la tsha 'gyur te/ t+ya dī sku// —de las skyes pa 'am de nas 'ongs pa'am de/ tsha ta dī sku//— de las skyes pa'am de nas 'ongs pa'am de—/ tsha ya dī yo/ gang las skyes pa'am gang nas 'ongs pa'am gang / pra t+ya yot+ta ra pa da yobya/rkyen dang tshig phyi ma dag las kyang ngo / /yuṣ+ṭhad dang a smad gnyis kyi da bor ba'i yuṣ+ṭha asma dag ni rkyen pha rol dang tshig gzhan pha rol las kyang rim pa bzhin twa dang ma dag tu 'gyur te/ khyad las skyes pa'am khyod/ t+yad la sogs pa zhes pas tsha khru twa dang asma ma ru 'gyur/ twa dī pa/ཿ/ yud+mada.asmad la/ ma dī pa/ཿ/ bdag las skyes pa 'am bdag /:drob/ :shā cha/ 'a /twah+phu traḥ/ khyed kyi bu/ mah+phu traḥ/ —bdag gi bu/ bha ba taṣ+ṭha ka tsha sau/ bha bta las ṭhaka tshas dag go/ /bha bta las lhag ma la ṭhaka dang tshas dag 'gyur te/ tshasī ya sa/ baṅkaḥ/ khyed las skyes pa'am khyed las 'ongs pa'am khyed/ bha bta la ṭhaka ka 'phel ba is us u7 ta sogs kyis ṭhakhre /bha bta la tshas si ti tsa/ sa 'gro ba la'ang ngo / /rkyen sa 'gro ba dang ya 1la sogs pa 2 pha rol tu byung na rkyen ster yul gyi ming de la tshig ces ming 'dogs byed do/ /dgos pa ni mtha'i dzha la rnams kyi dza sha snyernams so/ /zhes pas/ ta dar 'gyur ba'i ched yin no/ /bha btal tshas sa ta dar 'gyur ba'i don tsha ā+o ya/— bha pa dī yaḥ/— khyod las skyes sam khyod/ yi/ nyache / yi/ nya las kyang ngo / /rigs kyi don du byin pa'i inya'i mtha' las lhag ma la aṇa 'gyur te/ dāsgo bha baḥ/snyemakhas pa'i rigs/ dā k+ṣiṃ dza taḥ/ mkhas pa'i rigs las skyes pa// zhes pa'i don la/ inya aṇa —dāk+ṣaḥ/——mkhas nga/'i rigs las skyes pa'am mkhas pa'i rigs/ rgyal po'i rigs las skyes pa'am rgyal po'i rigs—/ — k+ṣu traḥ/ —inya.aṇa/ ga hā di byustsa/ ga ha la sogs pa rnams las kyang ngo / /ga ha la sogs pa rnams las kyang lhag ma la tsha 'gyur te/ khang pa ru skyes pa'am khang pa 117—408

lhag ma la ma 'gyur te/ ma dh+ya maḥ/ —dbus ma 'am dbus su skyes pa'am dbus nas 'ong ba ā debya / ā di las kyang ngo / /ā di las kyang lhag ma la ma 'gyur te/ ā di maḥ dang po'am thog ma'am legs pa/ a dha so3n+ta lo pa:/ a dhas kyi mtha' dbyi ba'ang ngo / /a dhas las lhag ma la ma 'gyur zhing mtha' dbyi ba'ang ngo a dha maḥ/ ngan nga 'am ngan pa/ las skyes nga 'am tha ma/ yi/ sa/ pra ti ka zu/ mnyam pa la yi/'o/ ma rmya las mnyam pa'i don la a 'gyur te/ ma rgyaḥ/ ma rgya la a gang gi ita la'ang ngos a phyis su/kā lāta ṭhanya/ dus las ṭhanya'o/ /dus brjod pa can la lhag ma la ṭhanya 'gyur te / zla ba'am zla ba las skyes pa /— na/ se kaḥ/ ṭhanya 'phel ba il /zla ba phyed dam zla ba byed nas 'ongs pa/ lhagabye na/ cig ma/ཿ/ ṭhanya 'phel ba i 7 /lo 'am lo las skyes pa/ dbus mnyam pa/'am 'dra ba'am mtshungs pa/ sāsbra t+pa ri kaḥ/ ṭhanya 'phel ba ika /ni shā pra do ṣā rgyutsa/ ni shā pra do ṣa dag las kyang ngo / /ni shā dang pra do ṣa dag las lhag ma la ṭhanya 'gyur te/ mtshan mo 'am ma/tshan las skyes sam mtshan las 'ongs/ bye tso/ ma/2 / ṭhanya 'phel ba ṭha i7 /srod dam mtshan mo'i dang ngo/'am srod la sa skyes sa ma srod la sa 'ongs/ pā do steng rka/ ṭhanya 'phel ba i7 /shwa sa(1tso / shwas 'a sa /ngeṭa 'ang ngo / /shwas las lhag ma la ṭhanya 'gyur zhing tuṭa ā ga ma yang ster te/ shwas la ṭhanya/ tuṭa/ dā sogs kyis i tsa ā gam/ ṭha ā+okhre/ sho paste| kai/ rlung ngam rlung las skyes/ dwa bas dī rmā tsa/ dā ra la sogs pa rnams kyi 'ang ngo / /dā ra la sogs pa rnams kyi pha rol tu rkyen 'phel ba'i rgyu mtshan can byung na rtags de dag gi dang po 'phel ba 4mi byed par ṣ+pe tsa ā ga ma ste ro/ /dā ra sogs ni/ dār swa ra byalka sha shwaste swa du mṛ du shwa su shwa ta sbya rnams so/ /sarba tāṇa tsa ta lo pastsa/ rtag tu aṇa ste ta dbyi ba'ang ngo / /te man+ta las lhag ma'i don can gyi aṇa ma gtogs aṇa byung tshad la ta dbye ba mayin no/ /lhag ma la aṇa rtag tu 'gyur zhing ta dbyi ba'ang ngo / /dgun nam dgun 7 117—410

ta dwa ha ti ra tha yu ga pā saṃ gi/ ra tha yu ga pā saṅga la de 'dren no la'o/ /ra tha la sogs pa 'di rnams la de 'dren no la gnyis pa'i mtha' la yata 'gyur te/ra dze+e ba ha ti/ zhes pa'i don la/ yata rajuḥ/ —shing rta'adren pa// de bzhin du/yata yu 23/ —gnya' shing 'dren pa/ yata pā saṃ byuṇ+ḍa/ glangadrug gis 'dren pa// dhu ro yata bhā kau/dhur las yata zwaka dag go/ /dhur las de 'dren no la yata dang bhāka dag 'gyur te / yata —dhubyutsho/— r+shang rta'i 'khor lo gnyis kyis lcags 'ding 'dren pa// kau re 'a ཿ/ thing rta'i 'khor lo gnyis kyis lcags 'ding 'dren pa/ rteka 'phel ba rtel e ya/ ha 6) can/ ha'/ 'a 'a nga ngo/ zab yig dang ba yig srog rnged kyi u pa dh+wa ika so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge yod na hal pha rol la ring por 'gyur ro/ /na bha kutshu dzā/ bha kur tshur rnams kyi ma yin no//bha'i ming can rnams dang kur dang tshur rnams kyi u pa dh+wa'i ika so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge rnams tal pha rol la ring por 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /khaḥsarba dhu rā ta/sarba dhu ra las kha'o/ /sarba snga ma'i dhu ra las de 'dren no la kha 'gyur te/lcags 'ding tham/sa cad 'dren pa// kha kha'i ā+o ṇa/ sarba dhu rī ṇaḥ/ e ka dhu rāphruka bā/ e ka dhu ra las yang na 'jig go/ /e ka dhu ra las kha yang na 'jig ste/ kha phyis pa —/ — ces ka dhu raḥ/ lcags 'ding gcig 'dren pa / ces ka dhu rī ṇaḥ/ khasteṇa/ sha ka ṭā daṇa/sha ka ṭa las aṇa'o/ /sha ka ṭa las de 'dren no la aṇa 'gyur te/ aṇa 'phel ba—/ —shā ka ṭaḥ/ shingarta'adren pa// ha la sī rā ta ṭhaka/ ha la sī ra las ṭhaka 'o/ /ha la dang sī ra las de 'dren no la ṭhaka 'gyur te/ ṭhal hā li kaḥ/ thong gshol 'dren pa /sī ra las ṭha7 'phel ba ṭha i7/— be+e ri kaḥ/ thongaba'adren nga / ta tra sā dhuḥ/ der legs pa la'o / /der legs pa la bdun pa'i mtha' la yata 'gyur te/ snyan tshig rnams la legs pa/— sām su sā dhuḥ/ bdun pa'i supa/ zhes pa'i don la/ snyan tshig legs nga//— sā ma 717—4/9
