spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa bshad par bya ste/ a ka khā dā ba ṣarnye pā ṣ+ṭha bā/ bklags pa la dang por ka kha med pa mthar ṣa med pa la yang na'o/ /bstan pa 'am bklags pa la byings na da sogs dang / ga da sogs dang / byings gang gi thog mar ka yig dang kha yig med 117—507

pa mthar ṣa med pa dag pha rol la pra la sogs pa na ṇar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can snga ma las nyer bsgyur ni'i na yig tu yang na 'gyur te/ khyul laṭa shapa// pra ṇi bha ba ti/ rab tu nges pa/ra yod/ rab tu nges nga ra yod/ pra ni bha ba ti/ lating// pu gan+ta la spyo pa dha sutsa / puka 1mtha' dang u pa dh+wa thung ngu dag gi 'ang ngo / /uka ā ga ma sbyin pa'i mtha' dang byings u pa dh+wa i ka na so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge thung ngu yod pa rnams rnam dbye byings thams cad pa dang byings phyed pa yon tan 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan can pha rol la yon tan du 'gyur te/lnga/ tse ta ti/ tsi tī ya nga dag nga/ra thes nga/ la la ṭa shang/ lnga tib/ mdo 'dis/ yon tan/ tse te ta / tsita la ling thang yā su ṭa la tipa// tse ta tu/ tsita la lo ṭa shang la nying / phyag byunge tata/ tsita la la nga shang lnga tipa tsi tī la byed pa po la shapa sbyar nas laṭa sogs byings thams cad pa'i ming can bzhi po cho ga thams cad bhū'i skabs dang 'dra la// pa rasmi pa da rnams 'jug cing / āt+pa ṣ+pe pa da rnams mi 'jug go/ /tsi tī la 'u/nga sbyar ba'i dper brjod bhū'i skabs dang cung mi 'dra ste/ ba da bra dza ha lan+ta snga tsaḥ ba da bra dza hal mtha' rnams kyi atsa'i 'o/ /byings bad dang / bradza dang /byengs hal mtha' can gyi dang po'i atsa ni sh+lau ra bsgyur ba se tsa pa rasmi pa da rnams pha rol la 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /ṣ+pe ṭi/ iṭa la ma yin no/ /gong du byings hal mtha' sogs kyi dang po'i a tsa ṅgir bsgyur ba'i sitsa pa rasmi pa da pha rol la 'phel bar 'gyur bar bshad kyang de'i dmigs bsal rgyu mtshan de dag 'dzom yang / byings phyed pa'i wal la iṭa'o zhes pa lta bu'i iṭa bar na yod pa la atsa de 'phel bar mi 'gyur ro/ /aste se tsophothrasto/ asti se tsa'i a bṛk+ta la'o/ /byings as dang ṅgi 'gyur ba se tsa'i pha rol tu a thrak+ta'i ming can 117—508

sogs kyis sa gnyis ru ru bsgyur/ u gnyis phyis/ ra gnyis rnam bcad/ tsi tsi tuḥ liṭa'i pa rame+e pa da'i skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tsi tse ti tha/ tsita la liṭa/ leṭa la byings a sgyu sa med pa'i 'os byengs gnyis brjod/ hal dang po lhag po 'os ta phyis/ la sepa/ du bsgyur pa/ rasmi pa da rnams kyi jes pas seng thal du bsgyur mtha'i ha la so gas kyis la phyis byings phyed pa 'i bal la iṭa bukhre mtha' u pa/ dh+wa thung ngu sogs kyis byengs la yon tan / tsi tsi ta thuḥ tsi tsi ta/ tsita la/ liṭa/ liṭa la byings a sgyus med pa 'i 'os byengs gnyis brjod— hal dang po lhag ngo/ 'os ta phyis/ pi thas dang thar bsgyur/ ba raspe pa/ da rnams kyi 'es nga/sa/ thas a thus dang / tha ar bsgyur/ liṭa'i pa rasmi pa da'i skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsi tse ta/ tsita la— liṭa liṭa la byings a sgyus med pa/'i 'os byengs gnyis brjod/ hal dang ngo lhag po la mipa du bsgyur/ nga rasmi pa da rnams zhes nga sa mipa ṇal du bsgyur/ pu7 mtha' u pa/ ṅgā thung ngu sogs kyis byings la yon tan/ tsi byunge ti ba / tsita la / liṭa byings gnyis brjod/ hal dang ngo lhag ngo la bas dang mas su bsgyur/ pa/ rasmi pa da so gas kyis bas pa dang / tsibyunge ti ma/ mas ma/ra bsgyur/ byings phyed pa/'i bal la iṭa/ pul ma/tha' dang u pa/ṅgā thung ngu sogs kyis byings la yon tan/ tsita la luṭa sbyar bas/ tse ti tā/ tse nyi tā ro/ tse ti tā raḥsogs te cho ga thams cad byu yod pa la luṭa sbyar ba'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /tsita la smon pa'i ling sbyar ba'i/ pa rasmi pa da'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tsi t+yāta/tsi t+yāspyo/ tsi kyā suḥ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tsi t+yāḥ tsi t+yāste/ tsi t+yāsta/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsi t+yā saṃ/ tsi t+yāsba/ tsi t+yāsma/ tsita la liṭa pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tse ti 6 ti/ tse ti 6 taḥtse ti 6rnyi/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tse ti 6 si/ tse ti 6 thaḥ tse ti 6 tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tse ti sgyu mi/ tse ti byā baḥ tse ti byā maḥtsita la mṛng gi pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a tse ti 6ta—/ a tse ti 6 tī/ a tse ti 6na/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a tse ti 6ཿ a tse ti byu tai/ a tse ti 6ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a tse ti 6/117—511

a tse ti byā ba/ a tse ti byā ma/pya/ ṭ+wā tir kun tu 'khrud pa la'o zhes pa'i byings la laṭa la sogs pa la yig bcu po'i pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i dper brjod ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i tsi ti yang dag par shes pa la'o zhes pa'i skabs dang phal cher 'dra ste/byengs kyi ir rjes 'brel/ byed pa po la shapa sogs sbyar bas laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ sh+lau tati/ h+ye ta taḥkhyu tarnyi/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/stso ta se/ stso ta thaḥ khyu ta tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ h+ye tā mi/ : tā baḥstso tā maḥ/ dz+nyā tir la ling sbyar ba'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dzu te ta/dzu tetsā/ dzu te yuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ stso teḥ dzu te tai/ dzu te ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dzu te yo/ dzu te ba/ byo te ma/ spro ta la lo ṭa nga/ rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ bh+ya ta tu/ byo ta tāta/ bh+ya ta tī/ stso tan+tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ stso ta/ rgyo ta tāta/ dzu ta tai/ stso ta ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dzu tā ni/ khyu tā ba/ stso tā ma/ tsū ta la lang gi pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i skyes bu dang ngo/ gsum la/ a stso ta ta/ a dzuta tsā/ a dzu tan/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a dzu taḥ a khyu tai/ a phyu ta ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/a dzu tai/ a dzu tā ba/ a rtsu tā ma/ ṭ+wā ta la lung sbyar ba'i skabs tsi tī dang cung mi 'dra ste/ i ri to bā/ ir 'gro ba las yang na'o/ /byings ir 'gro ba las pha rol kyi lung la ṅgi 'o zhes pas pa rasmi pa da'i skabs kyi sh+lau ni ang du yang na 'gyur te/ dz+nyā ang du bsgyur ba'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a dz+nyā tata/ a ṭ+wā ta hūṃ/ a dz+nyā tan/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum 117—512

la / dzu ti 6 si/ dzu ti 6 thaḥ/ stso ti 6 tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/byo ti byā mi/ dzu ti byā baḥ stso ti byā maḥ ṭ+wāta la mṛng pa rame+e pa da rnams sbyar ba'i bya ba rnams kyang tsi tī'i skabs dang 'dra ste/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/a dzuti ྾ta/ a khyu ti 6 hūṃ/ a dzu ti 6na/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/a byo ti 6ཿ a dzu ti 6 tai/ a dzu ti 6ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a dzu ti 6/ a rgyo ti byā ba/ a dzu ti byā ma/lnga/bh+ya tir 'gyur byed la 'o zhes pa'i byings la/ laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i cho ga rnams phal cher bshad ma thag pa'i dz+nyā tir gyi skabs dang 'dra ste/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ sbyo ta ti/ sbyo ta taḥ sbyo tadhi/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ sbyo ta si/ sbyo ta thaḥ sbyo ta tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sbyo tā mi/ sbyo tā baḥ sbyo tā maḥ byu tir la ling gi pa rame+e pa da rnams sbyar ba'i cho ga yang ṭ+wāta dang 'dra ste/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ sbyo teta / sbyo te hūṃ/ sbyo te yuḥ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ sbyo teḥ sbyo te tai/sbyo te ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sbyo ta yī/ sbyo te ba/ sbyo te ma/ byu tir la loṭa pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i cho ga rnams kyang ṭ+wā tir dang 'dra ste/skyes bu dang po gsum la/ sbyo ta tu/ sbyo ta tāta/ sbyo ta hūṃ/ sbyo tan+tu/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ sbyo ta/ sbyo ta tāta/ sbyo ta tai/ sbyo ta ta/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sbyo tā ni/ sbyo tā ba/ sbyo tā ma/ byu tir la lang gi pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i cho ga rnams kyang spro tir dang 'dra ste/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ asbyo tata/ asbyo ta tsā/ asbyo tan/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ asbyo taḥ asbyo ta tai/ asbyo ta ta/ skyes bu dh+ya ma gsum la/117—514

ita 'gro ba rnams kyi pha rol tu ming du bsgrubs 1pa'i rkyen dang / tshig tu bsgrubs pa'i rkyen gang byung yang byings de la num āg ma ster te/ ma gnas don dang u brjod don no/ /myu/ byings ku ti 'tshe ba dang nyon mongs pa dag la'o zhes pa la laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i laṭa la/ kun+d+ra ti sogs so/ /ling la/ kudz+re ta sogs so/ /'o/ṭa 'do/ ṭa tu sogs so/ /lang la/ yid kuṇ+ḍata sogs so//lung la a kadhīta snyesogs so/ /liṭa la/ ku hobyungaku ha dag gi tsu'o/ /byengs gnyis brjod pa'i a sgyu sa'i ming can de ku ste ka sde yin na grangs mthun pa'i tsa sngar 'gyur zhing ha yig yin na dzha yig tu 'gyur la/ dzha de yang a sgyu sa'i cara'ang ngo zhes pas dza yig tu 'gyur te/ tsu kun+d+ra/ tsu kun+d+ra tuḥtsu kunaḥsogs so/ /luṭa la/ kuṇ+ḍa tā sogs dang / smon pa'i ling la skabs 'dir i 'gro ba'i num yin pas na mi dbyi/ kud+dhā ta sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ kudz+re 6 ti sogs so/ /mṛng la/ a kudz+re 6 ta sogs te rigs 'gre'o/ /dh+wa tā deḥṣaḥsaḥbyings kyi dang po'i ṣa'i sa'o/ /ṣi dhu lta bu byings kyi dang po'i ṣa yig ni sa yig tu 'gyur te/myu/ ṣi dhu 'gro ba la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings la laṭa sogs pa rasme pa da rnams sbyar ba'i laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ se dha ti/ u pa sanārlu no ti su ba ti su ti sto ti sto dha tis+thā se na ya se dha si tsa sañja swadze+e/ nyer bsgyur las/ su no ti su ba ti su ti sto ti sto bha ti s+thā se na ya se dha se tsa sañja swañja rnams kyi'o/ /nyer bsgyur sa yig ṣa yig tu 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can snga ma las byings su no ti sogs te/ junya bskyed pa/ junya ded pa/ sngo mtha'i 717—517

las / junya bstod pa/ khye bha rengs pa/ jo gnas pa/ ṣinya 'ching kyeb/ṣi dhu 'gro ba/ ṣi tsa 'dzag pa/ ṣañja chags pa/ ṣ+ṭañja 'khyud pa rnams kyi dang po'i ṣa yig byings kyi dang po'i ṣa'i sa 'os ṣa sar bsgyur ba rnams be+er yang ṣa yig tu 'gyur ro/ /sa di ra pra teḥ pra ti ma yin pas sa di'o/ /pra ti ma yin pa ste bor bas nyer bsgyur gzhan sa ṣar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can dang po las sa di ste byings ṣa dri 'gro ba'i ṣa 5'gyur ba'i sa yang slar ṣar 'gyur ro/ /ste bheḥstaspyi'i 'o/ /nyer bsgyur rgyu mtshan can sngon ma las stam+bhi te/ byengs ṣ+ṭa bhi so sor 'ching ba'i sa yig kyang slar ṣa yig tu 'gyur ro/ /a bādz+nyā lasba nā bi drur+ya yoḥ a ba las kyang brten pa dang mi ring ba dag la'o/ /a ba snga ma las kyang stam+bhi'i sa yig brten pa dang mi ring ba'i don la 'jug pa na ṣa yig tu 'gyur ro/ /bebya swa no sgo dza ṣ+pe/ bi las kyang swa na'i zas la'o/ /bi dang yang gi sgras a ba sngon ma las kyang swa na ti zas kyi don la 'jug pa na ṣa yig tu 'gyur ro/ /pa ri ni be+e bh+yaḥse ba se ta sa ya se ba sa ha suṭa stu ṣ+ṭaspyo/ pa ri ni bi rnams las se ba si ta sa ya se ba sa ha stu ṣ+ṭañja suṭa rnams kyi'o/ /nyer bsgyur ba ri dang /ni dang bi rnams snga ma las/ byings se ba sogs te/ ṣe dz+re 'thor ba/ se ta dang ṣinya 'ching ba/ ṣi bu thags 'thag zipa/ kha 5ha bzod pa/ ngh+runya bstod pa/ ṣañja 'khyud pa rnams dang suṭa dang 'byel pa'i sa yig rnams ṣa yig tu 'gyur ro/ /ni sngon ma'i ṣi dhu la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ laṭa la/ni ṣe dha ti sogs so/ /ling la/ ni ṣe dhe ta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ ni ṣe dha tu sogs so/ /praka si tā da rgya ba yophopi/ se talas dang por aṭas bar chod pa las kyang ngo / /nyer bsgyur rgyu mtshan can sngon na yod pa las se ta ste su 117—518

no ti la sogs pa rnams kyi sa yig ni aṭa ā ga ma bar na yod pa las kyang ṣa yig tu 'gyur te/ lang la/ n+ya ṣe dha ta sogs so/ /lung la/ n+ya ṣe dhīta sogs so/ /s+thā di khya sgyu se na tsā sgyu sa gya/ s+thā la sogs pa rnams la a sgyu sa yis kyang a sgyu sa'i 'o/ /nyer bsgyur rgyu mtshan can snga ma las/ s+thā la sogs pa rnams kyi byings gnyis brjod pa a sgyu sa'i ming can yod na a sgyu sa de nyid ṣa yig tu 'gyur te/ liṭa la/ ni ṣi ṣe dha/ mdo 'dis sa snga ma ṣa dang kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa phyi ma ṣa/ ni ṣi ṣe dha tuḥ ni ṣi ṣi dhuḥ brtsegs nga ma yin pa'i 'es pa/sa 'dir liṭa ṅkata yin pas yon tan mi byed/ sogs so/ /luṭa la/ ni ṣe bye tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la ni ṣi dh+yāta sogs so/ /mṛṭa la ni ṣe dhi 6 ti sogs dang / mṛng la n+ya ṣe dhi 6ta—/ sogs so/ /se dha terga to/ /se dha ti 'gro ba la'o/ /nyer bsgyur rgyu mtshan can sngon na yod kyang byings ṣi dha 'gyur ba'i sa yig ni 'gro ba'i don brjod pa la ṣar 'gyur ba ma yin te/ ni snga ma'i ṣi dha 'gro ba la laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i/ laṭa la/ ni se dha ti sogs te/ ngag tu sbyar na/ni se dha ti tsā/ ba lang rnams nges nga/ra 'gro bar byed/ ling la ni se dhe ta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ ni se dha tu/ sogs so/ /lang la/ n+ya se dha ta sogs so/ /lung la n+ya se dhī ta/ sogs so/ /liṭa la/ ni se se dha/ ni si si dha tuḥ brtsegs pa ma yin pa'i thes pas 'dir liṭa kita yin pa/ u pa/ dh+wa yo na tan mi byed/ sogs so/ /luṭa la/ni se bye tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ni se dh+yāta/ —smon pa la kita 'os u pa dh+wa yo na tan mi byed/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ ni se bye 6 ti sogs so/ /mṛng la/ n+ya se dhi 6ta/ sogs so/myu/ ṣi dhū bstan bcos la ste bkra shis pa la 'ang ngo / /zhes pa'i 117—519

byings la laṭa sogs sbyar ba'i cho ga rnams kyang bshad ma thag pa rnams dang 'dra ste 'on kyang lung man chad byings phyed pa'i ming can rnams kyi skabs su cung mi 'dra'o / /laṭa la/ se dha ti sogs dang / chang la/ se dheta/ sogs dang / loṭa la se dha tu sogs dang / lang la/ a se dhata sogs so/ /lung la/ swa ra ti sru ti sru ya ti dhūnyu di to bā/ swa ra ti sru ti sru ya ti dhūnya u 'gro ba rnams yang na'o/ /byings/ h+phu sgra la'o dang / junya dang jung mngon par skye ba dang / dhūnya g.yo ba rnams dang / byings u 'gro ba rnams la byings phyed pa wal dang po rnams la iṭa yang na ba bya ste/ iṭa byen pa'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang pa 1 gsum la/ a se dhī ta/ a se byeṣ+ṭi/ a se bye ṣāḥskyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a se dhīḥ.a se byeṣ+ṭi/ a se dhiṣ+ṭa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/a se bye ṣe/ a se byeṣa/ a se dhiṣ+ṭha/ sogs te snga ma rnams dang 'dra la/ iṭa mi ster ba'i phyogs kyi lung gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ a me+edhīta/ r+ṣa sgru la 'u nga ci iṭa yang na ba'i don/ byengs kyi dang ngo 'i ṣa'i sa 'os sa ṣa/ lung lang dṛ nga sogs kyis byengs la a ṭa ṭa gnas don rjes 'greng phyis nas / la ting du bsgyur/ ita kyi'ang ngos i phyis/ 'u nga la ཿ 'os ཿ byen/cha'i sitsa 'os se tsar bsgyur/ tsa dang i phyis ba tabra dza hal ma tha' rnam/sa kyi a tsa'i 'os byings kyi u nga dh+wa 'phel ba/ a ste setsa'i a thrak+ta la 'os ba / ṭa gnas don/ khar la tsar 'os dha ta/ dzha lo dzha li/ dzhal gyi dzhal la'o//byings kyi mtha' dzha la so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge yin pa'i pha rol gye sh+lau 'gyur ba'i setsa ni rnam dbye dzhal so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge dang po can pha rol la 'jig go/ /dzha ṣasta thosgophodhaḥdh+wa ma yin pa'i dzhaṣa las ta tha dag gi dha'o/ /byings che dh+wanya ma yin pa'i byengs mtha' dzhaṣa so sor basbu ba'i yi ge yin pa'i pha rol gyi ta yig dang tha yig dag ni dha yig tu 'gyur ro/ /lung gi skyes bu dang po'i gnyis tshig la / a me+ezlo/ ṣi sgru la lung / byings kyi dang po'i ṣa'i sa 'os ṣa sa/ lung lang mṛng sogs kyis byings la 117—520

la byings hal dang po ste atsa gcig pu ma yin pa'i hal gyi srog tu zhugs pa'i a yig thung ngu ni 'phel 1 ba byed pa dang mi byed pa 'dam kha can te/ lung gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ a kha dīta/ a khā dīta/ gnyis tshig la/a kha dispya/ a khā dibye/ mang tshig la/ a kha di ṣāḥ a khā di 6ཿ sogs so//a ta u pa jo yāḥ/ u pa dh+wa'i ata kyi'o/ /rkyen nya 'gro ba dang ṇa 'gro ba dag pha rol la byings kyi u pa dh+wa'i a yig ni 'phel bar 'gyur te/ liṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig 21ga la/ tsa khā da/ kha da la / liṭa/ liṭa la byengs a sgyu sa med pa 'i 'os byings gnyis brjod/ hal dang ngo lhag ngo/ 'os du sgong ma phyis/ ku ha dab sga tsu 'os kha song ma tsha/ a sgyusa'i tsar 'ang ngos/tsha tsar bsgyur/ rjes 'grel phyis nas/ lnga ting du bsgyur/ nga/ rasme pa da rnams kyi ṇal sogs kyis tipa/ ṇal du bsgyur la khyad don mdo 'dis u pa/ dh+wa'i a 'phel ba sogs ṇa de'i don da a 'a drangs / gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la / tsa kha da tuḥ tsa kha duḥ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tsa kha di tha/tsa kha da thuḥ tsa kha da/ ṇa lut+ta mo bā/ ṇal phyi ma'i yang na'o/ /liṭa'i skyes bu phyi ma'i ṇal pha rol la u pa dh+wa'i a 'phel bar byed pa dang mi byed pa yang na ba bya ste/ skyes bu phyi ma'i gcig tshig la/ tsa khā da/ tsa kha da/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ tsa kha di ba/ tsa kha di ma/ luṭa la/ kha di tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ kha t+yāta sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ kha di 6 ti sogs so/ /mṛng la/ a kha di 6ta sogs so/ /myu/ ga da gsal bar brjod pa la'o zhes pa'i byings la'ang laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i cho ga rnams kyang snga ma rnams dang 'dra ste/ laṭa la/ga da ti sogs so/ /ling la/ ga de ta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ ga da tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a ga da ta/ sogs so/ /lung la u pa ṅgā 'phel ba 1 17—523

yang na bar byas pas/ a gā dīta/ a ga dīta/ sogs so/ /liṭa la/dzagā da/ byings gnyis brjod nas ku ha dag sga tsu 'os ga dzar bsgyur/ dza ga da tuḥ dza ga duḥ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dza ga di tha/ dza ga da thuḥ dza ga da/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dza ste/ da/ ja ga da/ ṇal phyi ma'i yang na 'os 'phel ba 'dam ka byas pa'o/ /ja ga di ba/ dza ga di ma/ luṭa la/ ga di tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ga t+yāta sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ ga di byu ti sogs so/ /mṛng la/ a ga di byuta / sogs so/ /byings ga da sogs pha rol la nyer bsgyur ni la rnam 'gyur 'byung tshul ni/ ṣ+perga da na da pa tapa da ghu mā su ti hadhi yā ti bā ti dā tid+mā ti ba ya ti ba ha ti shā mya ti tsi no ti de sti6 tsa/ ni'i ga da/ ga da gsal ngo/ra brjod nga la 'o/ /na da ṇang mi gsal ba'i sgra la'o pa ta nga kṛlhu nga ba la 'o pa da pa/ da 'gro ba la'o gh+ra byings ghu'i ming can ḍū dh+wanya 'dzin pa/ dang ḍū rānya sbyin pa/ gnyis na/ mang ma chad nga/ la 'o su ti sgo mtha'i 'a sa la 'o hadhi han 'tshe ba la ste 'gro ba la 'ang ngo sgo/ ti yā thob nga/ra byed nga la 'o bā ti ba 'gro ba la ste dri la 'ang ngo dru ti dru sma da nga/ la 'o che/ ti bza' ba la'o pa sa/ ti ngenya thags 'thag pa/ la 'ob ha ti baha thob pa la 'o/ /ste/ 4/ ti sha mu nye bar 'i ba la 'o byu1 code ste tsistogasog nga la 'o/ /rngo/ ha di ha gsog pa/ la 'o//rnams la'ang ngo / /byings ga da la sogs pa 'di rnams pha rol la nyer bsgyur na ṇar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can rnams las pha rol gyi nyer bsgyur ni'i na yig ṇa ru 'gyur te/ pra dang ni snga ma'i ga da la laṭa sogs sbyar ni'i na ṇar bsgyur bas/pra ṇi ga da ti/ nges nga ra rab tu rjod nga/ra byed/ sogs so/ /myu/ ra da rnam par rko ba la'o zhes pa'i byings la'ang laṭa sogs pa rame+e pa da rnams sbyar ba'i liṭa'i skabs su cung zad ma gtogs snga ma rnams dang 'dra ste/laṭa la/ ra di ta/ sogs so/ /ling la/ ra deta sogs so/ /loṭa la/117—524

ra da tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a ra data sogs so/ /lung la/ 'phel ba yang na ba byas pas/ a rā dī ta/ a ra dī ta/ sogs so/ /liṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ ra rā da/ a ta e ka hasma byephonā de shā derli ṭi/liṭa la dang po kun nas bsgyur ba ma yin pa'i hal gcig pa dbus ma'i ata kyi'o/ /liṭa ka 'gro ba'i ming can pha rol la byings gnyis brjod pa'i dang po a bh+ya sa'i ming can de a sgyu sa'i tsar 'ang ngo 'am/ ku ha dag gi tsu'o zhes pa lta bu'i kun nas bsgyur ba ma yin pa'i dbus ma ste/ de'i pha rol gyi yi ge de brtsegs pa ma yin pa hal gcig pa yin pa'i srog gi a 1 yig ni e yig tu 'gyur zhing a sgyu sa'i ming can de yang dbyi ste/ liṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gnyis tshig dang mang :drog la/ red tuḥ rad la/ liṭa/ liṭa la byings a sgyu sa med pa 'i 'os/ byengs gnyis brjod/ hal dang ngo/ lhag pa'o zhes pa/sa du gong ma phyis / rjes 'byel phyis nas / lnga tas dang dzhai ru bsgyur ba rasmi pa da rnams kyi 'es nga sa— tas a tus dang rnyi u sa su bsgyur/ mdo 'dis ra phyi ma'i so ga i dang ra sgong ma phyis dra a dang u sa la drangs/re duḥ rad la liṭa/ liṭa la byings a sgyu sa med pa 'i 'os/ byengs gnyis brjod/ hal dang ngo lha ga pa'o 'es pas du yong ma phyis/ rjes 'brel phyis nas/ lnga tas dang dzhai ru bsgyur ba rasmi nga/ da rnam/sa kyi 'es pa/sa/ tas a tus dang dzhai u sa su bsgyur/ mdo 'dis ra phyi ma'i sog i dang ra bong ma phyis a dang u sa la drangs/ tha li tsa se ṭi / thal la'ang iṭa dang bcas pa la'o/ /liṭa'i skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig thal iṭa dang bcas pa pha rol la'ang bshad ma thag pa bzhin 'gyur te/ra di tha/ snyerangal liṭa/ skyes bu dbus ma dang phyi ma la/ re da thuḥ re da/ skyes bu phyi ma'i gcig tshig la 'phel ba yang na bar byas pas/ ra rā da/ ra ra da/gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ re di ba/ re di ma/ luṭa sogs snga ma rnams dang 'dra ste/ luṭa la/ ra di tā/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ra byāta sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ ra di 6 ti sogs so/ /mṛng la/ a ra di 6ta 117—525

sogs so/ /kho naḥ ṇa'i na'o/ /byings kyi dang po'i ṇa yig ni na yig tu 'gyur te/lnga/ byings ṇa da mi gsal ba'i sgra la'o/ /zhes pa la laṭa sogs sbyar mdo 'dis ṇa na ru bsgyur/ gzhan cho ga thams cad bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra ste/laṭa la/ na da ti sogs so/ /ling la/ na deta sogs so/ /loṭa la/na da tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a na data sogs so/ /lung la 'phel ba yang na bar byas pas/ a nā dīta/ a na dīta/ sogs so/ /leṭa la/ na nā da / ṣ+pe da tuḥ ṣ+pe duḥsogs so/ /luṭa la/ na di tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ na byāta sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ na di 6 ti sogs so/ /mṛng la / a na dibyuta sogs te cho ga mi 'dra ba ci yang med do/ /u pa sanā da sa mā se3pi no pa de sha su/ nyer bsgyur las tshig sdud ma yin pa las kyang ṇa nye ba'i yul gye'o/ /ṇa nye ba'i yul te byings kyi dang po'i ṇa ṇa'i na 'os/ na yig tu bsgyur ba'i na yig ni nyer bsgyur na ṇar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can dang po las / tshig sbud dang tshig snyud ma yin pa las kyang ṇar 'gyur te/ pra snga ma'i ṇad la/ laṭa/ ṇa'i na 'os/ ṇa nar bsgyur/ mdo 'dis slar yang ṇar bsgyur/ pra ṇa da ti sogs so/ rab tu mi gsal ba'i sgra/stsa/ arda 'gro ba la ste slong ba la'ang ngo zhes pa'i byings la laṭa sogs sbyar ba'i cho ga rnams kyang liṭa'i skabs phran bu ma gtogs bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra ste / laṭa la/ arda ti sogs so/ /ling la arde ta sogs so/ /loṭa la/arda tu sogs so/ /lang la/ ārda ta arda la lang byed pa/ ngo la shang 'os shapa/ byin pa dang sha phyis/rjes 'grel phyis nas/ lnga tipa tu bsgyur/ ita kyi'ang ngos i phyis/ lung lang mṛng sogs kyi byings la aṭa ṭa gnas 117—526

don atsa dang po rnams kyi ā 'os byings la ā yang byen/ ṭa gnas don aka 'dra ba la ring po 'os a ā a gsum ring po gcig tu song / sogs rus/ /yi/nga 'a / sto/ji ta jo/gas so// atsa dang ngo/ rnams kyi ā 'os u ṭa gnas don/ a ta ā deḥdang po'i ata kyi'o/ /byings gnyis brjod pa'i dang po a sgyu sa'i ming can de hal gyi srog tu zhugs pa lta bu ma yin pa'i a yig kho na yin na a de ring por 'gyur ro/ /tasmrasgruṭa dī ha laḥ de las nuṭa hal gnyis pa rnams so/ /gong du bshad pa'i a ring por song ba de las pha rol gyi a yig la nu ṭa ā ga ma ster te de yang a yig de'i pha rol tu hal nyis brtsegs mthong) pa stu/ba/ nga/bo/sa ses/ /bla ṭa 'ab/ sto/ narda/ arda la / liṭa/ a tsa gcig pa 'i dang ngo/'i gnyis sos a gnyis brjod/ dang po'i aṭa kyi 'os a sgong ma ring ngo ra song / ma/do 'dis a phyi ma/ la nuṭa ā ga ma/ byen/ṭa gnas don u brjod don rjes 'brel rnams phyis nas/ lnga ti pa tas rnyi rnams su bsgyur ba rasmi pa da rnams kyi 'es pas tipa sogs rim bzhin/ ṇal/ a tus u sa rnams su bsgyur ba'o/ /lhag zugazad /ngeḥ arda la/ liṭa/ a tsa gcig pa 'i dang po'i gnyis sos a gnyis brjod/ dang ngo/'i aṭa kyi 'os a gong ma ring ngo ra song / ma/do 'dis a phyi ma/ la nuṭa ā ga ma byin/ ṭa gnas don u brjod don rjes 'bre' rnam sa phyis nas / lnga ti pa tas dhi rnams su bsgyur ba rasmi pa da rnams kyi zhis nga/sa ting sogs rim/ ba'in/ ṇal / a tus u sa rnam sa su bsgyur ba'o/ /stog zugasdogaḥ a rda la / liṭa/ a tsa gcig pa 'i dang ngo 'i gnyis sos a/ sanyis brjod/ dang ngo 'i aṭa kyi 'os/ a sgong ma ring ngo ra so nga /mdo 'dis a phyi ma la nuṭa ā ga ma byin/ ṭa gnas/ don u brjod don rjes 'brel rnams phyis nas/ lnga ti nga tas dzhai rnams su bsgyur ba rasmi nga da rnams kyi 'es pa sa ting/ so gas rim/ ba'in/ ṇal / a tus u sa rnam sa su bsgyur ba'o/ /skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ā nardi tha/ ā narda thuḥ ā narda/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ā nārda/ ā nardi ba/ ā nadi ma/ luṭa la/ ālda tā/sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la ādh+yāta sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ adi ྾ ti sogs chos / /lngasang 'a// sto/ji byungata rusags ses// atsa dang ngo rnams kyi ā 'os/ ā dang byings kyi a mtshams sbyar bas a ring ngo gcig tu song /༈ i di mchog gi dbang phyug nyid la'o zhes pa'i byings la laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i cho ga rnams kyang phal cher 'dra ste/ laṭa'i skyes bu 117—527

bsgyur ṇa nar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can snga ma las byings ṇa si dang ṇik+ṣa'o byed pa la'o zhes pa gnyis dang / bshad ma thag pa ṇi di smad pa gsum kyi ṇa 'gyur ba'i slar ṇa na yig tu yang na 'gyur te/ pra ṇin+da ti/ rab tu sma da pa ra byed/ pra nin+da ti lta bu'o/ /༈ byings u kha 'gro ba'i don la'o zhes pa la/ laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i cho ga rnams kyang liṭa'i skabs su cung zad ma gtogs snga ma rnams dang 'dra ste/ laṭa la/ khro kha ti/ sogs so/ /ling la/ o kheta sa/gas so/ /'o/ṭa 'a// yon kha // masags so/ /'a nga ba/ mas khata/ sesags ses/ /yi/par 'ab/ skyes ste/ta/ atsa dang ngo/ rnams kyi ā 'os/ byengs la āṣ+ṭa gnas don/ ā las kyang atsa'i 'os 'phel ba/ sogs so/ /a sgyu sa snga sa brte/ a sgyu sa'i 'dra ba ma yin pa la'o/ /byings gnyis brjod pa'i dang po a sgyu sa'i ming can de hal gyi srog tu zhugs pa ma yin pa'i u dang i yig gang rung yin la/ de'i pha rol tu atsa 'dra ba ma yin pa byung na u ni ubra dang i ni i lnga zhes par 'gyur/ te/ liṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig chirdog la/ u bo kha/ u kha la liṭa atsa gcig pa 'i dang ngo 'i sanyis so 'es nga sa u gnyis brjod/ rjes 'brel phyis nas/ lnga tipa du bsgyur/ pa rasmi pa da rnams kyi 'es nga sa tipa ṇal du bsgyur pu7 mtha' u pa/ dh+wa thung ngu dag bi 'ang ngos u pa dh+wa yo na tan ma/do 'dis u u bar bsgyur rim ba'in drangs / gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ u kha tuḥ spru khuḥskyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ u bo khi tha / u kha thuḥ.u kha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ u bo kha/ u bo khi ba/u bo khi ma/ luṭa la/ o khi tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ u khyuta sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ tshe khi 6 ti sogs so/ /mṛng la/ chas khi 6ta sogs so / /117—531

hutshwagya gyu la'o zhes pa'i byings la laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar/ mdo 'dis ring por byas pas laṭa la/ byutsho ti/ sogs dang / ling la/tūbyu tra sogs dang / loṭa la/ snutshatu sogs so/ /lang la/ a snumata sogs dang / lung la/ a tūdhīta sogs so/ /liṭa la/ dzu tūmasogs so/ /luṭa la/ byutshi tā/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ tūdh+yāta sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ snutshi 6 ti sogs so/ /mṛng la/ a tūtshi 6 ta/ sogs so/ /ba dza 'gro ba la'o zhes pa'i byings la'ang laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i cho ga yang liṭa'i skabs ma gtogs snga ma rnams kyi rigs 'gre ste/ laṭa la/ba dza ti sogs so/ /ling la/ ba dze ta sogs dang / loṭa la/ ba dza tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a ba dzata sogs so/ /lung la 'phel ba yang na bar byas pas/ a ba dz+reta sogs sam/ yang na a bā dz+reta sogs so/ /na sha sha da da bā dī dzā/ sha sha da da/ ba dang po rnams kyi ma yin no/ /byings sha sha ring du 'gro ba dang da da byin pa dang byings ba yig dang po can rnams gabyes brjod pa'i skabs a sgyu sa dbyi ba dang / phyi ma'i a er 'gyur ba sogs bya ba ma yin te/ liṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ba bā dza/ ba ba dza tuḥb ba dzuḥ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ba ba dzi tha/ ba ba dza thuḥ ba ba dza/skyes bu phyi ma'i gabyug tshig la 'phel ba yang na bar byas pas/ ba bā dza/ ba ba dza/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ ba ba dzi ba/ ba ba dzi ma/ luṭa la/ba dzi tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ba rjeta sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ ba dzi 6 ti/ sogs so/ /mṛng la/ a ba dzi 6ta sogs so/ /pra dza 'gro ba la'o zhes pa'i byings la laṭa sogs pa rame+e pa da rnams sbyar ba'i cho ga rnams kyang 1 17—534

snga ma rnams dang 'dra ste/ laṭa la bra dza ti/ sogs dang / ling la/ pra dzeta / sogs dang / loṭa la/ bra dza tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a bra dzadata sogs so/ /lung la/ a drwa dz+reta/ ba da bra dza hal mtha'i 'ang ngos 'phel ba/ adrwa dzispya / a krā dzi 6ཿ/ sogs so/ /liṭa la/ ba shā dza/ ba shā dza tuḥ ba bra dzuḥsogs so/ /luṭa la/ bra dzi tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la bra dz+nyāta sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ bra dzi 6 ti sogs so/ /mṛng la/ a bra dzi 6ta/sogs so/ /a dza 'gro ba dang 'phen pa dag la'o zhes pa'i byings la'ang laṭa la sogs pa pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i cho ga byengs thams cad pa'i ming can bzhi po snga ma rnams dang 'dra ste/ laṭa la/ a dza ti sogs so/ /ling la/ a jogata sogs so/ /loṭa la/ a dza tu sogs so/ /lang la/ ā dzata sogs so/ /lung nas brtsams te byings phyed pa rnams cung zad mi 'dra ste/ a dze rgyagha nya yoḥ.a dza' bī gha nya ma yin pa ya ma yin pa dag las so/ /byengs a dza ni ghanya dang ya thog ma can ma yin pa'i kṛta sogs kyi rkyen rnams dang byings phyed pa'i ming can rnams pha rol la bī zhes par 'gyur te/ 'grel par lung drangs pa/ba khā dā bārnya jo tu ke be 6 te/ wal dang po'i byings phyed pa la yang na bar 'dod do / /gong du byings phyed pa'i ming can rnams 1pha rol la byings a nadza bīr 'gyur bar bshad kyang de'i nang gses byings phyed pa'i ming can wal so sor bsnyu ba'i yi ge dang po na yod pa pha rol la a dza bīr 'gyur ba dang mi 'gyur ba 'dam ka can du byed do/ /e kā tsa ru pa de shā dā niṭa/ atsa gcig pa nye ba'i yul las iṭa ma yin no/ /byings ata mtha' dang uta mtha' dzāta mtha' rnams dang / hu sngu spru shing yu rku k+ṣu shi ḍi shri 117—535

mtha' ig so sor bsdu ba yin na sitsa rnam dbye pa rasmi pa da dang bcas pa pha rol la 'phel bar 'gyur te/ lung gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a be+e ྾ ta/ a be+ebye—/ a be+e 6ཿ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a be+e ṭīḥ/ a be+eṣ+ṭi/ a be+e ṣ+ṭa/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a be+e ྾/ a bai ṣ+ṭa/ a baiṣ+ṭha/ dza ṭa'i skyes bu dang bo gsum la/ bi bā ya/ bi bya tuḥ bi juḥ a tsas+thā swat+tha l+ya ni ṭo ni bye/ atsa las tās 'dra bar thal la iṭa rtag tu 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /byings atsa gcig pa mtha' rten ha la med pa las tās dang 'dra ba ste thal la iṭa rtag tu 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /ri ta bhā ra dā dza gya/ ṛta las bhā radā dza' 'o/ /gong du tās dang thal dag la byings atsa gcig pa mtha' rten hal med pa las iṭa rtag tu 'gyur ba ma yin no zhes byung yang de'i dmigs bsal byings ṛta mtha' rnams dang atsa gcig pa mtha' rten ha la med pa las kyang thal dang tās dang bal dang po rnams las kyang iṭa 'jug par sngon gyi drang srong bhā ra dā dza 'dod do zhes/ byung bas thal kyi skabs 'dir gzugs gsum 'byung ste/ bal dang po'i byings phyed pa la yang na bar 'dod do zhes pas/ a dza bī ru 'gyur ba dang mi 'gyur ba yang na ba dang / bī ru 'gyur ba'i phyogs la mdo 'di gnyis kyis iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ā dzi tha/ bi ba yi tha/ bi be tha/ skyes bu dbus ma'i gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/bi bya thuḥ bi bya/ skyes bu phyi ma'i gcig tshig la 'phel ba dang yon tan yang na bar byas pas/ bi bā ya/ bi ba ya/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ bī ru 'gyur ba dang a dza nyid du gnas pa yang na bar byas pas ā dzi ba/ ā dzi ma/ bī ru 'gyur ba'i phyogs la iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ bi ba yi ba/ bi ba yi ma/ blaṭa med pa'i phyogs la/ be+e bī ba/ bi bī ma/ a dza bī ru ma bsgyur ba'i phyogs kyi 117—537

luṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a dzi tā/ a dzi tā ro/ a dzi tā raḥ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a dzi tā si/ a dzi tās+thaḥ a dzi tāsru/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a dzi tāsmi/ a dzi tā swaḥ a dzi tāsmaḥ a dza bī ru bsgyur ba'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ be tā/ de tāro/ be tāraḥ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ be+e tā se/ be+e tāsgraḥ/ be+e tās+tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/bai tāsmi/ be+e tā swaḥ be tāsmaḥ drang srong bhā ra dā dza' 'dod pa ltar iṭa sbyar na/ ba yi tā/ ba yi tā ro/ ba yi tā raḥsogs so/ /smon pa'i leng la bya ba lhag po med de/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ bī yāta/ bī yās+t+ri/bī yā suḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bī yāḥ bī yāste/ bī yāsta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bī yā saṃ/ bī yā swa/ bī yāsma/ a dza bī ru ma bsgyur ba'i phyogs kyi mṛṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a dzi byu ti/ a dzi 6 taḥ.a dzi 6dhi/ skyes/ bu dbus ma gsum la/ a dzi 6 se/ a dzi 6 thaḥ/ a dzi ṅgha tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a dzi byā mi/ a dzi byā baḥ a dzi byā maḥ.a dza bī ru bsgyur ba'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ be 6 ti/ be 6 taḥbe ṅgharja/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ be 6 se/ be 6 thaḥ/ be 6 tha/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ be t+yā mi/ be+e byā baḥ be+e dzi maḥ bhā ra dā dza' 'dod pa ltar iṭa sbyar na/ ba yi 6 ti/ ba yi byu taḥ/ ba yi t+yarnyi sogs so//a dza bī ru ma bsgyur ba'i phyogs kyi kṛng gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ā dzi 6 ta/ā dzi 6 tī/ ā dzi byu na/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ā dzi 6ཿ/ ā dzi 6 tai/ ā dzi 6 ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ā dzi 6/ ā dzi byā ba/ā dzi byā ma/ a dza bī ru bsgyur ba'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a be+e 117—538

6 ta/ a be 6 hūṃ/ a be+e 6 na/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a be 6ཿ/a be 6 tai/ a be 6 ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a be 6/ a be+e byā ba/a be t+yā ma/ drang srong bhā ra dā dza' 'dod pa ltar iṭa byen na/ a ba yi 6 ta/a ba ①yi 6 hūṃ/ a ba yi 6 tairngu/ sogs te rigs 'gre'o/ /k+ṣi zad pa la'o zhes pa'i byings la'ang laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i cho ga rnams kyang phal cher bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra ste/ laṭa le1/ k+ṣa ya ti/ sogs so—/ /ling la/ k+ṣa yeta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ k+ṣa ya tu sogs so/ /lang la—/ a k+ṣuta/ sogs so/ /lung la/ ak+ṣe bhā ta/ a k+ṣe bye/ a k+ṣe 6ཿsogs so/ /liṭa la/ sgo ya/ dzik+ṣi ya tuḥ/ tsi k+ṣi yuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tsi k+ṣa yi tha/ tse k+ṣe tha/ tsi k+ṣi ya thuḥ/ tsi k+ṣ-i ya/ skyes bu phyi ma'i gcig tshig la/ tsi k+ṣu ya/ tsi k+ṣa ya/ gnyis tshig la/ tsi k+ṣi yi ba/tsi k+ṣa ba/ mang tshig la/ tsi k+ṣa yi ma/ tsi k+ṣi ma/ luṭa la iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ k+ṣe tā'am/ k+ṣa yi tā sogs so/ /a kṛn+d+rarba dh+wa tu ka yodīr+ghaḥ/kṛta ma yin pa byings thams cad pa dag la ring po'o/ /kṛta sogs kyi nang tshan ma yin pa'i rnam dbye byings phyed pa dang byings thams cad pa dag pha rol gyi rkyen ya yig ka dang nga 'gro ba'i ming can la byings mtha'i atsa ring por 'gyur te/smon pa'i ling la/ khye yāta/ k+ṣi yāspyo/ k+ṣi yā suḥsogs so/ /mṛṭa la iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ k+ṣe 6 ti'am/ k+ṣa yi 6 ti sogs so/ /kṛng la'ang /a k+ṣe 6ta'am/ a k+ṣa yi 6ta sogs so/ /༈ ka ṭi char dang sgrib pa dag la'o zhes pa'i byings la/ laṭa sogs pa rame+e pa da rnams sbyar ba'i bya ba rnams kyang lung gi skabs 'phel ba mi byed pa'i 117—539

khyad tsam ma gtogs snga ma rnams dang 'dra ste/ laṭa la/ ka ṭa ti sogs so/ /ling la/ ka ṭi ta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ ka ṭa tu sogs so/ /lang la/a ka ṭata sogs so/ /1n+ta k+ṣa ṇa shwa sa dzā kṛ ṇi bye di hūṃ/ hu phra lnga mtha' k+ṣaṇa/shwa sa/ dzā kṛ ṇi shi e 'gro ba rnams kyi'o/ /sh+lau'i 'gyur ba sitsa iṭa dang po can pha rol la/ byings hu yig dang po yig dang lnga yig gsum gyi mtha' can rnams dang / k+ṣa rku 'tshe ba/ shwa sa srog /dzā kṛ gnyid sad pa/ ṭu o shī 'gro ba dang 'phel ba rnams dang / byings gang la yang rkyen ṇi ①sbyar ba rnams dang / byings e yig 'gro ba rnams kyi 'phel bar 'gyur ba ma yin te/'dir ka ṭi e 'gro ba yin pas lung la 'phel ba mi byed/ a ka ṭīta/ a ka ṭispya / a ka ṭi 6ཿsogs so/ /liṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tsa kā ṭa/tsa ka ṭa tuḥ/ tsa ka ṭuḥ/ dbus ma gsum la/ tsa ka ṭi tha/ tsa ka ṭa thuḥ/tsa ka ṭa/ phyi ma gsum la/ tsa kā ṭa/ tsa ka ṭa/ tsa ka ṭi ba/ tsa ka ṭi ma / luṭa la/ ka ṭi tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ka t+yāta sogs so//mṛṭa la/ ka ṭi 6 ti sogs so/ /kṛng la/ a ka ṭi 6ta sogs so/ /gu pū dhū pa bi tsha pa ṇi pa ni bh+ya ā yaḥ gu pū dhū pa bi tsha pa ṇa pa na rnams las ā ya'o//byings gu pū bsrung ba/ dhū pa kun tu gdung ba/ bi tsha 'gro ba/ pa ṇa dang pa na tha snyad de byings 'di rnams las rang don la ā ya 'gyur te byings byengs su byed pa'i rkyen no/ /sa nā r+yad+dhā dh+wa ta baḥ san la sogs pa'i mtha' rnams byings so/ /san la sogs pa'i rkyen rnams sbyar ba'i mtha' dang ka mu la ṇi sbyar ba'i mtha' yang byings nyid du gnas te byings byings su bsgrub pa'i rkyen dang /ming byings su bsgrub pa'i rkyen zhes zer ro /117—540

༈ gu pū bsrung ba la ā ya sbyar spru yig spru dita kyi don/ puka mtha' u pa dh+wa thung ngu dag gi 'os yon tan/ byings byings su bsgrubs nas laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar bas cho ga snga ma rnams dang 'dra ste/ laṭa la/ go pā ya ti/ sogs so/ /ling la/ go pā yeta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ go pā ya tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a go pā yata sogs so/ /byengs phyed pa rnams la yang na bar byed de/ ā yā da yaḥ/ ādzha jo tu ke pā/ ā ya la sogs pa rnams byings phyed pa la yang na'o/ /ā ya la sogs pa'i rkyen rnams byengs phyed pa'i ming can rnams pha rol la yang na 'gyur ro/ /a to lo paḥ/ata kyi dbyi'o/ /rkyen mtha'i ata ni byings phyed pa'i ming can kye7rnams pha rol la dbyi'o/ /gu pū la ā ya sbyar ba'i phyogs kyi lung gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/a go pā yīta/ a go pā yispya/ a go pā yi 6ཿ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/a go pā yīḥ/ a go pā yiṣ+ṭi/ a go pa 1yiṣ+ṭa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a go pā yi ṣe/ a go pā yi ṣa/ a go pā yiṣ+ṭha/ ā ya ma byin pa'i phyogs la khru 'gro ba sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar byed de/ iṭa sbyar ba'i phyogs la a go r+pāta/a go pispya/ a go pi 6ཿsogs so/ /iṭa ma byin pa'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a godhīta/ a go hūṃ/——dzhal gyi dzhal la 'os sa phyis pa'o/ /a godruḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a godz+reḥ/ a gobye/— dzhal gyi dzhal la 'os sa phyis/ agop+ta/ dzhal rmi dzhal la 'os sa phyis/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a gorja/ a gogrwa/ a goju/liṭa la/ kā sa pra t+ya yā dā ma oṃ tre li ṭi/ kā sa dang rkyen las bod pa ma yin pa la liṭa la ām 'o/ /byings kā sre sgra ngan pa la'o zhes pa bod pa'i don brjod pa ma yin pa dang / san sogs rkyen mtha' can rnams las liṭa pha rol la 117—541

byings mthar ām sbyar bar bya ste/ go pā ya la/ liṭa/ mdo 'dis ām sbyar / ām las so zhes pas leṭa yang 'jig /kṛnya khyu as sogs liṭa dang bcas pa rjes su sbyar bas go pā yā mās/ go pā yī tsa kā ra/ go pā yī ba byu ba/sogs so/ /yang na ā ya mi sbyor te/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dzu go pa/dzu gu pa tuḥ dzu gu puḥ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dzu go pi tha/ dzu golba—/ dzu gu pa thuḥ dzu gu pa/ skyes bu phyi ma'i gcig tshig la/ dzu gopa/gnyis tshig la u 'gro ba sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ dzu go pi ba/dzu guthra/ mang tshig la yang / dzu go pi ma/ dzu gube+e/ gu pū la/ ā ya sbyar ba'i phyogs kyi luṭa la/ go pā yi tā sogs so/ /ā ya ma sbyar ba'i phyogs la / iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ go pi tā'am/ gobhā/ sogs so/ /gupa la ā ya sbyar ba'i phyogs kyi smon pa'i ling la ata kyi dbyi 'os byings mtha'i a phyis nas drangs pas/ go pā ljata sogs dang / yang na ā ya ma sbyar bas gu byāta sogs so/ /gu pū la ā ya sbyar ba'i phyogs kyi mṛṭa la/ go pā yi 6 ti sogs so/ /a yā ma sbyar ba'i phyogs la iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ go pi 6 ti'am / gop+lu ti sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng la/ a go pā yi 6ta sogs sam/ a go bi6ta sogs sam/ a go sgra ta sogs so/ /༈ dhū pa kun tu gdung ba la'o zhes pa'i byings la'ang laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i cho ga rnams bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra ste/ laṭa la/sgo pā ya ti sogs so/ /ling la/ sgo pā yeta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ bho pā ya tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a sgo pā yata sogs so/ /lung la/ a bho pā yīta'am—/ a sgo r+pāta sogs so/ /liṭa la/ bho pā yā mā sa sogs sam/717—542

rnams kyi dang po'i ṣa yig ni sa yig tu 'gyur ba ma yin te/myu/ ṣ+ṭi bu sel ba la'o zhes pa'i byengs la laṭa sogs sbyar 'dis ṣa sar mi 'gyur cho ga gzhan snga ma rnams dang 'dra ste/ laṭa la/spyo bu kla mu sogs kyis shi ta la ring po/ —spyu pa ti sogs so/ /ling la/ sgo pe ta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ dhī pa tu sogs so/ /lang la/ adhī bta sogs so/ /lung la/ akhye bīta sogs so//'grel par lung drangs pa/ bye be+eḥr sgyu sa su ṭha kā ras+tha kā ro bā/ ṣ+ṭha bu'i a sgyu sa'i ṭha yig dang tha yig yang na'o/ /sbyi bu gnyis brjod pa'i a sgyu sa'i ming can shar sngon ma'i kha nya lhag po 'os/ ṣa phyis pa'i ṭha yig ni ṭha yig nyid dam/yang na tha nyid du 'gyur te/ liṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ ṭikhye ba/tīsgre ba/—a sgyu sa'i tsa ra 'ang ngos/ ṭha ru bsgyur ba'i phyogs ṭa dang / tha ru bsgyur ba'i phyogs ta ru bsgyur ba'o/ /ṭa 'gro ba sogs ṭi e/ gnyis tshig la/ ṭikhye ba tuḥ tikhye ba tuḥ/ mang tshig la/tibye buḥ/ tikhye buḥsogs so/ /luṭa la/ ṣ+ṭha bi tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ spyu byā ta sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ ṣ+ṭi bi 6 ti sogs dang / mṛng la/abyā bi 6ta sogs so/ /stsa/ dzi rgyal ba la'o zhes pa'i byings la laṭa la sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar / cho ga liṭa'i skabs cung zad ma gtogs snga ma rnams dang rigs 'gre ste/laṭa la/ dza ya ti sogs so/ /ling la/ dza yeta sogs so/ /loṭa la/dza ya tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a dza yat+pa sogs so/ /lung la/ a dze+e ྾ta/a dze+ebye/ a dze+e 6ཿsogs so/ /sazli ṭordzeḥ/ san liṭa dag la dzi'i'o/ /san dang liṭa dag pha rol la byings dzi lan gnyis brjod pa'i phyi ma ni grangs mnyam pa'i ka sder 'gyur te/ lita'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dzi gā ya/117—549

tuḥ / ru ru 6ཿ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ru re ṣi tha/ ru roṣ+ṭha/ru ru ṣa thuḥ/ ru ru ṣa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ru ro ṣa/ ru ro ṣi ba/ru ro ṣi ma i 6 sa ha lu bha ru ṣa ri ṣaḥ/ i 6 sa ha lu bha ru ṣa ri ṣa las so/ /byings i 6 'dod pa/ ṣa ha bzod pa/ lu bha chags pa/ ru ṣa dang ri ṣa 'tshe ba rnams las ta yig dang po can kyi byings phyed pa la iṭa yang na 'gyur te/ru ṣa la/ luṭa/ iṭa byin pa'i phyogs la/ ro ṣi tā/ ro ṣi tā ro/ /ro ṣi tā raḥsogs so/ /iṭa med pa'i phyogs la/ roṭ+wā/ roṣ+ṭa ro/ robye raḥsogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ru byāta/ ru byā ā+oṃ/ ru byā suḥ/ sogs so / /mṛṭa la/ rogh+ra ti/ rogh+ra taḥ/ ro 6rnyi/ sogs so/ /mṛng la/a ro gh+rata/ a rogh+ra tī/ a rogh+ran sogs so/ /stsa/ ri ṣa 'tshe ba la'o zhes pa'i byings la'ang laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i cho ga thams cad bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra ste/ 'on kyang luṭa la iṭa yang na bar byed la/ gzhan bal dang po rnams la iṭa rtag tu sbyor te/laṭa la/ re ṣa ti sogs so/ /ling la/ re ṣeta sogs so/ /loṭa la/re ṣa tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a re ṣata sogs so/ /lung la/ a re ṣā te/a re ṣispya/ a re ṣi 6ཿsogs so/ /liṭa la/ ri re ṣa/ ri ri ṣa tuḥ/ri ri 6ཿ/ ri re ṣi tha sogs so/ /luṭa la/ iṭa yang na bar byas pas re ṣi tā sogs sam/ /reṣ+ṭa sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ri byāta sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ re ṣi byu ti sogs so/ /mṛng la/ a re ṣi 6ta sogs so/ /myu/ u ṣa sreg pa la'o zhes pa'i byings la/ laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i cho ga rnams kyang liṭa'i skabs ma gtogs snga ma rnams dang 'dra 117—556

— —ste—/ laṭa la/ o ṣa ti sogs so/ /ling la/ o ṣa ta sogs so/ /loṭa la / o ṣa tu sogs so/ /lang la/ au ṣa ta/——o atsa dang po'i āṭa 'os/ āṭa byin/aṭa las kyang ngos 'phel ba/ sogs so/ /lung la/ lo ྾ ta sogs so/ /u ṣa bi da dzā kṛ bh+yolhan+ya ta ra sde/ u ṣa bi da dzā kṛ rnams las yang na'o/ /byings u ṣa sreg pa/ bi da shes pa/ dzā kṛ gnyid sad pa rnams las liṭa pha rol la ām yang na 'gyur te/ u ṣa la liṭa/ ām sbyar ba'i phyogs la/ ྾ ba bhū ba/o ྾ tsa kā ra/ o ṣā mās/ sogs so/ /ām ma sbyar ba'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ u po ṣa/ spru ṣa tuḥ/ spru 6ཿ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ u bo ṣi tha/ spru ṣa thuḥ/ spru ṣa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ u bo ṣa/ u bo ṣi ba/ u bo ṣi ①ma/ luṭa la/ o ṣi tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ u byāta sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ o ṣi t+ya ti sogs so/ /kṛng la—/ au ṣi byuta sogs so/ /༈ sha sha ring du 'gro ba la'o zhes pa'i byings la/ laṭa sogs pa rame+e pa da rnams sbyar ba'i cho ga rnams kyang snga ma rnams kyis rigs 'gre ste/ laṭa la/sha sha ti/ sogs so/ /ling la/ sha 5 sheta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ sha sha tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a sha shata sogs so/ /lung la/ a sha shīta sogs so/ /liṭa la/ sha shā sha /sha sha sha tuḥ/ sha sha shuḥsogs so/ /luṭa la/ sha shi tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ sha shāta sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ sha shi 6 ti sogs so/ /kṛng la/ a sha shi 6ta sogs so/ /༈ mi ha 'khrud pa la'o zhes pa'i byings la laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar ba'i bya ba yang phal cher snga ma rnams dang 'dra ste/ laṭa la/ rnge ha ti 117 557

sogs so/ /ling la/ me hata sogs so/ /loṭa la/ me ha tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a me ha ta sogs so/ /lung la/ a mi k+ṣata/——mi ha la lung lung lang sogs kyis aṭa lung la ཿ 'os zo byin/ shal ika u pa jo zhes pas ཿ kla ru bsgyur ka phyis ha'i rte 'os ha rte sa la ṣa rte dag gi ka 'os/ rte ka kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣa/ ka ṣa 'dus pa k+ṣa/ la tipa/ ha sa sna rnams su bsgyur ba'o/ /yi :she k+ṣa hūṃ/ —mi ha la lung lung lang sogs kyis aṭa lung la ཿ 'os rtswa byin/ shal ika u pa d+ma zhes pas ཿ kla ru bsgyur ka phyis ha'i rte 'os ha rte sa la ṣa rte dag gi ka 'os/ rte ka kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣa/ ka ṣa 'dus pa k+ṣa/ la tipa/ ha sa rnyi rnams su bsgyur ba'o/ /yi/ :she k+ṣan sogs rus/ /—mi hal lung lung lang sogs kyis aṭa lung la ཿ 'os rtswa byin/ shal mika u pad+ma zhes pas sh+lau mi ru bsgyur ka phyis ha'i rte 'os ha rte sa la ṣa rte dag gi ka 'os/rte ka kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣa/ ka ṣa 'dus pa k+ṣa/ la tipa/ ha sa sgo rnams su bsgyur ba'o/ /6)ṭalnga/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ mi me ha/ mi mi ha tuḥ/ mi mi huḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ mi me hi thasne)/ mi me bhā/snyemi ha la/ liṭa byings gnyis brjod ha phyis la sib pa rasmi pa da zhes pas sipa thal du bsgyur/ ha'i rte 'os/ ha rte dzha ṣa las ta tha dag gis tha dha ṣa ṭul ṣa ṭu 'os dha rte rte'i rte la dbyi 'os rte sngon ma phyis/ mi mi ha thuḥ/ mi mi ha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/mi me ha/ mi me hi ba/ mi me hi ma/ phyo snye lo paḥ/ bhā'i bhā la dbyi'o/ /mtha'i zwa srog med ni bhā pha rol la dbyi bar bya ste/ luṭa la/ me ṭ+wā/snyemi ha la luṭa tās la 7 ṭa phyis pas tā ha'i zwa 'os ha rte dzha ṣa las ta tha sogs kyis ha dha ṣa ṭu la ṣa ṭu 'os/ dha rte mdo 'dis rte gong ma phyis/ me ṭ+wā ro/ be+e ṭ+wā raḥsogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la mi t+yāta sogs so/ /'o/ṭa la/ megh+ra ti/ —ha'i rte 'os ha rte/ sa la ṣa rte dag gi ka 'os/rte ka kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣa ka ṣa 'dus pa k+ṣa/ rusags cas/ /thosang 'a / yi ces gh+rata sogs so/ /༈ da ha thal bar byed pa la'o zhes pa'i byings la laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar/ cho ga bshad ma thag pa dang phal cher 'dra ste/ laṭa la/ da ha ti sogs so/ /ling la/ da teta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ da ha tu sogs so/ /177 558

pa—/ swa ra teḥsu su ni t+ya mi ḍā tsu①ཿ/ swa ra ti las gya kyi iṭa rtag tu brjod do—/ /swa ra ti ste byings kṛ las pha rol gyi su la iṭa rtag tu 'gyur te/ kṛṭa larka/ swa ri 6 ti/ swa ri 6 taḥ/ swa ri 6rnyi sogs so/ /kṛng la/ a swa ri 6ta/ a swa ri 6 hūṃ/ a swa ri 6na sogs so/ /༈ mṛ 'gro ba la'ang ngo zhes pa'i byings la/ laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar/ pā s+thā ④n+d+ra sogs kyi mdos thra sgo ru bsgyur byed pa po la/ shapa/dz+nyā ba ti sogs so/ /leng la/ dz+nyā beta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ dh+wa ba tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a dz+nyā bta/ sogs so/ /yang 'grel par thra 'gro ba de yang shin tu mgyogs par 'gro ba'i don la 'jug pa na sha 'gro ba pha rol la kau zhes par 'gyur la dal bus 'gro ba la ni sgo ru 'gyur ba ma yin no zhes bshad pas—/ dal bus 'gro ba'i don la/ laṭa la/ sa ra ti sogs so/ /ling la/sa ri ta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ sa ra tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a sa ra ta sogs so/ sarti shāskyarti bh+ya:/ sarti shāste arti rnams las kyang ngo / /thra 'gro bsneske/ shā su rjes su ston pa/ ṛ 'gro ba la ste thob pa la'ang ngo zhes pa rnams las kyang ṅgi ni pa rasmi pa da dang ād+ma ni gnyis ka la ang du 'gyur te/ sre la/lung / ṅgi ang / ṛ dṛ shophodi gu ṇaXḥ/ ṛ dṛ sha dag gi ang la yon tan no/ /byings ṛta mtha' dang dṛ ⑤shir lta ba dag gi ṅgi 'gyur ba ang pha rol la yon tan du 'gyur te/ a sa rata/ a sa rjor tsā/ a sa ran sogs so/ /'grel par lung drangs pa/ ṛ mṛ sgyu mas+thā ke tsita/ ṛ thra dag las la lar ang yang na'o—/ /gong du thra/ shā su/ ṛ rnams la ṅgi ang du 'gyur bar bshad kyang skabs la lar ṛ dang thra dag las yang na sa ⑦tsa ru'ang 'gyur te/ a sādhīta/117—570

skyes bu dang po'i gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ ā ra tuḥ/ ā ruḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig la/ i ḍargyurti bya ya tī ā+oṃ/ asti arti bya ya ti ①rnams kyi iṭa'o/ /byings a da za ba/ ṛ 'gro ba/ byanya sgrib pa rnams las pha rol gyi thal la iṭa rtag tu 'gyur te/ ā ri tha/ skyes bu dbus ma'i gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ ā ra thuḥ/ ā ruḥ/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ā ra—/ ā ri ba/ ā ri ma/ luṭa la/ aṭ+wā/ aṭ+wā ro/ aṭ+wā raḥ/smon pa'i ling la/ arti brtsegs pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ arlu ta/ar+yā.ā+oṃ—/ arlu suḥsogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ ṛta han sogs kyis eṭa sbyar bas/a ri 6 nyi/ a ri gyi taḥ/ a ri 6rnyi sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ thrang la/ā ri t+yata/ ā ri 6 hūṃ/ ā ri 6na sogs so/ /shu baḥ/ sh-i tsa/ shu'i 1 'ang ngo / /byings shu thos ②pa la'o zhes pa la byings thams cad pa rnams pha rol la byed pa po la shapa kyi don la shā 'gyur zhing der ma zad byings shu nyid kyang 1 zhes par 'gyur te/ sha yig ni sha 'gro ba'i don no/ /laṭa'i/ skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig la/ 1 ḍo ti/—ra ṣa sogs kyis na ṇa byings phyed pa dang byings thams cad pa dag gi 'os yon tan/ 1 rku taḥ/ hushā boḥ/ sārba dh+wa tu ke/hushā dag gi byings thams cad pa la'o/ /byings hu sbyin pa dang rkyen shā dang gzhan yang byings atsa gcig pa dang / yi ge brtsegs pa ma yin pa rnams kyi mtha'i u yig ni rnam dbye byengs thams cad pa atsa dang po can rnams pha rol la ya ṇar 'gyur te/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i mang tshig la/ kṛ t+parnyi/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ sh-i ḍo ṣi/ 1 rku thaḥ/ shri rku tha/ skyes bu phyi ma'i gcig tshig la/ shri rto mi/ lo pasbyo snga n+ya ta ra sde khroḥ/ ba ma dag la 'di'i 117—572

dbyi ba'ang yang na'o/ /rkyen gyi u yig ni pa 'gro ba'i ming can ma yin pa'i rnam dbye ba yig dang ma yig dang po can rnams la yang na dbye ste/ skyes bu phyi ma'i gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ sh-i rku baḥ/ sh-i ṇaḥ/ sh-i rku maḥ/ sh-i rjaḥ/leng gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ 1 rku yāta/ 1 rku yāshā/ shri rku yā suḥ/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ sh-i lce yāḥ/ sh-i rku yāste/ 1 ṇa yāsta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ 1 rku lnga/ 1 rku yā ba/ shri rku yā ma/ loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ shri kho tu/ 1 rku tāta/ sh-i rku tsā/ sh-i ṇan+tu/ skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig la/ u tabyu pra t+ya yā da saṃ yo ga sgor+pāta/ rkyen uta las kyang brtsegs pa dang po ma yin pa las so/ /yi ge brtsegs pa dang po ma yin pa'i rkyen u yig mtha' las kyang sepa bsgyur ba'i nyi ni dbyi ste/ 1 rku/snyel sipa/ si nyi/hi phyis tu nyi dag gi 7 tang yang na 'os/ hi 7 tang du bsgyur/—sh-i rku tāta/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ 1 ṇa haṃ/ 1 rku ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sh-i ṇa bā ṇi/ 1 ṇa bā ba/ shri ṇa bā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a shri rtota/ a 1 rku hūṃ/ a sh-i ṇan/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a shri rtoḥ/ a 1 rku tai/a shri rku ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a shri ṇa baṃ/ a 1 ṇa/ a 1 rku ba/a sh-i rja/ a 1 rku ma/ shu la/ lung sbyar/ setsa pa rasmi pa da rnams la 'phel ba 'os/ 'phel ba byas pas skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a 1 ྾ta/a 1ṣ+ṭi/ a 1 6ཿ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a shri ྾/ a1 ṣ+ṭi/a 1ṣ+ṭa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a 1ṣe/ a sro ṣ+ṭa/ a shriṣ+ṭha/ liṭa'i ①skyes bu dang po gsum la/ shu shā ba/ shu shu ba tuḥ/sko.atsa la/ shā byings shu sogs kyis ub byas so/ /shu shu buḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma ⑤gsum la/ shu sgo tha/ shu khru ba thuḥ/117—573

so—/ /liṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ su ṣā ba/ su 6 ba tuḥ/ su 6 buḥ—/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ su ṣe tha/ su ṣa bi tha/ su 6 ba thuḥ/su 6 ba/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ su ṣā ba/ su ṣa ba/ su 6 bi ba/su 6 bi ma/ luṭa la/ iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ sa bi tā/ sa bi tā ro/sa bi tā raḥsogs sam/ yang na/ so tā/ so tā ro/ so tā raḥsogs so/ /smon pa'i leng la/ kṛta ma yin pa sogs kyis ring po byas pas/ sru yāta/sru yā:/ sru yā suḥ sogs so/ /dzaṭa la/ iṭa yang na bar byas pas sa bi 6 nyi/ sa bi ྾ taḥ/ sa bi byurnyi sogs sam/ yang na/ so byu ti/ so 6 taḥ/ so t+yarnyi/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du kṛng la/ a sa bi 6ta/ a sa bi gyi hūṃ/ a sa bi 6na sogs sam/ yang na/ a so byuta/ a so 6 tsā/ a so byun ①sogs so/ /༈ sru 'gro ba la'o zhes pa la/ laṭa sogs pa ①rasmi pa da rnams sbyar bas—/ laṭa la/ sra ba ti sogs so/ /ling la/ sra be+eta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ sra ba tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a sra bta sogs so/ ṇi shri dru sru bh+yaḥkarta ri tsang / ṇi shri dru sru rnams la byed pa la tsang 'o/ /rkyen ṇi'i mtha' can gyi byings rnams dang / shrinya bsten pa dru dang sru 'gro ba rnams las byed pa po la ṅgi ni tsang du 'gyur te/ nga jita kyi don dang / tsu ni/ tsang la'o zhes byengs gnyis brjod pa'i don no/ /sru la/ lung / ṅgi tsang du bsgyur④/atsa la sgo sogs kyis u wa/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a su sru bta/ a su sru ba hūṃ/ a su sru ban/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a su sru baḥ/a su sru ba tai/ a su sru bta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a su sru baṃ/ a 117—575

su sru bā ba/ a su sru bā ma/ liṭa la/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ su sru ba/su sru ba tuḥ/ su sru buḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ su sro tha/ su sru ba thuḥ—/ su sru ba/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ su sru ba/snyeṇal/—su sra ba/ su sru ba—/ su sru ma/ skabs 'dir sa phyi ma ṣar mi 'gyur te/ byings 'di dang po nas sa yig yin pas so/ /luṭa la/ sro tā/ sro tā ro/ sro tā raḥsogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ kṛta ma yin pa sogs kyis ring po byas pas—/ sru yāta/ sru yā.ā+oṃ/ sru yā suḥsogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ sro 6 ti/sro 6 taḥ/ sro 6rnyi sogs so/ /kṛng la/ a sro 6ta/ a sro 6 hūṃ/ a sro 6na sogs so/ /༈ du 'gro ba la'o zhes pa la laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar bas/laṭa la/ da ba ti sogs so/ /ling la/ da beta sogs so/ /loṭa la/da ba tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a da bta sogs so/ /lung la/ byings ru du su sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ a dā bīta/ a dā biṣ+ṭi/ a dā bi 6ཿsogs sam/ yang na①/ a do ྾ta/ a dospya/ a do 6ཿsogs so/ /liṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ du dā ba/ du du ba tuḥ/ du du buḥ/'grel par iṭa dang bcas pa'i liṭa'i 'gyur ba rnams la lar ka 'gro ba'i ming can du bya zhing / la lar pa 'gro ba'i ming can du yang bya'o zhes bshad pas/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ du da bi tha/ du du bi tha/ du du ba thuḥ/ du du ba/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ du dā ba/ du da ba/ du du bi ba/ du da bi ba/ du du bi ma/ du da bi ma/ luṭa la/ byengs ru du su sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ iṭa'i phyogs la/ da bi tā/ da be+e tā ro/117—576

da bi tā raḥsogs dang / iṭa med pa'i phyogs la/ do tā/ do tā ro/ do tā raḥsogs so/ /sgon pa'i ling la/ kṛta min pa sogs kyis ring po byas pas/dru yāta/ dru yā.ā+oṃ/ dru yā suḥsogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ byings ru du su sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ da bi byu ti/ da be+e byu taḥ/ da bi 6rnyi sogs sam/ yang na/ do 6 ti/ do t+ya taḥ/ do 6rnyi sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng la'ang a da bi 6ta/ a da bi 6 hūṃ/ a da bi t+yan sogs sam—/ yang na/ a do 6ta/ a do 6 hūṃ/ a do 6na sogs so/ /༈ dru 'gro ba la'o zhes pa la laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar bas/laṭa la/ dra ba ti sogs so/ /leng la/ dra beta sogs so/ /loṭa la/dra ba tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a dra bta sogs so/ /lung la/ ṇi shri dru zhes pas ṅgi tsang du bsgyur/ tsang la 'os/ byings gnyis brjod pas/ a du dru bta/ a du dru ba tsā/ a du dru ban sogs so/ /liṭa'i skyes bu dang po rnams la/ du dru ba/ du dru ba tuḥ/ du dru buḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la—/ du dro tha/ du dru ba thuḥ/ du dru ba/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ du dā ba—/ du dra ba/ du dru ba/ du dru ma/ kṛ sre sogs kyi iṭa mi 'jug go/ /luṭa la/ dro tā/ dro tā ro/ dro tā raḥsogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/kṛta ma yin pa sogs kyis ring po byas pas/ dru yāta/ dru yārte/ dru yā suḥsogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ dro 6 ti/ dro 6 taḥ/ dro 6rnyi sogs so/ /mṛng la/a dro 6ta/ a dro 6 hūṃ/ a dro 6na sogs so/ /sgo gasmṛ 'gro ba la'o zhes pa la laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar/ i 6 gam yam rnams kyi tsha 'os/ mtshar bsgyur bas①/ laṭa la/ gats+tsha ti 117—577

'os—/ iṭa dang ā+oṭa yang na bar byas pas/ ta ri 6 ti/ ta ri 6 taḥ/ta ri 6rnyi sogs sam/ yang na/ ta rī 6 ti/ ta rī 6 taḥ/ ta rī 6rnyi sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng la/ a ta ri 6ta/ a ta ri 6 hūṃ/a ta ri 6na sogs sam/ yang na/ a ta rī 6ta/ a ta rī 6 hūṃ/ a ta rī 6na sogs so/ /dar+sha sañja swadze+e sha pi/ dar+sha sañja swaspru rnams kyi shapa la'o/ /byengs dar+sha mche ba ṣañja chags pa/ ṣ+ṭañja yongs su 'khyud ①pa rnams kyi na yig ni rkyen shapa pha rol la dbyi ste/ /༈ (miṣañja la/ laṭa shapa byings kyi dang po'i ṣa sa dang / mdo 'dis nya phyis pas/ sa dza ti snesogs so/ /de bzhin du/ ling la/ sa dze ta sogs so/ /loṭa rjol/ sa dza tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a sa dzata sogs so//lung gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ bad bradza sogs kyis 'phel ba/tsu'i ku 'os/ dza ga /khar la tsar 'os/ ga ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣa byas pas/ a tsā spyi ta/ gnyis tshig la/ tsu'i ku 'os/dza ga dzhal las dzhal la 'os/ sitsa phyis/ khar la tsar byas pas/ a sā.ā+oṃ/mang tshig la/ tsu'i ku dang / khar la tsar/ kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis a rmā k+ṣuḥ/ cho ga de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs ④pas/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a saṃ khyiḥ/ a sī lte/ a rjosīk+ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/a sī k+ṣe/ a shā k+ṣu/ a sīgh+ra/ liṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ sa saṃ dza/sa saṃ dza tuḥ/ sa saṃ dzuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ sa saṃ dzi tha sa saṃsba / sa saṃ dza thuḥ/ sa saṃ dza/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sa saṃ dza/ sa saṃ dzi ba/ sa saṃ dzi ma/ luṭa la/ tsu'i ku dang / khar la tsar byas pas/117—582

luṭa la/ braspru bh+rasnga sogs kyis sha ṣa dang / ṣa ṭu la ṣa ṭu 'os ta ṭa byas pas/rda ṣ+ṭa/ rda ṣ+ṭha ro/ rda ṣ+ṭha raḥsogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ita 'gro ba ma yin pa sogs kyis na phyis pas/ da shāta/ da shātsū/ da shā suḥsogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ brabyā bh+rasnga sogs kyis sha ṣa/ sa la ṣa shwe dag gi ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣa byas pas/ rda gh+ra ti/ rda k+ṣu taḥ/ rda k+ṣudhi sogs so / /de bzhin du/ mṛng la'ang / a rda k+ṣuta/ a rda k+ṣu tī/ a rda gh+ran sogs so/ /gubhiṅgibyeḥsan/ gupa ti dza kita rnams las sana'o/ /byings gu pū sbed pa dang smad pa dag la 'o dang / ti dza rno ba la ste bzod pa la yang ngo dang / kita nges par gnas pa la ste nad sel bar byed pa la yang ngo zhes pa'i byings gsum la san pha rol tu 'gyur te/ san gyi na yig ni san yang dag la'o zhes byings gnyis brjod pa'i don no/ /sa n+ya doḥsan yang dag la'o/ /san dang yang dag pha rol la byings a sgyu 1sa med pa'i gnyis brjod par bya'o/ /pūrbat+pa naḥ/ san gyi snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /byings la san byin pa'i san gye mtha' yang snga ma dang 'dra ba ste byings nyid du gnas pas byings byings su bsgrub pa'i rkyen zhes bya'o/ /'grel par lung drangs pa/ gu pā deḥkra mām+bin+d+ra k+ṣa ma rugyu ye 6 sarja 6 te/ gupa sogs las rim pa bzhin smad pa bzod pa nad sel ba rnams la san 'dod do/ /gong du bshad pa'i gupa sogs la san 'jug pa de yang rim pa bzhin te/ byings gu pū smad pa la 'jug pa dang / ti dza bzod pa la 'jug 4pa dang / kita nad sel ba la 'jug pa rnams la san 'gyur bar 'dod la/ sbed pa sogs don gzhan la ni 'jug pa ma yin te/ kita la/san / san yang dag la 'os/ byings gnyis brjod/ hal dang po lhag po 117—585

bye the/ e dhi 6 bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ e dhi bye/ e dhi : ba te/e dhi r+sā ma he/ e dha la/ mṛng / atsa dang po'i āṭa 'os/ byings la āṭa/āṭa las kyang ngos 'phel ba/ su sbyor ba sogs byas pas skyes bu dang po gsum la—/ e dhi 6 ta/ e dhi bye hūṃ/ e dhi 6n+ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/e dhi 6 thāḥ/ e dhi bye shaṃ/ e rnyi 6 dze+e/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ e dhi bye/i dhi byā ba hi/ e bye 6 ma hi sogs te/ cho ga phal cher khyu thob pa'i skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /༈ ik+ṣa lta ba la'o zhes pa'i byings la/ laṭa sogs ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da rnams sbyor ba'i cho ga thams cad bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra'o/ /༈ da da sbyin pa la'o zhes pa la laṭa sogs ad+ma ṣ+pe pa da rnams sbyar bas cho ga yang liṭa'i skabs ma gtogs e dha'i skabs dang 'dra ste/ laṭa la/ da da te/ da da te/ da darnye sogs so/ /ling la/ da de ta/ da de yā hūṃ/da de ran sogs so/ /loṭa la/ da da hūṃ/ da de hūṃ/ da dadz+nyā sogs so/ /lang la/ a da da ta/ a da de hūṃ/ a da dan+ta sogs so/ /lung la/ a da diṣ+ṭa/ a da di ṣā ṭ+wā/ a da de ṣa ta sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ byings gnyis brjod pa dang wal dang po la iṭa sbyor ba sogs byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ da da de/ da da dā te/ da da di re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ da da di ṣe/ da da dā the/ da da di bye/ da da di bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ da da de/ da da di ba te/ da da di ma hi sogs te/'dir sha sha /da da/ ba dang po sogs kyi mdos/ a sgyu sa dbyeb dang er bsgyur ba sogs mi byed do/ /luṭa la byings byed pa'i bal dang po la iṭa 'os 117——592

ba sogs byas pas/ laṭa la/ swa dza te/ swa dze te/ swa dzaste sogs so/ /ling la/ swa dze ta/ swa dze yā ྅/ swa je ran sogs so/ /loṭa la/ swa dza hūṃ—/ swa dze hūṃ①/ swa dzahūm̐ sogs dang / lang la/ a swa dza ta/ a swa dze hūṃ / a swa dzan+ta sogs so/ /lung la iṭa mi 'jug /ṅgi sitsa ru bsgyur/dzhal las dzhal la dbye ba dang / tsu'i ku sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ lung gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a sīk+ta/ a swek+ṣu tsā/ a swek+ṣa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a sris+thāḥ/ a swek+ṣu hūṃ/ a sum̐ rgyu④/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a swe k+ṣi/ a swo k+ṣu nyi/ a srigla nyi/ liṭa la/ 'grel par lung drangs pa/ swe dzeḥsaṃ yo gā dpi li ṭo bā ki two/ swañja las brtsegs pa las kyang le ṭa'i kita yang na'o/ /swañja dang brtsegs pa las kyang pha rol gyi liṭa bsgyur ba 'phel ba'i rgyu mtshan can ma yin pa rnams ni yang na ka 'gro ba'i ming can du ming 'dogs byed de/ dgos pa ni ita 'gro ba ma yin pa sogs kyi ki ta la na dbyi ba dang yon tan sogs yang na bar bya ba'i don te/ kita kyi phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ sa swa dze/ sa swa dzā te/ sa swa dze re/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ sa swa dzi ṣe/ sa swa dzā the/ sa swa dzi bye/ sa swa dzi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sa swa dze/ sa swa dzi ba he/ sa swa dzi ma te/kita kyi brda chad ma byas pa'i phyogs las kyang na mi dbyi ba ma gtogs gzhan 'dra ste—/ sa swañji/ sa swadzi te/ swa swañji re sogs so/ /luṭa la/ tsu'i ku 'os—/ dz+ra ga/ khar la tsar 'os/ ga kar bsgyur bas/ sriṣā/ srighā ro/sweṭ+wā raḥ/ swek+ta se sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ tsu'i ku dang / khar la tsar 'os/ ga ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyi sī yu ṭa'i sa ṣa/ ka ṣa 117—596

yon tan sogs byas pas/ kā ma ya te sogs so/ /ling la/ kā ma ye te sogs so/ /loṭa la/ kā ma ya kyetī sogs so/ /lang la/ a gā ma ya ta sogs so/ /ka mu la ṇi sbyar bas kā mi la lung / lung / ṅgi/ ṇi/ shri sogs kyis ṅgi tsang du bsgyur la ta/ kā mi tsang ta/ rto tsa rlu pa dh+wa yā hra soḥ27/ṇi la tsang la u pa dh+wa'i thung ngu'o/ /ṇi mtha' can gyi u pa dh+wa ṅgi bsgyur ba'i tsang pha rol la thung ngur 'gyur te/ kā thung ngur song / tsang la'o zhes pas byings gnyis brjod/ ku ha dag gi krutsu 'os/ tsa ka /tsa ka mi/ tsang ta zhes pa byung / sa nal+la ghu na byung ba re na twaglo pe/ aka phyis pa ma yin pa la yang ba la tsang pha rol la san bzhin no/ /byings kyi mtha' aka so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge phyis pa ma yin pa ṇi mtha' can yi ge yang ba yin pa de'i a sgyu sa'i bya ba rnams tsang pha rol la san bzhin du bya'o/ /san+ya taḥsan la āta kyi'o/ /san pha rol la byings gnyis brjod pa'i dang po a sgyu sa'i ming can gyi ata ni ita du 'gyur te/skabs 'dir mdo snga phyi gnyis kyis tsi ka mi/ tsang ta dīsgo la ghoḥyang ba'i ring po'o / /yi ge yang ba'i sngon ma'i a sgyu sa'i ṇi dang tsang pha rol la ring por 'gyur te/ tsi ring por song / ṭī ④ka mi/ tsang ta/ ṇa ra ni ṭi/ iṭa ma yin pa la ṇi'i 'orgya/ /rnam dbye byings phyed pa iṭa dang po can ma yin pa pha rol la ṇi dbyi bar bya ste/ ṇa'i rjes 'byel phyis/ tsang gi rjes 'byel nga dang tsu'ang phyis/ lung lang sogs kyi byings la aṭa sbyar bas/ a ṭī ka ma ta/de bzhin du bsgrubs pas gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ a ṭī ka me tsā/ a ṭī ka man+ta/ lung gi skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a tsā ka ma thāḥ/ a ṭī ka rnge shaṃ/ a ṭī ka ma bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a ṭī ka me/ a tsā ka mā 117—601

kṛng la/ a da yi ⑥ ta/ sogs so/ /༈ swā yī ①'phel ba la'o zhes pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ laṭa la/ s+thā ya te sogs so/ /ling la/ swā ye ta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ swā yā hūṃ sogs so—/ /lang la/ a swā ya ta sogs so/ /lung sogs wa la dang po ②rnams la iṭa yang na bar bya ste/ 'grel par lung drangs pa/ tsā ya swā ya pyu yā ①mi ḍā/tsā rjoya swā ya byā ya rnams kyi iṭa yang na'o/ /tsā mṛ mchod pa/ swā yī dang o byā yī ⑤'phel ba rnams kyi liṭa ma gtogs pa'i wal dang po rjol iṭa yang na bar bya ste—/ lung la/ iṭa sbyar ba'i phyogs la/ a swā ⑦yiṣ+ṭa/ a swā yi ṣā hūṃ/a swā yi ṣa ta sogs so/ /iṭa ma byin pa'i phyogs la/ ⑧wa phra dag gi wal la dbye 'os ya phyis pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ aswāsta/ aswā sā hūṃ/aswā sa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ aswās+thāḥ/ aswā sā shaṃ/ aswā snye—/ snyedha la'ang ngos si tsa'ang phyis pa'o/ /skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a swā si/ aswā swa hi/aswā sma hi/ leṭa la/ byings gnyis brjod/ thung ngu'o zhes pas thung ngur song / shar dang po la kha ya ⑨'os/ sa phyis/ a sgyu sa'i tsar 'ang ngos/pha par bsgyur ba sogs byas pa/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ pa swā ye/ pa swā yā ⑪ te/ pa swā yi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ pa swā yī ṣe/ pa s+thā yā the/ pa swā yi dhī/ pa swā yi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ pa swā ye/pa swā yi ba he/ pa swā yi ma ho/ luṭa la iṭa sbyar ba'i phyogs la/ swā yi tā/swā yi tā ro/ /swā yi tā raḥsogs dang / iṭa med pa'i phyogs la/ wa ya dag gi bal la ⑪dbyi 'os ya ⑫phyis pas/ swā tā/ swā tā ro/ swā tā raḥsogs so—/ /smon pa'i ling la iṭa sbyar ba'i phyogs la/ swā yi ྾ṣ+ṭa sogs dang / 117—604

iṭa med pa'i phyogs la ya phyis pas/ swā sīṣ+ṭa sogs so/ /kṛṭa la iṭa sbyar ba'i phyogs la/ swā yi 6 te sogs dang / iṭa med pa'i phyogs la wa ya dag gi zhes pas ya phyis pas/ swā su te sogs so/ /de bzhin du mṛng la iṭa sbyar ba'i phyogs la/ a swā yi 6 ta sogs dang / iṭa ma byen pa'i phyogs la/phra phyis pas/ a swā su te sogs so/ /༈ o pyu yī ①'phel ba la'o zhes pa la/ laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ laṭa la/byā ya te sogs so/ /ling la/ byā ye ta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ pyu ya tsā sogs so/ /lang la/ a byā ya ta sogs so/ /dī pa dza na bu dha pū ri tā yi byā yi bh+yophon+ya ta ra sde/ dri pa dza na bu dha pū ri/ tā yi pyu yi rnams las yang na'o/ /dī r+pā 'bar ba/ dza rtswa rab tu skye ba/ bu dha khong du chud pa/ pū rī tshim pa/tā mṛ rgyud/ o pyu yī 'phel ba rnams las lung gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig ta pha rol la ṅgi ni yang na tsi ṇa zhes par 'gyur zhing yang na se tsar 'gyur te/tsi rto luka /tsi ṇa las 'jig go/ ṅgi tsi ṇar bsgyur ba'i tsi ṇa las la bsgyur ba'i ta yig kyang dbyi bar bya ste/ byā ya la/ lung / lung la ṅgi dī pa sogs kyis ṅgi tsi ṇa ru bsgyur/ ṇa 'phel don/ tsa/ tsi ṇa las 'jig go'i don/la ta mdo 'dis ta phyis/ a byā yi/ ṅgi se tsar bsgyur ba'i phyogs la/ tsā ④ya sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar bya ste/ iṭa sbyar ba'i phyogs la/ a byā yiṣ+ṭa/a pyu ①yi ṣā hūṃ/ a byā i ṣa ta sogs dang / iṭa ma byin pa'i phyogs la/wa yu dag gi wal la dbyi 'os ya phyis pas/ a byāsta/ a pyu sā hūṃ/ a byā sa ta sogs so/ /lirgya dobyu/ leṭa yang dag la'ang ngo / /li ṭa dang yang dag pha rol la pyu ya ni spru zhes par bsgyur bar bya ste/ pyu ya la liṭa/ mdo 'dis 117—605

r+pā 3ru bsgyur/ gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ pi bye/ pi pyu te/pi pyi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ pi byi ṣe/ pi byā the/ pi pyi bye/pi pyi dhī/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ pi bye/ pi pyi ba te/ pi pyi ma te/luṭa la/ iṭa yang na bar byas pas iṭa byin pa'i phyogs la/ byā yi tā sogs dang / iṭa med pa'i phyogs la/ lnga yu dag gi wal la dbyi 'os yu phyis pas/pyu ta sogs so/ /de bzhin du smon pa'i ling la/ iṭa sbyar ba'i phyogs la/byā yi ྾ṣ+ṭa sogs dang / iṭa med pa'i phyogs la/ byā sīṣ+ṭa sogs so/ /mṛṭa la iṭa sbyar ba'i phyogs la/ pyu yi byu te sogs dang / iṭa ma byin pa'i phyogs la/ lnga phra sogs kyis ya phyis pas pyu gya te sogs so/ /de bzhin du/mṛng la/ a pyu yi 6 ta sogs sam/ a byā mya ta sogs so/ /lnga/ tā yī rgyud dang skyong ba dag la'o zhes pa la/ laṭa sogs sbyar bas/laṭa la/ tā ya te sogs so/ /ling la/ tā ye ta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ tā ya hūṃ sogs so/ /lang la/ a tā ya ta sogs so/ /lung gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ dīpa sogs kyi ṅgi yang na tsi ṇa ra bsgyur ba'i phyogs la/a tā yi/ yang na se tsar bsgyur bas/ a tā yiṣ+ṭa/ a tā yi ṣā tī/ a tā yi ṣa ta sogs so/ /liṭa la/ ta tā ye/ ta tā yā te/ ta tā yi re/ ta tā yi ṣe sogs so/ /luṭa la/ tā yi tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la tā yi bhāṣ+ṭa sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ tā yi 6 te sogs so/ /kṛng la/ a tā yi 6 ta / a tā yi bye hūṃ/ a tā yi 6n+ta sogs so/ /lnga/ sha la g.yo ba la ste kun du sgrib nyapa la yang ngo zhes pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ laṭa la/ sha la te sogs so/ /ling la/ sha le ta sogs so/ /117—606

loṭa la/ sha la tsā sogs so/ /lang la/ a sha la ta sogs so/ /lung la/wal dang po'i iṭa sbyar bas/ a sha liṣ+ṭa sogs so/ /liṭa la/ a sgyu sa dbye ba dang er bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/ she le/ she khā te/ she li re sogs so/ /luṭa la/ sha li tā ①sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ iṭa sbyar bas/ sha li ྾ṣ+ṭa sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ sha li 6 te sogs so/ /kṛng la/ a sha li 6 ta sogs so/ /༈ ṣe thra 'khrud pa la'o zhes pa la/ laṭa sogs sbyar/ byengs kyi dang po'i ṣa sar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ laṭa la/ se ba te sogs so—/ /ling la/ se be ta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ se ba hūṃ sogs so/ /lang la—/ a se ba ta sogs so/ /lung la byings phyed pa'i wal dang po'i iṭa 'os/iṭa byin pas a se biṣ+ṭa sogs so/ /liṭa la/ byings gnyis brjod/ thung ngu 'os/ e ir bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/ se ṣe be+e/ si ṣe bā te/ se ṣe pi re sogs so/ /luṭa la/ se bi tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la se bi ྾ṣ+ṭa sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ se bi t+ya te sogs so/ /kṛng la/ a se bi 6 ta sogs so/ /༈ kā sh-i 'bar ba la'o zhes pa la/ laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ laṭa la/kā sha te ②sogs so/ /ling la/ kā she ta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ kā sha hūṃ sogs so/ /lang la/ a kā sha ta sogs so/ /lung la iṭa sbyar bas①/ a kā shiṣ+ṭa sogs so/ /'grel par lung dudrangs pa/ kā sha kā so rās+thā/ kā sha kā sa dag gi ām yang na'o/ /kā sh-i 'bar ba dang / kā sre sgra ngan pa dag gi liṭa pha rol la ām yang na sbyar bar bya ste/ ām sbyar ba'i phyogs la/ kā shaṃ 117—607

ge ran/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ge ①thāḥ ge ④yā tsā/ ge ①snye/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ge ya/ ge ba hi/ ge ma nyi/ loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ lo taṭa 'gro ba sogs kyis e/ eta kyi ām 'os e ām/—sta/hūṃ/rko'agro bar mdzod/ la ā shā saka 'dra ba la ring po/snyegā tsā/snyedag 'gro bar mdzod/ rnams 'gro bar mdzod/snyegāhūṃ/—la dzha āt+pa ṣ+pe pa da sogs kyis dzha atra ṭa 'gro ba sogs kyis e eta kyi ām/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ gā swa/gā shaṃ/ gā dz+nyā/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ gi/ gā wa hai/ gā ma hai/lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a gā ta/ a gā tsā/ a gā ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a gā thāḥ/ a bā tsā/ a gā bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la—/ a ge/ a gā ba nyi/ a gā ma hi/ lung la/ a gāsta/ a gā sā tsā—/ a gā sa ta sogs so/ /liṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dza ge/snye.ata kyi iṭa la'ang dbyi 'os a phyis pa'o/ /—dza gā te/ dza gi re/—ata kyi iṭa la'ang dbyi 'os a phyis pa'o/ /skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dza gi ṣe/ dza gā the/ dza gi bye/ dza gi bye/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dza gi/ dza gi ba he/ dza gi ma he/ luṭa la/ gā tā/gā tā ro/ gā tā raḥ/ gā tā sa sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ gā sboṣ+ṭa/gā sī yātram̐/ gā sī ran sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ gā su te sogs so/ /kṛng la/a gā su ta sogs so/ /༈ rud 'gro ba la ste bshad pa la'ang ngo zhes pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/laṭa la/ ra ba te sogs so/ /ling la/ ra be ta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ra ba hūṃ sogs so/ /lang la/ a ra ba ta sogs so/ /lung la/ ru dru sogs kyi iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ a ra biṣ+ṭa/ a ra bi ṣā tī/ a ra bi ṣa ta sogs sam/ /a roṣ+ṭa/ a ro ṣā tai/ a ro ṣa ta sogs so/ /leṭa'i 117—609

skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ru ru pe/ ru ru bā te/ ru ru bi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ru ru bi ṣe/ ru ru bā the/ ru ru bi khye bye/ ru ru be+e bye/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ru ru be/ ru ru bi ba te/ ru ru bi ma he/ luṭa la/iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ ra bi tā sogs sam/ ro tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la'ang iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ ra bi ྾ṣ+ṭa sogs sam/ ro ྾ṣ+ṭa sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ ra bi 6 te sogs sam/ ro 6 te sogs so/ /de bzhin du / kṛng la/ a ra bi 6 ta sogs sam/ a ro 6 ta sogs so/ /༈ deng skyong snyeb la'o zhes pa la laṭa sogs byen pas/ laṭa la/ da ya te sogs so/ /ling la/ da ye ta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ da ya tī sogs so / /lang la/ ad ya ta sogs so/ /s+thā gho rits+tsha/ s+thā gh+ra'i ita 'ang ngo / /lung āt+pa ṣ+pe pa da rnams pha rol la s+thā dang byings ghu'i ming can rnams kyi mtha' ita du 'gyur zhing ita du 'gyur ba de las pha rol gye ṅgi 'gyur ba si tsa'ang ka 'gro ba'i ming can zhes tha snyad byed de/ yon tan sogs mi byed pa'i don no/ /deng la/ lung / si tsa/ sha 'gro ba ma yin pa nye ba'i yul la e tsa'i āta 'os / e ā mdo 'dis ā khrata du bsgyur/ tu yig ta pha rol de'i dus kyi 'os ta phyis pas/ a di/ sra t+pa/ zhes pa la/ hra swā rda gā tazhu /gzugs thung ngu las so/ /gzugs te byings mtha' ④atsa thung ngu las ṅgi bsgyur ba'i sitsa ni dzhal so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge dang po can pha rol la dbyi ste/sitsa phyis pas/ a dita/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ a di ṣā tsā/ a di ṣa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a di thāḥ/ a di ṣā tsā thu/ a di bye/a di j-i/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a di ṣi/ a di ṣ+ṭa hi/ a diṣ+ṭha hi/117—610

da ya tirdi gi li ṭi/ liṭa la da ya ti'i di gi'o/ /liṭa pha rol la da ya ti ste/deng skyong ba la 'os/ byings deng ni di gi zhes par 'gyur zhing gnyis brjod pa sogs kyang mi byed de/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ di gye/ di gyu rmyete/ di gyi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ di gyi ṣe/ disgyu the/ di gyi bye/ di gyi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ di gye/ di gyi ba te/ di gyi ma te/ luṭa la—/ sha 'gro ba ma yin pa sogs e tsa āta /zudu bsgyur bas/ dā tā/ dā tā ro—/ dā tā raḥsogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ dā sīṣ+ṭa sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/dā gya te sogs so/ /mṛng la/ a dā su ta sogs so/ /myu/ ḍing nam mkha' la 'gro ba la'o zhes pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ laṭa la / ḍa ya te sogs so/ /ling la/ ḍa ye ta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ ḍa ya hūṃ sogs so/ /lang la/ a ḍa ya ta sogs so/ /lung la/ iṭa dang byengs la yon tan byas pas/ a ḍa yiṣ+ṭa sogs so/ /liṭa la byings gnyis brjod / thung ngu 'os thung ngur song / a sgyu sa'i tsar 'ang ngos ḍa ṭar bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/ ṭi be+e/ ṭi ṭ+wā te/ ṭi be+e re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la—/ ṭi be+e ṣe/ ṭi t+yā the/ ṭidhī bye/ ṭi be+e bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ṭi bye/ ṭi be+e ba te/ ṭi be+e ma he/ luṭa la iṭa sbyar yon tan byas pas/ḍa yi tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ḍa yi ྾ṣ+ṭa sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ḍa li 6 te sogs so/ /mṛng la/ a ḍa yi 6 ta sogs so/ /myu/ gupa sbed pa dang smod pa la 'o zhes pa la/ gubhi dza kita rnams las san 'os san sbyar/ san yang dag la 'os/ byings gnyis brjod/ ku ha dag gi tsu 'os ga dzar bsgyur nas/ dzu gube+e zhes grub pa la/ laṭa sogs sbyar 117—611

brjod don no/ /pa ta la lung / lung la ṅgi pu ṣa sogs byuta sogs dza 'gro ba sogs kyis ṅgi ang du bsgyur/ mdo 'dis pum ā ga ma byin pas/ a pa p+tata/a pap+ta tsā/ a pap+tan sogs so/ /liṭa la/ kita rnams la a sgyu sa phyis nas er bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas pa pā ta/ pe ta tuḥ/ pe tuḥ/ pe ti tha/ sogs so/ /luṭa la/ wal dang po'i iṭa sbyar bas/ pa ti tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ pa t+yāta/ pa t+yās+t+ri/ pa t+yā suḥsogs dang /kṛṭa la/ wal dang po'i iṭa sbyar bas/ pa ti byu ti/ pa ti 6 taḥ/ pa ti 6rnyi sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng la/ a pa ti 6ta/ a pa ti 6 tsā/a pa ti 6na sogs so/ /༈ ṭu pa mu skyug pa la'o zhes pa la'ang pa rasmi pa da can yin pas laṭa sogs pa rame+e pa da rnams sbyar bas/ laṭa la/ ba ma ti sogs so/ /ling la/ba me ta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ ba ma tu sogs so/ /lang la a ba mata sogs so/ /lung la/ wal dang po'i iṭa sbyar bas/ a pa rmā tā①/ a pa miṣ+ṭi—/ a pa mi 6ཿsogs so/ /'grel par lung drangs pas/ ba ma e tā sgyu sa lo po bā/ ba ma'i a sgyu sa dbye ba dang e nyid yang na'o/ /gong du sha sha da da ba dang po zhes a sgyu sa mi dbyi bar bshad kyang de'i dmigs bsal laṭa kita pha rol la ba ma'i a sgyu sa dbye ba dang ar bsgyur ba sogs yang na bar bya ste/ba bā ma/—ṇal/bematuḥ/snye.atus/snyeb ba ma tuḥ/ be+e muḥ/—us/—ba ba muḥ/ be mi tha—/ snyethal/—ba ba mi tha/ luṭa la wal dang po'i iṭa byin pas/ ba mi tā sogs dang / smon pa'i ling la/ ba myuta/ ba myuspyo/ ba myu suḥsogs so/ /kṛṭa la wal dang po'i iṭa byin pas/ ba mi 6 ti sogs so/ /de bzhin du 117—622

du bi las kyang swa ni zas la'o zhes pas/ su ni'i sngon du bi dang a ba zas kyi don brjod pa na ṣa ru 'gyur te/ bi khya ṇa ti mā saṃ/rkosha zabar byed/ zas ma yin na sa ṣa ru mi 'gyur bas/ bi swa na ti bī ṇa piwangagi sgra sogs te/ de bzhin du a wa yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /༈ kha nu kun nas rko ba la'o zhes pa rasmi pa da can yin pas laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar bas/ laṭa la/ kha na ti sogs so/ /ling la/ kha ṣ+pe ta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ kha na tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a kha nata sogs soske/ /lung la/ 'phel ba yang na bar byas pas/ a khā bhāta/ a khā ni:/a khā ni 6ཿsogs sam/ a khā rtswata sogs so/ /liṭa la/ kita rnams la/gam han dzan khan sogs kyi mdos u pa jo'i a dbyi ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/tsa khā na/ tsa t+na tuḥ①/ tsa rdzuḥsogs so/ /luṭa la/ wal dang po'i iṭa byin pas/ kha ni tā sogs so/ /ye bi bhā ṣā/ ya la 'dam ka'o/ /byings kha na rko ba/ dza ①na skye ba/ ṣa na kun nas gus pa rnams kyi ṭi rkyen ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can ya yig dang po can pha rol la yang ata du 'gyur te/ smon pa'i ling la/ kha t+yāta sogs sam/ kha yāta sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ kha ni 6 ti sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ mṛng la/ a kha ni byuta sogs so/ /༈ tsā yī mchod pa dang zhi ba dag la'o zhes pa'ang pa rasmi pa da can yin pas laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar bas/ laṭa la/ tsā ya ti sogs so/ /ling la/ tsā yeta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ tsā ya tu sogs so/ /lang la/a tsā yata sogs so/ /lung la/ tsā ya swā ya byā ya sogs kyi lung 'dren gyis iṭa yang na bar byas/ iṭa ma byin pa'i phyogs la/ lnga phra dag gi wal la 117—629

dbye'o zhes lnga dbye ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ a tsā yī ta/ a tsā yi—/ a tsā ①yi 6ཿsogs sam/ a tsā sīta/ a tsā ā+oṃ/ a tsā suḥsogs so/ /liṭa la/ tsa tsā ya/ tsa tsā ya tuḥ/ tsa tsā yuḥsogs so/ /luṭa la/ iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ tsā yi tā sogs sam/ tsā tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ tsā yāta sogs so/ /mṛṭa la iṭa ster ba dang phra dbye ba yang na bar byas pas/ tsā yi 6 ti sogs sam/ tsā gya ti sogs so/ /de bzhin du/kṛng la/ a tsā yi 6ta sogs sam/ a tsā suta sogs so/ /༈ la ṣa mdzes pa la'o zhes pa yang pa rasmi pa da can yin pas laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams 'jug ste/ byengs thams cad pa bzhi po rnams la/ r+sā sha zla ④sha bhā mu sogs kyi mdos ④shapa dang byun yang na bar byas pas/ laṭa la/la ṣa ti sogs sam/ la 6 ti sogs so/ de bzhin du/ ling la/ la ṣeta sogs sam/ la byeta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ la ṣa tu sogs sam/ la 6 tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a la ṣata sogs sam/ a la 6ta sogs so/ /lung laske/ wal dang po'i iṭa byin 'phel ba yang na bar byas pas/ a khā ྾ta/a lā ṣiṣ+ṭi/ a lā ṣi 6ཿsogs sam/ a la ྾ ta sogs so/ /liṭa la/ la khā ṣa/ le ṣa tuḥ/ le 6ཿsogs so/ /luṭa la wal dang po'i iṭa byin pas/la ṣi tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ la byāta sogs so/ /mṛṭa la iṭa sbyar bas/ la ṣi 6 ti sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ thrang la/ a la ṣi 6ta sogs so/ /spru du pa d+ma yā go haḥ/ go ha'i u pa d+ma'i be+eta'o/ /rkyen atsa dang po can pha rol la go ha ste/ go hu dukun nas sgrib pa'i u pa jo'i u yig ni uta ste spru ring por 'gyur te/ /117—630

6 ti sogs dang / ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da la/ ha ri 6 te sogs so/ /de bzhin du/kṛng gi pa rasmi pa da la/ a ha ri 6ta sogs dang / ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da la/ a ha ri 6 ta sogs so/ /༈ z-inya 'gengs pa la'o zhes pa'ang gnyis ka'i tshig can yin pas laṭa'i pa rasmi pa da la/ bha ra ti sogs dang / ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da rnams la/ bha ra te sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ ling gi a tang la/ bha reta sogs dang / tang la—/ bha reta sogs so/ /loṭa'i a tang la/ bha ra tu sogs dang ①/tang la/ bha ra hūṃ sogs so/ /lang gi a tang la/ a bha rata sogs dang /tang la/ a bha rata sogs so/ /lung gi a tang la/ setsa la 'phel ba zhes sogs kyi mdos 'phel ba byas pas/ a bhāṭītu/ a bhaspyo/ a bhākhyoḥsogs dang / lung gi tang la/ ṛ las kyang ngos/ kita yin pas yon tan mi byed/gzugs thung ngu las so zhes pa'i mdos rnam dbye dzhal dang po rnams la setsa dbye ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ a j-i ta/ a j-i ṣā hūṃ/ a j-i ṣa ta sogs so/ /liṭa la/ kṛ thra j-i sogs kyi wal dang po rnams la iṭa mi 'jug ste/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ba bhā ra/ ba blu tuḥ/ ba juḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ba bharba/ ba bh+ra thuḥ/ ba bh+ra/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ba bhā ra/ ba bha ②ra/ ba z-i ba/ ba j-i ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la—/ ba bye/ ba blu te/ ba ji re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ba z-i ṣe/ba bhā the/ ba z-i rje/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ba bhe/ ba z-i ba te/ ba j-i ma he/ luṭa la 'grel par iṭa yang na bar bshad pas/ a tang la/ bha ri tā/ bha ri tā se sogs sam/ bharta/ bharta si sogs so/ /de bzhin du/117—635

pa dang 'dra'o/ /༈ bha dza bsten ①pa la'o zhes pa gnyis ka'i tshig can yin ①pas laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams dang ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da rnams gnyis ka 'jug ste/ laṭa'i a tang la/ bha dza ti sogs dang / tang la/ bha dza te sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ ling gi a tang la/ bha je ta sogs dang / tang la/ bha dze ta sogs so/ /loṭa'i a tang la/ bha dza tu sogs dang / tang la/ bha dza tsā sogs so/ /lang gi a tang la/ a bha dza ta sogs dang / tang la/ a bha dza ta sogs so/ /lung la tsu'i ku 'os/ dza ga khar la tsar 'os/ ga ka /dzhal las dzhal la 'os rnam dbye dzhal dang po rnams la sitsa 'jig /dzhal ma yin pa rnams la kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pasarka/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a bhāspyita/—bad bh+ra sogs kyis 'phel ba/a bhā.ā+oṃ/ a bhā gruḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a bhā spyiḥ/ a bhālte/a bhāk+ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a bhāk+ṣe/ a bhāk+ṣa/ a bhāgh+ra/ de bzhin du/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a bhāk+ta/ a bhāk+ṣu tsā/ a bhāk+ṣata—/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a bhās+thāḥ/ a bhāk+ṣu shaṃ/ a bhāshrī/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a bhāk+shi/ a bhāk+ṣu hi/ a bhāgh+ra hi/ liṭa la/byings gnyis brjod kita rnams la/ ṭī pha la bha dza trapa las kyang ngos / a sgyu sa dbyi ba dang er bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ba bhā dza/ ste dza tuḥ/ bhe dzuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bhe dzi tha/ bha bhas+tha/ bhe dza thuḥ/ bhe dza/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la—/ ba bhā dza/ ba bha dza/ ste dzi ba/ bhe dzi ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po 117—637
