gsum la/ bhe dze/ bhe dzā te/ bhe dzi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bhe dzi ṣe/ bhe dzā ze/ bhe dzi dhī/ ste dzi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ste dze/bhe dzi ba te/ bhe dzi ma te/ luṭa la/ tsu'i ku 'os/ dza ga /khar la tsar 'osarka/ ga kar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ a tang la/ bhakyā/bhalnga se sogs dang / tang la/ bhaṣā/ bhaṣā se sogs so/ /smon pa'i leng gi a tang la/ bha dz+nyāta/ bha dz+nyātram̐/ bha dz+nyā suḥ①sogs dang / tang la/tsu'i ku 'os/ dza ga /khar la tsar 'os/ ga ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur bas/ bhak+ṣiṣ+ṭa/ bhakhye yā.ā+oṃ/ bhakhye ran sogs so/ /kṛṭa la'ang bshad ma thag pa'i cho ga dang mthun par bsgrubs pas/ a tang la/bhak+ṣu ti sogs dang / tang la/ bhakhyu te sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ mṛng gi a tang la/ a bhakhyuta sogs dang / tang la/ a bhargya ta sogs so/ /༈ shrinya bsten pa la'o zhes pa'ang gnyis ka'i tshig can yin pas laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da dang āt+pa ṣ+pe pa da gnyis ka 'jug ste/ laṭa'i a tang la/shra ya ti sogs dang / tang la/ shra ya te sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ leng gi a tang la/ shra yeta sogs dang / tang la/ shra ye ta sogs so/ /loṭa'i a tang la/ shra ya tu sogs dang / tang la/ shra ya tsā sogs so/ lang gi a tang la/ a shra yata sogs dang / tang la/ a shra yata sogs so/ /lung la/ ṇi shri dru sogs kyis ṅgi tsang du bsgyur/ tsang la 'os/ byings gnyis brjod/ dang po'i hal lhag po 'os/ ra phyis/ a tsa la byings shā sogs kyi i ya sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ a tang la/ a shi shri ya ta/ a shi shri ya hūṃ/ a shi shri yan sogs dang / tang la/ a shi shri yata/ a shi shri 117—638

ya tsā/ a shi shri yan+ta sogs so/ /liṭa la 'phel ba'i rgyu mtshan can ma yin pa rnams la/ swañja las brtsegs pa la liṭa'i kita yang na'o zhes pas lung 'dren gye kita kyi brda chad yang na bar byas pas/ kita kyi phyogs la i ya dang kita ma yin pa'i phyogs la yon tan byed de/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/shi shā ya/ shi shra ya tuḥ/ shi shri ya tuḥ/ shi shra yuḥ/ shi shri yuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ shi shra yi tha/ shi shra ya thuḥ/ shi shri ya thuḥ/ shi shra ya/shi shri ya/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ shi shā ya/ shi shra ya/ shi shra yi ba/shi shri yi ba/ shi shra yi ma/ shi shri yi ma/ de bzhin du/ tang la yang /tso///skub/ — ta/ /de the skub/ tso//de pa/ ste// ashā/ /de 6) sa/ cad canab/sa sa / /tha/ṭa ba wal dang po'i iṭa byin/ byings thams cad pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/a tang la/ shra yi tā/ shra yi tā si sogs dang / tang la/ shra yi tā/ shra yi tā se sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/ kṛta ma yin pa sogs kyis ring po byas pas/ shrī yāta/ shrī yā.ā+oṃ/ shrī yā suḥsogs dang / tang la iṭa byin hūṃ pas/ shra yi ྾ṣ+ṭa/ shra yi ྾ yā༈/ shra yi ྾ ran sogs so/ /kṛṭa la'ang iṭa byin nas yon tan byas pas/ a tang la/ shra yi 6 ti sogs dang / tang la/ shra yi 6 te sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ mṛng gi a tang la/a shra yi 6ta sogs dang / tang la/ a shra yi 6 ta sogs so/ /myu/ rañja tshos la'o zhes pa'ang gnyis ka'i tshig can yin pas laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams dang ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da gnyis ka 'jug go/ /rañji:/ rañja'i'ang ngo / /rañja'i na yang byed pa po'i don gyi shapa pha rol la dbyi ste/ na phyis pas/laṭa'i a tang la/ ra dza nyi sogs dang / tang la/ ra dza te sogs so/ /117—639

de bzhin du/ ling gi a tang la/ ra dze ta sogs dang / tang la/ ra dze ta sogs so/ /liṭa'i a tang la/ ra dza tu sogs dang / tang la/ ra dza tī sogs so/ /lang gi a tang la/ a ra dza ta sogs dang / tang la/ a ra dza ta sogs so/ /lung la/ tsu'i ku 'os/ dza ga /khar la tsar 'os/gaka / kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣa dang rnam dbye dzhal dang po rnams la/dzhal las dzhal la 'os/ sitsa dbyi ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ a tang la/bad bh+radza sogs kyis 'phel ba'ang bya ste/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a dzāk+ṣita / a dzā s+t+ri/ a dzā k+ṣuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a dzā khyeḥ/a dzā ste/ a dzā k+ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a dzā hūṃ/ a dzā lnga/ a dzāgla / de bzhin du tang la/ a re 1k+ta/ a re k+ṣu tsā/ a dzā k+ṣa ta sogs so / /liṭa'i 'phel ba'i rgyu mtshan can ma yin pa rnams la/ swañja sogs kyis na dbye ba yang na bar byed de/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ra rañja / ra rañja tuḥ/ ra ra dza tuḥ/ ri 2rañjuḥ/ ra ra dzuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ra rañji tha/ ra ram̐ gh+ra/ ra rañja 4thuḥ/ ra ra dza thuḥ/ra rañja/ ra ra dza/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ra rañja/ ra rañji ba/ ra ra dzi ba/ ra rañji ma/ ra ra dzi ma/ de bzhin du/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ra rañji/ ra ra dze/ ra rañju te/ ra ra dzā te/ ra rañji re/ra ra dzi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ra dārañji ṣe/ ra ra dzi ṣe/ ra rañju je/ ra ra dzā je/ ra rañji bye/ ra rañji byeshi/ ra ra dzi bye/hūṃ ra ra dzi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ra rañji/ ra ra dze/ ra rañji ba he8 /ra ra dzi ba he/ ra rañji ma he/ ra ra dzi ma he/ luṭa la/ tsu'i ku dang khar 7 17—640

la tsar byas pas/ a tang la/ ram̐ lnga/ ram̐ ghā se sogs dang / tang la/ram̐ k+ta/ ram̐ ghā se sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/ ita ma yin pa sogs kyi na phyis pas/ ra rjeta/ ra rjoste/ ra dz+nyā suḥsogs dang / tang la/tsu'i ku 'o dang / khar la tsar/ kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis/ ram̐ spyiṣ+ṭa/ram̐ spyi yāspyo/ respyi ran sogs so/ /mṛṭa la'ang tsu'i ku sogs kyis bsgrubs pas / a tang la/ ram̐ gh+ra ti sogs dang / tang la/ ram̐ k+ṣu te sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ mṛng gi a tang la/ a ram̐ k+ṣuta sogs dang / tang la/ a ram̐ k+ṣu ta sogs so/ /myu/ tī ṣa 'bar la'o zhes pa'ang gnyis ka'i tshig can yin pas laṭa sogs kyi pa rasmi pa da dang / ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da gnyis ka 'jug ste/ laṭa'i a tang la/two ṣa ti sogs dang / tang la/ two ṣa te sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ ling la / two ṣe ta sogs dang / tang la/ two ṣe ta sogs so/ /loṭa'i a tang la / te ṣa tu sogs dang / tang la/ two ṣa dzā sogs so/ /lang gi a tang la / a two ṣata sogs dang / tang la/ a two ṣa ta sogs so/ /lung la/shal u pa dh+wa iṭa med pa la kla 'os/ ṅgi kla ru bsgyur/ ka phyis/ sa la ṣa bhā dag gi ka 'os/ ṣa ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyi sa ṣar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ a tang la/ a tī k+ṣata/ a tī k+ṣahūṃ/ a tī k+ṣan sogs dang / tang la/ a tī k+ṣa ta/ a tī k+ṣu tī/—kla'i atsa la 'os 7 phyis/ a tī k+ṣa ta sogs so/ /liṭa 'phel ba'i rgyu mtshan can ma yin pa rnams la/swañja sogs kyi lung 1'dren gyis kita du yang na bar byas/ a tang la/ ti te ṣa—/ ti te ṣa tuḥ/ ti tī ṣa tuḥ/ ti te guḥ/ ti tī 6ཿ/ skyes bu 117—641

dbus ma gsum la/ ti two ṣi tha/ thal/——ti tī ṣi tha/ ti te ṣ+ṭha/—thal/ ti two ṣa thuḥ / ti tī ṣa thuḥ/ ti te ṣa/ ti tī ṣa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ti two ṣa/ ti two ṣi ba/ ti tī ṣi ba/ ti tī ṣi ma/ ti tī ṣi ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ti te ṣe/ ti tī ṣe/ ti two ṣā te/ ti tī ṣā te/ti te ṣi re/ ti te ṣi 1re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ti te ṣi ṣe/ ti tī ṣi ṣe/ ti te ṣā je/ ti tī ṣā the/ ti two ṭī bye/ ti tī ྾ bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ti two ṣe/ ti tī ṣe/ ti two ṣi ba te/ ti tī ṣi ba he/ti tī ṣi ma he/ ti tī ṣi ma he/ luṭa la/ puka mtha' sogs kyi yon tan dang / ṣa ṭu la ṣa ṭu 'os ta ṭar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ a tang la/ twoṣ+ṭa/ twoṭ+wā se sogs dang / tang la/ tīṭ+wā/ twoṭ+wā se sogs so//smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/ tī ṅgāta/ tī byā.ā+oṃ/ tīspyosuḥsogs dang / tang la / sa la ṣa bye dag gi ka 'os/ ṣa ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/ tī k+ṣiṣ+ṭa/ tī spyi yā.ā+oṃ/ tīṭī ran sogs so/ /mṛṭa la'ang ṣa kar 2bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/ a tang la/ te gh+ra ti sogs dang / tang la/ te k+ṣu te sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng gi a tang la/a te k+ṣuta sogs dang / tang la/ a two spyata sogs so/ /myu/ ya dza lha mchod pa dang / 'grogs par byed pa dang sbyin pa rnams la'o zhes pa'ang gnyis ka'i tshig can yin pas/ a tang dang / tang gnyis ka 'jug ste/ laṭa'i a tang la/ ya dza ti sogs dang / tang la/ ya dza te sogs so/ /ling gi a tang la/ ya dze ta sogs dang / tang la/ ya dze ta sogs so/ /loṭa'i a tang la/ ya dza tu sogs dang / tang la/ ya dza 117—642 /

ma gsum la/ i yā dza/ i ya dza/ sī dzi ba/ yī dzi ma/ de bzhin du/tang ①gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ yī dze/ yī dzā te/ khra dzi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ yī dzi ṣe/ yī dzā the/ ā+o dzi dhī/ yī dzi bhā/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ā+o dze/ khra dzi ba he/ ā+o dzi ma ho/ luṭa la/ bra: blusnga sogs kyis dza ṣa/ ṣa ṭu la ṣa ṭu sogs kyi a tang la/ yaṣ+ṭa/ yaṭ+wā si sogs dang / tang la/ yaṣ+ṭa/ yaṭ+wā se sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/ ba tsi swa pi ya dza la sogs pa rnams kyi kita la 'os saṃ pra sā ra ṇar bsgyur bas/ i dz+nyāta/ i dz+nyā:/ i dz+nyā suḥsogs dang / tang la/ brastsa bh+rasnga sogs kyis dza ṣa/ sa la ṣa bye dag gi ka 'os/ ṣa ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis yak+ṣiṣ+ṭa/ yaspyi yā.ā+oṃ/ yaspyi ran sogs so/ /kṛṭa la'ang dza ṣar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ a tang la/ yakhyu ti sogs dang /tang la/ yak+ṣu te sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng gi a tang la/ a yak+ṣa ta sogs dang / tang la/ a gh+ra ④ta sogs so/ /༈ ṭu ba pa sa bon 'debs pa la'o zhes pa la yang a tang dang tang gnyis ka 'jug ste/ laṭa'i a tang la/ ba pa ti sogs dang / tang la/ ba pa te sogs so/ /leng gi a tang la/ ba pe ta sogs dang / tang la/ ba pe ta sogs so/ /loṭa'i a tang la/ ba pa tu sogs dang / tang la/ ba pa hūṃ sogs so/ /lang gi a tang la/ a ba pa ta sogs dang / tang la/ a ba pa ta sogs so/ /lung la dzhal dang po can rnams la/ dzhal las dzhal la 'os setsa dbyi ba sogs byas pas/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a badhīta/a badz+nyā/ a bap+luḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a badhīḥ/ a pabye/117—644

he ta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ ba ha tu sogs dang / tang la/ ba ha hūṃ sogs so/ /lang gi a tang la/ a ba hata sogs dang / tang la/ a ba ha ta sogs so/ /lung la/ dzhal dang po can ma yin pa rnams la ha'i bhā 'os/ha zwa/ sa la ṣa bhā dag gi ka 'os/ zwa ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur ba sogs dang / dzhal dang po rnams la hra hre/ dzhal las dzhal la 'os setsa phyis/ d+ma ma yin pa sogs kyis ta dang tha dag dha/ ṣa ṭu la ṣa ṭu 'os dha bye/ zwa'i bhā la dbyi 'os bhā gong ma phyis/ sa ha'i ba ha dag gi a yig gi ota 'os/ a ota du bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a wāspyita/—bad 1dza sogs kyis 'phel ba/ a bo ā+oṃ/ a wāgruḥ/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a wāk+ṣiḥ/ a bo r+ghaṃ/ a bo bhā/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a wāk+ṣ-i/ a wāk+ṣu/ a wāgru/ de bzhin du/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a bo bhā/ a wak+ṣu hūṃ/ a bak+ṣa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a bo ṭ+wāḥ/ a bak+ṣu shaṃ/ a bo hūṃ/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a bak+ṣi—/ a bak+ṣu hi/ a bagh+ra hi/ liṭa la kita min pa rnams la/ leṭa la gnyis rnams kyi sogs kyi mdos a sgyu sa/ saṃ pra sā ra ṇa dang / kita rnams la watsa swa pi yadza sogs kyis gnyis ka saṃ pra sā ra ①ṇar bsgyur ba sogs byas pas a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ u bā ha/ u ha tuḥ/ spru huḥ/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ u ba hi tha/ u bo bye/—thal/ u ha thuḥ/ uha/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ u bā ha/ u ba ha/ spru hi ba/ spru hi ma/ de bzhin du/ tang la/ spru ②te/ spru hā te/ spru hi re sogs so/ /luṭa la/ha'i bhā/ dh+wa ma yin pa sogs kyis ta dha/ ṣa ṭu la ṣa ṭu 'os/ dha bhā/117—646

a bā siṣ+ṭa/ a bā siṣ+ṭha/ tang la sa 'dren pa ma gtogs bya ba lhag po med de/skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a bāsta/ a bā sā hūṃ/ a bā sa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a bās+thāḥ/ a bā sā r+ghaṃ/ a bā dz+nyā/snyedha la'ang ngos sitsa phyis pa'o/ /skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a wā si/ a bā swa nyi/ a bāsma hi/ liṭa la/benya nyid du gnas pa dang / ba yi ru bsgyur ba'i phyogs gnyis 'byung ste benya nyid du gnas pa'i phyogs la/ benyaḥ/ benya'i'o/ /gong du leṭa la gnyis rnams kyi zhes sogs kyis benya ba tsa'i sogs khongs yin kyang de'i dmigs bsal/liṭa pha rol la benya'i saṃ pra sā ra ṇa mi byed de/ benya la liṭa sbyar bas/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ba bo/—āta las ṇal gyi au 'os/ ṇal sko ba ba tuḥ/snye.iṭa las kyang āta kyi dbyi 'os/ ā phyis/—ba buḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ba bi tha/ba bā tha/ ba ba thuḥ/ ba ba/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ba bo/ ba bi pa/ba bi ma/ tang la'ang iṭa las kyang āta kyi dbyi 'os ā phyis pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ba be+e/ ba bā te/ ba bī re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ba bi ṣe/ ba bā the/ ba bi bye/ ba bi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ba be/ba bi ba he/ ba bi ma he/ yang phyogs gcig la/ be nyo ba yiḥ/ benya'i wa yi'o—/ /be nya ni liṭa pha rol la ba yi zhes par yang na 'gyur te/ liṭa'i a tang gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ be nya/ wa yi ru bsgyur i brjod pa'i don yin pas phyis/ a sgyu sa med pa sogs kyis byengs gnyis brjod/liṭa la gnyis rnams kyi sogs kyi mdos a sgyu sa saṃ pra sā ra ṇar byas pas u bā ya/ gnyis tshig la byings gnyis brjod/ btsi swa pi yadza sogs kyi mdos/ba gnyis ka saṃ pra sā ra ṇar bsgyur/ aka 'dra ba la ring po 'os ring por 117—648

a sgyu sa saṃ pra sā ra ṇa byas/ atsa'i nyaṇa 'gro ba la 'os 'phel ba byas pas/bi byā ya/—ṇal/ 'grel par lung drangs pa/ byenyaḥki nyi li ṭi saṃ pra sā ra rde bā/byenya'i liṭa kita la saṃ pra sā ra ṇa yang na'o/ /byenya'i a sgyu sar ma zad leṭa kita pha rol la gnyis ka saṃ pra sā ra ṇar yang na bsgyur te/ a sgyu sa nyid saṃ pra sā ra ṇa byas pa'i phyogs kyi rnam dbyes atsa dang po can rnams la/ etsa'i a ya a wa sogs dang / gnyis ka saṃ pra sā ra ṇa'i phyogs la ika gi atsa la yaṇa byas pas/skyes bu dang po'i gnyis tshig dang mang tshig gnyis la/ bi bya ya tuḥ/ bi bya tuḥ/bi bya yuḥ/ bi byuḥ/ de bzhin du/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bi bya yi tha—/ snye.ati arte bya ya ti rnams kyi iṭa 'os/ thal la iṭa yang na bar mi byed/ bi bya ya thuḥ/ bi bya thuḥ/bi bya ya/ bi bya/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bi byā ya/ bi bya ya/ bi bya yi ba/ bi byi ba/ bi bya yi ma/ bi byi ma/ de bzhin du/ tang la yang /bi bya ye/—ta/snyebi bye/ bi bya yā te/snye.āshā/— bi byā te/ bi bya yi re/snyedzha/—bi byire sogs so/ /luṭa la/ shita ma yin pa sogs kyis etsa āta du bsgyur bas/a tang la/ byā tā/ byā tā se sogs dang / tang la/ byā tā/ byā tā se sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/ shita ma yin pa sogs kyis etsa āta/ba tsi swa pi sogs kyis saṃ pra sā ra ṇa dang / kṛta ma yin pa sogs kyis ring po byas pas/ bī yāta/ bī yātram̐/ bi yā suḥsogs dang / tang la/ byā sīṣ+ṭa/byā sī yāspyo/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la etsa ata du bsgyur bas/ a tang la/ byā ①su ti sogs dang / tang la/ byā su te sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng gi a tang la/ a byu gya ta sogs dang / tang la/ a byā gya ta sogs so/ /༈ tīnya 'gran pa la ste sgra la yang ngo zhes pa'ang gnyis ka'i tshig can te/117—651

liṭa byin/ kita ma yin pa rnams la liṭa la gnyis rnams kyi sogs kyi a sgyu sa saṃ pra sā ra ṇar bsgyur ba dang / kiṭa rnams la ba tsi swa pi sogs kyis gnyis ka saṃ pra sā ra ṇa dang mdo 'dis sa ṣar bsgyur bas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/u bā sa/ ā ṣa tuḥ/ spru 6ཿ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ u ba si tha/u basba/ spru ṣa thuḥ/ u ṣa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ u bā sa/ u ba sa/spru ṣi ba/ spru ṣi ma/ luṭa la bstu/ bstu ro①/ bstu raḥ/ bstu si sogs dang / smon pa'i ling la/ btsi swa pi sogs kyi saṃ pra sā ra ṇa dang / shrī sa/ba se gha si sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur bas/ u sgyuta/ u t+yāspyo/ u sgyu suḥsogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ byings phyed pa la sa'i 'os sa tar bsgyur bas/ baṣ+ṭha te sogs dang / de bzhin du kṛng la/ a barmyata sogs so/ /༈ ba da gsal bar brjod pa la'o zhes pa la'ang pa rasmi pa da rnams 'jug ste/ laṭa la/ ba da ti sogs dang / ling la/ ba da ta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ ba da tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a ba data sogs so/ /lung la/bal dang po'i iṭa dang / bad bh+radza sogs kyis 'phel ba byas pas a bā dītaske/ a bā di྾/ a bā di 6ཿsogs so/ /liṭa la/ kita ma yin pa rnams la/ liṭa la gnyis kyi sogs kyis a sgyu sa saṃ pra sā ra ṇa dang / kita rnams la ba tsi swa pi sogs kyis gnyis ka saṃ pra sā ra ṇar bsgyur bas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ u bā da/ spru da tuḥ/ spru duḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ u ba di tha/ spru da thuḥ/ spru da/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ u bā da/ u ba da/ spru dī ba/ spru di ma/ luṭa la wal dang po'i iṭa sbyar bas—/ ba di tā/ ba di tā ro/ ba di tā raḥ/ pa di tā si sogs so/ /117—654

smon pa'i ling la/ u byāta/snyeb tsi su pi sogs kyis saṃ pra sā ra ṇar bsgyur/ u t+yāṭ+wā/ u byā suḥsogs so/ /dzaṭa la/ iṭa byin pas/ ba di 6 ti sogs dang / de bzhin du/ kṛng la/ a ba di 6ta sogs so/ / 1 ṭu o shi 'gro ba dang 'phel ba dag la'o zhes pa'ang pa rasmi pa da can yin pas/ laṭa sogs a tang rnams 'jug ste/ laṭa la/ shwa ya ti sogs so—/ /ling la/ shwa yeta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ shwa ya tu sogs so/ /lang la—/ a shwa yata sogs so/ /lung la bsgrub tshul gsum 'byung ste/ dzā stasbru/mru tsu/ rlu tsu sogs kyis ṅgi ang du bsgyur ba dang / se tsa ru bsgyur ba yang na bar bya ste/ ang gi phyogs la/ shwa ya te raḥ/ shwa ya ti'i a'o/ /ṅgi bsgyur ba'i ang pha rol la shwa ya ti'i i yig ni a yig tu 'gyur te/ i a ata kyi yon tan la 'os/ gnyis dag gis gcig pha rol gyi gzugs su song / a shwata/a shwa tsā/ a shwan sogs so/ /ṅgi se tsar bsgyur ba'i phyogs la/ wal dang po'i iṭa byen pas/ a shwa yīta/ a shwa yiṣ+ṭi/ a shwa yi guḥsogs dang /yang na dhe ṭa shi dag gi 'dam ka 'os/ ṅgi tsang du bsgyur tsang la 'os /byings gnyis brjod/ dang po'i hal lhag po dang / atsa la/ shā byings sogs kyis ub tu bsgyur bas/ a shi shi yata/ a shi shī ya lta/ a shi shi yan sogs so/ /bi bhā ṣā shweḥ/ shī'i gdam nga'o/ /liṭa pha rol shi'i saṃ pra sā ra ṇar bsgyur ba dang mi bsgyur ba 'dam ka can du bya ste/ bsgyur ba'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ shu shā ba/snyemado 'dis pa dbyangs bcas u ru bsgyur nas/ de nas byings gnyis brjod/ kita min pa rnams la rang bzhin yon tan dang 'phel ba/ kita rnams la atsa lashā sogs kyis ub/ shu shu ba ①tuḥ/ shu shu buḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ shu sha bi tha/117—655

shu shu ba thuḥ/ shu shu ba/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ shu shā ba/ shu sha ba/shu shu bi ba/ shu shu bi ma/ ma bsgyur ba'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/shi shā ya/ shi shī ya tuḥ/ shi shi yuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ shi shwa yi thaske/ shi shī ya thuḥ/ shi shi ya/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ shi shā ya/ shi shwa ya—/ shi shī yi ba/ shi shī yi ma/ kṛṭa la wal dang po'i iṭa byen pas/ shwa yi tā/ shwa yi tā sī ①sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la②/ wa tsi swa pi sogs kyis saṃ pra sā ra ṇa ①byas/ kṛta ma yin pa sogs kyis ring por bsgyur bas/ shā yāta—/ shu yā.ā+oṃ/ shā yā suḥsogs so/ /mṛṭa la wal dang po'i iṭa byin pas / shwa yi byu ti sogs dang / de bzhin du kṛng la/ a shwa yi 6ta sogs soske/ /i nyi pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa sru sru trarwa da yam māp+taḥzhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇi'i mdo las bhū la sogs pa rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las/ byed pa po la shapra 'jug pa'i yul khyu la sogs pa rnams las/ byings gzhan don gyi tshig can pa rasmi pa da 'jug pa rnams la rnam dbye pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyor tshul dang / byengs bdag don gyi tshig can ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da 'jug pa rnams la rnam dbye ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da rnams sbyor tshul/ byings gnyis ka'i tshig can rnams la rnam dbye pa rasmi pa da rnams dang ④ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da gnyis ka sbyor tshul sogs spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //117—656

kṛṭa la wal dang po'i ①iṭa byen pas/ ba shi 6 ti/ ba shi 6 taḥ/ ba shi 6rnyi sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ mṛng la/ a ba shi 6 ta/ a ba shi 6 tsā/a ba shi 6na sogs so/ /༈ ha na 'tshe ba dang 'gro ba dag la'o zhes pa la 'ang / laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams 'jug cing shapa kyang 'jig ste/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ harnye/ a nu dāsto pa de sha ba na ti ta no t+yā dī nā ma nu nā si ka lo pa dzha le sdi ti/ a nu dāt+ta nye ba'i ①yul ba no ti/ ta no ti la sogs pa rnams kyi rjes su sna ldan dzhal ka nga 'gro ba la dbyi'o/ /a nu dāt+ta nye ba'i yul te/ya mu nye bar 'gog pa/ ra mu rtse ba/ na ma rab tu 'dud pa/ gasmṛ 'gro ba/ha na 'tshe ba/ ma nu shes pa rnams dang / ba no ti ste/ ba nu 'tshe ba dang /ta no ti la sogs pa ste/ ta nu rgyas pa/ k+ṣa nu 'tshe ba/ ṛ nu 'gro ba/ 1 rku 'bar ba/ ba nu slong ba/ ma nu rtogs pa rnams kyi rjes su sna ldan gyi yi ge rnams rkyen dze+edzhal so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge dang po can ka dang nga 'gro ba'i ming can pha rol la dbyi bar bya ste/ han la skyes bu dang po'i gnyis tshig sbyar bas/ha taḥ/ mang tshig la/ gam han dzan sogs kyis u pa dh+wa phyis/ harnyi'i nyiṇ+ḍi ta dhirnams la 'os/ ha ghar bsgyur bas/ snarnyi/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ habyu/ ha thaḥ/ ha tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ham+bi/habe+eḥrka/ had+maḥ/ ba mor+pā/ ba mo dag la yang na'o/ /nyer bsgyur na ṇar bsgyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can sngon du byung na han gyi na yig ni ba yig dang ma yig dag pha rol la ṇa yig tu yang na 'gyur te/ pra ham+bi/—rab tu 'tshe bar byed/ pra ham+bi/pra hasbaḥ/ pra harbaḥsogs so/ /leng gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ha t+yāta/117—662

ha sgyu tsā/ ha rgyuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ha t+yāḥ/ ha snge tai/ ha t+yā ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ha dz+nyā/ ha t+yā ba/ ha t+yā ma/ nyer bsgyur rgyu mtshan can sngon du byung na/ harnyi'i ata sngon ma'i 'os/ na ṇar 'gyur te/ pra ha sgyuta sogs so/ /loṭa la/ kita rnams la/ a nu dāt+ta nye ba'i yul sogs kyis rjes su sna ldan dbyi ba dang / atsa dang po can rnams la/gam han sogs kyi u pa d+ma dbyi ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ han+tu/ ha tā ta①/ ha hūṃ/ snan+tu/ skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig la/ hadherdzaḥ/ harnyi'i dza'o/ /se'i hi ste ②pa 'gro ba 'ang ma yin no zhes pas loṭa la si hi ru bsgyur ba'i hi pha rol la harnyi'i dza zhes par bsgyur bar bya ste/ dza nyi/ ha tāta/ a sidha ba da tā shra yi/ 'di la gzhi mnyam pa la ma grub po/ dza hi zhes gzhi mnyam du gnas pa 'di la ata las hi'i 'o zhes pas hi dbyi ba ma grub ste/ snga ma han zhes na yig gi rgyu mtshan nyid las so/ /gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ ha )/ ha ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ phyi ma la āṭa ste bita 'ang ngos āṭa sbyin pas/ ha nā ni/ ha nā ba/ ha nā ma/lang la/ hal gcig pa rnams/ hal dīpa sogs kyis dbye ba dang / kita dzhal dang po can rnams la a nu dāt+ta sogs kyis na dbyi/ atsa dang po can rnams la gam han sogs kyis u pa dh+wa dbye ba sogs byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a han/ a ha hūṃ/ asnan/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/a han/ a ha tai/ a ha ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a ha dz+wa/ a han+d+ra/a had+ma/ lu ji tsa/ lung la'ang ngo / /lung pha rol la han ni ba dha zhes par bsgyur bar bya ste/ han la lung / mdo 'dis han ba dha ru bsgyur/ bal 117—663

bas| skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ rdzu ti/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la / byu taḥ/ byu brnyi/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ rdzu ṣi/ byu thaḥ/byu tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bye mi/ byu baḥ/ byu maḥ/ ling la bya ba lhag po med de/ byu yāta/ byu yā:/ byu yuḥsogs so/ /loṭa la/ tipa hal dang po can rnams la 'phel ba dang / atsa dang po can rnams la/ atsa la shā byengs sogs kyis u bar bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ rngu tu/ rdzu tāta/ byu tsā/ byu ban+tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la—/ byu hi/ byu tāta/ byu lta/ byu ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ r+ya bā ni—/ snye.āX byin nas yon tan byas so/ /r+yabā ba/ r+ya bā ma/—āṭa byin nas yon tan byas so/ /de bzhin du lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a rdzuta/ a byu hūṃ/ a byu ban/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a byeḥ/ a byu nya/ a byu ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a r+ya baṃ/—yonatan/ a byu ba/ a byu ma/ lung la/ sitsa la 'phel ba pa rasmi pa da rnams la 'os/ 'phel ba byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a rngu ྾ ta/ a rngu ṣ+ṭi/ a dro 6ཿ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/a rdzu ྾ཿ/ a byiṣ+ṭi/ a rdzuṣ+ṭa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a rdzu ṣe/ a bye khya—/ a rdzuju/ liṭa la/ ṇal gnyis dang thal ma yin pa rnams la/ swañja brtsegs pa dang po sogs kyi lung 'dren gyis kita yang na bar byas pas/ kita kyi phyogs la/ atsa sgo byengs kyi upa dang / kita ma yin pa'i phyogs la yon tan byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ du t+yā ba/ du byu ba tuḥ/ du r+ya ba tuḥ/ du byu buḥ/ du r+ya buḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ du byo tha/du r+ya bi tha/ du byu ba thuḥ/ du r+ya ba thuḥ/ du byu ba/ du r+ya ba/ skyes bu 117—665

phyi ma gsum la/ du byā ba/ du r+ya ba/ du byu bi ba/ du r+ya bi ba/ du byu bi ma/ du r+ya bi ma/ luṭa la byings thams cad pa dang byings phyed pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ byo tā/ byo tā ro/ byo tā raḥ/ dro tā si sogs so//sgon pa'i leng la kṛta ma yin pa sogs kyis ring po byas pas/ dh+yā yāta/ dh+yā yātram̐—/ byu yā suḥ/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la byings thams cad pa dang byings phyed pa sogs kyis yon tan dang / kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣa byas pas—/ dro 6 ti/ byo t+ya taḥ①/ byo t+yarnyi sogs dang / de bzhin du/kṛng la/ a byo ②nyu ta/ ①a byo 6 tsā/ a byo 6 na sogs so/ /༈ yu sres pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams 'jug cing cho ga thams cad bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra ste/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ yo ti/yu taḥ/ yu brnyi/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ yo ṣi/ yu thaḥ/ yu tha/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ yo mi/ yu baḥ/ yu maḥ/ ling la/ yu yāta/yu yā tsā/ yu yuḥsogs so/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ yo tu/ yu tāta—/ yu ྅/ yu ban+tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ yu hi/ yu tāta/yu haṃ/ yu ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ya bā ni/ ya bā ba/ ya bā ma/lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a yota/ a yu tsā/ a yu ban/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a yoḥ/ a yu tai/ a yu ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la / a ya baṃ/ a yu ba/ a yu ma/ lung la bal dang po'i iṭa sbyar bas/a yā bīta/ a yā bi྾/—sitsal 'phel ba/ a yā bi 6ཿsogs so/ /liṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ yu yā ba/ yu yu ba tuḥ/ yu yu buḥrjo/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ yu ya bi tha/ yu yu ba thuḥ/ yu yu ba/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum 117—666

la—/ yu yā ba/ yu ya ba/ yu yu bi ba/ yu yu bi ma/ luṭa la bal dang po'i iṭa sbyar bas/ ya bi tā/ ya bi tā ro/ ya bi tā raḥ/ ya bi tā si sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la kṛta ma yin pa sogs kyis ring po byas pas/yu yāta/ yu yā.ā+oṃ/ yu yā suḥsogs so/ /kṛṭa la iṭa byin pas/ ya bi byu ti sogs dang / de bzhin du/ ling la/ a ya bi 6ta sogs so/ /༈ ṇa bstod pa la'o zhes pa la a tang rnams sbyor/ chog yu dang 'dra ste/laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ kau ti/ nu taḥ/ nu brnyi/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ no ṣi/ nu thaḥ/ nu tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/no mi/ nu baḥ/ nu maḥ/ leng la/ nu yāta/ nu yā hūṃ/ nu yuḥsogs so—/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ no tu/ nu tāta/ nu hūṃ/ nu ban+tu| skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ nu hi/ nu tāta/ nu lta/ nu ta/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ na bā ni/ na bā ba/ na bā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a nota/ a nu hūṃ/ a nu ban/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a noḥ/ a nu te/ a nu ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a nu baṃ—/ a nu ba/ a nu ma/ lung la wal dang po'i iṭa dang / sitsa 'phel ba pa rasmi pa da rnams la 'os 'phel ba byas pas/ a nā bīta/ a nā ①biṣ+ṭi/a ṭ+wā bi 6ཿsogs sam/ yang na 'grel par nu las bal dang po la iṭa yang na mi 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas iṭa med pa'i phyogs la 'phel ba byas pas/ a no ྾ta / a noṣ+ṭi/ a no guḥsogs so/ /liṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/nu nā ba/ nu nu ba tuḥ/ nu nu buḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ nu na be+e tha—/ nu nu ba thuḥ/ nu nu ba/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ nu nā ba/ nu na 117—667

ba—/ nu nu bi ba/ nu nu bi ma/ luṭa la/ na bi tā sogs sam/ no tā sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la ring po byas pas/ nu yāta/ nu yāspyo/ nu yā suḥsogs so/ /kṛṭa la iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ na bi 6 ti sogs sam/no 6 ti sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng la/ a na bi 6ta sogs sam/ a no t+yad sogs so/ /༈ sgri rno ba la'o zhes pa 'ang yu dang 'dra ste/ a tang rnams sbyar bas/laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ spyo ti/ spru taḥ/ spru brnyi/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ spyo ṣi/ spru thaḥ/ sgri tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ spyo mi/sgo baḥ/ sgri maḥ/ ling la/ spru yāta/ sgri yā hūṃ/ sgri yuḥsogs so/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ spyo tu/ sgri tāta/ spru tī/ sgri brnyu/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ khyu hi/ spru tāta/ spru te/ sgrita/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ kyā bā ni/ kyā bā ba/ kyā bā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la—/ a spyota/ asgo hūṃ/ asgri ban/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a spyoḥ—/ a spru tai/ a:ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a kyā baṃ/ a sgri ba/a sgri ma/ lung la bal dang po'i iṭa sbyar/ 'phel ba byas pas/ a ṣ+ṭha bīta/a 1 biṣ+ṭi/ a 1 bi 6ཿsogs so/ /liṭa la gnyis brjod/ dang po'i hal lhag po 'os/ ṣa dang ṇa phyis/ ku ha dag gi tsu ṇal gnyis dang thal bor te/gzhan rnams kita yang na bar byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tsu kyā ba/tsu kyā ba tuḥ/ tsu spru ba tuḥ/ tsu kyā buḥ/ tsu sgri buḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tsu 1 bi tha/ tsu kyā ba thuḥ/ tsu sgri ba thuḥ/ tsu kyā ba/ tsu spru ba/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsu ṣ+ṭha ba/ tsu kyā ba/ tsu kyā bi ba/ tsuspru bi ba/117—668

tsu k+ṣa bi ma/ tsu spru bi ma/ luṭa la iṭa byin bas/ kyā bi tā/ kyā bi tā ro/kyā bi tā raḥ/ kyā bi tā se sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la kṛta ma yin pa sogs kyis ring po byas pas/ glu yāta/ 1 yāspyo/ glu yā suḥsogs so/ /mṛṭa la wal dang po'i iṭa sbyar bas/ kyā bi 6 ti sogs dang / de bzhin du/ kṛng la/a ṣ+ṭha bi 6ta sogs so/ /༈ ju rab tu 'dzag pa la'o zhes pa'ang pa rasmi pa da can yin pas a tang rnams 'jug cing shapa 'jig /byings kyi dang po'i ṣa'i sa 'os ṣa sa/ rgyu mtshan med na rgyu mtshan can yang med do zhes pas/ ṇa'ang na ru log /sgru zhes pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ cho ga bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra ste/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ sgo ti/ sgru taḥ/ snu brnyi/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ sgo ṣi/ snu thaḥ/ snu tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sgo mi/snu baḥ/ snu maḥ/ ling la/ snu yāta/ snu yā ṭ+wā/ sgru yuḥsogs so/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ sgo tu/ snu tāta/ snu hūṃ/ snu ban+tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ snu nyi/ snu tāta/ snu tai/ snu ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sna bā ni/ sna bā ba/ sna bā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la—/ a sgota/ a snu hūṃ/ a snu ban/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a sgoḥ—/ a snu lta/ a snu ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a sna baṃ/ a snu ba/a snu ma/ lung la wal dang po'i iṭa dang 'phel ba byas pas/ a rtswa bīta/a sna biṣ+ṭi/ a rtswaḥbi 6 sogs so/ /liṭa la ṇal gnyis dang thal bor ba'i rnam dbye gzhan rnams swaspru brtsegs pa dang po sogs kyi kita yang na bar byas pas—/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ su: ba/ susngu ba tuḥ/ suṇ+ḍa ba tuḥ/717—669

skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ā yo/ i ①ba/ e ma/ i kho gā lu di/ lung la iṇa gyi gā'o/ /lung pha rol la iṇa ni gā zhes par bsgyur bar bya ste/ iṇa laske/ lung / mdo 'dis gār bsgyur/ gā ti/ s+thā/ ghu bā/ bhū sogs kyis setsa 'jig pas/ a gāta/ a gā hūṃ/ a guḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a gāḥ/ a gā lta/ a gā ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a hūṃ—/ a gā ba/ a gā ma/ liṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ iṇa la liṭa a sgyu sa med pa sogs kyis byings gnyis brjod/ la tipa/ tipa ṇal/atsa'i 2 n+d+ra 'gro ba la 'os 'phel ba etsa'i aya a ba sogs kyis e ④ālnga/ a sgyu sa'i 'dra ba ma yin pa la 'os i gong ma i yang nga dang a 'gro ba rim pa bzhin drangs pas i yā ya/ dīr+gha i ṇaḥ①ki ti/ ka 'gro ba la iṇa gyi ring po'o| /liṭa ka 'gro ba'i ming can pha rol la in gyi a sgyu sa ring por 'gyur te/skyes bu dang po'i gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ i gnyis brjod mdo 'dis a sgyu sa ring po/ iṇa gyi ya ṇa 'os i phyi ma phra drangs pas/ yī ya tuḥ/ yī yuḥ/de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ i ya yi tha| i ye tha/ yī ya thuḥ/ ā+o ya/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ i yā ya/i ya ya/ i yi ba/ i yi ma/ luṭa la byings thams cad pa dang byengs phyed pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ e tā/ e tā ro/ e tā raḥsogs so / /smon pa'i ling la kṛta ma yin pa sogs kyis ring po byas/ spyi yāta/yī yā༈/ yī yā suḥsogs so/ /e te rmi ji / e ti'i ling la'o/ /nyer bsgyur sngon du sbyor na iṇa'i smon pa'i ling pha rol la thung ngur 'gyur te/ sī yāta ces grub pa'i sngon du a nu bzhag /mdo 'dis thung ngu / ika gi atsa 117—671

la yaṇa byas pas/ a ni yāta sogs so/ /mṛṭa la yon tan byas pas e 6 ti/ e 6 taḥ/ e 6rnyi sogs dang / kṛng 'ang de dang 'dra ba la/atsa dang po'i āṭa 'os āṭa byin/ āṭa las kyang ngos 'phel ba byas pas e 6 ta/ e 6 hūṃ/ e byu na sogs so/ /༈ ika dran pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams 'jug ste/ 'grel par lung drangs pa/ i ṇa dika i ti tsa bak+ta bya mi ti ṇaṭ+wār+ya rū paṃ tsa/ iṇa 'dra bar ika ces pa'ang brjod par bya ste/ bya ba iṇa 'dra zhing gzugs 'ang ngo / /ika ces pa 'di 'ang iṇa dang 'dra bar brjod par bya ste/ i ti sogs sgrub tshul gyi bya ba thams cad 'dra la/ iṇa skabs kyi mdo rnams kyang thams cad 'jug cing bsgrubs zin gyi gzugs thams cad kyang iṇa dang 'dra bas—/ laṭa sogs sde tshan bcu po thams cad la rigs 'gre bas/ sgrub ①tshul bsgrubs zin gyi gzugs sogs dper brjod logs su ma bkod do/ /༈ mā mchod pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams 'jug ste/ a di sogs kyis shapa 'jig pas laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ mā ti/ mā taḥ/mārnyi—/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ mā si/ mā thaḥ/ mā tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ mā mi/ mā baḥ/ mā maḥ/ ling la/ mā yāta/ mā yā tī/mā yuḥsogs so/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ mā tu/ mā tāta/ mā dzā⑤—/ mān+tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ mā hi/ mā tāta/ mā tai/mā ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ mā ni/ mā ba/ mā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a mā ta/ a mā tī/ a muḥ/snyelang la shāka ṭā ya ṇas nges pa 'os/rnyi dzus/ a mān/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a māḥ/ a mā tai/ a mā ta/117—672

skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a rmā/ a mā ba/ a mā ma/ lung la/ yam/ram| nam sogs kyis saka dang iṭa byin pas/ a mā sīta/ a mā siṣ+ṭi/a mā se 6ཿsogs so/ /liṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ma mo/ ma ma tuḥ/ma muḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ma mi tha/ ma ma thuḥ/ ma ma/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ma mo/ ma mi ba/ ma mi ma/ luṭa la/ mā tā/mā tā ro/ mā tā raḥ/ mā tā si sogs so/ /smon pa'i leng la ling la e 'os er bsgyur bas/ me yāta/ me yā.ā+oṃ/ me yā suḥsogs so/ /kṛṭa la/mā gya ti sogs dang / kṛng la/ a mā gyata sogs so/ /༈ yā thob pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams 'jug ste/ cho ga phal cher mā dang 'dra bas/ laṭa'i ①skyes bu dang po gsum la/ yā nyi/ yā taḥ/yārnyi / skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ yā ṅga/ yā thaḥ/ yā ④tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ yā mi/ yā baḥ/ yā maḥ/ ling la/ yā yāta/ yā yā:/yā yuḥsogs so/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ yā tu/ yā tāta/ yā hūṃ—/ yān+tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ yā hi/ ya tāta/ yā tai/ yā ta—/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ yā ni/ yā ba/ yā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a yāta/ a yā hūṃ/ a yuḥ/ a yānasne/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a yāḥ⑦/ a yā lta⑤/ a yā ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a lnga/ a yā ba/ a yā ma/ lung la/ yam ram/nam sogs kyis saka dang iṭa byen pas/ a yā sīta/ a yā seṣ+ṭi/ a yā se 6ཿsogs so/ /liṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ya yo/ ya ya tuḥ/ ya yuḥ / skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ya yi tha/ ya ya thuḥ/ ya ya/ skyes 117—673

bu phyi ma gsum la/ ya yo/ ya yi ba/ ya yi ma/ luṭa la/ yā tā/ yā tā ro/ yā tā raḥ/ yā tā sī sogs so/ /smon pa'i leng la/ 'dir er ①mi 'gyur bas/ yā yāta/ yā yāste/ yā yā suḥsogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ yā su ti sogs dang / kṛng la/ a yā suta sogs so/ /bā 'gro ba dang dri ba dag la'o dang /dru smad pa dru la/ smon pa'i ling la/ gzhan yang brtsegs pa sogs kyis e ru bsgyur ba dang / mi bsgyur ba yang na bar byed pa'o/ /la'o gnyis kyang cho ga thams cad yā dang 'dra'o/ /༈ khyu gtam la'o zhes pa'ang bshad ma thag pa rnams dang phal cher 'dra ste/laṭa la/ khyu ti/ khyu taḥ/ khyurnyi sogs so/ /ling la/ khyu yāta/ khyu yā :rka/ khyu yuḥsogs so/ /loṭa la/ khyu tu/ byu tāta/ khyu hūṃ/ khyun+tu sogs so/ /lang la/ a khyuta/ a khyu hūṃ/ a khyuḥ/ a khyun sogs so/ /a su nyi bat+ta khyu ti bh+yophong / a su ti bat+ta khyu ti rnams las anga'o a su 'phen pa/ ba tsa brjod pa khya gtam rnams las ṅgi ni ang du bsgyur te/ khyu la/lung / lung la ṅgi 'os ṅgi byin/ mdo 'dis ṅgi ang / iṭa las kyang āta kyi ①dbye 'os ā phyis pas/ a khyata/ a khya tsā/ a khyan sogs so/ /liṭa la gnyis brjod/ hal dang po lhag po/ ku ha dag gi tsu 'os/ kha tsha/ a sgyu sa'i tsar 'ang ngos/ tsha tsar bsgyur ba sogs byas pas skyes bu dang po gsum la—/ tsa khye/ tsa khya tuḥ/ tsa khyuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tsa khyi tha/tsa khya thuḥ/ tsa khya/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsa khyo/ tsa khye ba/ tsa khye ma/luṭa la/ khyu tā/ spyo tā ro/ khyu tā raḥ①/ khyu tā se sogs so/ /smon pa'i leng la/ gzhan yang brtsegs pa dang po sogs kyis dhi.er bsgyur ba dang mi bsgyur ba yang na bar byas pas/ khye yāta/ khye yāshā/ khye yā suḥsogs sam/117—674 /

cad pa la'o/ /kṛnya u'i mtha' can gyi ad ni byings thams cad pa ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can pha rol la uta du 'gyur te/ loṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ bi dzā ku ru tī/ bi dzā kurban+tu/ de bzhin du skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bi dzā ku ru/snyerkyen uta las kyang brtsegs pa ma yin pa sogs kyis nyi phyis/ bi dzā ku ru tāta/ bi dzā ku ru tai/ bi dzā ku ru ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/bi dzā ka ra bā ṇi/ bi dzā ka ra bā ba/ bi dzā ka ra bā ma/ ām ma sbyar ba'i phyogs la bita rnams la/ puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan byed shapa 'jig pas skyes bu dang po gsum la/ bestu/ bit+tata/ bihūṃ/ bi dan+tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bidhi/ hu dzhal la hi rnyi 'os ti rnyir bsgyur/ bit+tata/ bir+ghaṃ/ bit+ta/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ be dā ni/ be dā ba/ be dā ma/ bid la lang sbyar ba'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig la/ a bed/ a beta/a bid+dhā/ 'grel par lung drangs pa/ be sterla ngo snardzu swā/ be ti las lang gi dzhai'i dzus yang na'o/ /bita las pha rol gyi lang bsgyur ba'i sto ni dzus su yang na 'gyur te/ a bi duḥ/ a bi dan/ skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig la/da:—/ da'i 'ang ngo / /byings mtha'i da srog med pha rol nas sepa phyis pa de ni yang na ru ru 'gyur te u brjod don no/ /a beḥ/ a beta/ a bed/skyes bu dbus ma'i gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ a bisto/ a bit+ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a be rda/ a bi dwa/ a be+ed+ma/ lung la iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ a be dīta/ a be dibye/ a be di 6ཿsogs so/ /liṭa la/u ṣa bid dzā kṛ sogs kyis yang na ām sbyar bas/ bi dzā ba byu ba/ bi dzā tsa kā ra/ bi dā mā sa sogs sam/ yang na leṭa nyid sbyar/ byings gnyis 777 676

brjod pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ bi be da/bi bi da tuḥ/ bi bi duḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bi be di tha/ bi bi da thuḥ/ bi bi da/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bi be da/ bi bi di ba/ bi bi di ma/ luṭa la iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ be di tā/ be di tā ro/be di tā raḥ/ be di tā si sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ bi byāta/ bi byās+t+ri/bi byā suḥsogs so/ /kṛṭa la iṭa byen yon tan byas pas/ be di 6 ti sogs dang / de bzhin du/ kṛng la/ a be di t+yata sogs so/ /༈ as yod pa la'o zhes pa la'ang pa rasmi pa da rnams spyor te/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ aste/ shā so ra khro paḥ/ shā as dag gi ata dbyi'o/ /rkyen shā dang as kyi a yig byings thams cad pa ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can pha rol la dbye ste/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la—/ staḥsarnyi/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a si/—tās aste dag gi sa dbyi 'os sa phyis/ sbaḥ/ sba/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ asmi/ swaḥsnye.as la laṭa shapa 'jig /la bas dang mas su bsgyur/ shā as dag gi a dbyi 'os/ a phyis/ sa drangs/snyesmaḥ/ ling la shā as dag gi ata dbyi 'os a phyis sra yā la drangs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/sngata / snga tsā/ sruḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ sngaḥ/ snga haṃ/ snga ta/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sde/ sgyu ga snga ma/ de bzhin du loṭa la'ang ka nga 'gro ba rnams la a dbyi ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/astu—/ stuta/ tram̐/ san+tu/ ghā so red+dhā ba sgyu sa lo pa:/ ghu as dag gi hi la e ste a sgyu sa dbyi ba'ang ngo / /byengs bhu'i ming can rnams dang as kyi loṭa bsgyur ba'i hi pha rol la e ru bsgyur zhing sgo sogs kyis a sgyu sa 'ang dbyi ste/117—677

as la/ loṭa/ shapa 'jig /la sepa/ si hi 'os/ si hir bsgyur/mdo 'dis as e ru bsgyur/ hu dzhal la hi dhi'o zhes pas nyi dhir 'gyur te/as zhes snga ma dzhal gyi yi ge yin pas 'di la gzhi mnyam pa las ma grub po zhes pa'i mdos da lta gzhi mnyam yang snga ma'i sa yig gi rgyu mtshan te/ e dhi/ yang na tu nyi dag gi zhes pas/ hi tā tang du bsgyur bas/ stuta/ skyes bu dbus ma'i gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ sto/ sta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a sā ni—/ a sā ba/ a sā ma/ lang la/ hal gcig pa rnams la aste sitsa sogs kyis yīṭa/ ka nga 'gro ba rnams la a dbye ba sogs byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ā sīta/ ātsū/rko.as kyi a phyis kyang 'di la gzhi mnyam pa las ma grub po zhes pas sngon ma'i ā'i rgyu mtshan la /de byin pa'o/ /ā san/ de bzhin du/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ā sīḥ/ āste/ āsta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ā saṃ/ ā swa—/ āsma/ a stespyoḥ/ aste'i byu'o/ /rnam dbye byings phyed pa'i ming can rnams pha rol la aste ste/ as ni khyu zhes par bsgyur bar bya ste/ as la lung /mdo 'dis bhū ru bsgyur/ gā ti sogs kyis sitsa 'jig /'grel bar bhū a har bsgyur ba dang / as bhūr bsgyur ba dag las ha la gcig pa la yīṭa mi 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas yīṭa mi ster te/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a khyu ta/a bhū hūṃ/ a bhū ban sogs te/ bya ba dang gzugs thams cad byu yod pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /byengs phyed pa yin kyang liṭa pha rol la khyur mi 'gyur te/skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ā se①/ ā sa tuḥ/ ā suḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ā sa ②tha/ ā sa thuḥ/ ā sa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ā sa—/ ā se ba/ ā si ma/ luṭa smon ①ling kṛṭa kṛng rnams as bhū ru bsgyur 117—678

ba tsā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a bka /a bag /a bas+t+ri/a ba tsan/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a bka /a bka /a bar+ghaṃ/a bak+ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a ba rtsa/ a ba tswa/ a badz+ra/ lung la/a gya ti/ bat+ta/ spyo ti rnams las ang ngos ṅgi ang du bsgyur/ a btsu/atro ces pa la/ ba tsa um/ ba tsa'i uma'o/ /ba tsa'i ṅgi bsgyur ba'i ang pha rol la um ā ga ma ster te/ ma gnas kyi don/ a las yon tan nos/mtshams sbyar bas/ a bo tsad/ de bzhin du/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/a bo tsa tsā/ a bo tsan/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a bo tsaḥ a bo tsa tai/ a bo tsa ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a bo rtsahu/ a bo tsā sdeb/a bo tsā ma/ liṭa la ṇal gnyis dang thal la gnyis rnams kyi sogs kyis a sgyu sa saṃ pra sā ra ṇa dang ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can rnams la/ ba tsi swa pi ya dza sogs kyis gnyis ka saṃ ①pra sā ra ṇar bsgyur/ ag 'dra ba la ring po sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ u bā tsa/ spru ④tsa tuḥ/ spru tsuḥ—/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ u ba tsi tha/ u bagh+ra/ u tsa thuḥ/spru 5tsa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ u bā tsa/ u ba ( ketsa/ spru tsi /spab/ khru tsi ma/ luṭa la/ balnga/ baṭ+wā ro/ balnga raḥ/ bklu si sogs so/ /smon pa'i leng la/ ba tsi swa pi sogs kyis saṃ pra sā ra ṇa byas pas/ u tsāta/ u tsā:—/ spru tsā suḥsogs so/ /kṛṭa la tsu'i ku 'os tsa ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur bas/ bak+ṣu ti sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng la—/ a bagh+rata sogs so/ /༈ ru dir mchi ma 'dzag 8pa la'o zhes pa la'ang pa rasmi pa da rnams 117—682

'jug ste/ ru dā di bh+yasrurba dh+wa tu ke/ rud la sogs pa rnams las byings thams cad pa la'o/ /ru da la sogs pa ste/ ru dir mchi ma 'dzag pa/ ṣ+ṭa pa nyal ba/ shwa sa dang a na srog /dzak+ṣa za ba dang dgod ①pa rnams las pha rol gyi byings thams cad pa bal so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge dang po can la iṭa ā ga ma 'gyur te/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig la/ ro di ti—/ ru di taḥ/ mang tshig la/ ru darnyi/ de bzhin du/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ro di ṣi/ ru di thaḥ/ ru di tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ro di mi/ ru di baḥ/ ru di maḥ/ leng la/ ru byāta/ ru byā hūṃ/ ru byuḥsogs so/ /loṭa la/ rud la sogs pa rnams sogs kyis iṭa byin pas/ro di tu/ ru di tāta/ ru di hūṃ/ ru dan+tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ru di hi/ ru di tāta/ ru di tai④/ ru di ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ro dā ni/ ro dā ①ba/ ro dā ma/ ru dbyu pañca bh+yaḥ/ rud las kyang lnga rnams las so/ /rud la sogs pa rnams las rkyen hal gcig pa a thrak+ta'i ming can la ā+oṭa ā ga ma 'gyur te/ aṅgārgya gā la ba yoḥ/ garga'i bu dang gā la ba dag gi aṭa'o—/ /rud la sogs pa lnga bulas pha rol gyi byings thams cad pa hal gcig pa a thrak+ta'i ming can de la aṭa ster ba sngon gyi drang srong garga'i bu dang drang srong gā la ba dag gis bshad do zhes pas lang gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la yīṭa dang aṭa yang na bar byas pas/ a ro dīta/ a ro data/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ a ru di tsā/ a ru dan/ de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas—/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a ro dīḥ/ a ro daḥ/ a ru di tai/a ru dita/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a ro rda/ a ru di ba/ a ru di ma/117—683

lung la ir 'gro ba la yang ①na 'os/ ṅgi ang du bsgyur ba dang se ⑧tsar bsgyur ba yang na bar byas pas/ ang gi phyogs la/ a ru data/ a ru da hūṃ/ a ru dan sogs dang / sitsa'i phyogs la bal dang po'i iṭa dang / puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ a ro dīta/ a ro diṣ+ṭi/ a ro di 6ཿsogs so/ /liṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ru ro da/ ru ru da tuḥ/ ru ru duḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ru ro di tha/ ru ru da thuḥ/ ru ru da/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ru ro da/ ru ru di ba/ ru ru di ma/ luṭa la bal dang po'i iṭa byen pas/ ro di tā/ ro di tā ro/ ro di tā raḥ/ ro di tā si sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ru byāta sogs so/ /mṛṭa la iṭa byin pas/ro di 6 ti sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ dzang la/ a ro di gyid sogs so/ /༈ nyi ṣ+ṭa pa nyal ba la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyar bas/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ swa pi ti/ swa pi taḥ/ swa parnyi/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ swa pi ṣi/ swa pi thaḥ/ swa pi tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/swa pi mi①/ swa pi baḥ/ swa pi maḥ/ ling la/ swa pyuta/ swa pyu hūṃ/ swa pyuḥsogs so/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ swa pi tu/ swa pi tsā/ swa pan+tu—/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ swa pi hi/ swa pi ti/ swa pi ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ swa ④pā ni/ swa pā ba/ swa pā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a swa r+pāta/ a swa pata/ a swa pi hūṃ/ a swa pa na/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a swa spruḥ/ a swa paḥ/ a swa pi tai/ a swa bi ta/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la⑤/ a swa paṃ/ a swa pi ba/ a swa pi dum/ lung la dzhal dang po rnams la/ dzhal las dzhal la 'os⑦/ sitsa dbyi ba sogs byas pas/117—684

skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a swādhī ta/—bad bh+radza sogs kyis 'phel ba/ a swā dz+nyā/ a swāp+luḥ—/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a swādhīḥ/ a swābye/ a swābha/byes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a swādze+e/ aswā grwa/ a swāza/ swa pi la liṭa sbyar byings gnyis brjod nas/ ṇal gnyis dang thal la gnyis rnams kyi sogs kyis a sgyu sa saṃ bra ①sā ra ṇa dang / ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can rnams la/ ba tsi swa pi sogs kyis gnyis ka saṃ pra sā ra ṇa byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/su ṭī pa/ su 6 pa tuḥ/ su 6 puḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ su ṣ+ṭa pi tha| su ṣ+ṭaza/ su 6 pa thuḥ/ su 6 pa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ su ṣa pa—/ su ṭī pa/ su 6 pi ba/ su 6 pi ma su bi nirdur bh+yaḥswa bi sru ti sa māḥsu bi ni dur rnams las swa pi sru ti sa ma rnams kyi'o/ /nyer bsgyur su bi ni dur rnams las/ swa pi nyal ba sru nyi ste/ jung srog chags rab tu skye ba/ sa ma mnyam pa rnams kyi sa yig ni ṣa yig tu 'gyur te/ su 6 ṭī pa/snyelegs par nyal/bi 6 ṭī pa/—rnamapar nyal/ ni6ṭīpa/snyengesaparanyal/ dukhyoṭī pa/snyengan par nyal/ sogs so—/ /luṭa la/ swabhā/ swabhāro/ /sbabhā raḥ/ swabhā si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ba tsi swa pi sogs kyis saṃ pra sā ra ṇa byas pas/ su byāta/su byā.ā+oṃ/ su byā suḥ/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la swasmya ti/ sogs dang / kṛng laske/ a swasgrata/ sogs so/ /༈ shwa sa srog la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams 'jug ste/ byings thams cad pa bal dang po rnams la/ rud la sogs pa rnams sogs kyis iṭa byinarka/ la ṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ shwa se ti/ shwa se taḥ/ shwa sarnyi/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ shwa si ṣi/ shwa se thaḥ/ shwa se tha/ skyes bu phyi 117—685

ma gsum la/ shwa se mi/ shwa se baḥ/ shwa se maḥ/ ling la/ shwa sgyuta/shwa snga tsā/ shwa sruḥ/ sogs so/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ shwa si tu/shwa si tāta/ shwa si hūṃ/ shwa san+tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ shwa se hi/shwa si tāta/ shwa si tai/ shwa se ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ shwa sā ni/ shwa sā bi①/ shwa sā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a shwa sī ta/ a shwa sa ta/ a shwa se tsā/ a shwa san/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a shwa sīḥ/a shwa sata/ a shwa si tai/ a shwa si ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a shwa saṃ/a shwa si ba/ a shwa si ma/ lung la/ ha phra phra ②mtha' sogs kyis 'phel ba mi byed/ bal dang po'i iṭa byin pas/ a shwa sbota/ a shwa si.oṃ/ a shwa si 6ཿ—/ sogs so/ /liṭa sbyar ba'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ sha shā sa/ sha shwa sa tuḥ/ sha shwa suḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ sha shwa si tha/ sha shwa sa thuḥ/sha shwa sa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sha shā sa/ sha shwa sa/ sha shwa si ba/ sha shwa se ma/ luṭa la iṭa sbyar bas/ shwa se tā/ shwa si tā si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ shwa sgyuta/ shwa snga:/ shwamyu suḥ/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/shwa se 6 ti/ sogs so/ /kṛng la/ a shwa se 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ a na srog la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams 'jug la/ cho ga snga ma dang 'dra ste/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a ni ti/ a ni taḥ/ a narnyi—/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a ni ṣi/ a ni thaḥ/ a ni tha/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a ni mi/ a ni baḥ/ a ni maḥ/ ling la a t+yātaske/ a t+yā hūṃ/ a rgyuḥ/ sogs so/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/a ni tu/ a ni tāta/ a ni tsā/ a nan+tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/117—686

a ni hi/ a ni tāta/ a ni tai/ a ni ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a nā ni/ a nā pa/ a nā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ā m+bita/ā nata7/ ā ni tsā/ ā nan/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ā nīḥ/ā naḥ/ ā ni tai/ ā ni ta / skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ā rgo/ ā ni pa/ā ni ma/ lung la iṭa byin pas/ ā m+bita/ ā nīspya/ ā ni 6ཿ/sogs so/ /liṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ā na/ ā na tuḥ/ ā nuḥ/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ā ni tha/ ā na thuḥ/ ā na/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ā na/ ā ni ba/ ā ni ma/ luṭa la/ a 4ni tā/ a ni tā si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ a t+yāta/ a t+yāspyo/ a t+yā suḥ/sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ a ni 6 ti/ sogs so/ /kṛng la/ a ni 6da/sogs so/ /a ni ter+pā/ a ni ti'i yang na'o/ /nyer bsgyur na ṇar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can las pha rol gyi a ni ti'i na yig ṇa yig tu yang na 'gyur te/pā ṇi ti/ pā na ti/ sogs so/ /myu/ dzak+ṣa za ba dang dgod 5pa dag la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams 'jug ste/ ru da sogs kyis dzhal dang po rnams la iṭa byin pas/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig la/ dzasti ti/ dzasti taḥ/ a da bh+yastuta/ a bh+yasta las ata'o/ /byings la a bh+yasta'i ming can dzak+ṣa za ba/dzā kṛ gnyid sad pa/ da ri dru ngan 'gro/ tsa kā sre 'bar ba/ shā su rjes su ston pa/ dī dhīng 'bar ba/ be+e bing rngan pa sogs las pha rol gyi dzhani ata du 'gyur te/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i mang tshig la/ dzak+ṣa ti/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dzasti ṣi/ dzasti thaḥ/ dzadza tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/117—687

gartu / dzā kṛ tāta/ dzā kṛ tī/ dzā gra tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/dzā kṛ nyi/ dzā kṛ tāta/ dzā kṛ tai/ dzā kṛ ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dzā ga rā ṇi/ dzā ga rā ba/ dzā ga rā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig la/ a dzā gaḥ/ a dzā kṛ tī/ mang tshig la/ dzu sitsa/dzus la'ang ngo / /byings mtha' ika so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge ni dzhai dzus su bsgyur ba'i dzus pha rol la 1yon tan bya ste/ dzā kṛ la/ lang / la rnyi/setsa a bh+yasta sogs kyis rnyi dzus/ mdo 'dis yon tan byas pas/ a dzā ga ruḥ/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a dzā gaḥ/ a dzā kṛ tai/ a dzā kṛ ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a dzā ga ram̐/ a dzā kṛ ba/ a dzā kṛ ma/ dzā gro3bi tsiṇ+ḍa ldirlu—/ dzā kṛ gyi pi tsi ṇa ṇal nga 'gro ba rnams ma yin pa rnams la'o/ /dzā kṛ gyi rkyen bi dang tsiṇa dad ṇal dang / gzhan yang nga 'gro ba'i ming can ma yin pa rkyen byings phyed pa'i ming can rnams pha rol la yon tan bya ste/ lung la iṭa dang mdo 'dis yon tan byas pas/ a dzā ga rī ta/ a dzā ga ribye/ a dzā ga ri 6ཿ/ sogs so/ /liṭa la/ u ṣa/ bi da/ dzā kṛ rnams las yang na 'os/ ām sbyor ba dang mi sbyor ba yang na bar byas pas/ ām sbyar ba'i phyogs la/ dzā ga dzā pa bhū ba/ dzā ga dzā tsa kā ra/ dzā ga rā mā sa/ sogs dang / ām ma sbyar ba'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dza dzā gā ra/dza dzā ga ra tuḥ/ dza dzā ga ruḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dza dzā ga ri tha/dza dzā ga ra thuḥ/ dza dzā ga ra/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dza dzā gā ra/ dza dzā ga ri ba/ dza dzā ga ri ma/ luṭa la/ dzā ga ri tā/ dzā ga ri tā ro / dzā ga ri tā raḥ/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la'ang skabs 'dir/ dzā kṛ gyi bi 717—689

dzin sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ dzā gar+yāta/ dzu gar+yā ā+oṃ/ dzu gar+yā suḥ/sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ dzā ga ri byu ti/ sogs so/ /mṛng la/ a dzā ga ri byuta / sogs so/ /lnga/ da ri dru ngan 'gro la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams 'jug ste/laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ da ri dru ti/ idrwa ri dra gya/ da ri dru'i ita'o/ /byings thams cad pa ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can hal dang po pha rol la da ri dru'i āta ni ita du 'gyur te/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gnyis tshig la/da ri dri taḥ/ shā bh+yasta yo rā taḥ/ shā a bh+yasta dag āta kyi'o/ /byings thams cad pa ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can atsa dang po pha rol la rkyen zla dang byings a bh+yasta'i ming can rnams kyi āta dbyi ste/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i mang tshig la/lnga / rnyi/ a bh+yasta las ata 'os dzha ata/ mdo 'dis ā phyis pas/ da ri dra ti/ de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/da ri dru si/ da ri dī thaḥ/ da ri dī tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ da ri dā mi / da ri dri baḥ/ da ri dri maḥ/ ling la/ da ri dra'i ita 'os/ i ru bsgyur bas/ da ri dri yāta/ da ri dri yā tsā/ da ri dri yuḥ/ sogs so/ /loṭa la'ang ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can hal dang po rnams la āta 7iṭa bsgyur ba dang a tsa dang po rnams la dbyi ba sogs byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/da ri dru tu/ da ri dri tāta/ da ri dri tsā/ da ri dra tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ da ri dri nyi/ da ri dri tāta/ da ri dri tai2/ da ri dri ta/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ da ri dā ṇi/ da ri dru ba/ da ri dā ma/ de bzhin du lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a da ri drita/ a da ri dri hūṃ/ a da 117—690 /

ri druḥ/snyesitsa a bh+yasta sogs kyis rnyi dzus/ shā a bh+yasta dag gi āta kyi 'os ā phyis/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a da ri druḥ/ a da ri dri tai/ a da ri dri ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a da ri d+dhā/ a da ri dri ba/ a da ri dri ma/ 'grel par lung drangs pa/ da ri dā ti rādzha ṅgā tu ke ākhro po/ da ri dru ti'i byings phyed pa la āta nyadabyi'o/ /da ri drwa ti'i āta ni/ san dang rkul dang be+eṭa rnams ma yin pa'i rkyen byings phyed pa'i ming can pha rol la dbyi'o/ /yang 'grel par byings phyed pa yin kyang lung la yang na bar bya'o/ /zhes bshad pas/ a dbyi ba'i phyogs la wal dang po'i iṭa byin pas/ a da ri dī ta/ a da ri dribye/ a da ri dri 6ཿ/ sogs sam/ yang na mi dbyi ba'i phyogs la/ yam ram nam āta rnams kyis saka 'ang ngos saka dang iṭa byin pas/ a da ri dru se ta/ a da ri dī sabye/ a da ri dru si ṣāḥ/ sogs so/ /liṭa la byings gnyis brjod/dang po'i hal lhag po 'os/ a sgyu sa'i da bzhag gzhan thams cad phyis pas/da ri drwa ti'i byings phyed pa la āta dbye 'os āta dbyi ba sogs byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ da da ri dro/ da da ri dra tuḥ/ da da ri druḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ da da ri dri tha/ da da ri dra thuḥ/ da da ri dra/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ da da ri dro/ da da ri dri ba/ da da ri dri ma/'grel par lung drangs pa/ a ṣ+pe kā ca ā sbak+ta byaḥ/ atsa gcig ma yin pa la'ang ām rjod par byed do/ /byings atsa gcig pa ma yin pa'i liṭa pha rol la ām spyor bar bya ste zhes pas liṭa pha rol la ām sbyor ba thob kyang de'i dmigs bsal—/ yang 'grel par lung drangs pa/ da ri dru te rā mā/ da ri drwa ti'i ām yang na'o/ /da ri drwa ti'i liṭa pha rol la ām sbyor ba dang mi sbyor ba yang na 117—691

byings kyi ru yang na'o/ /lang bsgyur ba'i sepa pha rol la byengs mtha'i sa yig ni yang na rur 'gyur zhing yang na da ru 'gyur te/ a tsa kāḥ/ a tsa kāta/ a tsa kād/ a tsa kāste/ a tsa kāsta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a tsa kā saṃ/a tsa kā swa/ a tsa kāsma/ lung la iṭa byin pas/ a tsa kā sbo ta/ a tsa kā ṅga——/ a tsa kā se 6ཿ/ sogs so/ /leṭa la a tsa gcig ma yin pa sogs kyis ām yang na bar byas pas/ ām med pa'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la—/ tsa tsa kā sa/ tsa tsa kā sa tuḥ/ tsa tsa ka suḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tsa tsa kā si tha/ tsa tsa kā sa thuḥ/ tsa tsa kā sa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsa tsa kā sa/ tsa tsa kā si ba/ tsa tsa kā si ma/ ām sbyar ba'i phyogs la/ tsa kā sī ba bhū ba/ tsa kā sī tsa kā ra/ tsa kā sā mā sa/ sogs so//luṭa la/ iṭa byin pas/ tsa kā si tā/ tsa kā se tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i leng la/ tsa kā sgyu ta/ tsa kā sgyu.ā+oṃ/ tsa kā snga suḥ/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la yang iṭa byin pas/ tsa kā se 6 ti/ sogs dang / kṛng la/ a tsa kā si 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ shā su rjes su ston pa la'o zhes pa la laṭa sogs a tang rnams 'jug ste/laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ shāste/ shā sa i dang ha loḥ/ shās kyi ita ang hal dag la'o/ /shās kyi u pa d+ma'i ā niṅgi bsgyur ba'i ang rkyen ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can hal dang po can pha rol la ita du 'gyur te/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gnyis tshig la/ shiṣ+ṭaḥ/snyeshā su la/ laṭa shapa 'jig la tas mdo 'dis i shā si gha si pa si sogs kyis sa ṣa/ ṣa ṭu sogs kyis taṭa/ mang lnga/ga la/ a bh+yasta las ata 'os/ dzha ata du bsgyur bas/ shā sa ti/ de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/117—693

dbus ma gsum la/ sha shā si tha/ sha shā sa thuḥ/ sha shā sa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sha shā sa/ sha shā se ba/ sha shā se ma/ luṭa la/ shā si tā/ shā si tā si/ sogs so/ /sgon pa'i ling la/ shās kyi ita ang hal dag la 'os u pa dh+wa i/ shā se gha se ba se sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/shi t+yāta/ shi byā.ā+oṃ/ sha byā suḥ/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la bal dang po'i iṭa byin pas/shā si 6 ti/ shā se byu taḥ/ shā se gyirnyi/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng la/ a shā si 6ta/ a shā se t+ya hūṃ/ a shā si 6na/ sogs so/ /༈ tsak+shing gsal bar brjod pa la'o zhes pa la/ laṭa sogs ād+ma no pa da rnams 'jug ste/ dzhal dang po rnams la brtsegs pa'i dang po sa ka sogs kyis ka dbyi ba dang / ṣa ṭu la ṣa ṭu sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tsaṣ+ṭi/ tsak+ṣa te/ tsak+ṣa te/ skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig la/ lnga thā sa/ thās kyi se 'os/ thās se/ brtsegs pa'i dang po sa ka ①sogs kyis ka phyis/ sa la ṣa rte dag gi ka 'os/ ṣa ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣa byas pas/ tsak+ṣe/ gnyis tshig la/ tsak+ṣu the/mang tshig la/ lnga ②bye/ brtsegs pa sogs kyis ka phyis/ ṣa ṭu sogs kyis dha rte/ ṭa 'gro ba sogs kyis ṭi e/ dzhal rnams kyi dza sha 'os ṣa ḍa byas pas/tsarte/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsak+ṣe/ tsak+ṣu he/ tsagla he/ ling la/brtsegs pa sogs kyis ka phyis/ sa la ṣa bhā dag gi ka 'os/ ṣa ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/ tsaspyi ta/ tsaspyo yā hūṃ/ tsaspyi ran/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tsaspyo thāḥ/ tsaspyi yā tsā/ tsaṭī dhī/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsak+ṣi ya/ tsaspyi ba hi/ tsaspyi ma nyi/ loṭa'i skyes bu dang po 117—695

gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ khra she/yī shā te/ spyi shi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ā+o shi ṣe/ yī shā the/spyi shi bye/ yī shi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ yī she/ khra shi ba he/ yī shi ma he/ luṭa la/ bal dang po'i iṭa byen pas/ khyu shi tā/ yī shi tā se/sogs so/ /de bzhin du smon pa'i ling la/ yī shi ྾ṣ+ṭa/ yī shi ྾ yā:/ā+o shi ྾ ran/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la'ang iṭa byen pas/ ā+o shi 6 te/ yī shi bye te/ yī shi 6rnye/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du kṛng la/ e shi 6 ta/e shi bye tsā/ e shi byurnya/ sogs so/ /༈ ā sa nye bar sdod pa la'o zhes pa la'ang tang rnams sbyor te/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ā ste/ ā sā te/ ā sa te/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ āsbe/ ā sā the/ ā bye/snyedhe la/ dha la'ang ngos sa dbyi ba dang / āste/snyedzhal rnams kyi dzasha 'os sa da ru bsgyur ba yang na bar byas pa'o/ /skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ā se/ ā swa te/ āsma he/ ling la ata mtha' ma yin pa sogs kyis sī yuṭa'i sa phyis/ās kyi sra yī la drangs pas/ ā sī ta/ ā sbo yā hūṃ/ ā sī ran/ sogs so—/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ā.ā+oṃ/ ā sā hūṃ/ ā sa tsā/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ā swa①/ ā sā shaṃ/ ā dz+nyā/ spruhūṃ/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ā be+e/ ā sā ba hai/ ā sā ma te/ lang la/ atsa dang po'i āṭa mtshams sbyor ba sogs byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ āsta/ā sā hūṃ/ ā sa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ās+thāḥ/ ā sā shaṃ/ ā bye—/ ār+ghaṃ/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ā se/ ā swā hi/ āsma hi/lung la atsa dang po'i āṭa byen/ 'dra ring / bal dang po'i iṭa byin pas/117—702

ā seṣ+ṭa/ ā se ṣā hūṃ/ ā si ṣa ta/ sogs so/ /liṭa la/ da ya a ya/ās las kyang ngos ām sbyar bas/ ā sī tsakre/ ā sī ba bhū ba/ ā sā mā sa/sogs so/ /luṭa la bal dang po'i iṭa byin pas/ ā se tā/ ā se tā se/sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la'ang iṭa byin pas/ ā se ṭīṣ+ṭa/ ā se ṭī yāspyo/ā se ྾ ran/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ ā gya 6 te/ ā si bye te/ ā si 6dhe / sogs so/ /de bzhin du mṛng la/ ā se byu ta/ ā si bye tsā/ ā se 6n+ta/ sogs so/ /lnga/ ba sa kun nas 'gebs pa la'o zhes pa la'ang tang rnams sbyar te/la ṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ bste/ ba sā te/ ba sa te/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bske/ ba sā the/ ba bye/ badhe/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ba se/ ba swa he/ basma he/ ling la/ ata mtha' min pa sogs kyis sī yuṭa'i sa phyis/ bas kyi sa drangs pas/ ba sbo ta/ ba sī yā tī/ba sbo ran/ sogs so/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ bas+t+ri/ ba sā tī/ba sa hūṃ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ basmra/ ba sā shaṃ/ ba bye/ badhe/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ba me+e/ ba sā ba hai/ ba sā ma hai/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a bsta/ a ba sā tsā/ a ba sa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a bas+thāḥ/ a ba sā shaṃ/ a ba bye/ a bar+ghaṃ/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a ba se/ a ba swa hi/ a basma hi/ lung la bal dang po'i iṭa byin pas/ a ba siṣ+ṭa/ a ba si ṣā tī/ a ba si ṣa ta/ sogs so/ /liṭa la gnyis brjod pa sogs byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ba ba se/ba ba sā te/ ba ba se re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ba ba se ṣe/ ba ba 117—703

a sa bi ṣa ta/ sogs dang / iṭa rnged pa'i phyogs la'ang / byings thams cad pa dang byings phyed pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ a soṣ+ṭa/ a so ṣā tī / a so ṣa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a so ṣ+ṭhaḥ/ a so ṣā dzā/a so dhī/ a so r+ghaṃ/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a so ṣi/ a so ṣ+ṭa hi/ a husoṣ+ṭha hi/ liṭa la byengs gnyis brjod atsa dang po can rnams la/ atsa la sgo sogs kyis u ba ru bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ su 6 be/ su 6 ba te/ su 6 bi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ su 6 bi ṣe/su 6 ṣe/ su 6 bā the/ su 6 bi bye/ su 6 bi bye/ su ju bye/ su ju dhī / skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ su 6 be/ su 6 bi ba he/ su ju ba ho/ su 6 bi ma he/ su byu ma he/ luṭa la iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ iṭa'i phyogs la/a be+e tā/ sa bi tā se/ sogs dang / iṭa med pa'i phyogs la/ so tā/so tā se/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ smon pa'i ling la'ang iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ iṭa'i phyogs la/ sa bi ྾ṣ+ṭa/ sa bi ṭī yātram̐/ sa bi ṭī ran/sogs dang / a no ṭa'i phyogs la yon tan byas pas/ so ṭīṣ+ṭa/ so ྾ yā.ā+oṃ/so ྾ ran/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la'ang iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ sa bi byu te/sa bi bye te/ sa bi 6dhe/ sogs sam/ iṭa ma byin pa'i phyogs la/ so 6 te / so bye te/ so 6dhe/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ mṛng la'ang iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ iṭa byin pa'i phyogs la/ a saṃ 3bi 6 ta/ a se zhe bi bye tī/ a sa be+e 6n+ta/ sogs dang / iṭa ma byin pa'i phyogs la/ a so 6ta/ a so 4bye tī/ a so 6n+ta/ sogs so/ /myu/ shrīng nyal ba la'o zhes pa la'ang tang rnams 'jug ste/ shā ngaḥsarba dh+wa 117—706

tu ke ①gu ṇaḥ/ shīng gi byings thams cad pa la yon tan no/ /byings thams cad pa'i ming can rnams pha rol la shīng gi yon tan du 'gyur te/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig la/ she te/ sha yā te/ shī do ruṭa/shīng las ruṭa'o/ /shīng las pha rol gyi āt+pa ṣ+pe pa da rnams la/ āta mtha' ma yin pa sogs kyis dzha ata du bsgyur ba'i aṭa la ruṭa/ ā ga ma 'gyur te/ṭa gnas don dang u brjod pa'i don no/ /laṭa'i mang tshig la/ a dzha āt+pa ṣ+pe pa da rnams la/ ata mtha' ma yin pa sogs kyis dzha ata/ mdo 'dis ruṭa / shīng gi byings thams cad pa la yon tan nos yon tan byas pas/she ra te/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ she ṣe/ sha yā the/ she bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sha ye/ she ba he/ she ma he/ ling la/ ata mtha' ma yin pa la ling gi sa phyis/ byings la yon tan/ etsa sogs kyis a yar bsgyur bas/ sha yī ta/ sha yī yā hūṃ/ sha yi ran/ sogs so/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum las2/ she tsā/ sha yā tī/ she ra hūṃ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ shi ṣ+ṭa/ sha yā tsā/ she bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sha ma/sha yā ba hai/ sha yā ma hai/ de bzhin du/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/a she ta/ a sha yā ṭ+wā/ a she ra ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a she thāḥ—/ a she yā shaṃ/ a she dz+nyā/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a sha yi/ a she ba hi/ a she ma hi/ lung la bal dang po'i iṭa dang / byings thams cad pa dang byengs phyed pa sogs kyis yon tan byas/ etsa sogs kyis a yar bsgyur bsaske/ a sha yiṣ+ṭa/ a sha yi ṣā tsā/ a sha yi ṣa ta/ sogs so/ /liṭa la byings gnyis brjod/ atsa dang po rnams la/ atsa lashā byings sogs kyis 117 707

——yī i ya ru bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ shi shi ye/shi shi yā te/ shi shi yi ra/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ shi shi yi ṣe/ shi shi yā the/ she shi yi byehūṃ/ shi shi yi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ shi shi ye/ shi shi yi ba he/ shi shi yi ma he/ luṭa la bal dang po'i iṭa dang / byings thams cad pa dang byings phyed pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ sha yi tā/ sha yi tā se/sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ smon pa'i ling la/ sha yi ྾ṣ+ṭa/ sha yi ྾ ②yā.ā+oṃ/sha yi ྾ ran/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la'ang iṭa dang yon tan sogs yon tan byas pasaske/ sha yi 6 te/ sha yi bye te/ sha yi byurnye/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du kṛng la/a sha yi 6 ta/ a sha yi bye hūṃ/ a sha yi 6n+ta/ sogs so/ /༈ ing tshig 'don pa la'o zhes pa la'ang tang rnams sbyor te/ 'grel par ing gi sngon du nyer bsgyur a bye rtag tu sbyor dgos te/ don gzhan du 'gyur ba'ang ma yin pas/ ing gi don kho nar gnas so/ /zhes bshad pas/ a bye sngon du sbyar/ atsa dang po can rnams la atsa la shā byings sogs kyis i yar bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a dhī te/ a dhī yā )te/ a dhī ya te/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a dhī ṣe/ a dhī yā theske/ a dhī bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a dhī ye/ a dhī ba he/ a dhī ma he/ leng la/ ata ma yin pa la ling gi sa dbye 'os sa phyis/ aka 'dra ba la ring por gyur dhi na pha rol dbyi ba sogs byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a dhī ta/ a dhī yā tī/ a dhī ran/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/a dhī thāḥ/ a dhī yā shaṃ/ a dhī bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a dhī sa/a dhī ba nyi/ a dhī ma hi/ loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a dhī tī/ a 117 708

༈ dī dhīng 'bar ba dang rtse ba dag la'o zhes pa la'ang tang rnams sbyor te/hal dang ①po rnams la bya ba med/ a tsa dang po rnams la/ a'i a tsa gcig ma yin pa sogs kyis ya ru bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dī dhī te/ dī dh+wa te/ dī dh+ya te/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dri dhī ṣe/ dī dh+yā the/ dī dhī dhī/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dri bye—/ dī dhī ba he/ dī dhī ma he/ yī bar+ṇa yodī dhī be byoḥ/ yi i yig dag la dī dhī be bī dag gi'o/ /rkyen yi ste ya yig dang i yig dag ①pha rol la/ dī dhī dang be bī dag gi mtha' dbye ste/ dī dhī la/ ling / ata mtha' ma yin pa sogs kyis sī yuṭa'i sra phyis/ mdo 'dis byings kyi yī phyis drangs pas/dī dhī ta/ dī dhī yā hūṃ/ dī dhī ran/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dī dhī thāḥ/dri dhī yā shaṃ/ dī dhī dhī/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dī dhī ya/ dī dhī ba hi/dī dhī ma hi/ loṭa la/ laṭa'i skabs ltar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dī dhī hūṃ/ dī smyu hūṃ/ dī dhī ྅/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/dī dhī khya/ dī dh+yā tsā/ dī dhī dhī/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dī bye/snyerī dhī be bī iṭa rnams kyi 'os yon tan mi byed/ dī dh+yā ba hai/ dī sgyu ma hai/ de bzhin du/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a dī dhī ta/ a dī sgyu hūṃ/ a dī dh+ya ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a dī dhī thāḥ/ a dī dh+yātsā/ a dī dhī bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a dī dhi/—yi i yig dag la dri : be+e bī dag gi 'os smi phyis/ a dī dhī ba hi/ a dī dhī ma hi/ lung la bal dang po'i iṭa yi i yig dag la dī dhī be bī dag gi 'os byengs mtha'i yī phyis pas/ a dī dhiṣ+ṭa/ a dī bye ṣā tī/ a dī bye ṣa ta/sogs so/ /liṭa la/ atsa gcig ma yin pa sogs kyis ām sbyar bas/117—711

ta phyis/ mtha'i dzhal sogs ṣa ḍa/ gnas med pa la yang na byas/ a dz+wa ḍa/ a dīṣ+ṭi/ mang tshig la/ dī ṣabyu dīṣa las kyang ngo / /dīṣa las kyang pha rol gyi lang bsgyur ba'i rnyi dzus su yang na 'gyur te/ a dri 6ཿ/ a di ṣan/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a deṭa/ a dz+waḍa/ a driṣ+ṭi/ a dīṣ+ṭa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la / a dz+wa ṣe/ a dī khya/ a dīju/ lung la/ shal ika upa dz+nyā iṭa med pa sogs kyis ṅgi klar bsgyur/ ka phyis/ sa la ṣa bhā dag gi ka 'os/ ṣa ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur ba sogs byas pas a dī k+ṣata| a dwo k+ṣa hūṃ/ a dī k+ṣan sogs so/ /liṭa la gnyis brjod ṇa la gnyis dang thal ma gtogs gzhan ma rnams la/ swañja brtsegs pa sogs kyis kita yang na bar byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ di dz+wa ṣa/ di dz+wa ṣa tuḥ—/ di dī ṣa tuḥ/ di dz+wa 6ཿ/ di dī 6ཿ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/di dz+wa ṣi ①tha/ di dz+waṣ+ṭha/ di dwo ṣa thuḥ/ di dri ṣa thuḥ/ di dre ṣa/ di dwo ṣa/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ di dre ṣa/ di dz+wa ṣi ba/ di dī ṣi ba/ di dī ṣi ma/di dwo ṣi ma/ luṭa la puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan ṣa ṭu la ṣa ṭu byas pas/dreṭ+wā—/ dwo ṣ+ṭa si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la ṣa ②drangs pas/ dī byāta/dī : spyo/ dī : suḥ/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ sa la ṣa bye dag gi ka 'os ṣa ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣa sogs byas pas/ dz+wa gh+ra ti/ dwo khyu taḥ—/ dwo khyurnyi/ sogs dang / de bzhin du/ kṛng la/ a dz+wa khyuta/ a dwo rgya hūṃ/ a dre k+ṣun/ sogs so/ /༈ du ha 'jo ba la'o zhes pa la laṭa sogs a tang dang tang gnyis ka 'jug ste/ laṭa'i a tang gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ la ④tipa/117—713

hai| lang gi a tang gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ la tipa/ ita kyis 'ang ngos i phyis/ da dang po'i ha gha puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan/hal dīpa sogs kyis ta phyis/ gnas med pa la yang na 'os/ gra'am krar bsgyur bas/ a dog a doka① /gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ a duspyo/a du han/ de bzhin du/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a dhog/snyesa'i rgyu mtshan las da dha/ a dhoka /a dur+ghaṃ/ a dusnya/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a do haṃ/a du hwa/ a du za/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a dusnya/ a du hā hūṃ / a du ha ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a dud+dhāḥ/ a du hāshaṃ/a byuhūṃ/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a du nyi②/ a du hwa hi/ a du h+ma nyi/lung la/ shal ika u pa jo iṭa med pa sogs kyis ṅgiklar bsgyur/ ka phyis/da dang po'i ha gha/ a tsa gcig pa sogs kyis da dha/ khar la tsar 'os gha ka/kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/ a tang la/a dhu k+ṣa ta/ a dhu k+ṣa tsā/ a byu k+ṣan/ sogs dang / tang gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ du ha/ di ha/ li ha sogs kyis kla dbye ba dang mi dbyi ba yang na bar byas pas/ a dhu k+ṣa ta/ a dusna/ gnyis tshig la/kla'i atsa la 'os sa'i a phyis pas/ a dhu ①k+ṣu hūṃ/ mang tshig la a dbyi ba yang na bar byas pas/ a byu k+ṣan+ta/ a dhu k+ṣa ta/ de bzhin du/ skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig la/ a dhuk+ṣa thāḥ/ a dhukyāḥ/ gnyis tshig la/ a dhu k+ṣu tsā/ mang tshig la/ a byuk+ṣa snye/ a dhutsā/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/a byuk+shi/ a byuk+ṣa ba nyi/ a dhugla ma hi/ liṭa la gnyis brjod pa sogs byas pas—/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ du do ha/ du du ha tuḥ/ du du 117—715

dik+taḥ—/ di harnyi/ sogs so/ /nyer bsgyur ni dang pra lta bu sngon du sbyor na/ ga da/na da/ pa da sogs kyis ṇar bsgyur bas/ pra ṇi deghi/ sogs so/ /༈ li ha ro myang ba la'o zhes pa'ang gnyis ka'i tshig can te/ laṭa'i a tang gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ la tipa/ puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan/ ha'i rte 'os/ ha zwa/ dzhaṣa sogs kyis ta dha/ ṣa ṭu la ṣa ṭu 'os—/ dha rte/ bhā las dha ①dbye 'os/ bhā gong ma phyis pas/ le bye/gnyis tshig la/ la tas/ ha'i bhā/ dzhaṣa sogs kyis dha bhā/ bhā las bhā phyis| dhar phyis pa la sngon ma'i a ṇa'i ring po 'os/ ring por bsgyur bas/lī byeḥ/ mang tshig la ha 'dren pa kho na ste/ li hadhi/ skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig la/ la sepa puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan/ ha'i bye/ sa la ṣa bhā dag gi ka 'os/ sto ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/ lek+ṣi/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ la thas dang thar bsgyur—/ ha'i rte/ dzhaṣa sogs kyis tha dha/ ṣa ṭu la ṣa ṭu 'os/ dha bye/rte las bhā phyis②/ rte ra phyis pa sogs kyis ring po byas pas/ lī bhāḥ/ byā sto—/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ lem+bi/ li hwaḥ/ li h+maḥ/ cho ga de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ lī snye/ li hā te/ li ha te/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ li k+ṣe/ li hā shaṃ/ lī bye/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ li he/ li hwa he/ lih+ma he/ ling gi a tang la ha 'dren pa kho na ste/ le rgyata/ li t+yā :/ li rgyaḥ/ sogs dang / tang la'ang a ta mtha' ma yin pa sogs kyis sa phyis/ ha drangs pas/ li tī ta/li tī yā shaṃ①/ li tī ran sogs so/ /loṭa la laṭa'i skabs ltar bsgrubs pas/117—717

a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ le zu/ lī ṭ+wāta/ lī rte/ li han+tu/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ lī rnyi/ byā rwata/ lī haṃ/ lī bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ le hā ni/ le hā ba/ le hā ma/ de bzhin du/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ lbo dh+wa/ li hā hūṃ/ li ha hūṃ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ le k+ṣa/ li hā thā/ byā hūṃ/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ le hai/le hā ba hai/ le hā ma hai/ lang gi a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a leḍa—/ a leṭa/ a lī ji/ a li han/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/a leḍa/ a leṭa/ a lī hūṃ/ a lī bhā/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a le hi—/ a li hwa/ a li h+ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a lī bye/a li hā hūṃ/ a li ha ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a lī rteḥ/ a li ①hā tsā/ a lī dz+wa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a li nyi/ a li hwa hi/ a li ④h+ma hi/ lung gi a tang la/ shal i ka upa dha iṭa med pa la kla 'os/ṅgi klar bsgyur/ ha'i bhā 'os/ ha bhā/ sa la ṣa bye dag gi ka /kun nas ①bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur bas/ a li k+ṣata/ a li k+ṣa hūṃ/ a li k+ṣan—/ sogs dang / tang gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ du ha/di ha/ le ha sogs kyis kla dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba yang na bar byas pas a li k+ṣata/ a byā bye/ gnyis tshig la/ khri'i atsa la 'os a phyis pas/ a lik+ṣu hūṃ/ mang tshig la a dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba yang na bar byas pas a li k+ṣan+tarka/ a li k+ṣa ta/ de bzhin du/ skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig la/a li k+ṣa thāḥ/ a lī ④ṭ+wāḥ/ gnyis tshig la/ a li lnga r+ghaṃ/ mang tshig la/a le k+ṣa d+dhā/ a lī j-i/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a li k+ṣi/ a li k+ṣu ba hi/117—718

a li k+ṣu ma hi/ liṭa'i a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ li le ha/ li li ha tuḥ/ li li huḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ li le hi tha/ li le bhā/li li hā thuḥ/ li li ha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ li le ha/ li li nyi ba/li li nyi ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ li li te/ li li hā te/ li li hi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ li li hi ṣe/ li li hā the/ li li hi bye / li li hi rje/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ li li he/ li li hi ba te/ li li hi ma he/ luṭa la puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan/ ha'i bhā/ dzhaṣa sogs kyis ta dha/ ṣa ṭu la ṣa ṭu/ bye las bhā phyis pas/ a tang la/ le ṭ+wā / le ṭ+wā se/ sogs dang / tang la/ le ṇ+ḍa/ le ṭ+wā se/ sogs so//smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/ li t+yā ta/ li t+yās+t+ri/ li t+yā suḥ/ sogs dang /tang la/ ling setsa sogs kyis yon tan mi byed/ ha'i bhā/ sa la ṣa bhā dag gi ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur bas/ laspyiṣ+ṭa/ lak+ṣi yā tram̐/ lakhye ran/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan/ha'i bhā/ sa la ṣa bye dag gi ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/a tang la/ lek+ṣu ti/ sogs dang / tang la/ le k+ṣu te/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng gi a tang la/ a legh+rata/ sogs dang / tang la/a le gh+rata/ sogs so/ /myu/ ākhunya kun nas 'gebs pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang dang tang sna gnyis ka 'jug ste/ urto teḥ/ bi bhā ṣā/ urto ti'i 'dam ka'o/ /khrurto nyi'i byings thams cad pa pa 'gro ba'i ming can hal dang po can pha rol la 'phel ba dang yon tan bye'adam ka can du bya ste/ laṭa'i a tang gi skyes bu dang po'i 117—719

gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ stu taḥ/ stu brnyi/ de bzhin du/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ sta bī ṣi/ sto ṣi/ stu thaḥ/ stu tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sta bī mi/ sto mi/ stu baḥ/ stu maḥ/ tang la hal dang po can la bya ba lhag po med/ atsa dang po can rnams la atsa la dzo byings sogs kyis u bar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/stu te/ stu bā te/ stu ba te/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ stu ṣe/ stu bā the / stu bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ stu be/ stu ba he/ stu ma he/ling gi a tang la bya ba lhag po med pas/ stu yāta/ stu yā hūṃ/ stu yuḥ/sogs so/ /tang la ata mtha' sogs kyis sī yuṭa'i sa phyis atsa la ji byings sogs kyis u bar bsgyur bas/ stu bī ta/ stu bī yā tī/ stu bī ran/sogs so/ /loṭa la laṭa ltar bsgrubs pas/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ sta bī tu/ sto tu/ stu tāta/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/stu tī/ stu ban+tu/ de bzhin du/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ stu hi/ stu tāta / stu haṃ/ stu ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sta bā ni/ sta bā ba/sta bā ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tu '-itī/ stu bā tī/ stu ba tsā/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ stu ṣ+ṭa/ stu bā shaṃ/ stu bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sta bai/ sta bā ba hai/ sta bā ma hai/ lang gi a tang gi skyes bu dang bo gsum la/ astota/ asta bīta/ a stu 4tsā/ astu ban/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ astoḥ/ asta bīḥ/ astu tai/ astuta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ asta baṃ/ astu ba/ astu ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la / astu ta/ astu bā hūṃ/ astu ba ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/117—724

phyi ma gsum la/ a ra baṃ/ a ru ba/ a ru ma/ lung la/ bal dang po'i iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ a ra bīta/ a ra bispya/ a ra bi 6ཿ/liṭa la ṇal gnyis ma gtogs atsa dang po rnams la/ atsal sgo byings sogs kyis u bar bsgyur ba sogs bya ste/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ru rā ba/ ru ru ba tuḥ/ ru ru buḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ru ra 4bi tha ru ru ba thuḥ/ ru ru ba/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ru rā ba/ ru ra ba/ ru ru bi ba/ ru ru bi ma/ luṭa la/ ru du nu su sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ ra bi tā/ ra bi tā si/ sogs sam/ ro tā/ ro tā si/sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ kṛta ma yin pa sogs kyis ring por bsgyur bas / rū yāta/ rū yā.ā+oṃ/ rū yā suḥ/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la'ang / ru du nu sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ ra bi 6ti/ sogs sam/ ro 6 ti / sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ mṛng la/ a ra bi 6ta/ sogs sam/a ro 6ta/ sogs so/ /lnga/ rku bstod pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams 'jug ste/ cho ga thams cad bshad ma thag pa ru dang khyad par cung zad kyang med de/ na bī ti/kau ti/ nu taḥ/ nu babye/ sogs so/ /lnga/ byunya gsal bar brjod pa la'o zhes pa la a tang dang tang gnyis ka 'jug ste/ bru ba yīṭa/ byu las ā+oṭa'o/ /byu las pha rol gyi byings thams cad pa hal dang po pa 'gro ba'i ming can rnams la yīṭa ā ga ma 'gyur te/laṭa'i a tang gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ mdo 'dis yīṭa byings thams cad pa dang byings phyed pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ bra bī nyi/177—728

gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ byu taḥ/ bru brnyi/ de bzhin du skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bra bī ṣi/ byu lkuthaḥ/ byu tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/bra bī mi/ byu baḥ/ byu maḥ/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ byu te/bru bā te/ bru ba te/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ byu ṣe/ bru bā the/ byu bye / skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bru be+e/ byu ba he/ byu ma he/ bru baḥ/pa.ā+oṃ nā mā di ta ā ho bru baḥ/ byu las dang po lnga rnams kyi ste byu'i ā ha'o/ /byunya las pha rol kyi laṭa bsgyur ba pa rasmi pa da rnams kyi tipa sogs dang po lnga ni rim pa bzhin ṇal la sogs pa lnga ru yang na 'gyur la/ bsgyur ba na byu'ang ā ha zhes par bsgyur bar bya ste/ byu la/ laṭa/ la rim pa bzhin tipa sogs lnga ru bsgyur/ mdo 'dis tipa sogs lnga po rim bzhin ṇal sogs lnga ru bsgyur/byu'ang ā har bsgyur bas/ ṇal ā tu sa/ us rnams la/ ā ha/2 ā ha tuḥ / ā huḥ/ ā has+thaḥ/ ā ha'i tha'o/ /ā ha'i ha ni dzhal so sor bsdu ba pha rol la tha yig tu 'gyur te/ byu la/ laṭa la sepa/ byu las dang po lnga sogs kyis sepa/ thal dang / byu ā har bsgyur/ mdo 'dis/ ha tha/khar la tsar 'os/ tha tar bsgyur bas/ āt+tha/ gong bzhin bsgrubs pas/thas a thus su bsgyur ba la/ ā ha —thuḥ/ ṇal sogs su ma bsgyur ba'i phyogs kyi dpe gong du brjod zin to/ /smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/ byu yāta/byu yā tsā/ byu yuḥ/ sogs dang / tang la/ ata mtha' ma yin pa sogs kyis sī yuṭa'i sa phyis/ atsa la sbyo byings byu sogs kyis u bar bsgyur bas/bru bī ta/ bru bī yā tī/ bru bī ran/ sogs so/ /loṭa'i a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ bra bī tu/ byu tāta/ byu tsā/ bru ban+tu/ skyes bu dbus 117—729

ma gsum la/ byu hi/ byu tāta/ byu tai/ byu ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/bra bā ṇi/ bra bā ba/ bra bā ma/ de bzhin du/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ byu tī/ bru bā tsā/ bru ba tī/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ byu ṭī / bru bā tsā/ byu dhī/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bra be+e①/ bra bā ba hai/bra bā ma hai/ lang gi a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a bra bīta/ a byu hūṃ / a bru ban/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a bra bīḥ/ a byu tai/a byu ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a bra baṃ/ a byu ba/ a byu ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a bru ta/ a byu bā tsā/ a bru ba ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a byu thāḥ/ a bru bā shaṃ/ a byu j-i/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a bru bi/ a byu ba hi/ a byu ma nyi/ bru bo ba ཿ/ byu'i ba tshi'o / /rkyen byings phyed pa'i ming can pha rol la byu'i ba tsi zhes par bsgyur te/i yig brjod pa'i don no/ /byu la lung / mdo 'dis byu ba tsir bsgyur/a su ti/ bat+ta sogs kyis tsa li ang du bsgyur/ btsa'i um 'os/ u ā ga ma byin/ ata las yon tan sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ a tang la a bo tsa ta/a bo tsa tsā/ a bo tsa na/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ tang la a bo tsa ta/a bo tse tsā/ a bo tsan+ta/ sogs so/ /liṭa la/ byu ba tsar bsgyur kita ma yin pa rnams la/ gnyis rnams kyi sogs kyis a sgyu sa saṃ pra sā ra ṇa dang kita rnams la/ ba tsi so pi sogs kyis gnyis ka saṃ pra 1sā ra ṇar bsgyur bas/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ u bā tsa/ u tsa tuḥ/ spru tsuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ u bathi/ u ba tsi tha/ khru tsa thuḥ/ u tsa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ u bā tsa/ u ba tsa/ u tsi ba/ spru tsi ma/ de bzhin du/117—730
