tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ spru tse/ spru tsā te/ khru tsi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ u tsi ṣe/ u tsā the/ u tsi bye/ spru tsi dh+wa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ u tse/ spru tsi ba he/ spru tsi ma he/ luṭa la/ tsu'i ku 'os tsa kar bsgyur nas drangs pas/ a tang la/ balnga/ bak+ta se/ sogs dang / tang la/ baghā/ baghā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling gi a tang la / ba tsi swa pi sogs kyis saṃ pra sā ra ṇar bsgyur bas/ u tsāta/ u tsāspyo/u tsā suḥ/ sogs so/ /tang la/ tsu'i ku'os/ ka tsa/ kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur bas/ bak+ṣiṣ+ṭa/ bakhye yā tī1/ bak+ṣi ra na/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la'ang tsu'i ku/ kun nas bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/ a tang la/ bagh+ra ti/bagh+ra taḥ/ bagh+rarnyi/ sogs dang / tang la/ bak+ṣu te/ bakhye te/ bak+ṣudhe/sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ mṛng gi a tang la/ a bak+ṣuta/ a bak+ṣu tī/a bagh+ran/ sogs dang / tang la/ a bak+ṣu ta/ a bakhye tsā/ a bak+ṣun+ta/sogs so/ /i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gya sru tā da dā da yaḥs mās+thāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las ad la sogs pa rnams sdogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las/ byed pa po'i don gyi shapa 'jig pa ad la sogs pa rnams la/ laṭa sogs spyor tshul spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa rags pa rnams re zhig sdogs so// //da ni dzu ho ti la sogs pa'i cho ga rnams bshad par bya ste/ dzu ho t+yā di 117—731

bh+yaḥthruḥ—/ dzu ho ti la sogs pa rnams las blu'o/ /byings hu sbyin pa la sogs pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni dzu ha ti la sogs pa rnams te/ de rnams las pha rol gyi byed pa po la shapa'o zhes pas shapa ni blu zhes par bsgyur bar bya'o/ /sh+lau/ shu la'o//shapa blu ru bsgyur bas tha pha rol la byings a sgyus med pa'i gnyis brjod par bya zhing blu'ang 'jig ste/༈ hu sbyin pa dang bza' ba dag la'o zhes pa la laṭa sogs a tang rnams sbyar—/ byed pa po la shapa/ dzu ho ti sogs kyis shapa shur bsgyur/ mdo 'dis byings gnyis brjod cing blu'ang 'jig /ku ha dag gi tsu 'os ha dzha/a sgyu swa'i ①tsas 'ang 'os ha dzhar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dzu ho ti/ dzu hu taḥ/ dzu hwa ti/—dzha sata hu shu dag gi sogs kyis ya ṇa②/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dzu ho ṣi/ dzu hu thaḥ/ dzu hu tha/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dzu ho mi/ dzu hu baḥ/ dzu hu maḥ/ dzu hu'i bar gong ltar bsgrubs pas/ ling la/ dzu hu yā ta/ dzu hu yā hūṃ/ dzu hu yuḥ/sogs so/ /de bzhin du loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dzu ho ①tu/ dzu hu tāta—/ dzu hu hūṃ/ dzu ho rjotu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dzu hu dhi/—hu dzhal las nyi dhi/ dzu hu tāta/ dzu hu haṃ/ dzu hu ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dzu ha bā ni/ dzu ha bā ba/ dzu ha bā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a dzu hota/ a dzu hu hūṃ/ a dzu ha buḥ/snyesi tsa a byusta sogs kyis sna dzus/ dzus la'ang ngos yon tan/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a dzu hoḥ/ a dzu hu tai/ a dzu hu ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a dzu ha baṃ/ a dzu hu ba/ a dzu hu ma/ lung la sitsa la 'phel ba pa rasmi ⑤pa da rnams la 'osarjo/ /'phel ba byas pas/ skyes bu 177—732

dang po gsum la/ a ho ྾ta/ a hoṣ+ṭi/ a ho 6ཿ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a ho ྾ཿ/ a hoṣ+ṭi/ a hoṣ+ṭa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a ho ṣe/ a ho ṣ+ṭa/ a hoṣ+ṭha/ liṭa la/ dhī byā j-i hu r+pā blu brtso/ bhā spyo z-i hu rnams kyi blu bzhin du yang ngo / /nyi dhī 'jigs ①pa/ byā ngo tsha ba/ z-inya 'dzin pa/ hu sbyin pa rnams kyi liṭa pha rol la ām yang na sbyor te/ ām la'ang blu bzhin gnyis brjod pa sogs bya ste/ ām gyi phyogs la/ dzu ha r+pā tsa kā ra/ dzu ②ha r+pā ba khyu ba/ dzu ha bā mā sa/ sogs dang / ām ma sbyar ba'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dzu hā ba/ dzu hu ba tuḥ/ dzu hu buḥ/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dzu ha bi tha/ dzu ho tha/ dzu hu ba thuḥ/ dzu hu ba—/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dzu hā ba/ dzu ha ba/ dzu hu bi ba①/ dzu hu bi ma/ luṭa la byings thams cad pa dang byings phyed pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ ho tā/ ho tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la dhikṛta ma yin pa sogs kyis ring po byas pas/ ju yāta/ tū yāspyo/ tū yā suḥ/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la byengs thams cad pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ ho 6 ti/ ho6 taḥ| ho 6rnyi/ sogs dang / de bzhin du/ kṛng la/ a ho 6ta/a ho byu tsā/ a ho byun/ sogs so/ /༈ nyi bhā 'jigs ⑤pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor zhing shapa thrur bsgyur ba sogs cho ga phal cher hu dang 'dra ste/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ bi bhe ti/ bhi yo3n+ya ta ra sde/ dī'i yang na'o/ /dī'i khra yig ni byings thams cad pa hal dang po ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can pha rol la i thung ngur yang na bsgyur te/ skyes bu dang po'i gnyis tshig la/ bi bhi taḥ/117—733

bi bhā taḥ/ mang tshig la atsa gcig ma yin pa sogs kyis ya ṇar bsgyur bas/bi bh+ya ti/ de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/bi bhe ṣi/ bi bhi thaḥ/ bi bhā thaḥ/ bi r+bha tha/ bi dhī tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bi snye mi/ bi bhi baḥ/ bi ṭī baḥ/ bi rnyi maḥ/ bi dhī maḥ/ling la/ d+dhā'i yang na 'os yī thung ngur yang na bsgyur bas/ bi bhi yāta/ bi bhi yā tsā/ bi bhi yuḥ/ sogs sam/ bi bhā yāta/ bi ji yā hūṃ/ bi dhī yuḥ/sogs so/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ bi bhe tu/ bi bhi tāta/①bi bhā tāta/ bi bhi tsā④/ bi bhā tī/ bi bh+ya tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/bi bhi hi/ bi dhī hi/ bi bhi tāta/ bi dhī tāta/ bi rnyi tai/ bi dhī lta/ bi bhi ta/ bi dhī ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bi bha yā ni/ bi bha yā ba/bi bha yā ma/ de bzhin du/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a bi bhe ta/a bi snyi hūṃ/ a bi d+dhā ṭ+wā/ a be+e byuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a bi bheḥ—/ a bi bhi tai/ a bi d+dhā haṃ/ a bi rnyita/ a bi bhā ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a bi bha yo/ a bi ①bhi ba/ a bi dhī ba/ a bi rjornyi ma/a bi d+dhā ma/ lung la/ sitsa la 'phel ba pa rasmi pa da rnams la 'os 'phel ba byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a bye ྾ta/ a r+bhaspya/ a dzhai 6ཿ/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a bhe ྾ཿ/ a steṣ+ṭi/ a haiṣ+ṭa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a bye ṣe/ a bye ṣ+ṭa/ a bheṣ+ṭha/ liṭa la/ dhī s+thā sogs kyis ām yang na bar byed de/ ām gyi phyogs la/ bi bha yī tsa kā ra/ bi bha lnga ba bhū ba/ bi bha yā mā sa/ sogs dang / ām ma sbyar ba'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ bi bhā ya/ bi bh+ya tuḥ/ bi byuḥ⑤/ skyes bu dbus ma 777—734

gsum la/ bi bha yi tha/ bi bhe tha/ bi bh+ya thuḥ/ bi bh+ya/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ be+e bhā ya/ bi bha ya/ bi bye ba/ bi bye ma/ luṭa la byings thams cad pa dang byings phyed pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ bhe tā/ bhe tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ dhī yāta/ dhī yās+t+ri/ bhā yā suḥ/sogs so/ /kṛṭa la yon tan byas pas/ bhe sh+ya ti/ sogs dang / kṛng la/a bhi 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ spyo ngo tsha ba la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor zhing cho ga phal cher bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra ste/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dzi hri ti/dzi trī taḥ/ dzi hri ya ti/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dzi hre ṣi/ dzi ji thaḥ/dza trī tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dzi s+thā mi/ dzi s+thā baḥ/ dzi s+thā maḥ/ling la/ dzi s+thā yāta/ dzi byā yā hūṃ/ dzi ju yuḥ/ sogs so/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dzi hre tu/ dzi ju tāta/ dzi dī tsā/ dzi hri ya tu/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dzi dī hi/ dzi byā tāta/ dzi s+thā lta/ dzi s+thā ①ta/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dzi hra yā ni/ dzi hra yā ba/ dzi hra yā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a dzi hreta/ a dzi s+thā hūṃ(mi/ a dzi hra yuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a dzi hreḥ/ a dzi byā tai/ a dzi s+thā ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a dzi hra yi/ a dzi s+thā ba/ a dzi dī ma/ lung la/ setsa la 'phel ba byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a hai ྾ta/ a haiṣ+ṭi/ a hai 6ཿ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a hai ྾ཿ/ a haiṣ+ṭi/ a hreṣ+ṭa/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a hre ṣi/ a hre ṣ+ṭa/ a hreṣ+ṭha/ liṭa la/ ām yang na bar byas pas/ dzi hra lnga tsa kā ra/ a hra yī ba khyu ba/ dzi hra yā mā sa/117—735

pi thra taḥ/ pi pra ti/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ pi pak+ṣi/ pi thra thaḥ/pi thra tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ pi pami/ pi dṛ baḥ/ pi thra ①maḥ/ling la/ pi thra yāta/ pi dṛ yā hūṃ②/ pi thra yuḥ①/ sogs so/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ pi partu/ pi thra tāta/ pi thra hūṃ/ pi pra ti/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ pi thra hi/ pi thra tāta pi thra tai/ pi thra ta/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ pi par+ṣa ṇi/ pi pa rā ba/ pi pa rā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a pi paḥ/ a pi thra tsā/ a pi pa ruḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a pi paḥ/ a pi thra haṃ/ a pi thra ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a pi pa ram̐/ a pi thra ba/ a pi thra ma/ lung la 'phel ba byas pasaske/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a pā khyita/ a pāspyo/ a pākhyoḥ/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a pāk+ṣiḥ/ a pār+ghaṃ/ a pāspyo/ skyes bu phyi ④ma gsum la/ a pār+ghaṃ/ a pār+ṣa/ a pā྾/ liṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la—/ pa pā ra/ pa pra tuḥ/ pa pruḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ pa barba—/ pa pra thuḥ/ pa pra/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ pa pra ra/ pa pa ⑤ra/pa pri ba/ pa thra ma/ luṭa la yon tan byas pas/ parta/ paṭ+wā si/sogs so/ /sgon pa'i ling la/ sha yaka leng sogs kyis ring du bsgyur bas/pre yāta/ pri yā hūṃ/ pre yā suḥ/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ ṛta han sogs kyis iṭa sbyar bas/ pa ri byuti/ sogs dang / de bzhin du/ kṛng la/a pa ri 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ o hāka gtong ba la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ shapa blur bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/117—738

dza hā ti/ dza hā teṣ+ṭa/ dza hā ti'i 'ang ngo / /ghu'i ming can ma yin pa'i dza hā ti'i āta ni byings thams cad pa hal dang po ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can pha rol la ita du yang na 'gyur ro/ /ā+o ha l+ya ghoḥ/ ghu ma yin pa'i hal la yī'o/ /ghu'i ming can ma yin pa'i byings a bh+yasta'i ming can rnams dang rkyen shā'i āta ni byings thams cad pa ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can pha rol la ā+o ru bsgyur bar bya ste/skyes bu dang po'i gnyis tshig la/ dza hā ti'i 'ang ngos ita dang mdo 'dis ā+o yang na bar byas pas/ dza hi taḥ/ dza tī taḥ/ mang tshig la/ a bh+yasta las ata 'os dzha ata/ shā a bh+yasta dag gi āta 'os ā phyis pas/ dza ha ti/ de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dza hā si/dza hi thaḥ/ dza tī thaḥ/ dza hi tha/ dza tī tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dza hā mi/ dza hi baḥ/ dza tī baḥ/ dza hi maḥ/ dza tī maḥ/ lo po yi ya la dbye'o①/ /dza hā ti'i āta ni byengs thams cad pa ya yig dang po can pha rol la dbyi ste/ ling la/ dza t+yā ta/ dza t+yā hūṃ/ dza rgyaḥ①/ sogs so/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dza hā tu/ dza hi ④tāta/ dza tī butāta/dza hi tsā/ dza tī hūṃ/ dza ha tu/ ā tsa ho/ hi la ā'ang ngo / /loṭa bsgyur ba'i hi pha rol la dza hā ti'i yang na ā nyid du gnas te/ loṭa'i skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig la/ dza hā hi/ dza nyi hi/ dza tī ⑤hi/ dza hi tāta/dza tī rjotāta/ ste gzugs lnga 'byung ngo / /gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ dza hi tai/ dza tī tai/ dza tī ta/ dza hi ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dza hā ni/dza hā ba/ dza hā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a dza hāta/ a dza hi hūṃ—/ ashedza tī tsā/ a dza huḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a dza hāḥ/117—739

a dza hi tai/ a dza tī tai/ a dza nyi ta/ a dza tī ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la—/ a dza hūṃ/ a dza hi ba/ a dza tī ba/ a dza hi ma/ a dza tī ma/lung la/ yam/ ram/ nam/ āta mtha' sogs kyis saka dang iṭa byin pas—/ a hā sīta/ a hā seṣ+ṭi/ a hā si 6ཿ/ sogs so/ /liṭa la gnyis brjod/ āta las ṇal au 'os/ rnal gnyis au/ iṭa la'ang āta kyis dbye ba sogs byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dza ho/ dza ha tuḥ/dza huḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dza hā tha/ dza nyi tha/ dza ha thuḥ/dza ha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dza ho①/ dza nyi ba/ dza ti ma/ luṭa la/hā tā/ hā tā se/ sogs so/ /zon pa'i ling la/ ling la e 'os e ru bsgyur bas te yāta/ te yā:/ he yā suḥ/ sogs so/ /thraṭa la/ hā gya ti—/ sogs dang / kṛng la/ a hā su ta/ sogs so/ /༈ ṛ 'gro ba la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams 'jug ste/ ṛpa/ shapa blur bsgyur/ blu la'ang ngos gnyis brjod/ arti pi parti dag gi 'ang ngos/ a sgyu sa i/ a sgyu sa'i 'dra ba ma yin pa la 'os/ i ya ru bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ i yarti/ i kṛ taḥ/ i yu ti/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ i yabhā/ i kra thaḥ/ i mṛ tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ i yarme/ i mṛ baḥ/ i yī maḥ/ ling la/ i kṛ yāta/i yī yā hūṃ/ i kṛ yuḥ/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ i yartu/ i kṛ tāta/ a mṛ tsā/ i yu tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ i yī nyi/ i yī tāta/ i yī tai/ i yī ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ i ya rā ṇi/ i ya rā ba/ i ya rā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po 117—740

ga/de/de /de/ /de /deḥ/ —a tsa dang po'i /de/ /de las kyang ngos 'phel ba/ byings thams cad pa sogs kyis yon tan/ hal dī pa/ sogs kyis ta dang sa phyis/ i mṛ tsā/ i ya ruḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma ga/dem/ /de/ /de /deḥ/ a tsa dang po'i /de/ /de las kyang ngos 'phel ba/ byings thams cad pa sogs kyis yon tan/ hal dri pa sogs kyis ta dang sa phyis/ /de yī tai/ /de yī ta/ /des /de phyi /de gsum la/ i ya ram̐/ i yī ba/ i yī ma/ lung la/ sarti shāste arti rnams las kyang ngos/ ṅgi ang du bsgyur/ ṛ dṛ sha dag gis ang la yon tan byas pas/ ā rata/ ā ra hūṃ/ ā ran/ sogs so/ /yang na ṛ sre dag las ang yang na'o zhes lung 'dren gyis ṅgi sitsa ru bsgyur 'phel ba byas pas/skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ākhyi ta/ ā:/ ā྾ཿ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ājoḥ/ ār+ghaṃ/ āste/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ārde/ār+ṣashā / ān+d+ra/ liṭa la/ byings gnyis brjod/ ṛ'i ata 'os/ a sgyu sa a/ ṛ ts+tsha ti dṛta rnams kyi 'os 'phel ba'i rgyu mtshan can ma yin pa rnams la yon tan dang / ṇal gnyis la 'phel ba byas/ aka 'dra ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ā ra/ ā ra tuḥ/ a ruḥ/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ā ri tha/ ā ra thuḥ/ ā ra/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ā ra/ ā ri ba/ ā ri ma/ luṭa la yon tan byas pas/arta—/ ar+sā si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i leng la/ arti brtsegs pa dang po dag gis yon tan nos yon tan byas pas/ ar+yā ta/ ar+yā s+t+ri/ ar+yā suḥ/sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ ṛta han dag las gya la 'os iṭa byin/ byings thams cad pa dang byings phyed pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ a ri 6 ti/sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng la/ ā ri 6ta/ sogs so/ /117—741

skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bi be ṣa/ bi be ṣi ba/ bi be ṣi ma/ luṭa la/beṣ+ṭa①| beṣ+ṭa si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ bi byāta/ bi byā spyo①/bi ṭī suḥ/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa ①la/ puka mtha' sogs yon tan/ sa la ṣa dha dag gi ka 'os/ ṣa ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur bas/bekhyu ti/ sogs dang / de bzhin du/ thrang ④la/ a bekhyeta/ sogs so/ /༈ dzan skye ba la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ shapa blur bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i ⑤gcig tshig la/ dza dzasti/dza na sa na kha rmā san dzha loḥ/ dza na sa na kha na rnams kyis na dzhal dag la'o/ /dza na skye ba/ sa na dang kha rjon kun nas gus pa rnams kyi ṭi ⑦ni rkyen san dang dzhal dang po ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can pha rol la āta du 'gyur te/ gnyis tshig la/dza dzā taḥ/ mang tshig la/ a bh+yasta las ata 'os/ dzha ata gam han dza na sogs kyis u ba jo phyis/ sa tu'i sha tsu la sha tsu 'os/ nu pho/ dza nya 'dus pa p+ta byas pas/ dza dzha ti/ de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dza dza ni ṣi/—'iṭa dzan dag las dha la'ang ngos/ eṭa/ dza dzā thaḥ/dza dzā tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dza dzam+bi/ dza dza naḥ/ dza dzad+maḥ/ling la/ yal 'dam ka 'os/ ṭi atu du yang na bar byas pas/ dza dzā yāta/dza dzā yā tsā/ dza dzā yuḥ8)/ sogs sam/ dza dza n+ya ta1/ dza dza t+yā tsā/ dza dza rtseḥ/ sogs so/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dza dzan+tu/ dza dzā tāta—/ dza dzā tī/ dza dzha tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dza dzā hi/ dza dzā spyotāta/ dza dzā tai/ dza dzā ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dza dza nā ni/dza dza nā ba/ dza dza nā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a dza dzan/117— 747

a dza dzā hūṃ/ a dza tshuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a dza dzan/ a dza dzā tai/ a dza dza ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a dza dza rna/ a dza dzan+d+ra/a dza dzad+ma/ lung la iṭa byin pas/ a dza nī ta/ a dza niṣ+ṭi/ a dza ni 6ཿ/sogs so/ /liṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dza dzā na/ dza snyo tuḥ/ dza tshuḥ / skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ①dza dza ni tha/ dza snyo thuḥ/ dza rnye/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dza dzā na/ dza rnyib/ dza rnyi ma/ luṭa la/ bal dang po'i iṭa byin pas/ dza ni tā/ dza ni tā si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ya la 'dam ka 'os/ ār bsgyur ba dang mi bsgyur ba gdam nga can du byas pas/ dzā yāta/ dzā yā.ā+oṃ/ dzā yā suḥ/ sogs sam/ dza t+yāta/dza t+yātram̐/ dza t+yā ④suḥ/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la iṭa byin pas/ dza ni 6 ti/sogs dang / de bzhin du/ kṛng la'ang ①a dza ni 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ che dānya sbyin pa la'o zhes pa la a tang dang tang gnyis ka 'jug ste/shapa blu gnyis brjod pa sogs byas pas/ laṭa'i a tang gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ da dā ti/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ shā a bh+yasta dag gi āta 'os ā phyis/ khar la tsar 'os da ta sogs byas pas/ dat+taḥ/ da da ti—/ de bzhin du/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ da dā se/ dat+thaḥ/dat+tha—/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ da dā mi/ da dwaḥ/ dad+maḥ/ de bzhin du / tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ daste/ da dā te/ da da te/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ da྾/ da dā the/ dadhe zhe/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ da de/ da dwa he/ dad+ma te/ leng gi a tang la/ shā a bh+yasta sogs kyis ā phyis drangs pas/ da byāta/ da byā hūṃ/ da byuḥ/ sogs dang /117 748

ṣi—/ a di ṣ+ṭa hi/ a diṣ+ṭha hi/ liṭa la/ ṇal gnyis au dang / iṭa la'ang āta kyis dbyi 'os/ ā phyis pas/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/da do/ da da tuḥ/ da duḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ da di tha/ da dā ①tha/ da da thuḥ②/ da da/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ da do/ da di ba/da di ma/ de bzhin du/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ da de/ da dā te—/ da di re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ da di ṣe/ da dā the/ da di dhetshu)—/ da di bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ da de/ da di ba te/ da di ma he/ luṭa'i a tang la/ dā tā/ dā dutā si/ sogs dang / tang la/dā tā/ dā tā se/ sogs so⑤/ /smon pa'i ling ④gi a tang la/ ling la e 'os—/ er bsgyur bas/ de yāta/ de yā.ā+oṃ/ de yā suḥ/ sogs dang /tang la/ dā sīṣ+ṭa/ dā sī yā s+t+ri/ dā sbo ran/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la'ang bya ba gzhan med/ a tang la/ dā su ti/ sogs dang / tang la/ dā khru te/sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng gi a tang la/ a dā gyata/ sogs dang /tang la/ a dā su ta/ sogs so/ /༈ che dh+wanya 'dzin pa dang gso ba dag la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang dang tang gnyis ka 'jug ste/ shapa shār bsgyur bas/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ da dh+wa ti/ da dhasta thobya/ da dha'i ta tha dag la'ang ngo / /che dh+wanya/gnyis brjod a sgyu sa'i 'ang ngos dha sngon ma dar bsgyur bas/ da dh+wa zhes pa shā a bh+yasta dag gi āta dbye 'os ā phyis/ da dha zhes pas pha rol tu ta yig dang tha yig dang 'ang sgras sa dang dh+wa rnams byung na da de be+er yang dhar bsgyur bar bya ste/laṭa'i a tang gi skyes bu dang po'i gnyis tshig la/ dhat+taḥ/ skyes bu dang po'i 117—750

—du bsgyur ba sogs byas pas laṭa'i a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ bi bharti/bi j-i taḥ/ bi bh+ra ti/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bi bhak+ṣi/ bi j-i thaḥ/bi z-i tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bi bharmi/ bi z-i baḥ/ bi j-i maḥ/ de bzhin du/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ bi z-i te/ bi khyu ①te/ be bh+ra te/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bi j-i ṣe/ bi sgyu ⑧the/ bi j-i snye/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bi bye/ bi z-i ba he/ bi z-i ma he/ ling gi a tang la—/ bi z-i yāta/ bi j-i ①yā tsā/ bi j-i yuḥ/ sogs dang / tang la mtha' ma yin pa sogs kyis sī yuṭa'i sa phyis/ ika gi atsal yaṇa byas pas/bi sgyi ④ta/ bi sgyi ⑤yā tsā/ bi d+dhā duran/ sogs so/ /loṭa'i a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ bi bhartu/ bi j-i tāta/ bi j-i tsā/ bi bh+ya tu/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bi z-i hi/ bi j-i tāta/ bi z-i tai/ bi j-i ta/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ be+e bha rā ṇi/ bi bha rā ba/ bi bha rā ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ be+e z-i tsā/ bi 7 tsā/ bi bh+ra hūṃ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bi j-i ṣ+ṭa/ bi bhā ⑦tsā/ bi j-i dz+nyā/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/bi bha ri/ bi bha rā ba hai/ bi bha rā ma hai/ lang gi a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a bi bhaḥ/ a bi z-i hūṃ/ a bi bha ruḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a bi bhaḥ/ a bi j-i tai/ a bi z-i ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/a bi bha re/ a bi z-i ba/ a bi skez-i ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/a bi j-i ta/ a bi bhā hūṃ/ a bi bh+ra ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a bi z-i thāḥ/ a bi bhā shaṃ/ a bi z-i snye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a bi j-i/a bi z-i ba hi/ a bi z-i ma hi/ lung gi a tang la setsa la 'phel ba pa rame+e pa 117—753

ring du bsgyur bas/ ji yāta/ bh+ri yā ste/ ji yā suḥ/ sogs dang /tang la/ ṛ las kyang ngos yon tan mi byed/ z-i ྾ṣ+ṭa/ j-i ྾ yā s+t+ri/ z-i ྾ ran/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ ṛta han dag las su la 'os iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ a tang la/ bha ri 6 ti/ sogs dang / tang la/ bha ri 6 te/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ mṛng gi a tang la/ a bha ri 6 ta/sogs dang / tang la/ a bha ri 6 ta/ sogs so/ /༈ māng tshad la ste sgra la 'ang ngo zhes pa la tang rnams sbyor te/ shapa ji gnyis brjod/ j-inya rnams kyi ita 'os/ a sgyu sa i ta/ ghu ma yin pa rnams kyis ha la la ā+o 'os/ sdita hal dang po rnams la mtha' yī/ a tsa dang po rnams la/ shā a bh+yasta dag gi āta 'os ā dbyi ba sogs byas pas/laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ mi m+bi te/ mi mā te/ mi ma te/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ mi m+bi ṣe/ mi mā the/ mi m+bi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum larka/ mi mi/ mi rmā ba he/ mi m+bi ma te/ ling la/ mtha' ma yin pa sogs kyis sbo yuṭa'i sa phyis/ shā sogs kyis ā phyis/ mi m+bi ta/ mi sbo yā ā+oṃ/mi sbo ran/ sogs so/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ mi sbo hūṃ/ mi mā hūṃ/ mi ma hūṃ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ mi sbo ṣ+ṭa/ mi mā tsā/ mi m+bi dz+nyā/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ mi mi/ mi mā ba hai/ mi mā ma hai/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a mi sbo ta/ a mi mā hūṃ/ a mi ma ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a mi m+bi thāḥ/ a mi mā tsā/ a mi m+bi snye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a mi me/ a mi m+bi ba hi/ a mi m+bi ma hi/ lung la sitsa'i sra 'dren pa kho na ste/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a māsta/ a mā sā tsā/117—755

a mā sa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a mās+thāḥ/ a mā sā shaṃ/ a mā dz+nyā / snyedha la'angangos sitsa phyis/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a ①mā si/ a mā swa hi/ a mā sma hi/ liṭa la/ iṭa la'ang āta kyis snedabyi 'os ā phyis pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ma me/ ma mā te/ ma mi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ma mi ṣe/ ma mā the/ ma mi snye/ ma mi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ma me/ma mi ba he/ ma mi ma he/ luṭa la/ mā tā/ mā tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i leng la/ mā sīṣ+ṭa/ mā sī yā:/ mā sī ran/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la—/ mā su te/ sogs dang / kṛng la/ a mā su ta/ sogs so/ /༈ o hāng 'gro ba la'o zhes pa la'ang tang rnams sbyor te/ shapa tha 'os/byings gnyis brjod/ ku ha dag gi tsu 'os/ ha dzha/ a sgyu sa'i tsar 'ang ngos dzha dza/ j-inya rnams kyi ita 'os/ a sgyu sa ita/ ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can hal dang po rnams la/ ghu ma yin pas hal la ā+o 'os/ mtha' yī dang /atsa dang po rnams la/ shā a sgyusta sogs kyis ā phyis pas/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dzi tī te/ dzi hā te/ dzi ha te/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dzi tī ṣe/ dzi tī the/ dzi tī dhe/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dzi he / dzi tī ba he/ dzi tī ma he/ ling la/ mtha' ma yin pa sogs kyis sī yuṭa'i sa phyis/ shā sogs kyis ā ①phyis pas/ dzi tī ta/ dzi tī yā tsā/ dzi tī ran/ sogs so/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dzi tī hūṃ/ dzi hā hūṃ/dzi ha hūṃ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dzi tī ṣ+ṭa/ dzi rjohā shaṃ/ dzi tī dhe⑤/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dzi hai/ dzi hā ba hai/ dzi hā ma rjohai/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a dzi tī ta/ a dzi hā tsā/ a dzi ha ta/ skyes bu 117—756

dbus ma gsum la/ a dzi ①tī thāḥ/ a dzi hā shaṃ/ a dzi tī dhī/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a dzi hidze+e/ a dzi tī ba ti/ a dzi tī ma hi/ lung la/sitsa'i sa 'dren pa kho ①na ste/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a hāsta/ a hā sā tī—/ a hā sa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a hā s+thāḥ/ a hā sā shaṃ/a hā dz+nyā/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a hā se/ a hā swa hi④/ a hāsma hi/dzaṭa la/ gnyis brjod thung ngu 'os thung ngur bsgyur/ ku ha dag gi tsu 'os ha dzha—/ a sgyu sa'i tsar 'ang ngos/ dzha dza/ yīṭa la'ang āta kyis dbyi 'os ā phyis pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dza te/ dza hā te/ dza nyi ⑤re/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dza hi ṣe/ dza hā the/ dza hi be+e/ dza hi bye/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dza he④/ dza hi ba te/ dza hi ma he/ smon pa'i ling la/ hā sīṣ+ṭa/ hā sī yā ā+oṃ/ hā sī ran/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/hā su te/ sogs dang / kṛng la/ a hā su ta/ sogs so/ /i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gya sru tā ta ⑦hā da yaḥs māste/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las hu la sogs pa rnams rdzogs so/ /de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las/ byed pa po'i don gyi shapa blur bsgyur ba dzu ho ti la sogs pa rnams la laṭa sog/sa sbyor ba'i cho ga spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //da ni di bu la sogs pa byed pa po'i don la sh+yan 'jug pa rnams kyi cho ga 117—757

rnams bshad par bya ste/ di bu rtse ba dang mngon par 'dod pa dang / tha snyad dang / sdu ①gu dang / gsal ba dang / bstod pa dang / mjes pa dang / 'gro ba rnams la'o zhes pa la laṭa skesogs a tang rnams sbyor te/ di bā di bh+yaḥsh+yan/ di ba la sogs pa rnams las sh+yana'o/ /byengs di bu la sogs pa rnams las byengs thams cad pa rnams pha rol la byed pa po'i don gyi shapa kyi yul la sh+yan 'gyur te/ na dbyangs don dang sha shita ①kyi don no/ /dipa la sh+yan rjes 'brel phyis/ upa dh+wa'i 'ang ngos ring por bsgyur bas/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dī bya ti/ dī bya taḥ④/ dī byarnyi/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dri bya si/ dri bya thaḥ/ dī bya tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dī byā mi/ dī byā baḥ/ dī byā maḥ/ ling la/ ata las yā i yā 'os ya i ⑤yar bsgyur/ bra lnga dag dugi bal la dbyi ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dī byeta/ dī bye hūṃ/ dī bye yuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dī byeḥ/ dī bye hūṃ/ dī bye ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dī bye yo—/ dī bye ba/ dri bye ma/ loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dī bya tu/ dri bya tā ta/ dī bya tsā/ dī byan+tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la⑦/ dī bya/—sata las nyi 'os nyi phyis/ dī bya tāta/ dī bya tai/ dī bya ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/dī byā ni/ dī byā ⑧ba/ dī byā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a dī byata—/ a dī bya ⑨hūṃ/ a dī byan/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a dī byaḥ/a dī bya ⑩tsā/ a dī bya ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a dī bye/ a dī byā ba/a dī byā ma/ lung la/ bal dang po'i iṭa byen/ puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ a di bī ta/ a de biṣ+ṭi⑪/ a de bi 6ཿ/ sogs so/ /117—758

liṭa la byengs gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la / di de ba/ di di ba tuḥ/ di di buḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/di de bi tha/ di de ①ba thuḥ/ di di ba/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ di de ba/di di bi ba/ di di bi ma/ luṭa la/ iṭa byen pas/ de bi tā/ de bi tā se—/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ u pa dh+wa'i dze+e'ang ngos ring por bsgyur bas—/ dī byāta/ dī byā ṭ+wā/ dī byā suḥ/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ bal dang po'i iṭa dang / puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ de bi 6 ti/sogs dang / de bzhin du/ kṛng la/ a de bi ⑦6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ ṣi bu thags 'thag pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams 'dzug dhiste/cho ga thams cad bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra bas/ laṭa la/ sī bya ti/sogs dang / ling la/ sī byeta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ sī bya tu/sogs dang / lang la/ a sī byata/ sogs so/ /lung la/ bal dang po'i iṭa dang / puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ a se sge)bī ta/ a se bīspyarjo/ a se bi 6ཿ/ sogs so/ /liṭa la gnyis brjod pa sogs byas pas| skyes bu dang po gsum la/ se ṣe ba/ se ṣi ba tuḥ/ se ṣi buḥspyo/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ se ṣi bi tha/ si ṣi ba thuḥ/ se ṣi baḥ⑧/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ si ṣe ⑨ba/ si ṣi bi ba/ si ṣi bi ma/ luṭa la/iṭa dang yon tan byas pas/ se bi tā⑩/ se bi tā si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ u pa d+mā'i 'ang ngos ring por bsgyur bas/ sī byāta/ sī ⑪byātram̐/sī byā suḥ/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ bal dang po'i iṭa dang / puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ se bi byu ti/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/117—759

sogs sam/ tra su tu/ sogs so/ /lang la/ a tra sa ta/ sogs sam/a tra suta/ sogs so/ /lung la iṭa byin/ bad bradza sogs kyis 'phel ba byas pas/ a tā sī ta/ a tā ①sispya/ a tā se 6ཿ/ sogs so/ /liṭa la—/ ṇal gnyis ma yin pa rnams la/ dz+re bh+ra mu tra sa rnams kyis yang na 'os/a sgyu sa dbyi ba sogs yang na bar byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ta tā sa/ ta tra sa tuḥ/ tre sa tuḥ/ ta tra suḥ/ tre suḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ta tra si tha/ tre si tha/ ta tra sa thuḥ/ tre sa thuḥ/ ta tra sa/tre sa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ta tā sa/ ta tra sa/ ta tra se ba/ tre si ba/ ta tra se ma/ tre se ma/ luṭa la iṭa byin pas/ tra sitā/ tra si tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ tra snga ta/ tra sngatsū/ tra snga suḥ/sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ bal dang po'i iṭa byen pas/ tra se byu ti/ sogs dang / kṛng la/ a tra se 6ta/ sogs so/ /myu/ j-iṣa lang tsho nyams pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/byings kyi dṛta kyi ita 'os dzā ita/ ṛ'i aṇa las ra pha rol los/ dra/ u pa dh+wa'i 'ang ngos ring bor bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/ laṭa la/ dz+rer+yate/sogs dang / ling la/ dzīrleta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ dz+rer+ya tu/sogs dang / lang la/ a dz+rer+yata/ sogs so/ /lung la/ dz+re stasgru/mru tsu sogs kyis ṅgi ang du bsgyur ba dang setsar bsgyur ba yang na bar byas pas/ang gi phyogs la/ ṛ dṛ sha dag gi ang la yon tan nos yon tan byas pas/a dza ra ta/ a dza ra tsā/ a dza ran/ sogs so/ /setsa'i phyogs la/iṭa byin/ setsa la 'phel ba sogs kyis 'phel ba byas pas/ a dzā ṛta/117—761

a shā sīta/ a shā sīṣ+ṭi①/ a shā sī ②6ཿ/ sogs dang / setsa phyis pa'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a shāta/ a shā hūṃ/ a shuḥ/—āta las sos sna dzus/ tshig mtha' ma yin pa sogs kyis pha rol gyi gzugs/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a shāḥ/a shā lta/ a shā ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a shā(kye/ a shā ba/ a shā ma / liṭa la/ ṇal gnyis au/ iṭa las kyang āta kyi dbyi 'os/ āta dbyi ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ sha sho/ sha sha tuḥ—/ sha shuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ sha shi tha/ shā shā tha/ sha sha thuḥrka/ sha sha /skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sha sgo/ sha shi ba/ sha shi ma/luṭa la/ shā tā/ shā tā si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ shā yāta/shā yā.ā+oṃ/ shā yā suḥ/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ shā su nyi/ sogs dang /kṛng la/ a shā suta/ sogs so/ /༈ tsho gcod pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams 'jug cing cho ga thams cad sho dang 'dra ste/ laṭa la/ tshu ti/ sogs dang / ling la/ dz+reta/sogs so/ /loṭa la/ tshu tu/ sogs dang / lang la/ a tshuta/sogs so/ /lung la/ saka dang iṭa'i phyogs la/ a tsā sī ta/ a tsā seṣ+ṭi/a tsā si 6ཿ/ sogs dang / setsa phyis pa'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/a tsā ta/ a tsā hūṃ/ a tshuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a tsāḥ/ a tsā haṃ④/ a tsā ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a rmā/ a tsā ba/ a tsā ma/liṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tsa tsho/ tsa tsha dutuḥ/ tsa tshuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tsa tshi tha/ tsa tsā tha/ tsa tsha thuḥ/ tsa tsha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsa tsho/ tsa tshi ba/ tsa tshi ma/ luṭa la/ tsā tā/ tsā tā si/117—763

sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ tsā yāta/ tsā yā:/ tsā yā suḥ/ sogs so//mṛṭa la/ tsā snasu ti/ sogs dang / kṛng la/ a tsā su ta/ sogs so/ /myu/ kho mtha'i las la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ cho ga thams cad bshad ma thag pa gnyis dang 'dra bas/ laṭa la/ su ti/sogs dang / ling la/ phye ta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ gya tu/ sogs dang / lang la/ a gya ta/ sogs so/ /lung la/ saka dang iṭa byin pa'i phyogs la/ a sā sī ta/ a sā sespya/ a sā se 6ཿ/ sogs so/ /setsa phyis pa'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a sā ta/ a sā tsā/ a suḥ / skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a sāḥ/ a sā tai/ a sā ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a sī/ a sā ba/ a sā ma/ liṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ sa sau/ sa sa tuḥ/ sa suḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ sa se tha/ sa sā tha/ sa sa thuḥ/ sa sa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sa sau/sa se ba/ sa si ma/ luṭa la/ sā tā/ sā tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ling la e 'os/ er bsgyur bas/ se yā ta/ se yā༈/se yā suḥ/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ sā gya ti/ sogs dang / mṛng la/a sā gyata/ sogs so/ /myu/ do gcod pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ laṭa la/r+ya ti/ sogs dang / ling la/ byeta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ r+ya tu/sogs dang / lang la/ a r+ya ta/ sogs so/ /lung la/——lung la/ 'dir āta mtha' yin kyang / sa ka dang med mi 'jug gsung / gā ti s+thā/ ghu sogs kyis setsa dbyi ba kho na ste/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a dā ta/ a dā hūṃ/ a duḥ/ skyes bu 117—764

dbus ma gsum la/ a dāḥ/ a dā haṃ/ a dā ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/a dzā/ a dā ba/ a dā ma/ liṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ da do/da da tuḥ/ da duḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ da di tha/ da dā tha/ da da thuḥ/ da da/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ da do/ da di ba/ da di ma/luṭa la/ dā tā/ dā tā si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la ling la e ①'os—/ er bsgyur bas/ de yāta/ de yātsū/ de yā suḥ/ sogs so/ /dzaṭa la/ dā su ti/ sogs dang / kṛng la/ a dā su ta/ sogs so/ /༈ rā dha yang dag par grub pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams spyor te/laṭa la/ rā rgya ti/ sogs dang / ling la/ rā bye ta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ rā rgya tu②/ sogs dang / lang la/ a rā rgyata/ sogs so/ /lung la/ dzhal dang po rnams la/ dzhal las dzhal 'os setsa phyis/ khar la tsar sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ a rādhīta/ a rāhūṃ/ a rārluḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a rā—ཿ/ a rātrī/ a rāt+ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/a rāhūṃ/ a rāt+pa/ a rāt+tha/ rā rnyo hid+mā lnga/ rā dhi la 'tshe ba la'o rā dhi 'tshe ba'i don la 'jug pa na liṭa'i ṇal gnyis ma gtogs gzhan rnams pha rol la a sgyu snes dbyi ba dang / er bsgyur ba sogs yang na bar byed la/yang dag par grub pa'i don la ni mi dbyi'o/ /liṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ra rā dha/ ra rā dha tuḥ/ re dha tuḥ/ ra rā byuḥ/ re dhuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ra rā dhi tha/ re dhi tha/ ra rā dha duthuḥ/ re dha thuḥ/ ra rā dha—/ re dha⑤/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ra rā dha/ ra rā rnyi ba/ re rnyi ba/ra rā dhi ma/ re dhi ma/ luṭa la/ dzhaṣa sogs kyis ta dha/ dzhal sogs kyis 117—765

pu ṣa sogs byu ta sogs kyis ṅgi ang du bsgyur bas/ a mu ha ta/ a mu ha ྅/a mu ha na/ sogs so/ /liṭa la/ gnyis brjod pa sogs byas pas/skyes bu dang po gsum la/ mu mo ha/ mu mu ha tuḥ/ mu mu huḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ mu mo ①nyi tha/ mu mu ha thuḥ/ mu mu ha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ mu mo ha/ mu mu nyi ba/ mu mu nyi ma/ luṭa la/ ra dha la sogs pa rnams las kyang ngos/ iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ iṭa'i phyogs la/mo hi tā/ mo hi tā si/ sogs dang / iṭa med pa'i phyogs la/ dru ha/mu ha/ sngu ha/② ṣ+ṭi ha/ rnams kyis yang na'o/ /ha bye ru bsgyur ba dang gha ru bsgyur ba yang na bar byas pas/ rte'i phyogs la/ puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan/ dzha ṣa sogs kyis ta dha/ ṣa ṭu la ṣa ṭu 'os dha rte/ bhā las rte dbyi 'os rte gong ma phyis pas/ mo ṭ+wā/ mo bhā ①se/ sogs dang / ghar bsgyur ba'i phyogs la/ puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan/ dzhaṣa sogs kyis ta dha / dzhal sogs kyis gha gar bsgyur bas/ moṣ+ṭha/ modh+wa si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ mu khyuta/ mu t+yāste/ mu t+yā suḥ/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ra dha sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ iṭa'i phyogs la/ mo nyi 6 ti/sogs dang / iṭa med pa'i phyogs la/ ha rte dang gha yang na bar byed de/bhā'i phyogs la sa la ṣa bhā dag gi ka dang / gha'i phyogs la/ khar la tsar 'os/gha ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur bas sgrub ④tshul mi gcig kyang gzugs gcig pas/ mokhyu ti/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng la'ang a mo hi byu ta/ sogs sam/ a mo khyu ta/ sogs so/ /༈ ṇa sha mi mthong ba la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ laṭa la/117—772

sogs so/ /saṃ yastsa/ sam yas las kyang ngo / /nyer bsgyur sngon ma'i ya su las kyang shapa dang byun yang na bar bya ste/ saṃ ya sa ti/snyeyang dag par 'bad par byed/sogs sam/ saṃ ya su ti/—yang dag par 'bad par byed/ sogs so/ /lung la iṭa byen pas/ a yā sīta①/ a yā sespya/ a yā se 6ཿ/ sogs so/ /liṭa la/kita rnams la a sgyu sa dbyi ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la—/ ya yā sa/ ye sa tuḥ/ ye suḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ye si tha—/ ye sa thuḥ/ ye sa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ya yā sa/ ya ya sa/ye se ba/ ye si ma/ luṭa la/ iṭa byin pas/ ya se tā/ ya se tā se/ /sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ya sngata/ ya snga༈/ ya snga suḥ/ sogs so//phroṭa la/ bal dang po'i iṭa byin pas/ ya si 6 ti/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ mṛng la/ a ya si 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ lu bha chags pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ laṭa la/lu bh+ya ti/ sogs dang / ling la/ lu byeta/ sogs dang / loṭa la/lu bh+ya tu/ sogs dang / lang la/ a lu bh+yata/ sogs so/ /lung la iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ a lo ②bhāta/ a lo r+bhaspya/ a lo bhi 6ཿ/ sogs so—/ /liṭa la gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis ④skyes bu dang po gsum la/ lu lo bha④—/ lu lu bha tuḥ/ lu lu bhuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ lu lo bhi tha/lu lu bha thuḥ/ lu lu bha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ lu lo bha/ lu lu bhi ba/lu lu bhi ma/ luṭa la/ i 6/ sa ha lu bha sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar byas pas—/ lo bhi tā/ li rnyi tā si/ sogs sam/ iṭa med pa'i phyogs la/dzha ṣa rjosogs kyis ta dha/ dzhal sogs kyis bha bar bsgyur bas/ lod+dhā du/117—777

lod+dhā si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ lu sgyuta/ lu sgyuspyo/ lu sgyu suḥ/sogs so/ /mṛṭa la iṭa byin pas/ lo bhi byu ti/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/kṛng la/ a lo bhi 6ta/ sogs so/ /cha/ 1nyi mi dā gsher ba la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ mi dergu ṇa/ mi di'i yon tan no/ /nyi mi di'i 3snarkyen sha 'gro ba pha rol la yon tan du bsgyur te/ laṭa la/ me r+ya ti/ sogs dang / ling la/ me byeta/sogs so/ /loṭa la/ me r+ya tu/ sogs dang / lang la/ a me r+yata/sogs so/ /lung la/ pu ṣa sogs kyis ṅgi ang du bsgyur bas/ a mi data/a mi da tsā/ a mi dan sogs so/ /liṭa la gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ mi med/ mi mi da tuḥ/ mi mi duḥ / skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ mi me di tha/ mi me da thuḥ/ mi mi da/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ mi me da/ mi mi di pa/ mi mi di ma/ luṭa la/iṭa byin puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ me di tā/ me di tā se/sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ mi byā ta/ mi byāspyo/ mi byā jesuḥ/ sogs so / /liṭa la iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ me di t+pa ti/ sogs dang /de bzhin du/ mṛng la/ a me di 6ta/ sogs so/ /myu/ jung srog chags rab tu skye ba la'o zhes pa la tang rnams spyor 5te/byings kyi dang po'i sa ṣa/ di pa sogs kyis sh+yan sbyar bas/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ sru ya te/ sru ye te/ sru yarnye6/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ sru ya se/ sru ye the/ sru ya dhī/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sru ye / sru yā ba te/ sba yā ma te/ de bzhin du/ ling gi skyes bu dang po 117—778

gsum la/ sdod ye ta/snyematha' min pa sogs kyis sī yuṭa'i sa phyis a la yon tan/ sa/ ye yā tsā/sru ye ran/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ sru ye thāḥ/ sru ye yā shaṃ/ sru ye dz+nyā/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sru ye ya/ sru 1ye ba hi/ sru ye ma hi/ loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ sru ya tī/ sru ye tsā/ sru yadz+nyā/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ sru ya swa/ sru ye shaṃ/ sru ya bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/sru yi/ sru yā kyib hai/ sru yā rngum hai/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/a sru pya ya ta/ a sru ye tsā/ a sru yan+ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a sru ya thāḥ/ a sru ye tsā/ a sru ya dhī/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a sru ye 5 /a sru yā ba hi/ a sru yā ma hi/ lung la/ swa ra ti sru ti su ya ti sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar bya ste/ byings thams cad pa dang byings phyed 6pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ iṭa'i phyogs la/ a sa biṣ+ṭa/ a sa bi ṣā hūṃ/ a sa bi t+ya ta/ sogs dang / iṭa med pa'i phyogs kyi 7skyes bu dang po gsum la/a soṣ+ṭa/ a so ṣā tsā/ a so ṣa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a sojoḥ/a rnguso ṣā rde/ a so dz+nyākye / skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a so ṣi/ a so ṣa hi/a so ṣ+ṭha nyi/ liṭa la byings gnyis brjod/ atsa la sgo byings sogs kyi u bar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ su 6 be/su 6 bā te/ su 6 bi ⑩re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ su 6 bi ṣe/ su 6 bā the/ su 6 bidhī/ su 6 bi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ su 1nya6 be+e/su 6 bi ba te/ su 6 bi ma he/ luṭa la/ swa ra ti/ sru ti sru ya ti sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ sa bi /5tā/ sa bi tā se/ sogs sam/so tā/ so tā se/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ smon pa'i ling la/ iṭa 117—779

di dī yi ma he/ luṭa la/ m+bi nā ti/ mi no ti/ dīng rnams kyis l+yapa la'ang ngos āta du bsgyur bas/ dā tā/ dā tā se/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du—/ smon pa'i ling la/ dā sīṣ+ṭa/ dā sī yāspyo/ dā sbo ran/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la'ang m+bi nā ti sogs kyis āta du bsgyur bas/ dā su te/ sogs dang / mṛng la / a dā gya ta/ sogs so/ /myu/ dza ni rab tu skye ba snasnala'o zhes pa la'ang tang rnams 'jug ste/ dz+nyā dza no sbyo/ dz+nyā dzan dag gi dzā'/ /dz+nyā khong du chud pa dang / dzan skye ba dag gi rkyen sha 'gro ba'i ming can pha rol la dzā zhes par bsgyur bar bya ste/ dzan la/sh+yan—/ mdo 'dis dzār bsgyur bas/ laṭa la/ dzā ya te/ sogs dang /ling la/ dz+wa ye ta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ dzā ya hūṃ/ sogs dang /lang la/ a dzā ya ta/ sogs so/ /dza ni ba bye:/ dza ni ba bye dag gi 'ang ngo / /dza ni skye ba dang ba dhi dag gi ṅgi bsgyur ba'i tsiṇa dang kṛta sogs kyi rkyen nya 'gro ba rnams la u pa dh+wa 'phel bar bsgyur ba ma yin te/ dzan la lung sbyar ba'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ la ta/ dīpa dzan bu dha sogs kyis ṅgi/tsi ṇar bsgyur ba dang si tsar bsgyur ba yang na bar byas pas/ tsi ṇa'i phyogs la mdo 'dis 'phel ba mi byed/ tsiṇa las 'jig gos ta phyis/ a dza ni/setsa'i phyogs la iṭa byen pas/ a dza niṣ+ṭa/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/a dza ni ṣā hūṃ/ a dza ni ṣa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a dza nijoḥ/a dza ni ṣā tsā④/ a dza ni dz+nyā/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a dza ni ṣi/ a dza ni khya nyi/ a dza ni ṣ+ṭha nyi/ liṭa la/ gam han dzan sogs kyis u pa dh+wa phyis—/ sa tu'i sha tsu la sha tsu 'os/ na nyar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs 117—781

pas—/ dza sna/ dza dz+nyā te/ dza rnyire/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dza rnyi ṣe—/ dza dz+nyā the/ dza rnyi snye/ dza rnyi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dza dzhai/dza rnyi ba te/ dza rnyi ma he/ luṭa la iṭa byin pas/ dza ni tā/ dza ni tā se/sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ dza ni ྾ṣ+ṭa/ dza ni ྾ yā.ā+oṃ/ dza ni ྾ ran/sogs so/ /kṛṭa la'ang iṭa byin pas/ dza ni 6 te/ sogs dang / de bzhin du/ kṛng la'ang iṭa byin pas/ a dza ni 6 ta/ sogs so/ /༈ dī bī 'bar ba la'o zhes pa la'ang tang rnams sbyar te/ laṭa la/dī pya te/ sogs dang / leng la/ dī bye ta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/dī pya tsā/ sogs dang / lang la/ a dī pya ta/ sogs so/ /lung gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ dī pa dzan bu dha sogs kyis ṅgi tsi ṇar bsgyur ba dang si tsar bsgyur ba yang na bar byas pas/ a dī pi'am/ a dī piṣ+ṭa/gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ a dī pi ṣā tsā①/ a dī piṣa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a dī pijoḥ/ a dī pi ṣā tsā①/ a dī pi dz+nyā/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a dī pi ṣi/ a dī pi ṣ+ṭa hi/ a dī pi ṣ+ṭha nyi/ leṭa la gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ di dī pe/di dī pā te/ di dī pi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ di dī pi ṣe/ di dī pā the/ di dī pi bye/ di dī pi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ di dī pe/di dī pi ba te/ di dī pi ma he/ luṭa la iṭa byin pas/ dī pi tā/ dī pi tā se / sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ smon pa'i ling la/ dī pi ྾ṣ+ṭa/ dā pi ྾ yā (4ā+oṃ/ dī pi ྾ ran/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la'ang iṭa byin pas/ dī pi 6 te/ sogs dang / kṛng la/ a dī pi 6ta/ sogs so/ /117—782

༈ pū rī tshim pa la'o zhes pa la'ang tang rnams sbyor te/ laṭa la/pur+ya te/ sogs dang / leng la/ pūd+me ta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/pūr+ya hūṃ/ sogs dang / lang la/ a pūr+ya ta/ sogs so/ /lung gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ dī ba dzan bu dha sogs kyis ṅgi tsiṇa ①dang setsa yang na bar byas pas/ a pū ri/ a pū riṣ+ṭa/ lhag ma rnams la iṭa byen pas/a sgo ri ṣā hūṃ/ a pū ri ṣa ②ta/ sogs so/ /liṭa la gnyis brjod/thung ngu 'os thung ngur bsgyur bas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ pu pū re'-i/pu pū rā te/ pu sgo ri re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ pu pū ri ṣe/ pu pū rā the/ pu pū ④ri snye/ pu pū ri bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ pu sgo re/pu sgo ri ba he/ pu pū ri ma te/ luṭa la iṭa byin pas/ pū ri tā/ pū ri tā se⑤/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ pū ri ྾ṣ+ṭa( / pū ri ྾ yās+t+ri/ pū ri ྾ ran/ sogs so/ /thraṭa ⑦la/ sru (/ri 6 te/ sogs dang / kṛng la a ⑨pū ri byu ta/ sogs so/ /༈ pa da 'gro ba la'o zhes pa la'ang tang rnams sbyor te/ laṭa la/ pa bye ⑩te/ sogs dang / leng la/ ba bye ta(me/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/pa r+ya tsā/ sogs dang / lang la/ a pa r+ya ta/ sogs so/ /tsiṇa te pa daḥ—/ pad las ta la tsiṇa'o/ /pa da las lung gi la bsgyur ba'i tang gi gcig tshig ta pha rol la ṅgi tsiṇar bsgyur te/ pa da la/ lung la ta/ mdo 'dis ṅgi tsi ṇar bsgyur/ u pa jo'i 'ang ngos/ 'phel ba/ tsiṇa las 'jig gos ta phyis pas/ a pā di/ lhag ma rnams la/ dzhal dang po can la sitsa phyis/ khar la tsar sogs byas pas/ skyes bu dang po'i gnyis tshig dang 117—783

la sh+yan 'jug pa rnams la laṭa sogs sbyor tshul spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa rag ①pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //༈ da ni 6 nya la sogs pa rnams kyi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ 1 6 nya mngon par skye ba la'o zhes pa la laṭa sogs a tang dang tang gnyis ka 'gyur ro/ /swā di bh+yaḥshāḥ/ su la sogs pa rnams las shā'o/ /6nya mngon par skye ba sogs ni su la sogs pa ste/ de rnams las pha rol tu byed pa po'i don la shā 'gyur te/ 6 nya la shu/ sha shita kyi don byengs kyi dang po'i ṣa sa ④sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ laṭa'i a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/su no ti/snyebyings thams cad pa dang byings byed pa sogs kyis yon tan/ su nu taḥ/ su narnyi/snyehu ཿ dag gi byengs thams cad pa la'ang ngos u bar bsgyur/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ su no ṣi—/ su nu thaḥ/ su nu tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ su no mi/ su nu baḥ—/ su naḥ/—ba ma dag la 'di'i dbye ba'ang yang na 'os/ u dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba yang na bar byas/su nu maḥ/ su d+maḥ/ de bzhin du/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ su nu te—/ su nā te/ su na te①/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ su nu ṣe/ su nā the/ su nu dhī/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ su nī/ su nu ba he/ su nu ma te/ ling gi a tang la/ su nu yāta/ su nu yā hūṃ/ su nu yuḥ/ sogs dang / tang la mtha' ma yin pa sogs kyis sī yuṭa'i sa phyis/ hushā dag gi byings thams cad pa la 'os u bar bsgyur bas/ su rtswa ta/ su rtswa yā tsā/su rtswa ran/ sogs so/ /loṭa'i sa tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ su no tu—/ su nu tāta/ su nu hūṃ/ su nan+tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ su 117—787

nu—/ su nu tāta/ su nu haṃ/ su nu ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ su na bā niske/ su na bā ba/ sun bā ①ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ su nu tsā—/ su nā hūṃ/ su na tsā/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ su nu ṣ+ṭa/ su nā tsā—/ su nu dz+nyā/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ su na bai/ su na bā ba hai/ su na bā ma hai1/ lang gi a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a su nota/ a su nu hūṃ/ a su nan/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a su noḥ/ a su nu tai/a su nu ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a su na baṃ/ a su nu ba/ a su na—/ —ba ma sogs kyis yang na u phyis pa'o/ /a su nu ma/ a sud+ma/snyeb ma sogs kyis yang na u phyis pa'o/ /tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a su nu ta/ a su nā tsā/ a su na ta/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a su nu thāḥ/ a su nā tsā/ a su nu dhī/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a su —/ a su nu ba hi/ a su na hi①/ a su nu ma nyi—/ a sud+ma hi/ lung gi a tang la/ stu su byunya rnams la sogs kyis iṭa byinaske/ sitsa la 'phel ba sogs kyis 'phel ba byas pas/ a sā bīta/ a sā bispya/ a sā bi guḥ/ sogs dang / tang la/ ru du su nu sogs kyi lung 'dren gyis iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ iṭa byen pa'i phyogs la/ a sa biṣ+ṭa/a sa bi ṣā tsā/ a sa bi ṣa ta/ sogs dang / iṭa med pa'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a soṣ+ṭa/ a so ṣā hūṃ/ a so ṣa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a so joḥ/ a so ṣā shaṃ/ a so r+ghaṃ/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/a so ṣi/ a so ṣ+ṭa hi/ a soju nyi/ liṭa la gnyis brjod/ atsa dang po can rnams la/ atsa la shā byengs sogs kyis u bar bsgyur bas/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ su ṣā ba/ su 6 ba tuḥ/ su 6 buḥ/ skyes bu 117—788

kedabus ma gsum la/ su ṣa bi tha37/ su 6 ba thuḥ/ su 6 ba/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ su ṣā ba/ su ṣa ba/ su 6 bi ba/ su 6 bi ma/ de bzhin du/tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ su 6 be+e/ su 6 bā the/ su 6 bi re/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ su 6 bi ṣe/ su 6 bā the/ su 6 bi bye/ su 6 bi rnye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ su 6 be/ su 6 bi ba te/ su 6 bi ma te/luṭa la/ ru du su nu sogs kyi lung 'dren gyis iṭa yang na bar byas pas/a tang la/ sa bi tā/ sa bi tā se/ sogs sam/ so tā/ so tā si/sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ tang la/ sa bi tā/ sa bi tā se/ sogs sam/so tā/ so tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/ kṛta ma yin pa sogs kyis ring po byas pas/ sru yāta/ sru yā.ā+oṃ/ sru yā suḥ/ sogs dang / tang la/ ru du su sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ sa bi ྾ṣ+ṭa/sa bi ྾ yāspyo/ sa bi ྾ ran/ sogs sam/ so ྾ṣ+ṭa/ so ྾ yāspyo/ so ྾ ran / sogs so/ /mṛṭa la'ang a tang la/ sa bi 6 ti/ sogs som/so 6 ti/ sogs so/ /tang la/ sa pi 6 te/ sogs sam/ so 6 te/sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng gi a tang la/ a sa bi 6ta/ sogs sam/a so 6ta/ sogs so/ /tang la/ a sa bi 6ta/ sogs sam/ a so 6ta / sogs so/ /su no teḥsu sa noḥ/ su na ti'i su san dag la'o/ /nyer bsgyur sogs sa ṣar bsgyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can sngon du byung yang su no ti'i sa 5yig su dang san dag gi rkyen pha rol la ṣar bsgyur ba ma yin te/ bi sa mṛṭabi byu ti/ sogs so/ /myu/ ḍū minya rab tu 'phen pa la'o zhes pa la a tang dang tang gnyis ka 717—789

m+bi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ mi bye/ mi m+bi ba he/ mi m+bi ma he/ luṭa la| m+bi nā ti mi na ti dring sogs kyis i āta du bsgyur bas/ a tang la/mā tā/ mā tā se/ sogs dang / tang la/ mā ①tā/ mā tā se/ sogs sod / /smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/ m+bi nā ti sogs kyis i āta/ ling la e 'os/ ā er bsgyur bas/ me yāta/ me yāspyo/ me yā suḥ/ sogs so//tang la/ sde.i āta du bsgyur bas/ mā sīṣ+ṭa/ mā sī yāskṛ/ mā sī ran/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la'ang i āta du bsgyur bas a tang ①la/ mā dusu ti/ sogs dang / tang la/mā su te/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng gi a tang la/ a mā gyata/sogs dang / tang la/ a mā su ta/ sogs so/ /༈ tsinya ⑤gsog pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang dang tang gnyis ka sbyor te/laṭa'i a tang la/ tsi no ti/ sogs dang / tang la/ tsi nu dute/sogs so/ /ling gi a tang la/ tsi nu yāta/ sogs dang / tang la/ tsi rtswa ta/ sogs so/ /loṭa'i a tang la/ tsi no tu/ sogs dang / tang la/tsi nu hūṃ/ sogs so/ /lang gi a tang la/ a tsi nota/ sogs dang /tang la a tsi nu ta/ sogs so/ /lung gi a tang la⑦/ sitsa la 'phel ba sogs kyis 'phel ba byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a tsi ྾ta/ a tsispya / a tsi 6ཿ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a tsi ྾ཿ/ a tsiṣ+ṭi/ a tsiṣ+ṭa—/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a tsi ṣe/ a tsi ṣ+ṭa/ a tsi ṣ+ṭha/ tang la/byings thams cad pa dang byings phyed pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a tseṣ+ṭa/ a tse ṣā hūṃ/ a tse ṣa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a tse joḥ/ a tse ṣā shaṃ/ a tse snye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/117—791

a tse ṣi/ a tse ṣ+ṭa nyi/ a tse ṣ+ṭha hi/ bi bhā ṣā tseḥ/ ci'i 'dam ka'o/ /tsinya'i loṭa san pha rol la gnyis brjod pa'i tsa kar bsgyur ba dang mi bsgyur ba 'dam ka can du bya ste/ tsinya la liṭa sbyar/ tsa kar bsgyur ba'i phyogs kyi a tang gi/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tsi kā ya/ tsi kya tuḥ/ tsi kyuḥ/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tsi ke tha/ tsi ka yi tha/ tsi kya thuḥ/ tsi kya/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsi ka ya/ tsi ka ya/ tsi kyi ba/ tsi kyi ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tsi kye/ tsi kyā te/ tsi kyi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tsi kyi ṣe/ tsi kyā the/ tsi kyi dhe/ tsi kyi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsi kye/ tsi kyi ba he/ tsi kyi ma he/ sogs dang / tsa kar ma bsgyur ba'i phyogs kyi a tang la/ tsi tsā ya/ tsi tsu ①tuḥ/ tsi sgoḥ/ sogs dang / tang la/ tsi h+ye/ tsi tsā te/ tsi rtsu re/ sogs so/ /luṭa la byings thams cad pa dang byings phyed pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas a tang la/ tse tā/ tse tā se/ sogs dang / tang la/ tse tā/ tse tā se/sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/ kṛta ma yin pa sogs kyis ring por bsgyur bas/ ṭī yā ta/ ṭī yāṭ+wā/ ṭī yā suḥ/ sogs dang / tang la yon tan byas pas/ tse ྾ṣ+ṭa/ tse ྾ yās+t+ri/ tse ྾ ran/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la'ang yon tan byas pas/ a tang la/ tse byu ti/ sogs dang /tang la/ tse 6 te/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ mṛng gi a tang la/ a tse 6taske/ sogs dang / tang la/ a tse byu ta/ sogs so/ /༈ skṛnya kun nas 'gebs pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang dang tang gnyis ka 'jug ste/ laṭa'i a tang la/ sto kho ti/ sogs dang / tang la/ skṛ 117—792

a tang la/ ba ri tā/ ba ri tā se/ sogs sam/ ba rī tā/ ba rī tā si/sogs so/ /tang la/ ba ri tā/ ba ri tā se/ sogs sam/ ba rī tā/ba rī tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/ sha yaka /ling rnams la ring 'os/ ṛ ring du bsgyur bas/ thra yāta/ thra yā.ā+oṃ/ thra ①yā suḥ—/ sogs so/ /tang la/ ling sitsa dag gi ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da rnams ④la 'os/iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ ba ri ྾ṣ+ṭa/ pa ri ྾ yāshā①/ ba ri ྾ ran/sogs sam/ dṛ ྾ṣ+ṭa/ khru ྾ yā.ā+oṃ/ thra ྾ ran/ sogs so/ /thraṭa la/bri rīta las yang na 'os/ iṭa dang yīṭa yang na bar byas pas/ a tang la/ba ri 6 ti/ sogs sam/ ba rī 6 te/ sogs so/ /tang la/ ba ri 6 terka/ sogs sam/ pa rī 6 te/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ mṛng gi a tang la/ a ba ri 6ta0/ sogs sam/ a ba rī gyita/ sogs so/ /tang la/ a ba ri 6ta/ sogs sam/ a ba rī 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ dhunya 'gul ba la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang dang tang gnyis ka sbyor te/laṭa'i a tang la/ dhu no )/ sogs dang / tang la/ dhu nu te/ sogs so—/ /leng gi a tang la/ dhu nu yāta/ sogs dang / tang la/ dhu nī ta/sogs so/ /loṭa'i a tang la/ dhu no tu/ sogs dang / tang la/ byu nu tsā—/ sogs so/ /lang gi a tang la/ a dhu nota/ sogs dang / tang la—/ a byu nu ta/ sogs so/ /lung gi a tang la/ stu su dhunya rnams las pa rasmi pa da rnams la 'os/ iṭa byin/ sitsa la 'phel ba sogs kyis 'phel ba byas pas/ a dh+wa bīta/ a dh+wa bi྾/ a dh+wa bi 6ཿ/ sogs dang /tang la/ swa ra ti sru ti sru ya ti dhūnya spruta ⑤'gro ba sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar 117—796

byas pas/ iṭa'i phyogs la/ a dha biṣ+ṭa/ a dha bī ①ṣā hūṃ/ a dha bi ṣa ta/sogs dang / iṭa med pa'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a byeṣ+ṭa/a dhe ṣā tsā/ a bho ṣa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a dhojoḥ/ a dho ṣ+ṭha shaṃ/ a dho dz+nyā/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a dho ṣi/ a dho ṣ+ṭa hi/ a sgoṣ+ṭha hi/ liṭa la/ gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis ④bsgrubs pas/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ du jo ba/ du dhu ba tuḥ/ du dhu buḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ du dhe tha/ du dha bi tha/ du dhu ba thuḥ/ du dhu ba/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ du dh+wa ba/ du dha ba/ du dhu bi ba/ du dhu ④bi ma/tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ du dhu be/ du dhu bā te/ du dhu bi re/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ du byu bi ṣe/ du dhu bā the/ du dhu bi dhī/ du dhu bi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ du dhu be/ du dhu bi ba he/ du dhu bi ma he/lu ṭa la/ swa re rjoti/ sru ti sru ya ti dhūnya spruta 'gro ba sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ a tang la/ dha bi tā/ dha bi tā si/ sogs sam/ dho tā/bye tā si/ sogs so/ /tang la/ dha bi tā/ dha bi tā se/ sogs sam/bye tā/ bye tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/ kṛta ma yin pa sogs kyis ring por bsgyur bas/ dhū yāta/ byu yā.ā+oṃ/ dhū yā suḥsogs so/ /tang la/ swa ra ti sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ dha bi ྾ṣ+ṭa/ dha bi ྾ yāspyo/ dha bi ྾ ⑤ran/ sogs sam/ dho ྾ṣ+ṭa/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la'ang iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ a tang la/ dha rjobi gyi ti/ sogs sam/sgo ⑦྾ ti/ sogs so/ /tang la/ dha bi 6 te/ sogs sam/ dho 6 te/sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng gi a tang la/ a dha bi byu ta/ sogs sam/117—797

a sgo byu ta/ sogs so/ /tang la/ a dha bi 6ta/ sogs sam/ a sgo byu ta/ sogs so/ /༈ hi 'gro ba la ste ①'phel ba la'ang ngo zhes pa la a tang rnams sbyor te/laṭa la/ hi no ti/ sogs dang / ling la/ te nu yāta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ hi no tu/ sogs dang / lang la/ a nyi no ta/ sogs so/ /hi nu m+bi nā/ he nu m+bi nā dag gi'o/ /hi 'gro ba las pha rol gyi shā'i na dang /m+binya 'tshe ba las pha rol gyi shā'i na yig ni nyer bsgyur na ṇar bsgyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can sngon du byung na ṇa yig tu bsgyur bar bya ste/ pra nyi kho ti/snyerab tu 'gro bar byed dam rab tu 'phel bar byed/ sogs so/ /lung la/ si tsa la 'phel ba pa rasmi pa da rnams la 'os 'phel ba byas ④pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a hai ྾ ta—/ a haiṣ+ṭi/ a hai 6ཿ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a tai ྾ཿ/ a haiṣ+ṭi—/ a haiṣ+ṭa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a hai ṣe/ a hai ṣ+ṭa/ a hai ṣ+ṭha/te ra tsa ji / ha'i tsang ma yin pa la'o/ /tsang ma yin pa'i rkyen byings gnyis brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan can pha rol la hi 'gro ba'i ha phyi ma ni gha yig tu bsgyur bar bya ste/ nyi la leṭa byings gnyis brjod ku ha dag gi tsu 'os ①a sgyu sa'i ha dzha/a sgyu sa'i tsar 'ang ngos dzha dza/ mdo 'dis ha phyi ma ghar bsgyur bas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dzi ghā ya/ dzi rgya tuḥ/ dzi sgyuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dzi bhe tha/ dzi gha yi tha/ dzi gya thuḥ/ dza gya/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dzi ghā ya/ dzi rgyu ba/ dzi phyi ma/ luṭa la yon tan byas pas/te tā/ he tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la kṛta ma yin pa sogs kyis ring por bsgyur bas/ ṭī yāta/ ṭī yā spyo/ hi yā suḥ/ sogs dang / mṛṭa la 117——798

—byings thams cad pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ hi 6 ti/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng la/ a he 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ kṛ bi 'tshe ba la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ byem+bi kṛ rjo ra tsa/ dhim+bi kṛ ṇi dag gi a'ang ngo / /dhi bi srog kṛ bi 'tshe ba dag las byed pa po'i don gyi tso'i yul la u 'gyur zhing u pha rol la de gnyis kyi mtha'i ba yig kyang a yig tu bsgyur bar bya ste/ kṛ bi la u ita 'gro ba'i byengs la num 'os/num ā ga ma/ ma gnas don u brjod don/ mdo 'dis ba ar bsgyur/ata kyi dbyi 'os a phyis/ num gyi na u la drangs pas/ kṛ rku 4)zhes pa grub la/laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ laṭa la/ kṛ kho ti sogs dang / ling la/ kṛ rku yāta—/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ kṛ kho tu/ sogs dang / lang la/ a ①kṛ khota sogs te cho ga thams cad shā'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /lung la bal dang po'i iṭa byen/ iṭa 'gro ba'i byings la num 'os/ num ā ga ma byin pas/a kṛ hā ta/ a kṛ be+eṣ+ṭi/ a kṛ ṇi 6ཿ/ sogs so/ /liṭa la'ang num byin gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tsa kṛ ṇa—/ tsa kṛ ṇa tuḥtsa kṛ rtsuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tsa kṛ ṇi tha/tsa kṛ ṇa thuḥ/ tsa kṛ ṇa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsa kṛ ṇa/ tsa kṛ tri ba/tsa kṛ ṇi ma/ luṭa la/ num dang iṭa byin pas/ kṛ ṇi tā/ kṛ ṇi tā se/sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la num byen pas/ kṛ rkyuta/ kṛ dhe.ā+oṃ/ kṛ sgo suḥ—/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ kṛ ṇi 6 ti/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ mṛng la'ang / a kṛ ṇi 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ bye bi srog ①la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ dhi be+e 4/117—799

kṛ ṇi dag gi a'ang ngos/ shā'i yul la ubra a/ ita 'gro ba'i byings la num 'os—/ num ā ga ma/ ata kyi dbyi 'os a phyis pas/ bye nu zhes grub pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ laṭa la/ dhi no ti/ sogs dang / leng la/ dhi nu yāta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ dhi no tu/ sogs dang / lang la/ a dhi nota/ sogs so/ /lung la/ num dang iṭa byin pas/ a dhi rtswa ta/a bye nīṣ+ṭi①/ a dhi rtswa 6ཿ/ sogs so/ /leṭa la/ num byin gnyis brjod pa sogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ di dhi na/ di dhi rwa tuḥ/ di dhi nuḥ/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ di dhi nī tha/ di dhi rwa thuḥ/ di dhi na/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ di dhi na/ di dhi — ba/ di dhi ā+oṃ ma/ luṭa la/ bye nī tā/ dhi nī tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ dhi rgyuta/ dhi rgyu ā+oṃ/bye n+d+ra suḥ/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ bye blu byu ti/ sogs dang / mṛng la/a bye — 6 ta/ sogs so/ /༈ dbyu ngan g.yo ba la'o zhes ④pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ i tra 'gro ba ma yin pa sogs kyis na phyis pas/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/da sgo ti/ da byu taḥ/ da zla brnyi/—atsu la shu byings sogs kyi u brnga bsgyur/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dasgo ṣi/ da byu thaḥ/ da zla tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la—/ da sgo mi/ da byu baḥ/ da byu maḥ/ ling la/ da byu yāta/ da byu yā ྅/ da byu yuḥ/ sogs so/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ da sgo tu/da zla tāta/ da khyu tsā/ da khyu ban+tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ da zla hi/da zla tāta/ da byu tai/ da zla ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dasna bā ni/da sna bā ba/ da sna bā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a da sdota/117—800

༈ a shung khyab pa la'o zhes pa la tang rnams 'jug ste/ atsa dang po rnams la atsa la shā byings sogs kyis u bar bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/ laṭa'i/skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a sgo te/ a shā bā te/ a shā ba te/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a shā ṣe①/ a snu bā the/ a shā dhī/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a shā be/ a snu ba te/ a shā ma he/ ling la mtha' ma yin pa sogs kyis sa phyis u bar bsgyur bas/ a shā bī ta/ a shā bī yā tsā/ a shā bī ran/ sogs so/ /loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a shā tsā/ a shā bā tsā9/ a shā ba tsā/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a shā ṣ+ṭa/ a shā bā the/a shā dz+nyā/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a shā bai①/ a shā bā ba hai/ a shā bā ma hai/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ā shā ta/ ā shā bā tsā/ ā shā ba ta—/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ā shā thāḥ/ ā shā bā tsā/ ā shā dhī/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ā sgo baṃ/ ā shā ba hi/ ā shā ma hi/ lung la spruta 'gro ba sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ iṭa'i phyogs la/ ā shiṣ+ṭa/ā shi ṣā ྅/ ā shi ṣa ta/ sogs so/ /iṭa med pa'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ dzhal las dzhal la 'os setsa phyis/ brabyu blusnga ⑦sogs kyis sha ṣa/ ṣa ṭu la ṣa ṭu 'os/ ta ṭar bsgyur bas/ āṣ+ṭa/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ bra: bh+rasnga sogs kyis sha ṣa/ sa la ṣa bhā dag gi ka 'os ṣaka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur bas/ ā k+ṣu tsā/ ā k+ṣa ta/ de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu 3 dbus ma gsum la/ ājoḥ/ājo tsā( pe/ ā dz+wa⑦/—dzhal sogs kyis ṣa ḍa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ā k+ṣi/ā k+ṣu hi/ āgh+ra (/hi/ asgo testsa/ asgo ti'i 'ang ngo / /asgo ti'i 'ang 117—802

— —— — /de—/de— — —liṭa pha rol la byings gnyis brjod pa'i dang po'i ata kyi 'os a sgyu sa ring por bsgyur ba'i pha rol tu nuta ā ga ma 'gyur te/ a shu la/ liṭa/ byings gnyis brjod/ dang po'i ata kyi 'os ring por bsgyur/ mdo 'dis nuṭa ā ga ma byin ṭa gnas don u brjod don drangs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la—/ ā na she/ ā na shā te/ ā na shi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ā na shi ṣe/ ā nak+ṣe/ ā na shā the/ ā 1na shi bye/ ā na shi bye/ ā na r+bhe/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ā na she/ ā na shi ba te/ ā na shwa he/ ā na shi ma te/ ā na thra te/ luṭa la iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ a shi tā/a shi tā se/ sogs sam/ aṣ+ṭa/ aṣ+ṭa se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la—/ iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ a shi ྾ṣ+ṭa/ a shi bhā yā.ā+oṃ/ a shi ྾ ran—/ sogs sam/ iṭa med pa'i phyogs la/ brabya bh+rasnga sogs kyis sha ṣa/sa la ṣa bhā dag gi ka 'os ṣa ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur bas—/ a spyiṣ+ṭi na/ a spyi yā spyo/ a khye ran/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la'ang a shi 6 te/ sogs sam/ ak+ṣu te/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ mṛng la/ā shi 6 ta/ sogs sam/ āk+ṣuta/ sogs so/ /i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gya sru tārwa da yaḥs mābhāḥzhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las su la sogs pa rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyi brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las/ su la sogs pa byed pa po'i don gyi shapa kyi yul la shā 'jug pa rnams kyi cho ga spyir btang dmigs bsal dang (77 803

bcas pa rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// // ༈ da ni tud la sogs pa rnams kyi ①cho ga rnams bshad par bya ste/༈ tud gzir ba la'o zhes pa la laṭa sogs a tang dang tang gnyis ka 'jug ste/ tu dā di bh+yaḥshaḥ/ tud la sogs pa rnams las sha'o/ /byings tud la sogs pa rnams las pha rol tu shapra kyi yul la sha 'gyur te/ sha shita kyi don no/ /laṭa'i a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tu da ti/ tu da taḥ/tu darnyi/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tu da ṅga/ tu da thaḥ/ tu da tha/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tu dā mi/ tu dā baḥ/ tu dā maḥ/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tu da te/ tu de te/ tu darnye/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/tu da se/ tu de the/ tud dhe/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tu da②/ tu dā ba he/ tu dā ma he/ ling gi a tang la/ ata las yā i phra 'os yā suṭa'i yā i lngar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tu de ta—/ tu de hūṃ/ tu de yuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tu deḥ/ tu de tai①—/ tu de ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tu de yo/ tu de ba/ tu de ma/tang la mtha' min pa ④sogs kyis sra phyis pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/tu de ta/ tu de yā hūṃ/ tu de ran⑤/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tu de thāḥ—/ tu de ā+o shaṃ/ tu de d+dhā/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tu de ya/ tu de ba hi/ tu de ma hi/ loṭa'i a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tu da tu/tu da tāta/ tu da tī/ tu dan+tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tu da/ tu da tāta/ tu da haṃ/ tu da ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tu dā ni/ tu dā 117—804

ba—/ tu dā ma/ laṭa'i ①tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tu da hūṃ/ tu de hūṃ/ tu da:/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tud swa/ tu de tsā/ tu da dhī—/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tu de/ tu dā ba hai/ tu dā ma hai/ lang gi a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a tu data/ a tu da hūṃ/ a tu da dz+wa②/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a tu daḥ/ a tu da tai①/ a tu da ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a tu rda/ a tu dā ba/ a tu dā ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a tu data/ a tu de hūṃ/ a tu darnya/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a tu da thāḥ/ a tu de r+ghaṃ/ a tu da r+ghaṃ/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a tu de/ a tu dā ba hi/ a tu dā ma hi/ lung gi a tang la/bad bradza sogs kyis 'phel ba/ dzhal dang po rnams la/ dzhal las dzhal la 'os—/ setsa phyis/ khar la tsar 'os da tar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas—/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a todhīta/ a tohūṃ/ a tokhruḥ/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a totrīḥ/ a tor+ghaṃ/ a tot+ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a tohūṃ/ a tot+pa/ a tot+tha/ de bzhin du/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a tut+ta/ a tuṣ+ṭha hūṃ/ a rjotut+pa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a tus+thāḥ/ a tuṣ+ṭha shaṃ/ a tuhūṃ/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/a tu྾/ a tut+ta hi/ a tut+tha ⑤hi/ liṭa la gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum labu/ tu to da/ tu tu da tuḥ / tu tu duḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tu to di ⑦tha/ tu tot+tha/tu tu da thuḥ/ tu tu da/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tu to ④da/ tu tu da/tu tu di ba/ tu tu di ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tu tu de/ tu 117—805

la—/ dzhal 1dang po rnams la/ dzhal las dzhal la 'os setsa dbye/ gzhan rnams la tsu'i ku 'os④/ tsa ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyi ①sa ṣar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a muk+ta/a mugla tsā/ a muk+ṣa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a mus+thāḥ/ a muk+ṣu shaṃ / a muhūṃ/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a mukhri/ a muk+ṣu hi/ a mugla hi—/ liṭa la gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ mu mo tsa/ mu mu tsa tuḥ/ mu mu tsuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ mu mo tsa tha/ mu mot+tha/ mu mu tsa thuḥ/ mu mu tsa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ mu mo ④tsa/ mu mu tsi ba/ mu mu tsi ma/ de bzhin du tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ mu mu tse/ mu mu tsā te⑤/ mu mu tsi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ mu mu tsi ṣe/ mu mu tsā the/ mu mu tsi dhī/ mu mu tsi bye/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ myu mu tse/ mu mu tsi ba te/ mu mu tsi ma te/ luṭa la tsu'i ku 'os tsa kar bsgyur puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan byas pas a tang la/ molnga/ moklu se/ sogs dang / tang la/ moklu/ molnga se/sogs so/ /smon pa'i leng gi a tang la/ tsa 'dren pa kho na ste/ mu dz+nyā ta/mu tsā ā+oṃ/ mu tsā suḥ/ sogs dang / tang la tsu'i ku 'os/ tsa kar bsgyur kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur bas/ mospyiṣ+ṭa/ mok+ṣi yā buspyo/mo k+ṣu ran/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du kṛṭa'i a tang la/ mok+ṣu ti/ sogs dang / tang la/ mogh+ra te/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la'ang a tang la/ a mogh+ra ta—/ sogs dang / tang la/ a mokhyu ta/ sogs so/ /༈ li pa byug pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang dang tang gnyis ka 'jug ste/117—810

mutsa la sogs pa rnams kyi sha la 'os/ num ā ga ma byin pas/ laṭa'i a tang la/ lispa ti/ sogs dang / tang la/ lidza te/ sogs so/ /ling gi a tang la/ lispe ta/ sogs dang / tang la/ lispe ta/ sogs so—/ /lo ṭa'i a tang la/ lilnga tu/ sogs dang / tang la/ lidza tsā/sogs so/ /lang gi a tang la/ a lidza ta/ sogs dang / tang la/ a lidza ta/ sogs so/ /lung gi a tang la/ li pi se tsi dh+wa las kyang ngos/ṅgi ang du bsgyur bas/ a le pa ta/ a le pa hūṃ/ sa li pa na/ sogs dang / tang la/ ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da rnams la yang na 'os/ ṅgi ang du bsgyur ba dang setsar bsgyur ba yang na bar byas pas/ ang gi phyogs la/ a li pa ta/a li pe tsā/ a li parnya/ sogs dang / sitsa'i phyogs la/ dzhal dang po rnams la/ dzhal las dzhal la 'os/ setsa dbyi ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a lip+ta/ a lisgyu hūṃ/ a libe+e ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a lithoḥ/ a liju tsā/ a lir+ghaṃ/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a lispru/ a ligrwa hi/ a liza hi/ liṭa la gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ li le pa/ li li pa tuḥ/li li puḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ le le pi tha/ li lebe+e/ le li pa thuḥ—/ li li pa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ le le pa/ li li pi ba le li pi ma/ de bzhin du/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ le li pe le li pā te/ li li pi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ li le pi ṣe/ li li pā the/li li pi dhī/ li le pi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ le li pe li li pi ba te—/ li le pi ma te/ luṭa la/ puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/117—811

a segla hi/ liṭa la gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la—/ se ṣe tsa/ se ṣi tsa tuḥ/ se ṣi tsuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/si ṣe tsi tha/ se ṣen+d+ra①/ se ṣe tsa thuḥ/ se ṣi tsa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/si ṣi tsa/ si ṣe tsi ba/ si ṣe tsi ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ si ṣi tse/ se ṣi tsā te/ si ṣi tsi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ se ṣi tsi ṣe/si ṣi tsā the/ si ṣi tsi dhī/ se ṣi tsi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ se ṣi ②tse/si ṣi tsi ba te/ ṅga ṣi tsi ma he/ luṭa la/ tsu'i ku/ puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ a tang la/ selnga/ selnga si/ sogs dang /tang la/ selnga/ selnga se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/ se stota—/ si tsā :/ se tsā suḥ/ sogs dang / tang la/ puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan/ tsu'i ku 'os/ tsu kra/ kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ sekhyeṣ+ṭa/ sespyi yā shrī/ sek+ṣi ran/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛṭa'i a tang la/ sekhyu ti/ sogs dang / tang la/ sekhyu te/sogs so/ /mṛng la'ang de bzhin du bsgrubs pas/ a tang la/ sa ①sekhyu ta/sogs dang / tang la/ a sek+ṣu ta/ sogs so/ /༈ kṛ tī gcod pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ mutsa la sogs pa rnams kyis sha la 'os num ā ga ma byin pas/ laṭa la/ kṛrnya ti/sogs dang / mṛng la/ kṛdhe ta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ kṛn+ta tu/sogs dang / lang la/ a kṛn+tata/ sogs so/ /lung la bal dang po'i iṭa—/ puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ a karte ta/ a kartiṣ+ṭi④/a karti 6ཿ⑤/ sogs so/ /liṭa la gnyis brjod/ ku ha dag gi tsu 'os/117—813

ka tsa/ ṛta kyi ata 'os ṛ ata du bsgyur ba sogs kyis skyes bu dang po gsum la tsa karta/ tsa kṛ ta tuḥ/ tsa kṛ tuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tsa karti tha/ tsa kṛ ta thuḥ/ tsa kṛ ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsa karta/ tsa kṛ ti ba/ tsa kṛ ti ma/ luṭa la iṭa byin/ yon tan byas pas/ karti tā/karti tā si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ kṛ t+yāta/ kṛt+yā ā+oṃ/ kṛ t+yā suḥ—/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la①/ kṛta/ dz+ra ta/ zo ta/ tro da/ dṛta rnams kyis setsa ma yin pa'i sa la 'os iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ karti rngu ti/sogs sam/ kargya ti/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng la/ a karti 6ta—/ sogs sam/ a kah+phu ta/ sogs so/ /༈ ju de da pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams 'jug ste/ byings kyi dang po'i ṣa'i sa 'os/ ṣa sa/ atsa la shā byings sogs kyis u bar bsgyur bas—/ laṭa la/ su ba ti/ sogs dang / ling la/ su be ta/sogs so/ /loṭa la/ su ba tu/ sogs dang / lang la/ a su ba ta/sogs so/ /lung la/ bal dang po'i iṭa byin/ si tsa la 'phel ba pa rasmi pa da rnams la 'os ①'phel ba byas pas/ a sā bī ta/ a sā biṣ+ṭi/ a sā bi 6ཿ/ sogs so/ /liṭa la gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis skyes bu dang po gsum la/ su ṣā ba/ su 6 ba tuḥ/ su 6 buḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la—/ su ṣa bi tha/ su 6 ba thuḥ/ su 6 ba/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/su ṣā ba1/ su ṣa ④ba/ su 6 be+e ba/ su 6 bi ma/ luṭa la iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ sa bi tā/ sa bi tā si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i leng la sru yāta—/ sru yā.ā+oṃ/ sru yā suḥ/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ bal dang po'i iṭa 117—814

'os—/ iṭa dang yīṭa yang na bar byas/ byings thams cad pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ ka ri byu ti/ sogs sam/ ka rī 6 ti/sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng la/ a rka ri 6 ta/ sogs sam/ a ka rī 6 ta/ sogs so/ /ki ra to la ba ṣ+pe/ ki ra ti la gcod par byed pa la'o/ /nyer bsgyur u pa las pha rol rmi ki ra ti la gcod par byed pa'i don la suṭa ā ga ma 'gyur te/ u pa ni ra ti/snyenye bar gcod par byed/ aḍa sgyu sa bya bā ye3pi/aṭa a sgyu sa dag bar na yod kyang ngo / /u pa las pha rol gyi ki ra ti la aṭa ā ga ma dang a sgyu sa bar na yod kyang ka'i sngon du suṭa ā ga ma 'gyur te/ aṭa bar na yod pa la/ —langa.upāni rata/—nye b.ragacod par byed/ a sgyu sa bar na yod pa la/ snyeliṭa.upa tsaska ra/snyenyebar gcod/ lta bu'o/ /nyid+mā yī pra testsa/ 'tshe ba la/pra ti las kyang ngo / /1 'tshe ba'i don la 'jug pa na upa dang pra ti ①pha rol las kyang suṭa ā ga ma 'gyur te/ u pa snyi ra ti/snyenye bar 'tshe bar byed/ pra ti ni ra ti/snyeso sor 'tshe bar byed/ sogs so/ /༈ 1 gsal bar byed pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ a tsi pi bhā ṣā/ a tsa la gdam nga'o/ /rkyen a tsa dang po can pha rol la kṛ'i dra ②yig lnga ④yig tu bsgyur ba dang / ra nyid du gnas pa 'dam ka can du bya ste/shrī la sha /byings kyi dzāta kyi ita 'os/ dzā ita/ ṛ'i aṇa las ra pha rol los dra byin/ mdo 'dis lar bsgyur ba dang mi bsgyur ba 'dam ka can du byas pas—/ laṭa la/ gi ra ti/ sogs sam/ gi la ti/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ leng la/ gi re ta/ sogs sam/ gi le ta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ gi ra tu/ sogs sam/ gi la tu/ sogs so/ /lang la/ a 117—818

sogs kyi jita yin pas/ jita pha rol la gra nyi dz+nyā sogs kyis saṃ pra sā ra ṇa byas pasaske/ bi ṭīta/ bi tsispya/ bi tsi 6ཿ/ sogs so/ /liṭa la/ byings gnyis brjod/ ṇal gnyis la/ gnyis rnams kyi sogs kyis a sgyu sa ①saṃ pra sā ra ṇar bsgyur/ gzhan rnams la gra hi dz+nyā sogs kyis gnyis ka saṃ pra sā ra ṇa byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ pi byā tsa/ be+e bi tsa tuḥ/ be+e be+e tsuḥ/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bi bi tsi thu④/ bi bi tsa tha①ཿ/ bi bi tsuḥ/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bi byā tsa/ bi bya tsa/ bi bi tsi ba bi bi tsi ma/luṭa la iṭa byen/ gāng kuṭa sogs kyis jita yin pas/ jita pha rol la gra hi dz+nyā sogs kyis saṃ pra sā ra ṇa byas pas/ bi tsi tā/ bi tsi tā si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ gra nyi dz+nyā sogs kyis saṃ pra sā ra ṇa byas pas/ be+e tsāta/bi tsā.ā+oṃ/ bi tsā suḥ/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la bal dang po'i iṭa byin/ gāng kuṭa sogs kyis jita yin pas/ jita pha rol la gra hi dz+nyā sogs kyis saṃ pra sā ra ṇa byas pas/ bi tsi 6 ti/ sogs dang / de bzhin du/ kṛng la/ a bi tsi 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ tru ṭa rnam par gcod pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ dz+nyā sha zla sha klu ④mu kra mu tra si tru ṭi la ṣa las yang na 'os/ sha dang sh+yan yang na bar byas pas/ la ṭa la/ truṭa ti/ sogs sam/ tru rgya ti/sogs so/ /ling la/ tru ṭita/ sogs sam/ tru bye ta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ tru ṭa tu/ sogs sam/ tru rgya tu/ sogs so/ /lang la/ a tru ṭata/ sogs sam/ a tru bye ta/ sogs so/ /lung la/ grung ⑤kuṭa sogs kyis yon tan dang 'phel ba sogs mi byed/ iṭa byin pas/ a tru ṭī 117—830

a sgra ra ta/ sogs so/ /spru ra ti sbu la rkyo rno sna bi bh+yaḥ/ nir ni bi rnams las sgu ra ti sgru la ti dag gi'o/ /nyer bsgyur ni ra dang ni dang bi rnams las pha rol gyi sgu ra nyi dang sbu la nyi dag gi sa yig ni ṣa yig tu yang na bsgyur te/ niḥspru ra ti/ nisprur ti/ ni glu ra ti/ nispru ra ti/ bi gra ra ti/ bispru ra ti/niḥh+phu la ti/ nispru la ti/ sogs so/ /༈ sgu la kun nas sogs pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/smon pa'i leng gi skabs su ring po mi byed pa tsam ma gtogs cho ga thams cad spu ra dang 'dra ste/ sgu la ti/ sogs so/ /༈ ḍū bstod pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ ṇa'i na 'os ṇa na—/ a tsa la sgo byengs sogs kyis u bar bsgyur bas/ laṭa la/ nu ba ti—/ sogs dang / ling la/ nu be ta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/nu ba tu/ sogs dang / lang la/ a nu ba ta/ sogs so/ /lung la/ iṭa byin/ gāng kuṭa sogs kyis yon tan dang 'phel ①ba sogs mi byed/ a tsa la shā byings sogs kyis u bar bsgyur bas/a nu bī ta/ a nu biṣ+ṭi/ a nu bi 6ཿ/ sogs so/ /liṭa la/ gnyis brjod ṇal gnyis la 'phel ba dang / gzhan rnams la u bar bsgyur bas skyes bu dang po gsum la/ nu nā ba①/ nu nu ba tuḥ/ nu nu buḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ nu nu bi tha/ nu nu ba thuḥ/ nu nu ba/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ nu nā ba/ nu na ba/ nu nu bi ba/ nu nu bi ma/ luṭa la iṭa byin—/ gāng ④kuṭa sogs kyis yon tan mi byed/ atsa la shā byings sogs kyis u bar bsgyur bas/ nu bi tā/ nu bi tā si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i 117—832

ling la/ nu yāta/ byu yā ṣ+ṭi/ byu yā suḥ/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la iṭa byin/gāng kuṭa sogs kyis yon tan mi byed/ a tsal shā byings sogs kyis u bar bsgyur bas/ nu bi 6 ti/ sogs dang / de bzhin du/ mṛng la/ a nu bi 6ta/ sogs so/ /myu/ mṛng srog gtong ba la'o/ /mṛ 1ya te rlung la dobya/ mṛ sneya ti las lung ling dag gi'ang ngo / /mṛ /ya ta —las rkyen sha 'gro ba'i mtha' dang lung dang smon pa'i ling 'ang ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da rnams spyor zhing gzhan rnams kyi pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyor te/ mṛng 5la sha /sha ya ka hūṃling rnams la ring 'os ṛ ring du bsgyur / atsa la shu byings sogs kyis i yar bsgyur bas/ laṭa la/ mri 7ya te/ sogs dang / ling la/ mri ya ta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ mri ya tsā/ sogs dang / lang la/ a mri ya ta/ sogs so/ /lung la/dzhal dang po rnams la gzugs thung ngu las sos/ setsa dbyi ba sogs byas pas/skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a spyo ta/ a mṛ ṣā tsā/ a mṛ ṣa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a mṛ thāḥ/ a mṛ ṣā tsā/ a mṛ bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a mṛ ṣi/ a mṛ ṣ+ṭa hi/ a mṛṣ+ṭha hi/ sogs so/ /liṭa'i a tang rnams sbyor te/ gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ma mā ra9/ ma mra tuḥ/ ma mruḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ma ma ri tha/ ma marja/ ma mra thuḥ/ ma mra/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ma mā ra / ma ma ra/ ma mṛ ba/ ma mṛ ma/ luṭa'i 'ang a tang rnams spyor te/byings thams cad pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ maṭ+wā/ maṭ+wā se/sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling gi mri ya ti las lung ling dag gi 'ang ngos tang 117—833

rnams sbyor te/ mṛ ྾ṣ+ṭa/ mṛ ྾ yā ā+oṃ/ mṛ ྾ ran/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa'i a tang rnams sbyor te/ ṛta han dag las sul 'os iṭa byin/ byings thams cad pa dang byengs phyed pa dag gi 'os yon tan byas pas/ ma ri 6 ti/sogs dang / de bzhin du/ kṛng gi a tang rnams sbyor ①bas/ a ma ri byu ta—/ sogs so/ /༈ o bi dz+re 'jig pa dang g.yo bar byed pa dag la'o zhes pa la tang rnams sbyor te/ laṭa la/ bi dza te/ sogs dang / ling la/ bi dze ta/sogs so/ /loṭa la/ bi dza hūṃ/ sogs dang / lang la/ a bi dza ta/sogs so/ /bi dza iṭa/ bi dza las iṭa'o/ /bi dza las pha rol gyi nya ṇa 'gro ba'i ming can ma yin pas rkyen iṭa dang po can ni nga 'gro ba'i ming can zhes ming 'dogs byed de/ dgos pa ni yon tan dang 'phel ba 'gog pa'i don te/lung la/ a bi dziṣ+ṭa/ a bi dzi ṣā hūṃ/ a bi dzi ṣa ta/ sogs so/ /leṭa la—/ gnyis brjod pa sogs kyi/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ bi bi dze/bi bi dzā te/ bi bi dzi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bi bi dzi ṣe/ bi bi dzā the/ bi bi dzi bye/ bi bi dzi rje/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bi bi jo/bi bi dzi ba te/ bi bi dzi ma te/ luṭa la iṭa byin/ bi dza las iṭa 'os/jita yin pas yon tan mi byed de/ bi dzi tā/ bi dzi tā se/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ smon pa'i leng la/ bi dzi ྾ṣ+ṭa/ bi dzi ྾ yā༈/ bi dzi ྾ ran/sogs so/ /kṛṭa la'ang iṭa byen/ bi dza las iṭa 'os/ jita yin pas yon tan mi byed/ bi dzi 6 te/ bi dzi bye te/ bi dzi 6dhe/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ mṛng la/ a bi dzi 6 ta/ a bi dzi bye hūṃ/ a bi dzi 6n+ta/117—834

sogs so/ /i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gya sru tābhu dā da yaḥs mābhāḥzhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las tud la sogs pa rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las/ tud la sogs pa byed pa po'i don gyi shapa kyi yul la sha 'jug pa rnams kyi cho ga spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //myu/ da ni ru dha la sogs pa rnams kyi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ ru bye ra sgrib pa la'o zhes pa la lngaṭa sogs a tang dang tang gnyis ka sbyor ro/ /ru jo di bh+yaḥshām / ru dha la sogs pa rnams las shāma'o/ /ru dha la sogs pa rnams las atsa'i mtha' las byed pa po la shām 'gyur te/ sha 7shita kyi don dang ma yig ma 'gro ba a tsa'i mtha' las pha rol lo'i don no/ /laṭa'i pa rasmi pa da'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la sna/ la tipa/ mdo 'dis shām byin/ ma gnas don/ sha shita don/ dzhaṣa sogs kyis ta dha/ dzhal sogs kyis dha dar bsgyur bas/ ru ṇadhi/ gnyis tshig la/ la/ nyi sa/ shām byin/rjes 'byel phyis/ shā as dag gi ata dbyi 'os ldita pha rol la na'i srog a phyis/dzhaṣa sogs kyis ta dha/ dzhar 'dra ba la dzhar rnams kyi 'os dha gong ma phyis/na'i yang tshig mtha' ma yin pas dzhal la 'os na nga ro byas pas/ sum̐ dhaḥ/mang tshig la la rnyi/ dzha'i an+ta/ sogs kyis dṛ dharnyi/ de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ru ṇa྾/ dro dhaḥ/ sum̐ dha/117—835
