skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ru ṇad+dhi/ zu dh+waḥ/ zu d+maḥ/ de bzhin du/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ zu dhe/ zu r+sā te/ zu dha te/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ zu sne/ zu dh+wa the/ zu dhe/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ zu dhe/zu dh+wa te/ zu sgro he/ ling la/ shā as dag gi ata dbyi 'os a phyis/na'i 'ang tshig mtha' min pa'i dzhal la 'os na nga ro byas pas/ a tang la/zu dh+yā ta/ zu khye tī/ zu byuḥ/ sogs dang / tang la cho ga gzhan 'dra ba la/mtha' ma yin pa sogs kyis sī yuṭa sa phyis nas drangs pas/ zu dhī ta/ zu dhī yās+t+ri/ zu dhī ran/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ laṭa'i skabs ltar bsgrubs pas—/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ru ṇaskyi dro dh+wa ta/ zu bye/ sum̐ dhan+tuske/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ zu dhi/ zu jo ta/ zu sgo/ zu dha/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ru ṇa dh+wa ni/ ru ṇa jo ba/ ru ṇa dh+wa ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dzu jo/ zu dh+wa tsā/ sum̐ dha tsā/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ zu grwa/ zu dh+wa tsā/ ru dhī/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ru ṇa hai/ru ṇa jo ba hai/ ru ṇa dz+nyā ma hai/ de bzhin du/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la—/ a zu ṇata/ a ru ṇa ta/ a zu d+dhā/ a zu dhan/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a ru ṇaḥ/ : a ru ṇa ta/ a ru ṇa da/— : de'i 'ang ngos/ da ru u phyis/ra rnam bcad ṇa yang na gnas med pa sogs kyis bsgrub pa'o/ /a zu r+ghaṃ/ a zu dha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a ru ṇa sgo/ a zu r+ghaṃ/ a ruzla/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a sum̐ dha/ a zu dh+wa tsā/ a sum̐ dha ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la—/ a zu d+māḥ/ a zu dh+wa shaṃ/ a zu dz+nyā/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a sum̐ dhi—/ a zu dh+wa hi/ a zu byu hi/ lung gi a tang la/ ing 'gro ba sogs 117—836

kyis sh+lau ang du bsgyur ba dang sitsar bsgyur ba yang na bar byas pas/ ang du bsgyur ba'i phyogs la/ a ru dhata/ a ra dha dzā/ a ru dha na/ sogs dang /se tsar bsgyur ba'i phyogs la/ ba da brabya sogs kyis 'phel ba byas/ rnam dbye dzhal dang po rnams la/ dzhal las dzhal la 'os setsa phyis/ dzhaṣa sogs kyis ta tha dag dha dang / dzhasha la dzhal rnams sogs kyis dha 1da/ dzhal dang po ma yin pa rnams la khar la tsar sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a rodhī ta/ a rozlo/ a rokhruḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/a rodhīḥ/ a rod+dhāḥ/ a rodhe/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a rohūṃ/ a rot+pa—/ a rot+tha/ tang la/ dzhal dang po rnams la/ dzhal las dzhal la 'os sitsa phyis/ dzhaṣa sogs kyi ta dang tha dag dha/ dzhasha la dzhal rnams kyis dza sha 'os dha da/ dzhal dang po ma yin pa rnams la khar la tsar 'os/ dha tar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a rudha/a ru dh+wa tsā/ a ru dha ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a rud+dhāḥ2/ a ru dh+wa r+ghaṃ/ a rurnyi —/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a ru bye/ a ru bye hi/ a rudhū hi/ liṭa la gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ru ro dha/ ru ru dha tuḥ/ ru ru dhuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ru ro bye tha/ ru rodhe/ ru ru dha thuḥ/ ru ru dha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ru ro dha/ ru ru bye ba/ ru ru bye ma/ de bzhin du/tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ru ru dhe/ ru ru jo te/ ru ru bye re/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ru ru dhi ṣe/ ru ru jo the/ ru ru dhi be+e/ ru ru bye bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ru ru bye/ ru ru bye ba he/ ru ru bye ma te/777—837

ṣarka/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ shi she ṣa/ shi shi ṣi ba/ shi shi ṣi ma/luṭa la/ puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan/ ṣa ṭu la ṣa ṭu 'os ta ṭar bsgyur bas—/ sheṣ+ṭha/ sheṣ+ṭa si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ she : ta/shi byā ā+oṃ/ shi t+yā suḥ/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan byas/ sa la ṣa zwa dag gi ka 'os/ ṣa ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur bas/ she k+ṣu ti/ sogs dang / de bzhin du/ mṛng la/a she k+ṣu ta/ sogs so/ /༈ dṛ ha 'tshe ba la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ dṛ ṇa ha im/tro ṇa ha las im 'o/ /tre ṇa ha las pha rol gyi shām la hal dang po pa 'gro ba'i ming can pha rol la im ā ga ma 'gyur te ma yig gnas kyi don no/ /laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ lnga ti pa/ mdo 'dis im byen①/ a las yon tan nos e/ ha'i bhā 'os ha rte/ dzhaṣa sogs kyis ta dha/ ṣa ṭu la ṣa ṭu 'os dha bhā/ dzhar 'dra ba la dzhar rnams kyi 'os bye gong ma phyis pas/tre ṇi rnyi/ gnyis tshig la/ lnga tas shā as dag gi a dbyi 'os a phyis/ha'i bhā 'os/ ha bhā/ dzhaṣa sogs kyis ta dha/ ṣa ṭu la ṣa ṭu 'os/ dha bye/dzhar 'dra ba la dzhar rnams kyi 'os/ rte gong ma phyis pas/ tro byeḥ/ mang tshig la—/ shā as sogs kyis a phyis pas/ tro harnyi/ skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig la/ wa sipa/ tri ṇa ha las im 'os/ im ā ga ma byen/ mtshams sbyar—/ ha'i zwa 'os/ ha bhā/ sa la ṣa bye dag gi ka 'os bhā ka /kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur bas/ khru ṇi k+ṣi/ gnyis tshig ②dang mang tshig la/ tro byeḥ/ tro bhā/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tre ṇim+bi/ tro hwaḥ/ tro d+maḥ/117—842

shā las na dbyi 'os①/ shā las pha rol gyi nu yig dbyi bar bya ste/ laṭa'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ la tipa/ shā ma sbyin ita 'gro ba sogs kyis num byin/ mdo 'dis de phyis pas/ nyi na ste/ gnyis tshig la/ shā as sogs kyis a phyis pas/ ho staḥ/ mang tshig la/ ho sarnyi/ de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ nyi nabyu④/ ho sbeḥ/ho sbe/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ hi nasmi/ ho swaḥ/ ho smaḥ/ ling la/shā las na dbyi 'os/ num gyi na phyis/ shā sogs kyis a phyis pas/ ho snga ta/ho sgyu tsā/ ho gyuḥ/ loṭa la laṭa'i skabs ltar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ho na stu/ ho stu ta/ ho shā/ nyi san+tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ho bye/snyehu dzhal nyi'i rnyi 'os nyi dhi/ dha la'ang ngos sa phyis/ ho stu ta/ ho ste/ho sta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ hi na sā ni/ hi na sā ba/ hi na sā ma/lang gi ④skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a hi naḥ/ a ho ṭ+wā/ a ho sa na/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a hi naḥ/ a ho ste/ a nyi sta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a hi na saṃ/ a ho swa/ a ho sma/ lung la ita 'gro ba sogs kyis num ā ga ma byin/ bal dang po'i iṭa byin pas/ a nyidrita/a ho sespya/ a ho si 6ཿ/ liṭa la/ ita 'gro bas num byin byings gnyis brjodaske/ ku ha dag gi tsu 'os/ ha dzha a sgyu sa'i tsa ra 'ang ngos dzha dzar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dzi hid+ma/dzi hid+ma tuḥ/ dzi hirluḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dzi hibe+e tha/ dzi hid+ma thuḥske/ dzi nyid+ma/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dzi nyid+ma/ dzi hirmi ba/ dzi hirmi ma—/ luṭa la iṭa byin pas/ hirmi tā/ ho se tā si/ sogs so/ /smon 117—844

s+tha—/ ā dz+wa dza thuḥ/ ā rna dza/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ā dz+wa dza/ ā rna dzi ba/ ā rna dzi ma/ luṭa la/ uta 'gro ba sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ a dzi tā/ a dzi tā se/ sogs sam/ i lnga/ e lnga se/sogs so/ /smon pa'i leng la/ ita 'gro ba ma yin pa sogs kyis nya phyis pas/a dz+nyā ta/ a dz+nyā ā+oṃ/ a dz+nyā suḥ/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la spruta 'gro ba sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar byas/ iṭa med pa'i phyogs la/ tsu'i ku 'os/ dza ga /khar la tsar 'os/ ga ka kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur bas/4 ①dzi 6 ti/ sogs sam/ sde ②rgya ti/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/kṛng la/ e ①dzi 6 ta/ sogs sam/ dze+e rgya ta/ sogs so/ /༈ nyi irnyi 'bar ba la'o zhes pa la tang rnams sbyor te/ shā las na dbye 'os—/ na phyis/ sdita rnams la/ shā as dag gi 'os/ shā ma gyi na'i a phyis—/ ta dang tha dang po can rnams la/ dzha ṣa sogs kyis ta tha dag dha/dzhar 'dra ba la dzhar rnams kyi 'os/ dha gong ma dbye ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/laṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ idhe/ in+t+ra te/ irnya te/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ idhe/ in+dha the/ idhe/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/idhe—/ idh+wa te/ in+d+ra te/ leng la mtha' ma yin pa sogs kyi sī yuṭa'i sa phyis—/ na'i a phyis nas drangs pas/ irnyi ta/ irnyi yā hūṃ/ irnyi ran/sogs so/ /loṭa la/ laṭa'i skabs ltar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ i:/ in+t+ra hūṃ/ in+ta hūṃ/ skyes bu dbus rjom gsum la/ in+d+ra/id+dhā shā/ i:/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ i na dhe(pe/ i na d+ma ba hai/i na dh+wa ma hai/ lang la gzhan cho ga snga ma rnams dang 'dra/ a tsa dang po 117—846

bin+da 3ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a bin+d+raḥ/ a bin+d+ra shaṃ/ a bir+ghaṃ bye /skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a bin+di/ a bin+d+ra hi/ a bin+d+ra hi/ lung la iṭa byin pas/ a be diṣ+ṭa/ a be+e di ṣā tī 5/ a be+e di ṣa ta/ sogs so/ /liṭa la gnyis brjod pa sogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ bi bi de/ bi bi dā te/ bi bi di re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ be+e bi de ṣe/ bi bi dā the/bi bi di bye/ bi bi di rje/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bi bi de/ bi be+e di ba te / bi bi di ma he/ luṭa la iṭa byin/ puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ be+e di tā/ be+e di tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la iṭa byen pas/ bi di ྾ṣ+ṭa/ bi di ྾ yā.ā+oṃ/ bi di ྾ ran/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la iṭa byin puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ bi di 6 te/ sogs dang / de bzhin du/ kṛd la/ a be di 6 ta/ sogs so/ /i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa su sru tā tru dh+wa da yaḥ/ sa mābhāthu ཿ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las ru dha la sogs pa rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las ru dha la sogs pa shapa kyi yul la shām 'jug pa rnams kyi cho ga spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa rags pa rnams re zhig thurdzogs so// //da ni ta nu la sogs pa rnams kyi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ ta nu rgyas pa la'o zhes pa la laṭa sogs a tang dang tang gnyis ka 'jug ste/ byings thams 117—848

cad pa rnams pha rol la ta na la sogs pa la u 'os rkyen u pha rol du sbyor te/laṭa'i a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ta no ti/ ta nu taḥ/ ta narnyi/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ta no ṣi/ ta nu thaḥ/ ta nu tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ta no mi/ ta nu baḥ/ ta naḥ/ ta nu maḥ/ ta d+maḥ/tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ta nu te/ ta nā te/ ta na te/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ta nu ṣe/ ta nā the/ ta nu dhī/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la / ta dz+wa/ ta nu ba he/ ta na te/ ta nu ma he/ tad+ma he/ ling gi a tang la/ ta nu yāta/ ta nu yā tī/ ta nu yuḥ/ sogs dang / tang la mtha' ma yin pa sogs kyis sī yuṭa'i sa phyis ika gi a tsa la ya ṇar bsgyur bas/ta rtswa ta/ ta rtswa yā tī/ ta rtswa rān/ sogs so/ /loṭa'i a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ta no tu/ ta nu tāta/ ta nu tī/ ta nan+tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ta nu/ rkyen u sogs kyis hi phyis/ ta nu tāta/ ta nu tai/ta nu ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ta na bā ni/ ta na bā ba/ ta na bā ma/tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ta nu tsā/ ta nā tsā/ ta na tsā/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ta nu ṣa/ ta na tsā/ ta nu byetāsna/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ta na bai/ ta na bā ba hai/ ta na bā ma hai/ lang gi a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a ta nota/ a ta nu tī/ a ta nan/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a to noḥ/ a ta nu tai/ a ta nu ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a ta na baṃ/ a ta nu ba/ a ta na/ a ta nu ma/ a ta d+ma/tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a ta nu ta/ a ta nā hūṃ/ a na na ta/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a ta nu thāḥ/ a na nā tsā/ a ta nu dhī/117—849

skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a ta —/ a ta nu ba hi/ a ta na nyi/ a ta nu ma hi/ a tad+ma hi/ lung gi pa rasmi ①pa da la iṭa byen/ hal dang po yang ba sogs kyis 'phel ba yang na bar byas pas/ a tā nī ta/ ④a tā ni྾/a tā ni 6ཿ/ sogs sam/ a ta bhā ta/ sogs so/ /tang la/ ta nā di bh+yasta thā soḥ/ ta na la sogs pa rnams las ta thās dag la'o/ /ta na la sogs pa rnams las pha rol gyi si tsa ni lung bsgyur ba'i ta dang thās dag pha rol la yang na dbyi ste/ tan la/ lung lata/ mdo 'dis se tsa dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba yang na bar byas/ se tsa phyis pa'i phyogs la/ a nu dāt+ta ①nye ba'i yul/ ba na ti/ ta no ti la sogs pa rnams kyi rjes su sna ldan dzha la kra du 'gro ba la dbyi 'os na phyis/ sitsa ma phyis pa'i phyogs la ④iṭa byin pas a ta ta/ a ta niṣ+ṭagaskyes bu dang po'i gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ a ta di ṣā tsā/ a ta ni ṣa ta/skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig la/ ta na la sogs pa rnams las ta thās dag la 'os se tsa dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba yang na bar byas pas/ a ta thāḥ/ a ta nijoḥ—/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ a ta ni ṣā shaṃ/ a ta ni dhī/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a ta ni ṣi/ a ta ni ṣ+ṭa hi/ a ta ni ṣ+ṭha hi/leṭa la gnyis brjod/ sdita rnams pha rol la a sgyu sa dbye ba sogs byas pas/a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ta tā na/ te na tuḥ/ ti ④nu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ta ta ni tha/ te na thuḥ/ te na/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ta tā na/ ta ta na/ te ni (peb/ te ni ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ te ṣ+pe/ te nā te/ te ni re⑧/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la / te ni ṣe/ te nā the/ te ni bye/ te ni bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/117—850 /

te ṣ+pe/ te ni ba te/ te ni ma he/ luṭa la iṭa byin pas/ a tang la/ta ni tā/ ta ni tā si/ sogs dang / tang la/ ta ni tā/ ta ni tā se/sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/ ta t+yā ta/ ta t+yā s+t+ri/ ta t+yā suḥ/sogs so/ /tang la iṭa byin pas/ ta ni ṭīṣ+ṭa ta ni ྾ yāspyo/ ta ni ྾ 1ran/sogs so/ /kṛṭa'i a tang la/ ta ni 6 ti/ sogs dang / tang la/ ta ni 6 te/ sogs so/ /kṛng gi a tang la/ ata ni 6 ta/ sogs dang /tang la/ a ta ni 6 ta/ sogs so/ /myu/ ṣa nu sbyin pa la'o zhes pa la a tang dang tang gnyis ka 'jug ste/laṭa'i a tang la/ sa no ti/ sogs dang / tang la/ sa nu te/ sogs so / /khring —gi a tang la/ sa nu yāta/ sogs dang / tang la/ sa rtswa ta / sogs so/ /loṭa'i a tang la/ sa no tu/ sogs dang / tang la/sa nu tsā/ sogs so/ /lang gi a tang la/ a sa no ta/ sogs dang /tang la/ a sa nu ta sogs so/ /lung gi a tang la iṭa byin/ hal dang po yang ba sogs kyis 'phel ba yang na bar byas pas/ a sā be+e ta/ a sā m+bispya/a sā ni 6ཿ/ sogs dang / yang na/ a sa — ta/ sogs so/ /tang la/ ta dang jethās la/ ta na la sogs pa rnams las ta thās dag la 'os/ se tsa dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba yang na bar byas/ se tsa phyis pa'i phyogs la/ a nu dāt+ta 5nye ba'i yul sogs kyi na phyis/ san dzha la dag la dzan san khan 6rnams kyi 'os ring por bsgyur/ sitsa ma phyis pa'i phyogs dang gzhan rnams la iṭa byen pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a sā ta/ a sa niṣ+ṭa/ a sa ni ṣā hūṃ / a sa ni ṣa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a sā thāḥ7/ a sa 117—851

nijoḥ—/ a sa ni ṣā tsā/ a sa ni dhī/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a sa ni ṣi/a sa ni khya nyi/ a sa niṣ+ṭha hi/ liṭa la gnyis brjod/ ldita rnams la a sgyu sa dbye ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ sa sā na/ sa ①na tuḥ/ se nuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ sa sa ni tha/se na thuḥ/ se na/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sa sā na/ sa san/ se ni ba/se ni ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ se rna/ se nā te/ se na te/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ se ni ṣe/ se nā the/ se ni bye/ se ni bye/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ se ṣ+pe/ se ni ba he/ se ni ma he/ luṭa la iṭa byen pas/ a tang la/ sa ni tā/ sa ni tā se/ sogs dang / tang la/sa ni tā/ sa ni tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/ yal 'dam ka 'os/ ṭi āta du bsgyur ba dang mi bsgyur ba yang na bar byas pas/sā yāta/ sā yāspyo/ sā yā suḥ/ sogs sam/ sa r+sāta/ sa t+yā.ā+oṃ/ sa t+yā suḥ—/ sogs so/ /tang la iṭa byin pas/ sa ni ྾ṣ+ṭa/ sa ni ྾ yā:②/sa ni ྾ ran/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la iṭa byin pas/ a tang la/ sa ni 6 tirka/ sogs dang / tang la/ sa ni 6 te/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/thrang gi a tang la/ a sa ni 6 ta/ sogs dang / tang la/ sa ①sa ni 6 ta—/ sogs so/ /༈ k+ṣi rku 'tshe ba la'o zhes pa la a tang dang tang gnyis ka sbyor te/'grel par lung drangs pa/ u pra t+ya ye ta nā de rno pa ṅgā gu ṇaḥ/ u rkyen la ta na la sogs pa'i u pa dh+wa yon tan ma yin no/ /rkyen u pha rol la ta na la sogs pa rnams kyi u pa dh+wa ṛ yig yin na yon tan yang na bar byed la/117—852

āṇi 6 ta/ sogs dang / tang la/ āṇi 6 ta/ sogs so/ /༈ che kṛ nya/ byed pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang dang tang gnyis ka 'jug ste/ kṛ ①la u byings thams cad pa dang byings phyed pa sogs kyis yon tan—/ ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can rnams la/ byengs thams cad pa la ata kyi uta 'os/ u pa dh+wa'i a u dang atsa dang po rnams la/ ika gi a tsa la yaṇar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ laṭa'i a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ka ro ti/ ku ru taḥ/ kurbarnyi/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ka ro ṣi/ ku ru thaḥ/ ku ru tha/ skyes bu phyi ma'i gcig tshig la/ ka re mi/ni bye ka ro te/ ka ro nyi las rtag tu'o/ /ka ro ti las pha rol gyi rkyen u ni ba ma pha rol la rtag tu dbyi ste/ skyes bu phyi ma'i gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/kurbaḥ—/ kurmaḥ/ de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ku ru te/ kur+pā te/ kurba te/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la—/ ku ru ṣe/ kur+pā the/ ku ru bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ kurbe/kurba he/ kurma te/ ye tsa/ ya la'ang ngo / /ka ro ti las pha rol gyi u ni rkyen ya dang po can pha rol la'ang dbyi ste/ leng gi a tang la/ kurlu ba/ kurlu tsā/kurluḥske/ sogs so/ /tang la/ mtha' ma yin pa sogs kyis sī yu ṭa'i sa phyis—/ ika gi a tsa la ya ṇa ②'os ya ṇar bsgyur bas/ kuṭī ta/ kuṭī yā tsā—/ kubye ran sogs so/ /loṭa la laṭa'i skabs ltar bsgrubs pas/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ka ro tu/ ku ru tāta/ ku ru tsā/ kurban+tu/skyes ①bu dbus ma gsum la/ ku ru/snye.ud las kyang brtsegs pa ma yin pa sogs kyis nyi phyis/ku ru tā ta/ ku ru lta/ ku ru ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ka ra bā ṇi/117—856

ka ra bā pa/ ka ra bā ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ku ru tī/kudzā tsā/ kurba ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ku ru ṣ+ṭa/ kur+pā tsā/ ku ru dhī ①/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ka ra be+e/ ka ra bā ba hai/ ka ra bā ma hai/lang gi a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a ka ro ta/ a ku ru tsā/ a kurban / skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a ka roḥ/ a ku ru tai/ a ku ru ta / skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a ka ra baṃ/ a kurba/ a kurma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a ku ru ta/ a kur+pā tī/ a kurba ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a ku ru thāḥ/ a kur+pā shaṃ/ a ku ru bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a kurbi/ a kurba hi/ a kurma hi/ lung gi a tang la/sitsa la 'phel ba pa rasmi pa da rnams la 'os/ 'phel ba byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a kādhī kyita/ a kāspyo/ a kākhyoḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a kāchad1/ a kālja/ a kāspyo/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a kār+ghaṃ / a kār+ṣa/ a kān+d+rathu/ tang la dzhal dang po rnams la gzugs thung ngu las kyang ngos setsa dbyi ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/a kṛ ta/ a kṛ ṣā hūṃ/ a kṛ ṣa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a kṛ thāḥ / a kṛ ṣā shaṃ/ a kṛ bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a kṛ ṣi/ a kṛ ṣa hi/ a kṛṣ+ṭha hi/ liṭa thul gnyis brjod/ ṛ'i ata sbyi 'os ṛ aṭa⑫ /ku ha dag gi tsu 'os/ ka tsar bsgyur ba sogs kyis/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tsa kā ra/ tsa kra tuḥ/ tsa kruḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/tsa karba/ tsa kra thuḥ/ tsa kra/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsa kā ra/ tsa ka rnyir / tsa kṛ ba/ tsa kṛ ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tsakre/ tsa 117—857

krā te/ tsa kṛ re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tsa ①kṛ ṣe/ tsa krā the/tsa kṛ bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsa kre/ tsa kṛ ba he/ tsa kṛ ma he/luṭa la/ byings thams cad pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ a tang la/kaṭ+wārka/ karta se/ sogs dang / tang la/ karta/ karta se/ sogs so//smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/ sha yaka ling rnams la ring 'os ṛ ring du bsgyur bas/ kṛ ④yāta/ kṛ ①yā༈/ kṛ rjoyā suḥ/ sogs dang / tang la/kṛ ྾ṣ+ṭa/ kṛ ྾ yaste/ kṛ ྾ ran/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ ṛta ha na/dag las sa ⑤'os/ iṭa byin/ byengs thams cad pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ a tang la/ ka ri 6 ti/ sogs dang / tang la/ ka ri byu te/sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ mṛng gi a tang la/ a ka ri byuta/ sogs dang /tang la/ a ka ri t+ya ti⑥/ sogs so/ /saṃ parlu pe sgyu⑦ཿ/ ka ro to zla ⑧ṣa ṇi—/ saṃ pa ri u pa rnams las ka ro ti la rgyan la'o/ /nyer bsgyur saṃ pa ri u pa rnams las pha rol gyi ka ro til rgyan gyi don la suṭa ā ga ma 'gyur te/ ṭa gnas don dang u brjod pa'i don no/ /saṃ ska ro ti/snyergyan legs par byas⑨/—rgyan yongs su byed/snyepa riṣ+ka ro ti/snyeb ri — tha rnams las sogs kyi sa ṣar bsgyur ba'o/ /u pa ska ro ti/—rgyananye bar byed/ pa ri sngon ma'i kṛ la lung aṭa a sgyus bar na yod kyang ngos/ ka'i sngon du suṭa byin/ sib la sogs pa rnams kyis yang na 'os/ sa kar yang na bar byasaspyo/ par+yaskuṭīta/⑪snye rgyanayongs su byas/— parluṣ+kaṭī ta / u pa sngon ma'i kṛ la liṭa aṭa a sgyus bar na yod kyang ngos/ ka'i sngon du suṭa/snyesngo/ pa tha sku/ zab/ sngon rgyan nye bar byas/ u pa dang saṃ sngon ma'i kṛ la/ li ṭa a ṭa a sgyu sa dang bar na yod kyang ngos/ suṭa byin/ la tas dang rnyi ru bsgyur/ de gnyis a tus dang us su bsgyur/ suṭa ka'i steng du byung bas/ brtsegs pa'i pha rol la liṭa rnams sdita ma yin pas⑫/ byings thams cad pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pa ste/ a tang dang tang gnyis ka'i lhag ma kun la rigs 'gre'o/ / u pa tsa ska ra tuḥ/snyesngon rgyan nye bar dag byas/ saṃ tsaska ra tuḥ/snyesngon rgyan 177—858

legs pa dag byas/ u pa tsaska ruḥ/— sngon rgyan rnams nye bar byas①/ saṃ tsaska ruḥ/——sngon rgyan rnams legs par byas/ 'grel par suṭa sngon ma'i kṛ las pha rol gyi liṭa bsgyur ba'i bal dang po rnams la iṭa 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ saṃ tsa ska ri tha/——sngon rgyan legs par byas/ // 'a sgo/ lnga/ pa/snyesngon rgyan dag legs par byas/ /batha ska lnga/ ṣe/snyesngon rgyan legs par byas/sogs so/ /saṃ skri yā ta/——smonapa'i ling / sa ma bā ye tsa/ 'dus pa la'ang ngo / /saṃ pa ri upa rnams las pha rol gyi ka ro ti las pya 'dus pa'i don la'ang suṭa 'gyur te/ u pa ska ro ti ka dh+yā/——bu mo la nye bar 'dus par byed/ saṃ ska ro ti ka bye①/— bumo la yang dag par 'dus par byed/ pa lnga 〉 zo/ ti ka dz+nyā/—bu mo la yongs su 'dus par byed/ sogs so/ /u pāt+tha ti yasne be+e kṛ ④ta bā kyā dh+yā hā re 6/ u pa las so sor 'bad pa dang /rnam 'gyur brjod pa dang / rtog khya pa rnams la'o/ /u pa las pha rol gyi ka ro ti la so por ④'bad pa dang / rnam 'gyur brjod pa dang / rtog pa rnams kyi don la suṭa 'gyur te/ so sor 'bad pa'i don/—gaṇ+ḍi ⑦gu ṇa sro pa sku ru te/— mgrinapa la yon tan nye bar byed/ zas la nye bar byed/snyesngo paska ro ti hūṃ ste/— rnam 'gyur brjod pa'i don/ so pa ska ro ti shāste/——bstan bcos la nye ba dang bcas par byed/ rtog pa'i don/ i nyi pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa su sru tāt+ta bhunā da yaḥ/ sa mābhāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las/ta na la sogs pa rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las/ ta na la ⑨sogs pa byed pa po'i don gyi shapa kyi yul la u 'jug pa rnams kyi cho ga spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //117—859

da ni kṛ la sogs pa rnams kyi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ ༈ che 1nya rdzas tshang ①ba la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang dang tang gnyis ka 'jug ste/ kyā di sgyusneḥ/shā—/ grwa la sogs pa rnams las shā'o/ /spri la sogs pa rnams la sa shapa kyi yul la shā pha rol du 'gyur te/ hal dang po ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can rnams la/bhu ma yin pa'i hal la yī 'os/ shār bsgyur ba dang / a tsa dang po rnams la : a bh+yasta dag gi āta 'os/ ā ①dbyi ba sogs byas pas/ laṭa'i a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ shrī ḍā ti/ 4 hā taḥ/ ṭā ④ṇarnyi/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ṭā ḍā se/ spri bhā thaḥ/ 4 tī tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ 1 ṇ+ḍa mi/ spri tī baḥ⑤/ 4 bhā maḥ/ de bzhin du/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ shrī tsā te/ 4 ṇ+ḍa te/ 4 ṇa te/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ 4 bhā ṣe/ shrī ṇ+ḍa the/ — bhā dhī/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/spri ṇi/ spri bhā ba he/ k+shi bhā ma he/ ling gi a tang la/ ghu ma yin pa sogs kyis yīr bsgyur bas/ k+shi bhā yāta/ k+shi bhā yā hūṃ/ spri bhā yuḥ/sogs so/ /tang la/ mtha' ma yin pa sogs kyis sī yuṭa'i sa phyis/ shā a sgyu dusta dag gi āta 'os/ ā phyis nas drangs pas/ shrī tsā ta/ ṭā bhā yā hūṃ/k+shi bhā ran sogs so/ /loṭa la laṭa'i skabs ltar bsgrubs pas/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ k+shi ṇ+ḍa tu/ spri bhā tāta/ lnga bhā tsā⑦/ lnga rngon+tu/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la⑧/ 4 bhā nyi/ 4 bhā tāta/ shrī tsā te/ shrī tī ta /skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ yī ṇa ni/ spri ḍā ba/ k+shi ṇa ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ 4 bhā hūṃ/ 4 ṇ+ḍa hūṃ/ 4 ṇa hūṃ/ skyes bu dbus ma 117—860

gsum la/ shrī d+dhā ṣ+ṭa/ bī zla shaṃ/ bī bhā dhī/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ṭā ṇa—/ spri shā ba hai/ spri zla ma hai/ lang gi a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/a bī shā takhye/ a spri 3d+dhā tī/ a 4 ṇan/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/a 4 ṇaḥ/ a 4 bhā taitsa/ a spri bhāta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a spri rde/a grwa bhā ba/ a k+shi ṇ+ḍi ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a gī bhā 4ta/a bī rja tsā/ a bī ṇa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a 1 bhā thāḥ/ a yī shā tsā/ a shrī d+dhā bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a shrī ṇi/ a yī bhā khyab hi / a grwa bhā ma hi/ lung gi a tang la/ sitsa la 'phel ba sogs kyis 'phel ba byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a kre ṭī ta/ a kre bye'u/a kre 6ཿ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a kreṭīḥ/ a kreṣ+ṭi ④/ a kreṣ+ṭa/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a kreṣe/ a dze+e ṣ+ṭa/ a kreṣ+ṭha/ tang la byings thams cad pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a kreṣ+ṭa / a kre ṣā tsā/ a kre ṣa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum byel/ a krejoḥ/a kre ṣā r+ghaṃ/ a kre byeshe/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a kre ṣi/ a kre ṣa hi/a kreṣ+ṭha hi/ liṭa la/ gnyis brjod 'di brtsegs pa can yin pas ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can ma yin pas yon tan dang 'phel ba sogs byas pas/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la tsi krā ya/ tsi kra ya tuḥ/ tsi tra yuḥ/1 7 skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tsi kra yi tha/ tsi kre tha/ tsi kra ya thuḥ/ tsi kra ya/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsi krā ya/ tsi kra ya/ tsi kra yi ba/ tsi kra yi ma/tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tsi kra ye/ tsi kra yā dwate/ tsi kra yi re/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tsi kra yi ṣe/ tsi kra yā the/ tsi kra yi bye/ tsi kra 117/de861

yi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsi kra ye/ tsi kra yi ba he①/ tsi kra yi ma he/luṭa la byengs thams cad pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ a tang la/ kre tā—/ kre tā se sogs dang / tang la/ kre tā/ kre tā se sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/ shrī yā ta/ k+shi yā.ā+oṃ/ spri yā suḥ/ sogs dang /tang la byings thams cad pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ kre ②྾ṣ+ṭa/ kre ྾ yātram̐①/ kre ྾ ran/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la byengs thams cad pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ a tang la/ kre 6 ti/ sogs dang / tang la/kre 6 te/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng gi a tang la/ a kre 6 ta/sogs dang / tang la/ a kre 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ sku nya kun tu grol ba la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang dang tang gnyis ka sbyor te—/ stasgru stusgru skasna skusgyu sku:ཿ/ shāstsa/ stasna stusna skasgru skusnyu kunya rnams las shā 'ang ngo / /stasnyu dang stusgru dang skasgru dang skusgru rnams sgrib ④pa/skunya kun tu grol ba rnams las pha rol tu shapa kyi yul la shā 'grur zhing shā 'ang 'gyur te/ skunya la shā dang dzo yang na bar byas pasarjo/ la ṭa'i a tang la/sku nā ti/ sogs sam/ sku no ti/ sogs sorjo/ /tang la/ sku smi te/sogs sam/ sku nu te/ sogs so/ /leng gi a tang la/ sku smi yāta⑦/sogs sam/ sku nu yāta/ sogs so/ /tang la/ sku nī ta/ sogs sam/sku rtswa ta⑧/ sogs so/ /loṭa'i a tang la/ sku nā tu/ sogs sam/ sku no tu/ sogs so/ /tang la/ sku m+bi tī/ sogs sam/ sku nu hūṃ/sogs so/ /lang gi a tang la/ a sku nāta/ sogs sam/ a sku nota/sogs so/ /tang la/ a sku rtswa ta/ sogs sam/ asku nu ta/ sogs so//117—862

skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ mi bya ṣe/ mi myu the/ mi bya dhī/ mi rmya bye/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ mi bye/ mi m+bi ba te/ mi rmya ma te/ luṭa la/ sri nā ti/ mi no ti sogs kyis ata du bsgyur bas/ a tang la/ mā tā/ mā tā se/ sogs dang / tang la/ mā tā/ mā tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/ rmā nā ti/ mi no ①ti sogs kyis āta du bsgyur/ling la e 'os/ de er bsgyur bas/ me yāta/ me yā.ā+oṃ/ me yā suḥ/sogs dang / tang la āta du bsgyur bas/ mā sīṣ+ṭa/ mā sī yāshā/ mā sī peran / sogs so/ /loṭa ①la'ang / rmā nā ti/ mi no ti/ dring rnams kyis phyapa la'ang ngos āta du bsgyur bas/ a tang la/ mā su ti/ sogs dang / tang la/ mā gya te/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng gi a tang la/a mā suta/ sogs dang / tang la/ a mā suta/ sogs so/ /༈ pūnya dag byed pa ④la'o zhes pa la a tang dang tang gnyis ka 'jug ste/pā ⑤dī rmā hra swaḥ/ sgo la sogs pa rnams kyi 0thung ngu'o/ /byunya la sogs pa nyi shu po rnams kyi rkyen sha 'gro ba pha rol la thung ngur bsgyur bar bya ste/ laṭa'i a tang la/ pu nā ti/ sogs dang / tang la/ pu nī te/ sogs so/ /leng gi a tang la/ pu nī yāta/ sogs dang / tang la/ pu nī ta/sogs so/ /loṭa'i a tang la/ pu nā tu/ sogs dang / tang la/ pu bhā hūṃ—/ sogs so/ /lang gi a tang la/ a pu nāta/ sogs dang / tang la/a pu rtswa ta/ sogs so/ /'grel par lung drangs pa/ dā ⑦dī rmā hra swaḥ/ke tsi dā/ gu la sogs pa rnams kyi thung ngu skabs 'gar yang na'o/ /pū la sogs pa rnams kyi shita pha rol la 'ga' zhig tu thung ngur bsgyur ba yang na bar 117—868

bya ste/ pu nā ti/ pū nā ti/ sogs so/ /lung gi a tang la iṭa byin/setsa 'phel ba pa rasmi pa tsad rnams la 'os 'phel ba tsabyas pas/ a pā bīta/a pā bi spya/ a pā ①bi 6ཿ/ sogs so/ /tang la iṭa byin/ byings thams cad pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ a pa biṣ+ṭa/ a pa bi ṣā tī/a pa bi ṣa ta/ sogs so/ /liṭa la gnyis brjod ldita rnams la/ atsa la sgo byings sogs kyis u bar bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ pu pā ba/ pu pu ba tuḥ/ pu pu buḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ pu pa bi tha/ pu pu ba thuḥ/ pu pu ba/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/pu pā ba/ pu pa ④ba/ pu pu bi ba/ pu pu bi ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ pu pu be+e/ pu pu bā te/ pu pu bi re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la—/ pu pu bi ṣe/ pu pu bā the/ pu pu bi ⑪ dhī/ pu pu bi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ pu pu be/ pu pu bi ba te/ pu pu bi ma he/ luṭa la iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ a tang la/ pa bi tā/ pa bi tā se/ sogs dang /tang la/ pa bi tā/ pa bi tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/pū yāta/ pū yāspyo/ pū yā suḥ/ sogs dang / tang la iṭa byen yon tan byas pas/ pa bi ྾ṣ+ṭa/ pa bi ṭī yā༈/ pa bi ྾ ran/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa khyela'ang iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ a tang la/ pa bi byu ti/ sogs dang /tang la/ pa bi 6 te/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ mṛng gi a tang la/a pa bi t+pa ta/ sogs dang / tang la/ a pa bi 6 ta/ sogs so/ /༈ 1nya 'tshe ba la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang dang tang gnyis ka sbyor te/byu la sogs pa rnams kyi ⑦thung ngu 'os thung ngur bsgyur bas/ laṭa'i a tang la/117—869

kṛ ṇa ti/ sogs dang / tang la/ kṛ bhā te/ sogs so/ /ling gi a tang la/ kṛ d+dhā yāta/ sogs dang / tang la/ kṛ tī ta/ sogs so/ /loṭa'i a tang la/ kṛ ṇ+ḍa tu/ sogs dang / tang la/ kṛ bhā tsā/ sogs sorka/ /lang gi ①a tang la/ a kṛ ṇ+ḍa ta/ sogs so/ /tang la/ a kṛ bhā ta/ sogs so/ /lung gi a tang la/ iṭa byin sitsa la 'phel ba pa rasmi pa da rnams la 'os/ 'phel ba byas pas/ a kā rīta/ a kā ri :/ a kā ri 6ཿ/ tang la/ dṛ dzāta las yang na 'os/ iṭa dang ā+oṭa yang na bar byas—/ byengs thams cad pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ a ka riṣ+ṭa/a ka ri ṣā tsā/ a ka ri ṣa ta/ sogs sam/ a ka rīṣ+ṭa/ a ka ⑧rī ṣā tsā①/a ka rī duṣa ta/ sogs so/ /liṭa la gnyis brjod ṛ'i ata 'os/ ṛ a ku ha dag gi tsu 'os/ katsa ṇa la gnyis la 'phel ba dang / gzhan rnams la/ṛts+tsha ti dzāta rnams kyi 'os yon tan byas pas/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la—/ tsa kā ra/ tsa ka ra tuḥ/ tsa ka ruḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/tsa ka risnatha/ tsa ka ra thuḥ/ tsa ka ra/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsa kā ra/tsa ka ra/ tsa ka ri ba/ tsa ka ri ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tsa ka re/ tsa ka rā te/ tsa ka ri re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tsa ka ri ṣe/tsa ka rā the/ tsa ka ri dhī/ tsa ka ri bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsa ka re/tsa ka ri ba te/ tsa ka ri ma ho/ luṭa la thra dzāta ⑤las yang na 'os/ iṭa dang yīṭa yang na bar byas pas/ a tang la/ ka ri tā/ ka ri tā se/sogs sam/ ka rī rjotā/ ka rī ⑦tā si/ sogs so/ /tang la/ ka ri tā/ka ri tā se/ sogs sam/ ka rī ⑧tā/ ka rī ⑨tā se/ sogs so/ /smon 117—870

pa'i ling gi a tang la/ byings kyi rīta kyi ita 'os/ ṛ ita/ ṛ'i aṇa la ra pha rol los ra byin/ u pa dh+wa'i 'ang ngos ring por bsgyur bas/ tīr+yāta/tīrlutram̐—/ tī rlu suḥ/ sogs so/ /tang la iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ka ri ṭīṣ+ṭa/ ka ri ྾ yādz+nyā/ ka ri ྾ ran/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la/ dṛ dṛta las yang na 'os/ iṭa dang ā+oṭa yang na bar byas/ yon tan byas pas/a tang la/ ka ri 6 ti/ sogs sam/ ka rī 6 ti/ sogs so/ /tang la/ka ri 6 te/ sogs sam/ ka rī 6 tenyu/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/kṛng gi a tang la/ a ka ri 6ta/ sogs sam/ a ka rī nyuta/ sogs so//tang la/ a ka ri 6ta/ sogs sam/ a ka rī 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ dhūnya 'gul ba la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang dang tang gnyis ka sbyor te/pū la sogs pa rnams kyi thung ngu 'os/ thung ngur bsgyur bas/ laṭa'i a tang la / ju 3nā ti/ sogs dang / tang la/ dhu bhā te/ sogs so/ /ling gi a tang la/ dhu m+bi yāṭa/ sogs dang / tang la/ dhu nī ta/ sogs so//loṭa'i a tang la/ dhu nā tu/ sogs dang / tang la/ dhu nī tī/ sogs so/ /lang gi a tang la/ a dhu na ta/ sogs dang / tang la/a dhu nī ta/ sogs so/ /lung la/ uta 'gro ba sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar byed/ a tang la 'phel ba byas pas/ iṭa'i phyogs la/ a dh+wa bīta/a jo bispya/ a jo bi 6ཿ/ sogs dang / iṭa med pa'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a sgo ྾ ta/ a sgo bye/ a sgo 6ཿ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a sgo ྾ཿ/ a sgo bye/ a sgo ṣ+ṭa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a kau ṣe/ a dhi ṣa/ a dhi ṣ+ṭha/ tang la yon tan byas pas/ a dha biṣ+ṭa/117—871

a dha bi ṣā tsā/ a dha bi ṣa ta/ sogs sam/ iṭa med pa'i phyogs kyi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a dhoṣ+ṭa/ a sgo ṣā tsā/ a dho ṣa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a rnyojoḥ/ a rnyo ṣā r+ghaṃ/ a dho dz+nyā/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/a dho ṣi/ a dho ṣ+ṭa hi/ a dho ṣ+ṭha he/ liṭa la/ gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas①/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ du dh+wa ba/ du dhu ba tuḥ/ du dhu buḥ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ du byu bi tha/ du dhu ba thuḥ/du dhu ba/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ du dh+wa ba/ du dha ba/ du byu bi ba/du dhu bi ma/ tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ du dhu be/ du dhu bā te/ du dhu bi ra②/ byes bu dbus ma gsum la/ du dhu bi ṣe/ du byu bā the/ du dhu bi dhe/ bu dhu bi rje/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ du dhu be/ du dhu bi ba he/du byu bi ma te/ luṭa la/ spruta ①'gro ba sogs kyis iṭa yang na bar byas/yon tan byas pas/ a tang la/ dha bi tā/ dha bi tā si/ sogs sam/dho tā/ sgo tā se/ sogs so/ /tang la/ dha bi tā/ dha bi tā se/sogs sam/ dho tā/ dho tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling gi a tang la/dhū yāta/ dhū yā:/ dhū yā suḥ/ sogs dang / tang la iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ dha be+e ྾ṣ+ṭa/ dha bi ྾ yā.ā+oṃ/ dha bi ྾ ran/ sogs sam/ rnyo ྾ṣ+ṭa—/ rjosogs so/ /kṛṭa la'ang iṭa yang na bar byas pas/ a tang la/dha bi byu ti/ sogs sam/ sgo gyi ti/ sogs so/ /tang la/ dha bi 6 te/sogs sam/ sgo 6 te/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng gi a tang la/a dha bi 6 ta/ sogs sam/ a ho 6 ta/ sogs so/ /tang la/ a dha kri 6ta/ sogs sam/ a rnyo 6 ta/ sogs so/ /717—872

ma yin pa la ring po 'os de ring por bsgyur bas/ gra tī tā/ gra tī tā ṅga/sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ gra hi dz+nyā sogs kyis saṃ pra sā ra ṇar bsgyur bas—/ kṛ t+yā ta/ kṛ khyaṭ+wā/ gre t+yā suḥ/ sogs so/ /thraṭa la/ bal dang po sogs kyis iṭa/ gra ha las loṭa ①ma yin pa sogs kyis ring por bsgyur bas/ gra tī 6 ti/ sogs dang / de bzhin du/ thrang la/ a gra tī 6ta②/ sogs so/ /༈ shrī 'tshe ba la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ pū la sogs pa rnams kyi thung ngu 'os thung ngur bsgyur bas/ laṭa la/ tsu ṇa ti/ sogs dang / leng la/ shrī bhā yāta/ sogs so/ /laṭa la/ shrī ṇ+ḍa tu/ sogs dang / lang la/ a 1 ①zlata/ sogs so/ /lung la/ iṭa byin/setsa la 'phel ba sogs kyis 'phel ba byas pas/ a shā rīta/ a shā riṣ+ṭi/a shā ri 6ཿ/ sogs so/ /shrī dzā/ shrī hra rjoswo bā/ shrī dṛ dzā rnams kyi thung ngu'o—/ /shrī 'tshe ba/ dzā rnam ⑤par 'joms pa/ spru skyong bar byed pa rnams kyi liṭa bsgyur duba'i ka nga 'gro ba rnams pha rol la thung ngur yang na bsgyur te/thung ngur bsgyur ba'i phyogs la/ ika gi atsa la yaṇa ⑦dang thung ngur ma bsgyur ba'i phyogs la/ ṛts+tsha ti dzāta rnams kyi 'os yon tan byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ sha shā ra/ sha shra tuḥ/ sha sha ra tuḥ/ sha shuḥ/ sha sha ruḥ/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ sha sha ri tha/ sha shra thuḥ/ sha sha ra thuḥ/ sha shra/sha sha ra/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ sha shā ra/ sha sha ra/ sha shri ba/ sha sha ri ba/ sha shri ma/ sha sha ri ma/ liṭa la/ thra dzāta dag las yang na 'os/iṭa dang yīṭa yang na bar byas pas/ sha ri tā/ sha ri tā si/ sogs sam/117—874

༈ dz+nyā lang tsho nyams pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ ha laḥ/hal rnams so/ /byings mtha' saṃ pra sā ra ṇa byas pa yin na de'i pha rol tu rkyen hal dang po can byung na ring por bsgyur bar bya ste/ dz+nyā la shā gri 4sna hi dz+nyā sogs kyis saṃ pra sā ra ṇar rngubasgyur bas/ dzi nā zhes pa la mdo 'dis ring por bsgyur/de be+er yang pū /3la sogs pa rnams kyi thung ngu 'os/ thung ngur bsgyur bas/laṭa la/ dzi nā ti/ sogs dang / ling la/ dzi bhā yāta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ dzi nā tu/ sogs dang / lang la/ a dzi nāta/ sogs so/ /lung la/ yo sogs kyis saka dang iṭa byin pas/ a dz+nyā sīta/ a dz+nyā sebye/a dz+nyā 5si 6ཿ/ sogs so/ /liṭa la/ ṇal gnyis dang thal la gnyis rnams kyi sogs kyis a sgyu sa saṃ pra sā ra ṇa dang gzhan ldita rnams la gra ha chodz+nyā sogs kyis gnyis ka saṃ pra sā ra ṇar bsgyur ika gi atsa yaṇa bye byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dzi bye/ dzi bye tuḥ/ dzi dzuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/dzi byi tha/ dzi dzhai 3tha/ dzi bye thuḥ/ dzi bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dzi bye/ dzi byi ba/dzi dz+re ma/ luṭa la/ dz+nyā tā/ dz+nyā tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ gra ti sgodz+nyā sogs kyis saṃ pra sā ra ṇar bsgyur/ kṛta ma yin pa sogs kyis ring por bsgyur bas zu / dz+re yāta/ dzī yāspyo/ dzī yā suḥ/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ dz+nyā su ti/ sogs dang / kṛng la/ a dz+nyā myata/ sogs so/ /༈ bye sgrib pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams spyor te/ laṭa la/ bhā ṇa ti/ sogs dang / ling la/ bye bhā yāta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ bye ṇa tu/ sogs dang / lang la/ a pyo ṇata/ sogs so/ /lung la 'phel ba byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a gru ྾ ta/ a zebye/ a gru 6ཿ/117—877

skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a ze ྾ཿ/ a gru spya/ a byeṣ+ṭa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a gru ṣe/ a gru khya/ a ze ṣ+ṭha/ liṭa la/ gnyis brjod 'phel ba dang yon tan sogs byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ji shā ya/bi bra ya tuḥ/ pi bra yuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bi bra yi tha/ bi bye tha—/ bi bra ya thuḥ/ bi bra ya/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bi krā ya/ bi bra yaske/ bi bra yi pa/ bi bra yi ma/ luṭa la yon tan byas pas/ bye tā/ bye tā si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ sbyi yāta/ bye yā:/ bye yā suḥ/sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ yon tan byas pas/ bye t+ya ti/ sogs dang /kṛng la'ang de bzhin du yon tan byas pes/ a bre byuta/ sogs so/ /༈ dz+nyā khong du chud pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ dz+nyā dzan dag gi ①dzā 'os dzār bsgyur bas/ laṭa la/ dzā nā nyi/ sogs dang /ling la/ dzā rtswa yāta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ dzā nā tu/ sogs dang /lang la/ a dzā nāta/ sogs so/ /lung la/ yam ram nam sogs kyis saka dang iṭa byin pas/ a dz+nyā sītadze+e/ a dz+nyā si྾/ a dz+nyā si 6ཿ/ sogs so—/ /liṭa la gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis bsgrubs ①pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dza dzhai/ dza snyo tuḥ/ dza tshuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dza rnyi tha/ dza dz+nyā tha/ dza dzha thuḥ/ dza dzha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dza rnyi④/dza rnyi ba/ dza rnyi ma/ luṭa la/ dz+nyā tā/ dz+nyā tā ṅga/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la gzhan yang brtsegs pa sogs kyis er bsgyur ba dang mi bsgyur ba yang na bar byas pas/ dz+nyā duyāta/ dz+nyā yā:/ dz+nyā yā suḥ/ sogs sam/zlo yāta/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ dz+nyā su ti/ sogs dang / kṛng la/ a 177—878

༈ ku ṣa nges par 'gugs pa la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/laṭa la/ ku : ti/ sogs dang / ling la/ ku: yāta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ ku ṭ+wā tu/ sogs dang / lang la/ a ku: ta/ sogs so/ /ni raḥku ṣaḥ/ nir las ku ṣa las so/ /nyer bsgyur ni ra sngon ma'i ku ṣa las pha rol gyi byings phyed pa bal dang po can la iṭa yang na 'gyur te/ lung la iṭa byin pa'i phyogs la/ ni ra ko ྾ ta/ ni ra ko ṣi ñju①/ ni ra ko ṣi 6ཿ/sogs dang / iṭa med pa'i phyogs la/ shal ika u pa dh+wa sogs kyis ṅgi'i klar bsgyur/ sa la ṣa snye dag gi ka 'os/ ṣa ka kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur bas/ ni ra ku k+ṣa tā①/ ni ra ku k+ṣa hūṃ/ ni ra ku k+ṣan/sogs so/ /ni ra sngon du med na iṭa rtag tu 'gyur te/ a ko ྾ ta④/ a ko ṣiṣ+ṭi/ sogs so/ /liṭa la gnyis brjod/ ku ha dag gi tsu 'os/ ka tsar bsgyur bas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tsu ko ṣa/ tsa ku ṣa tuḥ/ tsu ku guḥrka/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tsu ko ṣi tha/ tsu ku ṣa thuḥ/ tsu ku ṣa/skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsu ko ṣa/ tsu ku ṣi ba/ tsu ku ṣi ma/ luṭa la iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ ko ṣi tā/ ko ṣi tā si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ku :ta/ ku t+yā:④/ kuṭī suḥ/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/ bal dang po'i iṭa byin/ puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ ko ṣi 6 ti/sogs dang / de bzhin du/ mṛng la/ a ko ṣi 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ a sha zas la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ laṭa la/ sa shā ti/ sogs dang / ling la/ a : yāta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ a shā tu/ sogs dang / lang la/ ā shāta/ sogs so/ /lung la iṭa byin 117—880

pas—/ ā shī ta/ ā shiṣ+ṭi/ ā shi 6ཿ/ sogs so/ /liṭa la gnyis brjod—/ aka 'dra ba la ring po byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ā sha /ā sha tuḥ/ ā shuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ā shi tha/ ā sha thuḥ—/ ā sha /skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ā sha/ ā shi ba/ ā shi ma/luṭa la/ iṭa byen pas/ a shita/ a shi tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la /a shāta/ a shā.ā+oṃ/ a shā suḥ/ sogs so/ /loṭa la iṭa byin pas/ a shi 6 ti/sogs dang / de bzhin du/ mṛng la/ ā shi 6ta/ sogs so/ /stsa/ thra yang dag par gus pa la'o zhes pa la tang rnams sbyor te/ laṭa la/dṛ bhā te/ sogs dang / ling la/ bṛ bhā ta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/dṛ ṭ+wā tsā/ sogs dang / lang la/ a thra ṇ+ḍi ta/ sogs so/ /lung la/thra dzāta las yang na 'os/ iṭa dang yīta 1yang na bar byas pas/ a ba riṣ+ṭa/a ba ri ṣā tsā/ a ba ri ṣa ta/ sogs sam/ a ba rīṣ+ṭa 4/ sogs so/ /'grel par dṛ la pha ro gyi lung dang / smon pa'i ling la yang na iṭa mi 'jug go zhes pa bshad pas/ ita ldum byin pa'i phyogs la/ dzhal dang po rnams la/gzugs thung ngu las kyang ngos/ se tsa phyis pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/a dṛ ta/ a thra ṣā hūṃ④ / a bṛ ṣa ta/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a bṛ thāḥ—/ a thra ṣā shaṃ/ a thra dhī/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a bṛ ṣi/ a bṛ ṣa hi/ a thraṣ+ṭha hi/ liṭa la gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis skyes bu dang po gsum la'u—/ ba bre/ ba bye te/ ba bri re/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ba dṛ ṣe—/ ba shā the/ ba bri dhī/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ba bre/ ba dṛ ba te/ba bṛ ma he/ luṭa la thra dzāta las yang na 'os/ iṭa dang yīṭa yang na bar 117—881

byasaske/ ba ri tā/ ba ri tā se/ sogs sam/ pa rī tā/ pa rī tā se/①sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ iṭa byin pas/ ba ri ྾ṣ+ṭa/ ba ri ྾ yāspyo/ba ri ྾ ran/ sogs dang / yang na iṭa ma byin pas/ dṛ ྾ṣ+ṭa/ sogs so—/ /kṛṭa la dṛ dzāta las yang na 'os/ iṭa dang yīṭa yang na bar byas pas/pa ri 6 te/ sogs sam/ pa rī 6 te/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ dzang la—/ a pa ri 6 ta/ sogs sam/ a pa rī 6 ta/ sogs so/ /i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa su sru tāskyud yaḥ/ sa māp+ta/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las shrī la sogs pa rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las 4 la sogs pa byed pa po'i don la shapa kyi yul la shā 'jug pa rnams kyi cho ga spyir btang dmigs ①bsal dang bcas pa rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //da ni tsu ra la sogs pa rnams kyi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ ༈ tsu ra rku ba ①la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ sa t+yā pa pā sha rū pa spru rjoṇ+ḍa tū la sh+lau ka se nā lo ma twa tsa bar+ṇa tsarma tsur+ṇa tsu rā di bh+yo ṇitsa/ sa t+yā pa bden pa pā sha zhags pa rūpagazugasabīṇ+ḍasgra brnyan tū laphra mo sh+lau ka tshigs bcad ⑤se na sde lo ma spu twa tsa pags pabar+ṇa mdog tsarmapags pa tsur+ṇa phye ma tsu ra la sogs pa rnams las ṇi rjotsa'o/ /sa t+yā pa la sogs pa rtags de rnams dang / byings tsu ra la sogs pa rnams las rang don la ṇitsa pha rol tu 'gyur te/ tsa dbyangs don dang ṇa 'phel ba'i don no/ /117—882

tsu ra la/ ṇitsa puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ tso ri zhes pa grub pa la laṭa sogs sbyar/ byed pa po la shapa byings thams cad pa sogs kyis yon tan etsa'i a ya sogs kyis mtshams sbyar bas/ laṭa la/ tso ra ya ti/sogs dang / ling la/ tso ra yeta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ tso ra ya tu/sogs dang / lang la/ a tsor yata/ sogs so/ /ṇi tsabya/ ṇitsa las kyang ngo / /ṇitsa'i mtha' las kyang byed pa po la sems dang ldan pa 'bras bu thob pa'i don la ād+ma sneṣ+pe pa da rnams 'jug ste/ laṭa la/ tso ra ya te/sogs dang / ling la/ tso ra ya ta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ tso ra ya tī/sogs dang / lang la/ a tso ra ya ta/ sogs so/ /lung la/ tso ri la/lung ṅgi byin/ ṇi shri sogs kyis ṅgi tsang du bsgyur/ tsang la 'os byings gnyis brjod/ hal dang po sogs kyis ra phyis/ yang ba'i ring po 'os/a sgyu sa ring por bsgyur/ ṇi la tsang la u pa dh+wa'i thung ngu 'os/ u pa d+mā thung ngur bsgyur/ ṇi'i iṭa med pa la 'os ṇitsa'ang phyis pas/ a tang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a tsu tsu rata/ a tsū tsu ra tsā/ a tsū tsu ran/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a tsū tsu raḥ/ a tsū tsu ra tai/ a tsū tsu ra ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a tsū tsu ram̐/ a tsū tsu rā ba/ a tsū tsu rā ma/ ṇitsa las kyang ngos tang rnams sbyar na/ a tsū tsu ra ta/ a tsū tsu ra tī/ a tsū tsu ran+ta / sogs so/ /liṭa la/ kās sogs kyis ām sbyar byings thams cad pa dang byings phyed pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ tso ra yī tsa ka ra/ tso ra lnga ba bhū ba/ tso ra yā mā sa/ tso ra dze+e tsa kre/ sogs so/ /luṭa la/iṭa byin/ byings thams cad pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ tso ra yi tā/117—883

tso ra yi tā si/ sogs dang / ṇitsa las kyang ngos/ tang la/ tso ra yi ①tā/tso ra yi tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ṇi'i iṭa med pa la 'os ṇi tsa phyis pas/ tsor+yā ta/ tsor+yā ༈/ tsor+yā suḥ/ sogs dang / ṇi tsa las kyang ngos tang rnams sbyor na/ bal dang po'i iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/tso ra yi ྾ṣ+ṭa/ tso ra yi ྾ yātram̐/ tso ra yi ྾ ran/ sogs so/ /loṭa ②la iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ tso ra yi 6 ti/ sogs dang / ṇitsa la'ang ngos/tang la/ tso ri yi 6 te/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ kṛng la/ a tso ra yi 6 ta/ sogs dang / a tso ra yi 6 ta①/ sogs so/ /'grel par lung drangs pa/ tsu rā dernyitsa bā ke tsita/ tsu ra la sogs pa rnams las ṇitsa 'ga' zhig tu yang na'o/ /tsu ra la sogs pa rnams las skabs 'ga' zhig tu ṇitsa yang na bar byed de/ byed pa po la shapa sbyar bas/ laṭa la/ tso ra ti/sogs dang / ling la/ tso reta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ tso ra tu/sogs dang / lang la/ a tso rata/ sogs so/ /lung la/ iṭa byen puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a tso rītaske/ a tso riṣ+ṭi/ a tso ri 6ཿ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a tso rīḥ/a tso ri—/ a tso riṣ+ṭa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a tso ri ṣe/ a tso ri khya/a tso riṣ+ṭha/ ④liṭa la gnyis brjod pa sogs byas pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ tsu tso ra/ tsu tsu ra tuḥ/ tsu tsu ruḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la—/ tsu tso ri tha/ tsu tsu ra thuḥ/ tsu tsu ra/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ tsu tso ra/ tsu tsu ri ba/ tsu tsu ri ma/ luṭa la iṭa byen yon tan byas pas/tso ri tā/ tso ri tā si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i leng la u pa d+ma'i 'ang ngos 117—884

ling la/ ga ṇa yeta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ ga ṇa ya tu/ sogs dang /lang la/ a ga ṇa yata/ sogs so/ /lung la/ yī tsa ga ṇaḥ/ ga ṇa'i yī 'ang ①ngo / /ṇi tsang dang bcas pa pha rol la ga ṇa'i a sgyu sa'i ā+o yang na ste/ṇi shri sogs kyis ṅgi tsang du bsgyur/ tsang la 'os byengs gnyis brjod/ ku ha dag gi tsu 'os/ ga dza mdo 'dis yīr yang na bsgyur ṇi'i iṭa med pa la 'os/ṇitsa phyis pas/ dzī ga ṇata/ dzī ga ṇa tsā/ dzī ga ṇan/ sogs sam/ dza ga ṇata/snyeskabs 'dir aka phyis pa yin pas ṇi tsang la/ san bzhin gyi bya ba mi 'jug go/ /sogs so/ /leṭa la/ ām ②sbyar bas/ ga ṇa yī tsa kā ra/ ga ṇa lnga ba byu ba/ ga ṇa yā mā sa/ sogs so/ /luṭa la iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ ga ṇa yi tā/ga ṇa yi snetā si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ṇi'i iṭa med pa la 'os ṇitsa phyis pas/ ga sgyu ta/ ga sgyu.ā+oṃ/ ga sgyu suḥ/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la/iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ ga ṇa yi byu ti/ sogs dang / mṛng la/ a ga ṇa yi 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ ka tha dag gi rgyun la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ ata kyi dbyi 'os a phyis/ a phyis pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'phel ba mi byed/ shapa la yon tan byas pas/ laṭa la/ ka tha ya ti/ sogs dang / ling la/ ka tha yeta—/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ ka tha ya tu/ sogs dang / lang la/a ka tha yata/ sogs so/ /lung la 'grel par lung drangs pa/ ka jophobyu sa gya yī two ke tsidā/ ka tha'i rjo.a sgyu sa'i yī nyid 'ga' zhig tu yang na'o/ /ṇi tsang dag pha rol la ka tha'i a sgyu sa'i ā+o nyid skabs 'ga' zhig tu yang na bar bya ste—/ ṇi shri sogs kyis ṅgi tsang du bsgyur/ tsang la 'ang ngos byengs gnyis 117—886

brjod / lung 'dren 'di'i yīr bsgyur ba dang mi bsgyur ba yang na bar byas/ṇi'i ita lkumed pa la 'os/ ṇitsa phyis pas/ a ṭī ka thata/ a ṭī ka tha tsā/a ṭī ka than/ sogs sam/ a tsa ka thata/ skabs 'dir a ka phyis pa yin pas ṇi tsang la san bzhin gyi bya ba mi byed do/ /sogs so/ /liṭa la ām sbyar bas/ ka tha yī tsa kā ra/ka tha yī ba khyu ba/ ka tha yā mā sa/ sogs so/ /luṭa la iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ a ka tha yi tā/ a ka tha yi tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la—/ ṇi iṭa med pa la 'os ṇi phyis pas/ ka byāta/ ka byā.ā+oṃ/ ka byā suḥ/sogs so/ /mṛṭa la iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ ka tha yi 6 ti/ sogs dang / de bzhin du/ mṛng la/ a ka tha yi 6ta/ sogs so/ /cha/ e ka 'gro ba dang mtshan nyid dag la'o zhes pa la'ang a tang rnams sbyor te/ ata kyi dbyi 'os byings mtha'i a phyis pas/ laṭa la/ e ka ya ti/sogs dang / ling la/ e ka yeta/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/ e ka ya tu/sogs dang / lang la/ dze+e ka yata/ sogs so/ /lung la/ 'grel par e ka'i tsang pha rol la atsa gnyis mi brjod par ka gnyis brjod pa 'am yang na ka ṇitsa dang bcas pa gnyis ñchabarjod do zhes bshad pas ka gnyis brjod pa'i phyogs la/ sde tsa kata/ slo tsa ka tsā/ dze+e tsa kan/ sogs dang / ṇitsa dang bcas pa gnyis brjod pa'i phyogs la yang ṇa'i iṭa med pa la 'os ṇi phyi ma phyis pas/ sde tsi kata/ slo tsi ka tsā/ dze+e tsi kan/ sogs so/ /liṭa la ām sbyar bas/ saṃ ka lnga ba bhū ba/ e ka yī tsa kā ra/ saṃ ka yā mā sa/sogs so/ /luṭa la iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ saṃ ka yi tā/ e ka yi tā si—/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ṇi'i iṭa med pa la 'os ṇitsa phyis 117—887

ra ṇa gya sru tā sgo rā da yaḥ/ sa mābhāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byu ka ra ṇa'i mdo las tsu ra la sogs pa rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin zis su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las/ tsu ra la sogs pa rnams kyi cho ga spyor btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //de ltar byu la sogs pa 1byings sde tshan bcu la rnam dbye brgya dang brgyad cu'am / la yig sde tshan bcu sbyar ba'i bya ba byed tshul gyi rnam 'gyur rags pa rnams bshad zin nas/ da ni byings byings su bsgrub pa dang / ming byings su bsgrub pa'i rkyen mtha' can kyi bya ba rnams bshad par bya ste/ de yang dang po ṇi tsa ni/ te tu ma ti tsā he tuḥ/ rgyu dang bcas pa dang rgyu med pa las kyang ngo //rgyu dang bcas pa ste rang gi dgos don gyi bya ba rang gis byed pa'am/ gzhan zhig byed du 'jug pa'i don dang rgyu med pa ste/ gzhan kyi bya ba zhig rang gis byed pa'am/ gzhan zhig byed du 'jug pa rtogs par byed pa la'ang byings las pha rol tu ṇitsa 'gyur te/ kṛ la ṇi tsa/ a tsa'i nyaṇa 'gro ba la'o zhes pas 'phel ba byas/ kā ri zhes grub pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ laṭa —kā ra ya ti/ling kā ra yeta/ loṭa kā ra ya tu/ lang — a kā ra yata/ sogs dang /lung la ṇi shri sogs kyis ṅgi tsang du bsgyur/ tsang la 'os byings gnyis brjod/ṛ'i ata 'os ṛ a/ ku ha dag gi tsu/ ṇi la tsang la u pa dh+wa thung ngu 'os/u pa dh+wa thung ngur bsgyur/ aka ma phyis pa la yang ba la tsang pha rol la san 117—891

bzhin nos/ a sgyu sa'i a i yang ba'i ring po 'os/ de ring por bsgyur/ṇi'i iṭa med pa la 'os/ ṇi tsa phyis ra drangs pas/ a ṭī ka rata/ a ṭī ka ra hūṃ/ a ṭī ka ran/ sogs so/ /leṭa la ām sbyar bas/ kā ra lnga ba byu ba/ kā ra yī tsa kā ra/ ka ra ①yā mā sa/ sogs so/ /luṭa la iṭa byin snepas/ kā ra yi tā/ kā ra yi tā se/ sogs so/ /spon pa'i ling la ṇi iṭa med pa la 'os ṇi itsa phyis pas/ kārluta/ kārluste/ kārlu suḥ/sogs so/ /kṛṭa la iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ kā ra yi 6 ti/ sogs dang / de bzhin du/ kṛng la/ a kā ra yi 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ tsu ra la rgyu dang bcas pa dang rgyu med pa la'ang ngos/ ṇitsa sbyar/puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ tso ri zhes grub pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ laṭa—tso ra ya ti/ ling—tso ra yeta/ loṭasnyetso raya tu/ langaskyi.a tso ra yata/ lung la/ nā glo pi shā smṛ di tsā/ aka phyis pa dang shā su ṛta 'gro ba rnams kyi ma yin no/ /byings kyi mtha' nas aka so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge phyis pa dang / shā su ①rjes su bstod pa dang / byengs ṛta 'gro ba rnams kyi tsang pha rol na yod pa'i ṇi la u pa d+mā thung ngur bsgyur ba ma yin no zhes pas u pa dh+wa thung ngur bsgyur ba mi thob kyang / 'grel par tsu ra la sogs pa rnams ni rtag tu ṇitsa'i mtha' can yin pas aka phyis pa yin kyang tsang pha rol la u pa d+dhā thung ngur bsgyur ba dang mi bsgyur ba yang na bar byed do zhes bshad pas/ thung ngur bsgyur ba'i phyogs la/ ṇi shri sogs kyis ṅgi tsang / tsang la 'os gnyis brjod u pa dh+wa thung ngur bsgyur/ ṇi'i iṭa med pa la 'os ṇitsa phyis pas/ a tsu tsu rata—/ a tsu tsu ra hūṃ/ a tsu tsu ran/ sogs dang / yang na gzhan cho ga 117—892

rnams 'dra ba la u pa jo thung ngur ma bsgyur bas/ a tsu tso rata/ a tsu tso ra tī / a tsu tso ran/ sogs so/ /liṭa la ā sbyar bas/ tso ra yī ba bhū ba/tso ra lnga tsa kā ra/ tso ra yā mā sa/ sogs so/ /luṭa la iṭa byin pas/ tso ra yi tā/ tso ra yi tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ṇi'i iṭa med pa la 'os ṇi tsa phyis pas/ tsor+yāta/ tsor+yā.ā+oṃ/ tsor+yā suḥ/ sogs so/ /liṭa la iṭa byen yon tan byas pas/ tso ra yi 6 ti/ sogs dang / de bzhin du/ mṛng la/ a tso ra yi 6ta/ sogs so/ /myu/ shā su ① rjes su bstod pa la'o zhes pa la rgyu dang bcas pa dang rgyu med pa la'ang ngos ṇitsa sbyar bas/ shā se zhes grub pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/laṭa —shā sa ya ti/ ling —shā sa yeta/ loṭa——shā sa ya tu/ langasnyephyag shā sa yata/lung la/ ṇi shri sogs kyis ṅgi tsang du bsgyur/ tsang la 'os byings gnyis brjod—/ aka phyis pa shā su ṛta 'gro ba rnams kyi ma yin no/ /u pa dh+wa thung ngur mi bsgyur ṇi'i iṭa med pa la 'os ṇi phyis pas/ a sha shā sata/ a sha shā sa hūṃ/ a sha shā san/ sogs so/ /liṭa la/ ām spyor bas/ shā sa yī ba bhū ba/ shā sa yī tsa kā ra/ shā sa yā mā sa/ sogs so/ /luṭa la iṭa byen yon tan byas pas/ shā sa yi tā/ shā sa yi tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ṇi'i iṭa med pa la 'os ṇitsa phyis pas/ shā sngata/ shāsnga.ā+oṃ/shā snga suḥ/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la iṭa byin pas/ shā sa yi 6 ti/ sogs dang / de bzhin du/ mṛng la/ a shās yi 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ rto kṛ 'gro ba la'o zhes pa la/ rgyu dang bcas pa sogs kyis ṇitsa byen/rjes 'brel phyis pas/ rnyo ki zhes pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ laṭasnyernyo ka ya ti/117—893

ling snyerto ka yata/ loṭa snyernyo ka ya tu/ langasnye.a phyo ka yata/ sogs dang /lung la/ ṇi shri sogs kyis ṅgi tsang du bsgyur/ tsang la 'os gnyis brjod/thung ngu 'os thung ngu dang a sgyu sa'i tsar 'ang ngos/ rte ḍa aka phyis pa shā sa ṛta 'gro ba sogs kyis u pa dh+wa thung ngur mi bsgyur ṇi'i iṭa med pa la 'os ṇi phyis pas—/ a che phyo kata/ a che rnyo ka tī/ a che phyo kan/ sogs so/ /liṭa la—/ ām sbyar bas/ rto ka yī tsa kā ra/ sogs so/ /luṭa la iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ phyo ka yi tā/ rnyo ka yi tā se/ sogs dang / smon pa'i leng la/ ṇi'i iṭa med pa la 'os ṇi phyis pas/ phyo kyā ta/ dhi kyā spyo/phyo kyā suḥ/ sogs so/ /kṛṭa la iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ bye ka yi 6 ti/sogs dang / de bzhin du/ kṛng la/ a phyo ka yi 6 ta/ sogs so/ /༈ ṭu o ①shi 'gro ba dang 'phel ba dag la'o zhes pa la/ rgyu dang bcas pa sogs kyis ṇi tsa sbyar/ a tsa'i nyaṇa 'gro ba la 'os 'phel ba dang etsa'i a ya sogs kyis/ shā yi zhes pa grub pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ laṭasnyeshāyaya tiske/ lingasnyeshāyayeta/ loṭasnyeshāyayatu/ lang—a shā ya ya ta/ sogs so//ḍo tsa saṃbyu ngoḥ/ /ṇi la'ang san tsang dag la'o/ /shwa ya ti ṇi la'ang san tsang dag pha rol la saṃ pra sā ra nar ④yang ṇa bsgyur te/ lung la saṃ pra sā ra ṇi'i ①phyogs la/ shi ṇi tsa ces pa la/ ṇi shi sogs kyis ṅgi tsang / mdo 'dis saṃ pra sā ra ṇar bsgyur/ shu ṇi tsang tsang la 'os gnyis brjod/ yang ba'i ring po 'os—/ de ring por bsgyur/ a tsa'i nyaṇa rjo'agro ba la 'os 'phel ba etsa sogs kyis au ā bar bsgyur/ ṇi la tsang la u pa dh+wa'i thung ngu 'os/ u pa d+dhā thung ngur bsgyur/ de nas ṇi'i iṭa med pa la 'os ṇi phyis pas/ a shu sha bta/117—894

thung ngu 'os/ thung ngur bsgyur/ ṇi'i iṭa med pa la 'os ṇitsa phyis/ bi sngon—/ stasbru shā su sa ha sogs kyis sa ṣar mi bsgyur te/ bya sī ṣa tata1 /bya sī ṣaha hūṃ1/ bya sbo ṣa han/ sogs so/ /liṭa la ām sbyar bas/ sā ha lnga tsa kā ra/ sogs so/ /luṭa la iṭa byen pas/ sa hi tā/ sogs so//smon pa'i ling la/ sā t+yā ta/ sā t+yā stu/ sā t+yā suḥ/ sogs so/ /loṭa la/iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ sā ha yi 6 ti/ sogs dang / de bzhin du/mṛng la/ a sā ha yi 6ta/ sogs so/ /myu/ tsa kā mṛ sgra smad pa la'o zhes pa la/ rgyu dang bcas pa sogs kyis ṇi tsa sbyar bas/ tsa kā se zhes grub pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ laṭa —tsa kā sa ya ti/ lingasnyetsa kā sa yeta/ loṭasnyetsa kā sa ya 1 tu/ lang——a tsa kā sa yata/sogs dang / lung la/ ṇi shri sogs kyis ṅgi tsang / tsang la 'os tsa gnyis brjod / aka ma phyis pa la yang ba la tsang pha rol la san bzhin nos/ a i ④yang ba'i ring po 'os de ring por bsgyur/ aka phyis pa shā su ṛta 'gro ba sogs kyis u pa ṅgā thung ngur mi bsgyur/ ṇi'i iṭa med pa la 'os/ ṇi phyis pas/a ṭī tsa kā sata/ a ṭī tsa kā sa tsā/ a ṭī tsa kā san/ sogs so/ /'grel par lung drangs pa/ sud+dhā to ra ṣ+pe kā tsabya sanaṅka tsi dā/ supa kyi byings dang atsa gcig ma yin pa'i san bzhin 'ga' zhig tu yang na'o/ /supa kyi byings rnams dang byings atsa gcig ma yin pa rnams kyi ṇi tsang pha rol la san bzhin gyi bya ba skabs 'ga' zhig tu yang na bar bya ste/ lung la gzhan cho ga sngon ma dang 'dra ba la/ ir bsgyur ba sogs ma byas pas/ a tsa tsa kā sata/ a tsa tsa kā sa hūṃ/ a tsa tsa kā san/ sogs so/ /liṭa la ām sbyar pas/ tsa kā sa 117—897

sa sogs kyis u pa jo thung ngur bsgyur ba dang mi bsgyur ba yang na bar byas pas/a pi pi ḍa ta/ sogs sam/ a pi spru ḍa ta/ sogs so/ /la yig phyi ma rnams la/liṭasnyespru ḍa lnga tsa kā ra/ luṭa—r+pā ḍa yi tā/ smonalingasnyespru sgyuta/ dzaṭasnyespru ḍa yi 6 ti/dzang—a spru ḍa yi 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ ka ṇa sgra la'o zhes pa la rgyu dang bcas pa sogs kyis ṇitsa sbyar/ u pa dh+wa'i 'os 'phel ba byas pas/ kā ṇi zhes grub pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/laṭa—kā ṇa ya tī①/ ling—kā ṇa yeta/ loṭasnyekā ṇa ya tu/ langarko.a kā ṇa yata/sogs dang / lung la/ ka ṇa ra ṇa ba ṇa bha ṇa shra na tīh+la pa lu pa lu ṭha he ྾ tsa/ka ṇa ra ṇa ba ṇa bha ṇa shra ṇa twonya la pa lu pa lu ṭha hā i ṣa rnams kyi'ang ngo / /ka ṇa ra ṇa ba ṇa bha ṇa ④rnams sgra/ sha ①ṇa 'tshed pa/ tīnya 'dren pa/ la pa yongs su brjod pa/ lu pa sbed pa/ lu ṭha srub pa/ o hāka gtong ba/i 6 'dod pa rnams kyi'ang ṇi dang bcas pa'i tsang pha rol la u pa dh+wa thung ngur bsgyur ba dang mi bsgyur ba yang na bar bya ste/ thung ngur bsgyur ba'i phyogs la san bzhin byi bya ba 'jug cing / thung ngur ma bsgyur ba'i phyogs la san bzhin gyi bya ba'ang mi 'jug ste/ a ṭī ka ṇata/ sogs sam/ a tsa kā ṇata/ sogs so/ /la yig lhag ma rnams la/ liṭa—kā ṇa lnga tsa kā ra// luṭasnyekā ṇa yi tā/ smonalingarkokā sgyuta / dzaṭa—kā ṇa yi t+yata/ dzang—a kā ṇa yi 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ raṇa sgra la'o zhes pa la ṇi tsa sbyar/ u pa dh+wa'i 'phel ba 'os 'phel ba byas pas/ rā ṇi zhes grub pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ laṭasnyerā ṇa ya ti/ling snyerā ṇa yeta/ loṭa—rā ṇa ya tu/ lang—a rā ṇa yata/ sogs dang / lung la/ka ra ṇa sogs kyi mdos/ u pa jo thung ngur bsgyur ba dang mi bsgyur ba yang na 117—911

ga ma dag yang na 'gyur te/ laṭa—lī na ya ti/ lungasnye.a li li nata/ sogs dang / 'grel par lung drangs pas/ pa lo bha nā rnyi bha ba pu dzā su li yo ni t+ya mā twa ma shi ti bā rtsu/ 'jigs pa sngon byung mchod pa rnams la lī dag gi sha 'gro ba ma yin pa la ā nyid rtag tu brjod do/ /līng sbyor ba dang lī chung ngur gyur pa dag gi 'jig pa dang sngon byung ba dang mchod pa rnams kyi ①don dang sbyar ba na sha 'gro ba ma yin pa'i rkyen gang byung yang ā ②nyid du rtag tu brjod par bya ste/laṭasnyeta/pa ya ti/rkolīng dang lī gnyis ka bsgrub lugs dang gzugs gnyis ka 'dra ste āta du bsgyur nas puka byin pa'o/ /lung—al la pata/ sogs so/ /li yaḥsaṃ mān na shā lī rī ka ra ṇa yo stsa/lī las kun nas gus pa dang gnod pa dag la yang na'o/ /lī ṇitsa'i mtha' can las kun nas gus pa dang gnod pa byed pa dang rab tu thob pa la yang laṭa sogs āt+pa ṣ+pe pa da rnams 'gyur te/ dza ṭā bhi rā lā pa ya te/—ral pa can rnams la kun nas gus par 'dod/ bye no brti kā mu1 pa ya te/snyekhras co ka la gnod pa byed par 'dod/ kastu mup+lu pa ya te/snyekhyod su thob par 'dod/ sogs so/ /༈ nyi dhī 'jigs pa la'o zhes pa la ṇitsa/ bi bhe terte tu bha ye/ bi bhe ①ti'i 'jigs pa'i rgyu la'o/ /'jigs pa'i rgyu brjod pa las bi ste ti'i mtha' ṇitsa pha rol la āta du yang na bsgyur ro/ /'grel par lung drangs pa/ pra yo dza kārtse yi tsa bā rtsu/ 'jigs pa'i sbyor ba las kyang brjod do/ /'jigs pa'i rgyur ma zad 'jigs pa sbyor ba las kyang bi bhe ti'i ṇitsa pha rol la āta du yang na bsgyur ro/ /bhāsmyorte tu bha ye/ dī smi dag las 'jigs pa'i rgyu la'o/ /bhā dang ྾ cung zad rgod pa dag las 'jigs pa'i rgyu brjod pa la tang rnams sbyor te/bi ste ti'i 'jigs pa'i rgyu la 'os āta du bsgyur/ arti dī sogs kyis puka ā ga 117—924

sogs so/ /i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gya sru tāta ṇi dzad+dhāḥs mābhāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las ṇitsa mtha' can rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ①ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las ṇitsa'i dāmatha' can rnams kyi cho ga rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //༈ gnyis pa byings byings su bsgrub pa'i rkyen san gyi 'jug yul rnams bshad par bya ste/ d+dhā toḥkarma ṇaḥs mā na kaj-i kā ditshwa yī bā/ byings las las dang 'dod pa byed pa po mnyam pa las yang na'o/ /byings las pha rol tu bya ba'i las dang 'dod pa'i don byed pa po mnyam pa la tshig phrad du bya'o/ /a mā ba gyata ra sri/ a mā ba si yang na'o/ /a mā sngon ma'i ba sa nges par gnas pa la byuta 'gyur zhing 'phel ba yang na bar bya ste/ a mā bā snga/— gnas stong / amā ba snga/snyeganasastong / pa daḥsu pi kyastsa/ supa la bad las kyapa 'ang ngo / /supa las pha rol gyi bad smra ba la yata 'gyur zhing kyapa kyang 'gyur te/kyapa kyi pa tuka ā ga ma'i don dang / ka yig ka nga 'gro ba sogs kyi don te/brad+mā snga ma'i bad la kyapa/ ba tsi swa pi yadza la sogs pa rnams kyi ka 'gro ba la 'os/ saṃ pra sā ra ṇar bsgyur/ a las yon tan nos mtshams sbyar bas/brazo bye/ tshangs pa 'i brjod pa/ yang na yata sbyar/ brah+ma ba bye/snyetshangs pa'i brngod pa/ bhu bo bhā be/ byu las dngos po la'o/ /supa las pha rol gyi byu yod pa la dngos po brjod pa la kyapa 'gyur te/ brah+ma bhū yi ga ta/snyetshangs par gyur pa rtogs/ supa las pha 117—941

༈ bhū yod pa la'o zhes pa la san sbyar/ sa ni gra ha gu hostsa/ gra ha gu ha dag gi 'ang san la'o/ /gra ha nye bar len pa dang / gu snu kun nas sgrib pa dang 'ang sgras byengs mtha' uka so sor bsdu ba rnams las ①pha rol gyi san la iṭa mi 'gyur te/ gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis ②bsgrubs pas/ bu bhū ④ṣa zhes grub pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ laṭasnyebu byu ṣa ti/ lungasnye.a bu bhū ྾ta/liṭa—bā bhū ྾ tsa kā ra/ sogs so/ /༈ de bzhin du/ hu byin pa la san sbyar/ mdo 'dis iṭa mi 'jug /atsa han gam rnams kyi san la 'os ring por bsgyur gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis dubasgrubs pas/ dzu snu ṣa zhes pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ laṭasnyedzu tū ṣa ti/lungasnye.a dzu snu ྾ta/ liṭasnyedzu tū ྾ tsa kā ra/ sogs so/ /༈ gu snu kun nas sgrib pa la'o zhes pa la san gnyis brjod ku ha dag gi tsu ha'i rte 'os/ ha bye atsa gcig pa'i bha ṣa mtha' sogs kyis ga gha/ sa la ṣa bhā dag gi ⑤ka 'os/ bhā ka kun nas bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa ṣar bsgyur/dzu bhu k+ṣa zhes pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ laṭasnyedzu ghu k+ṣa ti/ lungasnye.a dzu ghu spyita/liṭasnyedzu ghu spyo tsa ka ra/ sogs so/ /༈ gra ha nye bar len pa la san sbyar/ ru da bi da mu ṣa gra hi swa pi pra tsā( steḥsaṃbyu / ru da bi da mu ṣa gra hi swa pi pra tsha las san 'ang ngo / /ru da mchi ma 'dzag pa/ bi da shes pa/ mu ṣa rku ba/ gra ha nye bar len pa/ swa pi nyal ba—/ prats+tsha shes par 'dod pa rnams las pha rol gyi kṛta sogs kyi rkyen k+ta dang san yang ka 'gro ba'i ming can te/ san kita yin pas/ gra hi dz+nyā sogs kyis saṃ pra sā ra ṇar bsgyur/ gnyis brjod ṛ'i ata dang / san la ita ha'i bye 117——951

dang po sogs kyis sa phyis/ khar la tsar 'os dha tar bsgyur bas/ laṭa—pra ti ṛt+pati—/ —so sor 'tshe bar 'dod/ sogs so/ /'tshe ba'i don min na is su mi 'gyur bas| gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis ①bsgrubs pas/ laṭasnye.ā rirāt+pa ti/snyekun du 'grub par 'dod/ lung—ā ri rātho ta/ liṭa—ā ri rādz+nyā tsa kā ra/ sogs so/ /༈ mu dṛ gro ba la ⑧la'o zhes pa la san sbyar/ mu tsopho karma su gu ḍo pā/mu tsa'i las ma yin pa'i yon tan la yang na'o/ mu tsa'i las kyi don la sbyar ba ma yin pa 'dod pa kho na'i don la 'jug pa na iṭa med pa'i san pha rol la u pa dh+wa yon tan du yang na bsgyur zhing bsgyur ba na a sgyu sa yang dbye ste/ yon tan a sgyu sa phyis/ tsu'i ku 'os tsa kar bsgyur bas/ laṭasnyemok+ṣa ti/ lung—amo khye ta/ liṭa—mo spyo tsa kā ra/ sogs dang / las kyi don yin na yon tan mi byed pas/ laṭasnyemu mu k+ṣa ti/ lung—a mu mu spyi ta/ liṭa—mu mu hūṃ tsa kā ra/sogs so/ /༈ spru ra 'phro ba la'o zhes pa la ṇitsa sbyar/ tsinya sgru ra dag gi ṇi la yang na 'os āta du bsgyur bas/ swā ri zhes pa la san gnyis brjod/ shar dang po sogs kyis sa phyis/ a sgyu ①sa'i tsar 'ang ngos pha pa iṭa byen pas/ laṭa—pu swā ra yi ṣā ti/ lung —a pu swā ra yi ྾ta/ liṭa —pu swā ra yi ྾ tsa kā ra/sogs dang / yang āta du ma bsgyur ba'i phyogs la yon tan byas pas/laṭa—pu sgo ra yi ṣa rjoti/ lungasnye.a pu sgor yi ྾ ta/ liṭa—pu sgo ra yi ྾ tsa kā ra—/ sogs dang / /༈ k+ṣu sgra la'o zhes pa la ṇi sbyar 'phel ba byas pas/ k+ṣu bi ⑤zhes pa la san dang iṭa gnyis brjod/ hal dang po lhag 0po dang / ku ha dag 117—962 /

gi tsu 'os ka tsar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ laṭasnyetsuk+ṣu ba yi ṣa ti/lung a tsuk+ṣu ba yi ྾ta/ liṭasnyetsuk+ṣu ba yi ྾ tsa kā ra/ sogs so/ /myu/ pū dag pa la ṇitsa 'phel ba byas pas pā bi zhes pa la san dang iṭa gnyis brjod/ u'i pu yaṇa dzi a pha rol la 'os u ir bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ laṭasnyepi pā ba yi ṣa ti/ lungasnye.a pi pā ba yi ྾ta/ liṭa— pipā ba yi ྾ tsa kā ra/ sogs so/ /༈ bhū yod pa la ṇi tsa 'phel ba byas pas/ bhā bi zhes pa la san dang iṭa sbyar/ gnyis brjod/ u'i pu yaṇa dzi a pha rol la 'os u ir bsgyur bas—/ laṭasnyepi bhā ba yi ṣa 1 ti/ lung— bi bhā ba yi ྾ ta/ liṭa —bi bhā ba yi ྾ tsa kā ra/ sogs so/ /༈ yu bsre ba la'o zhes pa la be+etsa 'phel ba byas pas/ yā bi zhes pa la san dang iṭa/ gnyis brjod/ u'i pu yan sogs kyis u ir bsgyur bas/laṭasnyeyi duyā ba yi ṣa ti/ lung——ayiyāb yi ྾ta/ liṭa——yi yā ba yi ྾ tsa kā ra/sogs so/ /༈ de bzhin du/ ru sgra la'o zhes pa la ṇi tsa'i mtha' can la san dang iṭa sbyar/ gnyis brjod/ u'i pu yaṇa sogs kyis u ir bsgyur bas/laṭasnyeri rā ba yi ṣa ti/ lungasnye.a ri rā ba yi ྾ta/ liṭaskyiri rā ba yi ྾ tsa kā ra/sogs so/ /de dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ khrunya gcod pa la/ laṭasnyeli lāb yi ṣa ti/ lungasnye.a li lā ba yi ྾ ta/ liṭa——li yā 1ba yi ྾ tsa kā ra/ sogs so/ /༈ dzu 'gro ba la'o zhes pa la/ laṭasnyedzi dzā ba yi ṣa ti/ lungaskyi.a dzi dzā ba yi ṭī ta/ liṭasnyedzi dzā ba yi ྾ tsa kā ra/ sogs so/ /117—963

༈ lce bstod pa la ṇitsa sbyar 'phel ba byas pas/ nā bi zhes pa la san dang aṭa ①sbyar/ gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ laṭasnyenu nā ba yi ṣa ti/ lung—a nu nā ba yi ྾ ta/ liṭasnyenu nā ba yi ྾ tsa kā ra/ sogs so/ / sru 'gro ba la ṇitsa sbyar 'phel ba byas pas/ sru be+e zhes grub ②pa la san dang iṭa sbyar/ gnyis brjod/ sra pa ti/ 1 kho ti/ dra ba ti/ pra ba ti/ bla ba ti/ bya ba ti rnams kyi yang na 'os/ a sgyu sa ir bsgyur bas/laṭa—si sru ba yi ṣa ti/ lungasnye.a se sru ba yi ྾ ta/ liṭa—si sru ba yi ྾ tsa kā ra/sogs so/ /༈ ru tsa 'bar ba la'o zhes pa la san sbyar iṭa byen/ u i u pa khyu hal dang po dang ral las sana'ang ngos/ san iṭa dang bcas pa kita du yang na bar byas pas/ kita kyi phyogs la yon tan med/ kita ma yin pa'i phyogs la| puka mtha' sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ laṭasnyeru ro tsi ṣa ti/ lung—a ru ro tsi ྾ta/ liṭa —ru ro tsi ྾ tsa kā ra/ sogs sam/ laṭa —ru ru tsi ṣa ti/ sogs so/ /༈ de bzhin du/ li kha ri mo 'dri ba la'o zhes pa la san sbyar iṭa byin/san kita du yang na bar byas pas/ laṭa—li le khi ṣa ti/ lung—a li le khi ྾ ta/liṭa—li le khi ྾ tsa kā ra/ sogs sam/ laṭa—li likhi ṣa ti/ lung—a lili khi ྾ta/ liṭa—li li khri ྾ tsa kā ra/ sogs so/ /༈ ru dir mchi ma 'dzag pa la'o zhes pa la san dang iṭa/ ru da bi dmu ṣa sogs kyis san iṭa dang bcas pa kita yin pas yon tan mi byed/ laṭa—ru ru di ṣa ti/ lungasnye.a ru ru di ྾ta/ liṭasnyeru ru di ྾ tsa kā ra/ sogs so/ /117—964

byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las san mtha' can rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las san gyi mtha' can rnams kyi cho ga rags pa rnams re zhig sdogs so// //gsum pa byings byings su bsgrub 1pa'i rkyen yang gi 'jug yul rnams bshad par bya ste/ dh+wa to re kā tso ha khā deḥkri yā sa ma bhi hā re yang / byings atsa gcig pa hal dang po las bya ba yang dag par sdud pa la yang ngo / /rutsa 'bar ba dang shutsa mya ngan gnyis ma yin pa'i byings atsa gcig pa hal dang po can las bya ba yang dag par sdud pa ste shin tu ba dang yang yang gi don la yang pha rol tu 'gyur te/ nga yig ni san yang dag la 'os byings gnyis brjod pa'i don no/ /'grel par lung drangs pa/ sru tsi sru tri mū rgyaṭa ju shārto ti bh+yo yang /sru tsi sru tro mū tri aṭa ti arti a sha khrurto ti rnams las yang ngo / sru tsa phra ma/ sru tra rab tu grol ba/ rū tra rab tu 'dzag pa/ aṭa 'gro ba/ṛ 'gro ba/ a sha zas/ ukhunya 'gebs pa rnams las shin tu ba dang yang yang gi don la yang 'gyur ro/ /ni bye kau ṭi bye ga to/ 'gro ba la 'khyog po kho na la'o/ /'gro ba'i don gyi byings las shin tu ba dang yang yang gi don ma yin pa'i 'khyog por 'gro ba kho na'i don la 'jug pa na yang pha rol tu 'gyur ro/ /lu pa sa da tsa ra dza pa dza bha da ha da sha shrī bh+yo bhā ba garta yī/ lu pa sa da tsa ra dza pa dza bha da ha da sha shrī rnams las smad pa nyid la'o/ /lu bla gcod pa/117—967

ṣa dṛ rnam par 'gro ba/ tsa ra 'gro ba/ dza pa yid/ dza bha lus rnam par nyams pa/ da ha rmye thal bar byed pa/ da sha mche ba/ ṭ+wā gsal bar byed pa rnams las smad pa nyid la 'jug pa la yang 'gyur te bya ba yang dag par bsdu ba tsam la ni ma yin no/ /༈ sru tsa phra ma byed pa la'o zhes pa la yang / san yang dag la 'os gnyis brjod/ thung ngu 'os thung ngur bsgyur bas/ su sru tsa/ yang zhes pa la / gu no yang lu koḥ/ yang 'jig 1pa dag la yon tan no/ /yang gi rkyen 'jig pa dang mi 'jig pa dag pha rol la'ang a sgyu sa yon tan du bsgyur te/mdo 'dis yon tan byas pas/ so sru tsu zhes grub pa la/ laṭa sogs tang rnams sbyor te/ byed pa po la shapa ata las yon tan la 'os gnyis dag gi gcig sngon ma'i gzugs su bsgyur bas/ laṭa——so sru tsu te/ ling— so sru h+ye ta/loṭasnyeso sru tsu tī/ lang——a so sru tsu ta/ sogs dang / lung la/ ya su halaḥ / ya'i hal las so/ /byings mtha' hal las pha rol gyi ya'i byings phyed pa pha rol la dbyi bar bya ste/ mdo 'dis ya phyis/ byings phyed pa'i bal dang po la iṭa 'os iṭa byin pas/ a so sru cib/ a so sru tsi ṣā tsā/ a so sru tsi ṣa ta/ sogs so/ /liṭa la/ kās sogs kyi tshog sbyar/ ya'i hal las zu'os ya phyis pas/ so sru tsā tsa kre/ so sru rtswa ba byu ba/ so sru tsā ④mā sa/sogs so/ /la yig phyi ma rnams la bal dang po'i iṭa byin/ ya'i hal las sos / ya phyis pas/ luṭasnyesosru tsi tā/ r+sāling ——so sru tsi ྾ṣ+ṭa/ thraṭasnyeso sru tsi 6 te/ kṛng——a so sru tsi 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ rū tra rab tu 'dzag pa la yang sbyar/ gnyis brjod/ thung ngu 'os 117—968

༈ che krinya byed pa la'o zhes pa la yang / ṛta kyi rīng 'os ring du bsgyur/gnyis brjod/ thung ngu 'os thung ngur bsgyur/ dra phyis/ ku ha dag gi tsu/yang 'jig pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ laṭasnyetse grwa ya te/ lung——a tse shrī yiṣ+ṭa/ liṭasnyetse 4 yī tsa kre/ luṭasnyetse spri yi tā/ sogs so/ /sam sngon du byung na ka'i sngon du suṭa byin pas/ laṭasnyesī tse spyi ya te/ sogs so/ /༈ ṣi tsa srung ba la'o zhes pa la yang sbyar/ gnyis brjod/ yang 'jig pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ laṭa——se se tsu te/ lungasnye.a se si tsiṣ+ṭa/ liṭa——se si tsā tsa kre/ luṭasnyese si tsi tā/ sogs so/ /se tso ya di/ si tsa'i yang la'o se /'a sa yig ni nyer bsgyur dang a sgyu sa/ sa ṣar bsgyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can sngon du byung yang / yang pha rol la ṣar mi 'gyur te/ a sgyu rmyesa'i dper brjod bstan zin la/ nyer bsgyur la ni se se tsu te/ sogs so/ /༈ bra dza 'gro ba la'o zhes pa la yang / gnyis brjod/ hal dang po sogs kyis ra phyis/ ka 'gro ba ma yin pa sogs kyis ring bor bsgyur bas/laṭasnyebā pra bye te/ lung—a pā pra dziṣ+ṭa/ liṭasnyebā pra rdzu tsa kre/ luṭa—bā bra dzi tā/sogs so/ /༈ shrī gsal ba la'o zhes pa la/ yang / gro ya ji / shrī'i yang la'o/ /shrī'i ra yig ni yang pha rol la la yig tu bsgyur bar bya ste/ byings kyi dṛta zhukyi ita 'os dzā iṭa1/ ṛ'i aṇa la dra pha rol los dra/ mdo 'dis dra lngar bsgyur—/ gnyis brjod/ ku ha dag gi tsu dang / yang 'jig pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ laṭasnyedze gi be+e te/ lungasnye.a dze gi liṣ+ṭa/ liṭasnyedze gi dze+e ③tsa kre/ luṭa ——dze gi li tā/ sogs so/ /117—973

༈ lu bla gcod pa la'o zhes pa la/ yang sbyar/ gnyis brjod/ yang 'jig ①pa sogs kyis ②yon tan ④byas pas/ laṭasnyelo lupya te/ lung—a lo lu piṣ+ṭa/ liṭasnyelo lu r+pā tsa kre/ luṭasnyelo lu pi tā/ sogs so/ /༈ ku 'bar ba la'o zhes pa la/ yang sbyar/ na ka pa te r+ya ji / ka ba ti'i yang la ma yin no/ /ka ba ti'i a sgyu sa'i ka yig ni yang pha rol la tsa yig tu bsgyur ba ma yi te/ gnyis brjod/ yang 'jig pa sogs yon tan/mdos 'dis ka tsar mi bsgyur/ laṭa —ko kyu ya terjo/ lung—a ko kyu yiṣ+ṭa/liṭasnyeko kyu lnga tsa kre/ luṭasnyeko kyu yi tā/ sogs so/ /'grel par skabs 'gar tsar bsgyur ba'ang yod do zhes bshad pas/ laṭa—tso kyu ya te/ sogs so/ /༈ pazhu 'gro ba la'o zhes pa la/ yang sbyar/ bhā gzhu sre su dhī su ka sapa ta pa da skadz+nyā/ pazhu sre su dhī su ka sa/ pa ta pa da skan+da rnams kyi nīka'o/ /badzi 'gro ba/ sre su dang / bye su 'og tu lhung ba/ ka sa 'gro ba/ la dṛ ⑤rtsang ba—/ pa da 'gro ba/ skan+da 'gro ba rnams kyi yang gi rkyen gnas pa dang 'jig pa dag pha rol la a sgyu sa la smi ka ā ga ma 'gyur te/ ka gnas don no/ /gnyis brjod/ mdo 'dis nī ka ā dug ma/ glo bur ba kita yin pas a sgyu sa ring por bsgyur/ ita 'gro ba ma yin pa sogs kyis jita pha rol la na phyis pas/laṭasnyeb nī btsu te/ lungasnye.a ba rtswa ba tsiṣ+ṭa/ liṭasnyeb bhā ba tsā tsa kre/ luṭa—ba byā ba tsi tā/ sogs so/ /༈ sre su 'og tu lhung ba la'o zhes pa la/ yang gnyis brjod/ mdo 'dis nī ⑦ka ā ga ma byin/ ka 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan las a sgyu sa ring por mi 'gyur dra phyis/ ita 'gro ba ma yin pa sogs kyis na phyis pas/ laṭa—sanī 117—974

sogs so/ /༈ shīng nyal ba la'o zhes pa la/ yang sbyar/ a yang skru ti/ kā ①nga 'gro ba la a yang ngo / /rkyen pa yig dang po ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can pha rol la shing gi mtha' a yang du bsgyur te/ nga dbyangs 'gog pa'i don dang ya'i a brjod don no/ /yī a yang du bsgyur/ kita ma yin pa sogs kyis ring por bsgyur bas/ laṭa— shāsha yā te/ lungasnye.ashā sha yiṣ+ṭa/ liṭasnyeshā sha yī tsa kre/sogs so/ /༈ rnyo kṛ 'gro ba la'o zhes pa la/ yang sbyar/ gnyis brjod/ thung ngu 'os/au sprur bsgyur/ yang 'jig pa sogs kyis de slar yon tan/ a sgyu sa'i tsar 'ang ngos—/ rte ḍar bsgyur bas/ laṭasnyeḍo bye kya te/ ling—ḍo rnyo kye ta/ loṭasnyeḍo rnyo kya hūṃ/ lang—a ḍo rnyo kya ta/ lungasnye.a ḍo rto kiṣ+ṭa/ liṭasnyeḍo rnyo 4 tsa kre/ luṭasnyeḍo phyo ki tā/ smonaling snyeḍo rnyo ki ྾ṣ+ṭa/ thraṭasnyeḍo phyo ki t+ya te/ dzang—a ḍo rnyo ki 6ta/sogs so/ /i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa su sru tāta ya ngan+d+raḥs mābhāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las yang gi mtha' rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las yang rkyen gyi mtha' can rnams kyi cho ga spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //da ni yang rkyen 'jig pa'i cho ga rnams bshad par bya ste/ ya ngophotsi tsa/117——982

yang gi a tsa la yang ngo / /yang gi rkyen ni rkyen atsa dang po can pha rol dang gzhan yang mang po la 'jig go zhes pa ni spyir btang ba'o/ /rkyen phyis kyang rkyen gyi bya ba gnyis brjod pa sogs ni mi gnas pa ma yin no/ /yang gi rkyen gnas pa thams cad la laṭa sogs ata ma ṣ+pe pa da rnams sbyor zhing / yang rkyen 'jig pa thams cad la laṭa sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyor te/ yang 'jig pa las shapa kyang rtag tu 'jig go/ /ya ngo bā/ yang las yang na'o/ /yang 'jig pa las pha rol gyi byings thams cad pa hal dang po pa 'gro ba'i ming can la yīta rmye.ā ga ma yang na 'gyur te/ khyu yod pa la/ yang / san yang dag la 'os byings gnyis brjod/ yang gi a tsa la 'ang ngos yang 'jig /thung ngu 'os thung ngur bsgyur/ yang 'jig pa dag gi yon tan nos a sgyu sa yon tan/ a sgyu sa'i tsar 'ang ngos/ bha ba/ la tipa/ mdo 'dis ā+oṭa yang na bar byas yon tan byas pas/ bo bha bī ti 'am/ yang na bo sgo ti/ skyes bu dang po'i gnyis tshig sogs thams cad la/ bhū/ bo bhūr bsgyur ba'i bar cho ga 'dra/la tas su bsgyur bas/ bo bhū taḥ/ mang tshig la/ a bh+yasta las ata 'os/dzha ata du bsgyur/ a tsa la sgo byings sogs kyi u bar bsgyur bas/ bo bhū ba nyi / de bzhin du bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bo bha bī ṣi/ bo sgo 5ṣi/ bo byu thaḥ/ bo bhū tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bo bha bī mi/bo sgo mi/ bo bhū baḥ/ bo bhū maḥ/ ling gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ bo khyu yāta / bo byu yā hūṃ/ bo byu yuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bo byu yā ཿ/bo byu yā tsā/ bo bhū yāta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bo khyu dze+e/ bo bhū yā ba/bo byu yā ma/ loṭa'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ bo bha bī tu/ bo sgo tu/ bo 117—983

bhū tāta/ bo byu tsā/ bo bhū ba tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bo khyu hi/bo bhū tāta/ bo byu tsā/ bo bhū ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bo bha bī ni/bo bha bā ba/ bo bha bā ma/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a bo bha bīta/ a bo sgo ta/ a bo bhū tsā/ a bo bhu ①buḥ/—sitsa ma byusta sogs kyis sna dzus/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a bo bha bīḥ/ a bo sgoḥ/ a bo khyu tai/ a bo byu ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a bo bha baṃ/ a bo khyu ba/ a bo bhū ma/lung la/ gā ti s+thā bhū sā bhū sogs kyi setsa phyis pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a bo bhū ta/ a bo byu hūṃ/ a bo bha bu/—sitsa ma gyasta sogs kyis rnyi dzus/dzus la'ang ngos yon tan/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a bo bhūḥ/ a bo byu lta⑤/ a bo bhū ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a bo bhū baṃ/—ཿ'i lung liṭa dag la bhu'i buka 'os buka ā ga ma/ a bo bhū ba/ a bo bhū ma/ leṭa la kas sogs kyis ām sbyar bas/ bo bha r+pā tsa kā ra/ bo bha r+pā ba byu ba/ bo bha bā mā sa/ sogs dang / 'grel par skabs 'ga' zhig tu yang 'jig pa la ām mi sbyor ba yang srid do zhes byung bas/ ām ma sbyar ba'i phyogs la/ atsa dang po rnams la/ spyo'i lung liṭa dag la buka ①'os buka ④ā ga ma byin pas/skyes bu dang po gsum la/ bo bhū ba/ bo byu ba tuḥ/ bo byu buḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bo byu bi tha/ bo khyu ba thuḥ/ bo khyu ba/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bo khyu ba/ bo byu bi ba/ bo khyu bi ma/ yang na buka ma byin par ṇa la gnyis la 'phel ba dang / thal la yon tan gzhan rnams la/ a tsa la shā byings sogs kyi ⑤u bar bsgyur bas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ bo bhā ba/bo bhu ba tuḥ/ bo bhu buḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bo bha bi tha/ bo bhu 117—984

ba thuḥ/ bo bhu ba/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ bo bhā ba/ bo bha ba/ bo bhu bi ba/ bo bhu bi ma/ luṭa la iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ bo bha bi tā/ bo bha bi tā se/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ bo bhū yāta/ bo bhū yās+t+ri/ bo bhū yā suḥ/ sogs so/ /mṛṭa la iṭa byin yon tan byas pas/ bo bha bi 6 ti/sogs dang / de bzhin du mṛng la/ a bo bha bi 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ badzi 'gro ba la'o zhes pa la/ yang sbyar/ gnyis brjod/ badzi sre su dhī su rja su sogs kyis bhāka ⑫ā ga ma byen/ yang gi atsa la'ang ngos yang phyis pas/ ba nī pañca zhes pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ yang las yang na 'os snyam yang na bar byas/ khrab du med pa'i phyogs la/ tsu'i ku byas pas/ ba bhā baṃ ṭī ti/ ba nī baṃ sti/ gnyis tshig la ita 'gro ba ma yin pa sogs kyis na phyis/ tsu'i ku 'os tsa ka ra bsgyur bas—/ ba nī baṃ k+taḥ/ mang tshig la/ a bh+yasta las ata 'os dzha ata du bsgyur bas/ ba nī baṃ tsa ti/ de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ba smi baṃ ṭī ṣi/ ba smi baṃ k+ṣi/ ba nī bathiḥ/ ba smi bagh+ra—/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ba nī baṃ ṭī mi/ ba nī baṃ dz+re/ ba nī baṃ tswa'i/ba nī baṃ tsa maḥ/ ling la/ ita 'gro ba ma yin pa sogs kyis na phyis pas/ba smi ba tsāta1/ ba smi ba tsā ④hūṃ/ ba nī baṃ sgoḥ/ sogs so/ /loṭa la laṭa'i skabs ltar bsgrubs ⑤pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ ba nī baṃ ṭī tu/ba smi baṃthi/ ba bhā baghā ta/ ba smi ba.ā+oṃ/ ba nī btsa tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ ba nī bsti/ ba nī bkyāta/ ba nī bat+ta/ ba rī bak+ta—/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ba m+bi baṃ tsā ni/ ba nī baṃ tsā ba/ ba nī baṃ 117—985
