tsā ma/ de bzhin du/ lang 1gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a ba rtswa baṃ ṭī ta/ a ba smi ban/—ita kyi 'ang ngos i phyis ha la dri ba sogs kyis ta phyis/ brtsegs pa'i mtha' dbyi 'os tsa phyis/ a ba bhā badz+nyā/ a ba rtswa ba tsuḥ/snyesitsa a byusta sogs kyis sna dzus/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a ba nī bi ṭīḥ/ a ba rī ban/a ba byā bak+ṇi/ a ba smi bak+ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a ba nī baṃ rtsa/ a ba nī btswa/ a ba bhā bsko/ lung la iṭa sbyar bas/ a ba nī baṃ ṭīta/ab nī (9baṃ tsiñju/ a ba nī baṃ tsi 6ཿ/ sogs so/ /liṭa la kās sogs kyi ām sbyar bas/ ba smi baṃ tsa k+ṣa ra/ sogs so/ /luṭa la iṭa byin pas/ba rī baṃ tsi tā/ ba nī baṃ tsi tā si/ sogs so/ /smon pa'i ling la/ ita 'gro ba ma yin pa sogs kyis na phyis pas/ ba nī ba tsāta/ ba rī btsā spyo/ba rī ba tsā suḥ/ mṛṭa snel iṭa byin pas/ ba nī baṃ tsi byu ti/ sogs dang /de bzhin du thrang la/ a ba rī baṃ tsi 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ ga smṛ 'gro ba la/ yang sbyar/ gnyis brjod/ rjes su sna ldan mtha'i sogs kyi nuka ā ga ma byin/ ku ha dag gi tsu/ na nga ror byas/yang phyis pas/ rdza gam zhes pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ yang las yang na 'os yīṭa ④yang na bar byas pas/ rdza ga m+bi ti / dza gi ti/ gnyis tshig la/ rjes su sna ldan nye ba'i yul sogs kyis ma phyis pas/ rdza ga taḥ/ mang tshig la/ a bh+yasta las ata 1'os/ dzha ata/gam han sogs kyis yang na u pa dh+wa phyis bas/ rdza ga ma ti/ rdza gla nyi/ de bzhin du/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dze+e ga sbo ṣi/ dze+e go se/ rdza ga thaḥ/dza ga tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ / dza ga m+bi mi/ rdza ga m+bi/snyepa ma dag 117 986

'jig pa sogs kyis yon tan/ yang gi a tsa la 'ang ngos/ yang phyis/ de dipa ces grub pa la laṭa sogs sbyar/ skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ yang las yang na 'os/ bso yang na bar byas pas/ yīṭa'i phyogs la/ de di bī ⑦ ti—/ khrab med pa'i phyogs la/ rjoḥ/ shu ṭha nu nā si ke tsa/ tsha ba dag gi rjes su sna ldan la'ang shra spru ṭha dag go/ /byings mtha'i tsha yig dang ba yig ni kṛta rjo sogs kyi rkyen kwa dang / rjes su sna ldan dang / dzhal dang po ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can rnams pha rol la rim pa bzhin dza shra dang bra u ṭha zhes par bsgyur bar bya'o/ /'grel par lung drangs pa/ yang lu ki shu tho bā 3dzha li ba ka re/yang 'jig pa la shra u ṭha dag dzhal dang ba yig la yang na'o/ /byings mtha'i tsha yig dang ba yig dag yang 'jig pa na/ ldita ma yin kyang dzhal dang po can dang ba yig pha rol la rim pa bzhin shra be+e ṭha dag tu yang na 'gyur te/ khru ṭhar bsgyur ba'i phyogs la/ i ka gi atsa la yaṇa ④dang / de nas yon tan/ u ṭhar ma bsgyur ba'i phyogs la/ ba ya dag gis bal la dbyi 'os ba phyis yon tan byas pas/ de byo ti/ de de ti/ gnyis tshig la/ spru ṭhar bsgyur ba dang mi bsgyur ba yang na bar byas/ ma bsgyur ba'i phyogs la/ ba ya dag gi bal la dbyi 'os ba phyis pas/ de dhū byetaḥ/ de di taḥ/ mang tshig la/ a bh+yasta las ata 'os dzha ata du bsgyur bas/ de di ba ti/ de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ de di bī ṣi/ de byo ṣi/ de de ṣi—/ de dhū thaḥ/ de di thaḥ/ de byu tha/ de di tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la / de di bī mi/ de byo mi/ de de mi/ rngu de dhū baḥ/ de di ba thuḥ/de byu maḥ/ de di maḥ/ ling la/ de di byāta/ de di byā tī/ de di byuḥ117—991

sogs so/ /loṭa la laṭa'i skabs ltar bsgrubs pas skyes bu dang po gsum la/de di bī tu①/ de byo tu/ de de tu/ de byu hūṃ/ de di hūṃ/ de di ba tu/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ de byu ti/ de byu tāta/ de byu te/ de di lta/de byu ta/ de di ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ de di bā ni/ de di bā ba/de di bā ma/ de bzhin du lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a de di bīta/a de drod/ a de deta/ a de byu hūṃ/ a de di hūṃ/ a de di buḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a de di bīḥ/ a de byoḥ/ a de deḥ/ a de byu tai/a de di haṃ/ a de byu ta/ a de di ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a de di baṃ/ a de byu ba/ a de di ba/ a de byu ma/ lung la iṭa byen pas/a de di bīta②/ sogs dang / de bzhin du/ la yig lhag ma rnams la/liṭasnyede di r+pā tsa kā ra/ luṭa—de di bi tā/ smonaling—de dī byāta/ yoṭa—de di bi 6 ti/ kṛngasnye.a de di bi 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ bi tsha 'gro ba la'o zhes pa la yang sbyar/ gnyis brjod/ yang 'jig pa sogs kyis yon tan/ yang gi atsa la'ang ngos yang phyis pas/ be bi tsha zhes pa la laṭa sogs sbyar/ skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ yang las yang na 'os ā+ota ①yang na bar byas/ yīṭa med pa'i phyogs la/ bra: bh+rasnga sogs kyis tsha 'am sha ṣa/ ṣa ṭu la ṣa ṭu 'os ta ṭa/ yon tan byas pas/be bi ṭī ti/ be biṣ+ṭi/ gnyis tshig la/ brabyu bh+rasnga sogs kyis tsha 'am sha ṣa/ṣa ṭu la ṣa ṭu 'os ta ṭar bsgyur bas/ be biṣ+ṭaḥ/ mang tshig la/ a sgyu rjosta las ata 'os dzha ata du bsgyur bas/ be bi tsha ti/ de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ be bi ṭī ṣi/ be bik+ṣi/ be biṣ+ṭhaḥ/117—992

be+e biṣ+ṭha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ be+e bi ṭī mi/ be+e bi shri/ be+e bi shwaḥ/be+e bi tshwaḥ/ be bi thraḥ/ ling la/ be+e bi stsota/ be bi dz+nyā tī/ be bi khyed/sogs so/ /loṭa la laṭa'i skabs ltar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la / be bi ṭī tu/ be bibyu/ be+e biṣ+ṭi/ be bi tsha tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ be bi nyi①/ be biṭ+wāta/ be+e biṣ+ṭi/ be+e biṣ+ṭa3/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ be+e bi tsā ni/ be+e bi tsā ba/ be+e bi tsā ma/ de bzhin du/ lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a be bi tshita/ a be+e be+eṭa/ a be+e biṣ+ṭi/ a be+e bi tshuḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a be bi ṭīḥ/ a be biṭa/ a be biṣ+ṭi—/ a be+e biṣ+ṭa/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a be+e bi tsho a be bi shwa/a be bi tshwa/ a be+e bi shra/ la yig lhag ma rnams la/ lungasnye.a be+e bi ṭīta/liṭa ——be bi rjo tsa kā ra/ luṭa——be+e bi tshi tā/ ba/ling —be bistota/ mṛṭa—be bi tshi 6 ti/ kṛngasnye.a be bi tshi 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ yu bsre ba la'o zhes pa la/ yang sbyar/ gnyis brjod/ yang 'jig pa sogs kyis yon tan byas/ yang gi a tsa la'ang ngos yang phyis pas/yo yu zhes pa la laṭa sogs sbyar bas/ skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ yang las yang na 'os yīṭa yang na bar byas/ yon tan byas pas/ yo ya bī ti/yo yo ti/ gnyis tshig la/ yo yu dutaḥ/ mang tshig la/ a bh+yasta las ata 'os dzha ata du bsgyur/ atsa la shā byings sogs kyis u bar bsgyur bas/ yo yu ba ti/ de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/yo ya bī ṣi/ yo yo ṣi/ yo yu thaḥ/ yo yu tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/yo ya bī mi/ yo yo mi/ yo yu baḥ/ yo yu maḥ/ ling la kṛta ma yin pa 117—993

sogs kyis ring bor bsgyur bas/ yo yu yāta/ yo yu yā tī/ yo yu yuḥ/sogs so/ /loṭa la laṭa'i skabs ltar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la / yo ya bī tā/ yo yo tu/ yo yu tāta/ yo yu hūṃ/ yo yu ba tu/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ yo yu hi/ yo yu tāta/ yo yu tai/ yo yu ta/yo yā shesna bā ni/ yo ya bā ba/ yo ya bā ma/ de bzhin du lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a yo ya bīta/ a yo yota/ a yo yu tsā/ a yo ya buḥ/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a yo ya bā2ཿ/ a yo yoḥ/ a yo yu hūṃ/ a yo 1yu ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a yo ya baṃ/ a yo yu ba/ a yo yu ma/la yig lhag ma rnams la/ lung —a yo ya bīta/ liṭasnyeyo ya r+pā tsa kā ra/ luṭasnyeyo ya bi tā/ 0napa'i ling —yo yu yāta/ kṛṭa yo ya bi 6 ti/ kṛng —a yo ya bi 6ta/sogs so/ /myu/ o hāka gtong ba la'o zhes pa la/ yang sbyar/ gnyis brjod/ thung ngu 'os thung ngur bsgyur/ ku ha dag gi tsu/ a sgyu sa'i tsar 'ang ngos/ dzha dza/ ka 'gro ba ma yin pa sogs kyi sa ring por bsgyur/ yang gi atsa la'ang ngos ya phyis pas / dzā hā/ zhes pa la laṭa sogs sbyar/ skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ā+oṭa yang na bar byas/ ā+oṭa'i phyogs la khrab mtshams sbyar bas/ dzā te ti/ dzā hā nyi/ gnyis tshig la/ ghu min pas hal la yī 'os/ ā khyur bsgyur bas/dzā tī taḥ/ mang tshig la/ a bh+yasta las ata'o/ /dzha ata/ shā a bh+yasta dag gi ata kyi 'os a phyis pas/ dzā ha ti/ de rnams dang thu'adra bar bsgrubs rgyapas—/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dzā he ṣi/ dzā hā se/ dzā tī thaḥ/dzā tī tha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dzā he mi/ dzā hā mi/ dzā tī baḥ/ dzā 117—994

tī maḥ/ ling la ya la dbyi 'os ā phyis pas/ dzā t+yāta/ dzā t+yā tsā/ dzā rgyaḥ/sogs so/ /loṭa la laṭa ltar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dzā he tu/ dzā hā khyetu/ dzā tī tāta/ dzā tī tsā/ dzā ha 1tu/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ dzā tī hi/ dzā tī tāta/ dzā tī hūṃsnye/ dzā tī ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ dzā hā ni/ dzā hā ba/ dzā hā ma/ de bzhin du lang gi skyes bu dang po gsum la/ a dzā te ta/ a rnyidzā hāta/ a dzā tī hūṃ/ a dzā huḥ/skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a dz+wa heḥ/ a dzā hāḥ/ a dzā tī tai/ a dzā tī ta / skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a dzā hūṃ/ a dzā tī ba/ a dzā tī ma/ la yig lhag ma rnams la/ lung— a dzā hiṣ+ṭa/ liṭa —dzā hūṃ tsa kā ra/ luṭa——dzā hi tā lta/smon ling — dzā t+yāta/ kṛṭa —dzā hi 6 ti/ kṛng—a dzā hi 6ta/ sogs so/ /༈ rda sha mche ba la'o zhes pa la/ yang / gnyis brjod/ dza pa/dza bha sogs kyis nuka ā ga ma byin/ yang phyis pas/ rda rda sha zhes pa la laṭa sogs sbyar/ skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ yīṭa yang na bar byas/yīṭa'i ⑥phyogs la na phyis pas/ rda da shī ti/ rda rdaṣ+ṭi/ gnyis tshig la/ita kru'agro ba ma yin pa sogs kyis na phyis/ brabya bh+rasnga sogs kyis sha ṣa/ ṣa ṭu la ṣa ṭu 'os ta ṭar bsgyur bas/ rda daṣ+ṭaḥ/ mang tshig la/ a bh+yasta las ata 'os dzha ata du bsgyur bas/ rda da sha ti/ de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ rda da shi ṣi/ rda rda k+ṣi/ rda da ṣ+ṭhaḥdu—/ rda daṣ+ṭha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ rda da shī mi/ rda rdad+me/ rda dashwaḥ—/ rda da thraḥ/ ling la iṭa ⑨'gro ba ma yin pa sogs kyis na phyis drangs pas/ rda da shāta/ rda da shā tī/ rda da byuḥ/ sogs so/ /loṭa 117/de995

pa bzhin spyod par byed mkhas pa/ 'grel par gabe+e sogs su ma zad rtags thams cad la kun spyod pa'i don la kipa 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ kṛṣ+ṭa ti/ —nag po bzhin spyod par byed—/ swa ti/snyebadag bzhin spyod par byed/ de ba ti/snyelha bzhin spyod par byed/ sogs mtha' yas so/ /z-i shā di bh+yo ju bya rtswarla pastsa ha laḥ/ bye sha la sogs pa rnams las gyur pa la rtswa ma yin pa las hal dbye ba'ang ngo / /z-i sha la sogs pa rnams las shin tu ba ma yin pa shin tu bar gyur pa lta bu gsar byung gi don rtswa byin pa'i mtha' ma yin pa la don de dag la kyang 'gyur zhing / kyang pha rol la rtags de rnams kyi mtha'i hal rnams kyang dbyi ste/ j-i shā ya ste/— shin tu spyod par byed/ u nā ya te/snyematho bar sems par byed/ sogs te/ z-i sha sogs ni/ j-i sha——shinatu/ 4zla nas—/ ——mtho bar sems/ //gh+ra/snyemyur ba/ paṇ+ḍi ta/snyemakhasapa/ 45ma/ /——rtsolab/ phyag bhi ma nas/snyemangon rlom/ durma nas/snyeyid mi bde ba/ dṛ pata/——mi bdag /shu tsi/ —gtsang ba/nī la/snyesngonapo/ badz+ra/snyerdorje/ phe ṇa/——lbub/ brtsas/snyebashangab/ ha ri ta/snyeljangagu/ ma dra / snyezabadabyangs/ sogs so/ /'grel par de rnams la gsar byung gi don la kipa kyang yang na 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ bye sha te/ sogs so/ /lo hi tā di ḍā dz+raḥkya ṣa/ lo hi ta la sogs pa dang ḍā tsa rnams las lhakyaṣa'o/ /lo hi ta la sogs pa rnams dang ḍā tsa'i mtha' rnams las gsar byung gi don la kyaṣa 'gyur te/ ṣa yig /kyaṣa las yang na 'os don dang / ka yig kya'i 'dam ka 'os spyi don no/ /bā kya ṣaḥ/ kya ṣa (bye las yang na'o/ /kya ṣa'i mtha' las laṭa sogs tang rnams 'gyur zhing yang na gye.a tang rnams kyang 'gyur te/shin tu dmar bar byed/snye41 hi tā ya ti/ laṭasnyesku hi tā ya te/ lo hi tā yeta/ lingasnyelo hi tā ye hasde/ lo hi tā ya tu/ loṭa —lo hi tā ya hūṃ/ a lo hi tā yata/ langasnye.a 117—1009

na las kyang steng du 'phyur ba'i don la kyang 'gyur te/ phe nā stiya te/snye1 ba 'phyur bar byed/ sogs so/ /'grel par lung drangs pa/ dhū mā (midā/ dhū ma las yang na'o/ /dhū ma las steng du 'phyur ba'i don la kyang 'gyur zhing yang na laṭa sogs a tang rnams spyor te/ dhū mā ya te/—duba'aphyur bar byed/ dhūmā⑦ya ti/— dub 'phyur bar byed/ sogs so/ /shasde be+e ra ka la hā bh+ra kaṇ+ḍa ma bye bh+yaḥka ra ṇi/ shasda bai ra ka la ha a bh+ra kaste ma rgya rnams las byed pa la'o/ /shasda la sogs pa 'di rnams las byed pa'i don la krukyang 'gyur te/ shas+thā ya te/——sgrabyed do/ /be+e rā ya te—/ snye'akhon byed do/ /ka la hā kyang te/——'khrug pa byed do/ /phyag bhā ya te/snyesprinabyed do/ /ka41 pa/ te—/ snyemagrin pa byed do/ /ma dh+yā ya te/— dbusabyed do/ /sogs so/ /su di na du rdi na bhā hā re bh+ya bya/ su di na du rdi na bhā hā ra rnams las kyang ngo / /su di na la sogs pa 'di rnams las kyang byed pa'i don la kyang 'gyur te/ su di nā ya te/——nyi ma bzang po byed/ durdi nā ya te/snyeyul ngan byed/ nīhā rā ya te/— khugarnabyed/ sogs so/ /su khā di bh+yaḥkad+ngha be da nā yī/ su kha la sogs pa rnams las rig par byed pa la'o/ /su kha la sogs pa rnams las rig par byed pa 'am/ stsong bar byed pa 'am/thob par byed pa'i don la kyang 'gyur te/ su khā ya te/—bde ba myong bar byed/ duḥkhā ya te—/ ——sdug bsngal myong bar byed/ sogs te/ su kha la sogs pa rnams ni/ su kha/——bde ba—/ duḥkha/——sdug bsngal/ tro pa/snyekhrag gi mchod sbyin/ kṛs//snyedaka'ab/ yi/gra/shemachog /phyag —— ka /snyerdzun nam mi bden pa/ kṛpa ṇa/——rta dang mda' dang ser sna dang nyon mongs pa dang ral gri/ yi/ ru ṇa/snyedamar skya/ kanges ṇa/skyisnyingarje/ so bhā/ —daram/ pra dī pa/——mar me 'am rab gsal/ ma dra—/ snyezab dbyangs/ sogs so/ /na mo pa ri — trang kyatsa/ na mas ba ri bas tsi trang la kyatsa'/ /na mas/ ba ri bas gnyis la gus par byed pa dang / tsi 117—1011

pa'i rgyu mtshan can pha rol la rang nyid gang 'dod gnyis brjod par bshad pas/dper na/ pu dang ti dang yi gsum gang rung gcig gnyis brjod pas/ pu pu ṭī yi ṣa ti/— bu bzhin spyod par 'dod/ sogs sam/ pu ti ṭī yi ṣa ti/ sogs sam / yang na pu ṭī yi yi ṣa ti/ sogs so/ /yang 'grel par ming de atsa dang po yin na atsa de gnyis mi brjod kyi atsa'i rjes kyi hal dbyangs bcas gang rung gnyis brjod do zhes bshad pas/ a shī ya la san sbyar/ iṭa byin/yi dang shi gang rung gnyis brjod pas/ a shi shi yi ṣa te/——dbang phyug bzhin spyod par 'dod—/ sogs sam/ a shi yi yi ṣa ti/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du/ i: ya la san/ iṭa sbyar bas/ i: yi ṣa ti/—dbang po bzhin spyod par 'dod/ sogs sam / iju yi yi ṣa ti/ sogs so/ /'grel par lung drangs pa/ ka: de skṛ ti ya sri ba/ kazla la sogs pa rnams kyi gsum pa nyid do/ /kazle la sogs pa yaka gi mtha' can la'ang san 'gyur zhing de rnams kyi gsum pa nyid gnyis brjod par bya ste/ kazle ya la san sbyar/ iṭa byin/ ata kyi dbyi 'os a phyis/ lung 'dren 'dis gsum pa yi ① gnyis brjod pas/ kash+lau yi yi ṣa ti/ sogs so/ /'grel par ṇing gi mtha' la'ang san 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ kā mi la san sbyar iṭa byen gnyis brjod pas/ tsi kā ma yi ṣa nyi/sogs so/ /i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gya sru tān+d+ra ma jo ta baḥs mābhāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las ming gi bying grurnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gye go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las/ ming byings su bsgrub pa'i cho 717—1020

byed pa po la pa rasmi pa da rnams 'gyur te/ u pa ra ma ti/—nye bar dga' bar byed/sogs so/ /bi bhā ṣā karma kāta/ las med pa las 'dam ka'o/ /u pa dh+wa las pha rol gyi ra ma las las med pa la pa rasmi pa da dang ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da rnams 'dam ka can du bya ste/ u pa ra ma ti①/——nye bar dga' bar byed/snye.u pa ra ma ti/sogs so/ /bu dha yu dha na sha dzeng pru dru sru bh+yo be+e/ bu dha/ yu dha/ na sha /dzan—/ ing / pru/ dru/ sru rnams las ṇi las so/ /bu dha la sogs pa 'di rnams ṇitsa'i mtha' can las 'bras bu ldan pa thob pa'i don la pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyor te/ bo dha ya ti/ rtogs su 'jug /yo dha ya ti/— 'thab tu 'jug /nā sha ya ti / nyams su 'jug /jo na ya ti/ skyed du 'jug /a rnyi sngon/snyeyinadh+yā pa kya ti/——gsol ba 'debs su 'jug /kri ing sogs kyis 3āta dang / arti sogs kyis puka /rwa/ba kyang ti/— thobatu 'jug /dru ba kyang ti / byed du 'jug gam 'ded du 'jug gam bros su 'jug /srub ya ti/——'gro ru 'jug /sogs so/ /ni ga ra ṇa tsa la nārba bh+yabya/ 'gro ba dang g.yo ba dang zas rnams kyi don las kyang ngo / 'gro ba dang g.yo ba dang zas rnams kyi don las kyang ṇitsa'i mtha' las 'bras bu ldan pa thob pa la pa rasmi pa da rnams 'gyur te/ tsā la ya ti/snye'agro bar byed du 'jug /kasba ya ti/— g.yo bar byed du 'jug /sgo dzaya ti/ —za ru'ajug /sogs so/ /za ba'i don yin kyang a da ṇi mtha' can la pa rasmi pa da rnams 'gyur ba ma yin te / ā da ya te/— za ru'ajug /sogs so/ /a khyo ba karma kā:t+ta baṅkadṛ kāṇ+ḍiḥ/ṇi med pa la sems dang ldan pa'i byed pa po las med pa las ṇi las so/ /ṇi'i mtha' med pa la gang sems dang ldan pa'i byed pa po las dang bral ba de las ṇi'i mtha' las 'bras bu ldan pa zhes pas thob pa la pa rasmi pa da rnams 'gyur te/ṇitsa'i mtha' med pa la/ āste bi praḥṇi mtha' can la/——bramaze'i khye'u sdod/ ā sa ya 117—1022

ti bi sre/snyebram ze'i r+ṣa sdod du 'jug na pā da mā ya mā ya sa pa ri mu ha ru tsi dṛ ti pa da ba saḥ / pā/ dam/ ā yam/ ā yas/ pa ri mu ha/ ru tsi/ dṛ ti/ba da/ bas las ma yin no/ /pā la sogs pa 'di rnams las ṇitsa'i mtha' las 'bras bu ldan pa zhes pa thob pa la pa rasmi pa da rnams 'gyur ba ma yin te/pā pa ya te/snyebatungadu 'jug /dā ma ya te/——zhiru'ajug /sto/pa/ma ya te/—kun nas 'gog tu 'jug /sto/ya sa ya te/ kun nas 'ded du 'jug /pa ri mo ha ya te/snyeyongs su rmongs su 'jug /ro tsa ya ti/—mdzes su 'jug /narta ya te/snyegarabyed du 'jug /bād ya te/—spra ru 'jug /bā sa ya te sogs so/ / —gnas su 'jug /'grel par dheṭa las kyang a tang rnams mi 'jug par bshad pas/ 'thungadu 'jug /— d+mā pa ya te sogs so/ /kadṛ karma bya ti hā ro/ /byed pa po las gcig la 'jug pa la'o/ /byed pa po dang bya ba du ma las gcig la byed pa gcig gis 'jug pa'i don la lnga ṣ+pe pa da rnams 'gyur te / byam ti bha ba te/snyegacig tu 'gyur/ byu/ti ste/snyegacig tu yod/ shā as zhes pas/ na ga ti ①hid+mābe+e bh+yaḥ/ 'tshe ba dang 'gro ba'i don las ma yin no/ /byed pa dang bya ba du ma las gcig la byed pa gcig gis 'jug pa yin kyang bya ba de 'tshe ba dang 'gro ba'i don yin na pa rasmi pa da rnams 'gyur ba ma yin te/ bya ti gharnyi/——rnam par shin tu 'tshe bar byed/ bya ti sarba ti/— rnam par shin tu 'gro bar byed/ sogs so/ /'grel par ha sa sogs la'ang ād+ma de pa da rnams 'gyur ba ma yin no zhes bshad pas/bya ti ha sa ti/snyernam par shin tu gnod par byed/ bya ti pa ṭha bye ti/snyernam par shin tu klag par byed/bya ti dzalpa ti/——rnam par shin tu rjod par byed/ sogs so/ /yang 'grel par 'tshe ba'i don yin kyang z-inya las a tang rnams mi 'gyur gyi tang kho na spyor ro zhes bshad pas—/ saṃ pra ha ra tekhye/snyekun nas rab tu 'phrog par byed/ sogs so/ /bi na ma 117—1023

ye tsa/ phan tshun byed pa la'ang ngo / /phan tshun byed pa brje ba'i bya ba la 'jug pa la'ang pa rasmi pa da rnams 'jug pa ma yin te/ bya ti lu na te/—gcod par byed/ bya ti su na te/—dgapar byed/ sogs so/ /ṣ+pebe+e sha /ni las bi sha las so/ /ni las pha rol gyi bi sha las ād+ma de pa da rnams 'gyur te/ ni bi sha te①/—nges par 'jug/ sogs so/ /pa ri bya be bh+yaḥkri yaḥ/ pa ri/ bi/ a ba rnams las shrī las so/ /pa ri/ bi/ a ba rnams las pha rol gyi smi las ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da rnams 'gyur te/ pa ri 4 bhā te/snyeyongs su 'tshong bar byed/ shu byu min pa sogs kyis/ bi shrī ṇ+ḍi ④te/snyernam par 'tshong bar byed/ ab 4 tī te/—kun du 'tshong bar byed/ sogs so/ /bi pa rā dz+nyā ③dzeḥ/ bi pa ra dag las dzi las so/ /be+e dang pa ra dag las pha rol gyi dzi las tang rnams 'gyur te/ bi dza ya te/—rnam par rgyal bar byed/ pa ra bi dza ya te/snyegazhan las rgyal bar byed/ sogs so/ /ā ngo do nā gya bi ha ra ṇi/ āng ④las dā las kha gdangs pa ma yin pa la'o/ /āng ⑤las pha rol gyi dā las kha gdangs pa'i don ma yin pa la tang rnams 'gyur te/ āste/—kun du sbyin par byed/sogs dang du/ kha gdangs ⑦pa yin na a tang rnams sbyar bas/ ā sum̐ skebyā da dā ti/—kha gdangs pa la byin/ sogs so/ /4 ḍophonu saṃ pa ri bh+yastsa/ ṭāḍa las/a ⑨nu/ saṃ/ pa ri rnams las kyang ngo / /a nu/ saṃ/ pa ri rnams dang āng yilas kyang pha rol gyi k+shi ḍa las tang rnams 'gyur te/ a nu 4 ḍa te⑪/—mazun par rtse bar byed/ saṃ 4 ḍa te/snyelegs par rtse bar byed/ pa ri spru ḍa te/—yongs su rtse bar byed/ā 4 ḍa te/ kun du rtse bar byed/ sogs so/ /ā ngo ga meḥk+ṣa mā lnga/ āng las ga mi las bzod pa la'o/ /āng las pha rol gyi ga ma ṇi tsa'i mtha' can las bzod pa la 'jug pa na tang rnams 'gyur te/ ā ga ma ya te/—bzod par byed/117 1024

'grel par nā tha las smon pa la khye('jug pa na tang rnams 'gyur bar bshad pas/sabe+e ṣa nā tha te/snyemar gsar smon par byed/ sogs so/ /yang 'grel par j-inya la rngu 'gro ba'i ngang tshul rtogs par byed pa la tang rnams 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/a nu ha ra tephoshwaḥ/——rta rjes su 'gro bar byed/ sogs so/ /a pārtso tubye ts+tsha ku ni ṭī le kha ṣ+pe1/ a pa las rkang bzhi dang 'dab chags 'dri ba la'o/ /a pa las pha rol gyi 1 las rkang bzhi dang 'dab 4/chags ri mor 'dri ba'i don la 'jug pa na tang rnams 'jug cing suṭa ā ga ma yang 'gyur te/ a paskri ra te bṛ ⑤ṣaḥ/snyeglang 'dri bar byed/ byings ṛ ita ra pha rol/ a paskri ra te ku kuṭaḥ/snyekhyim bya 'dri bar byed/ 'grel par āng las pha rol gyi nu dang prats+tsha las tang rnams 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ā nu te sh-i ⑦gā la/snyecespyang 'ded/ ā thrats+tsha te gu rūn/snyebla ma rnams la dri bar byed/ sogs so//yang 'grel par shapa las mna' 'dor ⑦ba'i bya ba la tang rnams 'jug par bshad pas/ de ba daṭ+wā yā sha pa te/——lhas byin la spyod par byed/ sogs so/ /sa ma ba pra bi bh+yaḥsbaḥ/ sam/ a ba/ pra bi rnams las s+thā las so/ /nyer bsgyur sam sogs 'di rnams las pha rol gyi s+thā las tang rnams 'gyur te/ saṃ tiṣ+ṭha te—/ snyeyang dag par gnas par byed/ ab tiṣ+ṭha te/snyekun du gnas par byed/ pra tiṣ+ṭha te/ rab tu gnas par byed/ bi tiṣ+ṭha te/snyernam par gnas par byed/ sogs so/ /'grel par āng las pha rol byi s+thā las rtag tu tang rnams 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ ā tiṣ+ṭha te—/ kun du gnas par byed/ sogs so/ /pra kā sha na sbe yā khya yo:/ rab tu ston pa nges par bshad pa dag las kyang ngo / /rab tu ston pa dang nges par bshad pa'i don la 'jug pa las kyang s+thā las tang rnams 'gyur te/ ni h+ye mā tiṣ+ṭha te—/ snyesgra rtag par gnas/ tiṣ+ṭha te ka sngets+tsha tre bh+yaḥ/snyegrib ma rnams la bu mo gnas/ sogs so/ /117—1025

—u dophobyurnya karma ṇi/ uta las steng ma yin pa'i las la'o/ /uta las pha rol gyi s+thā las steng ma yin pa'i las la 'jug pa na tang rnams 'gyur te/ muk+ta butiṣ+ṭha te—/ —mu tig las byung / sogs dang / steng yin na mi 'jug pas/ ā sā nā dustiṣ+ṭha tikhya/snyestanalas langs/ sogs so/ /u pād+me tra ka ra ṇi/ u pa las sngags kyi byed pa la'o/ /u pa las pha rol gyi s+thā las sngags kyi byad ②pa la 'jug pa na tang rnams sbyor te/ sā be+e byu u pa tiṣ+ṭha te/snyerig byed 'don par nye bar gnas/ sogs so//'grel par u pa las pha rol gyi las/ mchod pa/ 'dus pa/ grogs lam rnams kyi bya ba la 'jug pa na tang rnams 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ bur+ghaṃ u pa tiṣ+ṭha te/— sangs rgyas mchod par nye bar gnas/ shaṃ ka )gā ya mu nā u pa tiṣ+ṭha te/— chu bo ge gā dang ya mu na lhan du gnas/ mi tram̐ u pa tiṣ+ṭha te/snyegrogs dang nye bar gnas/ rga tsāsnyege gā dang nye bar gnas/upa tiṣ+ṭha te pan+d+raḥ/snyelam/ lis+thā yī bā/ thob par 'dod pa la yang na'o/ /u pa las pha rol gyi s+thā las thob par 'dod pa rtogs par byed pa la tang yang na 'gyur zhing yang na a tang rnams 'gyur te/ bhik+ṣu ko zwah+ma ṇa ku la mu pa tiṣ+ṭha te/snyedage slong bram ze'i khyim la nye bar gnas/ ti/ a karma kārtso/ las med pa la'ang ngo u pa las pha rol gyi s+thā las las med pa la'ang tang rnams 'gyur te/ sgo dza na kā le u pa tiṣ+ṭha te sogs so/ /zas kyi dus su nye bar gnas/snye.u dī r+ghaṃ ta pa/ uta bi dag las ta pa las so/ /uta dang bi dag las ta pa la las med pa la 'jug pa na tang rnams 'gyur te/ ut+ta pa te/snyeshin tu gdung bar byed/ bi ta pa te/skyirnam par gdung bar byed/sogs so/ /ā ngo ya ma ha naḥ/ āng la yam han las so/ /āng las pha rol gyi yam dang han las las med pa dang rang gi yan lag gi bya ba la 'jug pa na tang rnams 'gyur te/ āts+tsha te/snye sbyinapar byed/ ā / ha te/— snunapar byed/ ā 5yats+tsha te bā 177 /026

do / ——rkang pa la snun par byed/ ā ha te u lku re/ brlal snun par byed/ sogs so/ /lung la/ ha naḥsitsa—/ han las ṅgatsa'o/ /han las pha rol gyi sitsa ni āt+pa ṣ+pe pa da rnams pha rol la ka 'gro ba'i ming can no/ /kita pha rol la rjes su sna ldan mtha'i sogs kyis na phyis/ dzhal dang po can rnams la gzugs thung ngu las sos setsa 'ang phyis pas—/ ā ha ta/ ā ha sā tī/ ā ha sā ta sogs sam/ yang na/ la ṣ+pe pa de khya n+ya ta ra sde/ āt+pa ṣ+pe pa da rnams la yang na'o/ /lung bsgyur ba'i ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da rnams pha rol la han ni ba dha zhes par yang na bsgyur bar bya ste/ ba dhar bsgyur ba'i phyogs la iṭa byen pas/ ā ba byeṣ+ṭa/ ā na7ba dhi ṣā tsā/ ā ④ba bye ṣa ta/ sogs so/ /ya ma:/ yam las 'ang ngo / /yam las pha rol gyi setsa'ang āḥ ṣ+pe pa da rnams pha rol la ka 'gro ba'i ming can te/ ka 'gro ba'i ming can pha rol la rjes su sna ldan phyis/ dzhal dang po can rnams la gzugs thung ngu sogs kyis setsa 'ang phyis pas/ ā ya ta/ ce/ ā ya sā tsā/ ā 'aya sa ta—/ sogs so/ /sa mo ga mṛ tshi pra tshi swa ra t+yarti shu bi di bh+yaḥ/ sam las/gam—/ ṛ tshi/ pra tshi/ swa ra ti/ arti/ khru/ bi di rnams las so/ /sam las pha rol gyi gam la sogs pa 'di rnams las la ṣ+pe pa da rnams 'gyur te/saṃ gats+tsha te/— yang dgapar 'gro bar byed/ lung la/ bā ga maḥ/ gam las yang na'o/ /gam las pha rol gyi setsa dang smon pa'i ling nya.āt+pa ṣ+pe pa da can ni ka 'gro ba'i ming can du yang na bar bya ste/ ka 'gro ba'i phyogs la rjes su sna ldan mtha' sogs kyis ma phyis/ dzhal dang po rnams la gzugs thung ngu sogs kyis se tsa'ang phyis pas/ sa ma ga ta/ sa ma ga sā hūṃ/ sa ma ga sa ta/ sogs dang / ka 'gro ba ma yin pa'i phyogs la ma mi dbyi bas/ sa ma gi sta/ sa ma 117—1027

gi sā hūṃ/ sa ma gi sa ta/ sogs so/ /de bzhin du smon pa'i ling la saṃ ga sīṣ+ṭa sogs sam/ saṃ gi sīṣ+ṭa/ sogs so/ /sa mṛts+tsha te/—yang dag par gnas par byed/ saṃthrats+tsha te/snyekun du 'dri bar byed/ saṃ①swa ra te/snyekun du sgog par byed/ sa sngon ma'i ṛ la ta hu sogs kyis gnyis brjod shapa 'jig /arti/ pi parte sogs kyis a sgyu sa mi/ a sgyu sa'i 'dra ba ma yin pa sogs kyis i ya/—sa mi yī te/—kunadu'agro bar byed/ saṃ1 rku ④te/—shu shu tsu/ yang dag par nyan par byed/saṃ biste/snyekun du rig par byed/ sogs so/ /birtebe+e bhā ṣā/ biti las gdam nga'o/ /bid las pha rol gyi dzha ad du bsgyur zhing ru ka ā dze+eg ma yang na 'gyur te/ saṃ bi dra te/ sogs sam/ saṃ bi da te/ sogs so/ /'grel par saṃ las pha rol gyi dṛ sha las kyang tang rnams 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ saṃ pa byu te/—yang dag par lta bar byed/ sogs so/ /ni sa mu pa bi bh+yo hwaḥ/ ni sam u pa be+e rnams las hā las so/ /ni sam u pa bi rnams las pha rol gyi hā las tang rnams ④'gyur te/ ni hwa ⑤ya te/—nges para'adren par byed/ saṃ hwa ya te/—kun nas 'dren par byed/ upa hwa ya te/—nye b.ra'adren par byed/ bi hwa ya te/—rnam par 'dren par byed/sogs so/ /'grel par lung drangs pa/ u pa satā su kyu ho bā/ nyer bsgyur las a su ti u ha las yang na'o/ /nyer bsgyur rnams las pha rol gyi a mya ti dang / be+e ha dag las tang rnams yang na 'gyur te/ ni ram̐ su te/snyemi 'phen par byed/ sa spruduha te/snyetshogs par byed dam 'dus par byed/ sogs dang / yang na/ ni ra su ti/ sa rū ⑦ha ti/ sogs so/ /u pa sanān+d+ra swa spru ha teḥ/ nyer bsgyur las u ha ti'i thung ngu'o/ /nyer bsgyur sngon ma'i u ha ti'i u pa d+ma ni rkyen ya thog ma ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can pha rol la thung ngur bsgyur te/ smon pa'i ling la/ sa mu t+yāta⑧/ sogs so/ /spad+dhā yā mā ngaḥ/ 'gran pa las 117—1028

āng ①las so/ /'gran pa rtogs par byed pa la āng las pha rol gyi hā sdelas tang rnams 'gyur te/ mkhro mabe+e mā hwa ya te/—gyad dang gyad 'dren par byed/ sogs so—/ /garnya nā ba k+ṣe pa ṇa se sneb na sā ha se kya pra ti yat+na pra ka tha no pa yo ge kṛ nyaḥ—/ smod pa dang / gnod pa dang bsten pa dang / lhan cig pa dang 'bad pa dang / gtam dang nye bar sbyor ba rnams la kṛnya las so/ /smod ༷pa sogs don 'di rnams la 'jug pa na ⑤kṛnya las ād+ma ṣ+pe dupa da rnams 'gyur te/ sru tsa a ya mi ya musku ru te/—phra ma'adi 'di la byed/ bye no brti kā ma pa ku ru te/—khras bye'u co ka la gnod par byed dam khras sdong bu la gnod par byed/ ga ṇa ⑦kān pra ku ru te/—tshogs pa la gus par byed/ pa rā ka ā+oṃ ⑧pra ku ru te/—gzhan gyi bu mo dang lhan cig byed/ e rnyo da ka sro pasku ru te / —chu 'phel ba'i bya ba la 'bad par byed/ dza na bā dān pra ku ru ste/snyeskye bo rnams za bar byed/ sha tai pra ku ru te/—brgya lanye bar byed/ sogs so/ /a dheḥpra ha sa ṣ+pe/ a rnyi las nus pa la'o/ /a dhi las pha rol gyi kṛnya las nus pa rtogs par byed pa la tang rnams 'gyur te/ de t+yā na bhi ku ru te bisnguḥ/—lha min rnams byed nus khyab 'jug gi/ be+eḥshaja karma ṇaḥ/ bi las sgra'i las las so/ /bi las pha rol gyi kṛnya las sgra'i las rtogs par byed pa la tang rnams 'gyur te/ swa rān bi ku ru te bi praḥ/—bram ze dbyangs 'don par byed/ a karma kārtso/ las med pa las kyang ngo / /las med pa las kyang bi las pha rol gyi kṛnya las tang rnams 'gyur te/ bā ⑨yube+e ku ru te/—rlung rnam par byed/ sogs so/ /saṃ mā na nohūṃ dza nā tsār+ya ka ra ṇa tshwa na z-i ti bi ga ṇa na bya ye 6 ni yaḥ/ nī las yang dag par gus pa dang / khro ba dang /mchod pa byed pa dang / sgrub pa shes pa dang / yon dang gla rnams la'o/ /bhā las yang dag par gus pa sogs don 'di rnams rtogs ⑩par byed pa la tang 117—1029

rnams 'gyur te/ bstan bcos 'dren par byed/— ste/snga na ya te/ yang dag par gus pa'i don/ ma ṇa ba ka mu pa dā na na ya te/ yang dag pa/ra gus pa'i don/ bram ze'i khye'u la nye bar byin/ khros pa—/ sha tru nu pa na ya te/ dgra bo rnams khrid par byed/ de bā nu pa na ya te/— lha rnams nye bar 'dren/mchod pa/ byā ka ra ṇi na nga te/ sgrub shes pa/ brda spyod pa 'dren par byed/ sha tai na pa te/ —brgya 'dren par byed/ yon/ gla/ sha tai na ya te dā naḥ/snyebargya drangs nas sbyin/ sogs so/ /kadṛste tsā sha rī re karma ṇi/ byed pa po'i gnas su lus can ma yin pa'i las la'o/ /byed pa po'i gnas su gang gi bya ba'i las lus can ma yin pa rtogs par byed pa la be+e las tang rnams 'gyur te/ kro dhe bi na ya te/— khro ba 'dul bar byed/ sogs so/ /dz+dzasti 7 sarga tā ya no 6 kra maḥ/ 'jug pa dang / spro ba dang / bstan pa tsa rnams las kram las so/ /'jug pa dang / spro ba dang / bstan pa rnams rtogs par byed pa la kram las tang rnams 'gyur te/ ṛsngo su kra ma te budhiḥ/— blo 'jug par byed/ kra ma te byā ka ra zla dh+ya ya nā ma/snyebarda sprod pa bklags pa la spro bar byed/prasnye ste/s+thā ṇi pra kra ma te/ —mkhas pa la bstan bcos rnams ston par byed/ sogs so/ /sngo pa pa rā dz+nyā5/ u pa pa rā dag las so/ /u pa dang / pa rā ④dag las pha rol gyi kra ma las tang rnams 'gyur te/ u pa kra ma te/snyenye bar rkang pa skyong bar byed/ pa rā kra zhem te/ gzhan du rkang pa/ skyong bar byed/ ā nga uṅga ma ṣ+pe/ āng las 'gyed pa la'o/ /āng dzilas pha rol gyi kra ma las steng du 'od zer 'gyed pa la 'jug pa na tang rnams 'gyur te/ ā kra ma te srud+ma /—nyi ma 'od zer 'gyed par byed/ beḥpā dā /gyebi ha ra te / bi las rkang pa gas pa la'o/ /be+e las pha rol gyi kra ma las rkang pa gas pa rtogs par byed pa la tang rnams 'gyur te/ bi kra ma te pā daḥ/——rkang pa 'gas par byed—/ sogs so/ /sngo pā sgyu byemā raste/ pra u pa dag las rtsom pa la'o pra 1 17—1030

dang u pa dag las pha rol gyi kra ma las bya ba rtsom pa la 'jug pa na tang rnams 'gyur te/ pra kra ma te sgohūṃ/snyezas la rab tu 'jug par byed/ u pa kra ma te sgohūṃ/snyezas la nye bar 'jug par byed/ sogs so/ /'grel par nyer bsgyur med pa la kra ma las tang rnams yang na 'gyur ro zhes byung bas/ kra ma te/ sogs sam/ kra ma ti/sogs so/ /a pa t+na be dzhaḥ/ brdzun la dz+nyā las so/ /mi shes pa shes zer ba lta bu brdzun rtogs par byed pa la dz+nyā las tang rnams 'gyur te/ sha ta mu pa dzā nī te/—brgyathamapa shes/ sogs so/ /a karma kārtso/ las med pa las kyang ngo / /las med pa las kyang dz+nyā las tang rnams 'gyur te/ sabe+e ṣe dzā nī te/snyemar gsar shes/ saṃ pra ti sgyu ma nā sgyu ṣ+pe/ saṃ pra ti dag las dran pa ma yin pa la'o/ /sam ①dang pra ti dag las pha rol gyi dz+nyā las dran pa ma yin pa la 'jug pa na tang rnams 'gyur te/ saṃ dzā nī te/snyekunadu shes/ pra ti dzā nī te/—so sorashes/ sogs so/ /bhā sa no pa saṃ bhā ṣā dz+nyā na yat+na bi ma kyu pa oṃ tra ṇi gu pa da④ཿ/ bad las gsal ba dang nye bar 'dun pa dang shes pa dang 'bad pa dang blo gros tha dad pa dang nye bar bsngags pa rnams la'o/ /bad las gsal ba sogs don 'di rnams rtogs par byed pa la tang rnams 'gyur te/ shān+t+ra pra ba da te/snyebastan bcos rab tu gsal bar smras—/ gsal ba/ karma ka dā nu ba da te/snyelas byed pa la rjes su smras/ nye bar 'dun pa/ pā ṇi nirba da te/snyepā ṇi pa klog par byed/ shes pa/ kolha smin k+ṣe tre ba da te/—gang zhing du srus/ 'bad pa/ ge he bi ba da te/snyekhyim du tha dad par smras/ blo gros tha dad pa/ bi ba da te shi byā①ཿ/snyeslob ma la rnam par smras/ nye bar bsngags/ sogs so/ /byā ④k+ta bā tsā ⑤sa mudz+nyā ra be+e/ gsal bar lhan cig brjod pa la'o/ /bad las tshig gsal bar lhan cig tu brjod pa la tang rnams 'gyur te/ saṃ pra ba da te gra myaḥ/—grong du kun nas rab tu smra/ sogs so/ /117—1031

a no ra karma kāta/ a nu las las med pa las so/ /a nu las pha rol gyi bad las bya ba'i las med pa la tang rnams 'gyur te/ a nu ba da te ka ṭha ka khā pa ①gya/snyegatam gyi tshogs rjes su tha dad par byed/ sogs so/ /bi bhā ṣā bi pra lā pe/ bi pra brjod pa la gdam nga'o/ /bi pra brjod pa ste bi dang pra gnyis stel gyi pha rol gyi bad las tang dang a tang 'dam ka can du bya ste/ bi pra ba da te mo snuṭ+wāḥ/—yud tsam rnam par rab tu smra/ sogs sam/ bi pra ba da ②ti mo ①byuṭ+wāḥ/—yud tsam rnam par rab tu smra/ sogs so/ /a bāsgraḥ/ a ba las 1 rjolas so a ba las pha rol gyi ṭ+wā las tang rnams 'gyur te/ a ba gi ra te/—kun nas gsal bar byed/ sogs so/ /sa ma pra ti dz+nyā no/ sam las dam bca' ba la'o/ /sam las pha rol rmi 1 ⑤las dam bca' la 'jug pa na tang rnams 'gyur te/ sha tai saṃ gi ra te/—brgyatham pa dam bca' bar byed/ sogs so/ /udabya raḥs karma kāta/ uta las tsa ra las las dang bcas pa las so/ /uta las pha rol gyi tsa ra las las dang bcas pa rjolas tang rnams 'gyur te/ ge ha murtso ra ti⑦/—khyim du spyod par byed/ sam skṛ tī yā ⑧yulngata| sam las gsum pa sbyor ba la'o/ /sam las pha rol gyi tsa ra las rnam dbye gsum pa'i mtha' can dang sbyor ba la tang rnams 'gyur te/ a shwe na saṃ tsa ra te/snyertas yang dag par 'gro bar byed/ sogs so/ /dā ṇabyu sā tsertso turgyaze/ dā ṇa las gal te bzhi pa'i don la'o/ /sam las pha rol gyi dāṇa las gal te gsum pa'i mtha' de'ang bzhi pa'i don la 'jug pa na tang rnams 'gyur te/dā snga saṃ pra yats+tsha te put+pa mā dze+e/snyebran mos me tog gi phreng ba sbyin par byed/ sogs so/ /u pā ⑨r+ya ma⑩ཿswa ka ra ṇi/ u pa las yam las rang gi bya ba la'o/ /u pa las pha rol gyi yam las rang gi bya ba ste/ bag ma len pa la 'jug pa na tang rnams 117—1032

'gyur te/ kā t+yā mu pa yastso te①/snyebu mo nye bar sbyin par byed/ sogs so/ /be+e bhā sgo pa ya ma ṣ+pe/ u pa yam las 'dam ka'o/ /u pa sngon ma'i yam las tang dang bcas pa'i setsa ka 'gro ba'i ming can du yang na bya ste/ kita kyi phyogs la rjes su sna ldan mtha'i sogs kyis ma phyis/ dzhal dang po rnams la gzugs thung ngu sogs kyis se tsa'ang 'jig /kita ma yin pa'i phyogs la sra 'dren pa kho na ste/u pā ya ta/ u pā ya sā tsā/ u pā ya sa ta/ sogs sam/ u pā sdeyi ta/u pā yi sā tsā/ u pā yo snos ta/ sogs so/ /rā maḥsī tā mu pā ya ta/snyedaga' byed kyis sī 7 bag mar blangs/ dz+nyā thra ④smṛ dṛ shī rngusanaḥ/ dz+nyā shā smṛ dṛsha rnams kyi san las so/ /dz+nyā la sogs pa 'di rnams san mtha' can las tang rnams 'gyur te/dzi dz+nyā sa te dharmi/—chos shes par 'dod/ shu byu ṣa te gu rūn/——bla ma rnams la nyan par 'dod/ su sprur+ṣa te mi tram̐⑥/— grogs dran par 'dod/ eṣ+ṭi'i sngon min pa'i/ di dṛk+ṣa te dza na bhū m+bi/——skye yulalta bar 'dod/ sogs so/ /a nodz+nyaḥ/ a nu las dz+nyā las so/ /a nu sngon ma'i dz+nyā san mtha' can las kyang tang rnams 'gyur te/ a nu dzi dz+nyā sa te pu tram̐/snyebu rjes su shes par 'dod/ sogs so/ /'di la tsan+d+ra par a nu snga mas dz+nyā san mtha' can la tang rnams mi 'jug par bshad 'dug cing / 'dir 'jug par bshad nas rgya 'grel du dper brjod kyang gnang bas cung zad mi mthun no/ /pra t+yāng rgyu khru baḥ/ pra ti āng dag las khru las so/ /pra ti dang āng ⑦dag las pha rol gyi thra khrusan mtha' can las tang rnams 'gyur ba ma yin te/ pra ti shu shā ṣa ti/snyeso sor nyan par 'dod/ sto/shu thra ṣa ti/— kun nas nyan par byed/ sogs so/ /ya tsā pā shā/ ji ltar bklags pa la'o/ /bya ba'i don la tang rnams ji ltar bklags pa bzhin 'gyur te/ brta te/snye'ajugapar byed/ brnyo te/— 'phel bar byed/ sogs so/ /117—1033

bhā bā su yo/ dngos po dang bya ba dag las so/ /dngos po dang de'i bya ba las kyi don la tang rnams 'gyur te/ bha ba te/ —thob par byed/ pa tsa te/ —'tshed par byed/ku ru te ka shā/ —reldebyed/ sogs so/ /pro pā ①dz+nyā yu dze ra yadzha pā tre sbyi6/ pra u pa dag las yu dzi las mchod sbyin gyi snod ma yin pa la'o/ /pra dang u pa dag las pha rol gyi yu dzi las mchod sbyin gyi snod ma yin pa la tang rnams 'gyur te/prayī ste/— rab tu sbyor bar byed/ upa yīste/——nye bar sbyor bar byed/ sogs so/ /samaḥspru baḥ / sam las khyu la'o/ /sam las pha rol gyi spru las tang rnams 'gyur te/saṃ spru te shaste/ —mtshon cha kun du rno bar byed/ sogs so/ /bhu dzophon ba ṣ+pe/ bhu dza las skyong ba ma yin pa la'o/ /bhu dza las skyong ba ma yin pa la mi tang rnams 'gyur te/khro 4da rgo hūṃ ste/——zasaza bar byed/ sogs so/ /skyong ba yin na a tang rnams sbyar bas / bhu nat+ta thra thi rā dzā/ sa skyong bar byed rgyal po/ sogs so/ /rdeḥpha la ba tāḥkarta re/ ṇi las 'bras bu ldan pa'i byed pa po la'o/ /ṇi tsa'i mtha' can las 'bras bu ldan pa'i byed pa po la tang rnams 'gyur te/ kā ra ya te/— byedadu 'jug—/ hā ra ya te/ 'phrog tu 'jug/ sogs so/ /pā ṣ+ṭha bi bhā ṣi tāta5 /bklags pa rnam par bshad pa las so/ /bklags pa rnam par bshad pa las 'bras bu ldan pa'i byed pa po la tang rnams 'gyur te/ pa tsa te/ 'tshed par byed/ku ru te/— byedado/ /sogs so/ /kṛ bye baṃ tsuḥpra lo bha ṣ+pe/ kṛ bye pañci dag las rab tu thob pa la'o/ /kṛ dhi dang pañci dag ṇi mtha' can las rab tu thob pa la 'jug pa na tang rnams 'gyur te/ ba sum̐ garja ya tethu/ —slob ma 'dod par byed/ mā ṇa ba shaṃ bañca ya te/ bram ze'i khye'u slu bar byed/ sogs so/ /mi bye pa pā dāta kṛ nyolhasgyu se/ma byā nye ba'i tshig las kṛnya las yang yang la'o4/ /mi byā'i 3sgra 6nye ba'i kṛnya ṇi 117—1034

mtha' can las yang yang la 'jug pa na tang rnams 'gyur te/ pa rda ①mi byā kā ra ya te/—gnas log pa byed du 'jug/ sogs so/ /a pā dwa daḥ/ a pa las pa da las so/ /a pa las pha rol gyi pa da las 'bras bu ldan pa'i byed pa po la tang rnams 'gyur te/ a pa ba da te/—skur pa 'debs par byed/ sogs so/ /sa mu dāng bh+yo ya mophograsgo/ sam uta āng rnams las sdeyam las gzhung ma yin pa la'o/ /sam uta ang ①rnams las pha rol gyi yam las gzhung ma yin pa'i yul la 'bras bu ldan pa'i byed pa po la tang rnams 'gyur te/ spru tīn saṃ yartso te/—'bru rnams sbyin par byed/ bhā ra mur+ya— te/—khur 'degs par byed/ radz+dza mā yartso te/rkothag pa kun du 'degs par byed/ sogs so/ /a nu pa sanāta dzhaḥ/ nyer bsgyur med pa las dz+nyā ④las so/ /nyer bsgyur sngon na med pa'i dz+nyā las 'bras bu ldan pa'i byed pa po la tang rnams 'gyur te/ hūṃ dzā nī te/snyeb lang rnams shes par byed/ sogs so/ /bi ⑤bhā sngo pa pā de na pra ti ya mā ṣ+pedhi/ nye ba'i tshig rtogs pa la gdam nga'o/ /nye ba'i tshig rtogs pa'i 'bras bu ldan pa'i byed pa po la tang dang a ⑦tang rnams 'dam ka can du bya ste/ swa ya oṃ ya dza te/snyerang nyid mchod sbyin sbyin par byed/ swa ya oṃ ⑧ya dza ti—/snyerang nyid mchod sbyin sbyin par byed/ sogs so/ /i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa su sru tād+dhā tū pa sarga yo gāḥs māṭ+wāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las byings dang nyer bsgyur sbyor ba rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las byings dang nyer bsgyur sbyor tshul/nyer bsgyur la brten nas ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da dang pa rame+e pa da sbyor tshul gyi dbye ba 117—1035

/de——/de—/de—/de— — —sogs rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //da ni dngos po dang las kyi skabs su dgos pa'i rkyen sogs kyi cho ga rnams 1bshad par bya ste/ bhā snyeb karma ṇi/ dngos po dang las las so/ /byings las dngos po dang las kyi don la laṭa sogs ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da ①rnams rtag tu 'gyur zhing ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da rnams kyi'ang skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig kho na rtag tu 'gyur te/de yang byings kyi sngon du nyer bsgyur med pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ nyer bsgyur sngon du byung na der ma nges te/ laṭa sogs ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da dgu po ④rnams thams cad 'jug cing der ma zad byings las med pa rnams las can du 'gyur ba dang las can las med du 'gyur ba sogs nyer bsgyur stobs che ba'i dbang gis (5)mtha' yas so/ /sarba /6dh+wa tu ke yaka /byings thams cad pa rnams las yaka'o—/ /byings las dang bcas pa rnams la ⑦las kyi don dang / byings las med pa rnams la dngos po'i don du rnam dbye byengs thams cad pa rnams pha rol la rkyen yaka 'gyur te ka yon tan 'gog pa'i don no/ /༈ bhū la yaka sbyar bas/ bhū ya zhes pa la laṭa/ ling loṭa lang rnams kyi ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig rnams (kyesbyar bas—/ bhū ya te/ bhū ye ta/sgo// bhū ya tsā/ a khyu ya ta sogs te/ a nu khyu ya te ā nan+da bye tre ṇa twa (/rteyā/snyenag pa zla ba'i khyod kyis dga' ba rjes su thog a nu bhū ya te ā nan+dabye tre 1)/ṇa mā yā/snyenag pa zla ba'i bdag gis dga' ba rjes su thob/ nyer bsgyur sngon du byung na ād+ma ṣ+pe pa da thams cad sbyor te/ a nu khyu ya te/ a nu khyu ye te/a nu bhū yadhe/ sogs so/ /byings phyed pa rnams la yaka /stomi 'gyur bas/117 /036

yaka ①tsiṇa dag ma ②yin no/ /1 dang / shrī dang / shinya dang byengs rgyan gyi don can rnams dang / byings san mtha' can rnams las kyang yaka dang tsiṇa dag 'gyur ba ma yin te/ tī ra te/ gī ra te/ shra ya te/ tai sa te/snyergyan byed / tsi tīr+ṣa te/ sogs so/ /byings las med pa dang / las dang bcas pa'i dbye ba 'grel par tshigs bcad byung ba ni/ ji skad du/ladz+dza saṭ+wābyu ti dzā ga ra ṇi dṛrnyi k+ṣa ya bha ya dzī bi ta ma ram̐/ sha yan kri ḍā ru tsi dīs+t+yadze+e dh+wa tu ga rte ta ma karma ka 1mā huḥ/ de bod skad du bsgyur na/ ngo tsha yod pa gnas pa mel tshe dang / /'phel ba zad pa 'jig pa 'tsho ba dang / /nyal dang rtsed mo 'dod dang 'bar ba'i don/ /byings kyi tshogs rnams las med par bshad do/ /zhes pa ste/ nyer bsgyur sngon na med pa'i dbang du byas nas—/ ngo tsha ba la sogs pa don tshan bcu gnyis po de rnams kyi don can gyi byings ni las med pa yin la/ gzhan rnams ni las dang bcas pa'i byings zhes bya'o/ /i ti bā ṇi ④byu ka ra ṇa su sru tād+dhā ba karma naḥs mābhāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las dngos po dang las rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las dngos po dang las kyi don gyi rkyen dang cho ga sogs rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //da ni laṭa la ⑤ sogs pa rnams kyi 'jug yul thun mong du bshad pa rnams bstan par bya ste/ a bhi dz+nyā ba tsa ṣ+pe kṛṭa/ dngos su shes pa'i brjod pa la 117—1049

khriṭa ki ki lkul two rngo 7shu dā.oṃ sgo gh+ra se/ —ci drag khyod dmangs rigs zas za bar 'gyur/ asnyi shu dī ga mi 1 gh+ra se/— yod pa dmangs rigs mo la 'gro bar 'gyur/ bha ba ti shu dī ④ga mi k+ṣu se/snyeyod pa dmangs rigs mo la 'gro bar 'gyur/ bi r+ya te a+yoshu dī khyeg mi k+ṣu ti/ yod pa dmangs rigs mo la 'gro bar 'gyur/ dzā tu ya do rling kye/ dzā tu yang dag las ling ngo / /dzā tu dang yang dag sbyor ba las smad pa la dus gsum ka la ling 'gyur te/ dzā tu ta tra bha bān shu dro yā dza yeta/ nam zhig der khyod dmangs rigs la mchod sbyin byed/ yat+ta tra two shu droyā dza yeta / gang der spyod dmangs rigs la mchod sbyin byed/ ya dā kyeya dro rlo ge tsa/ ya dā ya di ga gi spyor ba la 'ang ngo / /ya dā dang ya di sgra sbyor ba la'ang smod pa rtogs par byed pa la ling 'gyur te/ ya dā two shu dz+ra yā dza yeta/ gang tshe khyod dmangs rigs la mchod sbyin byed—/ ya di two shu dro yā dza yeta/ gang tshe khyod dmangs rigs la mchod sbyin byed/ yastso ya tra yoḥ/yastso ya tra dag gi'o/ /yastso dang ya tra dag gi sbyor ba la'ang smad pa rtogs par byed pa la ling 'gyur te/ yartso ta tra bha bān thra bye/ riṣa lo yā 6dza yeta/ gang yang der khyed dmangs rigs la mchod sbyin byed/ ya tra —1ta tra two bṛ ṣa lo ⑫yā dza yeta/— gang du der spyod dmangs rigs la mchod sbyin byed/ tsi ṭī ka ra be+e tsa/ ngo mtshar bar byed pa la'ang ngo / /yastso dang ya tra dag sgo /yod pa la ngo mtshar ba rtogs par byed pa la ling 'gyur te/yastso two shu dro yā dza yeta/ gang yang spyod dmangs rigs la mchod sbyin byed/ ya tra two shu dro yā dza yeta / —gang du spyod dmangs rigs la mchod sbyin byed/ she ṣe mṛ ḍa ya do/ lhag ma dang ya di ma yin pa la kṛṭa'o/ /lhag ma ste yartso dang ya tra dag dang ya di sbyor ba ma yin 6 pa las gzhan du ngo mtshar ba rtogs par byed pa la mṛṭa 'gyur te/ a 8 rtswadz+nyā an+dha nā ma kṛṇ+ḍa dra gh+ra ti/——ngo mtshar long ba jes bya ba nag po lta bar byed/ ābyarlo shā5ba bye ro nā ma shaja sho 6 ti/——ngo mtshar 'on pa zhes bya ba sgra nyan par byed/ u ta pyoḥs marba yorling /117—1054

uta a pi dag las legs pa'i don la linga'o/ /uta dang a pi sbyor ①ba las legs pa'i don rtogs par byed pa la ling 'gyur te/ uta ha r+sāta de tram̐ ha ri / —'phrog byed kyis lha min 'joms par byed/ a pi ha t+yāta de tram̐ ha ri/—'phrog byed kyis lha min 'joms par byed/ ling ni miste kṛ yā ti pasto ②bhū telhani tram̐ mṛng / ling gi yul la bya ba shor ba dang byung ba la'ang mṛng rtag tu'o/ /ling gi yul la bya ba shor ba dang byung ba'i dus rtogs par byed pa la kṛng rtag tu 'gyur te/ ka mo melhasgo k+ṣuta bha bān/—khyod kyis bdag gi las skyong bar mdzod/ saṃ bhā ba ṣ+pephol mi ti tsesmid+dhā pra ye ①ge/srid pa la a lo zhes pa gal te grub par mi sbyor ro/ /srid pa rtogs par byed pa la a lo zhes pas don gyi yul la gal te a lo nyid kyi sgra grub par mi sbyo/ra ba la ling mi 'gyur te/ a pi gi ri shi ra sā p+ta r+yata/—ri bo yang mgos 'bugs nus/ bi bhā ṣā jo to saṃ bhā ba na tsa ṣ+pe3ya di/ byings la srid pa brjod pa la ya di ma yin pa la yang na'o/ /byings la srid pa brjod pa rtogs par byed pa la ya di'i sgra sbyor ba ma yin pa la ling 'gyur zhing yang na kṛṭa 'gyur te/ ling—bhurdzi ta bha bān/snye.a kyis zos/ lngaṭa —sgo ④khyu te bha bān/rkozabara'agyur khyod kyis/ he tu he tu ma to rming / rgyu dang rgyu can dag la linga'o/ /rgyu dang rgyu can dag byung ba'i bya ba la 'jug pa rtogs par byed pa la ling 'gyur zhing yang na kṛṭa 'gyur te/ bud+dhā ya na meta su khaṃ yā yāta/—sangs rgyas la phyag byas pas bde ba thob/ bud+dhā ya na meta su khaṃ yā su ti/—sangs rgyas la phyag byas pas bde ba thob par 'gyur/ itshwaze 6 ling lo ṭo/ 'dod pa'i don rnams la ling loṭa dag go/ /byengs las 'dod pa'i don rnams rtogs par byed pa la ling dang loṭa dag 'gyur te/ bye dzī ta bha bān/rko.a za bar 'gyur/ bye ā+oṃ bha bān/snye.a za bar 'gyur/ ling tsa/ leng 'ang ngo / /byed po dang lhan cig pa'i las kyi 117—1055

bar byed/ pun pu na swa ste/snyeslar yang slar yang bde legs su stsar cig/ sogs so/ /i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa su sru tāta kā khārba brtuḥs mābhāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las dus kyi don gyi 'jug pa rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las laṭa sogs 'das ma 'ongs da ltar ba sogs kyi dus kyi khyad par gyi don la 'jug yul rags pa rnams bshad zin te/ 'grel par ji skad du/ d+mā tū ①nā ma nan+ta tārtso nā nārja tārtso sarba thā/a pi dh+wa tu ma sha kya mi t+ya la mā khyu ta khyu pa ṣ+pe/ byings rnams kyang ni mtha' yas nyid—/ /sna tshogs don nyid thams cad du/ /byings rnams mngon gsal nus ji bzhin②/ /kun bshad rdzogs par bshad pa'o/ /zhes kyang byung bas/byings re res don mang po dang / byengs mang po don re re la 'jug pa sogs mtha' yas la/ de rnams kyi don gsal bar brjod dgos pa rnams rang gi nus pa dang 'tsham pa kun nas bshad pa'i don rnams tshang bar bshad zin no zhes pa ste/ de ltar brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo slob dpon chen po rā ma tsan+d+ras mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las/ laṭa sogs sde tshan bcu bam ti sogs brgya brgyad cu ste rnam dbye sde tshan phyi ma rnams byengs la sbyor tshul sogs zhib mor bstan pa kun bshad pa'i rab tu bya ba rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //117—1057

/debla ma dang chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo /de ltar byings tshig tu bsgrub (pa kun nas bshad pa'i cho ga rnams bstan zin nas/da ni byings ming du bsgrub pa'i rkyen kṛta la sogs pa gernams kyi 'jug yul cho ga dper brjod sogs bshad par bya ste/ dh+wa toḥ/ byings las so 'chad 'gyur kṛta sogs kyi rkyen ta bya la sogs pa 'di rnams byings las pha rol tu 'gyur te byings ming du bsgrub pa'i rkyen zhes bya'o/ /ta tro pa pa rda sap+ta m+bisbe/de la bdun pa gnas pa nye ba'i tshig go/ /kṛta sogs kyi rkyen can de'i sngon du byung ba'i bdun pa gnas pa ste rnam dbye bdun pa'i don brjod pa'i tshig de la nye ba'i tshig gi ming can zhes ming 'dogs byed do/ /bā sa rū pophoste yī/ bud med ma yin pa gzugs mtshungs pa min pa yang na'o/ /bud med du bsgrub pa'i rkyen ma yin pa rkyen dmigs bsal can dang / bsgrubs zin gyi gzugs mtshungs pa ma yin pa'i spyir btang gi rkyen ni dmigs bsal gyi yul la'ang yang na 'gyur ro/ /kṛ t+yāḥpāngaṇa laḥ/ rtsul las sngon ma kṛta'o/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i rkyen rtsul las sngon ma'i rkyen gang yin pa de rnams dang der ma zad byengs ming du byed pa'i rkyen 'chad 'gyur thams cad la kṛta kyi ming can zhes ming 'dogs byed do/ /karta ri kṛta/ byed pa po la kṛta'o/ /byed pa po ste byed pa can dang bya ba'i don la bying las rkyen kṛta kyi ming can rnams 'gyur ro zhes pa spyir btang ba'o/ /ta yo re ba kṛ t+yak+ta kha laṭ+wāḥ/ kṛta k+ta khal dag don de dag nyid la'o/ /gong du rkyen kṛta kyi ming can rnams byed pa po'i don la 'gyur bar bshad kyang de'i dmigs bsal kṛta kyi ming can yin kyang rkyen k+ta dang khal gnyis ni don de dag nyid de dngos po dang las kyi don nyid la 'gyur 717 1058 //

gyis byed pa po'i don la 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /ta byat+ta byā m+bi ya raḥ/ ta byata/ta bya a nī yar rnams so/ /k+ta dang khal du ma zad byings las bya ba'i don las pha rol du dngos po dang las dag la/ ta byata dang ta bya dang / a bhā yar rnams 'gyur te/ ta bya ta'i tra yig ni rigs mtshon pa'i don dang a bhā yar kyi ra yig dbyangs 'gog pa'i don no/ /e dha 'phel ba la ta byata dang ta bya a be+e yar rnams sbyar/ ta bya gnyis la byings phyed pa sogs kyis bal dang po'i iṭa byin / ma ning la su am du bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/ e dhi ta bye/——'phel bar byas/ edha bhā yi/ 'phelabar byas/ 'grel par dngos po'i don gyi rkyen can rnams la su sogs gcig tshig kho na 'jug cing rtags kyang ma ning nyid do zhes kyang byung ngo / /de bzhin du/ tsisto gsog pa la ta bya a bhā yar sbyar/ byings thams cad pa dang byings phyed pa sogs kyis yon tan byas pas/ tabyasnyetse ta byaḥtwa yā dharmaḥ/—/da kyis chos gsog par byas/ tsa ya bhā yaḥtwa yā dharmaḥ/—/da kyis chos gsog par byas/ba seḥta byata/ ba si las ta byata'o/ /ba si las byed pa po'i don la ta byata 'gyur ro/ /karta ri ṇirtso/ byed pa po la ṇa 'gro ba'ang ngo / /ta byata byed pa po'i don la spyor ba na ta byata la ṇa 'gro ba'i ming can zhes bya ste dgos pa ni 'phel ba byed pa'i don no/ /bas nges par gnas pa la mdo sngon ma'i ta byata sbyar / mdo 'dis 'phel ba byas pas/ bās+thā byaḥ/ sdod par byed dam gnas par byed/'grel par lung drangs pa/ karma karta ri ke li ma/ las dang byed pa po la ke li ma'o/ /las dang byed pa po dag la ke li ma 'gyur te/ patsa 'tshed pa la ke li ma sbyar/ ka yon tan 'gog pa'i don yin pas phyis/ tsa drangs pas/pa tse li māḥtaṇ+ḍa lāḥ/snye'abrasa'atshod par byed/ kṛ t+ya tsaḥ/ kṛta atsa'i'o/ /nyer 117/de1059

bsgyur sngon na med pa'i ga da gsal bar brjod pa/ ma dī dag pa/ tsa ra g.yo ba/ ya mu nye bar 'gog pa rnams las kyang yata 'gyur te/ ga bye/snyerkangapa ste tshig lhug pa'i ming / mabye/——stsos 'gyur chang / tsa:/ spyod pa/ ya bye/ —'gog bya/ tsa re rā di tsā gu ro/ tsa ri'i āng las kyang bla ma ma yin pa las so/ /āng las pha rol gyi tsa ra las kyang bla ma brjod pa ma yin pa la yata 'gyur te/ ā tsaṅgi de shaḥ/ yul kun du spyod pa/ bla ma yin na rgya sbyar u pa dh+wa'i 'os 'phel ba byas pas ā tsā/de / — slobadapon/ a ba r+ya pa bye bra dz+nyā ga khya pa ṇi ta byu ni ro dhe 6ཿ/ a ba r+ya pa ju pra bye rnams smad bya/ btsong bya/ 'gog pa med pa rnams la'o / /nanya sngon ma'i ba da smra ba/ pa na tha snyad/ bra dza 'gro ba rnams la yata sbyar bas/ a ba byehūṃ/ khanam tho ba/ pa bye/ zong/ pra rdzu rnams rim pa bzhin/—'gro bya smad bya/ btsong bya/ 'gog pa med pa rnams brjod pa la tshig phrad do/ /ba hūṃ ka ra khaṃ/ ba hūṃ byed pa la'o/ /ba ha thob pa la yata sbyar bas/ ba hūṃ zhes pa byed pa po brjod pa la tshig phrad du bya ste/ ba hūṃ sha ka ṭi/—shingarta byed/ a/deswā mi be+e sh+ya yoḥ/ a/dejo bo dang rje'u rigs dag la'o/ /ṛ 'gro ba la yata sbyar bas a/dezhes pa ni jo bo dang rje'u rigs dag brjod pa la tshig phrad do/ /ṛ tu ma ngh+ru pa sar+yā snye/ u pa sar+yā zla mtshan can ma la'o/ /u pa snga ma'i mṛ 'gro ba la yata sbyar bas/ u pa sarlu zhes pa bud med zla mtshan can ma brjod pa la tshig phrad do/ /a dza.oṃ saṅga tai/ a dza: yang dag song ba la'o/ /nanya snga ma'i dzī lang tsho nyams pa la yata sbyar bas/ a dza:/ dang yol ba'am na tshong song ba/ zhes pa thuyang dag par song ba brjod pa la tshig phrad du bya'o/ /ṛ ha losbyata/ ṛ dang hal las juta'o/ /byings ṛ mtha' can dang hal mtha' can las bya ba'i don 1 17—1063

tsartsa:—/ ya dza yā tsa ru tsa pra ba tsa ṛtsa'i 'ang ngo / /yadza lha mchod pa/ yātsa slong ba/ rutsa 'bar ba/ pra sngon ma'i ba tsa brjod pa / ṛtsa mchod pa rnams kyi'ang rgya pha rol la ka sder ①'gyur ba ma yin te/yā3rdzu/— mchod bya/ yārtsu/——slongabya/ ro:/snye'abar bya/ prabāspyo /snyerab tu brjod bya/ astsod/— mchod bya—/ 'grel par t+ya dza lang tsho nyams pa dang pūdza mchod pa dag gi'ang rgya pha rol la ka sder 'gyur ba ma yin no zhes bshad pas/ t+yā rdzu/——rgan po/ pūrdzu/snyemachod bya—/ ba tsophoshalda saṃ snyo yī/ ba tsa'i sgra'i ming ma yin pa la'o/ /ba tsa'i sgra'i ming ste brjod pa'i don ma yin pa la ka sder mi 'gyur te/ bā rtsu/snyemismrab/ brjodapa'i don la ka sder 'gyur bas/ bā kyi/——brjod bya/ pra yo bye ni yo bye zhusha kyābe+e/ pra yo ribye ni yo bye dag nus pa'i don la'o/ /pra dang ni sngon ma'i yu dzir sbyor ba la rgyata sbyar bas/ pra yo bye dang ni yo bye dag nus pa'i don brjod pa la tshig phrad do / /nus pa'i don min pye na dza gar bsgyur bas/ pra yo bye/snyerab tu sbyor bya/ ni yo rgya/——ngesapar spyor bya/ 'grel pa/ bhu dza' 'ang za ba'i don la ka sder mi bye 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/ sgo bye ma.oṃ/——bza' bya bas/ za ⑦ba'i don min na ka sder 'gyur te/ sgo gyedu/snyeskyongabya/ o rā ba sh+ya ke/ u las nges pa can la'o/ /byengs u yig mtha' can las gdon mi za ba'am nges pa can gyi dngos po rtogs par byed pa'i don la 5ta 'gyur te/ khrunya ⑨gcod pa la k+shita/ atsa'i 'ang nya ṇa ⑫'gro ba la 'os 'phel ba/ ya'i rkyen la ba'i mtha' can nos au ⑫ā bar bsgyur rmyebs/ a ba sh+ya lā bye/—nges par gcad bya/ sogs so/ /ā su yu ba pi ra pi la pi tra pi tsa mastsa/ ā su yu ba pi ra pi la pi tra pi tsam las kyang ngo / /āng snga ma'i 6nya mngon par skye ba/ yu spel ba/117—1065

pa tsa dang di bu tse ① ba la atsa byin pas/ pa tsaḥ/— 'tshedapar byed/ de baḥ/snyelha/sogs so/ /ya ngolhatsi tse ti ya ngo luka /yang las atsa ste yang 'ang 'jig go/ /byings yang gi mtha' can la'ang atsa 'gyur te atsa pha rol la yang yang 'jig go//be+e dang khru yang rkyen bcas/ ṣ+pe nī ya dang lo phru ya la atsa byin yang 'jig /yang phyis pa'i rjes yin pas yon tan mi byed/ snga ma la atsa gcig ma yin pa sogs kyis yan dang / phyi ma la atsa la dzo byings sogs kyis u bar bsgyur bas/no n+yaḥ/—shin tu 'dren par byed/ lolubaḥ/——shin tu gcod pa byed/ sogs so/ /'grel par u mtha' can las yang rkyen yang na mi 'jig go zhes bshad pas/ yang na yang rkyen ma phyis pa ata kyi dbyi 'os a phyis pas/ ro rū ⑤yaḥ/——shin tu smra bar byed/sogs so/ /tsa ri tsa li pa ti ba dī rmā bā dri twa ma byātshi sgyu sa se①/ tsa ri tsa li ba ti ba di rnams kyi gnyis nyid yang na ste a sgyu sdesa'i āstsa 'ang ngo / /tsa ra dang tsa la g.yo ba/ ba da lhung ba/ ba da brjod pa rnams kyi atsa pha rol la yang na gnyis brjod cing gnyis brjod pa na a sgyu sa'i ā ④stsa ā ga ma 'gyur te/ a brjod don tsa khyad don ka gnas don no/ /byengs de rnams la a tsa gnyis brjod āstsa ā ga ma byin pas/ tsa rā tsa raḥ/snye'agro bar byed/ tsalā tsa laḥ/snyegayobar byed/ pa tā pa taḥ/snye lhungabar byed/ ba dā ba daḥ/snyesmra bar byed/ sogs sam yang na gnyis ma brjod na/ tsa raḥ/——'gro bar byed/ tsalaḥ⑥ /snyegayo bar byed/ pa taḥ⑦/——lhung bar byed/ ba daḥ/——smrabar byed/ sogs so/ /'grel par / kṛnya la dngos po'i don la ka 'gyur te/ ka pha rol la gnyis brjod pa'ang ngo zhes bshad pasaldu/ kṛ la ka gnyis brjod/ ṛ'i ata/ ku ha dag gi tsu/ kra ⑪kita kyi don yin pas ka ⑪ phyis/ ika gi atsa la yaṇa sbyar bas/117—1074

gā las rgyuṭa 'ang 'gyur te/ ṭa ṭita kyi don dang ṇa 'phel ba'i don/ yu a nar bsgyur āta las yuka ā ga ma byin pas/ gā 1ya naḥ/——glumakhan ma/ habyu spru hi kā la yoḥ/ hā las kyang 'bru dang dus dag la'o/ /o hāka gtong ba las 'bru dang dus dag brjod pa la byuta 'gyur te/ hā ya naḥ/—'bru/ nā ma bye ha yaḥ/ zhes bya ba'i 'bru/ hā ya naḥsadzat+pa raḥ/ 'dor byed de lo'o/ /pru thra lwaḥs ma rnyi 4hā re bun/pru mṛ phru las mnyam pa'i byed pa la bun 'o/ /prung dang mṛ 'gro ba/ phrunya gcod pa rnams las mnyam pa'i byed pa brjod pa la bun 'gyur te/ na dbyangs don bu a kar bsgyur bas/ pra ba kaḥ/ khrus mkhan/ sarakaḥ/ phor bzo ba/la ba kaḥ/— 'dreg mkhan/ ā shi ṣe tsa/ smon pa la'ang ngo / /byings las smon pa rtogs par byed pa la'ang bun 'gyur te/ dzī ba srog 'tsho ba/ nan+da dga' ba la bun sbyar bas/ dzī ba kaḥ/ 'tsho bar shog/ nan+da kaḥ/ dga' bar shog/ sogs so/ /t+tatsa lto tsa saṃ dz+nyā yī/ ming la t+tatsa dang k+ta dag kyang ngo / /byings las ming gi don brjod pa la stitsa dang k+ta dag 'gyur ro/ /ti tu tra ta thā se su sa ra ka se 6 tsa / ti tu tra ta thā si su sa ra ka sa rnams la'ang ngo / /kṛta sogs kyi rkyen ti la sogs pa 'di rnams la iṭa 'gyur ba ma yin no//bhū 1yod pa la mdo sngon mas t+tatsa byin/ tsa dbyangs don kra ce/yon tan 'gog pa'i don mdo 'dis iṭa 'gyur ba ma yin te/ byu tiḥthu/——'byorapa/ de bzhin du/junya srog chags mngal nas skye ba la stitsa sbyar bas/ sru tiḥ/—skyeb/ sogs so/ /a nu nā si kagya ki dzha loḥsdi ti/ rjes su sna ldan gye dzhal ka nga 'gro ba la kib dag la'o / /byings rjes su sna ldan mtha' can gyi u pa dh+wa ñcani kṛta sogs kyi rkyen dzhal dang po ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can dang kipa rnams pha rol la ring por 'gyur ro/ /117—1078

ma rnams kyang tshig phrad do/ /'grel par/ ka ra las pha rol gyi n+d+ra las kyang kha sha 'gyur bar bshad pas/ ka rarnya maḥ/——byedapa ste lag pa/ pri ya ba she ba daḥkhatsa/pri ya ba sha la bad las khatsa'o/ /thra ya dang ba sha dag las pha rol gyi bad las khatsa 'gyur te/ tsa dbyangs don/ kha khita kyi don no/ /gri yo ba daḥ—/ —dga'ab brjod pa/ ba shadza daḥ/— legasapa brngod pa/ 'grel par supa las pha rol gyi gam las khatsa 'gyur bar bshad pas/ bhu dze+e ga maḥ/——laga'agro/ bi hā yasaḥbi hatsa / bi hā ya sa'i bi ha'ang ngo / /bi hā yas las pha rol gyi gam las khatsa 'gyur zhing bi ha lhayas kyang bi ha zhes par bsgyur bar bya ste/ bi haṃ ga maḥ/—nam mkha' la 'gro ba ste 'dab chags so/ /'grel par yang na khatsa la nga 'gro ba bzhin rjes su sna ldan dbyi'o zhes bsha 37pas/ bhu j-i gaḥ/ —laga'agro/ bi haṃ gaḥ/snyemakha'a'agro/ sogs so / /dī ṣa pa ra yoḥtā pi 7ཿ/ dī ṣa pa ra dag la tā pi las so/ /dī ṣa dang pa ra dag las pha rol gyi ta pa ṇitsa'i mtha' can la khatsa 'gyur ro/ /kha tsi hra swaḥ/ khatsa la thung ngu'o/ /khatsa pha rol la ṇitsa las byung ba'i u pa jo bud med brjod pa ma yin pa thung ngur 'gyur te/ dī ṣa dang pa ra snga ma'i tā pi la mdo snga mas khatsa ṇi iṭa med pa la phyis/ mdo 'dis u pa jo thung ngur bsgyur bas—/ dī ṣe ta paḥ/——dgrabardung / pa re ta paḥ/snyepharolabardung / bud med yin na/dri ṣa tī tā paḥ/— mi mthun pa mo brdung / bā tsi ya mo pra te/ brtul zhugs la ④ bā tsa las yam la'o/ /mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la 'jug pa na bātsa las pha rol gyi ya mu la khatsa 'gyur ro/ /bā rtsa ya ma pu re da ro tsa/ bā rtsa ya ma pu ram̐ da ra dag kyang ngo / /bātsa snga ma'i ya mu dang pur snga ma'i dṛ la khatsa sbyar bas/ bā rtsa ya ma—/ — mi smra ba ngag bsdams pa'am smra bcad/ grong 'joms te dbang po'o//snyepu ram̐ da ra dag chirdog phrad 117/de1086

byā ka ra ṇa su sru tāṭ+wā ra ka da yaḥs mādz+nyāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las byed pa la sogs pa rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā 7ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las kṛta la sogs pa'i nang nas byed pa po la sogs pa'i rkyen rnams kyi 'jug yul cho ga dang bcas pa rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //da ni brtag pa'i rkyen uṇa la sogs pa rnams kyi 'jug yul sogs zur tsam bshad par bya ste/ u shā da yo ba hu lo/ uṇa la sogs pa rnams mang po la'o / /dus gsum ga la 'jug pa'i ming du bsgrub pa'i rkyen ni un la sogs pa ste rkyen de rnams ni bya ba'i don sogs la mang po la 'jug go zhes spyir btang ba'o / /kṛ bā pā dzi mi swa da sā dh+ya shu bh+ya 2uṇa/ kṛ bā pā dzi mi swa da sā bye a shu rnams las uṇa'o/ /kṛ byed pa/ bā 'gro ba/ bā btung ba/ dzi rgyal ba ḍū minya rab tu 'phen pa/ swa da ro myang ba/ sā dha yang dag par grub pa/ a shu khyab pa rnams las uṇa 'gyur te/kā ruḥ/ bzo bo/ bā 1yuḥ/— rlung / pāyuḥ/— bshangalam/ dzāyuḥ/ —rgyalab/ māyuḥ/ 'phen pa/ swā duḥ/ byang ba/ sa/dhuḥ/ legs pa/ yidashuḥ/ khyabapa/ ga me /deḥ/ gam las ḍo'o / /gasmṛ 'gro ba las ḍo 'gyur te/ ṭi'i 'os ziṭi phyis pas/——go las ṇita/snyegoḥ/ b.lang/ glu nu di rgyu ḍo/ glu nud dag las ḍo'o/ /1 dga' ba zad pa dang nud ded pa dag la ḍi 'gyur te/ sh+lauḥ/ zlab/ noḥ/ —gru/ se ta ni ga 117—1115

gre hā pyaḥ/—nyer len/ da rā be+eḥ/rkornama'ajoms/ dzayāpyaḥ/—rgyalab/ 'grel par lung drangs pa/ sta ni dru ṣi ga di z-irngo 5dhe bh+ya isnuḥ/ sta ni dru ṣi ga di z-id rnams las ṇi mtha' las isnu'o/ /sta ni la sogs pa 'di rnams ṇi tsa'i mtha' can las isnu 'gyur te mita bzhin 'phel ba mi byed do/ /sta na yisnuḥ/—bzhodadamanu ma/ dru ṣayisnuḥ/—kugabasngal/ gad yisnuḥ/—mab/ z-id yisnuḥ|—mdza' bo'am sems mthun/ 1 shrī : dzā kṛ bh+yaḥkin/ 4 spyo : dzā gre rnams las kin 'o/ /1 la sogs pa 'di rnams las kin 'gyur te/tīrbiḥ / —'tshe ba/ gībe+eḥ/—gsal ba/ snribe+eḥ/rna'agebs pa/ dzāgre biḥ/—gnyidasong ba/ 'grel par ji skad du/ a r+sā sru ṇa da yaḥ.un la sogs pa gzhan yang ngo / /uṇa la sogs pa 'dir bshad pa ni rags bsdus tsam yin la/ rgyas par gzhan yang 'byung bas de dag tu ltos zhes kha 'phangs pa'o/ /i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa su sru tā du ṇa da yaḥs mābhāḥ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā kā ra ṇa'i mdo las uṇa la sogs pa rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin zis su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las dus gsum ga la 'jug pa un la sogs pa'i cho ga rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //da ni bya ba'i rkyen la sogs pa rnams bshad par bya ste/ tu mun 2 lo kri yā lnga kri yāṭ+wā rmā/ bya ba dang bya ba'i don la tu mun rtsul dag go/ /byengs las bya ba dang bya ba'i don brjod pa la tu mun dang rtsul dag 'gyur te/ dubye/—nad/117—1117

rda sha las so/ /gsum pa'i mtha' nye ba'i tshig las pha rol gyi u pa rda sha las ṇa mul 'gyur te/ spru la ke no ba rda sha hūṃ ste/—rtsa ba can gyis nye bar za bar byed/ ā pa dā ṣ+pe pa rīsgyu lnga/ byung khungs la yongs su myur ba la'o/ /byung khungs te lnga pa'i mtha' nye ba'i tshig la ches myur ba'i don rtogs par byed pa'i bya ba'i don la ṇa mul 'a/der te/ sha 'do yāḥ/—nyal ba las langs/ yidat+tha sku//—uta snga ma'i s+thā la ṇa mul yug ā ga ma/uta la 1 stasgyu sogs kyis sa phyis/ dī tī rmā tsa/ gnyis pa la'ang ngo / /gnyis pa'i mtha' can nye ba'i tshig las kyang myur ba rtogs par byed pa la bya ba'i don la ṇa mul 'gyur te/ yaṣ+ṭi gra haṃ yu rgyan+ta/—gsal shing bzung nas 'bab par byed/ a bya ye ya thā snyi thra yā khyu ṣ+pe kṛ nyaḥghā ṇa mu lo/ gang mi zad pa la mngon par dga' ba brjod pa la kṛnya las ghā ①dang ṇa mul dag go/ /gang mi zad pa nye ba'i tshig las mngon par dga' ba brjod pa'i don rtogs par byed pa'i bya ba la ghā dang ṇa mul 'gyur te/ u: kṛ t+ya thra lnga bru te/snyedaga' ba brjod de mtho bar byas/—u: kṛ tā thra yī byu te/u: kā ram̐ thra lnga byu te/snyedaga' ba brjod de mtho bar byas/ sogs so/ /i ti pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa su sru tāskṛ tā da ya sa mābhā②ཿ/ zhes pa pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo las kṛta la sogs pa rnams rdzogs so// //de rnams kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs zin bris su bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las kṛta la sogs pa byings las ming du bsgrub pa'i cho ga spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa rags pa rnams re zhig rdzogs so// //'grel pa'i mjug tu sbyar byang dang shis pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 117—1131

byung ba ni/ pra kṛ yā kau mu dī se yo rā ma tsan+d+ra pra kā shi tā/ a sa twa tsasta mo pa dh+yāt+partso ko ra bri yā tsi ram̐/ bod skad du/ rab byed shin tu gsal ba de 'di yang / /dga' byed zla bas rab tu gsal bar byas/ /bden med brjod pa mtha' ma 'ching byed de/ /dpyod ldan dam pa rtag tu dga' bar byed/ /ces so / /gnyis pa shis pa brjod pa ni/ ā tsār+ya pā tu bha ga bān shi lhi pā tu bi nā ya kaḥ/ /nibe+ergyu sngatsu sarba tra pā ṇi m+bi ya pra sā da taḥ/ /bod skad du/ slob dpon srung bar mdzod cig bcom ldan 'das/ /slob ma srung bar mdzod cig rnam par 'dren/ /thams cad du yang gegs yod ma yin pa/ /drang srong pā ①ṇi ni yi bka' drin las/ /maṅga lo le kha kā rmā tsa pā ṭha kā rmā tsa maṅga lo/ /maṅga lo sarba byu tā dz+wa byu mi bhū pa ti maṅga lo/ /'dri ba rnams kyang bkra shis shing / /klog pa rnams kyang bkra shis pa/ /srog chags thams cad bkra shis shing / /sa dang sa bdag bkra shis shog /ces pa'o/ /de ltar brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po brgyad kyi nang tshan de rnams kyi nang nas kyang go don cho ga sogs phul du phyin pa mdor na sgra'i gtsug lag thams cad kyi phyi mo lta bur gyur pa 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal pos 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud sogs su lung bstan pa'i bram ze chen po pā ṇi ni la 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gis dngos su stsal ba/ pā ṇi ni byā ka ra ṇa gzhung 'grel gyi go don cho ga dper brjod sogs reg zig tu bkod pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang cag gangs ri'i khrod pa rnams kyi mtshungs pa med pa'i skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa 'phags pa phyag na pad+mo nyid gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs pa don gye be+ed du mtshan nas smos te/ rgyal dbang 117—1132

thams cad mdon pa chen po ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs ①med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mnyam pa med pa'i thugs rje'i zer ②gyis bskyangs shing / paṇ+ḍi ta mched la gser dngul zho grangs brgya phrag du ma sogs ci 'dod kyi yo byad mtha' dag 'bad med du /de te/ bka' 'bangs la'ang khyod kyis gzhung bod skad du bsgyur ba dang / 'grel pa'i go don dper brjod zin bris su 'debs pa sogs gyis shig ces bka'i gnang ①ba thob par brten/ dam pa gang de'i gzhal du med pa'i bka' drin las brda sprod pa'i ring lugs la cung zad tsam sbyangs pa bka' 'bangs ④kyi tha chungs ⑤gtsang stod 'dar gyi sa'i char se'i rigs las skyes pa ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub bam/ ming gzhan tshe dbang rab brtan rdo rjer bod pa'i rmongs brtul snyom las pas/ 'phags yul ku ru k+ṣe trar bram ze gtsang ma'i rigs su 'khrungs pa gnas lnga rig pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta ba la bha dra dang / paṇ+ḍi ta go ku la nā tha mi shra mched kyi drung du gzhung gi sgra sgrub dang go don dper brjod sogs legs par nyan te gzhung bod skad du bsgyur/ slob dpon chen po rā ma tsan+d+ras mdzad pa'i 'grel pa pra kri ya ste rab tu bya ba zhes pa gzhir bzhagarjo /kun bshad sogs cho ga rtogs dka' ba rnams la slob dpon mkhas pa'i gsung rgyun gyis zur brgyan te cung zad rgyas par byas/snyertsa bsgrub kyi mchan bu zhib par btab yod/rtogs sla ba rnams nyung ngur byas te/ me mkha' rgya mtsho la 'das lo drug cu skor bcu dang nyag sum cu rtsa gcig bsre pa rnam 'phyang zhes pa sa pho khyi lo rang lo nyer lngar sleb pa chu stod zla ba'i yar tshes dge bar 'go brtsams/ kun ldan zhes pa lcags byi nag pa zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa pa she'i 'grub sbyor gyi 117—1133

dus dge bar chos grwa chen po dpal ldan 'bras srungs kyi rang shag rgyud steng spyil por sbyar ba 'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can yongs la phan par gyur cig /ces pa 'di la bdag nyid blo gos kyi na tshod shin tu gzhon pas 'gyur ma dag pa dang / dper brjod go don sogs la 'gal 'khrul snang na bla ma mchog dang mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzod la tshul bzhin 'chos par mdzad du gsol—/ dge 'dis dpal stug gsang ba kun 'dus rin chen gser gyi sa gzhi 'dzin/ /mtha' yas gdul bya skabs gsum yongs kyi gnyen gcig dpal ldan ngag gi dbang / /blo gros bzang po'i nyi zlas rab 'khyud rgya chen shes bya'i mkha' la khyab/ /mtsho ltar zab yangs mkhyen pa'i dpal mnga' ji srid bar du brtan pa dang / /bgrang yas skye dgu'i legs byas kyis bskrun lugs zung khrims kyi gdugs dkar po/ /phul byung khyon yangs 'dod dgu'i dpal ster yid bzhin nor bu'i tog gis sprasasti/ /nam yang 'gog med mkha' la rab bteg phan dang bde ba'i grib bsel gang / /bstan dang 'gro ba'i mi mthun gdung sel mchog tu lhag par mdzes gyur cig /tshul 'dir log rtog rdul gyis nyer bsgribs nas/ /gzhung don dga' ma'i bzhin ras mi gsal na/ /mkhas mchog dam pa'i spyan sngar mi 'chab pas/ /dpyad gsum dag pas byi dor mdzad du gsol/ /gang gi narig tshul gaṅgā'i yab gcig las/ /nyer 'ongs legs tshogs rab dwangs dal 'gro yis/ /yid can rmongs pa'i dri ma kun bkrus nas/ /kun mkhyen rin chen rgya mtshor 'jug par shog/ //117——1134
